dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis ngo snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur nyi dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad snyelas brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i ming gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar :snas gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che sdos(//spung go'i bod rig pa dpe sgrun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ snye 'brel rgyal khab /bag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mjad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mjad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang nga pa ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung 1

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskur gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tsho la bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma snar lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las dar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser la khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyog sgrig khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla blta pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdu sgrig gsal nga yand/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus la dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum ming gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phru' par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (ka) (kha) rtoganaṭha ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) (cha) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ji she (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags ta) ste rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags (ta)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags 9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags smyon)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos chan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags 6)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) khu mi (tshan ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza/ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma rtong)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' 11la ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lha'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la pra klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'brul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ ratna'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi bande zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'brungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ni'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bcin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khrag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa g.yin don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ba khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'chos ba phyog sgrig khang nas/10

dkar 'tshanaza hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'di snang 'brul pa'i rol rtsed rtogs brjod kyi tshul du bkod pa du kū la'i gos bzang las glegs bam gnyis pa/ (1)bstan srid bde thabs kyi rim gro sogs dgung lo zhe dgu'i skabs kyi mdzad rim khag (1)dgung 61 lnga bcu par 'bras spungs su bzhugs ring gi gnas tshul dang / 'phan po khul du chab tshan la phebs pa bcas kyi skor/ (12)dgung lo nga gcig par bod khams bde thabs dang tshogs gsog gi ched du rdzong gzhis khag nas bka' 'gyur sogs rim gro bsgrubs pa'i skor/ (38)dgung lo nga gnyis par sde srid 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs dang / chos thebs gsar sprod dang byas can khag la sa ris bdag rkyen gnang ba/ ser 'bras kyi nang rten gsar bzhengs bcas kyi skor/ (59)dgung lo nga gsum par bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs dang tshogs gsog tu dmigs te khra 'brug dang yum bu bla mkhar gyi rgya phibs gsar bzhengs dang / zangs ri ba blo bzang mthu stobs sde srid du bskos pa bcas kyi skor/ (101)dgung lo nga bzhi par lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi chos rgyal lha khang dang o rgyan lha khang gi nang rten gsar bzhengs dang / gser thog zhig gso/ bka' 'gyur brgya tshar sgrog pa bcas kyi skor/ (127)

dgung lo nga lnga par ra mo che gtsug lag khang zhig gso'i thog nang rten mchod rdzas rgya phibs dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs dang / bstan 'dzin dā la'i han rgyal por bskos pa/ thang po che sogs su gser chos kyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa bcas kyi skor/ (147)dgung lo nga drug par rin chen rgyan cha ba'i srol gsar du btsugs shing lha sa ru bzhi'i spyi tshogs nas rims bzlog gi ched du ser 'bras sogs dgon khag zhe dgu nas rim gro dang / gdan yig zhib mo rnam dag me long rtsom 'bri gnang ba bcas kyi skor/ (177)dgung lo nga bdun par ra mo che gtsug lag khang gi nang rten dang ldebs bris sogs la tshon gsol bzhengs bkod dang / 'dus sde khag la chos rgyun rim gro btsugs shing zhwa dmar sprul sku sogs phyogs 'grul ltos cher mjal 'phrad mdzad pa sogs kyi skor/ (228)dgung lo nga brgyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung dang / lugs zung gi blang dor mu thi la'i 'khri shing mdzad cing 'bras spungs mchod khang chen mor bka' 'gyur sogs rten mchod gsar bsgrigs gnang ba bcas kyi skor/ (276)dgung lo nga dgu par sde par sku rten dngos chas sa ris dang bcas pa stsal ba dang / po tā la dang chos 'khor rgyal gyi zhig gsos/ sde srid blo bzang sbyin pa sde srid kyi khri la 'khod pa bcas kyi skor/ (319)

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)no༅༅/ /za hor gyi bande ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'di snang 'khrul pa'i rol rtsed rtogs brjod kyi tshul du bkod pa du kū la'i gos bzang las glegs bam gnyis pa bzhugs/bstan srid bde thabs kyi rim gro sogs dgung lo zhe dgu'i skabs kyi mdzad rim khag /༄༅/ /hor zla lnga pa'i tshes dgu la yar 'brog sde srid ri bo brag pa kun dga' tshe brtan stobs rgyal gyis tshogs chas dngos po tshan grangs su bstab pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad de/ gra tshang nas gra pa nyi shu skor gyis 'bras ljongs dag snang ma'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga la brten ring por gnas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs skabs gdan khri 'gul nges shes pa'i sa g.yos pa po ta lar yod pa gzhan rnams kyis ma tshor/ 'bras spungs su phal cher kha mthun par shes shing rong po 'dam du yon chab sogs kyang bo ba byung zhes se chen dbon po gleng / mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tshogs khro dang chu khro gsar blug re/ gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pas khur khur ba'i tshogs khro gsar blug gnyis rnams kyi zhal byang bris/ me rgan ji nong dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i mgyogs bsngo rten 'byor zhing bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs byas/(2na)rgyal gling mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis 'phyong rgyas skya ser spyi tshogs kyi ngag 'don smon lam dgos tshul bris shing ri bo bde chen/ spyan g.yas/ thang po che/ dpal ri sgrub sde/ 'phyos bkra shis bde chen/ lam rim pa/ chos 'khor steng pa/ drung gzims skya ser rnams lhan cig pas — 1 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)snam phrug gtso bor gyur pa'i ster cha spams bstod de ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrig par 'byor/ ri bo bde chen pas bla ma mchod pa dang 'brel ba'i smon lam shis brjod rgyas par gsungs/ sang nyin lha ldan ru bzhi spyi tshogs dang rmi ru bas gos dar gtso bor gyur pa'i dngos po bteg nas brtan par gnas pa'i smon lam dang shis pa brjod/ tshes bcu ba dang rmi ru bas so so'i lugs kyi 'cham brgyab/bra yag sprul sku khams su thon gdong rigs gsum mgon po/ gdugs dkar/ phyag drug pa/ las gshin sogs nyer mkho'i rjes (2ba)gnang kha shas dang lam rim gyi 'khrid gsar rtsom gyi lung bklags/thams cad mkhyen pa bus mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i las chog gi lung dgos tshul nan che'ang ma thob pas byed thebs ma byung / rjes su khyab bdag zhwa lu bar zhu ba'i bskul mar song thon gdong ster cha cher mdzad cing rdzong ba'ang bzabs/ rwa bsgreng mkhan po mnga' ris pa byon pa'i zang zing gi dngos po mang du bstabs/ 'jig rten bde thabs su bsam yas nas chos skyong chen pos rten bzheng dang mchod rten 'og tu mnan pa rgyag dgos tshul stag rtse tha'i jir bslab ston mdzad pas byed lugs kyi dri ba dang gzungs bzhugs kyi byin rlabs rten len par btang byung ba stod hor sogs bod kyi bde skyid 'phrog pa'i mtha' dmag gnon lugs dang byin rlabs rten bstan pa spyi bye brag ris su ma phye ba'i gang mang phul/ phur pa dbu dgu byang gter ma gtogs gzhan la mi yong 'dug cing gter gzhud la zhal gyi kha dog mi gsal ba'i gsung rgyun la bltos dgos pa snang bas tho dgos na bsrings chog tshul 'phrin lan du song rung phur pa dbu dgu spo bo 'dud 'dul rdo rje'i zog chos de nas bzhengs 'dug pa lha bzo pa rnams mdzub mo'i gron kho nar song / bkra shis ljongs chos rje dang sems dpa' chen po'i sprul sku la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang phul/'bras spungs sngags khang gi gra khang du rgyal ba btsong kha pa la 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ kun rig rnam par snang (3na)mdzad/ tshe dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ phyag drug pa/ las gshin phyi nang gsang gsum/ dmag zor ma/ dpal —2

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadalha/ yang gha bza'/ gnas chung chos rgyal/ sgo gdong la rgyal chen bzhi/ seng g.yabs la gnas bcu rnams 'dri ba'i shog khra bkod/ sde pas de thog 'khrungs rabs gra tshar gyi zhal bkod mdzad 'dugado dam sde pa 'dar gzhen ngag dbang 'phrin las dang sgo sper ba byams pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ ri mo ba sprul sku dgos nor gyis gtsos pa'i nyi shu tham pas zla ba gsum gyi bar legs par bsgrubs/zla smad du bsnyen mtshams pa rnams kyis so so'i sbyin sreg gi chog khrigs dgos tshul byung ba phur pa mkhan po bka' brgyad dang lhan du sbyin sreg byed pa'i brtsis kyi bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rigs 'dzin kunda'i 'dod 'jo/ tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun dang drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi me lce'i 'phreng ba/ zhar byung yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ lhan thabs rigs 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs/ drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po rnams kyi chog khrigs byas/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la a pa la'i gyi dpon mo sa'i khan jus dngos po stong phrag tu longs pa byin/ skam po yum pa'i gra pa zhig dang mdog lhun sdings sman grong nor gling pa'i bu gnyis kyi gso dpyad rgyud bzhi/ thod ri dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling gra pa bzhis lam rim chen mo dang gsar rtsom dbu phar/ gra (3ba)tshang chos 'bor gling gi gra pa zhig gis dbu ma'i rgyugs rnams sprad/ spyi sgos kyi rim gror phur rgyal bod kyi lha sde mi sder mchod sbyin gyi gtan deb bkod pa'i 'go brjod bris/rgyal po dang o chir thu tha'i ji gnyis kyis bka' 'gyur bzheng skabs nang so dkon dar bas bskul ba'i dpon yig rnams kyi ngag 'don smon lam brtsams/ lhun gling pa blo bzang nor bus pa shi tshor snyan ngag bslabs tshul gyi yig lan rgyan gyis spras pa bsrings/hor zla bdun pa'i tshes 'gor brgyud ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang rnams kyi zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i chos skyong gi rten thugs rdzas sngags 'khor lo bskyed sgrub kyi man ngag khyad par can gyi sgo nas rdo rje slob dpon brag sna chos rje blo bzang ngag dbang dang do dam mchod dpon pas byas te gsang sngags —3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)pho brang gi steng du btsugs/ srung ma'i tshogs dgyes nyams kyis byin chags shing khyad par thang lha'i rten thug gi skabs kha char 'dres ma'i bu yug 'tshubs pas rten 'brel legs par 'grig /tshes bcu bzhi la drung 'khor skya bo rnams dang hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la yar stod/ pho brang / gri gu gsum gyi tshogs chas bdog pa dang 'gyed cher bteg ste gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor brten nas tshe chog dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel rgyas par bsgrigs/ gri gu gzhis sdod tshe bdag gis bskul ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad bris/ sngags rams pa nor bu chos 'phel dang yar 'brog pa blo gros rgyal (4na)ba gnyis la 'jam dpal gshin rje me'i spu gri'i rnon po nang gcod kyi smin byed dang 'jam dpal zhi drag gi bsnyen pa sgrub pa chen po las sbyor dang bcas pa'i bsnyen mtshams yongs su rdzogs pa chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyi phyag bzhes thun mong ma yin pa bzhin zhib tu khrid cing 'jam dpal zhi ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas mngon sum du ston pa'i lag bcangs brtsams/ de dang lhan du sngags pa blo bzang don grub la gter kha 'og ma'i rta nag gi dbang dang las byang chog khrigs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor byas nas bsnyen mtshams bsdam bcug /bcu gcig la gdan sa chen po dga' ldan nas khri rin po che gdan zur/ byang rtse chos rje rnams kyis dbu mdzad gra slob brgya skor phebs te gos phyi nang gis gtsos pa'i dngos po'i maṇḍal bshams te mi 'gyur bar brtan pa'i smon lam dang bkra shis brjod cing me tog gi char phab/ dpon slob tshor dmigs brtse ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bla ma mchod pa gsar rtsom gyi lung phul/ gong nas gser yig tu mngags pa'i gdugs dkar lha khang gi sbyor ra chi dge slong dang / cha gan bla ma'i dbon po blo bzang dpal 'byor gnyis kyi slar 'grul pa mang tsam 'byor/nyer gsum la bka' shog gnang sbyin sprad/ sang nas rim bzhin mi sna sogs 'grul pa rnams kyis ster sbyin mang du byung / rgyal po'i sku zhang khor ching bing thu dbang gi bsngo rten dbyar dgun gyi gon pa cha 'grig lnga dang gser dngul gos dar gser sgas gtsos (4ba)pa'i bdog pa rgya cher bstabs —4

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanashing rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur bsngos/ gsang sngags pho brang gi sbug tu rgyal po dang tse'u dmar ba'i mdos/ mtshams khang shod kyi gza' khang du khyab 'jug gi mdos nag btsugs pa'i tshe khyab 'jug dang btsan ya ba skya bdun gyi mdos kyi chog khrigs byas shing tshugs pa'i khyab 'jug chen po'i lhongs kyis 'brug dang ser chol gyi gnam ngo'i rnam pa'ang che bar byung /'brug pa sprul sku dpon slob dang bde chen chos 'khor ba snum rtse sprad pa 'brug pas ma thon pa'i chags 'jig la gyar ba dngos gzhi dgongs yangs gnang ba'i phyi bsdoms la nang rten khrod nas chos dbang rin po che'i gter ma'i ga me gu ru'i lcags sku bya sa'i nang rten khyad 'phags me thub mar grags pa/ grub thob rin dpal gyis skyon du byon skabs sha za mkha' 'gro'i rdo char gyis bcag dus rlung gis rang 'byar du song ba'i dbu thod/ zhwa dmar nag gi mtho gang tsam gyi gas lar khyad mtshar du brtsi ba de dag gis bskrun du med pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che sa rgya nag nas gdan drangs pa'i gas la dang dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dang chos rje de bzhin gshegs par byung ba'i shel tham las khyad du che ba'i ye pha'u las grub pa'i 'phags pa'i bka' shog gnyis gtsang rong zlos mtshams kyi lab gter 'brug pas pa rnam lo shas bzung skabs gdan sa gong nas dbang shed kyis blangs pa sogs nang rten mang tsam ba zhes pa pho brang yas mas tshor bzhugs/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i dpon slob kha (5na〉nas kyi bdog pa dang yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro ba'i smon lam bkra shis kyis mtha' brten pa rgyas par mdzad/ dben sa sprul skus bdog pa'i yon sbyar ba'i gra tshang nas nyung bsdus kyis mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bsu zlog tshigs bcad ma btang / thar gling bla ma mtsho smad sngags rams pasadakar shākya grags kyi thugs dam rten gur zhal gyi sman sku byin rlabs can rjes su sman 'dam las grub pa'i rgyan drug gur mgon gyi zhal 'bag byin can sogs rim gyis byung /hor zla dgu pa'i tshes lnga la phan bde legs bshad gling par gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags ring bzlog pa dang bcas pa bye ba/ de mtshungs 'gong po ar la gtad pa'i rim gro btsugs/—5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa dang rong dga' ldan byams pa gling gnyis nas tshan grangs dang bcas mi 'gyur brtan pa'i smon lam shis brjod mdzad par grangs bcad cig 'byor/ a yo shi'i phyi rten du mi 'khrugs pa dang ji nong gi dge rtsar mchod rten bzhengs pa'i gzungs phul/ dbyangs can bya ka ra ṇa'i rtsa ba lha mthongs lo tsā ba bshes gnyen rnam rgyal gyis ming le'i phyed tsam bsgyur ba 'phror lus/ rjes su rtag brtan sprul sku kun dga' snying po rgya gar phal skad la byang bas paṇḍi ta ba la bha dra la brten nas rtsa bar 'gyur mdzad pa legs sbyar la sbyangs stobs zhan pas 'gyur skyon mang gshis/ 'dar pa lo tsā ba rtsa ba bsgyur du bcug cing rtag brtan pa'i bod 'grel des grul ma btub pa nas gzhan ma'i bod 'grel khungs ma (5ba)med pa dang bcas slob dpon a nu bhū ti rū pa tsams mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rab tu bya ba gsal ldan yang phyogs mtshungs par gsar 'gyur byed par bskul pa lo 'di'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas 'go btsugs pa dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor thog zin par dbyangs can brda sprod bstan pa rgyas pa'i bden tshig brjod pa/ tre po hor tshang ta'i si tu'i thugs dam du sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i brgyud 'debs/ ma ṇi ril sgrub gsar ma phyogs kyi khungs ma rnyed rung chos rje don rgyam pa'i ngo ma chogs pa'i lag len mthong tshor skyor zlos/ dge slong 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i cha gan no mo khan gyi sprul sku'i brtan bzhugs rnams bris/ bsnyen rdzogs brgya zhe drug dang dge tshul brgya so bdun bsgrubs/ bcu dgu la rigs kun bdag po zha lu mkhan chen phebs/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes drug gi bar bcad rgya'i khong nas bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti dang rnam sras kyi be'u bum sogs zab chos mang du zhus/ mkhan rin po cher 'phrang 'go gter ston gyi tshe rta zung 'brel dang byad 'grol phul/ gsol phogs dang bcas dgun gyi ring gong dkar chos sder sku mtshams la phebs/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bsod nams mchog grub kyi snag dbon tshangs rigs 'dzin pa'i dbang po legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa sogs bslab 'dod 'dug pa bstan rgyun la —6

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanaphan par bsams te 'dar pa lo tsā ba bslab tu bcug pa'i lo lnga'i bar gyi ja thug phogs sogs kyi mthun rkyen (6na〉grir/ bar khams dang mtsho kha phyogs su 'brum nag yod tshul byung bar nged rang gis nad bdag stobs 'joms dang brag sna chos rjes gtsos pa'i gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis lha sa nas 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bzlog pa dang 'brel ba'i zor 'phangs pas nad mtshams chod pa'i 'phrod lam che bar byung / des mtshon snga phyi du mar stod smad tshor mched par nye ba'i 'brum rims la 'di ga nas btang ba dang phyogs so so'i sngags 'chang rnams byed du bcug pa'i mdos zor kha bsgyur tshos phan thogs tsam byung bar mngon gter sgrom nas chu tshan blangs pa'i zhag bdun gyi bar 'phrod bsten byas te nyi shu'i nyin rgya nag gi mi sna tshor skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob rnams kyi rjes gnang byas/ phyi dro mi sna gzhen pas gtsos pa'i bsnyen rdzogs so lnga dang dge tshul zhe lnga bsgrubs/ sang nyin gling stod chos rje dkon cog dpal 'byor/ tsha mig mkhan po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bya gzhongs mkhan po/'chad ka spyan snga/ chos rje shel brag pa/ co ne me rgan chos rje/ ldan ma ra nyag sku skye/ lcam mda' bla ma sogs phrad mi mang / gling stod chos rje de dge bshes che bar ma zad thugs dam smin pa zhig snang /chos rje bco brgyad par gsar rtsom mtshar chen gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / 'bri gung nag shod bla ma 'phyos pa sku skyer rgyal gsol 'phrin las don bcu ma'i lung bklags/ brag dbar slob (6brko pon pas 'phel gdung / kha thun e jes gos dar ja dngul bstar zhing grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur/zal dkar dbon pos gser thums lag mgo tsam/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gser sku rgyal gyi dngul gdung gi bzo phud la drung nas gsung rab pas bzhengs pa rje bsod nams rgya mtshos al than rgyal po'i bla ma ga ru 'bul dpon la bum chu dang sbrags gnang / de'i tsha bos byang gling rab 'byams pa bde mchog bya khyung gdan sar yod skabs byin pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas byin/ bsnyen rdzogs so drug dang dge tshul phyed nyis brgya bsgrubs/ mtsho kha nas bdud 'dul dka' bcu 'jigs med sgra dbyangs —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'byor/ nyin mang po'i bar khams pa gsar rnying gi gleng mo zhib tu byung /nyer bzhi la ring 'tsho'i bdog pa spel bar sde drug spyi so'i gnyer pa dang mkhan po'i dbon po/sgam po sprul sku'i mgron gnyer rnams 'byor/ gong gi mi sna gzhen pa dang bdud 'dul dka' bcu ba gnyis la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas gsungs pa'i gdugs dkar dang skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang bskur/ yar 'brog bsam sdings sprul sku/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod pa/ ka tshal bla ma rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ nag shod dbon nag bla ma rnams dang phrad/ hor lha rgyal dar gyi bu'i skra phud blangs shing ming blo bzang phun tshogs su btags/shel dkar chos sde'i bla ma gra pa lnga bcu skor dang 'bri gung shag ram bla ma rnams phyogs mthun du bdog pa bstar ba'i ring por 'tsho ba'i smon lam gyi gsol 'debs byas/ (7na)gong gi yig mkhan slob gnyer ba san chag pa shi'i kha ton du gsol 'debs smon lam bor kho pa shi'i yi dam du 'jam dkar gyi sgrub thabs/ dpon mo sa'i khan thu'i ngag 'don du bdun rnam dag smon lam dang bcas pa/bsod nams sgrol ma'i kha tan du gsol 'debs smon lam rnams bris/ zhad ston sku mdun lhun grub dang bstan rgyal gnyis kyis hor nang nas 'khor ba'i dkor phu sno rta nyi shu dang gnag phyugs sum cu tsam byung / gnam gang la dpon mo sa'i khan ju dang mi sna gzhen par phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la rgyal po 'khor bcas byang nas phebs pa dang mjal/bsnyen rdzogs gsum dang dge tshul lnga bsgrubs/ ja'i sang bi chi'i bsngo rten ja gos dar rta sogs 'byor bar bsngo bas rgyas btab/ mi sna rgan par tshe dbang gdugs dkar gyi rjes gnang byas/tshes gnyis la gser yig pa gnyis la rdzong ba dang gong du zhu yig 'bul bar star sdong dka' bcu blo bzang rab brtan dang dogs bde lho mos rgyab pa blo bzang dar rgyas gnyis btang / pa shi rnams kyi yon tan bslab dgos grub pa'i so so'i 'dod sbyar gyi dpe cha dang zang zing gi ster sbyin —8

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)bzabs te phyogs mthun du slog shar khang no mon khan khal kha nas 'khor ba phyogs med kyi 'gro don skyong rgyu ma byung 'dug pas rnyed pa'ang de dang 'dra/ 'on kyang khong rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i bdog pa'i dngos po dpangs bstod pa bstabs(7ba)ji nong gi bsngo rten du gon pa/ khrab/ rmog mda' gzhu/ sag thag /me mda'/ shal dkar dmar/ gser dngul/ ja gos dar/ gur/ rta/ rnga mo sogs tshan che bar bstar/ skyid shod kyi lcam a snying gi skra phud blangs dge tshul du bsgrubs/ ji nong gi byang bzhu byas pa'i brtag par lhar skye ba'i mtshan ma shar/ bzhi la no mon khan gyis sbyin bdag mdzad de tshogs 'khor ster cha 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang gis tshe chog btang / de nas zhag gsum gyi bar bcad rgya byas o rod nas o chir thu tha'i ji dang g.yon ru cho khur o ba shi dpon chung sum cu tsam ser mo ba dang dmangs bcas stong phrag brgal ba/ se ra byes 'phrin las lhun grub kyi sku skye/ u rang mkhan gyi shi ta dha er khe'i nu bo/ bu thug sen khu thug thu can brgya skor rnams dang phrad/tshes dgu la khal kha nom chi a kha'i dang de'i nu bo bkra shis lhun po dkyil khang bla ma'i sku skye gnyis kyis stong 'bul/ sku skye'i phyag mdzod gnyer pa chos rje bsam grub rgya mtsho'i brgya 'bul/ tsha ba sku skye/ er khe chos rje/ u /we re tha'i ji gsum gyi mi sna/ sde pa thob pa bkra shis rab brtan yum sras/nyin byed gling pa'i bla ma gzung 'dzin/ gra thang mkhan po'i dbon po dang spyi pa/ a chi mgon po/ bde chen tha'i ji lha'i dbang phyug stong shong a'i sogs bod sog mchog dman du ma dang phrad/ rgyal po dang o chir thu tha'i ji gnyis kyis bka' 'gyur thang po cher bzhengs pa grub pa'i bsu ba ser sbreng / sbyin bdag khag gnyis dpon g.yog nyis brgya skor dang bcas po (8na)ta la'i tshoms chen du gdan drangs par shis brjod rgyas par byas/ mkhan po sku skyes er te ni gu shri/ ta 'on ba ga bla ma/ tho yon dge slong rnams kyis zang thing gi bdog pa bstabs/ dpon mo sa'i khan ju dang a yo shi'i dpon po dge tshul ma gnyis la 'pho 'khrid kyi dmigs pa phab/ dge tshul mar bzang spyod dang dmigs brtse ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung byas/ byes pa sku skyes gser gyi mdong mo dang ka to ra bzang gos kyis thog —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)grangs stong 'bul bteg /tshes bcu gcig nom chi a kha'i dang dkyil khang sku skye gnyis la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang /thugs rje chen po gar gyi dbang phyug gi rjes gnang / skyabs 'gro sgos bskyed/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig /rgyan drug ma/ thub dbang zhal pad ma/ blo bzang rgyal ba ma rnams kyi lung byas/ sku skyes gtsos pa bcu skor dge tshul du bsgrubs/ shal dkar dmar dang snam phrug sogs kyi rdzong ba bstabs/ sku skye rgya bod hor gsum gang du 'gro'ang phan thogs kyi lam yig sprad/ shel dkar rdzong sdod sbyar ra dngos grub la nang rten gyi bse sgam hor bse lugs gra tshar bzo bcug pa dngos gtsang zhing sgo lcags dang bcas gra 'grig par 'byor/ da'i 7 kho sho 'a dpon mo dpon wo shes rab/ mgon po pā thur/ she'i jin nang so rnams kyis bdog pa bteg /tha'i ji/ o pa shi dpon mo bcas par stobs bzhi'i bshags pa'i lung / grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / shi ta dha er ge /dpon mo phun tsho gis sgrol ma/ dpon chung bcas stong (8ba)phrag phyed gnyis lhag la skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang bskur/tshes bco lnga la u rang khon gyi da'i chin o pa shi de'i nu bo thug sen khu thug thus gos dar gser dngul gyis gtsos pa'i stong 'bul byas/ bo lo sus gtsos pa'i bcu skor bsnyen ri rdzogs/ a chi mgon po sa khyi sgo sna shag pa'i g.yo thabs kyis bde skyid pa'i bu mo len bcug pa phrug gu gnyis tsam dang 'brel ba bstan gzhung la bsam nas bzhag pa'i sngar 'gyod phyis sdom bstan pa'i don du srog la'ang 'phangs pa mi phyed ces kho rang blos bcad kyis bro bor/ du ri yal kho sho chi'i dpon mo rgan pa dge tshul ma byang nas 'byor ba dang phrad/ sbyar ra drung 'tsho dngos grub kyis bskul ba'i bdag bstod 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ o chir thu tha'i ji sku na mthos pa'i dpe 'dzin mang po dka' ba'i stabs tshig nyung zhing don tshang ba zhig dgos tshul dang bstun pa'i stobs bzhi'i bshags pa/ cho khur o pa shis bskul ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung ngu / drung yig lcang gseb 'jam dpal gyis gung thang lha mo lcags phur ma dang / drung yig dar rgyas bkra shis kyis dung skyong rgyal mor 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar zhal yig — 10

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanadagos zer ba rnams bris/ khro phu slob dpon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis thub pa thog thub ma'i rten dang bcas snyan ngag gi 'phrin yig byung ba'i de lan bsrings/ nyi ldog gi mtshams grol nyin spong rong bsod mgon gyis 'bras zan sha mar thud sogs stod 'brog lugs kyi ston mo btang / mtshams khag rnams (9na)kyang btsugs/spyi sger gyi rim gror hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du rdzong gzhis dgu bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar drug cu/ 'bum brgya bzhi/ brgyad stong pa/ bskal bzang / thar pa chen po gsum stong rtsa re/ dkon brtsegs dang ting 'dzin rgyal po brgya rtsa re/ gra sa phan tshun du ja tshul bcu/ phyugs lug brgya'i srog blu/ri mgo brgya la dar lcog /la btsas sum cu kha gsos/ phyi mtshams khog nas stag rtse tha'i ji dang mjal/ khal kha nom chi a kha'i gtsang nas 'khor ba'i thang kha zhig dgos tshul sde par zhus pa thang dmangs khrod du 'tshol dgos lugs byung ba ltar mchod dpon pa btang bas rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i shangs mtshal ma'i sku thang rgyab tu dkar chag bris pa shin tu rnying pa'i byin rlabs can nar ma nyan gyi gras su byas te thang dmangs khrod du'ang ma chud par bskyur te bzhag pa zhig rnyed nas khyer byung ba ring por ma lon par dbang gi chu bo gsos pa'i rten 'brel ya mtshan par mngon/ de'i dus nam mkha' dwangs pa la 'ja' sprin srab cing phra ba mang du 'khrigs pa byung / dpon mo phun tshogs sgrol ma/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho can la bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi rjes gnang bskur zhing nyer dgu'i zhogs smyung gnas kyi gso sbyong phab/ zla mtshams la khal kha o rod kyi 'grul pa drag rim tshor byin rlabs dang ja gral btang /hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du ngal gso dang sbrags phyi mtshams byas/ ding sang 'brug phyogs su de rigs la thugs bed spyod mkhan yod mdog ma kha yang (9ba)bla ma sku bsrungs pas bsgrubs pa'i 'chi bdag zhal dbye dang rang thag gnyis rgyal me tog thang du gdan drangs na rjes su gleng brjod chung bar mngon pas sngags rams pa byams pa gling pa/ yar 'brog pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ rdo pa blo — 11 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bzang mthu stobs gsum btang ba'i rtsis sgra khang du bzhugs su gsol/dgung lo lnga bcu par 'bras sbungs su bzhugs ring gi gnas tshul dang /'phan po khul du chab tshan la phebs pa bcas kyi skor/dus rim le tshan dang me rta lo gsar gyi dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i rten 'bul thog sa'i khan jus rin po che'i phras brgyan pa'i 'phan cha gcig byung ba de 'phral spyan gzigs su phul/ sog po gzhi byes bsdoms pa stong khrag bzhi tsam dang bod pa rnams la dga' ston gyi bzhugs gral bshams/gsar slebs bal po kho khom rgyal po'i mi sna yod/tshes gnyis la thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku/ bzhad bkra shis thub bstan gyi bla ma/ bkra shis kyi dpon mo/ zangs mtsho bla ma shes rab bzang po/ dwags po sgrom mda' ba/ byum pa/ gra bsam dar ba'i nang mi sogs bod sog mang ba dang phrad/ dpon tshang tsha rong pa'i slob ma gsum gyis rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/ dar rgyas chos sdings kyi gdung brgyud che bas g.ya' ma lung nas gter kha spyan drangs pa'i shog ser/ dam rdzas la ches gnyis rting mar rtog pa bcug pas nges shes 'drongs par byung /glegs bam gyi bka' gtad smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor tsam zhig zhus pa'i snga 'gros khyab bdag sman lung par dbang lung rnams phul ba nas brgyud de zhu dgos 'dug cing slar nas gter kha rim gyis bzhes pa tsho nod 'dun yod tshul gyi snyan gsan phab ste phyir (10na)lam chu bo rir phebs bcug /tshes gsum la dga' ldan khri rin po che blo bzang rgyal mtshan phebs pa dang mjal/ bu thug san khu thug thu la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang phyag drug pa'i bka' bsgo zang zing gi ster cha byas nas brdzangs/sna dkar rtse zhabs drung dang mjal zhing gsung 'phros 'phel ba'i chad cig byung / bsam yas chos skyong chen pos mgo brnyan gyi tog yod pa'i rgyal mtshan mang tsam bzo rtsis yin par rked khrar 'os pa'i — 12

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanagos chen dgos gsung ba phul zhing las bcol gyi 'phron yig tshigs bcad dang bcas lcang gling pa bsod nams dbang po btang /tshes bzhi nas bzung phyi mtshams khog gong dkar nas khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po phebs pa'i kye rdor rgyu dbang lam dbang sogs dbang / byin rlabs/ rjes gnang / lung man ngag mang du zhus/mkhan rin po che'i bkas bskul ba'i nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'chi med dpal ster gyi brgyud 'debs/gshed dmar gyi brgyud 'debs thugs sras lo tsā bas gnang ba'i kha skong rnams sbyar/ rnyed bkur 'bul nod gya nom pa bstabs te zha lur phebs/byams pa gdan 'dren gyi nyin kha ba shin tu che bas ser sbreng ba dang chos skyong gi spyan gzigs tsho spangs pa'i ri klungs kun dkar por song ba zhig byung ba tshang ma sngar 'di 'dra yong ma myong zer yang de nas bzung lo gnyis kyi bar mchod yon rnams sku tshe brtan zhing dus gzings mu ge nad yams 'dra cher ma byung bas mi lod dam snyam yang ha cang gi yun ma song bas the tshom gyi gzhir snang / dge slong rnam (10ba)rgyal dpal bzang dang snye thang pa blo gros rnam rgyal gnyis kyis gsang ba rin chen 'dus pa dang rgyal dar gong pa bshes gnyen dar rgyas kyi las khyung gi bsnyen pa byed par dmigs pa dang phyag len khrid cing khyung gi las byang zhig kyang brtsams/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum gyi mig dmar dbyu gu'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin o chir thu tha'i ji/ cho khur o ba shi/ dpon mo sa'i khan pu stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras/ bdud 'dul dka' bcu/ dpon chung /mi bzang / drung 'khor sogs bod sog brgyar nye bar nang rten rags rim gyi mjal kha btang / drug brgya ba dkon cog tshe dbang gis nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bris pa'i thang kha'i rgyab yig dang dpon po gra rigs rnams kyis bskul nas bla ma btsan po don grub rgya mtsho skye srid myur 'dzin gyi smon lam bris/tshes lnga la cho khur o pa shis sbu la ga ba'i nang byas pa'i ber gyis gtsos pa'i gos sna/ mu tig las bzos pa'i se ral kha/ zhwa phod/ gos dar/ ja dngul sogs stong 'bul bteg pa'i thog chos rje — 13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)pha bong kha pa dang 'phan yul gsas khang dgon pa'i gra pa kha shas kyis smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba'i dpon mo shes rab sgrol mas bskal brgyar bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhes dgos zhes nan du se chen dbon pos lo tsā byas zer bar ngo 'dzin tsam du khas blangs/ sna dkar rtse zhabs drung / lha gang ke ru'i zhabs drung snying snying / gnyal sha gzugs sku skye che chung / yang dgon spyan snga/ sang sing bla ma/ zangasamatsho bla ma/ 'bri gung yang ri bla ma/ sde pa thon pa bkra shis rab (11na)brtan/ dpal de ras chen/yar 'brog glang lung bla ma/ 'ba' rdzong sdod skyid sbug pa dang gsar byung la sogs rdzong sdod kha shas/'phan yul rgyal smad pa/ rgyang ro gser sdings pa rnams dang phrad/ gzer chen nas kyis gtsos gtsang gi lding dpon sum cu/ lding 'og brgya skor 'ongs pa spyi bsdus kyis bdog pa bstar ba'i brtan sdod chab mdo 'phags pa lha'i dngos po'i tshan grangs skyel bar rtags brgyad can/ a chi mgon po dpon mo gnyis kyis brgya 'bul gyis mtshon pa'i phrad mi shin tu mang / cho khur o pa shi'i mi ngo rnams la tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ sgro chir thu tha'i ji dpon g.yog brgyad cu skor la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/ phun tshogs sgrol mar phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang dang bzang spyod sogs chos spyod thor bu'i lung / u rang khan shi ta dha er khe spun la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel/ de'i bu mo can bco lnga tsam dge tshu 'ji du bsgrubs/ lcog dkar tre bo sprul skur dge tshul gyi sdom pa phab/ gung thang chos khri bla ma jo gdan rab stims pa/ zur ri bla ma/ nyi thang slob dpon/ mdo mkhar chos sde'i bla ma rnams dang phrad/ tsha ba sku skye'i gra pa rab 'byams pa dge 'dun dar rgyas kyis brgya 'bul dang sol thon tha'i shi'i dka' bcu bas 'phen legs pa bcus gtsos pa byin/ se ra byes sku skyes/ ji nong gi nu mo shu khu/ thon bkra shis rab brtan ming sring / g.yon ru tshe ring gi tsha mo/ kha thun e jes thog drangs mi grangs brgya skor la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / thon pa sger (11ba)du 'jigs byed za ma tog gi lung /lcam gyi skra phud blangs/tshes dgu la dpon mo sa'i khan thur 'pho ba'i 'khrid bskyar nas phab/ hor dpon btsun chung gi bu lus bsgyur cing skra phud blangs/ tshes bcu la byes pa sku skye/ dpal de ras chen/ rtse chen nas/ gzer — 14

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadachen nas/ legs gling nas/ byang gling rgyal po rnams la nyang lugs drag po me'i spu gri'i dbang / sgo mangs slob dpon ga ru ba/ tsha ba sku skye'i rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bkra shis/ sol thon tha'i shi'i dka' bcu/ a chi mgon po sogs mi grangs phyed nyis brgya la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur/ bsnyen rdzogs go gsum dang / dge tshul brgya bdun bsgrubs/ stod rgyud gra dmangs la byin rlakhas byas/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la o chir thu tha'i jis wa nag mjing bsgrigs kyi thul bas gtsos gos sna/ ja gos dar/ gser dngul gyi stong 'bul bteg /khyab bdag sman lung pa phebasapa'i zhag kha yar gyi bar stan 'jags/ g.ya' ma lung gi gter gsar rigs 'dzin thugs tig gi dbang lung sogs chos bka' kha shas zhus/hor zla bzhi pa'i sgrub mchod kyi stabs nas chu bo rir phebs/ tshogs gsog tu rdzong gzhis bcu bzhi bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar brgya dang lnga/ mtshan brjod sum 'bum/ tshe chog bzhi/ lha sa/bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu rnams su brgya mchod sna lnga/ gser chab/ spyan 'byed/ khrus gsol/khro rol gsum/ 'char ku'i mdos gcig /mnan pa gnyis/(12na)btson dong thar lnga/ phyugs lu ga drug cu'i srog blu/ dge 'dun/ rgan rgon/ sprang po/ byis pa/ nya/ bya rog /khyi rnams la ston mo/ mchod rten la sku dkar/ lam zam zhig gsos/ tshe dpag med dang / sgrol dkar gyi stong thang / gtor ma 'bum ther/ srong btsan du bkang brgya/ ma mo gling bzhi dang ma tre gi mdos/ bon gyi gto chog sna chags btang /dga' ldan dngul gdung rin po che'i gser thog zhig gsos rim par 'byung 'dug kyang ri mthos pa'i rlung gzan skyon bzhin yin nam 'phral 'phral gogs pa'i gshis da la'i hung tha'i jis lhag bsam rnam dag gis kun nas bslangs sbyin bdag mdzad pa'i gser gtos che ba bskur na'ang cung zad ma ldangs par gzhung nas gser gyi snon ma dang mchod khang la chu'i thigs pas mi gnod pa'i — 15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 'dekhyad kyis rgya bskyed pa'i phyogs rer rgyug mtho drug cu re gnyis pa gru bzhi dpangs la rgyug mtho zhe gnyis yod par gser thog byings dang mi 'dra ba'i padmas bteg pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis/ shang shang gnyis/ bum pa/ 'khor lo/ padma/ rdo rje bzhi brtsegs pa rnams 'phral du legs pa dang shes byed kyi khungs sogs med 'dra yang chos sde'i rigs la bsgyur bkod mangs na mi shis pa zhig byung tshe khag yod gin 'dug pa'i stabs sde pas kyang bzo rnying pa sor bzhag pa'i zangs mkhar rgya'i khal chig stong nyis brgya drug cu/ gser dbus zho bzhi stong brgyad brgya/ dngul chu zho nyi khri sum stong drug brgya/ star bu mkhar rgya'i khal nga drug /dmar (12ba)tshos so gnyis/ lcags khal brgya so drug /rlung dril lnga bcu rnams song ba'i bal po a ma ra sidha dang zangs mgar dbu mdzad sras lhas byin gyis gtsos pa'i lnga bcu nga lnga/ do dam bkras rab chos mdzad dang bla ma ma ṇi ba/ gra sa bas thog drangs shing bzo ba nyi shu rtsa lnga/ do dam khrom sa ba dpal 'byor bkra shis/ gser gsol ba rtse chen pa/ 'dar pa ngag dbang 'phrin las/ mnga' ris drung pa/ zangs brdung la zla ba drug zhang bzo la zla ba bzhi/ gser gsol la zhag nyi shu lhag 'gor ba'i phogs yon ston mo rnams 'bru thog tu dril ba mkha' ru'i khal chig khri chig stong sum brgya brgal ba song / zhing skyong dbang po'i mchod gtor rgyas par btang zhing phal cher phyi mtshams su bsdad/ khyab bdag sman lung pa'i gsan yig gi mchod brjod bris shig par gsung gis bskul ba ltar snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs/gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi spyi tshogs kyis gsol 'debs brtan sdod smon lam ja mchod gang la'ang kha bsgyur chog pa'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba rgya 'bag gi mig ltar 'phrul chog pa/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i gtor sgam zur lcags sgo 'khor gyi tshags ra ma lug gi dngul gra tshang spyi dang gser mchod dbon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bton do dam gnyer pa sbyin pas byas nas bsgrubs pa'i kha byang rnams bris/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la rgyal po gter kha gong ma'i drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu — /6

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadargyud/ rgyal mo gnyis/ o chir thu tha'i ji/(13na)jong gar tshe ring / a chi mgon po rnams la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur/ g.yon ru da'i chen kho lo che'i skye ba/ brag dbar gra tshang gi slob dpon/ du ri yal khon dzin gyi dar khan em chi/ lho pa bla ma kun legs/ shel dkar chos sde'i slob dpon/ gung thang gzims khang shar bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ khro phu bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ kong po bkra shis cho me gling pa'i bla ma/ de mo sprul sku'i mi sna sogs phrad mi mang du byung / snga sor brgo rgyu bskur ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ dpang lo'i brda sprod gsal ba rtsa 'grel/ rgyal ba btsong kha pas mdzad pa'i 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po rnams zin pa'i par 'byor/ sgyu 'phrul rtsa rgyud/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rigs gnas kun shes dang grub mtha' kun shes kyi rtsa 'grel/ kun mkhyen go bo dang paṇa chen shākya mchog gi lan 'bras spungs chos rje 'jam dbyangs legs chos pa dang se ra rje btsun pa gnyis kyis mdzad pa/ thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i bde gshegs snying po'i mdzes rgyan/ gnas rnying ba rin chen tog gis mdzad pa'i dbang po rdo rje dang rdo rje thog to rnams brko ba'i par byang brtsams shing ma dpe dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du bskur/gong gsal gyi par tsho mkho che bar ma zad rin cen tog gi yi ga cha rnams shin tu dkon pa dang rtag brtan sprul skus gzhan stong gi phyogs 'dzin rgyu'i rmongs zhen gyis mgon po klu sgrub rjes 'brang la skur pa chen po btab (13ba)nas rang gi zhar la skye rgu mang po ngan song du 'khrid pa'i sgo 'gegs pa la phan nam snyam/bcu gsum la sha khang no mon khan can zung du ma gyur pa'i grangs bcad la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang / shel dkar bla ma/ lho pa kun legs/ spyi dpon sum cu/ sa'i khan du/ bdud 'dul bka' bcu/ g.yon du u ra lug kho sho chis gtsos pa'i sum cu lhag la dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang bskur/ no mo mkhan dang btsan po'i gdan sar slob dpon 'phrin las rgya mtsho 'gro bar rdzong ba byas/ bcu bzhi'i thegs sa'i khan sa bdud 'dul dka' bcu/ sa — 17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sgyukechen dbon po gsum la smyung gnas kyi gso sbyong phab/ g.yon ru sku skye rgyal ba rgya mtsho can bsnyen rdzogs zhe brgyad dang dge tshul nga dgu bsgrubs/hor zla lnga pa'i nang du sbyor ra sprul sku yab sras la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang ba ri lugs kyi sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i rjes gnang phul zhing khong dpon slob dang se ra spyi sos dngos po dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung mdzad/ bsam dar nas kyis bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i sde tshan so sor 'dri rgyu'i smon lam dang dkar chag che brjod/ byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i dbon yig tsho'i kha ton byed rgyu'i smon lam dang dkar chag che brjod rnams bris/ gling smad chos rje bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ byams gling mkhan po tshul rgyam pa/ gra thang mkhan po 'phrang 'go chos rje/ sde pa 'bog gong pa rnams dang phrad/po ta la'i rtser sde bas mkhar las gsar du mdzad (14na)brtsis kyi tshes lnga la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su drung 'khor skya ser gyi rta pa sum brgya skor dang bcas phyin pa'i bsu bar 'bras spungs nas bla ma gra rigs phyed nyis brgya brgal ba 'byor/ skyel mar shar pa chos rje/ pha bong kha gdan sa pa/ g.yon ru dang a pa la'i dpon mo can sog ngo brgya zin rin chen sgang klu sdings su 'brang spungs spyi so'i thab bsur rta gzhol ja sbyor gsum btang ba'i dgon par slebs gdong tshogs chen gyi phyag mtshan bsgrengs pa'i ser sbreng gya noms pa dan 'bag dang stod lung mda'i bro gzhas dang khrom che bar snang / chos skyong chen po'ang khog tu zhugs nas zam sner phebs/ pho brang du slebs thog chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa dge steng pas da lam cho ga dang ma 'brel rung mos gus brtan bzhugs yin tshul dang bcas sna tshogs rdo rje'i re ji can gyi ras shig la smon lam btab nas stan 'og tu bcug /de nyin dang tshes drug la slog dpon rnams dang gra pa mang rab ltir ja dang sbrags phrad par byung zhing rgyal sgar pa gra tshang ba yongs rdzogs kong po g.yul rgyal rab brtan gyi chos sder 'degs pa'i sta gon la 'byor ba dang 'grig ste yun du gnas pa'i smon lam btab/— 18

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanatshes bdun gyi nyin tshogs chen du phyin chos sde chen po'i zhabs 'thud rnying khungs nye skor rnams kyis byas pa'i bdog pa rgya cher spel zhing dge 'dun 'dus pas ring por gnas pa'i bden pa brjod/dpon mo shes rab sgrol mas tshe dpag med kyi dkyil thang thags grub dang rin po che'i 'og pag byin/chos skyong chen po'ang khog zhugs su (14ba)phebs/ dge 'dun rnams la byin rlabs byas/ kun dga' ra bar bod sog gzhi byes gtos che bar 'bras spungs spyi so nas dkar spro dmar spro bzabs rgyas dang tshan grangs bstar/ sang nyin grwa thang mkhan po dang gong dkar chos sde ba bla ma gra rigs brgya lhag gis kun dga' ra ba'i tshoms chen du spyi sger gyi bdog pa bteg ste tshe chog dang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ nyin phyi mar chos sde dang dpon slob la paṇḍita gser gdugs can gyi 'jam dkar/ skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo/ bram nag bshan pa drug skor rnams kyi rjes gnang phul/tshes bcu la lha sa spyi sos bdog pa'i dngos po gya nom pa bstar te yun du gnas pa'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ kun dga' ra ba'i tshoms chen du drug brgya tsam dang der ma shong ba bcas stong lhag la byin rlabs dang mdud pa byin/ dan 'bag phu mda'i ma ṇi tshes bcu ba rnams la le'u bdun ma/ nor bu padma'i ljon shing / ma ṇi'i bzlas lung rnams byas/ sbyor ra chos sde'i gra pa zhig gis lam po ti bcu drug /dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa bcus gsar rtsom dbu phar mdzod kyis gtsos pa'i kha shas kyi rgyugs sprad/ sang nyin sgar pa gra tshang par nag po skor gsum dang dmag zor ma'i gtor chog /bkang ba'i lung phul/ bsnyen rdzogs zhe gcig dang dge tshul nga bdun bsgrubs/ chos skyong chen po'i sku khog gis dkar spro rgyas par bteg /sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin kyilas sa bkra shis chos ldan gyi dge ba bsgrubs (15na)pa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i smon lam/ lha sa spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa/ mchod yon gyi brtan bzhugs / 'jig rten bde ba'i smon lam sogs gcig tu 'dus pa/ gra legs pa gling pas ci btab 'grub pa'i smon lam dgos tshul rnams brtsams/ bcu gnyis — 19—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)la phan bde legs bshad gling pas bkra shis khang gsar du byes pa'i thog 'bras spungs kyi las tshan tsho bsnan par dkar spro dmar spro spel ma bzabs shing ster cha rgyas par byung / zhang ston sku mdun lhun grub/ 'bras spungs spyi gnyer/ dge skos/ chos skyong sku khog rnams la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang /sa'i khan thur gsar rtsom gyi sātstsha 'debs chog gi lung byas/ rjes gnang grub 'tshams zhang ston pa'i spyan gyis rab rib gsal du song tshul byung ba cha ma 'tshal/tshes bcu drug la gsang sngags pho brang du mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bkra shis khang gsar dang dbyibs 'dra ba'i gzhi byes tshang mar gzhis len dang gos dar stag sgam gyis sna drangs pa'i ster sbyin bzabs/ glang bu nas 'gyur med kyis phun sum tshogs pa'i bshad pa tshar bzhi tsam 'dabs song ba 'du khang gsar pa'i kha 'bebs la shis pa 'dra/ cho khur o pa shi'i nang mi bzhi/ jong gang tshe ring can la phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel bskur/ bdud 'dul dka' bcu la phyag rdor gos sngon can/ rnam sras smad lugs ser chen lha dgu/ las gshin phyi sgrub sogs 'dod chos ci rigs pa byas shing de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gis gtsos pa'i (15ba)dam rdzas/shal dkar dmar/ 'jam phrug gis thog drangs pa'i rdzong ba gya nom pa bstabs/ dka' bcu ba 'di pa dad zhen che zhing a rig bsam grub ces bdud kyis brlams pa zhig 'bad pa chen pos btul ba dang lhag tu hung tha'i jis gtsos pa'i drag zhan thams cad la zhang tshan gnyis ma 'dra tshul gyi gtam ngo gzung med par btang 'phros snang /bcu dgu la gra tshang dang mchod dpon dbu mdzad thun mong nas tshogs 'khor bzabs rgyas/ rung mthun gyi gos sna sogs ster cha dpangs bstod dang bcas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshe chog rgyas par btang / de'i nub nas zhag bzhi'i bar tshe bsnyen dam par bcad/nyer bzhi la gter sgrom gyi chu tshan blangs pa'i zhag bdun gyi bar mtshams khog tu 'phrod bsten byas/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum la rgyal po/ tha'i ji/ o pa shi/ a chi mgon po can drag rigs la —20—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul dang las gshin phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / sang nyin rgyal po sku rkyang la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dgung grangs/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang / kun dga' ra bar gsang phu chos rje chen po gzhung las pa rnams kyis zang zing gi maṇḍal dang bcas brtan par gnas pa'i smon lam mdzad cing bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang phul/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i be'u bum gyi lung gung ru dbyangs dbon pa zhing brjes pa nas bzung rgyun chad 'dug pa bo lugs la yod du re'i rtsad bcad kyang bsam sdings dang mtsho sna tshor med pa'i khungs chod/ spong rong rje (16na)dbon la yod 'gro zer bas zha lu mkhan rin po ches thabs rtsol gyis zhu ba'i khur bzhes gnang / 'gron gnyer drung pas ngos sbyor gyi yi ge dang bcas grub chen bkras rgyam pa rdzong bda' mdzad par bla ma nam mkha' dkar pos bkang ba dang mdos chog gi lung zhig mdzad nas be'u bum thams cad de la tshar khul las chos bka' gnang ba lta shog dpe cha'ang gzigs tshod du mi 'dug /bkang mdos kyi dpe gnyis dang sbrags grub chen pa mkhan rin po ches dpon slob sman lung pa'i sar chu bo rir rdzong bda' mdzad/ dpon slob kyis lung gsan te 'bras spungs su phebs byung yang de gnyis ni sngar thob zin pas ma zhus/ zhag bzhi tsam gyi bar gsung gleng zhib rgyas dang kun dga' ra ba'i gzigs mo gnang nas phyir phebs/ sna dkar rtse phyogs kyi gnas tshul la bo dong par ding sang mdo phyogs kyi bshad gra dga' mo 'dug kyang gsang sngags la 'go na oṃ dang mjug na swāhā gang yang med pa gleng ba shin tu bden par snang /dar rgyas chos sdings nas gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i gsung gis bskul te dpal o ḍi yā na'i slob dpon padma thod 'phreng gi rnam thar la brten pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa/ g.yon ru dpon po a nanda'i kha ton tu smon lam/ byes pa sku skye bsod nams lhun grub kyi ngor rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs 'khyer bde ba rnams brtsams/ rgyal mtshan mthon po'i phyag mdzod phun tsho gos rab brtan 'byor ba dang phrad/ tshes brgyad la tha'i ji/ o pa shi/ a chi mgon po —21 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)sogs sog po nyis (16ba)brgya tsam la yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims dang phyi dro bsnyen rdzogs bcu dgu/dge tshul nyer bzhi/ dge bsnyen gsum rnams bsgrubs/tshes bcu la chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa sogs bod pa kha shas dang tha'i ji/ o pa shis gtsos sog por bcas pa'i dbang cha tshar gnyis la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du mi 'khrugs pa la lha dgu'i dbang / sog dmangs rnams la dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / o pa shir snam phrug gal dkar dmar gyis mtshon pa'i rdzong ba bzabs shing bu gzhen pa dge tshul du bsgrubs/dpon mo shes rab sgrol mas pha khun 'du len o pa shi'i sdig sbyongs su dmigs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i dngul sku byis pa lo brgyad tsam bzhengs pa phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i gra khang du phul/rgyal mtshan mthon pa'i phyag mdzod pa dpon g.yog la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs/phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/ phyag drug pa dang las gshin phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bskur/ chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa 'gor ring nyin gnangs chag gi phrad cing zhib mol ngos ster cha rgyas pa/ kho rang gi tsha bo dge steng gi gdan sar bskos pa'i bsko 'ja'i yi ge gong nas gnang ba'i gser tham chen mo dgos tshul ltar re ba bkang / bcu bzhi la phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan gyis tshogs chen du bos pa'i gos phyi nang dngul spyad kyis sna drangs pa'i dgu tshan sum cu rtsa lnga dang tshogs chen du spyi 'gyed bstar zhing dge 'dun rnams kyis ring por gnas pa'i smon lam bkra shis rgyas par mdzad/tshes bco lnga'i nyin o chir thu tha'i ji dpon (17na)g.yog la bcu gcig zhal dang khro mo sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang / phun tshogs sgrol mar 'jam dbyangs lus dkyil gyi rjes gnang dang byams pas dam bcas pa'i lung bklags/ o rod nas dga' ldan pa'i dpon mo 'das pa'i bsngo rten rta sga ma bstoskor/ phying gur kha shas lhor/ 'di'i sdug bsngal gyis dpon mo phun tsho gos sgrol mas khri 'don skabs mgo gtums nas ngus song ba dpon mo rang gi rjes kyi ngang tshul gyi rten 'brel la lta ba 'dra/phyi dro o chir thur zhwa/ gon pa sogs tshan grangs dang bcas se chen rgyal po'i cho lo lung las kyi tham —22

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanaka byin te khri thog tu bton/ 'bul lan gyi rdzong ba bzabs/ dpon chung shes rab kyi bla mar thar gling zur pa bto / chos rje gnas gzhi ba/ lcam nor bu khra sgor/ hor dpon bsno chung / a chi thu chos rje'i bu'i bsngo zhus pa sogs mang du 'ongs/ bkra shis lhun po phyag mdzod kyis dgos tshul byung ba'i sdebs su blo gsal gling zur pa zhal snga nas 'bur ltag pa/ sgo mangs zur pa zhal snga nas ga ru ba shangs bkra shis rtse pas gtsos pa kha shas la bstan pa spyi bre brag gi nang mjal rags rim/ nor sna khyad mtshar rnams kyi mjal ka btang / ka tshal bla ma sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub kyis snyan ngag nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan bsrings/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod dkon cog rgyal mtshan gyis zhabs drung zur pa dang chos kyi grags pa gnyis kyi mtshan sgra dang nged rang gi ming sgra yod pa'i gsol 'debs bskul ba bris/ phyi mtshams kyi khog nas nyer bzhi'i nyin phyag mdzod (17ba) phun tshogs rab brtan dang phrad/ sprul sku rin po che'i ngos 'dzin skor gyi gleng gzhi byung bar spyir yang sku skye'i rigs 'di 'khrul gzhi chung ba 'ga' 'dug cing lhag tu dpon slob zhabs drung rin po che gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gshis nas brling po zhig ma byas na spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa dang 'brug pa padma dkar po gnyis kyi sprul sku la 'then 'byer gleng gzhi byung ba lta snye'i ci rjes su gan mi gtsang bar song na bla ma'i zhabs 'dren du 'gro bas da lam khyed dga' ldan gyi gnas mjal dang sbrags khri rin po che gdan drangs pa'i dngul gdung rin po che'i sku ga'o ges su zan ril/ de mtshungs rwa bsgreng mkhan pos jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang 'di nas slob dpon dbu mdzad pa lta bu zhig btang ba'i lha sar jo shāka /nged kyis chu mig rje btsun ma'i drung du brtag pa dril na 'gab 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan mol yang thugs dam brtag par gang babs las gzhan mi byed ces blor babs mdog kha ba zhig byung ma song bar thugs dam gyi nyams yod na 'thus pa 'dug rung zan ril lta bu zhig rang la'ang 'gangs ches pa'i kha mtshon gcod ma nus pas da cha sku chas bskur nas drung 'khor rgan rigs rnams btang ba'i ngos 'dzin 'khrul med byung ma byung brtag pa 'gab byas par re zhig de gar cha bzhag pa'i phyag mdzod pa dga' —23—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ldan rwa bsgreng gi gnas mjal la thon/ zho ston gyi gos sku zhal 'byed/ bro gzhas/ rtsed sna mang ba dang khrom che bar 'dug /hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gsum la shag skor gra tshang gi rigs gra'i tshogs dbur phyin/ de thog chab nag bla ma mtsho smad blo bzang (18na)chos 'phel gyis 'jam phrug dang rtas gtsos pa'i kong lugs kyi bdog pa bstar/ phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan gyi dngul gdung gsar pa'i gtsang khang rgya phibs/mchod rdzas/ phyag mdzod snga rting gnyis kyis rim par bsgrubs pa'i rtogs brjod srung ma la bzhes sgra dang bcas pa dgos tshul byung ba bris/phyi dro nas phyi mtshams kyi mu mthud mtshams khog tu dpe cha gsar pa mang du gsog pa'i tho bsgrigs dang gzims chung mgon khang lcang lo can du thang sku byin rlabs can gsar du'ang mang bar byung ba rnams la kha byang btab pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin gung yol rjes la rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dus kyi gsang sngags pho brang shod kyi gdong gas ma'i shog thang zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa ar po'i skabs mgon khang zur rgyas su bskyal 'dug pa dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis yar khyer yongs pa slebs pa dang dus mtshungs su gzims chung mgon khang khol bur sa ga yos shin tu che ba mchod dpon pa/ chos rje kha rag pa/ bshes gnyen dar rgyas/ gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rnams kyis shes par byung / de'i mdo ser rtsi sbug tu ri khrod dga' ldan zur pas tshor ba tsam tshoms chen du mchod rdzas gar 'cham chas kyi deb bsgrigs pa/ zhang tsha dkon cog rnam rgyal chang khyim pa sogs kyis rnam rtog za ba las nges tig ma byung zer/ gzhan ma 'bras sbungs/ lha sa gang du'ang bshad rgyu mi snang bas mgon po 'di sgrub pa'i gnas brag phug lta bur ma byas na 'jig nyen yod ces bshad pa ltar chos skyong gi (18ba〉sngas tu mngon/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i thugs dam rten yin zer ba'i zhal glang gdong ma'i thang sku bkra shis ljongs chos rjes byin byung ba de gra tshang la yod kyang chos skyong gi gtso bor song gshis de'i tshab tu rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i thugs dam rten rdo lag brgyud —24

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadakyis bsad pa'i mgon po zhal khra can gzims chung mgon khang du gnyis yod pa'i nag po 'phur shes kyi ya dang bla ma thugs kyi sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rten du rigs 'dzin ratna gling pa'i gter byon bye ma a krong las grub pa'i o rgyan padma gu ru dang mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal gyi sku brnyan gter ston gyi gdung brgyud chu mig dgon gsar ba nas brgyud pa'i khungs btsun dngul gyi bzhugs khang dang bcas pa/ 'phyongs rgyas stag rtse'i rten gral gser zangs las grub pa'i rdo rje gzhen nu khro bcu phra phyag sgo ma rnams kyi phur cha mkhyen brtse chen mos spra bzo mdzad pa'i dngos gtsang snod rgya skam mtshal rtsi rag shan ma/ 'jigs byed yongs rdzogs kyi dngul sku zhal phyag za ma tog dang mthun pa rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i thugs dam rten gnam rtsib steng nas bde chen yangs pa can du gdan drangs pa'i khyad mtshar ma/ mgon po phyag drug pa gtso 'khor gyi gos yol tshul mdangs gser bcad rnams legs shing mtha' hor gos me ri ma dang rdo rje gsang lam mas byas pa'i dbus gtsang gtsang dus bzos pa/gos thang tsham lhas ma la gser g.yu mu tig gi rgyan mchor yod pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ dge lugs 'jigs byed/ kun rig /tshe dpag (19na〉lha dgu rnams kyi dkyil thang / dus 'khor/ 'jigasabyed/ las gshin gsum gyi gos thang / phyag drug pa tshar gnyis dang bcas dpon mo sa'i khan sdus byung ba legs pa/ bdag chen mthu stobs dbang phyug gis gdan sa gong du gnang ba'i sbug chol pu tra tshangs dbyangs gzhis ka rtse brgyud byung ba'i shubs bcas legs pa/ gos khra bsgrigs kyi phan cha bzhi rnams spyi rdzas su sprad/ dbu mdzad ngos kyis zer ba 'tsher ngad che gshis rting bskul gyi dran pa'i gsal 'debs phal cher mchod dpon pas byas/sman sgom 'brang rgyas pas lhag bsam rnam dag gis kun nas bslangs te zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku myur 'byon gyi ched du dmigs pa'i o rgyan yab yum mtshan brgyad kyi sman sku bskrun pa'i gzungs 'bul gyi smon lam dang / bshes gnyen dar rgyas kyis sis rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod thang kha gcig la tshang ba bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig tshigs bcad bris/ bcu drug la bla ma snying ri ba 'dar nag —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bde ba bzang po la gnod sbyin beg tse'i rjes gnang dang ging lnga gza' gdong gi bka' gtad zhus/phar ras bris la brten pa'i rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi bde gshegs bka'i dbang / ranta gling pa'i gter ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi za yig dang byams pas dam bcas pa sogs gzungs phran 'ga' zhig gi lung phul/ rta gos dar gyis gtsos pa'i bdog pa bzabs rgyas su bstar te stod du thegs/ phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan dang 'dul ba slob dpon pa can kha shas la mngon rtogs rgyan dang byang sems rwa (19ba)bsgreng bas mdzad pa'i blo skyong gnyis kyi lung byas/ phyag mdzod par gos dar 'jam phrug gis gtsos pa'i ster cha gzengs bstod pa byin te gtsang du thon/ bsnyen rdzogs pa bdun dang dge tshul bcu la sdom pa phab/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho can kha shas la sman bla'i mdo chog chen mo dang gsar rtsom sātstsha 'debs choge gi lung bklags/ o rod nas a pa la'i 'byor ba'i gzhi byes/ 'grul zla dge slong chos dar rgyas skor sogs sum brgya lhag bcas/ thon legs lan dbang po/ spong rong grags pa/ g.yon ru seng ge'i dpon mo tshe dbang rgyal mo/ shu ge ja'i sang gis gtsos pa'i nyis brgya tsam dang phrad/ gu shri bla ma'i tsha bo bkra shis tshe ring gis phyag drug pa'i be'u bum dang chos rgyal gyi zhal thang byin/ shangs bkra shis rtse pa rta lo snga ma tshor 'chi bar thug pa'i nad gzhi byu snga 'dug pas 'di res 'tshub pa mi 'dug na skor cig dge tshul tsam byed/ 'byas lod na bsnyen rdzogs rang sgrub zer ba mo rtsis la chags che nges shar bas 'dod pa bzhin dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs pa zla ba dgu pa'i mthug tu 'das song bas sems lhag mi lus pa'i legs pa byung bar mngon/nyer bzhi nas bzung hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bdun gyi bar kun dga' ra bar tshogs pa nyis stong lhag bcas/ a pa la'i sa'i khan ma tshe dbang rgyal mos gtsos pa'i sog po nyis brgya skor/ sde pa thon pa dang tre bo sku skyes mtshon pa'i bod pa skya ser thor bu sogs stong phrag gsum tsam la byang chub lam rim chen mo nas chos thun ring tshad bzabs bshad kyi (20na)lugs skyabs 'gro'i 'gor sleb pa'i bar phul/ chos tshugs nyin u rang khan bstan 'dzin tho yon gyis gos dar dngul rdza/ rta sga mas—26

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanasna drangs pa'i brgya 'bul/ gser kha bla ma 'jam dbyangs kyi tsha bo rab 'byams pa can gyis gser zho nyis brgya dang bzang ja'i ster cha/ me rgan ja sag thu'i bsngo rten gos dar/ gon pa/ dmag chas kyisagatsos pa bu rab 'byor can gyis bstar bar bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs byas/ bstan pa rgya mtshos bskul nas gong dkar bshad sgrub gling slob dpon bzod pa rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs dang / u rang khan bstan 'dzin tho yon gyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa brtsams/ gter ston dar rgyas chos sdings pas padma gling pa'i gter ma'i padma gu ru'i sku dang gter gsar gyi slob dpon chen po'i na bza' ster ba mdzad par dngul lnga bcu ma yon du phul/ sbyor ra sprul sku rdo rje snying po'i rten khrod du rigs 'dzin ratna gling pa'i zhabs rkang yod tshul thos pas dad rten du dgos mol pa ltar khyid gang lhag tsam pa'i kha dog dang dri ngad phun sum tshogs pa zhig bskur byung ba de lan gyi skyes bsrings/ tre bo sku skye nam mkha' bsam grub la rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum gyi me tog bcud len dang gsar rtsom klu gtor 'bras spungs gra tshang bdun gyi slob dpon khri gdan zur rnams la byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs phan yon dang bcas pa'i lung bklags/ 'brug pa sprul sku dgongs dwangs la sde pa'i sar ched gnyer phebs zhor du 'bras spungs su (20ba〉gril sku rin po che lha khang nas skya ser bcas pa mjal gleng zhib par byung / gnad skyes kyi bris 'bur rnams kyi khrod du sring mo pe ta mgon skyid kyi phyag bzo'i rje btsun mi la'i sku zhig 'dug pa la la sring mos 'jim bzo bslabs 'phros mi 'dug pas mi bden nam zhes the tshom yang byed/thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor slob dpon blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyis gtsos brgya skor gyis bdog pa dang bcas yun mtsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs shing bla mchod zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta'i lung bklags/ cham pa ci tsam brgyab par dar mo sman rams pas bcos ka byas pa 'phrod ngo che ba byung / shu ge ja'i sang gis rdza dngul gos dar gyis bdog pa bteg /tre bo sku skye/ bstan 'dzin tho yon/lho brag bsam grub dgon gyi bla ma spun gnyis sogs la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / lhung bshags/—27
