rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rgyal ba btsong kha pas mdzad pa'i stobs bzhi'i bshags pa/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum nas mkha' spyod dkar mo dang mgon po snying zhugs kyi 'pho ba'i lung / g.yon du dpon mo skor nyis brgya tsam la/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul rnams kyi rjes gnang / slob dpon bdun dang dge skos gnyis la gsar rtsom bla ma mchod pa dang klu gtor gyi lung bklags/bcu bzhi nas zhag lnga'i bar nor bu gling khar bsdad pa'i chu zhugs byas/ ā tsarla 'ga' zhig gis gcig gis rkang mthil sa dang cig shos kyi gnam du bstad cing spyi gtsug sprad (21na)de 'gro ba/ sa la gri lnga btsugs pa'i rtse mig 'bor la gnyis/ snar gnyis/ lce la gcig bstad de mgo bo 'gul bskyod med pa la ske man gyi 'khrul 'khor la brten pa'i lus kyis mtshon cha la bskor ba'i ltad mo ngo mtshar ba mig 'phrul lta bu rtsed/ grong smad nas chu bzang du lha khang gsar pa brgyab par tshes bcu bdun la phyin me tog gtor cing shis pa brjod / drung 'khor skya ser nyis brgyar nye bar zhabs tog bzabs rgyas dang tshan grangs kyi dngos po bstar/ de'i nub 'bras spungs su 'khor/ a mdo nas rgyal sras shes 'phel ba'i dbon po 'byor pa'i tshogs chen du mang 'gyed dang gos dar gyi tshan grangs bstar/ gra tshang du dmag zor ma'i sger bkang 'bum ther dang gshin rje 'dus pa'i drag sngags bye ba btsugs/sde pa bsod nams rab brtan la stag lung zhabs drung rin po ches dwags yul chu tshan khrag dang chu ser la phan par gter kha zhig lung bstan la brten pa'i che brjod dang lha rje byang ngos pas 'phrod ngo yod tshul la yid brtan du bzung nyer gcig la 'bras spungs nas bteg pa'i nyang bran gyi la chen brgyud gro sar zhag gcig bsdad/ sang nyin lam zhor du dpal ldan rtse'i gur zhal gyi mgon khang mjal nang rten rnams la gdan sa 'og nas dam phrug gnang 'dug kyang bshig pa dkon gnyer byed mi bstad pa'i khyad kyis re zhig 'di ga'i thel 'byar byas der lam dus kyi dbang blangs shing mchod —28

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadagator rgyas par bsngos/ snyan shal dang go mtshon gyi spyan gzigs phul/ gnas 'di kha'u skyed (21ba)lhas dang khyad med ces bdag chen rdo rje 'chang thugs gtsigs nan ltar che/ ding sang 'dzin spras cher mi 'dug kyang nyams len 'dra skyong bar re zhig bsdad na snyam pa'i bag phebs pa snang / 'di dang rtses dang bsam gtan gling gnyis srung ma rang bzhin gyis 'dug pa'i gnas khyad par can du gda'/ za dam klu sdings su gung gi dro bstabs/ rgyal po dpon g.yog byang nas phebs pa'i dmangs ma gzhung lam du btang nyung bsdus dpon g.yog lnga bcu skor dang phyogs mthun du de nub chu tshan khar slebs/chu tshan de gzi chen gyis bdag tu bzung ba zhig yin par byed 'dug pas sleb gdong 'brug dang ser chol gyi gnam ngo'i rnam pa yod tsam dang sdod ring mi tshogs ches skyon gyis nam mkha' ha cang legs pa ma byung / phar lam tshur lam gnyis ka skya ser gyi phrad mi dang thag nye'i dgon pa tsho nas ser sbreng kyang thor bu bsgrigs/ stag lung zhabs drung khri thog pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal legs grub/ spras rin cen brag /rwa bsgreng / jo gdan dgon/ nyan pa dgon/ gser mig dgon/ lcang lung chos sdings/'phan yul rgyal stod smad/ thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor/ stod lung kha rag sogs kyi bla ma/ bla tshab gra rigs/ 'bras spungs spyi gnyer ngag dbang smon lam/ gser tog tho yon/ dge slong dar khan nang so/ lha khang dbon chung / sde pa drug brgya pa/ sems dpa' chen po'i dbon po/ mkhar rtse rdzong 'og gi drung 'khor/ bsam rtse ri khrod pa'i gtsang pa rab 'byams pa/ za dam gyi rta pa bcu skor/ klu (22na)kha stod/ tshong 'dus rag ma pa sogs phrad mi shin tu mang bas rang dbang 'du bar ma byung rung nyin star gyis chur nan tan gyis zhugs pas khrag la shin tu phan pa'i lo phyed gnyis lhag tsam gyi bar cham pa yang ma byung / la la sngar chu tshan yod pa phu chu ches pa'i de dang 'dres pas grang mor song ba 'dra zer zhing dpon tshang tsha rong pa sman chur ngos 'dzin/ gang ltar gnas brtan dam pas shar pa chos rje yin zer ba zhig nub nas byung smras pa'i dpe ltar chu tshan du grags kyang reg bya grang bar snang / grang ba'i rigs la gnod pa yod nyams kyis ma 'phrod pa'i nad bslang ba'am kha yar byung song / sde pa phon mdo —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ban grong pa nyan pa phyug pa gsum gyis gnyis len dang ster cha rgyas par bshams/ stag lung zhabs drung khri thog pas stag lung ngag dbang grags pa'i dus su dzo gis phul ba'i man ngag gi dpe cha shog bu nyi shu skor yod pa zhig gnang zhing phar tshur dngos po'i skyes dang skyes lan kyang bstar/ chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa'i bsngo rten skyel mi 'byor/ gong dkar rdzong sdod sgem bu bas snye mdo ba'i gdugs dkar bcu bdun ma'i dkyil thang skyel bar dkar brag pa rdo rje rnam rgyal btang / rgyal po dpon g.yog dang gnangs chag gis mjal/ dpon po bkra shis kyis ja gos dar gyi bdog pa bteg /rwa bsgreng mkhan por dmigs brtse ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor phul/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gnyis la za dam du 'byor/ sang nyin chos rje bco brgyad pas thog drangs rong stan shes bya kun rig gi chos sde nā landa'i tshogs chen la (22ba)dpal ldan bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa'i lung phul/ chos rje bco brgyad pas dpal ldan rtse'i gnas kyi lo rgyus rgyas par gsung / stag lung zhabs drung ma chen ri bo che nas chibs kha sgyur ba'i stag lung gi nye skor du phebs zin 'dug pa skor cig skyid shod du 'grul gnang ma dgos pa'i za dam du mjal phrad thub na thag ring nas bshad pa'i chibs khal rnams la mi gzan zhing thugs g.yeng chung khyad kyis tshes lnga la za dam klu sdings su phebs/ rdza khor drug ma brgya/ rta sum brgya tsam gyis gtsos pa'i sku skyos stsal/ nyin kha yar gyi bar mjal zhing gsung gleng shin tu 'phel/ ba ri lugs kyi sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i rjes gnang phul/ tshe bdag dang khro chu slar nyan dgos pa 'dug ces snyan gsan gnang / stag rtse tha'i ji/ rgyal stod gra tshang / 'brom sdings 'tsho byed nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs phrad mi shin tu mang zhing rgyal lha khang mi ser gyis mtshon pa'i skya ser tshos sha mar dang mdzo g.yag la brten pa'i ster cha byas pa bzhin chu tshan khar 'ong mi thams cad kyis kyang bzabs/rgyal stod pa'i gra pa rnams la dmigs brtse ma dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas/ sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang dge slong chos 'phel bzang po gnyis dpal ldan rtser go mtshon spyan —30

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)gzigs dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan shal bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i tshigs bcad bris pa bskyar 'bul du btang / stag lung zhabs drung dpon slob la dkar spro'i steng na bza' bca' skor/ gos dar dngul spyad kyis thog drangs (23na)phebs legs kyi skyes bzabs rgyas phul/ phyag phyir chad dkar lo tsā ba 'dug par sgra'i skor gyi dri ba byas pas gong ra lo tsā ba/ sprul sku gsung sprul/ khro phu dus 'khasapa/ dbu ma lo tsā ba sogs mang por gtugs nas yun ring du sbyangs pa'i ding dus legs sbyar la mkhas tshad du snang /tshes bdun la za dam nas thon pa'i gdong nyal gzhung du la bsgags byas/ sang nyin skam la brgyud pa'i dogs bde'i phur pha bong kha gdan sa ba dang se ra theg chen gling gi dpon slob rta bsu ba brgyar nye ba 'byor/ de nub lha mos zhigs kar bsdad sang nyin grong smad du gung gi dro bstabs/ rin cen sgang klu sdings su thab bsu dang bcas dpal ldan 'bras spungs pa'i rta pa phyed nyis brgya tsam gyis mdun bsus te dga' ldan pho brang du slebs/ sang nyin spos khang mkhan po zur pa 'bum rams pas thog drangs rin spungs lha sde mi sde rnams kyis gos dar ja ras kyi bdog pa bstar nas yun mtsho'i rten 'byung / sku mdun lhun grub/ sgar pa gra tshang slob dpon/ btsun mo tshal bla ma/ kha thig kha nang so/sku 'bum dbon pa/ a pa la'i/ sa'i khan ma tshe dbang rgyal mo sogs sog po nyis brgya lhag bcas dang kun dga' ra ba'i tshoms chen du phrad/dbyar stod drung 'tsho ba lhag bsam gyis long rtsa gtar zhing chu tshan kyang khrag la phan rung rgyun du dal bar 'dug bzhin pa'i mus glo bur du la chen gnyis bsdud mar brgyab pa sogs spyod lam dman lhag gi skyon nam lho mos su phrad mi'ang sna tshogs pa'i grib lta bu'i yin gang ltar de nub nas (23ba)rkang pa mi bde ba'i 'go brtsams pa rim lod du song bas tshes bcu gcig nas phyi mtshams bcad de dga' ldan pho brang gi rab gsal du sman sgom 'brang rgyas pa dang drung 'tsho ngag dbang lhag bsam gnyis kyis sman dkar yongs grags dang gsang ba'i man ngag gnyis re mos kyis rnga dang dril —31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bu dkrol ba'i tshul gyis 'phrod bsten byas/ nad g.yog mchod dpon pas rkang brdungs shing gnyid bsrung bar dgos dus chang khyim nas bos dreg la sngags rgyag rtsis kyi chos rje kha reg pas nyin 'byongs su bzlas brjod byas/ gra tshang du skong bshags nyin gsum sogs rim gro btsugs/ spos khang spyi tshogs kyi bskul ba'i mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs dang / mchod dpon pas ri bo chos gling gi 'du khang du gnam rgyan phul ba'i kha byang brtsams/zla gcig tsam la bde bas gter sgrom gyi tshu tshan blangs te hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas zhag bdun gyi bar bsten/ lhun 'du su chos rjes rgyu cha rnams brtan las byed sde pa lcang ra bas byas pa'i bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i smon lam sde pa ming sring gnyis rang la sbyar ba zhig dgos tshul byung yang dbon sa yid 'phrog ma smad dang ༅ 'du su chos rje'ang chud pa dgos rigs yin 'dra snyam tshang ma'i brjod bya thebs pa byas/ 'bri gung sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub kyi snyan 'phrin gyi lan tshigs su bcad pa/ sa spungs sngags khang du khrom gos dmar po yug tshang gi snyan shal gyi kha yig /gsang sngags dga' tshal gyi sbug mgon khang bsil pa tshal du snyan dar lnga brgya skor (24na)go mtshon spyan gzigs gya nom pa phul ba'i tshe gos sngon zhig la 'dod gsol gyi tshigs bcad rnams bris/ rdzong gzhis khag bcu drug bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar brgya dang lnga/ 'bum brgya/ dkon brtsegs dang ting 'dzin rgyal po so sor brgya rtsa/ mas brjod dang gdugs dkar so sor lnga tsom re/ gshin rje'i sngags ring 'bum phrag nyi shu/ ma ṇi dung phyur gnyis/ badzra gu ru dung phyur gcig /yig brgya chig 'bum/ sātstsha chig 'bum/ tshe chog /jo shākya la mchod 'bul/ gra sa phan tshun ja tshul sum cu dang dga' ldan du bco lnga btang / dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po er te ni'i lo mchod thebs dgos tshul mkhan po sa phag lo khur bsam che ba dang bcas 'dus byung khungs rgyal rtse chos sde'i bal lcags brang khang / grog kha khungs g.yu shel gzhis ka /thim 'dzin brgyad/ lag yong phyed drug brgya skor/ 'phyong rgyas mkhar ldan par rgyal me tog thang gi mchod gzhis rnying pa yar klungs bkra shis bde —32

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadalegs pa rkang gcig /lag yong bzhi brgya skor/ sangs rgyam pa'i rim gro sogs kyi thebs la grong smad du 'phan yul gro sa spe nang gnyis ka /smon mkhar them 'dzin nyer lnga lag 'bab phyed nyis stong skor/ lha rtse lha khang pa grub mtha' gtsang ba'i yus kyang che ba 'dug pas sa brjes sa snon dang bcas par ldog spang yul gzhis ka /them 'dzin drug /lag yong sum brgyar nye ba rnams sprad/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis la a rig 'a shur rgyal mo rong pa sogs thag (24ba)ring nas yong mi mang ba ngos phrad ma thub rung srung mdud dam rdzas bza' btung gis tshim par byas/ bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti'i dkar chag khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen pas bris shig par gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas chos kyi bzhugs tshul khog phug pa zhig brtsams/ gnas chud du chos skyong chen po sku phebs thog snyan shal tshigs bcad bris pa/ gser skyems/ sku chas cha tshang / gos phyi nang / ja khrab kyi spyan gzigs spro bar mchod dpon pa btang / sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal gyi gsung gis bskul ba'i 'brungs rabs gsol 'debs dang / u pa san cha'i kha ton du bdag bstod cig bris/ tshes bcu rting ma la kun dga' ra bar sgo mangs slob dpon lung rigs rgya mtshos tsha ba dang ha sdong spyi pas gung gi bzhugs gral bshams shing gos dar ja ras tshan grangs bstar/ bzhugs gral gnyis la sgo mngasapa'i dka' rab 'byams 'ga' zhig gis chos kyi 'bel gtam gleng / chos phyogs la jo bo bzang grags nas gral pa thams cad gnyid chog 'thib be ba las rigs lung gi tha snyad cher ma byung ma nas hor rab 'byams pas tshag khrad dang kha gzan par brten bla ma rnams kyis phud pas da cha stag lung cha la'i bong bu rang byas dogs 'dug go /sngags pa se chen zhabs drung gi sku skye brtag pa dang mthun pa gsang mdar gsal ba byung 'dug pa bzhin sgo mangs slob dpon zur pa ga ru pa can gyis khrid 'ongs pa skra phud blangs shing phyag drug pa'i bka' bsgo byas/ bla ma btsan po'i bsngo rten ma na ho/ g.yang ṭi/ gser dngul sogs gtos(25na)che ba byin cing bsngo smon gyi rgyas btab/ bzhugs gral grol nas bkra shis sgo mangs spyi sos —33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung gi smon lam mdzad/ sngags pa gra tshang la rgyal gsol gyi lung dgos tshul bzhin bklags/tshes bcu gcig la chos sde chen po nas skyel ma ba brgya skor dang bcas rin chen sgang du 'byor thog dben sa sprul sku/ rgyal po/ a pa la'i gyis gtsos pa'i sog po sum brgya tsam/ se ra theg chen gling gi rta pa lnga bcu lhag dang stag lung phyag mdzod pa bcas bsu mi rnams 'dzom thog ja sbyor sbrel btang /po ta la'i yang thog tu sde pas zhal bkod mdzad nas sdod gnas shin tu spro ba byung 'dug par gung tshigs la skyed bu kha dro dang sbrags dben sa sprul sku/ rgyal po/ a pa la'i se chen dbon po/ ja'i sang mi bzang drag rigs/ stag lung phyag mdzod/ nang so rnam pa/ mda' dpon gsum sogs bod sog tshogs par gung gi bzhugs gral rgyas par bshams/ phyi dro sde drug mkhan po rmi ru slob dpon/dga' ldan mchod pa/ sku mdun lhun grub/ dwags po sgrom mda' ba can mi grangs dgu brgya go grangs dang phrad/ lhag tu la stod sgam smyon sprul sku'i gdan sa phyag mdzod mnga' bdag pa'i sras kyis gter kha gong ma'i padma bdud 'dul rigs 'dzin chen po yol mo ba thugs gtsigs nan tan che ba'i 'brul med de dang mtshur phu phyag mdzod rnam rgyal gyis chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i thugs dam rten byu ru'i gshed dmar rgya bzo khyad mtshar 'phyong rgyas nas drung pa rgyal tshab par phul ba de (25ba)byin pa gnas khang gi thog ma'i rten 'brel shin tu legs pa byung / gtsang gi gzims chung ba spyi bsdus kyis dngosapo bteg ste mda' dpon gzer chen pa dang gzims chung pa brgya skor gyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ tsha ba dang nyang re'i 'grul pa gsar slebs rnams kyis ja dang 'ba' dar khan dka' bcu'i tsha bo bsod nams bkra shis kyis ja pags rigs rta dre'u'i dngos po gzengs bstod/ rgyal mo che chung /g.yon ru dpon mo/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ zur ri bla ma/ a jo rdzong pa'i bla mas mtshon pa brgya skor la ja gral btang / rgyal me tog thang gi mgon khang bsil ba tshal du thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos gdan sa gong nas pu tra'i bla mtsho'i rgyun bzhes 'dug par de ga'i mig ltos kyis —34

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chana'adar pa lo tsā ba 'khor zhag skabs zhabs drung rin po cher zhu yig dang bcas bla mtsho'i rgyun dgos tshul zhus pa sku ngos kyis pu tra khang du phebs pa'i skyogs lta bus bcu ni mi nus ji ltar drag gsung ba'i mus la khro'i ser ga nas glo bur du 'dzags pas len snod khengs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa chu gdan drangs te 'dar lo gza' skar legs thog tu 'byor/sne'u sdong rtse'i zhabs drung blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zhal ngo gong ma rnams kyi spyan rgyun bzhin thugs nges par 'byung ba'i bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba dang gdung brgyud rin po che sku lus bsgyur bar phebs pa tshes bcu gnyis kyi snga dro mjal zhing de thog sde pa 'dar lo mchis brang dang bcas pa/se ra'i dge skos gsum/ bā thur khi ya sogs sog po lnga bcu skor btang / thog mar bsnyen (26na)rdzogs gnang bzhed la nang so a nor gyis gtsos drung 'khor rnams kyis mchod dpon pa bskul ba'i zhal ngo 'brol chungs pas rab tu sdom pa bzhes rgyu 'then tsam dang de min skor cig dge tshul tsam gnang ba brtan pa yong tshul gyi snyan sgron zhus 'dug par brten thugs 'gyur pa'i dgongs bstad bzhin phyi dro zhabs drung ma chen dge tshul du bsgrubs/ zhabs drung gdung brgyud kyi gtsug phud blangs te mtshan ngag gi dbang phyug rin po che bkra shis dpal 'bar phun tshos sa rgya mtsho'i sder gsol/ sngar gong ma chos rgyal chen po la lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor bas sku tshe'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar legs tshul gyi lung bstan pa'i dgongs bzhed dang bstun pa ri lugs kyi sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i rjes gnang dang gsar rtsom bsangs dpe bkra shis 'khyil ba'i lung phul/ dpon mo tshe dbang rgyal mos gser las grub pa'i gtor cha ya mgu ma mgu dang bcas pa/ tsandan gyi gtor stegs/ dngul gyi gzheng pa rnams kyis gtsos pa'i gos dar gser dngul rta sogs brgya 'bul/ se chen rgyal po'i 'bul skyel ba bzhi bcu tsam 'byor ba'i gos khres/ dar khres/ ja ko dra kha shas bcas bstar/ dpon mo sa'i khan jur tshe rta dang / stag rtse tha'i jir tshe mgon gyi byin rlabs phul/ bar khams nas bla ma rgya ston pa/ hor smad ta lha rgyal dar gyi nu bo/ stong 'khor dbon po/ bde chen tha'i ji/ tshal sde pa grags pa/ dwags po rgyu —35—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)pa/ lcam nor bu khra sgor sogs dang mjal phrad byas/ bsnyen rdzogs brgya zhe gcig /dge tshul brgya so (26ba)brgyad/ dge bsnyen bzhi bcu zhe bzhi rnams bsgrubs/ stag rtse nas gser sku gra tshar bzhed ba mdzad 'dug par me tog gtor/ tshes bcu drug la sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal gyis sbyin bdag mdzad pa'i gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog btang / tshogs 'khor bzabs rgyas/ rung mthun gyi gos sna ja gos dar sogs kyi ster cha/ tshogs la 'gyed kyis bsnyen bkur/ zhag bdun gyi bar mtshams bcad pu tra'i bla mtsho skyel bar dra ma chas bzang ka phibs pa'i dgos 'dod/ dpal shag bsod nams dar rgyas/ zhol shar dkon cog gsum dang gra tshang gi gra pa yar stod pa ngag dbang tshul khrims btang bar rlung g.yos te nam mkha' 'tshub pa'i dam can 'khor nyams che ba byung gra khang sbug bsil ba tshal du khro snod la blug pa'i 'degs mkhan zur khang pa rgyal po don grub dang do dam mchod dpon pas byas rin po che'i mtsho rdzas phul te kha bcad snyan dar sgron pa'i lag tshags ru nga ba'i rgyas btab/ chad dkar lo tsā ba'i slob ma zhig gis legs par sbyar ba ka lā pa'i rtsa ba dang snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo chen rin cen chos skyong bzang po'i bshad sbyar steng nas ri mo yongs rdzogs kyi rgyugs sprad pa 'dar pa lo chen gyis blangs/ stag lung mkhas pas mi 'dzin pa'i sa nas 'di 'dra 'ong ba'i tshod na sa dge sogs su sgra cher mi sgrag go /nyer gsum nas mtshams grol te dben sa sprul pa'i skur grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang bla chas 'jam phrug gis thog drangs pa'i rdzong ba gang legs bstan (27na)gzhung la phan slebs kyi do dam gang che mdzad dgos pa'i bslab bya byas thon gdong mu tig gi 'phrong ba zhig lag gtod dang sbrags bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su gang 'gyur byed tshul 'phral yun gyi khe nyen zhib par gsung /gdan gzos dang skyel ma btang bas mtshon pa'i gzengs bstod cing bkra shis lhun por gsar du brgyab pa'i grang khang yang gzhung du sprad de mgu ba'i rnam 'gyur lhur blangs/ tshe dbang rgyal mor bzang —36

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadaspyod/ bkra shis brtsegs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi cho ga /gsar rtsom sgrol ma dkar ljang gi mngon rtogs rnams kyi lung / tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / shal dkar dmar snam phrug sogs rdzong ba bzabs/ shu ge ja'i sang khyo shugs gnyis kyis gos dar dang rna rgyan gyi sal khe bkrol te byin/ rnam sras gling pa phun tshogs dbang po gzhis rtse dang mdzes grong dka' bcu 'ba'i rdzong sdod la 'gro gdong lhan du phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur/ mtshams khag le tshan rnams btsugs/ nyer lnga nas phyi mtshams ngos grabs yul byas/zla ba bcu gnyis pa snga ma'i tshes nyi shu la gsang sngags pho brang gi mgon khang sbug tu chos skyong rnams kyi rten gtor so so'i man ngag bzhin srog 'khor/ gzungs/ rdzas sogs phyag len dwangs gtsang ba 'dzugs par mchod dpon pa btang / dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang chos rje kha rag pa can gra pa kha shas kyis sgrub pa tshul bzhin bstar/ dgon (27ba)pa mang por gser gtor du grags pa'i gtor ma 'di yin med pa/ la la gnang che bas de ltar grags zer/ 'ga' zhig gser mang po bsresapas de'i gong brgyab kyi gzan khugs pa'i dbang du byas gtor kha gso mi dgos gsung mkhan snang ba gdams pa mtshar po de 'dra ba ni rtsad ma chod gshis 'dzugs ma shes so/ /gtor 'dzugs kyi brel ba tsam ma gtogs zla ba bcu gnyis pa phyi ma ma rdzogs bar phyi mtshams khog tu thob yig gi 'phro bris/ru thog dbang po thugs sems thang chad nyams kyi snyan 'phrin byung ba'i lan thugs kyi gsos sman du 'gyur ba bsrings/—37—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dgung lo nga gcig par bod khams bde thabs dang tshogs gsog gi ched du rdzong gzhis khag nas bka' 'gyur sogs rim gro bsgrubs pa'i skor/dus rim le tshan dang me lug gnam lo tshes pa'i ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo mchod cing bod sog gi tshogs la bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston byas/ de thog bal po kho khom rgyal po dang lwa dwags bde ldan gyi mi sna sogs cha lugs dang skad rigs mi gcig pa 'ga' zhig 'byor/ tshes gnyis la yod khon gyis brgya 'bul bteg /de dang dpon mo sa'i khan ju 'khor bcas la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/lhung bshags/ byams smon/ bzang spyod/ gdugs dkar/ gsar rtsom sātstsha 'debs cho go rnams kyi lung byas/ sde pa bying pa/ lho brag bkra shis chos lung dang ba 'ad bkra shis dge 'phel gyi bla ma/ 'bri gung chos sgo ba mnga' bdag pa'i bla ma mdo sngags bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ zhabs drung snying snying / bra yag gnyer chung / rtse chen lcam/ la stod nas lcags zam 'dzugs mkhan sa lugs kyi bla ma zhig dang bcas par ja gral btang / lcags zam 'dzugs mkhan (28na)des rdo ring gi 'khris nas lus gcer bur phyungs te jo bor phyag 'tshal ba'i zhig por rlom pa zhig yod tshod du 'dug /gang ltar bslangs pa'i chas mtha' dag lcags zam kho na'i rgyur gtong zer bas zag zog mkhan rang ni min pa 'dra/skyor lung chos sde dgon lag mar khu 'bul rgyu dang bcas pas zang zing gi tshan grangs bteg ste yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ bsnyen rdzogs gya drug dang / dge tshul bdun cu don bzhi bsgrubs/tshes bzhi la khri rin po che blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang mjal zhing dkar spro bshams/ stag lung phyag mdzod dang gser tog tho yon la phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur/ de nub —38—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadanas phyi mtshams bcad/ 'phan yul drug brgya ba dkon cog tshe dbang chos byed par yongs chog pa dgos pa'i yi ge rim par 'byor bar stag rtse tha'i jir zhus pa'i bde khrol byung na 'dod sbyar byas chog labs par brten tshes lnga la 'byor ba dge tshul du bsgrubs shing ming blo bzang dkon cog tu btags/ phyi nang gi nor rdzas gtos che ba dang drug brgyas gtsos pa'i sa ris g.yog them 'dzin brgya dang gnyis mchod gzhis su sbyar ba'i deb sde par phul ba thugs la gtsang skur gnyis kyi dus zhwa dmar nag la de rigs byed mkhan byung bar 'then khyer cher mi yong 'dug pas de dang 'dra ba'i nyams shig shar bar snang nged kyis rang phyogs kyi sbyin bdag rnams kha zhu gting 'khyags kyi lo rgyus shin tu mang bas rta pa 'gros su song na mchod yon bar du gleng brjod mgo na ba byung dogs dgos tshul mol (28ba)rung thang sag bla ma can gyis bzhes chog pa yod pa'i gsed bkrol gyis kyang 'brul gzhi byas/ rtsis len pa song ba'i sang nyin bsam yas nas tha'i jis drug brgya ba blo log gis cho me bros la song 'dug pa slog dgos lugs kyi phyag bris byung rung drug brgya ba rang gis sngar phul ba'i zhu lan tshang mar lam lam zhig las chos byas na mi 'thus pa'i rdo sbrags mi 'dug cing dge tshul kyang bsgrubs zin pa dang snang tshal bas 'brug par kha bltas nas phyin pa las nag che rgyu med pa 'dra snyam slog pa ma shar/tshes bcu gcig gi nyin tshangs pa dung thod can la ja/ gos phyi nang / rta/ tsho gos mas kyi mchod sprin spros te dus rtags lkog gyur gyi lung bstan zhu bar 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de mtshungs gra tshong 'dus su chos skyong bya khrid mig gcig par spyan gzigs gong gsal gyi thog dung rgya gling dang bcas 'bul bar zhang tsha dkon cog rnam rgyal/ sang nyin bsam yas gnod sbyin chen por dam rdzas tshangs pa dang dbyibs mtshungs pa spros te mchod dpon pa chu tshan dang sbrags btang ba so sor las bcol gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i 'phrin yig phul/nyer gcig la skyid shod chos rje blo bzang bstan skyong rgya mtsho sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten rnams —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)byang chub kyi rgyur bsngos shing de dang 'brel ba'i bdog pa'i skyes kyang bsrings/ gnas snying zhabs drung sku gzhen pa'i sku skye rab byung du bsgrubs/ mtshan ngag dbang kun dga' bde legs su btags/ 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis gra tshang gang du byon pa 'gab dri bar khyad che ba mi yong yang ra ba stod slob (29na)gnyer smra tshul glengs pa bzhin byon song pa thugs gnyer kyang yong ba'i 'jal byung zer/ gnas chung chos skyong chen pos sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis phyi'i lar gya rnams mdzad/ da lam nor bu 'dzin pas nang gi zhib tshags rnams byung ba dang yon bdag shāka mgon gyi skye ba yin tshul sogs bslab ston rgyas par sger logs a dar la gsungs par snang /hor zla gnyis par tshogs gsog rim gro bod khams kyi bde thabs su rdzong gzhis khag bcu dgu bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar chig brgya sum cu/ 'bum/ brgyad stong pa/ bskal bzang / thar pa chen po/ gser 'od/ mdo mang / padma bka' thang rnams so sor brgya rtsa re/ dkon cog brtsegs pa dang ting 'dzin rgyal po so sor nyis brgya/ mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar/ sgrol ma/ sher snying rnams 'bum ther/ tshe chog gsum/ yig drug dung phyur gnyis/ lha sa/ bsam byis/ khrag 'brug gsum la mchod pa sna lnga brgya rtsa/ gser chab/ dar chen/ yum bu/ mchims phu/ shel brag sogs slob dpon chen po dang chos rgyal gyi gnas bsdoms pa bcu bzhi la mchod pa sna lnga sum cu re/ ser 'bras su ja tshul nyi shu rtsa drug /khro rol brgyad/ dgra sri'i mnan pa dgu/ 'char ga'i mdos/ phyugs lug brgya'i srog blu rnams btang / bsam dar nas kyis zhang blon la 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar zhal yig dgos zer ba bkod/ bsam yas chos skyong chen pos rdo rje brag /dpal ri/ dar rgyas chos sdings pa gsum gyis gnas chen gsum du bod (29ba/bams bde thabs kyi sku rim dgos gsung ba ltar rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po ches lha sa/ dpal ri sprul skus bsam yas/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos dbu ru ka tshal du mdzad pa'i gter ston de shor po ta lar byon byung bar gshin rje dmar po rlung sgrub kyi gter gzhung dang chos rgyal byang pa'i ljags bsgrigs kyi lung phyag len man ngag /dmar 'khrid/ sngar bskul —40

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadam mdzad pa'i 'phrang 'go gter ston pa'i sme brtsegs kyi 'phrin las dang o rgyan gyi gsol 'debs gsar rtsom gnyis kyi lung phul/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la bkra shis lhun po'i mgron gnyer dka' chen dge 'dun tshul khrims 'byor ba'i phyag mdzod kyi yi ge dang dngul gyi maṇḍal/ nyer spyad cha tshang / gos phyi nang sogs dngos po dpangs bstod dang bcas yun du gnas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan smed/ gam chu mkhar gyi mi dpon gyis ma'i da ri chos rje'i gra pa rin rṣa dbon po bto ba'i ja ko dra nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ chor yug nyi shu/ dngul gyi tha phag rnams byin/ bde 'byor gra tshang spyi sos slob dpon ngag dbang don grub kyi gsol 'debs bskul ba bzhin bris/ shel dkar chos sde'i gra pa gnyis kyis gsar rtsom dbu phar mdzod dang thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa'i gra pa gnyis kyis dbu phar gyi rgyugs sprad/ gong nas gser yig par des ger dge slong dang shes rab 'od zer can brgya lhag cig 'byor/ bka' shog dang gnang sbyin sprad/ bka' shog shubs bcas gnyis 'dug pa'i gcig rgya sog bar gyi gzhung don la phebs pa yin snang / mtsho kha phyogs nas rgya'i sa mtshams su mkhas mi mkhas 'dra byung ba'i rkyen (30na)gyis rgya dmag tshan che ba grong lang du slebs pa dang pho brang du rab tu byung bar khas 'che ba 'ga' zhig gi spyod pa ma dag pa la brten ser mo ba mang po so sor gnas dbyung sogs sgo du ma nas 'di lo gser yig pa'i zlar 'grul pa shin tu nyung / 'on kyang mi sna gnyis dang 'or dus su tshe ring tha'i ji'i bu mo'i bsngo zhus/ dor rta nang so'i bskur ma/ tha yan chi'i mis mtshon gang yod rnams kyis gos dar dang gser dngul gyi ster cha byas/ gnas snying zhabs drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po yon tan seng ge gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i lha sde/ rtse 'brong gis thog drangs pa'i drung 'khor sogs rgyal rtse khul gyi skya ser rnams kyi 'go mi rdzong sdod rdo dgon pa ba rta mgrin rnam rgyal gyis byas te ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung la 'byor/ gser/ gos dar/ ras snam/ pags rigs/ bu ram gyis gtsos pa'i bdog pa/ rngo thogs pa bteg /tshe dpag med kyi bskyed chog dang gsol 'debs bkra shis kyi me —41

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)tog gtor/ ru thog dbang po'i sras rab brtan/ gsung sgrog pa gsas khang dgon pa'i dge 'dun brgya skor/ gra lcog gra sprul sku/ de mo slob chung blo bzang bsam 'phel/ 'ba' ra sku skyes/ kong po rgyal skor ba bsod nams dbang po sogs phrad mi mang du byung /gter ston dri med lhun po'i gdung rabs dgu pa chos 'byung dbon pos gter sku zhig dang gter ston gyi gdung rus byin/ khong tshor sde pa gong ma'i dus lto skal phran bu gnang ba rnams la 'di ga'i the'u dang chu stag rgyal pos sgar thog nas gnang ba'i phyag (30ba)tham yod 'dug rung grog khang steng pa'i bla ma sku skye zer bas rtsi 'jog ye ma byas par phyogs pa'i don smin yong la re byed kyang mgron gnyer bka' blon tshor rngan pa ster rgyu mi 'dug pa'i stabs stong log tu phyir dengs song / ngor mkhan po dpal gling chos rje grongs pa'i bsngo rten skyel mi slebs/ khong pa 'chad nyan 'phel ba'i mkhan po legs rab byung song yang klu sdings pas gnod pa 'ba' zhig byas pa'i dus mi bde ba'i ngang la song / gong du 'gro mi star sdong dka' bcu ba dang lha mos rgyab pa gnyis kyis ster cha gzengs bstod/ rgyal rtse'i brtan bzhugs pa skya ser dang gsang phu gling stod chos rje/ gzhi ba slob dpon/ 'bras spungs 'dul ba zur pa/ zhang ston pa/ pha bong kha pa'i gdan sa pa/ drug brgya chos mdzad ri brgya skor la phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ brag ra bla ma ngag dbang padma dbang phyug /drug brgya chos mdzad sogs mang bar rgyal sras thogs med pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma/ lha sa'i tshes bcu pa rnams la le'u brgyad ma dang le'u bdun ma gnyis kyi lung bklags/tshes bdun la rgyal po/ rgyal mo/ sras mi bzang / stag rtse tha'i ji/ zangs ri dpon sa/ sgrom mda' mkhan po/ sgrom mda' sde pa/ lha sa'i bsnyen gnas ma khag gnyis sogs byin rlabs zhu mi mang bar byung / legs ldan nag po gdong bzhi pa'i dus kyi mchod gtor rgyas par phul/ mnga' ris lwa dgas bde ldan gyis rang go ma chod pa'i yi phyogs bzhir mug pa'i dpe ltar khyi gu can la rgyu mtshan lab mi mkhas mdzad (31na)pa dang 'brug pa nang ma 'cham pa'i skyon gyis sems kyi sog le shing la —42

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanam song bar rgyu sdug yin khul gyi khrig se dang dpe thub pa'i mchod gzhis pa gnyis zla bcas bong bu mun nag tu 'phul ba'i tshul gyi mi snar btang 'dug kyang de gnyis kyis ngag ma lab shes rigs su mi snang / mnga' ris rgyal po'i mi sna yin zhes gnas skor ba dang dbyibs mtshungs pa des rang sma rang 'bebs kyi thabs kho nar song / mi sna gcig gis bsnyen rdzogs dang cig shos kyi dge bsnyen du bsgrubs pa'i sdebs su kong po chos 'byung dgon dang gtsang byang chub gling gi bla ma sogs bsnyen rdzogasang drug /dge tshul go lnga/ drug brgya chos mdzad kyi sring mo can dge tshul ma drug rnams bsgrubs/ mi sna chos byas nas log lugs la dpags na dge slong 'char ka ltar sprul pa min pa'i nges pa'ang mi snang / rgyal mo gnyis/ zangs ri dpon sa/ lcam nor bu khra sgor/ sgrom mda' mkhan po/ gsang sngags gling dang thar pa gling gi bla ma/ bkra shis lhun po'i mgron gnyer bcas mang rab cig la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang bskur/ bde chen chos 'khor ba/ tshal tha'i je/ du ri yal dge tshul mas gtsos phrad mi phyed sum brgya tsam byung /tshes bcu la rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku dpon slob sum cu skor gyis bdog pa'i skyes spel te ring por 'tsho ba'i bden brjod mdzad/ a pa la'i dpon mo mi bzang dang bcas pas gos wo gyi ko dra dang ja ko dra sogs kyi brgya 'bul bteg /sog dmangs lnga brgya la byin rlabs dang er khe kho sho chis (31ba)gson bsngo'i rten byung bar bar chad sel ba'i bsngo smon bgyis/ a pa la'i dpon g.yog /sgrom mda' mkhan po/ de mo slob chung / kong po rgyal skor ba/ gsang gling thar gling slob dpon pa/ drug brgya chos mdzad/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul no gon dge tshul sogs brgya skor la dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang bskur/tshes bcu gcig la zangs ri dpon sa'i zhabs drung gis sbyin bdag mdzad gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshe chog btang / tshogs kyi yo byad phyur bur spungs shing gos snas gtsos pa'i ster cha rngo thogs par mdzad/ gnas chung chos skyong chen po slar bu la khog —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)zhugs byas nas phas ltad mo blta mkhan byed pa yongs gsungs 'dug rung sku khog gis mi mkhas pa zhig byung ba yin nam tshangs pa dung thod can gyis gnas chung chos rgyal li yul du 'byon gsung ba'i dus babs yin sogs dgos dbang ji ltar yang sras po bsod nams na yun ha cang mi ring bas ma 'tsho zhing zhe dgu thon nas sde pas sku chas kyang gsar bzo cha chang gnyis bzos shing bu dbang rgyal rdo rje la sku phebs kyi sta gon mang du byas rung 'di lo gsal ba ye ma byung / slob dpon 'phrin rgyam pa'i kha ton du bdag bstod dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi dri gtsang khang gi mchod rdzas kyi deb ther 'go brjod bi warta can bris/ rong nas chu tshan blangs pa'i zhag brgyad kyi bar 'phrod bsten byas/zla 'phros dang hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco brgyad bar ngal gso dang thob yig dri ba sbrags te phyi mtshams bcad/ lha sa byang sgo steng pa'i bgos (32na)phud la lho brag mar pa'i bzhes can byung ba nang rten khrod du yod/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku dang gzhis ka shar skrun pha bu rnams la nyang gi gter ma'i smin lam dbang gi rgyal po snang srid lha 'dre'i srog dbang / byang gter bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / sprul sku sger du dug khrag 'bum lcags skor/ bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti/ nyang gi gter ma'i rnam thar zangs gling ma/ gter kha 'og ma'i mdzad pa bcu gcig pa/ padma bka' thang ratna gling pa'i 'tsho rgyal skor gsum/ gnyal ston pa'i lha chen nor bu gcig pa sogs lung phyag bzhes kha shas bzhed pa dang sbyar/ bzhi pa'i 'gor 'dod khams dbang phyug ma mdos mchod 'bum gyis bkang ba'i snyan dar la zhal byang bris/ mtshams khog tu rgyal por lcags stong ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/ dpon mo tshe ring dang a mi dha ras bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ dge slong blo bzang don grub/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho/ rdzong ri chos rje blo bzang padma bzhis phur pa'i bsnyen chen gyi dus bskul ba'i brgyud 'debs brtsams shing bzhi po dang mnyam du gnang byung chos mdzad kyis ga rma gu ru'i bsnyen pa hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du btsugs pa'i phyag len dmigs pa rnams kyang zhib tu khrid/ ngag dbang dpal 'byor/ thod ri bshad sgrub gling slob dpon —44—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)bzod pa rgya mtsho gra dmangs dang bcas pa/ yer pa gra tshang spyi tshogs kyis bskul pa'i smon lam brtan bzhugs/ rta dpon rnams 'joms kyi kha rtan tu o rgyan rin po che (32ba)dang a pa la'i gyi nyams len du rdo rje 'chang la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mchod dpon pas ri bo chos gling gi 'du khang zhig gsos dus dpal ldan dmag zor mar phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig /chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse dang pu shud pa blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang gi spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrubs thabs/ sde pa gdong kha ba'i nyams len du rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas 'khyer bde ba rnams bris/tshes bcu dgu la 'brug pa'i phyag mdzod chos dbang / dwags po hūṃ pa/ 'brong rtse ba sogs kha shas dang phrad/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon dge 'dun brgya lhag gi zhabs gra byams pa gling pa dang rgyal gling tshogs pa gnyis kyis 'thud pa'i zang zing gi ster cha spel te yun du 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ gsang phu gling smad chos rjes gtsos gsang ne'u thog gi bla ma kha shas/ khams nas 'khor ba'i gong dkar gnas gsar tshe dbang dang khrom sa pa/ sde pa lcang ra ba/ sgrom mda' mkhan chen mthu stobs dpal 'byor/ hor bar ta'i dpon btsun chung rnams la ja gral byas/ a pa la'i dpon dpon mo skor bcas/ lha btsun chung pa'i sras thu med bstan pa/ rmog lcog sku skye ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ bang rim chos sde'i gnyer pa gnyis kyis gtsos mi grangs lnga bcu skor la a pa la'i gyis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs gsar rtsom dang blo bzang rgyal ba ma'i lung bklags/ sgam po gdung brgyud sgam spyon du grags pa nang khul du ma mthun par gnas dbyung la brten kong po sogs phyogs mthar bgrod (33na)de drag sngags kyi gdams pa mang po la zhun thar bcad/ dpe rnams bshus te nang mi tsho rje mi la'i a ba dang a khu lta bu zhig bzo rtsis la bsam pa la khar las nas bang rim chos sder grongs dpe rnams kyang der lus pa gnyer pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos dar can rgan gzhon gnyis kyis byin byung ba khungs btsun dngos gtsang sha stag tu snang / sgrom mda' mkhan po/ byams gling —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)mkhan po can 'ga' zhig la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod ma dkar mo'i 'pho ba/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dbu ma'i lta khrid rnams kyi lung phul/ smon lam chen mo'i dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog rung khang gal che bar brten sde pas zhal bkod legs par mdzad nas gsar bzo grub bstun tshogs khro lung bcu ma kha skor la mtho nyer brgyad re yod pa'i che legs lnga/ jo shāka sku mdun du mchod kong kha mtho drug re yod pa bcu drug rnams kyi rgyur khro zangs li 'dres pa mkhar rgya'i khal chig stong phyed bzhi brgya/ bsha' dkar khal drug cu re drug /do dam bkras rab pa can dang lo ro ba bcu drug gis zla ba gsum song ba'i phogs yon ston mo 'bru thog tu dril bar mkha' ru'i khal nyis stong bdun brgyar nye ba song / bsnyen rdzogs brgyad cu gya gsum dang dge tshul so lnga bsgrubs/nyer dgu'i zhogs u khe re'i tha'i ji'i btsun pa/ yod khon khyo shugs/ du re yal dge tshul ma/dpon mo tshe ring gis gtsos pa'i bzhi bcu skor dang hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la a pa la'i gyi dpon mo gzhen pa can sum cu lhag la smyung gnas kyi gso sbyong / bco lnga la (33ba)sa'i khan ju dang dpon mo tshe ring gis thog drangs pa brgya skor la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa dang skyabs 'gro'i khrid phab/stag lung gi nang rten jo bo chen po a ti sha'i phyag ting / chos rgyal byang pas lhang lhang brag nas gdan drangs pa'i slob dpon chen pos bdud rigs dam la btags pa'i rdo rje chos dbang gi dus thugs la dran nas bon po srung skyob la gnang ba thon zil gnan pas byin/ rdzing phyi mkhan po byams gling skyesamachog /chag byang chub gling gi sku skye/ brag dbang slob dpon/ kre pa khro bo dkar po/ ngan thub/ lha 'bum/ lha rgyal dar gyi nu po dkon cog sogs bzhi brgya nye ba dang phrad/ sde pa phon mdo ba'i sras po dge bsnyen du bsgrubs/ yer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pa dge 'dun phyed nyis brgya tsam gyis zang thing gi bdog pa dang bcas yun du gnas pa'i smon lam mdzad pa dang phyogs mthun du 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i gser yig pa rgan gzhen 'grul bsdebs rnams kyis gser dngul gyi maṇḍal dang gos dar bteg nas gsol ba btab/ stod lung tsher gseb dgon pa bas tshan grangs dang rgod tshang —46

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)pa'i gsang yum mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i phyag len gyi ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel dang de mtshungs tshe skyabs kyis gcos pa'i nag tshang pa rnams kyis rta nor brgya phrag gi bdog pa bstabs/ gong gi gser yig pa rgan gshon gnyis sogs bsnyen rdzogs zhe bzhi/ dge tshul gya gcig /dge bsnyen gnyis rnams bsgrubs/ mi sna gzhon par ming blo bzang phun tshogs su btags/ gser yig pa gnyis/ ong khon/ lcang ra nas/ kre pa'i (34na)dpon gsum gyis gtsos pa'i phyed nyis brgya tsam la skyer snang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po dang grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang bskur/ mon 'dzum lang gi rgyal po'i mi sna je tu bhaṇḍa ri/ ā nanda bhaṇḍa ri/ dpon drung khro bo rnam rgyal rnams 'byor ba'i rten bcas kyi gtso bo de bzhin gshegs pa glang po che sa la rab brtan du 'khrungs pa'i mche ba yin zer ba 'dom pa gang lhag pa dang srog ldan ma lha ra gnyis/ ras dkar po sha mi sgrib kyis gtsos dngos po gtos che ba snang / rgya nag tu glang po che gson po'ang mang du mthong rung mche ba de 'dra yod pa ye mi 'dug pas khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin par mngon/ mi sna rnams la bdag rkyen gang legs dang 'phrin lan lhug pa skad shan sbyar ma/ gos chen dngul gyi tha phag gi rten lan dang bcas bskur/ a pa la'i skor bcas drag rigs sum cu lhag la nang rten rags rim gyi mjal ka /dpon po dang sras mo gnyis la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/ ban chung dpon mo gsum dmangs yongs rdzogs la skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po dang phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang / sa'i khan thus bskul ba'i nyams len nyung ngu don gsal gyi dmigs skor bshad pa dang bcas pa byas/ dpon mo tshe ring gi kha ton du smon lam/ dpon mo bsod nams sgrol ma'i ngor gsol 'debs/ chos 'khor lha sa ba spyi tshogs kyis bskul pa'i bstan pa rgyas shing de 'dzin rnams brtan pa mi bdag gi sku tshe dang mtshan jus 'phel ba/ gnas skabs (34ba)dang mthar thug bde ba grub pa'i smon lam khyab che ba gang gi skabs su'ang bton chog pa rnams bris/ a pa la'i dpon g.yog la shal dkar dmar snam phrug gis gtsos yul lugs dang bstun pa'i rdzong ba bzabs/ spe ser bla ma/ chog thu ja'i sang / ja'i sang kho sho cha'i dge tshul ma can la —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ja gral btang / byang chub gling sku skyes 'on gyi dgon pa gsar par gsang snying gi bshad pa tshugs la re yin pas dgos tshul byung ba ltar rtsa rgyud kyi lung byas/hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la rgyal mtshan mthon po'i phyag mdzod pas tsha rong dpon tshang dge slong dang gsol dpon gnyis bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag smon lam dgos tshul la btang 'dug pa 'phral du brtsams nas bskur/ de mtshungs mda' dpon gzer chen pas bka' 'gyur bzhengs par 'dod sbyar gnam rab gzhis gnyer dgos dgos kyi ngor lha ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan gyi brtan bzhugs/ chos skyabs tha yan chi'i nyams len du bdun rnam dag dang 'brel ba'i smon lam dang sde brgyad la springs yig /bying bsam gtan rtse bla mas bskul ba'i bdag bstod rnams bris/ tshes bcu bzhi la gra tshang spyi dang mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis tshogs 'khor bdog pa gya nom pa dang bcas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshe chog btang /gsol dpon ge ra bas bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dang gong gi mi sna gnyis kyi kha tan tu gsol 'debs bris/ 'di lo'i stod smad tshor yan lag res bde res (35nas bde'i 'phrod bsten phran bu kha yar dgos pa byung rung rkang 'theng lag khyog gi ngang nas brel ba gcod pa las lus pa ma byung /hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la lcang ra nas/ hūṃ nas/ rnam sras gling nas/ 'brong rtse nas/ mgron gnyer drung pa/ stag ru nas/ mda' dpon gnyis kyis thog drangs drung 'khor gzims byung ba spyi bsdus kyis tshogs chas spyi 'byed gos dar snam phrug sogs ster cha dpangs mtho bar btegs nas tshoms chen du gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog rgyas par btang / 'bul yig le tshan la lcang ra nas kyis 'go brjod kyi rtsom pa'ang nad khyag byas/drung 'khor rnams la tshoms chen du bzhugs gral btang ba'i dus sbyar ra dngos grub kyis gso ba rig pa la brten pa'i 'phros gtam btang 'dug pa spobs pa mtho bar grags/—48—

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)shing rta chos rje brag sna bas gsang sngags gling pa rnams snye thang bde ba can du spo ba'i sa bcad la brten 'phags sde ba dang dgon brjes kyi sgo dod par chos rje 'gyur ba dang ra ba stod pa dol nas 'pho dgos pa gnyis 'dom pa las rgyu rkyen gzhan med pa'i shangs su dgon gnas mi 'dzin ka med ma 'phrod pa'i sa brjes kyi zhu 'bul la 'dod sbyar bzhin snye thang brag sna dgon rten gsum mchod rdzas/ thab gdan chas cha 'grig /them 'dzin lnga/ lag yong mkha' ru'i khal phyed nyis stong skor/ tshe chu sgrub sde 'di slob dpon chen po'i gnas khyad par can du song bas tshe chog gtong ba'i khyad nas gong ra nges gsang rdo (35ba)rje gling par sprad/ gzhi ba rnams bsam gtan gling tu spos par 'tsho thabs su 'bru khal byed nyis brgya/ yar klungs bkras rab par ljangs khri khang gzhi kha ka /them 'dzin bcu gcig /lag yong chig stong chig brgya/ 'phyong rgyas mthong dga' bar snye mo dgon 'don rkang lnga bcu skor sa ris rgya khyon che ba'i mi nor tshang 'grig gi steng du mag pa sde pa yol gdong pa nang mtshams su ma mthun pa'i rgan pa'i skal pa'i tshab tu rta nag rang byon gzhis ka /them 'dzin so gsum/ lag 'bab nyis stong phyed sum brgya skor/ shangs pa lha dbang la phyab spel khungs gzhis ka /them 'dzin gsum/ lag 'bab stong rwa can/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis sa phag rgyus med pa sor bzhag gis nged rang la mgo bskor ba'i myug sbubs zos byas pa 'jags 'os su ma song / bsgrubs yus med pa'i zhu re byed don mi 'dug drang zhu nan la brten span khum bu/ lu lung gi lud khang / them 'dzin bzhi/ lag yong drug brgya rnams sprad par drung 'khor 'gas kho snga phyi bar gsum du bsam sbyor ma dag pa kho na byed par rtsad gcod med pa'i khar ngus pa'i mchi mar de 'dra yod na nged phyag g.yog byed mkhan tshor khal bzhi brgya tsam byung na bka' drin skyong por rtsi dgos 'dug pas bka' blon dang mgron gnyer tshor rngan pa thebs ma thebs las tha snyad ci yod ces gleng yang mi zhig gis rgya ri zad nas zan gcig pu zos par gsol skrums e bskyar gyi lan du da gin nas 'di ga yin byas pa'i dpe bzhin dga' ldan pho brang bar snga mo nas srol de 'dra yod do/ /—49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)thos bsam dar rgyas gling slob dpon 'dus sde dang bcas pas bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs (36na)bcad/ bde chen khang gsar stag ru ba nor bus dad rten du gser sku gsum bzhengs pa bsod nams kyi yul du byas pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam/ sngar go cha rnams la gra sgrig par bkab gcig mi 'dug pa sde pas go mdzod rdo rje gling gsar brgyab tu g.yul chas tsho gra bsgrigs pa'i tshes bcu dgu dmag dpon tha skar gyi 'grub sbyor thog spyi'i deb ther gyi 'go brjod las gsol go'i skor/rta dmag gi go cha adhi gnyis pa bzabs mchor/ ru mtshon dkar po'i tsho chen gyi bzabs mchor dang thag ring du bgrod pa yang chas 'jug bde/ de bzhin du ru mtshon ser po/ dmar po/ mthing nag so sor rgyas bsdus kha bsgyur chog pa/ rgya gar/ rgya nag /hor sog /khams 'brog gi go mtshon rnams kyi deb ther 'go brjod bi warta can thugs bzhed ltar bris shing sde dpon gyi tshugs kha 'dzin pa la med thebs med pa zhig snang / mchog dman kun la skyes lan mtshar kha/ sbyin gtong gi deb kyi 'go brjod stag ru ba nor bus smed pa rnams bris/ nyer gcig la chos 'khor lha sa ru bzhi nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bdog pa'i skyes bcas dpangs bstod/ gong gi gser yig pa gnyis/ byams gling mkhan po/lam pa spyan snga/ sa chen dbon po/ khang gsar rab brtan/ bkra shis rtse pa bsod nams mgon po/'brong rtse nas/ bde chen khang gsar ba gnam gang 'brug rgyal/ skya ril can sum cu skor la nang mjal rags rim btang / nyer gnyis la zhang ston sku mdun lhun grub kyis bzang ja sbyor sbrel tshan grangs kyi thog gra tshang gi gra pa bcu tsam gyis mkha' (36ba)'gro sde lnga'i bsu bzlog tshigs bcad ma gsungs/da la'i hung tha'i ji dang mkha' 'gro'i mi sna/ mon snang rdog rgyal po/ rwa bsgreng mkhan po/ thar pa mkhan po byams pa bsod nams dngos grub/ sgrags sngags lcog dang spang ga spongs ha ri kha'i bla ma/ kre nag tshang gi dpon po bdun/ rdzogs chen sku skye/ spung ri sku skye/ skyor lung phug khang pa dang dol gsung rab gling gi bla ma/ 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon khri gdan zur rnams dang phrad/ bsnyen rdzogs zhe dgu dang /dge tshul go gnyis bsgrubs/ bsam blo lam pa spyan snga la ster cha byin te rang yul du thon/ rgya nag gi mi —50

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)sna 'grul sdebs dang bcas pa la ye shes khyung khra'i rjes gnang byas/ gser yig pa rnams thon pa dang lhan du byams gling mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang khang gsar rab brtan gnyis gong du zhu yig 'bul rten dang rgya sog bar gyi gzhung la sel cung zad byung bar mtsho sngon po'i dpon po khag gis gong du dgongs bsangs la rta nor gyis gtsos pa'i dngos po dpangs mtho bar phul/ sa mtshams rnams kyang so sor ma 'dres bar dbye/ rkun jag gi rigs mi yong ba'i phan tshun nas khrims kha bsdams/tshong gi las sgo mi bsdam pa sogs rgya sog gzhung bzang po dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'bul bar btang /de ga'i skor la sde pa dang rgyal po bka' bgros shing da la'i khung tha'i jis kyang khur bsam bskyed pa'i dpon po rnams kyis ya la'i 'bul ba la'ang rtseg gtam ma byas pas dus 'khrug zhi ste lus can 'byam klas par mi 'jigs pa byin pa'i 'bras bu gcig tu dkar (37na)zhing gzhung bstan pa mtha' dag la phan bde'i gsos sman bla na med par gyur/ lcags zam sprul pa'i sku me tog 'thor ba'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor/ re zhig sku tshe brtan na jo shāka gi brtan bzhugs su lcags zam 'dzugs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i sman yon du 'gyur ba zhig yong 'dug kyang dus kyi dbang gis de rigs la bar chad mang bar snang / stag lung zhabs drung ngag gi dbang phyug bar khams nas phebs par bkur gzos lha sde mi sde gang rung gi lugs bzhin ma thub pas mtha' gnyis su ma lhungs pa'i dbu ma'i lam la brten cing zhabs drung dang mon sgang rdog pa/ sde pa lcang ra ba/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma rnams la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang / yig drug bzlas lung / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam rnams kyi lung bklags/ nyer bzhi nas yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu la zhugs/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga la stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras/ dga' ldan gsung rab gling bla ma/ mon me rag bla ma gra bcas/ khu thug thu bstan 'dzin sku skye/ bdud 'dul dka' bcu'i mi sna/ bkra shis kyi dpon mo rnams dang phrad/ stag rtse tha'i ji la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang phul/ lhos la ma rim pa lnga bcu skor zang zing gi skyes dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung la 'byor/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang ring —51 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ gdong nas dang sbyar ra dngos grub gnyis la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi lung bklags/ gra rigs rnams kyis bskul ba ltar grub dbang lcags (37ba)zam pa kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug sku skye myur 'byon gyi smon lam/ skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan gyis pha'i don du don grub kyi sku brnyan dang stag lung ngag gi dbang phyug gi thugs dam thang sku'i rgyab yig rnams bris/tshes dgu nas gra tshang gis dmag zor ma'i rgyun mdos btang / tshes bcu bzhi la 'brug pa'i blon po bla ma la sngon pa/ khams bde dge'i bla dpon phun tshogs gnyis 'jig rten pha rol gyi ltad mor song bar tshoms chen du spyan gzigs bzabs rgyas su bshams/ gsar du dmar bye gshog ma'i khyab gos gsham ma rmog bcas legs pa/ gtor ma'i ri bo/ sman rag gi rgya mtsho/ mchod pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo bstar te nyin bzhi'i bar phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyis gtang rag gi mchod pa rgyas par phul zhing snyan dar la las bsgrubs kyi tshigs bcad bkod/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling pa'i smra seng can gra pa lngas gsar rtsom dbu phar mdzod rnams kyi rgyugs sprad/ ta 'on chos rje/ bstan 'dzin sku skye/ du ri yal gyi nu bo mo ja rag so sos gos dar ja ko dra sogs kyi brgya 'bul bstar/ sha ri tha'i ji'i ma/ sgrom mda' mkhan po/ ri khrod dga' ldan zur pa spyan g.yas blo bzang rnam rgyal/ kong po nags phu bla ma/ rgyal ri khrod pa bcu skor/ hor 'byog /lho sog skad dang zhwa gos rigs mi gcig pa nyis stong tsam la byin rlabs byas/ bstan 'dzin sku skye dang sha ri tha'i ji'i ma sogs dge tshul kha shas bsgrubs/ zhing skyong nang sos bskul ba'i 'jam dbyangs la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngas gzims(38na pog byang pa mgon po rab brtan gyi ngor ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad bris/ rgyal rtse ba 'jam dbyangs dbang po dang ngag dbang phun tshogs spun gnyis kyis 'di lo nas bzung dpe cha 'dri bar bcar sdod byas/ 'phags pa lha sprul pa'i sku bar khams nas phebs pa'i hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig mjal/ja khor drug ma sum brgya/ rta dral mdzo g.yag khrab sogs ster cha dngom che ba mdzad/ zhabs drung byams —52

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)pa'i phyag mdzod ga bye la chos rje'i bsngo zhus pa mo ja rag u rang kha a zhi'i bu dkon cog gi bsngo zhus/lhun po rtse mkhan po/ to rong slob dpon/ dung dkar sku skye/ mi rje dkon gnyer dpon pa/ long po bkra shis chos gling gi bla ma/ rag shul bla ma/ tshal nas zhabs drung grags pa/ ldan ma zal dkar bla ma/ dar rtse mdos yang / ta 'on shi ri ye thu'i mi sna rnams dang phrad/ so sos gang la'i gyi ster sbyin dang tha shi sbo lod kyis gos dar dang ja ko dra'i brgya 'bul bteg /ri khrod dga' ldan zur pa spyan g.yas pa/ mkhar skya grub chen/ nyan po chos 'phel sogs ri khrod pa sum cu skor la gsar rtsom bla ma mchod pa le tshan dang klu gtor gyi lung byas/ mkhar skya grub chen gyis lta ba la dogs gcod kha yar byed par de ga'i lan btab/ rdzong gzhis bcu dgu bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar chig brgya so bzhi/ gdugs dkar chig 'bum/ mtshan brjod sum 'bum/ sman bla nyi khri/ sgrol ma chig 'bum/ sher snying bzhi 'bum/ tshe gzungs chig 'bum/ tshe chog gnyis/ gshin rje'i sngags ring bye ba/ ma ṇi (38ba)dung phyur gnyis/ badzra gu ru dung phyur gcig /lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum la brgya mchod sna lnga/ gser chab/ snyan shal/ lha sar 'phar mchod nyin bdun/ pha bong kha yer pa yom bu sogs gnas chen bcu la mchod 'bul snyan shal/ gra sa phan tshun du ja tshul sum cu re/ chos 'khor rgyal du dmag zor ma dang beg tser bkang ba khri/ gzhan rnams la brgya rtsa byas/ tshes gnyis la ge re lha pa yab sras gsung ram pa'i ban tshang pa zhig yod 'dug pa phyag phyir khrid pa'i gsung chos rgyas par mdzad khul la gra pa rnams yong ba'i tshes grangs 'phyugs te thor bu las 'byor ma song yang gang yod kyis thog mar 'jigs byed kyi cho ga dang dngos gzhi tshe dpag med kyi mngon rtogs la brten nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung gsungs/sha gtso bor gyur pa'i tshogs 'khor shin tu rgyas pa rdzong gi phyi nang thams cad tshim par mdzad/ ras lcags 'bras stag lpags kyis mtshon pa'i ster cha dang gra tshang du khum bu'i 'gyed btang /tshes gsum la se ra theg chen gling bla ma gra bcas nyis brgya lhag byon pa'i bzhes spro bdog pa dang bcas yun du gnas pa'i bden pa brjod/ de mtshungs rgyal me tog thang chos rje gra pa nyi shu skor —53—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lanagyis zhal 'don rgyas par gsungs/ bsnyen rdzogs brgya sodagu dang dge tshul brgya bcu gnyis bsgrubs/skyor lung khyams pa bla mas gtsos pa'i gra pa nyis brgya skor/ stod rgyud slob dpon/ chos rje bco brgyad pa/ mon me rag bla ma gra bcas phyed sum brgyar nye ba'i phrad mi mang pa byung / gong dkar dkon (39na)gnyer gra tshang gis tshan grangs spel ba'i ma gcig 'gro ba bzang mo lugs kyi brtan bzhugs kyi phyag len bstar/ rtse tshogs mkhan chen tre bo bsod nams rgyal mtshan steng grib kyi bsnyun par sa dge spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i brtan bzhugs/ thod ri slob dpon bzod pa rgya mtsho dus las 'das par nye rigs kyi ngor smon lam/ gzhis rtse mnga' khul spyi'i kha ton du ring 'tsho'i bden pa brjod pa/ bdud 'dul dka' bcu 'jigs med sgra dbyangs kyi mtsho kha nas dus sbyor gyi 'khor lo rgya nag lugs ngo mtshar can bzos te bskur ba'i rtogs brjod tshigs bcad rnams brtsams/ slob dpon blo bzang rgya mtshos khur khur ba'i dga' ldan gsang sngags gling du rtse lugs kyi tshes bcu rgyas par btsugs pa'i tshes lnga la 'cham phud dang gsang gling pa rnams kyis tshogs 'khor bdog pa'i sbyin bdag byas/tshes drug la gra tshang ma bu lhan du 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon la brten pa'i tshe chog btang /gtsang stod zha lu'i chos gra nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang phebs/ 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i gzungs las gsungs pa'i thub pa'i dbang po lha bdun gyi rig gtad/ sems nyid ngal gso'i nyams khrid kyis mtsho ni pa'i byin rlabs rjes gnang lung zab chos mang du zhus/ thugs dam gtor bsngo'i gras su rgyal po'i rgyun gsol nyung ngu zhig bris/ dgun dpyid kyi ring gong dkar chos sder phebs pa'i gsol phog phul/ gshin rje'i sgrub pa dang 'gong po ar la gtad pa'i las sbyor btsugs/hor zla brgya pa'i tshes (39bsko sum la zhal phu dpon sa lha sar zhabs skor du byon pa'i zhal 'don gyi gsol 'debs smon lam blo bzang rin rṣa la dgos tshul byung ba bzhin bslab bya/ mchod dpon pas bskul nas 'phrang 'go lha rtse brag gi srung ma rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i rgyun gsol rnams bris/ 'dzin pa lag mang phog thug cung zad tsam la'ang 'tshub cha'i rnam pa'ang kha shas la byung snang bas klu 'di sa —54

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadagazhi kun la dbang ba'i stabs kyis gtor ma phan yon che bas dkar cha bzhi las zur du phyung ba'i klu gtor zhig gra tshang gi tshogs su btsugs/ bon po gru tshang pa'i sar sngags gra slob dpon sgang chen pa/dpon tshang tsha rong pa/ dbu mdzad chos dbyings can gyi rje gong ma'i sku mas khyer nas ngos 'dzin la phyin pa rnams rim par gsal ba byung tshul phyag mdzod pas smed pa'i mi sna'i bskul mar mgron gnyer gzhon pa dka' bcu chos 'phel 'byor don bzhin ri khrod dga' ldan slob dpon byams pa rin chen/skyar po mgron gnyer rdo rje dbang phyug /mda' dpon 'or pa gsum btang ba'i sprul sku rin po che'i mtshan blo bzang ye shes su gsol thog slob dpon byams rin pas me tog gtor/ legs 'bul gzengs bstod/ bkra shis lhun po tshogs chen du khri ston gyi tshar mang 'gyed bzabs rgyas btang / de mtshungs rgyal pos kyang mi sna mngags pa'i legs 'bul bteg /brgyad la dga' ldan khri rin po che/ rtse shar gnyis/ slob chung / lnga mchod pa/ gra pa nyis brgya tsam dang shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor gyi bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel gra slob/ rdzong sdod khro (40na)phu bas gtsos drung 'khor dmangs brgya skor 'ol dga' rdzing phyi'i spyi pa dang bcas pa phyogs mthun gyis bdog pa dpangs mtho ba bstar ba'i yun du gnas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor ba rnams la sman bla'i mdo chog gi lung bklags shing bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal bskul ba'ang rjes su bskur/ bzhad yangasacan mkhan po/ sle ri/ mdo mkhar chos sde/ bkra shis chos gling /spos khang mkhan po/ bde chen chos 'khor ba/ zhal bu lcam rnams la ja gral btang / nyi lding drung 'tsho nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ thar gling bla ma/ dga' gdong dka' bcu blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ rgyal pa 'tsho byed gzhan phan rnams la gsar rtsom g.yu thog snying thig gi las byang / zhang blon gyi bkang gso/smyung gnas kyi lag len gsum gyi lung byas/tshes bcu la rgyal po 'khor bcas byang nas phebs pa dang mjal/ rgyal mo gzhen par phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang / rmi ru bla ma mdo sde rgya mtsho dang star sdong dka' bcu gnyis la rje dge 'dun rgya —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mtshos mdzad pa'i smyung gnas kyi cho ga dang gsar rtsom bla ma mchod pa che ba/ bkra shis ljongs chos rje dang tha shi sbo lod la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur/ rgya ri zhabs drung ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan phebs par ba ri lugs kyi rnam 'joms dang sgrol dkar/ phyag rdor gos sngon can/seng gdong ma sngon mo/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang rnams phul/ phyag bzhi pa bka' (40ba)ma'i chos skor gsan bzhed 'dug rung nged rang gis ma thob cing gter mgon gyi dbang lung cha tshang ba zhig slar 'bul ba'i khas len zhus/ tshur skyes dang bda' lan gyi bdog pa gzhis len shangs len rgyas par bstar/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster gyi rgyun khyer dgos tshul phebs pa'ang phul/ bsnyen rdzogs brgya bcu bzhi dang / dge tshul don bdun bsgrubs/ rgyal mo che ba sras bcas la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bskur/tshes bco brgyad la 'phags pa lhas tshogs 'khor ster cha 'gyed kyi sbyin bdag mdzad de gra tshang gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshe chog btang / stag sa'i rgyal bur sne'u sdong rtse'i lcam bsus pa'i dga' ston du mchod yon lhan brgyas gdan drangs pa'i zhor lam dga' ldan du phebs skabs dngul gdung rin po cher 'bul rgyu'i maṇḍal gyi zhal byang dang rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal gyi klu 'dzin pa lag mang gis bskul ba'i ja mchod bkod/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga nas bcu gnyis pa'i zla stod kyi ring rkang pa'i mgo'i nad ro 'phar bar drang srong chen po byang ngos pa'i phyag g.yog dar mo bas zhus te sman dpyad mdzad/ dga' ldan 'og min gling gi gra pa skyi lung rab 'byams pa can bcus gsar rtsom dbu phar mdzod sogs kha yar gyi rgyugs sprad/ byang chub gling sku skye dus kyi chos nyid du gyur par skye srid 'dzin pa'i smon lam dgos tshul na bza' gling chos rje ngag dbang rab brtan gyis bskul ba/ thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor spyi so'i ngor slob dpon blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs (41na sko rtse slob dpon bstan —56

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 'dapa rgya mtshos bskul ba'i yun 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ 'brom sdings drung 'tsho nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi kha rtan du sho lo ka gcig gi tshig rkang phyi ma rim pa bzhin yan lag bdun po so sor bsgyur chog pa/ka tshal bla ma rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub 'bam gyis bro 'tshal ba las grol tshul la legs sor brjod pa'i 'phrin lan tshigs bcad rnams bris/ 'di lo nas bzung star chags su rdo rje brag pas gong dkar/ chos rgyal pho brang du dpal ri ba/ gzhis rtser chos rje sgrol ma bas mgon po g.yul bzlog btang ba'i rgyab chos pa chos 'khor yang rtse ba dang gangs can chos 'phel bas thog drangs pa'i so sor dgon bzhi skor gyi shel rnying/ yar stod dar rgyas gling pa can bzhi skor gyis gdugs dkar btang zhing rdo rje brag pa'i lo gsar zla ba bcu gcig par yong pa'i stabs ga bsgyur te zla ba dgu par byed pa'i sa bcad byas/tshes bco lnga nas nad las grol khul gyis 'phags pa lha sprul pa'i sku/ thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku/ lho brag sde pa gdang pa/ co ne chos rje blo bzang nyi ma/ sde pa sa lung pa/ du gshon/ sna dkar rtse nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrig mi bkra shis lhun po'i tho yon blo bzang rdo rje/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa/ lho pa bla ma gu ru rnams dang phrad/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal legs grub khri thog zhabs drung dpon la sprad de dbus phyogs kyi gnas gzigs la dpon slob nyung bsdus zhabs 'gros kyis bka' brgyud gong ma'i brtul zhugs lhur blangs te phebs (41ba)pa dang mjal/ se chen rgyal po'i sras dga' ldan pa sman bcos log pas glo bur du dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i dge sgrub la dka' bcu ba sangs rgyas bkra shis can 'byor/ gos dar/ gon pa/ go mtshon/ dngul spyad/ shel spyad/ dkar yol/ gser/ gser dngul gyi sga dang sga dmar sogs gtad pa'i rta brgya/ sga med nyis brgya/ rnga mo sum brgya rgyab bcas kyi gtos che ba byung zhing dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ byang bu bzhus par lhar skye ba'i mtshan ma shar/ skyid shod chos rje'i sku skyes/ dga' ldan pa'i don du bskul ba'i smon lam/ zur khang chos mdzad rgyal don pa'i ngor bdag bstod/ gra tshang dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'dzin gyi 'dod sbyar gsol 'debs smon lam/rin skrungs mnga' khul skya ser/shangs bkra shis rtse pa'i ma blo bzang sgrol mas bskul ba'i yun 'tsho'i smon lam/sku rab dga' ldan rab brtan gyi gra rigs se rar sdod mi tsho'i ngor sgrom mda' mkhan chen mthu stobs dpal 'byor gyi brtan bzhugs/pho brang ge ra chos mdzad blo bzang dge 'dun khams ma bde ba'i dus gra tshang mgon khang du 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar zhal yig rnams bris/ nyer bzhi la dga' ldan 'og min gling bla ma gra bcas sum cu tsam/bzang ldan mkhan po rgyal rtse zhabs drung /rdzong sdod che gsum nas/sde pa 'dar pas gtsos lha rtse khul gyi drung 'khor spyis gser gos dar ras chas thog drangs bdog pa spel te yun du 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung rgyas par bsgrigs/lha rtse slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtshos mdo tshig dang 'brel ba'i gtam btang /rgyal rtse bdag po bgres pa byams pa ngag 42na ) dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsung bris su rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i tshe bdag la zhal dkar 'di gsol rdzas bkang nas gnang ba'i rten 'byung gis kho bo'ang na tshod mthon po 'dir slebs pas da snam brtan bzhugs la phul yod tshul byung ba'i zhal dkar nang rten gras su bcug/de mtshungs 'ol dga' nas skya ser brgya skor gyis rten 'brel bsgrigs/'khrul snang du rnal 'byor pa'i cha byed can gnyis 'ongs nas gnyan mgon phug tu mchod gtor zhig byas na legs zer bar mtha' gcig tu nges gzung dka' na'ang 'gyangs med du snyan dar go mtshon dar po che dang bcas mchod gtor btsugs/'di lo deb tu bkod pa'i sa spre nas hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga la gtor gso ma chag par yod/lha rtse 'ol dga'i rten 'byung bsgrigs mi rnams dang 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon bdun/hor smad ta dang bar ta'i dpon rnams dang phrad/ja gral gyi sar bzang ldan mkhan po dang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skor la los gleng byung ba'i rkyen gyis 'dul ba zur pa blo gros rnam rgyal yid phyogs te nyams 'khrid zhu 'dun gyi 'phros gleng mang bar byung /bzang ldan mkhan por gsar rtsoX mtshar chen la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)lung phul/ sha gzugs sku skyes gtsos pa'i dge tshul so brgyad/ bsnyen rdzogs so dgu/ dge bsnyen gnyis rnams bsgrubs/dgung lo nga gnyis par sde srid 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs dang /chos thebs gsar sprod dang byas can khag la sa ris bdag rkyen gnang ba/ ser 'bras kyi nang rten gsar bzhengs bcas kyi skor/dus rim le tshan rnams sngar 'byud bzhin btang ba'i sa sprel gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i bskang gso'i dus a pa la'i gyi mi sna (42ba po ri'i bu can gyis 'phan khyad par can dang 'phreng ba lnga byin/ bzhugs gral rnams dkyus bzhin byas thog co ne chos rjes spu ja shas che ba'i ko dra brgya phrag gis gtsos pa'i stong 'bul du nye ba bteg /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar gdung brgyud rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis khri 'don gnang ba'i legs 'bul du 'dar pa gzhen pa ngag dbang 'phrin las rdzong bda' byas pa'i yab sras gnyi gar snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i zhu yig bi warta dang bcas pa phul/tshes gsum la se ra theg chen gling gi slob dpon/ tre bo sku skye/ zhabs drung dbyangs can/ zhang ston sku mdun lhun grub/ tha'i ji nor bu rgya mtsho khyo shugs/ thon pa'i dpon sa sogs dang phrad/ lha rtse bla ma gra slob la sman bla'i mdo chog chen mo dang brtan sdod gsar pa'i lung bklags/ tshes bzhi la khri rin po che blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang mjal/ dge tshul so dgu dang / bsnyen rdzogs lnga bcu nga gsum bsgrubs/ bde chen tha'i ji bsod nams lha'i dbang phyug bstang zhal lha sa smon lam gyi tsha ra gtong —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)bar phebs zhor du byon/ snga sor nas ltas sna tshogs byung ba'i dogs sel la tshong 'dus dang mchims phu gnam the'i lung bstan zhig 'dug par dri ba dang sbrags 'phrin yig tshigs bcad snyan shal gser skyems dang bcas chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse/ gong mtshungs tshangs pa dung thod can la dogs gcod zhu bar 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin btang /tshes lnga nas zla gcig lhag tsam phyi mtshams khog tu thob yig bris/ tha'i ri'i (43na)gsung nan ches pas drug brgya'i sa ris rnams phyir sprod mdzad song / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bdun la tha'i ji rdo rje rnam rgyal la tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/ dar rgyas chos sdings nas gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po bde chen dpon sar dbang dang sku rim gnang bar 'byon zhor tshes brgyad la g.ya' ma lung gter gsar gyi padma gu ru'i sku tshab ster sbyin mdzad par gan gos yug bzang gnyis skyes lan du bstabs/sgrags phur bzhugs pa'i nub kyi mnal ltas su mchod yon spyi thog tu sku chags che ba yod pa'i mtshan ma byung bar sku rim dgos tshul gsungs/ bcu gcig la mtshams grol ba'i 'phags pa lha sprul pa'i sku/ lha rtse chos sde bla ma/ brag sna chos rje'i bsngo zhuga'abul bar chos rje gzhon pa/ dar rtse mdo sa yang /sa'i khan ju dang tshe dbang gi mi sna rjes slebs/ chos rje bkra bzang pa/ sde pa 'phon mdo pa sku mched/drug brgya chos mdzad rnams dang phrad/ 'phags pa lhar bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang / mi g.yo sngon po dang khyung khra'i rjes gnang phul/ rgyal pa slob dpon bar rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rnam sras kyi bkang gso dang gsar rtsom bla mchod che ba/ sde pa phon mdo pa mched la gsar rtsom bsnyen gnas 'bogs chog gi lung / tshal sde pa grags par rnam 'joms ljang sngon/ spos khang mkhan po dang shangs bkra shis rtse pa can la tshe dbang grub rgyal dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs byas/ bla ma brag la ba don grub rgyal mtshan la chos rgyal byang pa'i phyag bzhes kyi dregs pa nyi shu'i skor mtha' chod par (43ba smon ga pa shin tu zhib par dogs bcad/tshes bcu gsum la 'phags pa lha dpon slob la gos phyi nang / na bza' skor/ sbug chol sil 60

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)snyan/ ka ra bu ram gyi ltang tse/ rta/ snam phrug gis gtsos pa'i rdzong ba rgyas pa zhus/ 'od zer rgya mtshos gra tshang du snyan dar phul ba'i zhal byang / mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis sbyin bdag byas nas phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tshogs khro gsar blug gi kha byang / a san gyis bskul ba'i bdag bstod rnams bris/ thon zil gnon pa dwags po lcang ra ba can nyi shu tsam la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel byas/ rmi ru bla ma/ gung thang gzims khang shar bla ma/ rgyal po'i sras chung sogs phrad mi mang ba'i re ba bkang ste re zhig mtshams bsdams/de'ang zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gcig la nub phyogs su dus min gyi 'brug langs/ smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dkyil du bya rog 'ongs/ nyer drug nas bzung nub phyogs nas 'od dkar po ring ba rtse gnyis su gyes pa zhig zla phyed kyi bar shar/ po ta la'i lcags ri'i steng du rgod babs/ mon nas mtshan ma gnyis ldan gyi rta zhig lam bgags pas thob pa bskyal/ gong dkar rdzong mgon khang steng gi thug drag rlung gis bcag /byang gi rgyu skar smin mar bya rog gi tshang bsags te bskyur/ dwags su sa g.yos che ba sogs mi shis pa'i mtshan ma mang du byung zhing zla ba dang po nas sde pa chab gzhi'i bsnyun gyis zin pa 'phral du bsnyun zug med pas mngon chung gshis thugs brel gyis g.yengs pa'i 'phrod bsten le dbar shor/ drung 'tsho byang ngos (44na skos kyang glo bur du steng gi grib lta bu rgyu 'phrul dka' bas rtsa 'phral 'phral gzigs ma thub/ zhogs star gyi chu rtags ston par btang ba gzo po ma byung na phugs skran dang chur 'gyur dogs pa'i lung bstan las da lta nyen mi che ba'i khul gyi ngang la 'or du lhungs/ 'di nas sku rim gyi tho bskur ba'i dbus kyi dgon khag rags bsdus la mang 'gyed 'bum brgyas mtshon kha shas phab pa smon lam grol 'phral du rdzong bda' mdzad pas zhag gnyis ngo blangs pa'i bde ba 'dra zhig byung zer/ grong smad nas tshangs pa dung thod can la lung bstan zhu mi btang 'dug par bsnyun babs dang bar chad kyi ngo che/ sku rim kyang yig drug dung phyur khag lnga tsam phab snang ba 'phral du btsugs kyang rdzogs lang ma byung / chos skyong gi de dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i dgongs —61 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lanagazhi can yin tshod du mchis/ drung 'tsho ba lhag bsam nyin star gyi phyag rtsa zhu bar btang ba bzang ngan thag chod kyi gsal kha ma rnyed rung chu rtags kyi babs la bltas na chab gsog byung dogs che ba 'dug pas/ dngar skyur gyi rigs dang sha sogs bzhes pa mi 'gab tshul zer byung zhing ngos su yang zhus par yid brtan che ba zhig mdzad tshod du mi snang / skad cha dri bshad byas pa tsho'i nga kha mi mthun pa mang sangs rgyam pa 'byor ba'i skad cha la'ang bzheng 'dug sogs dka' las chen po yod 'phros zer bas stag ru nas la saṃ ṭa bskur bar yang sangs rgyam pas zer ba dang dbyibs mtshungs gshis/ skyar po nas nye len la btang ba bab yul legs rgyu mi 'dug zer bas 'phyong rgyas (44ba)rab 'byams pa tshangs pa dung thod can la lung bstan zhu bar brdzangs/ mar dpon pa sde pa'i sar bto ba'i po ta lar 'phral 'byor 'gab tshul labs pa bzhin tshes bcu bzhi'i zhogs par byon/ lam du u'i ching gis mi shes pa'i rta de la zhen nas yar phyin pa dang mjal bar kha ma thub pa'i sde pa phyogs su phyi 'gros kyis car bar drung 'bor rnams kyis nyed dgos pa rma 'dug /byang ngos nas dang nang skor ba tsho ha cang zom drags pa ma gtogs chab kyi skrangs po shin tu che bar gdon byad lta bu'i gnod pa yin na phan du re bas ltas ga gyi rta de dang mnyam du rgyal rdzongs brdzangs/ 'chi blu/ byad 'grol/ gdon 'grol/tshe dbang dang drag dmar gyi dbang sogs sna ma 'gags pa byas/ drung 'tsho byang ngos pa byon pa'i ra mo she sman gyi gter ma'i chu sman sbyor rgyu'i lugs kyi sta gon dang gtsang phyogs su mang 'gyed kyi gra bsgrigs/'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa 'khor bar dris pa sde pa'i sku rim cha gsum gtor ma tsam las gsal kha med pa la ma dris pa'i nged la rim gro tshan che ba 'bebs pa mdzad 'dug /tshes bcu bdun gyi nyi phyed la sku gshegs par nye bas sangs rgyam pa 'phros gtong bar byung 'phral phyin de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gis thog drangs pa'i dam rdzas mang du zhus zhing 'da' kha ma'i mtshams sbyor gyi 'pho dmigs sprad/ gzungs sngags zab mo dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod/ gzhis ka shar pa lags a gur bos pa'i gza' skar stabs nyin bzhi'i bar gsang —62

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasgo bsdams/ gsang khog nas sde pa phyogs kyi sgo gsal (45na〉pa zhus pa byas la rgya dang rgyal po sogs kyi skor la bsam yas dang tshong 'dus su chang khyim pa brdzangs/tshes nyi shu la gsang brtol ba'i jo bo shākya mu nir thod gos gser ma ser po/ 'ja' gos sngon gser ma ldebs su dngul gyi bab le gong par rdo rje rin po che'i phras spras/ gzhi gos tā shun la bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun tshem grub ma gsham gos nag si'u can lce le brtsegs bcu re yod par byu ru dang shel sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'dogs thag lcags lung gis byas pa'i phye phur cha/gzhi hor gos dmar po la lcags ri dang tshal bu gser gyi me tog zlum ris can gyi snam sbyar/ ding phon khyad mtshar gyi bla bre/ dngul srang nyis brgya skor las grub pa'i maṇḍal/ rang byon lnga ldan/ byamasapa chos 'khor/ rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan rnams la snyan shal/ ra mo che'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rjer bkras btags nyin mo bde legs ma/ gzhi mchin kha si'u ma lcags ri dang tshal bu la sangs rgyas stong sku yod pa'i snam sbyar/ gan gos gzhi sngon mtshon khra'i 'phan cha/ dngul gyi maṇḍal che legs/'phags pa lo ke shwa ra dang wa ti bzang po gnyis la nyin mo bde legs ma'i snyan shal/ bsam yas su byang chub chen por mgo gos sngon bab gzugs thog si'u'i pa tra ris dbus gsum so sor 'phan mgo'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i gser zangs kyi rgyan phra bcas mtha'i mun ran la gser zangs kyi 'bu ril gyi mtshams la byu ru mu tig dang ske mtshams su byu ru bzhi bcu stong skud sna tshogs kyi rdzar yod pa la go tshon khra'i (45ba)thog si'u'i lañtsa ma ṇi ma padma sprin rgyal mtshan gyi gzugs rgyab sha ling dmar 'dogs thag dngul gyi a lung bcas pa cha gnyis/ dngul gyi maṇḍal che legs/ khra 'brug tu thod dang gsham gong gos sngo 'jam steng mu tig gi rgyan dang ling kha dog sna tshogs kyi sham bu brtsegs bcu gsum re yod pa'i rgyal mtshan cha gcig /dga' ldan dngul gdung rin po cher gos dmar po yug sne tshang gi snyan shal so sor smon lam tshigs bcad ma bkod/ de phyin lha sa/ ra mo che/ bsam yas mthil mchims phu/ khrag 'brug /rwa bsgreng / rgyal me tog thang rnams su snyan shal/ gser chab/ brgya mchod —63—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khyadasna lnga/ dkar me gtos che ba phul/ gzhung sogs gnyis gnas tshul skyel bar mtsho khar 'phral du btang / gzims chung dogs pa dang bcas po ta la rtser rgyud stod pa slob dpon gra pa nyi shus zhag lnga'i bar gsang 'dus kyi gsung chog btang bar nar ma'i zhabs tog yon bzabs rgyas dang bcas pa/ pur po ta la'i rdzong du bzhu rtsis kyis dud pa byung dogs pa'i khyad nas brgyad gtor snga bsnur ba yin rung tshang mas mi 'gab tshul la brten rtsis la shar smad las ma btub pa dang gnas kyang bzang ba nas dga' ldan du me mchod skabs dngul gdung rin po cher mchod 'bul/ rten rnams la gser gsol snyan shal/ tsho gos chen du mang ja 'bru dang ja 'gyed bsngo rten rnam gzhag /zhugs 'bul mdzad mi pha bong kha gdan sa pa dpon slob bdun la zhabs tog yon rgyas par bsgrubs/ pur 'dren par 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa/ kha rab 'brug pa/ 'or nas can btang (46na)bar kha 'or gnyis kyis khur 'khrur po byas 'phros mi 'dug /bsod nams phun tshogs ma gtogs nang du bcar ba'i za che kha drag pa rnams kyis kyang ze la zhen ne ba byas song / brag sna chos rje/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dge slong chos 'phel bzang po/ sngags rams pa dga' gdong pa/ zla bor dge tshul blo bzang dbang rgyal dang blo bzang dbang ldan gnyis dang bcas pas chu thun me thun brgyab ste drag sngags tsha rngams che bas gshed phud/ khyams rar chog mang la rgyud stod smad gnyis kyis gsang 'dus/ thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor bas mi 'khrugs pa/ spe ser nyi thang gnyis kyis lhung bshags/ rmi ru bas sman bla rnams nyin drug gi bar 'gro gang che btsugs/ rdzong du gra tshang gis nyin gsum gyi ring zhi khro'i skong bshags rgyas par btang / gdan sa gong 'og so sor bdag chen gnyis re/ stag lung zhabs drung khri zur/ sne'u sdong rtse/ bkra shis lhun po/ sgam po/ 'bri gung/ 'brug pa sprul sku sogs mkhan slob sprul sku/ gdung brgyud rags rim la bsngo rten/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bdun la lha sa khyams rar chos sde chen po gnyis kyis gtso mdzad/ pha bong kha gnas kha phan tshun/ thag nye'i dkor 'breng ba dang bcas dge 'dun stong phrag drug gi tshogs —64—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)dbur dga' ldan khri rin po che rtses dang pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan gdan drangs nyin gsum gyi bar tsha ra dang 'gyed kyi rnyed bkur gya nom pa bstabs/ de phyin dbus/ gtsang / nyang / kong / e dgas/ gnyal byar/ lho rgyud/ yar 'brog /la stod/ (46bsnyo byang / skyid grong / rdzong dgar tso gyi dgon khag a rmi gsum pa yan chig stong drug brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ dge 'dun brgyad khri bzhi stong brgya bcas so sor 'gyed mang ja bsngo rten rnams btang ba'i skam zog khyon brtsigs gser sku gcig /thugs rten nyer gcig /sku thang brgya dang bco brgyad/ rgya hor gyi sbug sil nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gan dril rdor bcas gag /gan spos brgya bam nyi shu tham pa/ ma na ho/ g.yang ṭig shel dkar sngo/ dkar sder sogs spyod pa sum cu so bdun/ gan dkar dang rgya dkar dkyus ma yu ring yu thung 'dres pa sum cu so bzhi/ gser zho nyis stong bdun brgya zhe lnga/ dngul spyad ngo grangs brgyad cu gya bdun dang dngul hrug bsdoms par srang chig khri nyis brgya bcu bzhi zho do/ nang sbu la ga g.yi spyang sogs kyis byas pa'i gos rtsag bcu tham pa/ban chas legs pa cha tshang gcig /ring 'gag gcig /ban gzan nyi shu rtsa gsum/ ding phon/ bum gdan ma/ bkral btags/ jus bsgril btags sogs kyis gtsos pa'i bla bre rten khebs 'phan phye phur rgyal mtshan rnams bsdoms par bdun cu don bzhi/ gos dar gyi yol ba bcu tham pa/ snam sbyar hor gos mngags btags mu tig gi rgyan yod gcig gis gtsos ber snam sbyar sogs gos chen dang ling dar las grub pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ gos yug sum brgya drug cu re bdun/ kha 'khyar nyis stong nyis brgya don gcig /sman tse/ ling / dar men chor sogs tshos kha sna tshogs yug bzhi brgya bcu bdun/sman rtse kha 'khyar lnga stong nyis brgya gnyis/ kha btags nyin bde ma/ mthing (47na༄/ ja kha/ dkar po dkyus ma sogs che chung 'dres pa tshig stong dgu brgya nyer bzhi/ mon dar/ lung ki /nam thang / lu ta/spa ri/ 'ban khra/ 'bu ras bsdoms pa lnga bcu nga bdun/ rgya mon gyi ras cha 'dres pa yug dgu stong chog brgya so brgyad/ khro zangs bcu bzhi/ grum tshe nyis brgya don drug /ja ko dra dang khor drug bsdomasapa chig stong dgu brgya nyi shu/ bur gos kyi ltang tse nyis brgya nga brgyad/ khrab glog drug /lcags kro le ma —65—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)lnga stong lnga brgya/ gser sga/ dngul sga/ ra ma lug /sga dmar dngul shan mas gtsos pa'i sga 'khor cha tshang bdun cu don brgyad/ rta dgu bcu go gcig /drel brgyad/ ral gri lnga bcu nga lnga rnams song zhing gong gsal dang rtsam nas sha mar tshwa sogs tshang ma 'bru thog tu phab par mkha' ru'i khal lnga 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong nyis brgya skor song /sde pa bsod nams rab brtan la gsang sgo'i stabs nas lo 'khor bas gdung 'bul ma blangs rung 'di skabs sde dpon gyi rgyun bzhin stod smad bar gsum kyi gdung 'bul byung ba rnams zur du bzhag pa'i rten bzhengs kyi yon la phan pa byas/ gong dkar chos sde nas khyab bdag zha lu ba chen po phebs pa'i brel ba'i gseng la dril bu lus dkyil/ lam zab nang mas gtsos pa'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang lung mang du zhus/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i thugs dam rten brda don gsal ba'i rdo khyad can 'di stsal/ gnas gsar rje btsun ma'i yig rten du rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i phyag 'phreng zhig bskur snang / byang bzhu kha yar bgyis pa'i bde 'gro'i rten bzang 'thob pa'i rgyur bzheng dgos pa shar ba bzhin zhe dgu'i khongs (47ba)su stag lung dpal mgon gyis gtsos ri mo ba mkhas pa bcu drug gi gan gos dmar 'jam gyi thog tu gtso bo sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga la lha mgron bzhi bzhi byas pa'i thang kha gnyis rer sman bla bde gshegs brgyad tshar re tshang brtsis kyi gser thang sum cu rtsa lnga tshes nyer lnga la grub pa'i rgyab yig smon lam brtsams/ gong gsham kha thi lcags sgrog ma/ gtso bo la zhal khebs sum brtsegs/ gzhan rnams la nyis brtsegs gos bzo ba o rgyan can gyis btsems shing tog gtso bo gser dang gzhan tsho dngul las grub pa bzhengs/ zha lu mkhan rin po ches rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad/ thon ston la gra sa gnyis su mang ja dngul
