'gyed btang / mjug gcod du gra tshang gis khro rol dang phyag rgya zil gnon gyi zor gyi las mdzad pa'i brag sna chos rjes 'phangs pa'i gshin rje'i gtor zor de khyis ye ma zos snang ba rtags ya mtshan par mngon/—66—

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)de'ang rgyal po 'byon bzhud la zhal dbugs 'tshangs nas 'o rgyal po zhig lo snga ma tshor yod 'dug pa de las spros pa'i bsnyun gzhi gsar skyes med kyang zla ba snga ma'i nang du sde pa'i bsngo rten skyel bar byon byung skabs tshang mas sku zo ga po 'dug ces blo ma bde ba byed snang / zhag shas nas zhal dbugs ma bder song tshul byung bar skas 'bab 'dzeg mi dgos pa'i khyad nas tshoms chen du byon pa'i skabs ltag sgo'i nang tshor zhal dbugs chad pa'i nyen shin tu che ba 'chi blu dang tshe dbang drag po'i dbang phul bas bde ru song ba'i zhag shas ngang bsring ba byung / 'phyong rgyas rab (48na〉bums pa tshangs pa dung thod can la lung bstan zhus par btang ba sku tshe'i bar chad bzlog thabs rab 'bring tha gsum zhus 'dug kyang zhal gyis ma bzhes pa'i rgyal po rang gi phyag rdzas bdag gir bzung ba'i steng nas btang na zhag 'phul nyin 'phul tsam yong khul byung bar dbu sgor che chung du sku rim gra bsgrig dgos tshul gyi 'phros btang/ sde pa'i dgongs rdzogs dang 'dom pa'i lcogs po mi 'dug rung gzhung gis kyang 'don cha byed rtsis la tshes bcu gnyis kyi gung yol la gshegs pa'i sngun tsam du se chen dbon po byin rlabs rten len par byung ba yar log pa dang yu'i ching thug pa'i gnyis ka log ste grongs zin tshul gleng bar 'byor pa 'phral du dga' spro skyed tshal gling khar phyin 'pho ba btab cing gzungs sngags khyad par can gyi sgo nas bye mas brab pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan bsgrags/sog lugs 'di phyi nang chungs pa'i ngu chom byed snang bas zhag grangs gsang thub ris min pa nas gzhis ka shar pa lags a gur bos pa'i tshes grangs sogs bltas/ na bza' dang bcas pa'i mgyogasabasngo bteg par bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ se chen dbon po/ mnga' ris drung pa/ stag ru nas rnams dang gros bsdur bar the tshom las thag chod mi 'dug rung sngar rgyal po chen mo gshegs skabs kyang da la'i shung tha'i ji bcar mar yod pas la rgya nas tshang ma bag dro ba yin/ ding sang 'khyoms lhad byung dogs pa'i mngon dod med kyang ratna yar 'byor na phyi nang kun tu skabs su bab cing rgyal sal khung tha'i ji sogs dpon po rnams dang mol (48ba)bsdur dgos pa gzhir bcas na'ang sog po'i srol —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)ltar na 'os gras yin pas 'phral du mi gtong ba 'gab par thag bcad pa'i po ta lar 'ongs/ zhag gsum thog tu se chen dar rgyas dang mgon po skyabs gnyis ratna 'bod pa dang khung tha'i jis gtsos par gnas tshul skyel bar btang / gza' skar dang bstun 'phrul snang rten dang brten pa spyir bzang gos kyi bla bre ka gling gsum khebs pa/ jo bo rin po cher sangs rgyas stong sku tshang ba'i snam sbyar khyad 'phags/dngul gyi maṇḍal che ba/ ra mo cher gan gos kyi snam sbyar/ gos chen stod gser ma la smad tshon khragabyas pa'i 'phan cha gcig /gos chen sngon po'i 'phan ring gcig /dngul gyi maṇḍal/ bsam yas su byang chub chen por gos chen gyi rgyal mtshan zung / dngul gyi maṇḍal dang bcas phul ba so sor kha byang bkod/ de phyin lha sa/ po ta la sogs nye skor gtsug lag khang rnams la snyan shal/ gser chab/ dkar me rgyas pa phul/ gdung chog la byang rtse chos rje/ smad rgyud gra tshang nas dge 'dun lnga bcu nga brgyad kyis zhag brgyad kyi bar gsang ba 'dus pa'i gsung chog dang byang rtse chos rjes pur bzhu mdzad/ rjes gcod kyi gsung rab sgrog pa dang rgyud stod smad sdeb tshogs dge 'dun lnga brgyar nye bas gsang 'dus kyi chog mang btang / gdan sa gong 'og /'bri stag /sgam 'brug /rdo rje brag sprul sku/ sbyor ra sprul sku/bsam sdings sprul sku/ bya rdzing mkhan po sogs gzhan phyogs pa thor bu dang gtso bor dga' ldan khri rin po che/ bkra shis lhun po'i sprul pa'i sku/ rtse shar/ sems dpa' chen po/ rwa (49na)bsgreng dang dpal 'khor chos sde'i ma khan pos thog drangs rang phyogs khyab che ba'i blo khag che chung rnams la bsngo zhus/ gong dkar du chos sde ba grangs bcad kyis rdo rje mi tshogs pa cho ga zhag bdun gyi bar btang /bsam yas su chos rgyal chen po dpon blon la lung bstan zhu ba dang lha mo rig 'dzin ma'i gsung lan spyan gzigs tshogs chas skyel bar chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse mngags pa'i tshe tshigs bcad kyi 'phrin yig spel / mchims phu rta ra ba'i bu nor bu 'dzin par 'phrin lan gser skyems ra la gri tshogs 'khor bsrings/ skyid shod chos rje'i gra pa zhig gis bskul ba'i smon lam/ dbu mdzad bsam gtan gyi kha ton du gsol 'debs/ bā khan brje'i ngor skyid shod sprul sku'i gsol 'debs rnams bris/—68—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang gleg bam gnyis pa/ (chanahor zla bzhi pa'i tshes lnga la gling khar ser tshogs sngar sde pa'i skabs ji lta ba la phyogs mtha'i dkor len ldebs 'byar mangs pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag brgyad dang bzhi brgya lnga bcu'i tshogs dbur dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa dkon cog chos bzang phebs par nyin gsum gyi bar tshar/ bsngo rten/rnam gzhag mang 'gyed / gong gsal du mi the ba'i dgon khag adhi gnyis pa yan drug brgya nga gsum/gra pa drug khri nyis stong nyis brgyar nye bar mang 'gyed song ba'i skam zog khyon bsdoms thugs rten gnyis/ spos brgya bam gnyis/ rag gi spos phor gcig /ting shags gcig /snam sbyar mu tig gi rgyan yod gcig dang gra bcad mngags btags ma gcig /gos bzang bsgrigs kyi bla bre (49ba)rten khebs/ 'phan/ phye phur/ rgyal mtshan rnams bsdoms pa sum cu so dgu/ gos dar gyi yol ba bzhi/ma na ho/ g.yang ṭi/ dngas shel/ bzhu shal/ dkar sder sogs spyad pa nyi shu rtsa drug /gan dkar dkyus dkar 'dres pa'i yu ring yu thung bco brgyad/ spos shel gyi 'phreng ba gnyis/ gser zho sum stong chig brgya brgyad cu/ dngul spyad lnga bcu nga bzhi dang dngul hrug bsdoms pa srang chig stong nyis brgya nyi shu/ gos yug dgu bcu go gcig /gos kha 'khyar chig stong brgya nyer bzhi/ sman/ chor/ dar/ ling /men sogs yug brgya dang nyer lnga/ sman rtse kha 'khyar chig stong sum brgya zhe brgyad/ kha btags nyin bde ma/ mthing kha/ ja kha/ dkar po dkyus ma rnams 'dres pa brgyad brgya bdun cu/ wa nag gi zhwa mo bzhi/ sbu la ga /g.yi spyang sogs kyis nang sha byas pa'i gos rtsag nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ zam rtsag gnyis/skya rtsag gcig /lham gnyis/ pags rigs kyi khom bcu bdun/ snye 'bol/ gos gdan/ sa gdan/dong se/ stan dmar bsdoms pa sum cu sogacig /mgo dkar gyi snam bu/ phying pa/ yol ba rnams ngo grangs bcu bzhi/ sbu la ga lnga/ mon dar/ lung ki /sba ri/ nam thang / lwa ta/ 'ban khra/ dwags sle bcas ngo grangs brgyad cu gya lnga/ rgya mon gyi ras cha yug nyis stong brgyad brgya so brgyad/ khro zangs bcu dgu/sgam bcu bzhi/ grum tse nyi shu rtsa drug /bur tsos kyi ltang tse bstogacig /lcags kro le ma brgyad stong drug brgya brgyad cu/ stong ltang gcig /ja ko dra dang (50na〉rgor drug ma 'dres pa chig stong nyis brgya bzhi —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bcu tham pa/ khrab sgrog nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ sag thag gzhu bcas bdun cu don dgu/ gser sga/ dngul sga/ra ma lug /sga dmar dngul shan mas gtsos pa'i sga 'khor cha tshang bzhi bcu zhe gsum/ rta drug cu re gcig /ral gri sum cu rnams dang rtsam nas sha mar tshwa sogs tshang ma zi gong 'bru thog tu phab par khal nyis 'bum brgyad khri dgu stong sum brgya song / dbu sgor che chung nas ser tshogs kyi 'gyed gcig la rta/ sga/ grum tse/ snam bu dkar dmar ser gsum/ gdan chas/ thab chas/ pags rigs sogs gtos che ba yod 'dug kyang khra ma zhib pa mi snang / khyab bdag zha lu pa chen por 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang dang drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu rgyud phul nas gtsang phyogs su chibs kha bskyod/ byang bzhu lan kha shas byas par mngon mtho'i rten bzang rnyed pa'i thabs su shar ba bzhin dbu mdzad dpal mgon gyis gtsos pa'i lha bzo ba mkhas pa bcus rnam par snang mdzad dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad gtso bo la rnam snang kho nas gtams pa'i stong thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig tu smon lam bris/ kha thi'i gong gsham/ zhal khebs nyis brtsegs tog bcas bsgrubs par rig 'dzin chen po khra tshang pa zla ba lnga pa'i nang du phebs skabs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab gnas mdzad/ zhe dgu'i thon ston la ser 'bras su mang ja ja 'gyed btang / mchod yon gnyis kyi dgongs rdzogs la dmigs nas mang 'gyed dang bsngo rten byed mi'ang mang du snang / tshangs (50ba)pa dung thod can gyi lung bstan du rim gro 'bebs pa mdzad pa rnams rings khyad yod tshul byung bar brten sde pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi zhan la bsgrigs te zla ba gnyis pa'i mjug tu gcig dang 'phar ma gsum par gtong dgos byung ba rdzong gzhis gnas khag dang bcas pa bzhi bcu zhe drug nas bka' 'gyur tshar nyis brgya bcu bdun/ mtshan brjod tshig 'bum/ sman bla chig 'bum sum khri nyis stong / ma ṇi dung bzhi/ badzra gu ru dung gnyis/ gong dkar chos sde dang bkra shis chos sder tshe chog re/ dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pas zla gcig ba ra gshin rje 'dus pa'i sngags ring / gra sa phan tshun du zla phyed kyi ja tshul/ mgon po g.yul bzlog gnyis/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa/ mnan pa drug /rgyal du dmag zor ma'i sger bskang —70

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang gleg bam gnyis pa/ (chanachig 'bum/ zhal dang beg tser khri tshar/ spyir stong rtsa/ phyugs lug brgya dang nya 'bum gyi srog blu/ lha sa sogs gnas chen nyi shu rtsa gsum so sor gra pa nyi shu res zhag bdun gyi bar brgya mchod sna lnga re phul ba'i zhal 'don du sman bla yod pa tshos de dang med pa rnams kyis gdugs dkar gsungs/gser chab/ snyan shal/ 'phan phul/ 'phar ma zla ba gsum par btang bar rdzong gzhis gnas chen nyi shu bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar bzhi brgya dang lnga/ 'bum/ phal chen/ dkon brtsegs gsum brgya rtsa/ dri med bshags rgyud sum stong / tshe chog drug /gdugs dkar mdos rpā dang khro rol sosor bzhi re/ 'char ga'i mdos gnyis/ phur bzlog gnyis/ mnan pa drug /btson (51na shong thar nyi shu/ phyugs lug brgya'i srog blu/ rgyal du dmag zor mar bkang ba khri dang chos skyong spyir stong rtsa btang / nang so dkon cog dar rgyas/ bde chen khang gsar ba gnam gang 'brug rgyal/ chad dkar chos mdzad bstan pa rgya mtsho gsum gyis do dam byas nas sde pa'i dgongs rdzogs su snag tshar sku rus mang du bsres pa'i bka' 'gyur skya pod bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i dkar chag sor gnas kyi steng rnying ma rgyud 'bum gsum mnan pa'i po ti brgya dang bcu bzhi bzhengs par btang skabs bka' 'gyur snga rting gnyis la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin 'chol du thang chen rgyal po chen por spyan gzigs snyan zhal gser skyems tshogs 'khor dang bcas 'phrin yig gi tshig bcad phul/ byang chen mchod rten sa'adzin nas nyi zla'i bar sku dpangs la rgyug mtho bcu bdun yod par sa 'dzin gser zangs them skad dang po dngul/ gnyis pa gser zangs/ padma dang gsum pa dngul/ seng khri dngul gyi thog gser zangs kyi ka ba 'phul ma bcu seng ge brgyad dang rgyal chen bzhi/ khri rgyab phyag mtshan bcas pa gser zangs/ gzungs sa dngul/ bad chung padma gser zangs/ bad chen dang rmang dge dngul/ bang rim padma gser zangs/ de phyin bang rim bzhi/ bum pa/ bre/ pho 'khor bcu gsum/ gdugs kyi nang / zla ba rnams dngul/ bum gdan padma/ sked chings bab le/ sgo rgyan pa tra me tog 'phul ma/ bum rgyan dra phyed/mo 'khor bcu gsum/ gdugs 'degs padma/ thugs rje mdo gzung / gdugs/ nyi ma rnams(51ba)—71 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gser zangs las grub pa'i sku rgyur rgya dngul srang brgyad brgya don gsum/ zangs mkhar khal nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang nyag bcu bdun/ gser 'dam zho stong phrag gcig dang nyis brgya go bzhi/ dngul chu zho stong phrag gnyis dang bdun brgya so gsum phra khung phyi ma gsum tsha gser dang nang ma gsum gser rkyang /dkyil 'tsho ljang pa g.yu rim gsum yod dbus 'bring gcig /grong smad nas g.yu phra che chung sum cu so gsum gyi zhal 'debs dang bcas gsar du bzos pa'i gser sga gcig /rtse rgyan la tshe dpag med/ padma/ nor bu/ ci par so gos sna tshogs yod pa'i phul sgor spus legs lnga/ g.yu spyang phra khung tsha gser gyis byas pa che chung gnyis/ spyi g.yu dbus 'bring stong bzhi/ g.yu hril phub chung gi phra tshoms yod pa cha tshang gcig /grong smad kyi zhal 'debs mu tig rdog che chung drug the ba'i mu tig tha na 'dres pa sran sbos tsam rdog chig brgya re lnga/ byu ru tshos legs rdog kham tshig che ba nas chung ba'i bar tshig brgya re gcig /mu men rdog gong 'dra tshig brgya zhe bzhi/ grong smad kyi zhal 'debs drug the ba'i byu ru phra phra khung tsha gser gyis byas pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ hor shel phra khung gong 'dra drug /grong smad kyi zhal 'debs bzhi the ba'i spos shel phra khung gong mtshungs nyi shu/ g.yang ṭi bzo babs dang che chung sna tshogs rkyang rgyugs nyis bsgrigs bzhi bsgrigs phra khung gong mtshungs bzhi bcu zhe gcig su ga rnyi dbus 'bring gcig shel sngo gru bzhi spus legs gnyis/ shel sna brgya kha gcig dang ljang kha gcig /me shel phra khung gong mtshungs bcu bzhi/ me shel bum gzugs gnyis/ snyan dar ling (52na8kar skyer/ hor dar sngo dmar ljang gsum dang bcas sna lnga'i rtsis kyi lug re/ mthon thigazhi ser gyi 'phan cha gcig /gos chen gser ma'i 'phan cha gnyis rnams do dam grub rgyal gling pa dang sger logs a dar/ thig cha dang bkod pa sprul sku dpal mgon/ shing bzo'i do dam gtsang pa bdud 'joms/ bal po a mar sidha can bco brgyad/ zangs brdungs pa dbu mdzad gnyis the ba'i bcu/ shing bzo dol gnas gsar ba dang lam rnyed can dbu chen gcig dang dbu chung gnyis/ dkyus ma bcu drug gis las rgyun zla ba gsum dang zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis song ba/ gsung rab dang zhal thang gi tho zhib par ma rnyed pas sku rgyu —72—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadarnams bsdoms ma thub/ dngul gdung gi sku rgyu 'bru thog tu phab par mkha' ru'i khal sum khri brgyad stong dgu brgya nyer lnga/ de phyin gyi dgos cha do dam bzo rigs dang bcas pa'i phogs gla yon/ gzungasa'abul rab gnas pa'i dgos cha kun 'bru thog tu dril bar mkha' ru'i khal nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya/rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs su sku rus bsres pa'i bka' 'gyur gong 'dra/ lha sa khyams ra'i rnam thar sgo gsum du dus gsum sangs rgyas/ nye sras brgyad/ phyag rdor/ rta mgrin rnams kyi 'bur sku bzhengasapa'i do dam byung pa chos mdzad phun tshogs chos 'phel dang byams gling pa blo bzang dkon cog gnyis kyis byas/ bzo bo e pa sprul sku hor dar dang bag gro can gyis gtsos pas bzhengs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi rgyu song bsdoms ma thub (52ba)pa dang dgos cha gzhan mkha' ru'i khal nyi khri lnga brgya song/ sde pa'i dgongs rdzogs su jo shāka /thugs rje chen po sogs gang la'ang phul chog pa'i snyan dar kha yig drung yig dar rgyas bkra shis kyis bskul ba brtsams/hor zla gnyis pa nas bzung khur len gzhan med pa'i stabs don med kyi g.yeng ba'i gzeb tu chud/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i gra pa so sos bsdus pa'i tsho gis 'khor dpangs bstod/ gosaber gyis thog drangs pa'i gos sna cha tshang gis mtshon dgu tshan bcu bzhi tsam dang bcas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'bor du ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung rgyas pa dang de nas bzung tshes nyi shu'i bar zhe gos star gyi rtser ja sbyor sbrel gyi thog yan lag bdun pa/ bsam pa lhun grub ma/ gsang mchog gdod dbyings ma sogs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi bden brjod mdzad/ tshogs su'ang zla ba gnyis kyi bar gra ja 'phar ma rer gsungs 'dug /mchod yon gnyis gshegs pa'i gnas gshis 'gangasache drags pas bgegs chags sangs pa las kyang 'os ma mchis shing thos bsam gyi skal ba zhan zhing srid kyi bka' babs pa lta bu'i las ngan pa zhig kyang yod tshod du 'dug pas 'di lo khams nan tar bde/ 'on kyang zon skyor lugs kyis gter sgrom gyi chu tshan zhag bdun gyi bar bsten/ nyer brgyad la co ne chos rje blo bzang nyi ma la skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul dang khyung khra'i rjes—73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gnang bskur/ co ba tshang bla rabs rim bzhin sog yul gyi bstan pa'i khur dang gus zhabs gnyis ka che ba nas ban chas snam phrug gis gtsos (53na)pa'i 'gro gdong gi ster cha bzabs/ chos rjer nad ro rnying pa zhig 'dug par klu dbang gi rgyal po'i sku par sogs rim gro mang tsam phab pa bsgrubs 'dug pas gzhi med du song snang /hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig la chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa gra slob dang lha sa ru bzhi spyi tshogs kyi so so'i lugs bzhin ring gnas kyi rten 'byung maṇḍal gyi tshul du bdog pa'i skyes bcas bsgrigs/mon ka thog bla ma/ gnas gsang mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/ 'bog gong mon pa/ stag lung phyag mdzod bzang sbyin/ mtsho kha nas ratna'i mi sna/ ras chung phug sprul sku/ tsha mig mkhan po/ lcam nor bu khra sgor can dang phrad/ tshes gnyis la dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon khri gdan zur/ dge 'dun phyed sum brgya skor gyis zang zing gi skyes dpangs bstod de yun du gnas pa'i bden brjod dang 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra gdan drangs te spyan 'dren khrus gsol mdzad/ sang nyin 'phyong rgyas khul gyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyis snam phrug gtso bor gyur ba'i dngos po bstar te tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/tshes bzhi la khyab bdag sman lung pa gra bcas sum cu tsam dang spung dkar khul gyi lha sde mi sde'i 'go pa rdzong sdod sgem bu nas kyis byas pa'i nges gsang rdo gling pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshe chog dang chos sde so so'i grwa bsdus nyi shu tsam gyis smon lam gsungs shing dngos po tshan grangs ring du brkyangs te nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bden tshig brjod/ tshes lnga'i nyin se ra theg chen gling slob dpon dge 'dun nyis brgya skor (53brdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku/ gsang phu'i chos rje gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i gra pa lnga bcu tsam/ skyor lung chos sde'i bla ma gra bcas brgya zin/ rmi ru ba yongs rdzogs kyis rim pa bzhin snga dgongs sbrel nas so so'i lugs ltar ring por gnas pa'i zhal 'don dang ster cha bzabs par mdzad/ gsang phu ba dpon slob la bzang po spyod pa'i lung phul/ dan 'bag dgos pas rnam snang gi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /'phyong rgyas rdzong sdod sdum po bas bskul ba'i dkar cha —74

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chad bzhi'i chog khrigs/ra ba smad chos skyong dang ar dge rgyal po'i 'phrin las bsrings/dar rgyas chosasdings nas rigs 'dzin ོ po dpon slob bco lnga tsam gyis lha ldan gandho lar gter gsar gyi tshe sgrub mdzad pa'i sngon 'gror rdzong du byon par dpon slob rnams la rnam rgyal 'joms kyi gzungs kyi lung bklags/bsnyen rdzogs nga gsum dang dge tshul brgya bco lnga bsgrubs/gnas rnying zhabs drung /ra ba smad slob dpon/chos rje dung dgon pa/rgya gar mthil ba/kha che bal po sogs mang bar ja gral btang /lha rgya ri ba'i sras dga' ldan bstan 'dzin gshegs pa'i bsngo rten phub sgor gyis gtsos pa 'byor snyo u'i 7 blo bzang bdog pa'i skyes spel bar bto /'di lo ma rdzo dpon pas do dam byas nas gos phod legs pa brgya don gcig gsar du bzos/snyan dar gra tshang gnyis gra bsgrigs spyan gzigs kyi dong pa dang gri shubs rnams la tshags brgyab/chos rje bco brgyad pas rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i zhun thigs kyi thub 54na ) pa grong khyer ma mchod dpon par byin pa lag tu 'byor/mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis sbyin bdag byas pa'i gos ber gser mas thog drangs rung mthun gyi gos cha tshang /gos dar ja stag sgam gyis gtsos pa'i ster cha dpangs mtho tshogs 'khor dang bcas gra tshang gis tshes bcu'i snga dro 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog rgyas par mdzad/de grub bstun gter byon bris 'bur gyi sku khyad can rnams dang tshogs gtor bshams nas byang gter thugs sgrub 'bring po le'u bdun ma dang bcas pa/dpal ldan 'dod khams ma sogs chos skyong gter srungs kyi bkang gso btang /de skabs nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing 'ja' sprin dang me rtag gi char sogs ltas legs pa byung zer/gzer chen nas kyis tshogs su ja nag po'i 'gyed btang /tshes bcu gsum la rgyun sdod kyi drung 'khor skya ser spyi dang shun khul gyi drung 'khor/dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gnyer pa gnyis rnams kyis tshogs chas ster cha 'gyed kyi sbyin bdag byas nas gra tshang gis cha med 'od snang gi tshe chog gsungs/bzhugs gral du khyab bdag sman lung pa/gnasagasar bshes gnyen pa/stag lung phyag mdzod gsum bsgrigs/de nub nas phyi mtshams bsdams/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)rin po che khra tshang nas kyang rong phyogs su thegs/nyer drug la rgya nag lha khang gi rten rnams mjal skabs mchog khang rtser me tog gi char byung zer/gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos lha ldan du gter gsar gyi tshe sgrub zin pa'i 'bras spungs su gta' bsdams te rdzong du phebs/ gter gsar gyi gshin (54ba)rje'i dbang lung dang theg mchog mdzod sogs lung kha shas zhus/ ka tshal bla ma rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub kyis snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig byung ba de lan bskur/ rtse'i gzims chung mdo'i dkar phibs la ldebs ris shig sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos mdzad rtsis 'dug pa ltar gzhis ka shar a gur pha bu/ ngag dbang 'phrin las/ legs pa rgyal mtshan/ dgos bsam rnams kyis tshes bcu bdun nas 'go brtsams te de bzhig gshegs pa'i mdzad pa 'ga' zhig khol du phyungs te bris pa zla ba drug pa'i zla smad la grub/sde pa sras pos mu tig dang a tsar sba ril sogs dngos po du mas dpal ri sprul sku dpon slob gnyis brngan te brtag pa/ dogs gcod/ sgrib shing gis mtshon pa'i rgyu 'grul byung nas lo kha yar song tshod du 'dug kyang rdzong sdod rnams kyis rdzi gsang ma phyes pa lo snga ma'i hor zla bcu pa'i dus rim skabs sras po'i yi ge zhig sprul sku'i gdan bar du lus pa gdan gnyer gyis rnyed pa rdzong sdod bsod nams dbang rgyal gyis sde pa stag rtser bzhugs thog 'bul bar btang ba la brten bsam dar nas mngags te sku skye rin spungs su sgor ba sogs kyi bkod pa mdzad grub 'dug pa bsam dar nas kyis 'phros btang byung ba sde par rgyu mtshan med pa'i rin spungs su skor cig ma thal tsam gyi thabs byas/ gzhi byes rnams kyis phan tshun zhib tu skor ba phal cher sprul skus ngos len dgos pa byung snang / de khrod du gzhung gi mtshan don bsdog pa'i dus rtags yang le shod du shing skyes pa sogs mang ba 'dug pa spo (55na)bo gter ston gyi rdzun lung der yod 'dra ba 'gangs ma mchis rung sras po'i ngo gzung gi grod pa nang blta dang kha phyi blta'i dper sde pa thugs la phog pa bden pa gzhir bcas/ spyi khyab tu ma zad rnying ma bar gtogs tshad kyis da lo khong gis nged rnying lugs pa thams cad chu nang du bcug mi sngon du gdong ston —76

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanami thub pa bzos zhes ldir mor gleng / dpal ri sgrub sde pa'i me tog phog pa'i lha skal de 'bri gung pa yin/ 'bri gung zur pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po yin kyang / sprul sku snang rtse ba phyogs su mos pa'i sgo du ma nas mthar lhung ba'i rgyu bsgrubs 'dug rung khong pa brgyud par yod pa'i chos bka' kha shas thob cing zhabs drung mi dbang stobs rgyal gyis phyag dar ba'i gra tshang la gong brgyab ste sde par nan bskyed kyis labs pa'i 'bras bu mna' gan gyis phyis 'doms dang bcas babs bde sar chags pa'i sgo dod pa bar skabs su mchod yon gshegs pa'i bya skad bye khyer gyis lus rung 'di skabs mda' dpon gnyis kyis lha sar bsdam ra blangs/ rin po che sman lung nas kyis gtsang du phebs gdong khebs khang che dgos pa'i gsung nan dang chad par gter ston rin po ches sku ngo byung bar chad shul bcag /dpal ri ba'i phung zhor du ri bo bde chen pas mu tig gi car pa blangs par chad 'gros byung ba la phan bde legs bshad gling spyi so dang mchod dpon dbu mdzad gra rgyun rnams kyi sku ngor yangs cha che ba byas/ gnam gang gi nyin dpal ri ba bla ma gra bcas kyi phyag 'bul bsgrubs/mkhan (55ba)chen phyag rdor ba'i tshems dkar po kun dga' grags nas 'phrang 'go gter ston brgyud dpal ri sprul skur byung ba mchod dpon par byin pa lag tu 'byor/hor zla drug pa'i nang du brel ba phyod che khyad nas phyi mtshams su bsdad/ tshes lnga'i nyin mchod khang gi steng du me tog gi char babs zer ba ni khram btang ba dang chad pa blangs pa sogs kyi byin rlabs yin pa'ang / khun du lan cho khur gyi sku skyes bskul ba'i sprul pa'i sku blo bzang ye shes kyi gsol 'debs/ 'phyos bkra shis bde chen spyi tsho gis kyi ngor ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan gyi deb kyi 'go brjod dgos tshul rnams bris/ 'di dag gi snga phyi'i lo phyed gnyis su nye ba'i bar phal cher drung yig rgya mtsho/ gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ chang khyim pa sogasayig mkhan gsum bzhi tsam dang bcas srid skyong gi yi ge 'dri 'dri kho nas dus 'da' bas rtsom pa'i rigs cher ma byung / lo 'di'i snga phyir bkra shis lhun po'i gra tshang bzhir rang byon nas gshor 'debs —77—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenakhal sum rgya sum cu re yong ba sa ris yol gdong nas rgan par chod pa'i tshab rta nag gung rgyal dang thon zhing kha 'thor nas gyod med/ zha lu mkhan rin po cher pa rnam lhun grub sgang gi them 'dzin bcu gnyis/ lag yong phyed dgu brgya skor/ gdan sa 'og gi sgrub mchod thebs su sgrol ma nas dang 'phags sde bas 'dzin khungs gzhung 'bul dang 'breng khud gzhis ka /dben dgon pas rjes su phul ba'i mthong smon spel shar them 'dzin bzhi/ lag 'bab sum brgya/ khang gsar gra tshang pas (56na)gnas gsar rgyal khang ham zos la tshab kyi bab thob mi 'dug drung dpal 'khor chos sde spyi sor gong brgyab kyis se brag sgrub sde'i dgon nas zhing 'khyar / rgyal byed sngags gra'i mchod gnyis bkra shis khang gsar gyi khungs dang bcas lag yong bzhi bcu/ bla ma chu mig pas sa ga zla ba'i nang du tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang gi sgrub mchod zhag bdun gtong ba'i thebs su lha rtse ldog na dgu'i khungs sogs shas bogs kha 'khyar bsdoms pa 'bru rkyang brgya nyer bdun/ phan bde legs bshad gling gi mchod gzhis su ljangs chog shes 'brog pa btsan thang gi rjes 'brang lag 'don/ bod 'brog rdo blo ljangs gsum bsdoms pa'i dud 'dzin sum cu skor btsan thang sra nang pa'i sa zhing mo bran rnams slar 'jags rgyud dang bcas pa'i khyon bsdoms lag 'bab drug stong sum brgya skor/ ri bo chos gling du tho btsun sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dus brgyab pas gra tshogs che gshis mthun rkyen gyis ma ldangs par mchod dpon pas do dam byas zhus pa'i mchod gzhis su pho brang lhun grub sgang gi gzhis ka /them 'dzin bcu bdun/ lag yong nyis stong lnga bcu/ mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis la 'phrang 'go phu nub sman khral dang bcas pa'i bod 'brog dud 'dzin nyer drug /lag 'bab chig stong sum brgya/ thugs sras zla ba'i sprul skus slob dpon chen pos lha sras la gnang ba'i padma dbang chen 'jon dmar gyi sku khyad mtshar sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po la gung thang chos kyi rgyal pos phul ba 'brug pa padma dkar pos lho brag (56ba)lung gsum las dga' gsungs pa chos dbang rin po cher mkha' 'gros dngos su phul ba'i thod pa dpal ldan 'ja' tshon ma gu ru lha khang gi nang rten/ des gnam skas brag nas gdan drangs pa'i nā ga rakṣa'i sku/—78

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanapadma gling pa'i bla ma rdor 'chang ma/ khros nag gi shog ser/ ldan ma rtse mang gi phyag ris o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma sogs rten byin rlabs can khungs btsun mang du byin par brten do rdzong khul nas spyi phu 'then/ 'brong lnga/ dga' bcu'i gzhis ka gsum them 'dzin so gsum lag yong stong phyed bzhi brgya/rin po che sman lung pa dpon slob chu bo rir spyi sgos kyi rim gro sgrub pa'i khyad nas gnas 'dzin mdzad pa'i 'chi med bkod pa'i mchod thebs su gron ze gnyis ka /them 'dzin bcu bzhi/ lag 'bab stong dang phyed sum brgya/ gong dkar chos ster gra slob bcu gcig gis sa ga zla bar zhag bcu'i ring yang dag gi sgrub mchod thebs su byang thang ser grong dgon rten gsum/ mchod rdzas/ thabs gdan chas cha 'grig /lag 'bab nyis brgya skor/ spyil 'dzin them chung lnga/ gong dkar dkon gnyer ba'i phogasakyi ston mar skyi nag grong gsar gyi sa khog nas khal lnga brgya dang sum cu skor/ bsam yas mchims phu dang lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i thig phyi'i gtsug lag khang du dkon gnyer so sos do dam byas pa'i mchod pa sna lnga bcu tshar dang sgro ba dgon du mchod me sdong rkang gcig rgyun du btsugs/dkon gnyer phyi pa kun dga' bkra shis kyis nyi ldog sku rim gyi rten sor sngags 'chang gnas chung ba'i sa zhing lag yong sum brgyar nye ba/ rgyal dar (57na)gong bshes gnyen dar rgyas la yar klungs snang rtse skor nas nyas brgya thon khungs kyi shas zhing / chu shur thar pa gling par khri stod gnas grong gi lag 'debs/ them 'dzin sum cu/ lag 'bab nyis stong / 'phags sde bas sku 'dra li ma dang gosachen bum gdan ma sogs zhu rten bzang bar brten sa snon du snye thang lcang 'go dang la ra'i gzhis ka /them 'dzin bcu gnyis/ lag 'bab bdun brgya/ gra dar rgyas chos sdings kyi gter ston rin po che'i mchod gzhis su bzang yul bkra shis steng gzhis ka /them 'dzin bcu bdun/ lag yong brgyad brgya/yar klungs bkra shis rtser khyab bdag bka' gyur ba chen po'i dus dran dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi thebs snga sor song ba'i snon mar dpon sa a 'bol gyis bzung shul nas bzhi brgya'i thon khungs/'phyos lam rim par 'phyos mda' rtse chen rkang gcig gi sa zhing shas 'grems thog 'brel mtshungs —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)nas bsnan pa'i phyed nyis brgya/ brag dbar gra tshang par bstan dar sku'i zhu rten kyang 'dug pa dang bcas mas dro gyang grong 'og gzhis ka them 'dzin bcu drug /lag 'bab drug brgya/ sku mdun lhun grub la rim gro sgrub rten dang bzang yul gyi sa tshab bsdoms par sa 'brel mtshungs khyad nas 'dod sbyar bzhin zhang ston nang ma 'cham pa'i bgos phud dud nyi shu/ lag yong nyis brgya/ dpon tshang byang ngos par sgo sna shag rgyab tu mo bran bcu skor dang bcas rta ra shar gyi khang tshab las sum skor gyis lhag pa/snang rtse/ thang 'bras/ bzang mo/ rta zhing khungs kyi bogs 'khyar (57ba)thog nas sum brgya skor/ yar stod dar mo bar btsun pas gso dpyad mkhas pa bslabs pa sogs zhi drag sgrub rten du shubs rdzing kha'i gzhes ka /them 'dzin bcu gsum/ lag 'bab stong lhag bcas/ dol dar byung ba pha dus sger du ster cha gzangs bstod pa byed yod kyang rgyu rkyen med par dgra bo yul shor song ba'i tshab la gra nang 'ger bel/ rnam rgyal brgyad gra'i shas yong / rtses dang rgyab ma shar bcas them 'dzin bcu gsum/lag yong dgu brgyar nye ba/ 'phyos chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse yi ge'i lag g.yog tu 'gyur bas g.ya' nang lding nas them 'dzin bdun/ lag yong drug brgyar nye ba/ stag ru bar 'ol dga' zhur mo'i gzhis ka /lag 'debs 'os rigs/ them 'dzin bdun/ lag 'bab bdun brgya/ 'brang rgyas shag par gzhu khang gi ru dpon snye thang nor bu sgang dud 'dzin bcu gnyis/ lag yong stong dang drug brgyar nye ba/ chu shur lcang lo pa nye skor nas them 'dzin drug /lag yong phyed bzhi brgya/ byang thang shar ma bar sa brjes snon ma dang sbrags par kha rag ser khyim dgon 'brang phu chos 'khor sdings them 'dzin bdun/lag 'bab brgyad brgya/ rta dpon rnam 'joms la skyor lung ka drug gzhis ka /them 'dzin dgu/lag yong lnga brgya/ drung yig pad rdor la sa tshab sa snon bcas par gsil ma bla 'od/ them 'dzin dgu/lag yong bdun brgya/ skyar bo ba rdo rje dbang phyug la stod lung gru stod gru smad nas them 'dzin bdun/snang rtse thang 'bras kyi bogs 'khyar bcas pa'i lag yong stong rwa can/ lha (58na tshe bang dbon chung pha bu drung 'khor rnying pa lag g.yog tu 'gyur gras su song zhing sa cha ma yar klungs 'phyos nas gnang ba —80

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanathag rings skyon gyis 'brel mtshungs khyad kyis sa snon za dam grub rgya'i skor nas them 'dzin lnga/ lag 'bab nyis brgya/ lcang lo can rdo rjer sa tshab snon ma sbrags par chu shur spus sde rjes pa'i gzhis ka them 'dzin brgyad/ lag yong lnga brgya lhag bcas/ lcang lo can bstan 'dzin dpal bzang la yer pa sgrom khungs them 'dzin bdun/ lag 'bab phyed drug brgya/ dwags po sa par zur sras khungs sba jo nyang kha gzhis ka them 'dzin dgu lag yong nyis brgya/ gyang grong pa'i zur bu don grub rnam rgyal gyang grong gong gi gzhis ka /them 'dzin bcu gnyis/ lag yong phyed brgyad brgya/ 'ol dga' 'bri lung gzhen tshang la them 'dzin bzhi/ lag yong nyis brgyar nye ba/ pho brang ge ra ba'i gsol dpon sdod rtag cing mtshan ldan dar rgyas kyis phag rir mon dmag byung skabs khur bsam che bar sngon nas sa snon 'os 'gab song ba'i kha longs su ra lpags khungs dud gsum/ las khral long ba gsum/ lag 'bab sum brgya/lha sa gzhis ka shar pa sku rum gyi 'khor los gtsos pa'i lag g.yog tu 'gyur ba dang bcas rags kha chu skor lag 'debs kyi thon phyed bzhi brgya/ them 'dzin bdun/ gra phyi phun rab par zhang mkhar rdzong pa 'jam dpal rdo rje nged rang gi slob dpon yin gshis gal che bas yul phu nas them 'dzin bcu gcig /lag yong dgu brgya/ mkhas pa don grub dbang rgyal phug rtsis khrid pa'i (58ba)slob dpon du song ba dang bcas gra ldum po bar mgar rtsa nub pa rkang gsum gyi sa zhing / them 'dzin gsum/lag yong sum brgya/ nyang bran sbyar ra bar blon po gong them 'dzin gcig la gtogs pa gang yod zung mkhar phun tshogs gling pa dgos dgos la 'phrang 'go bkra shis gling khungs kyi zhing khang / dud chung gsum/ lag yong nyis brgya/ 'phyong rgyas sgom bu bar nyang stod 'brong rtsis pas 'dzin bzhin pa'i mi gra yong 'bab tshang ba/ lding dpon nam mkha' 'brug chu khyi nas bzung thugs 'brel che zhing kha zhe med pa'i gus zhabs pa yin rung ban rtsa med skyon gyis bdag rkyen byung ma song bar lding dpon gyi bu pa rnam 'gol smon par bkras sgang khung nor gling gzhis ka /zhigs la ga bsam grub gling / spos sgang gra khang / them 'dzin nyi shu rtsa drug /lag yong nyis stong sum brgya skor/ snye thang tshong 'dus 'og pas rdzong —81 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)sdod rnams las rdzi gsang phyed tsam byung 'dug pa dang dbus kyi sa cha tshur phul ba'i sa tshab mtshar kha dang bcas par 'dus byung khul 'brum pho lha'i gzhis ka /gzhis lag bkra shis rdzong kha/ mag gzhis ka /them 'dzin bcu drug /lag yong chig stong bdun brgyar nye ba/ yol gdong nas rgan tshang la sa cha snga mas cung ma ldangs tshul byung bar sa snon du rta nag la kha gzhis ka them 'dzin sum cu/ lag 'bab stong lhag tsam/ 'phyong rgyas zhal dpon 'gro phan gyis zhi drag sgrub rten du rdor spyon khungs shab brag dkar gyi gzhis ka them 'dzin dgu/ lag yong brgyad brgyar nye ba/ stag lung dpal mgon (59na tshe snga phyir ri mo'i byas rjes che zhing bkod pa len pa dang slad nas brgyud bcas kyis sgrub rten du gzhis ka rtse zhol grang chen gzhis ka mo bran bcu skor dang bcas pa gzhu shugs gling gzhis ka them 'dzin bzhi/lag yong drug brgyar nye ba/ spo bo tha yan er khe khu lug bstan zhen che ba dang zhi drag sgrub rten du pa rnam shar phyogs 'bras khud pa'i gzhis ka them 'dzin bcu drug /lag 'bab stong rwa can/ lding dpon dgos sleb rtsis kyis las kur 'jug pa nas sa snon du mkhar gdong pa'i khungs spel bzhi'i khang shul sgo phyi sa skor them 'dzin bdun/ lag yong phyed drug brgya/ dga' ba skya rgyal rtsis la 'jug pa sogs zhi drag sgrub rten du grang chen khungs brag lung gnyis ka /them 'dzin dgu/ lag 'bab drug brgya skor/ 'phan po rnam snang la rong skyid stod la gtags pa rang 'jags thog gsar du shar ba a tshing dud 'dzin bdun gyi mi gra snga sor nas chod pa'i lag 'bab phyed sum brgya/ rong grags pa pa'i mas sribs skya ril la gnang 'dug pa'i sa tshab sgrol sbug khung rong thang spe'i khang pa 'og thog them 'dzin gcig /lag 'bab phyed nyis brgya/ lha ri rtse pas ldog na dgur gtogos pa'i sa ris ma zin pa'i tshur phul ba khong tsho grub mtha' yang dge lugs yin zer bas bu longs nas phyir slog byas pa se kha lung gi gzhis ka them 'dzin nyi shu/ lag 'bab sum stong du nye ba rnams song / 'gos khug pa lhasabatsal gyi dbu thod 'phyong rgyas kyi na nga rten gsol dpon bstan dar gyis gzhor 'debs zhu rten du byung / tre bo hor tshang rab 'byams (59bsgos rje sa skyong gis gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud dang —82

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chana'agrel pa sgron gsal gnyis kyi rgyugs sprad/hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig gi wo rdzong sdod gong dkar gnas gsar don grub/ thosabasam gling slob dpon pa/ rgyal mtshan mthon po'i mi sna rdor rgyan pa sogs chos sde che phra'i bla ma dang ngo tshab/ nang so rnam pa drung 'khor bcas gzhis rtse khul skya ser rnams kyis tshogs chas ster cha 'gyed gzengs bstod pa'i sbyin bdag byas/ gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog gi sgo nas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ bsam rtse mnga' 'bangs rnams kyis bzhi sde khang du 'jog rgyu'i le'u bdun ma bsam pa lhun grub dang bcas par du brkos pa'i tshe nged lung bstan gyis zin tshul thebs pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad dgos lugs byung ba ngo mi ldog tsam zhig bris/ zhar byung gtsang khul lding phrug rnams kyis ring 'tsho'i dngos po bteg /mon 'dzum lang gi mi sna 'byor ba'i me skyogs/me mda'/ ras kyis mtsho ni pa'i yig rten dpangs bstod pa 'dug /stod rgyud dpon slob/ gra tshang chos 'khor gling pa/ pos bkra shis bde chen pa so sos maṇḍal gyi tshul du dngos po'i skyes dang bcasatsho gis pa yongs rdzogs kyi yun du 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung rgyas par bsgrigs/ shar pa chos rjes gsang ba 'dus pa dang bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung 'dren mang ba'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs kyi rgyu mtshan gsungs/ chos 'khor gling pa rnams skad bzang tsho re mos kyis bskul ba'i dus bzang chos spyod lta bu mdzad/ bkra shis bde (60na skon pa tshor sman bla'i mdo chog gi lung phul/ rab stims pa blo bzang brtson khrus sa kha ton dang byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos ma ṇi dung phyur gyi chos 'khor btsugs skabs kyi smon lam/ mar dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyi sa ris deb kyi 'go brjod/ mchod dpon pas ri bo chos gling la nyams gsos byas pa'i dge ba bsngo tshig rnams bris/tshes gnyis la bkra shis ljongs chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ dar rgyas chos sdings pa'i rgyal sras pa mched drug brgya chos mdzad blo bzang dkon cog rnams kyis gtsos bsnyen rdzogs re dgu/dge tshul gya bzhi/ rab byung gsum/ dge bsnyen gcig bcas bsgrubs/ lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor —83—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba'i snyan brgyud glegs bam gyi dbang lung rgyun ma chad pa'i khungs btsun shin tu dkon pa gnyal bcom ldan lho mdzes pa gung snang chos rje mgon po mdzes pa'i dbang phyug la tshang bar bzhugs tshul khungs chod cing e chos ldan pa nas ratna gling pa'i gter chos bsab dgos 'dra'ang yod pa rnams kyi ched du rigs 'dzin chen po gsan par bskul ba'i er bzhugs ring gi gsol chas zangs ri dpon sa dang gzan me shing gzims shag lho pas bskyal/ mnga' ris dge lugs kyi dgon pa tshor mang 'gyed skyel ba dang bcas lding dpon dpal yags mi snar btang / sngags rams pa dkon cog rin chen lhun po rtse'i mkhan por 'gro gdong tshem bu lugs kyi dmar 'khrid nyams 'khrid du phab/pho brang sne'u stong rtse'i bla rdor grags pa'i dung lhas byin klus byin 'bras bu (60ba〉ten tu che ba gser ljang brdungs kyi dung gshog kha 'phul bkrol legs par g.yu mu tig gi rgyan can gshog pa'i nang du gser dngul gyi mdzo sna a lung bse shubs dang bcas pa brjod rib/sa la lar dung gcig rtse tsha mig pa dang cig shos la stod byang pa'i phyag nas gtsang sde srid la 'byor ba dung gshog gzhis ka rtser brgyab pa bzo bo mkhas drags pa'i rgya bzor 'khrul 'gro zhing de dang mnyam du bzos pa'i maṇḍal po ta la'i li ma lha khang du 'dug pa 'di yin zer ba 'dug khungs gang yin dpyad dka' yang gzhog pa'i khungs phyi ma btsan par mngon mod gang ltar 'gangs che bar snang bas phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i spyi rdzas su sbyar/ la stod nas rang rig grub chen du grags pa phyag rdzogs gnyis ka la nyams rtogs che ba zhig 'ongs pa dang phrad de ja gral la 'phros gleng mang du byung / la las mnga' bdag gi lung bstan du/ stod kyi phyogs nas rang rig ras pa 'byung zhes pa de yin nam zer gang ltar snang sems rang ngo 'phrod pa zhig tu mngon/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal legs grub dbus kyi gnas tshor zhabs 'chag dang tsa ri/ sgam po/ gdan sa mthil sogs bka' brgyud gong ma'i sgrub gnas mang por thugs dam gyi bogs 'don mdzad nas log phebs pa dang mjal/ zhabs drung rin po che ma'i dgongs pa dang 'gal 'gro snang pas khri thog byed dgos 'dra zhes ji ltar 'gab kyi bka' —84

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanagros gnang bar bal pos se'u'i dpe bzhin khag ngan nged la bskur ba'i dgongs bzhed 'dug pa zhes te zhal ngo lhan brgyas bka' gros khebs gang (61na)che gnang ba 'gab pa las spros pa'i tshig gzhan ye ma thal/ khong dpon slob lta bu'i 'jig rten gyi shes bya ci la yong yang ra ba stod pa'i gra pa rnams dang rigs lung gi tshe bsdus gra bde zer ba tsam byas pas ra thang rang g.yog pa gnang ga la thub/ zhabs drung nor bu khra sgor/ thub bstan mkhan po/ spos khang mkhan po/ sde pa grags pa/ no gon dge tshul/ zhal snga nas mngon dga' ba dang se chen zhabs drung gnyis kyi sku skye/ bla ma mngon mkhyen pa sogs phrad mi mang du byung / sna dkar rtse zhabs drung bsres pa phebs pa'i sa cha dgos gnang ba khab 'gro snyung 'gro las rgyu mtshan che ba mi 'dug pas 'bul ma bde/ gnas chung chos skyong chen po khog tu ma zhugs par rgyang tsam song bar brten tshang ma 'dod gdung che ba'i thog dan 'bag dge bsnyen rgya mtshor 'dre zhig zhugs nas lcog tu phyin pas phal cher 'khrul ba'i yin pa 'dra zhes dril bsgrags/nyer lnga'i nyin khog zhugs byas te po ta lar byung ba chos skyong yin pa sor bzhag gis rtser btang bsags gsum mgon po/ rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro/ ge sar rgyal po/ gtsang pa phun tsho gos rnam rgyal/sde pa bsod nams rab brtan rnams yin zer ba'i lha lab 'dre lab dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byed par de nyin 'jam 'gros kyis ldog /sang 'bras spungs kyi mchod khang yas mas kyi sku brnyan 'ga' zhig la'ang mtshon bsnun pa byas 'dug pas khog pa skor cig gdong dkar du bskyal bas mtshamasachod/ la la rgya 'dre yin nam zer yang dam sri ma rungs pa (61btokho tu mngon/ skyar po nas tshangasapa dung thod can la lung bstan zhu bar btang ba'i lan du spam me ba dang rting ma ngos mjal skabs dam sri de gar ngos 'dzin mdzad snang / 'dul ba slob dpon zur pa blo gros rnam rgyal dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi 'chad nyan du btang ba bla ma snga ma rnams las 'chad nyan smar ba byung 'dug /dgun stod ar dge'i chos skyong yin zer ba de stag tshang sgor mo'i bar slebs byung yang sna brdungs btang ba'i phyir slog /rting a byas tshe khog gsar de la bya khrid mig gcig pa mi phebs par 'dre ngan ar —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dge rang gi sku gsung thugs rten la gnod pa byed mkhan zhig yin 'dug khog tu zhugs nas bkra shis lhun por phyin pa'i gos dar gyi gdul bya che ba dang bde chen chos 'khor bas des gang zer bden par bzung ba'i rgyal khang bzhengs pa'i bla ma gu gul la re ba mang po byung tshod du gda'/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la khri rin po che blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ rtse shar/ slob chung / lnga mchod pa/ gra pa brgya skor/ rgya ma grub gsar ba dang dum bu ri pa can phyogs mthun du gos dar gyisagatsos pa'i skyes dang bcas tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i bden brjod gnang / de mtshungs nyin phyi ma tshor brag dbar gra tshang bla ma gra bcas dang ngam ring khul skya ser rnams kyis yun 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ dmar lcags gnyis kyi bar rgya mo bza' phyi mas bcad pa'i sa dgra gso byed mchod rten dang phan tshun du lcags thag rnga gdang dril bus sbrel dgos pa gter lung mang por gsal bar brten gtsang dus bzhengs (62na)pa me glang zhig pa'i tshe sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis gso dran gnang ba 'gyel zhig tu nye bas me rta sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos rgyas par mdzad rtsis kyis gsar du bzhengs kyang shing bzo gra sa pa spun gtsang du 'gror rings pa'i rtsig rmang ma lon pa'i skyon gyis gas grum ches nas me lug bskyar bzo mdzad/ phyi g.yu rtsis gtum bzhed yin 'dug pa g.yu rtsis lhad med byung ba shin tu mtshar ba yong rung bzo bo rnams kyis rgya'i gnad de ma things pas ring por mi thogs par mdog nyams 'gro gshes 'then/ bon po'i lung bstan 'dra na lha sa'i nub tu g.yu'i mchod rten byung na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i phyed la slebs zer rnam rtog byed mkhan 'dug pa gcig tu bden shas kha'ang thub dbang bltams nas nyis stong drug brgya lhag bcas song bas dog pa mi dgos pa 'dra/chos 'khor bcu gsum gser zangs kyis gtums pa'i padma/ pho gling mo gling/ thugs rje mdo gzung bcas par gling sum brgya don bzhir zangs mkhar rgya'i khal sum brgya dang go drug nyag drug spor do/dkyil 'khor sdings kyi zangs khra shin tu hrul pa'i bye'u sogs kyis gnod pa che ba 'dug par gsar bzo/ de zhor dpal lha lcog dang li ma lha khang gi sge khung gi zangs khra zer bcas bsdoms par khal —86

rang rnam du kū 0/'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)brgyad cu gya gsum dang nyag bco brgyad/ ti tsha nyag bcu dgu spor gsum/ gser 'dam zho stong phrag lnga dang lnga brgya bdun cu don brgyad/ dngul chu zho khri tsho gcig dang stong phrag gsum dgu brgya zhe lnga/mchod rten gsum dril ba'i lcags thag rgyug (62ba tsher dom bco lnga/ rlung dril sum cu skor bzhengs pa'i do dam grub rgyal gling pa dang sger logs a dar / bal po a ma ra sidha sa gtsos bco brgyad/zangs brdungs dbu mdzad gnyis kyis gtsos sum cu rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i gla yon 'bru thog tu phab par khal chig stong drug brgya skor song / ri bo bde chen du byams pa'i gos sku thog zo lnga tsam yod pa zhig bkra shis bde chen du gsang 'dus 'jam dpal rdo rje'i gos sku/ ri bo chos gling du rigs lnga'i gos sku dang gañdzi ra/ lho brag dpa' bo'i phyi rten gyi dngul gdung / bkra shis chos sder nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gos sku rnams phul zhing dngul gdung gi rgyab chos rje sgar pa'i kha zha thul gyis da chu yin 'dug pa dngul gyis brjes/ o rod dur bod rdo rje'i nu bo/ lho brag bsam grub dgon pa ba/ bde yangasapa'i rigs gra'i skal pa skyel ba'i slob dpon gra bcas rnams dang phrad/ bsnyen rdzogs sogacig /dge tshul brgya dang gsum/ dge bsnyen gcig rnams bsgrubs/ lha sa chu mig kha pa chog thu dang blo bzang rab brtan spun gyis bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bskul ba bris/zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal legs grub stag lung du shar mar phebs pa'i srod la drag shul gyi cho gas zhabs drung rtse pa yab sras gnyis mnyan yod mchod pa'i tshes brgyad kyi ston pa drug ltar bskrad de 'bras spungs su byon sde pa phon mdo bas saṃ ṭa btang ba'i da cha gnas gshis 'di bzhin gyis nged pha bu gnyis grub mtha' dge lugs su bsgyur/ lha sde mi sde nas sa ris bab thob bden 'brel gyi (63na)bgo bsha' dgos tshul gsung ba thugs bden par 'dug kyang de don bzhin byas tshe thang pa'i bstan pa mthar lhungs par ma zad zhabs drung ma chen gyi sku tshe'i sad du'ang mi 'gyur ba'i nges pa ma mchis pas nang lab gnang thub mi thub kyi dogs gcod zhu bar skyar po ba blo bzang legasaldan se ba lung du btang bar spus sgo'i mdo nas mjal kha gnang ba'i da cha nged kyi labs par khong —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)khag gnyis kyis nyan mi yong gsung ba'i sne len ma gnang 'dug par dpags zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal legs grub kyang tshur gdan drangs/ 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa/ mnga' ris drung pa/ stag ru nas/ bsam dar nas sogs btang ba'i skor g.yeng mang du btang/ zhu khra'ang kha yar byung ba sha bcad khrag gtigs kyi rtsa ba gcod ches na phyag rgya chen po de stong par mi 'gro bar rdos bcas bem po zhig tu grub nyen 'dug pas zhu ba rgyas bsdus 'tsham par blangs ngos bden 'brel gyi khra ma btang ba'i zhabs 'jug la dpon tshang tsha rong pa can rdzong bda' byas/sde pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi dngul gdung grub pa'i gzungs bzhugs 'bul mkhan gyi gtso bo mchod dpon pa dang de'i ram 'degs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa sogs kyis byas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gis gtsos rgya bod kyi mkhas grub 'gangs che ba rnams kyi sku gdung dang sku bal gyi ring bsrel/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs sngags chos sku'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can 'bum dum pa bsto drug /rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i bka' (63bsko.u ma yongs rdzogs/ gdung rten gnyis/ sku li ma dang gser sku 'dres pa nyi shu rtsa lnga/ zangs leb la gzong rkos kyi gnod sbyin 'khor lo sgrub zhag bdun pa dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid tshang bar phul/ gtsang khang chen mo'i gas la khyad mtshar de rten gsar pa rnams kyis bsgribs nas mi legs pa snang bas thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung la ar chog btang ste dngul gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi g.yas phyogs su bsgrigs par bad chen gyi mthongs su gser ga che legs/ de'i g.yas g.yon du g.yu mu men spel ba'i rdo rje dar dpyangs dang bcas pa re dang rdo rje phyed pa re/ de'i phan tshun du gser ga spus legs re/ de'i phan tshun du rdo rje phyed pa re rnams gsar du sgrogs/ gzungs bzhugs snga ma rgyas pa yod 'phros mi snang bas da lam chos sku'i ring bsrel dang bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi ring bsrel gong dang 'dra ba la sngar gyi gzungs bzhugs nas rgya bod kyi bstan bcos kha yar dang gdung rten so drug 'dug pa bldabs/gsar du dkon brtsegs phal chen gtso bor 'gyur ba'i mdo mang / 'dul ba lung / nyi khri man chad kyi —88—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasher phyogs/ rgyud 'bum/ sku kha shas bsnan/ gnod sbyin bang mdzod sogs phyag len gtsang bar phul/'jam dbyangs chos rje dang thon pa yon tan rgya mtsho gnyis kyi dngul gdung byams khang du spos/ dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi rdo rje slob dpon byas pa'i gra tshang gi gra pa bzhi bcu skor gyis phur pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad/de mtshungs dngul gdung (64na)'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi phra rgyan rta lo'i bde gzar dus 'thor bar dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches gsar bzo phran bu gnang zhing rjes su 'phyong rgyas paṇḍi tas gser ga bkongs song ba g.yu dbus gtsang rgyu mi 'dug pas da lam bad chen gyi mthongs su gser ga che legs gcig /de'i phan tshun du g.yu dang mu men spel ba'i rdo rje re dang rdo rje phyed pa re/ de'i phan tshun du mthong bsgyur shel dang de mtha' g.yu drug dkar dmar gyi phra nyis skor yod pa'i gser ga che legs re/ sgo khyim gyi phan tshun du gser ga gong 'dra re rnams kyi phra rgyan phul/ de mtshungs lha sar rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs kyi dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi gzungs bzhugs rus shing la bsdam dgos pa'i stabs gsung rab dang 'bur sku'i rigs gtos che ba mi chud 'dug rung bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi ring bsrel dang gtso bor chos sku'i ring bsrel gyis phyur bur gtams/ gnod sbyin bang mdzod bcas phyag len gtsang bar dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ chos rje kha rag pa/ rgya phrug rab 'byams pa gsum gyis phul zhing sngags rams pa nor bu chos 'phel gyis rdo rje slob dpon byabs pa'i gra pa zhaX grangs gong 'dras rab tu gnas pa legs par bsgrubs/ de yang sangs rgyasang stong skur gzungs bzhugs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas gtsos gra pa brgyad tsam gyis phul grub nas mchod khang gi go yul rnams la mchod dpon pas lta rtog dang do dam ge re dka' bcu dang zur khang rgyal don gnyis kyis byas/hor zla dgu pa'i nang du dpal ldan (64ba 'bras spungs kyi sgo mchor steng gi shar du bskal bzang lha khang rten khri mtshal rtsi gser shog gis spras par gtso bo rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i sku che ba zhig —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)la de las chung tsam gyi stong sku li ma gsar bzhengs gra tshar/ mchod rdzas spos shel gyi bum pa cha 'bras skyogs gcig /ma na ho/ g.yang ṭi/ dwangs shel rnams kyi pad sder/ pad phor/ 'bras skyogs/ me dam bya ma bum 'dres pa nyer gcig /nya phyis 'bras skyogs gnyis/ 'be da'i bum gzugs gser gyi kha gsham can/ dkar yol dang de las grub pa'i bum pa seng gzugs bsdoms pa nyer lnga/ dngul gyi pad sder/ pad phor/ 'bras skyogs/ bya ma bum/ maṇḍal bcas pa sum cu/ rgya rag gi maṇḍal/ dza rag /me dam bcas pa bcu gcig mchod kong bcu bzhi/ phud phor gnyis/ li dang ljang ser gyi ting rnying nga bzhi/ 'od 'bir gcig /gnam rgyan gser bsgril btags thog skyem si'i gnas bcu yod pa dang si'u'i 'brug tshang nyal 'ja' ris can gling gnyis ma/ gan gos kyi 'phran so bzhi/ de'i nub gser sku lha khang du rten khri gong mtshungs la gser sku rag sku bsdoms pa drug brgya go gcig /dngul sku gnyis/ li'i maṇḍal bcu gcig /me long bzhi/ rag tsha gser gyi pad rkang gdan bcas kyis btegasapa'i bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi snod/ de steng rtags brgyad dngul 'dab can/ gi gu shel gyi ting nga lnga/khrus sder/ pad sder/ lte ri/ bya ma bum bcas pa ba lcogacig /bsha' dkar gyi lte ri gcig /zangs tsha gser gyi spyi blugs/ li ting re lnga/ ser (65na)ting bcu drug /rag 'khar gyi so gcig /li rag zangs gsum gyi khrus sder pad sder bcu gsum/ rag gi ya mgu ma mgu gtor 'theb dang bcas pa/ljang ser gyi bum pa gsum/ zangs kyi ga ru gcig /khro rag gi me dam nyer bzhi/ mchod kong nyer gcig /'or ting gcig /phung phor gcig /'khar rnga gnyis/ khro'i spos 'dzan gnyis/ dung dkar bdun/ rgya mgron gcig /nya skyogs gcig /lcags kyi spos khra gcig /mañdzi gcig /gos 'phan lnga/bzang gos kyi gnam rgyan mdo sbug gnyis khebs pa/ dngul gdung lha khang gi lho ngos su sa khri'i rten stegs la bka' gdams gdung rten bya ru ma sogs thugs rten nga bdun/ bka' gdams li ma/ ya tshe rag sku gser sku 'dres pa'i sku brnyan tshig brgya nga gsum/ li ting bdun dang ster ma bcu gnyis/zangs ting bdun/ bzang gos kyi 'phan ring bzhi/ gan gos dang bum gdan gos ther sogs las —90

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 'degrub pa'i lcam gling bzhi'i gnam rgyan/ rgya nag ta ming dus kyi tsandan gyi gnas bcu khyad mtshar po snya pa de bzhin gshegs pas gdan drangs pa kong po rtse lha sgang gi mdzod nag nas chu rta mchod yon dpung thog tu phebs skabs bsnams byon pa sde pa sras po dang ka brgyad nor bu sogs phyag mdzod rnams gru ma btub pa'i hwa shang dang rgyal chen bzhi lam du bor ba'i lhag ma rnams bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi lha khang du khro lugs lta bur bzhugs 'dug pa byams khang shar ma'i steng du sprul sku hor dar dang bag dros gtsos e ba'i 'jim bzo ba rnams kyis (65ba)byang nas lhor gzigs pa'i brag ri sogs bzo dbyibs bkod pa legs shing sgo khyim bab le nyis brtsegs ma bcas bzos par bzhugs pa'i ma tshang ba kun 'jim pas gsos/ brag ri'i gseb rnams su tsandan dmar po las grub pa'i gnas bcu tshar gcig dang ba so las grub pa'i tshar gnyis bzhugs pa tsho rgya bzo sha stag /sku 'khyar pa thub dbang gi shing sku gnyis/ byang chub shing dang dkar yol gyi mi gzugs re/ dngas shel gyi mig gzugs gcig /blug shel gyi dam gzugs gnyis/ bzhu g.yang gi sder ma gnyis/ rdo mnyen gyi bum gzugs gcig /nya phyis kyi phor skyogs lnga/ dkar yol dang khri rdo'i phor pa me dam bsdoms pa nyer bzhi/ mi gzugs gnyas dang seng gzugs gcig /dngul phor 'bras skyogs/ bya ma bum/ mchod sdong bcas pa brgyad/ dngul gyi me tog lnga/ mu tig ljon shing gi dkar stegs gcig /gi gu shel gyi maṇḍal gnyis/ ting bdun/ gab tse gcig /bsha' dkar gyi me dam gnyis dang rkyan bu gcig ting kha che ma bdun/ 'khar ljang gi nyer gcig /me dam bzhi/ mchod gong drug /zangs rgyan gcig /lcags kyi mañdzi gcig /nub nas shar du gzigs pa'i rten khrir gser rag 'dres pa'i bla sku go gcig /sman sku gnyis/ maṇḍal gcig /dkar yol drug /gi gu shel gyi ting bdun/ li rag gi bcu gcig /me dam bzhi/ mchod kong drug shar nas nub tu gzigs pa'i rten star la bka' gdams li ma shas che ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan re dgu /li'i maṇḍal (66na)gcig /ljang ser gyi bum pa gnyis/ me dam drug /gi gu shel gyi ting bcu/ li 'khar rag gi nyer lnga/ mchod kong lnga/ gos 'phan —91 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dgu/ gos phrug rgya kha 'brug ris can si'u ma dang bkral btags gnas bcu'i ri mo can gyi gnam rgyan gnyis/ 'du khang chen mor gos dar spel ma'i phyi phur ka ring dang mnyam pa bdun/ de las thung ba bcu bdun/ gtsang khang chen mor khro kong sum cu/ byams chen la gos lu hang gi 'gan sbyar/ phyi phur cha gcig rnams phul/ de mtshungs 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pas do dam byas pa'i se ra theg chen gling gi mchod khang gsar bskrun gnyis kyi nub tu gser dngul gyi gdung rten lnga dang g.yin ma gdung rten chig brgya gya bdun/ li ma gser zangs khro sogs kyi sku chig brgya re brgyad tsandan dmar po'i skyon rin po che'i sku gcig /nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi nang nas byams pa dngul sku khru phyed gsum tsam pa dang gzhan bdun li ma lha khang cig shos su gdung rten chig brgya nyer dgu li gser zangs khro shing dang sman 'dam sogs las grub pa'i sku chig brgya gya drug /bka' 'gyur skya pod cha tshang / mchod khang phan tshun gnyis kyi mchod rdzas bsdoms pa gnam rgyan/ 'phan rgyal mtshan 'dres pa bco lnga/ shel spyad bco brgyad/ gi gu shel lnga bcu/ nya phyis kyi spyad pa bco lnga/ dkar yol zhe drug /bsha' dam lnga/sbug chal dang sil snyan cha re/ gzi dung gnyis/ mchod dung bdun/ gser zangs kyi maṇḍal bzhi/li'i maṇḍal bdun/ dkar yol dang khro'i (slob)spos 'dzin dgu/ me tog dam pe bsto drug /ting brgya dang nyi shu/ mnyi gsum/ phud phor gnyis/ mchod kong bzhi/ bse ru gcig rnams bsgrigs/ gnam gang gi nyin gling stod chos rje/ ldan chos 'khor ba'i 'grul pa/ dga' ldan dar rgyas kyi dge tshul ma 'das pa'i bsngo zhus pa dar rgyas rab 'byams pa/ khams ratna bha dra'i sku skye/ pa rnam thar pa'i mkhan po/ rgya gar gha ṭa gha'i rgyal po'i mi sna/ mon pa a cog sogs phrad mi kha yar byung / a cog phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs rkang pa 'dred nas 'gyel la khad byung song ba ma 'ongs pa'i gnas tshul la lta ba 'dra/dpon mo sa'i khan jus zor pang mang du btsems nas skyel mi btang / bo dong sbyor ra ba'i gra pa zhig gis yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yongs rdzogs chu shur dga' ldan thar gling pa'i gra pa zhig gis padma bka' thang/ tsha rong dpon tshang gi slob ma zhig gis gso dpyad rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/—92

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (za)tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin stag tshang ra ba stod pa dpon slob yongs rdzogs/ rwa bsgreng mkhan po spyi so gra pa thor bu/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po yon tan seng ge can gyis rim pa bzhin zang zing gi skyes dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ ra ba stod pa rnams la sgrol ma sher snying sogs kyi lung phul/ rgyas sras ratna 'khor bcas 'byor ba dang / lha rtse sprul sku/ bang rim mkhan po/thon legs ldan dbang po/ bya sgo ba tshe dbang rdo rje/ ka tshal bla ma/ yar 'brog padma gling pa/ spun drug rdzong pa'i dpon sa sogs dang phrad/ sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi dgongs par (67na)gra tshang chos 'khor gling pa gong dkar thod ri dang rtag brtan lta bur gzhis dgon mdzad pa'i dar rgyas che ba zhig gi thugs bzhed dang 'bras spungs su bzhugs par dgyes rgyu mi 'dug pa spyi so'i phogs kyi ma ldangs pa'i skyon de ga yin nam snyam rung gra tshang byings la kha cig yod kyang re gnyis kyis khams tshan mi tshan gyi mi sna 'dra byas skabs ngan shed kyis 'then khyer dang gra rgyun chu 'bab pa las ngos gzung med par bdag tu bzung ba/ lhag tu a pa la'i ban chung dpon g.yog brgya skor sde pa bsod namasarab brtan gyis chos 'khor gling du gtong ba'i sa bcad gnang ba'ang sgo mang slob dpon khri gdan zur dge rgan sogs kyis tsol pas lam du ma rgyugs/ zhal snga nas 'bur ltag pa dang gnyal pa gnyis kyi dus gra tshang gnyis mdo sgrub rgyag res dang chos 'khor gling pas sde pa bsod nams rab brtan la zhus pa'i blo gsal gling par mi sna phab ste dbu mdzad phud pas mtshon dbyen du mas bcos pa'i 'gras gzhi'i rgyun je 'phel du song ba 'di lo mngon dod du langs te gra tshang phan tshun gnyis bsgril bas chos 'khor gling pa'i steng du spungs pa'i so so'i zhu bsher rnam grangs shin tu mang bar go bskon gsed bkrol sna tshogs byas rung gra tshang gnyis 'bras spungs nas gzhan du 'pho zer ba'i 'gro sdod kyi zhu ba bskyar 'debs las gzhan ma byung zhing gra tshang chos 'khor gling pa'ang khong tshos phud pa'i gtam mi 'dod pa bsnyad pa'i brag phug rgyab bstad kho na'i rgyu mtshan byung bar gra tshang gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i 'bras spungs pa med pa lta bu yin pas (67ba)khag gnyis 'bras spungs nas 'pho thebs —93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ga la yod/ bla ma sne mo ba sogs yong mi rnams la phyi 'khyar mi yong ba'i rtsi kha bkag /gra tshang la dad btsun gyi rigs de nas bzung ma bcug pa'i btsun khral gsar pa sum brgya tsam brgyab chos 'khor gling rang du gra shag dang bcas gra tshang gnyis dang 'dres 'dres mi dgos pa byed par dril bsgrags/don du lo gsar bstun mkhar las byed khar tshan chen zhig ma byas na ma 'thus pa'i mi ser sbyong zhing nye skor sa dmigs dog par bsnyad rtag brtan du spos na gtam ngan sod cing don kyang tshang tshul lab par mgron gnyer drung pa/ stag ru nas/ skyar po nas gsum btang bar gnyer pa skam dgon pasathog drangs tshang ma da cha 'thor chog pa dgos zhes kha ma 'khyil bar had gyes la song 'dug /sang nyin blo 'gyur ba'i zhu 'bul yong du re ba'i bsgugs kyang ma byung bas nang par tsha rong nas dang star sdong blo bzang rin chen gnyis rtsis len la btang / dge 'dun gyi dbyen du song dogs pas gra tshang gi sgrigs 'grim bzhin pa rnams gzhis dgon dang dgon gnas gzhan du 'pho bcug /snyan dar sogs mtshan nyid par mi mkho ba'i sngags chas kyi rigs chos 'khor rgyal du bskyal/ de phyin zags 'thor med pa byas/ mi gcig gis bskal pa'i 'go zhabs tshang mar gra tshang gi rigs gzung ba'i dpe med cing gra thog mang du 'phos kyang gra tshang gi ming de ji srid bar sdod srol 'dug gshis gtsang phyogs nas btsun khral brgyab ste zla shas bar ra ba stod 'grim bcug pa'i bya lo'i nang du slob dpon phun tshogs (68na)tshogs 'phel/ dge rgan bcu skor/ gnyer pa 'phyong rgyas dka' bcu ba blo bzang tshe ring / dpal grong shag pa blo bzang rnam rgyal rnams btang ba'i myug mchod gzhis su sbyar rgyal khang dgon par gra tshang chos 'khor gling gsar du btsugs pas brgya byin dang tshangs pa tshe 'phos pa bzhin shul ni byung ma song / dpal 'khor chos sde mkhan po dang stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang /mon pa a cog la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bskur zhing gon pa rna g.yu byu ru gos dar sogs ster sbyin bzabs/ bsnyen rdzogs gya dgu/ dge tshul brgya bcu bdun/ dge bsnyen bcu bzhi rnams bsgrubs/chos rje sgrol ma bar khro rol gyi chog khrigs gsar pa'i lung bklags/ khams spung ri nang so'i dgon —94

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)pa khag gsum sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhing brje gdong dge lugs su bsgyur ba'i ji nong gi tsha brgyud dang mchod yon zung 'brel yong rtsis kyis shog che tsam mdzad song ba'i bla mar lcang lo can pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang slob chung gnyis btang / de rnams dang mtshan sgrog mkhan por 'gro mi gra tshang gi gra pa sngags rams pa ngag dbang 'phrin las bcas par skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang byas/tshes bcu dgu'i nyin sde pa thon pa sger gzhung / rtses dang / pho brang / gri gu bzhi khyon gcig pas tshogs 'khor ster cha'i yon sbyar te do dam mthon pa legs ldan dbang po/ bya sgo ba tshe dbang rdo rje/ pho brang rdzong sdod rnam snang / gri gu gzhis sdod tshe bdag rnams kyis byas pa'i gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang (68ba)gi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog btang /nyi shu'i nyin gshin rje me'i spu gri'i mtshams khag gnyis la las byang gsar bsgrigs lhan thabs kyi lung byas/ sang nas bzung nyin bdun gyi bar gter sgrom gyi chu tshan gyis nad kyi dri ma bkrus/ thos bsam dar rgyas gling gi tshogs su 'dzugs rgyu'i g.ya' bzang lha mo tsaṇḍi ka dang yar lha sham po gnyis kyi gsol mchod brtsams/ ru thog dbang pos ring du gnas dgos pa'i tshan grangs dang bcas snyan tshig gi gsung 'phrin byung ba'i de lan bsrings dpal ri sprul skus ring 'tsho'i tshigasabacad dgos tshul 'byung ba skur zhor du lo snga ma dam rdzi'i skabs 'phrang 'go gter ston pa'i yid bzhin nor bu sa'i snying po dang snang rtse ba'i sha za kha mo'i che'i mgul shel yin zer ba gnyis 'khyar ba lag tu byung ba 'phrang 'go ba'i gter ma de phyir bsrings/ snang rtse nas kyi de ni gtsang 'gram gyi dkar gong chung ngu zhig snang ba lho kha phyogs su'ang de rigs 'bal po yod dam snyams lus song / nyer brgyad la brag sna chos rje dang chos rje kha rag pa can bsnyen mtshams pa brgyad the ba'i gra pa drug cu skor la drang srong log tri'i rig gtad dang rje 'bri gung pa'i ljags bsgrigs le tshan gyi lung bklags/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gnyis la gong dkar rdo rje gdan nas slob dpon rnam mkhyen grong ba dang —95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)chos 'chad par rab 'byams chos rje sogs nyi shu skor/ tshal gung thang gi bla ma gra rigs tshos so so'i lugs bzhin skyes dang bcas brtan sdod kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs/ ngor mkhan po sgrub khang pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal legs bshad gling bla ma/ a rig sum brgya/(69na) nag 3|da pa brgya tsam dang phrad/ ngor mkhan po 'di gsan rgya dang sku yon dus phyis kyi mkhan thog cig la che/ 'on kyang klu sdings pa'i srin po'i za res las ni thar ma song / gong dkar chos sde pa rnams la thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i sgrol dkar gyi sbyin sreg gi lung bklags/tshes gsum la bde yangs slob dpon pas gtsos stod lung tsher gseb dgon pa pas dngos po'i tshan grangs dang bcas cho ga la brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa'i dus kyi phyag len kha shas btsun ma zhig gis dpe sbas te nub pa 'das shul nas rnyed de phyag len sngar las rgyas pa zhig byas song / dge slong nyis brgya nyer lnga/ dge tshul bdun cu/ dge bsnyen gcig rnams bsgrubs/ dbu skor che chung / yam bu rgyal po'i mi sna/ dga' ldan chosa'akhor yang rtse'i bla ma/ lho brag mkhar chu dang sgo chu'i bla ma sogs dang phrad/ bcu gsum gyi pa sangasanam gru'i 'grub sbyor thog rgyal sras sher 'phel sprul sku/ ratna/ sa skyong / dbon po gu ru sras bcas/bye rdzing mkhan po/ 'phags sde'i mkhan po gra bcas/ yang zur gyi dbu mdzad/ dpon po bsod namasachos 'dzom/ rgyal mo chung ba can la ja gral byas/ skye sa rum pa yin pa'i mgo dkar ha che zer bas me long khyad mtshar byin/ da la'i hung tha'i jis dga' ldan gser thog gi dgos cha gzhan rnams song ba'i tshab mar gser srang brgyad cu dang gos dar sa skyong la bskur 'dug pa 'tshem med du byung / tshogasagasog tu rdzong gzhis bcu (69ba)drug bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar nyis brgya/ 'bum/ brgyad stong pa/ bskal bzang / dkon brtsegs/ ting 'dzin rgyal po/ gzungs bsdus/ gser 'od rnams brgya rtsa re/ mtshan brjod dang gdugs dkar so sor sum 'bum/ sher snying nyis 'bum/ sman bla chig khri bzhi stong / tshe chog bzhi/ gshin rje'i sngags ring bye ba/ mnan pa bdun/ rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bkang ba —96

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanatshig 'bum/ beg tse la tshig khri/ spyir stong rtsa/ de ga'i mu 'thud jus rim du dmigs nas stod smad du dgra mnan khag bcu byas/tshes bco brgyad la shar 'phel sprul sku dang ratna mchod yon gyis gos dar/ ja ta/ cha khar dbang gi bla ma rtses dang las chen pas gser dngul/ gos phyi nang / tho yon bla ma'i dge rtsa'i ja gos dar/dbu sgor chung bas rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs su phying gur gon pa/ rta sga bcas/ sag thag /bra yag sku skye'i ja khor drug ma brgya skor sogs bdog pa mang du blangs shing dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos/rta tshag rje drung / gnas rnying zhabs drung gi sku skye/ tha'i ji nor bu rgya mtsho/ dge 'dun/ stag lung phyag mdzod/ a mdo pa'i gsar 'grul mang ba rnams dang phrad/ de mo sprul pa'i sku da la'i hung tha'i jisagatsos pa'i mtsho ba'i dpon khag rnams kyis gdan drangs te byon pa lam du chab gzhi yin nam zer gang ltar things dka' ba'i bsnyun gyis gshegs pa'i mgyogs bsngo rten dang gnas tshul skyel bar dge slong drag pa zhig ched bstad 'byor/ gos dar sha nas kyi dgongs rdzogs mthun rkyen gya nom pa bsrings/ dbon po bsod nams (70na skor bus bskul ba ltar sku skye myur 'byon gyi tshigs bcad bskur/ las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di mchog dman kun la gal che bas mdo sde mdzangs blun dang gzhan yang lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar phyi nang gsang gsum rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po dang mjal tshul gyi par rnams grub pa'i skyel mi 'byor/ me'i spu gri dang 'gong po ar gtad kyi sgrub pa btsugs/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis la gong nas mi sna yar klungs em chi dang ta 'on shi rel thu chos rje'i dbon po 'grul sdebs klu 'bum chos rje dang yer pa chos rje sogs mang ba 'byor/ bka' shog gnang sbyin sprad cing rgya sog gzhung bzang gi dgongs pa bstad pa'i bka' ngag stsal/ mi sna dang 'grul sdebs rnams kyis rgya zog gi bdog pa'i skyes shin tu che bar byas/ tre bo dpon gyi bskur ma/nag shod rab 'byams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ khams bya mo nang gi bla ma can 'grul pa mang ba dang —97—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)phrad/tshes bzhi la sher 'phel sprul skus gshed dmar gyi sku ding thags ma hor dus don pa'i khyad can gyis gtsos ster sbyin tshogs mchod 'gyed dang bcas pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad gra tshang gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog btang / tshes bcu la dpal ldan 'bras spungs gra slob nyis brgya skor gyis maṇḍal gyi rten du dngos po'i skyes dpangs bstod dang bcas bden tshig gi shis pa brjod / sher 'phel sprul skur spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang phul/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyisarim gro'i (70ba)bskul ma'i gsung lan tshigs bcad du bsrings/ dar khan ja'i sang gis ratna ra brjod rigs mangs pa'i 'khrul gzhis dge skyon cung zad byung bar skyar po ba btang ba'i gseng bkrol byas pas dpon po grung drags pa'i rjes su spang blang mtha' dag tshul dang ldan pa byung / rgyal rtse bdag po byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis rdo ring rin po che'i zhal thang tshar chen gyi phyag nas ma dang rdo nag maṇḍal drung yig byams pa don grub brgyud pa'i gangs che ba gnyis 'dar lo 'khor zhag nas phyir 'degs skabs bskur ba mdzad/ mchod dpon pas re zhig sgrol dkar gyi tshe chog cig byung na yong 'dra zer ba ltar gong dkar chos sde nas rdo rje slob dpon the ba li gra pa lngas po ta la'i zhol du zla grangs kyis brje len byas pa' chag med du btsugs/ me rta yum chen mo'i rgyugs sprod mkhan sbyor ra ba'i gra pa des nyi khri'i rgyugs sprad/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod pas bang chen rgyu 'grul sogs la thugs phan thogs pa yong zhes hor rta kha yar skyel bar btang /tshes bco lnga la gong gi mi sna gnyis kyis tshogs 'khor ster cha 'gyed gzengs bstod pa'i yon sbyar te gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog btang / 'or pa dka' bcu dang chab mdo rje drung rin po che'i sku skye gnyis bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ lho 'brug pas mon pa a chog sogs rang zhabs kyi steng du dpung bcug pa'i tshur rgol de lam du bzhag na ma 'thus pa'i dpung khag bzhi gtong ba shar bas gra tshang du jus rim btsugs/ spyan gzigs snyan dar tshogs chas spel ba'i 'phrin 'chol dang lung bstan —98

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)(71na)zhu bar bsam yas su lha sa nub pa rin cen/ tshong 'dus dang thang po che lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang / la mor chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse rnams btang / star sdong blo bzang tshe brtan can gyis mtsho sna phyogs su 'gro khyab che ba dang stag ru ba gnam gang 'brug rgyal dang mas chags pa/ du nas/ dmigs pa sogs kyis bum thang du'ang 'gro lugs legs po byung 'dug rung mda' dpon gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dpung chen rang zhabs ma bsgral ba'i dpa' bo rgyab bcad kyi skyon gyis khag zhan gnyis kyang gtong tshod byed dgos byung ba'i thog /gdan sa gong 'og /bkra shisalhun po skyid shod tha'i ji rnams kyis bar pa byed pas nyan dgos tshul byung ba bzhin phan tshun gnyis ka dgra zhed gnyen zhed la song ba'i sems can gyi bde thabs la phan par bsams gsungs dang du blangs pa'i shing yos tshun chings dan la gnas pa byas/ rin cen rtse pa lha bsangs kyis gtsang dusadang mchod yon sogs dpon thog na rim gyi dbu la ra thang g.yogs pa tshabs su song ba'i bu mo'i thog tu bla ma lha pa bsgril ba'i chos 'jig rten gang du'ang 'then chog pa bya gshog byi so'i dpe byed rtsis snang ba skabs su ma babs pas yol gdong nas gzhon pa legs ldan mag par bskyal 'on kyang sngo chas kyis gtsos chas ka drag pa rnams sbas bshubs kyis mtshon pa'i byed sgo sna tshogs la brten sde pa lha bsangs rang zur 'jog gi rmugs pa'i rang mdog ni mi ston ka med shar song /hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la khor chin ge (71ba)sar gu yeng ja'i sang dang a yo shi a sbas nang tshang gnyis kyis kha btags brgya/ gos yug nyi shu/ ling dang ma ha〉 bzhi bcu re/ dngul spyad/ rta sga 'khor gyis gtsos pa'i ster cha gtos che ba bteg /na mon e jen chab gzhi'i bsnyun babs lci ba'i lha sar 'byor ba khong pa na tshod dang nad babs tshang ma nas mthar thon mdog kha bas shing rta byas te jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs rten khyad 'phags rnams kyi zhal mjal 'phral du 'gab tshul glengs/ de na po ta lar yang yong dgos gsung ba ltar ltag sgo rgyab tu rdul mi ldang ba'i sa stan mang du 'ding ba'i sta gon bgyis kyang bla ma mngon mkhyen pa zer bas lo gsum bar gyi khag theg byas pas da —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)cha drag nas byed long gshom zhes bshol ba de rka'i gnangs gzhes tsam ma 'tsho rung thag ring nas 'ongs pa jo shāka gi drung du 'byor bas blo kha rdzogs shing gnam dpyad kyang legs pa byung song /klu 'bum me rgan chos rje/ dge tshul ma gnyis/ tha'i ji gsum/ ja'i sang drug /kong po dar khan em chi can khal kha'i 'grul pa tsho dang phrad/ dpon po'i dge rtsar bsngo rten dang chos sde rnams su dge ba'i rtsa ba brgyas pa mtha' dag rdzogs byang du bsngos/ so so'i ster chas mtshon pa'i bdog pa rgya cher spel/ dge rtsa dmigs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya byas/ chos rje brag la pa'i bsngo rten du chos dbang rin po che'i rta mgrin sgrub rten gyi thod sku/ byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po'i thugs dam rten gyis gtsos pa 'byor/ stag lung zhabs drung ma chen cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan par sku rim gyi mang 'gyed rgya (72na)che bar mdzad song zhing de skabs phyag mdzod pas jo shāka gnyis/ rang byon lnga ldan 'phags pa mched rnams la 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar zhal yig bskul ba bzhin brtsams/ er te ni chos rje/ se chen a khas gu shri tho yon sogs kyi mi snas so so'i yi ge rten sbrags sprad pa blangs/ chos lung byang rtse'i nang rten rgyal sras thogs med pa'i thugs dam rten gyi bde mchog dang lha mo'i shing sku/ 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam rten yang dag mar me dgu pa'i thod sku/ nag po spyod pa'i sku rgyan/ rtag brtan gyi nang rten sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung / shā ri'i bu'i tshems/ 'od srungs kyi tshems/ gha ya dha ra'i phyag dril rgya gar mgo dkar nas byung ba/ grub chen ko brag pa'i 'bral spang gi thod pa 'ja' bun ma rnams phyogs mthun du drangs pa nang rten khrod du yod/ dus ra ma le tshan btang / nyer dgu nas lag pa g.yon pa'i gru mo cung zad na ba gnam gang gi nyin skrangs che ba byung bas rol mo dang bcas gnyan khar gnod dogs bskang gsor 'gro mi 'gro the tshom gyi tshe sde pa a bar dang mchod dpon pas brtag pa zhig byas na yong zer ba ltar mo phywa zhig btab pas skyon med tshul babs pa bzhin gyi phyin par rol mo chen po des mi gnod pa'i khar nang bar bde ru song 'dug pa dar mo nas kyis khong sman btang ba'i phan yon yin nam gang ltar zhe med 'di nad la yang 'gro gin yod pa 'dra/— /00

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)dgung lo nga gsum par bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs dang tshogs gsog tu dmigs te khra 'brug dang yum bu bla mkhar gyi rgya phibs gsar bzhengs dang / zangs ri ba blo bzang mthu stobs sde srid du bskos pa bcas kyi skor/sa bya gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i srid gsum bdag mo mchod cing nyin gnyis kyi bar rgya nag /khal kha o (72ba)rod/ bod dang bcas pa'i drag rim la tshoms chen du bzhugs gral btang khyon bsdoms stong phrag gsum brgal bar lo gsar gyi dga' ston spel/ tshes bcu bzhi'i tsha rting khar sdigs shin tu che ba zhig byung ba sogs la brten mchod dpon dbu mdzad/ grong smad a bar/ stag ru nas/ skyar po nas sogs nye 'khor ba thams cad kyis rim gro byas pa 'gab tshul gleng ba dang nged rang yang lta ba dang blo sbyong kha bshad du lus pa'i bdag 'dzin gyi dbang gis rdzong gzhis bcu gsum bsgril bar dri med bshag rgyud sum stong / gdugs dkar 'bum ther bcu gsum dang mdos chen bzhi/ tshe chog dgu/ smon lam chen mo'i tsho gos chen du spong dag la brten pa'i 'gyed rgyas par btang /dngul chu ma dul ba mdze/ 'bam nag /gnyan rgod shin tu thu ba'i rigs ma gtags na da gang byung la btang na phan las gnod che zhing bco bkru la brten nas dpal ldan shaṭa ba ri dbang phyug drang srong rig pa'i blo gros grub thob bā li pa gsum 'ja' lus grub nas da lta'ang lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs par bshad cing grub thob o rgyan pas rgyud man ngag du ma las btus nas bod 'dir dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i rgyun bzhin shel dkar du sbyar ra dngos grub kyis do dam byas dpon tshang nam mkhas bzos pa'i dngul chu btul ma gtos che ba dang rten sgam chung gra rnams 'byor/ri bo chos gling gi dngul gdung dang gtsang khang mgon khang gi deb kyi 'go brjod dang sher 'phel —/01—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)sprul skus bskul ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad bris/ yul khams gang du'ang so (73na)so'i cha lugs sgrigs srol rang skad 'phyugs med du byas pa shes shing khyad par bod 'dir dus snyigs pa na cha lugs spyod tshul kha brda sogs 'phral 'phral 'gyur 'gro ba o rgyan chen po dang lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor ba sogs kyi lung bstan du gsal bas cha lugs sna tshogs legs rgyu mi 'dug rung sog po'i khrims lung rgyugs pa'i dus yin gshis sog lugs rang sha stag pa zhig byas na rnam pa gcig tu 'thad shas kha'ang phal cher gyis de bzhin ma 'byor bas steng gos sog lugs la sha gos/ ska rags/lham/ gzan rnams bod dang bstun pa'i chas ya ma zung gang du'ang ngos 'dzin dka' bas bod sog so sor chas ma 'dres par byung na lta snang spro zhing gtsang dus phan gyi lo chu tsam rjes su byung ma song bas bod kyi lha chen rnams mgu na lo chu legs su re ba dang mi nag skra med pa 'di dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor chen po'i dus dkor la snyeg pa'i sdig pa zhan la gsog pa zhig 'dug pas lding dpon yan skra lo dang de phyin dgon pa'i dkor gyis nges par 'tsho dgos pa'i dmigs bsal rnams ma gtogs rbad mgo drag gzhan go babs dang bstun pa'i bod chas byed dgos pa'i brda 'grems dang gan rgya blangs/ gong phyogs su ser srid dar rgyas che khul la dpon mthong las med pa'i yon sa mtha' dag snyam 'brug kho nas tshul 'chos pa'i gzhan 'drid kyis bdag gir bzung snang bas rang bstan la mi phan par nges te ser srid so sor dkor sa rnams bgos te yon mchod tshad ldan dgos pa'i bsdam ra byas/(73ba)hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la no mon e rjen gyi dge tshul ma gnyis/ da'i chin kho sho chi/ nom chi a kha'i rnams kyis ja gos dar / dngul spyad/ rta rmig ma/ pags rigs/ spos rigs/spos khyad mtshar/ khe re me gson po/ rta sga mas thog drangs stong 'bul bteg /dpon po'i dge rtsar dmigs pa'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi dngul sku bzheng ba'i rogs ram byas/ 'phags pa lha'i phyag mdzod chos bkras pa 'byor ba'i ja khor drug ma lnga bcu skor/ rta drel khrab kyi bdog pa bteg dbon drung chos 'khor yang rtser sdod mi dgos pa'i re ba yin 'dug rung chu shur nas chos 'khor yang —102

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanartser 'pho gdong ri gong mgon khang du rtsi kha bkag skabs mna' shas pa sogs stag shi'ang klad rtsal mi skam pa'i 'jam po gsum gyi gdul byar gtogs rigs su min 'dug pas don smin ma bde/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skus gra tshang du gra ja dang rgya rnga'i spyi 'bul thog yun du gnas pa'i bden pa brjod pa'i thugs rtsom mdzad de btsugs/ stag lung phyag mdzod/ gle bo'i mi sna/ ru thog dbang po'i bsngo zhus pa/ tre bo nam mkha' bsam grub/ tshal bde chen gyi tha'i ji/ gong gi gser yig pa 'grul sdebs dang bcas pa/ gung thang gi bla khag /ratna/ sa skyong phun tshogs dbang phyug gis gtsos pa'i dpon po rnams dang phrad/ dge slong don bdun/ dge tshul nyis brgya re drug /dge bsnyen gnyis rnams bsgrubs/sngags rams pa 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ser smad slob dpon tshul dar ba'i gsol 'debs/ chu shur thar gling slob dpon gra (74na)kyi bcas ngor ring 'tsho'i smon lam/ pe cing gi tsandan las grub pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la bstod pa smon lam thag ring po nas san chag pa shis bskul ba rnams bkod/ dpon tshang tsha rong pa'i slob ma gnyis kyis gso rig rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/zla ba dang po'i nang du cham pa zhig byung ba drung 'tsho lhag bsam dang dar mo nas gnyis kyis sman btang 'phrod ngo che'ang yang yang log pa'i stabs sman rkang par babs nyams kyis zla ba 'di'i nyi shu skor nas rkang pa'i mgo ma bde bar sman dpyad kyis bde skyid yong mur hor zla gsum pa'i tshes dgu la 'bam ro 'phar bar sman dkar btang bas zhag shas song tshe 'gro 'dug cung zad thub tsam byung / sde pa a bar dang dbu mdzad gnyis kyis nad g.yog byas shing a bar lo bcu bdun las mi 'gro yang gnyid bsrung bar sdod nus pa gos kyi srubs dbar nas rlung mi 'chor ba'i grung po byas pa stag ru nas kyis mthong bas ya mtshan gyi 'phros pa byed/ 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin dang chang khyim pa gnyis kyis yi ge 'dri rogs dang phyi rol tu ngag ma bsgyur ba'i rkang brdungs shing dar mo ba dang chang khyim pa mchod dpon pa'i sar btang bas sman dpyad drung 'tsho ba lhag bsam gyis byas/tshes bcu dgu la mchod dpon pa yar klungs kyi brel ba chod bstun rgyal gyi gtor gsos la 'gro —103

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba'i sa bcad yod par nub gcig rmi lam du chos skyong gi bskul ma yin 'dra snyam pa zhig shar ba sang nyin snyan dar gyi kha yig rnams gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi phaṭa bris pa'i dar thog tu phab/ (74ba)spyan gzigs tsho skyel ba dang sbrags mchod dpon pa snga 'gros rgyal du 'gro dgos pa'i hung rgya bskur ba'i grabs yul brtsams pa nas bzung 'gro 'dug la mngon pa'i bde skyid che ba zhig byung bar dpags na srung ma'i 'bren char mngon/ ma nas lo sngon ma'i nang sog phrag gi steng du nad zug lag mthil rgya tsam pa 'pho len dang yod med sna tshogs byed pa zhig byung ba dpon tshang byang ngos nas dang slob ma lhag dar gnyis la yang yang bstan rung rlung 'dra bas byug pa byugs zer ba'i dbugs dbyung tsam las ma byung / de skabs khrag ngan gsog gin yod tshod nas lag par gtar kha cig byas na chu bo wa kha bsgyur ba ltar da lam nad 'di ldang rigs min 'dra na'ang bod re bas 'phung ba chos nyid do/ /cha gan tha yan chi'i dbang phyug dge slong gis bskul ba dang mtshan sgrog mkhan po ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi ngor yun du 'tsho ba'i smon lam bris/ tshogs gsog tu rdzong gzhis brgyad bsdoms par 'bum brgya gnyis/ dri med bshags rgyud stong rtsa/ mtshan brjod lnga 'bum/ gdugs dkar bdun 'bum/ byams smon sher snying yig brgya gsum 'bum ther re/ tshe chog dgu /gra tshang du tha' na rje'i sngagasaring dang 'khor lo 'bar ba so sor
