bye ba dang skong bshags nyin bdun/ dga'i ldan du ja tshul bcu/bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu bla mkhar gsum du nyin lnga'i ring mchod pa sna lnga brgya rtsa/ gser chab/ snyan shal 'dod gsol gyi tshigs bcad dang bcas pa/ gdugs dkar mdos chen gsum/ khro rol bzhi/ 'char ga'i (75na)mdos gcig /tshe bdag /khro chu/ gshed dmar gyi gtor bzlog re/mgon po g.yul bzlog bzhi/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhi brgya/ btson dong thar bcu/ phyugs lug brgya dang nya 'bum gyi srog blu/ yer par dkar me dang nag me so sor brgya re/ dar lcog bcu gsum/ ser 'bras dge gsum/ rgyal ri mthil dang bcas pa'i mgon khang tshor gra pa sum cus bkang bshags bdun phrag re btang ba'i mjug tu gtor rgyag /dpal lha dang gnas lung lcog tu bkang gso stong rtsa —104—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)byas pas khams kyang zhag skyed nyin skyed du bde/ 'di lo nad yun rings pa la brten dpal ldan 'bras sprungs spyi sger khyon bsdus kyis zhag grangs mang por mang ja'i thog rgyal ba'i bka' gsung sgrog dang dbyibs 'dra'i rim gro se ra theg chen gling dang pha bong la sogs nas kyang mdzad/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bzhi lnga skor la rgya nag gi mi sna'i 'grul sdebs dmangs dang khal kha'i dpon mo chos rje rnams la rdzong ba gzhis len rgyas par byas shing ngos phrad ma thub/ lha sa/ ra mo che/ po ta la gsum la mchod pa sna lnga brgya rtsa/ zhal gser spyan 'byed 'dod don gsol ba'i smon lam brisapa'i snyan dar phul/ gra tshang du gshin rje 'dus pa'i sngags ring bzlog bcas dang 'khor lo 'bar ba sosor bye ba re/ khyab 'jug gi mdos nag /dri za'i rgyal por rten rdzas spyan gzigs mchode gtor gya nom pa 'phrin las 'chol ba'i snyan dar tshigs bcad ma dang bcas nyin bdun gyi ring bkang ba'i tshe kha 'tshub 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa'i rten 'brel (75ba)gyi mtshan ma legs par byung / mgon po yel deng gi tsha bo blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis pha ma gnyis kyi 'dod don 'grub pa'i smon lam bskul ba bris/ mchod dpon pa'i 'char ston byung ba blor babs pa'i stag ru bas gra sgrig byas te dbus khul chu lho byang nas dgon dmigs bsal lnga bcu nga brgyad la zhag bco lnga'i phogs rtsam ja thug rkyen theg /rgyar yon spom sprod dang bsngo rten rnam gzhag sgo sor sprad pa'i tshe mdo tshe gzungs/ tshe sgrubs/ smon lam/bshags pa/ bzlog pa/ gsung sgrog dgon babs dang bstun pa byas/ chu bo ri nas khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po phebs/ zhag bcu skor bzhugs bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i dbang dang lha 'dre stong dra'i lung sogasachos bka' 'ga' zhig zhus/ chu bo ri'i gnas srung rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin bkod/hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum nas mjug gcod du gter sgrom gyi chu tshan zhag bdun gyi bar bsten/ rtsegadong zhabs drung khri chen dgongs pa chos dbyings su bshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debasakyi rten 'byor zhing gdung 'bul gos phyi nang kha shas dngul mdong / tha phag /rta gser sgas gces—105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)pa'i dgu tshan bcu 'bul bar dar rtse mdo sa dkar mgo ba btang / 'di lo nyin kha shas lung pa thams cad khug rnas khengs pa'i nyi zla'i 'od mi gsal ba sogs la mi dmangs rnams rnam rtog chen po byed tshul stag ru ba dang chang khyim pa gnyis kyis glengs byung ba rtse gdong khri chen gzhan don du dgongs par lta bar snang /gong (76na skos rgyal por gnang ba'i bka' shog rgyal po gsar rnying gi mtshams su song bas sprod ma thub pa rgyal sa ma 'khod bar nged la 'chol rgyu bka' shog gnang ches pas ngos su ma phul bar brgyud na nged rnams khrims la thogs nyen yod ces 'jigs skrag gi bsgugs yod pa tshes nyi shu'i nyin mtshams khog tu phrad de rtsis blangs/ gong du zhu yig dang 'bul skyel/ rgya sog gzhung gi mjug sdom gyi snyan 'bul zhu bar thang sag slob dpon blo bzang 'jam dbyangs dang rgyus yod kyi stabs khang gsar rab brtan slar bskyar te btang / mnga' ris gra tshang slob dpon gra bcas kyis tshe spel ba'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba bris/tshes bcu nas mtshams grol ba'i rtses dang las chen byams pa rgya mtshos khong rang gis brtsams pa'i tshigs bcad brtan zhing gos dar gyi bdog pa/ nyin phyi ma rnams rim bzhin thang gling bla ma grags bcas/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi gra slob phyed sum brgya/ dga' ldan khri rin po che gdan zur/ rtse shar gyis thog drangs pa'i dge 'dun brgya skor/ rtser theg chen gling gra slob phyed sum brgya/ mnga' risagra tshang dpon slob rags bsdus/ chos 'khor lha sa ru bzhi rnams kyis zang zing gi bdog pa spel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ thar gling par yun 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsar pa'i lung bklags/thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dus bsam yas mdo sde'i thog gsol mchod gnang srol yod 'dug pa bar du chag pa 'di lo nas gos phyi nang gser skyems kyis (76ba)gtsos pa'i spyan gzigs/tshogs chas 'bul ba'i 'go btsugs te chos rgyal dpon blon so sor 'phrin 'chol gyi yi ge dang bcas pa rgya phrug pa dbang 'dus btang / de mo sprul sku'i dgongs rdzogs su dbon pos dge slong 'phags pa —/06

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)nor bu can mngags pa'i gser dngul ja/ gos dar gyi ster cha gya nom pa/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa/ri bo bde chen gyi gnyer pa/ brag la gdan sa snang dkar ba/ lcang ra nas ming sring sde pa phon mdo ba/nā landa bco brgyad pa thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku bla ma zhang ston pa mched/ chos rje chu mig pa/ chos rje dung dgon pa/ ratna sa skyong gnyis kyi mi bzang kha shas rnams dang phrad/ smar khams go bo dbon bo dang dar rtse mdo pa lcags la spun gyis ster cha bzabs/ rgya sbugs legs pa zhig byung ba gra tshang du sprad/gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gser chos glegs shing rtsi ma sku rags gdong dar gril tshas khom shubs cha 'grig po ti brgya dang gsum/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum skya chos glegs shing glegs thag cha tshang po ti zhe gnyis rnams kyang gsung rten du sbyar/tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin bsnyen rdzogs zhe dgu dang dge tshul lnga bcu skor bsgrubs/ bi ri dge rgyasadapon/ rab 'byams pa lung rigs/ rab stims pa tshogs 'phel/ dka' bcu blo bzang tshe ring /gong dkar chos sde nas po ta la'i tshe chog gi bzhi sde ba brje mkhan gzhi byes/ nyang re sku skye/ semasadapa' chen po'i sprul sku rnams ja gral btang / chos 'khor rgyal gnas dben pas 'dod yon kyang de dang mtshungs gshis (77na)mchod dpon pas ja tshul gyi thebs shig tshugs na legs zer bar 'bru thog nas nyo cha byed dgos byung na shogs che ba zhig dka' 'dug pas mdor rgya 'grul gtong ba'i tshong zog gi dngul/ snam bu/ 'og khal gra bsgrigs de ga'i lag g.yog dang mthun rkyen du gra phyi thar gling nas them 'dzin brgyad/ lag yong lnga brgya/ ri bo chos gling par mchod gzhis cho de grub kyang gang gi gser yig pa yar klungs em chis zhu rten bzang bas zhus ngor thob rgyal chu skor rkang gcig gi lag 'bab nyis brgya brgyad cu/ pho brang nas 'byu khal sum brgya'i gshor 'debs dang bcas pa/ gong dkar chos sde bar gtsang dus phan sgrub mchod sogs kyi gtong cha nar ma yin 'dug par lcags sprul bde gzar nas bzung gtong cha'i tshab la rgyal grub gling sa 'byed gnang ba lo gnyis gsum nas zhu log sna tshogs la brten bzhes pa'i lo skor lhag tsam gyi bar tshul sgrub mchod kyi phyag len rnams brjed —107

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)byang tsam dang dgon pa'ang nyams chag shin tu che bar gyur pa sa phag kha rag sgrub sde pa'i mchod gzhis dang snye mo nas sa hphu byas rung thag ring zhing 'jig rten gyi 'byer kha zhan pa'i zos po zhig med 'dug pas tshun blangs chu shur lha yul gzhis ka /them bzhi bcu zhe drug /lag yong nyis stong phyed sum brgya/khyab bdag zha lu ba chen pos nyi ma gling pa tshul khrims bkra shis kyi dus ja'i thebs rgyun 'jags dgos tshul gyis zhu rten dang bcas phebs byung ba rgyal grub gling shas rnying thog nas 'bru khal nyi shu skor/gter ston rigs (77ba 'dzin chen pos gra tshang gsar 'dzugs mdzad bzhed kyi mthun rkyen dgos tshul gyi zhu rten lha lcam manda ra ba'i thugs dam rten gyi phag mo'i li sku o rgyan chen pos chos rgyal la gnang ba snying mdzod nas mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis bton te 'bri gung zur par gnang / des yol mo ba nam mkha' brgya byin/ des mdo sngags bstan 'dzin la brgyud pa/ gter ston ratna gling pa'i zhal go bde chen gling pas sna tshogs rang grol phul ba/ sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbu thod chos rgyal pho brang pas mdo sngags bstan 'dzin la phul ba'i nang du khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyi phyag bris ma'i tshe mchog gi sku brnyan yod pa padma gling pa'i gter byon gyi gnam lcags rdo rje bcas byung bar bzang yul grong gsar dang spang 'dabs gzhis ka /them 'dzin bcu skor/ lag yong chog stong brgya lhag /rdo rje brag a waṃ lcog sgar par dol nas gshor 'debs byed rgyun la sa brjes dgos tshul dang bcas sprul pa'i skus mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen pos spyan drangs pa'i 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi gter snod dang chos dbang rin po che'i slob ma bdun gyi nang tshan e ma zhes nam snying gi sprul par lung gis zin pa de'i dbu thod mkhar chu'i tshogs khang gi mchod rten bum par sbas pa'i chos rgyal dbang po'i sde spyan drangs pa'i nang du yang dag gi sku dang rgyab tu e ma'i sku/ dkar chag gi yi ge dang bcas 'dri ba gnang ba'i rigs 'dzin yab sras kyi thugs gtsigs ma'i zhu rten byung zhing rim grar thugs khur che zhing rigs 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi rgyun la bsam sa snon dang (78na skyogs snye mo ka sdod dang zhur lhag gi gzhis ka /them 'dzin sum cu skor/ lag yong tshig stong brgyad brgya/ bde chen —108

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha) chos 'khor nas sprul pa'i skus lags lags rin cen gyi don du gad kha sa dang 'brel brgyud yod med kyi mtshams la gong dkar chos sde'i mgon khang du dbu rtsi mdzad pa khungs rdol gyi chad par rgyal sa sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos bzhes song bar zhu re'i spros pa mi 'dug rung ro dur khrod nas log re'i sun gtser gyi rgyur 'dug pa dang dga' ldan gsang sngags gling sngar phan nar ma yin rung mchod gzhis sbyar ba 'jags che bar bsam zhib cha'i rtsis grub ma btang bar 'di tsam gyis mi 'gro 'dug rung snga 'gros su rgyal sa dang khol ma bsdoms par them nyer lnga/ lag yong stong phrag phyed gnyis/spyan g.yas pa lcags sprul lo byas sdus che ba byed 'dug kyang sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi dus mchod gzhis gnang ba le lag ma 'dril ba rnams zhu re byung ba bzhin yar stod byang sribs gro mo ba khungs kyi gzhung sgrub byed dgos rnams zla 'dril gyi lag 'bab sum brgya skor/ g.ya' bzang lha mgon gyi mchod khang du dkar me sdong rkang gcig gi thebs su yar stod phu'i shas zhing steng nas khal bdun cu/ 'bru la bar zho kha khul gyong la gtogos pa'i them 'dzin bcu bdun/ lag yong brgya skor/ka tshal bla ma rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub la sku rim sgrub rten du mas dro chu bzang gi zhol khang gzhis ka /them chung lnga/ lag yong phyed sum brgya/ nā la nā bco brgyad pa sngar nas dga' ldan pho brang dang (78ba)thugs 'brel chags pa'i sku mdun rin po ches gang legs mdzad pa'i phyag tham yang 'dug cing skyid sho tha'i jis mkhar rtse 'dzin skabs sa cha shor 'dug pa dang bcas za dam mkhul sna mo jo gdan pa'i dgon bla brang gra shag dang sku gsung thugs rten/ mchod rdzas thor bu/ gzhi ba bcu gnyis kyis kun rig dang sman bla gtong ba'i thebs phran bu 'dug pa dang bcas bsdoms par lag 'bab phyed bdun brgya mo bran them 'dzin bco lnga dang nyis 'dzin them drug /bra yag tre bo gnyis kyis zhu rten bton pa'i 'bras spungs blo gsal gling par rkyang mo gzhis ka them 'dzin bcu gnyis/ lag yong dgu brgya/ gra ri bo rnam rgyal bar gra nang lhun rab pa dang dgon chung ra ma steng / lag yong brgyad cu tham pa/ snye chu lu bu gnyis rdzong kha ba'i rtsa ba lta bu yin kyang bar skabs su bla ma dge lugs dang —109

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)rnying ma ba 'dra bskos pa'i rang tshugs zhig 'dug pa thub pa'i rjes su 'jug nges kyi bstan pa yin phyin ma nyams pa legs par mthong bas mkhan byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang bsko bzhag byas nas sgye chur gra pa drug cu skor gyis padma yang gsang dang tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sgrub mchod gtong ba'i thebasasu 'chos ma lha khang gi gas ka /them bdun/ lag yong bdun brgyar nye ba/ rta nag thub bstan pa khams mnga' ris zlos pa'i rkyen gyis mnga' ris pa'i ban rtsa 'dra la brten sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtshor g.yo zhug kyis bra'u shug bzhes pa phyir slog par them bdun/ lag yong phyed lnga brgya/ ri bo bkra bzang 'di slob dpon chen po'i gnas chen stod phyogs kyi (79na)sa'i me btsa' lta bu yin kyang gtsang dus byang pa'i 'phul phyogs kyis shor god byung ba'i gshis chos rje bkra bzang bar gnas 'dzin chos pa'i thebs dang gra slob nyi shu skor gyis lo star 'chi med 'od snang gi cho ga gtor thebs bsdoms par bra ma lung gas ka /them bzhi/ lag yong bdun brgyar nye ba/ sog po tshe ring skyabs spun gnyis gzhud du re bltos byas nas rgyun ring zhing lta grub sogs gang sa nas skyongs 'os su snang gshis shangs dgra 'dul bas gzung shul gzhis lags/ glang chen dang 'i bcas pa gzhis ka /them bcu bdun/ lag yong stong rwa can skor/ ngam ru ba mgon po tshe 'phel grub mtha' gtsang zhing bsam pa che ba nas gzhis rtse sgom gnas pas bzung shul rdo spe byang gzhis ka /rtsa phu bas 'dzin shul rdza lung btsan gnyisaka/them so bdun/ lag yong stong phrag gnyis/ sman grong spel ba rtsis sogs la 'jug pas grang chen rnying khungs sna ru gzhis ka dang dbye gzhis ka /them 'dzin brgyad/ lag yong bdun brgya skor/ khyab bdag sman lung nas kyi gsung nan ches pa dang bcas rin spungs dkyil khang par 'breng khung khyung rtse gzhis ka /them chung / lag yong stong phrag skor/ lcog sbug pa tshe brtan rdo rjer rgyal rtse lcang lo can/'dzal gro chung bcas pa gzhis ma lag /them 'dzin bzhi/ lag yong stong brgyad brgya/ rgyal rtse yig mkhan tshe dbang rtsis la 'jug che bas sa tshab sa snon dang bcas par rtse chen grang chen la gtogs pa'i bud stongs rkang gsum gyi khang / them 'dzin lnga/ lag yong lnga (79ba)brgya/ shab khrom sa ba grub —//0

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)mtha' gtsang ba dang bcas sa snon du gnyis rtse khul rung ma gzhis ka /them drug /lag yong bzhi brgya skor/ gso ba rig pa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi spyi bor dam par 'dug pa'i phan yon la bsam sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi dus nas gzhis rtser phogs brgyab pa'i 'chad nyan 'dzugs dgos tshul mol ba ltar da lta'i bar du tshugs bzhin pa rgyud bzhi gtsang 'dril gyi rgyugs sprod pa'ang lo phal cher la byung ba dang bcas dpon tshang tsha rong par 'tsho byed kyi skyong thebs su lhun po rtse nas them bzhi/ phu gsum shas 'khyar dang bcas pa lag yong nyas brgya skor/ lha rtse lhug pa blo bzang shes rab kyis rten bzhengs kyi do dam khur che ba byung nas spel chung them 'dzin bzhi/ lag yong lnga brgya skor/ rag nas pha bu lag g.yog tu 'gyur bas sa brjes snon ma dang bcas par bya 'dab gzhis ka /them bcu gsum/lag yong stong rwa can la nye ba/ zhang tsha dkon cog rnam rgyal la snga sor byin pa'i snon mar thar gling khungs btsan mkhar ba them gcig /lag yong phyed sum brgya/ gos bzo shug ra bco lngar bzang sne ngos kyi khang zhing / lag yong sum brgyar nye ba/ 'ol dga' 'bring lung pa sngar nas sbyin bdag rkang ma'i lugs dang phag ri sogs sne mor khur bsam che ba byung bar dar rgyas rab brtan gyi gla tshal tshab dang sa snon sbrags par sgom bu bas bzung shul zil gnon dpal 'byor/ them 'dzin bcu/ lag yong byed drug brgya/ 'ol dga' gdan ru nas them bzhi/ lag yong brgya/ bsam yas nas chos skyong chen (80na)pos stag rtse tha'i jis mchod khang gi zhabs tog che ba byung ba'i mtshar khar ster cha'i ming btags shig dgos gsung bar brag shar stod kyi gzhis ka /them bdun/ lag yong drug brgya/ na bza' gling pa'i lho brag gi zhing 'khyar gyi tshab dang rgyud 'bum sbyin byung bar 'phyong rgyas don mkhar a jo khungs sa rkang gcig dang bzhi zur gcig /lag yong nyis brgya skor/ rnam sras tshal pa nor bu la phreng sbyar chen 'og gi gzhis ka /them gsum/ lag yong sum brgya/ rgya phrug par rtses dang zur bar gyi khang pa/ brgya lhag /spyil grong bcas pa'i shas lag 'debs bzhi brgya skor/ drung yig dar rgyas bkra shis grub mtha' gtsang ba dang gsang sgo nas bzung las gar 'jug che bas lcags grong gzhis ka /—111—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)them bcu bzhi/ lag yong phyed bdun brgya/ gnas gsar bar sa snon du thar gling khungs gnam rab tu yod pa'i them gnyis/ rgya ri dpon blon dang nyis 'dzin them gsum/ lag yong phyed bzhi brgya/ 'phan po tshong 'dus khang gsar ba sgar pa'i dus nas lta grub kha phyogs ma log pa dang bcas sne mo gzhis ka khungs them gnyis/ lag yong drug cu/ 'phyongs rgyas a bsam rgya bod kyi yig rigs dang rtsis sogasakyi 'jug che bar brten 'phags sde khungs gro chen them bzhi/ lag yong bzhi brgya/ gra phug pa bar gra nang gyang khang khungs g.yog rkang gcig /rgyal gling tshogs dang nyis 'dzin lhun po sgang pa bcas them gnyis/ lag yong dgu bcu tham pa/ grong smad nye skor du g.yog ris dud chen nyung ba 'dug pas nyang bran na (80ba)ga can gong 'og sgang mgo ba dang bcas pa'i them gsum/ lag yong nyis brgya/ cha dkar chos mdzad sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho gshegs gdong gi bsnyun g.yog rkang ma yin gshis gdam nga btang bar thag ring gi rgya che ba las thag nyer 'dam 'dug gshis them rkang gnyis/ lag yong lnga bcu skor/ dpon nyag rgyal nas bzung rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag gi gras su 'dug pa dang nang rten gyi rin mi chen zhal dro lag tu ma lon shigs shun gzhis ka bar chu shur kho ma khungs them gnyis/ bud stongs gnyis/ lag yong brgya skor/ yig mkhan gra nang bsod nams lhun grub la them gnyis/ bogs chag dang shas zhing 'khyar bcas pa'i lag 'bab phyed nyis brgya/ gong dkar dkar brag par dpal gzhongs pas bzung shul gyi gzhis ka /spyil bu/ g.yog bcas kyi bdag thob rnams sbyor 'jagasabyas/ stag lung dpal mgon gyis gtsos ri mo ba grangs bcad kyis 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chosa'aphel yan gyi lam rim bla brgyud ha tshon ma gra tshar zhig bzhengs/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis la mchod dpon dbu mdzad kyis gser dngul/ ja/ gos dar/sgam/ rta sga ma sogs brgya 'bul tshogs 'khor dang bcas gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog btang / de nyin mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs dang tsho gis gsog tu dmigs nas gser zho stong phrag skor gyi thebs phul bas gzhi byas g.yo ru khra 'brug gyi rgya phibs —/12

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)gsar bzhengs la lho byang gi dkyus rgyug mtho brgyad cu/ shar nub la zhe gsum dpangs la (81na)nyer lnga/ ltar rgyab la zhe brgyad/ zur chen bzhi'i dag lang gi sner chu srin/ ltar rgyab kyi gdong sne phan tshun du nor bu dbang rgyal/ dkyil du gañdzi ra dang bcas pa'i rgyur gad bdar phyis gsum grub pa'i zangs mkhar khal dgu brgya bco lnga/ gser btso ma zho drug stong dgu brgya don bdun/ gser 'dam la dngul chu zho nyis stong dgu brgya so gnyis/ gser gsol sna khrid mo re'i bsres bcas par dngul chu khal bcu gsum/ star bu khal nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dmar tshos khal nyi shu rtsa gcig /lcags thag rlung dril bzhi bcu zhe gnyis rnams/ yum bu bla mkhar 'di bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa'i gnas kyi thog mar song bas sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos thugs khur bzhes do dam ge ra ba dang res ma ba gnyis kyis byas pa'i shing 'brug zhig gsos grub par 'di lo rgya phibs gru bzhi phyogs re'i dkyus la rgyug mtho phyed bcu dgu /dpangs la bcu gcig /zur bzhi dang dbus su nor bu tog gzugs rnams kyi rgyur gad bdar grub pa'i zangs khal go gsum/ gser btso ma zho dgu brgya dang bzhi/ dngul chu zho nyisastong dgu brgya bcu gnyis/ sna khrid kyi dngul chu nyag bcu bzhi/ star bu nyag dgu/ btsod nyag bstogacig rnams song ba'i gong gsal gnyis kyi zangs bzo'i do dam 'dar gzhen/ gra dpon/ shing bzo'i do dam a dar/ lhun grub gling pa snyag grong smyon pa/ gser gsol ba nang so dkon dar ba/ rtse chen nas/ nang so dgos dgos/ spangs che nas/ bal po a ma ra sidha/ zangs (81ba)mkhar snam sras lhas byin/ dngos grub gsum gyis gtsos pa'i sum cu so bdun/ shing bzo dga' sbug pa dang lam rnyed can sum cu skor gyi phogs yon ston mo sogs 'bru thog tu dril bar mkhar khal chig khri rig stong sum brgya song / rab gnas la rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che dpon slob kyis phebs pa'i rgyas par mdzad/skyid shod dga' gdong chos skyong gis gsol mchod bskul ba brtsams/ khyab bdag zha lu pa gzhan snang du bstan pa'i tshul mdzad par brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad de dang 'brel ba'i rten bcas phul/ mtshur phu drung pa'i phyag mdzod mdo mkhar ba 'das pa'i tshab bsko dgos tshul smed par phyag —113—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)mdzod las bla ma gal che bas drung pa'i sprul sku stod smad gong du 'dug kyang rtsad bcad pa 'gab /lam yig sogs mthun rkyen dgos na yod byas kyang rna thos dang khungs chod ye ma byung zhes rtsol ba mi byed snang ba dad mos med pa e yin mi shes rung la la'i brjod rigs la ljang zhabs su da rma par sras 'ga' zhig yod 'dug pa'i gcig la drung pa'i sku skyer sgro btags pa thos pa'i re ba yin na zer/gang ltar 'dod sbyar bzhin pho brang dgon stod pa can gnyis las snar bskos/ yar 'brog 'dzam gling chos 'khor ba'i gra pa gnyis kyis brtag pa gnyis pa dang dus 'khor bsdus rgyud gnyis kyi rgyugs sprad/zla ba drug pa'i ring phyi mtshams khog nas brel ba bcad pa'i bdun pa'i tshes bdun la rgyud stod pa dpon slob/ gsal khang dgon pa'i bla spyi/ ra ba stod pa'i bla gnyer/ stag rtse tha'i ji (82na)yab sras/ yol gdong legs ldan/ khon jin bla ma'i bsngo zhug pa/ no mon e rjen gyi bsam gtan can phrad mi shin tu mang / kong po rnying phu ba'i sku skye dang gdung brgyud spun gnyis kong phyogs su spyi sgos kyi rim gro bgyid pa'i 'os su byung ba rdo rje brag tu bka' gter gyi chos zhu bar btang ba thob rgya dga' mo byung 'dug cing de bar gyi mthun rkyen mchad dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis sbyor du bas /spos khang mkhan po zur pa 'bum ram pa rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing khams su gshegs pa'i bsngo rten du glang bu nas kyis do dam byas pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i zhal thang mkhyen ris dngos gtsang ba zhig byung ba mus chen sems dpa' chen po man kha'u brag rdzong pa'i brgyud rim gong dkar chos sde'i dbu mdzad gsang sngags mkhar pa can gyis bris te bsabs/ rin po che rnying ri ba bde ba bzang po padma 'od kyi zhing khams su gshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor zhing dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pas mchod/ dgongs rdzogs mthun rkyen gyi phan pa bsgrubs/ grong smad kyi nang so dgos pa bkra shis byas pa che zhing sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dbyar tsha ba dang dgun grang ba'i dbye ba med pa'i gzhogs su stod rtag cing khur bsam che ba dang lhag tu sangs rgyam pa 'di chung ngu nas sri'u'i tshul gyis gsos shing srung mar gnyer bcol byas pa zhig yin pas sa ris mtha' dag 'dzin bde'i —//4

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)yang btsan/ dar khan gyi tham ka byin/ 'tshub chags shig 'dug pa'i rten 'brel bcos su skor cig po ta la dang sger gzhis su ma (82ba)bsdad pa'i chu bzang mchod khang du sdod nas kyi bslab ston byas/hor zla brgyad pa snga ma'i tshes gnyis la kong po dpon khag /sgye chu mkhan po/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po/skyer lung mkhan po rnams dang phrad/tshes lnga'i nyin blo gsal gling pa'i rigs gra'i skal ba skyel bar slob dpon dge 'dun grags pa gra bcas 'byor/ lding dpon dpal yags can dang lhan du mnga' ris bde ldan gyi mi drag khul no no rgyal zer ba btang byung rung 'brug pas snum ma thon pa sogs nyes pa rnams la ngos blangs 'gyod sdom/ mnga' ris kyi dge lugs tshor bdag rkyen 'di tsam zhig byed zer ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yang med par snum ma longs pa'i chad las kyi rgyu dngos shor ba rnams phyir gtod dgos zer ba'i rgyal khrims rna bas ma thos pa 'dra ba'i gtam btang 'dug pa de 'dra'i rigs la go ba bskon pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po labs kyang bser ma bskyed pa las mi snang bas lan spam pa zhig las ma btang / lding dpon can gyi sa rim kyang dge lugs kyi mchod gzhis rnams la bkal zhing rta drel tsho de mtshungs kyi gso bcug 'dug pa rang gis btsugs pa'i zam pa la rang 'gro ba chos nyid yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra byas nas phyir slog 'brug pa sprul sku rin po che phebs te sa rta'i bde gzar skabs 'bras spungs dngul gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi sgo rgyan nas thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhun thigs kyi tshe dpag med dang rgod tshang pa'i gdung phag mo'i sku rang byon gser khang pas bkog pa se ra la dmag phog skabs brgyad (83na〉stong gser chos lā ñtsa ma rgya rgan pa gdan drangs pa gsum khong dpon slob la phul 'dug pas thog drangs gos dar dngul shel spyad kyi ster sbyin mang du gnang / dpon slob nyung bsdus kyis mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i lugs kyi brtan bzhugs kyi zhal 'don mdzad pa sprul pa'i sku dang phyag mdzod mchog ster sku mched gsum gsung snyan zhing 'dren bde ba zhig 'dug /phar yang de mtshungs kyi skyes lan bzabs/ thegs gdong lo chen thugs rje dpal —/15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gyis mdzad pa'i tsand+ra pa'i 'grel chen ster ba mdzad nas de'i dpe dbang dgos phebs pa bla ma dgongs 'dus sogs rnying ma 'ga' zhig la 'phrin las dbang chog dang 'brel ba'i dpe dbang bshad ched du 'dug cing snga 'gyur la chos gang yin pa de'i dbang lung bla ma gzhan la thob na byin rlabs kyi rgyun la phan re'i brgyud pa mi gcig pa'i bla ma zhig gis thog mtha' bar gsum bklags glegs bam mgo la bzhag nas smon lam mdzad des chos rgyun gyi go tshad ldan ni mi chod/ de min dpe cha'i dbang bskur gsang sngags gsar rnying gang gi lugs la'ang ma mthong / lhag tu sgra snyan ngag la dbang yong don mi 'dug rung phyi skor bka' brgyud pa rnams thog mtha' bar gsum bklags pas lung tshad ldan gyi go gcod/ de las kyang dogs bde ba kong po gter ston dang sgam po zhabs drung gnyis kyis thob yig gi lung mdzad pas de'i nang du yod pa'i dbang lung thams cad dang dpe khang nang du phyin nas smon lam btab pas der yod tshad kyis chos rgyun thob pa/ dpon slob (83ba)mjal res med kyang dgongs pa bstad pa'i chos sogs gu yangs po zhig 'dug pa'i gras ni yin shas che/ 'on kyang sprul sku ni rin po che phebs nan ches pa'i dgongs khrid la dbu thog tu tsand+ra pa'i 'grel pa bzhag nas smon lam tshigs bcad cig btan/ sdom pa der bas ma dang chu gtor ma'i dpe bzhin 'bras spungs sprul sku nas brgyud pa'i tsand+ra pa'i dbang yod zer ba zhig mi yong la che/ tshogs gsog pa rgyal mtshan dang rin cen rgyal mtshan 'a 'ganyas kya kha ton tu smon lam/ tha shi sbo lod kyas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ thon legs ldan dbang po dge rnying gnyis su phar 'gyur tshur 'gyur kha yar mdzad pa'i rnying dus kyi drag po rtsal gyi thang kha'i rgyab yig dgos tshul byung ba rnams bris/ bla ma lha pa ma chen lha min gyi sa chu ma 'phrod par gshegs pa'i bsngo rten 'byor zhing dgongs rdzogs kyi mthun rkyen spel/ gling smad chos rje/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po/ brag dbar slob dpon can la ja gral btang /tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'dus tshogs rnams sger nas bsdus pa'i bdog pa dang bcas 'chi med 'od snang gi sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i —1/6

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadarten 'brel bsgrigs/ de thog mtshan sgrog mkhan po ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis gos dar ras cha/mchod dpon ni dbu mdzad gnyis kyis hor gos bum gdan ma dang theg chen gan dril kha shas/ gosadar gser dngul ja rnams kyi bdog pa bstar/ mchod dpon pa gtor ma dang phyag len gyi rigs la shin tu rung bar yod pas nam lcogs bar las 'dzin (84na)gyi mu 'thud/ de nas gos su bcar sdod dam mkhan po lta bu zhig byas na khong rang la khebs che bar ma zad mig ltos la phan pa yong zhing dpon po 'di gtso bor sdig pa la 'bags dgos pa'i drin chung dang gra rkyang byed mur sde dpon gyi bya gzhag kyang shogs chen dka' bas de 'dra'i 'dun pa med kyang lo snga ma tshor 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa/ dar khan dka' bcu/ spyi gnyer ngag dbang smon lam can la'ang gleng mi kha yar byung 'dug cing stag lung phyag mdzod dang stag ru ba gtso bor gyur pa'i shas cher mchod dpon pa rang 'os tshul lab mi mang ba'i stabs zla ba bdun pa'i nang du bsod nams dbang rgyal mtsho khar btang ba'i gtso bor rgyal po bsgo bzhag gang byed la thag gcod kyi gos dang sde pa'i gnas tshul zhar byung du mol/'di nyin gza' skar 'jam thog khur lan byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan lab par zhang tsha dkon cog rnam rgyal btang bar dgongs pa nan bskyed tsam zhus byung rung khrol cha ma bde/ stag ru ba nor bu lus bsgyur ba'i ming blo bzang dngos grub tu btags/tshes bco brgyad nas bzung zhag bdun gyi bar zhogs star gyis gra tshang gis mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bsu bzlog tshigs bcad ma'i zhal 'don mdzad/ o rod g.yon ru dkon cog tshe ring gi kha ton du 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs shig bris/ nyer dgu la bkra shis/ ratna/ sa skyong / phun tshogs can dpon khag 'byor ba dang phrad/ sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dus zhal dkar ba rnams chu babs su bzhag pa phal cher gyis phul (84ba)ba gzhir bcas kyang rgya ches pa'i re gnyis srubs dbar lus pa'ang byung mdog kha bas da lam zla ba phyed gnyis su tshang ma 'dril rtsis kyis brda 'grems sngun chug tu byas/rig byed smra ba thar pa nang so gzi brjid snying pos zhib mor brtsis te zla ba brgyad pa rting ma'i tshes—117

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gcig gi gza' phur bu skar ma me bzhi'i 'phrod dge ba'i nam seng la tshoms chen du mchod dpon pas tshe dpag med kyi sku rgya nag ma/ gos dar dang rta mang rags/ ja ras kyi bdog pa bstar/ de nas khrir 'byor thog tham kha che chung / dar zab kyi sgrom bu/ lde mig rnams sprad/ zhal dkar ba'i thog ma ming bkra'i khyad kyis stag rtse'i sde pa lha rgyal rab brtan gyis mdzad/ de nas sog po'i dpon khag tu gnyug mar gnas pa dang thar pa sogs gsar 'byor/ tshal/ bde chen/ ser 'bras/ bkra shis lhun po/rnying khungs sne shun skya ser gyis bdog pa rgyas par bstar/ 'dzum lang / yam bu/ mnga' ris pa'i mi sna 'ongs pa rnams kyang zhan byung du bzhugs gral la bsgrigs/ 'di nyin nas bzung khri 'don ma grub bar gyi 'phros gtam pa 'dar pa lo chen/ glang bu ba 'gyur med/ sab grub pa bsam grub rgyal po rnams kyis byas/ nyi ma kha shas kyi bar lha sa ba'i rgyal srid sna bdun gyis sna drangs/ gtsang po bro ba/dan 'bag /nyang dogs/ sde bzhi/ sne shun sogs yul gru mang po'i bro gzhas/ tshal gung / snye thang bkra shis sgang / rmi ru ba/ lha sa'i tshes bcu bas mtshone pa'i gar 'cham mang du phul/ mchod dpon gyi las 'dzin du rgyal dar gong pa bshes (85na)gnyen dar rgyas bskos/ sde pas dpal ldan lha mor tham phud phul ba'i zhal byang bris/tshes gnyis la stag rtse tha'i ji nas tshoms chen du bzhugs gral bshams thog da'i chin gyi sras thar pas brgya 'bul/ chab mdo phyag mdzod/ de mo ba dang bra yag pa'i mi sna/ lha ri bla ma rnamasakyis ja khrab/ rta dre'u sa gtsos pa'i yul lugs kyi dngos po bteg /tshes gsum la bde chen tha'i jis bzhugs gral dang bzhi la gzhung nas gzhis byes tshang mar gzhis len bzabs/ paṇḍita go klu la'i tshong pa li la mi shra/ a mdo ba kha shas/ rmi phu bla ma blo bzang dpal 'byor/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi gnyer pa/ sngags pa bla ma sgang chen pa/ ra ba smad bla ma/lhun rtse mkhan po/ tre bo sku skye rnams dang phrad/ tshes drug la dga' ldan rtse shar/ chos rje bco brgyad pa/ bkra shis ljongs chos rje/ sde pa phon mdo pa sogs dbu ru stod phyogs kyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyis—//8—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanakhri 'bul/ chos rje bco brgyad pas rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhun thigs las grub pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku zhig byin/ rdzing phyi mkhan byams pa rin cen/ stag lung phyag mdzod bzang sbyin can dang sger du phrad/ bkra shis ljongs chos rje dang bya yul mkhan po tre bo nam mkha' bsam grub gnyis kyis phyag 'bul dang byin rlabs ma zhus par brten gnas dbyung dang chad las sogs bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhig byung song ba rjes kyi mig ltos la phan pa'i bden 'brel dang mtshungs par go /tshes bdun gyi snga dro sde pa dang lhan du tshangs pa (85ba)dung thod can sku phebs zhus/ sku chas cha 'grig /go mtshon/ gos dar/ ja/ gser skyems/ rta sga bcas kyis gtsos pa'i mchod sprin spros/ blang dor gyi lung bstan pa rnams phal cher thog kho nar song / chos skyong gi phyag od zhal bar brdeg cing 'di'i 'og tu ca po zhig la 'dre gnas 'dug pa sdug 'dres e 'bud gsung ba dmu gab kyis bcings pa lta bus bskul ba ma shar rjes su byas tshe sne'u sdong bdag mo'i rten chas kyi snam bu kha shas yod 'dug pa 'dre de phud na gegs kyi 'tshe ba de bzlog rgyu yin pa 'dra/tshes brgyad la phan bde legs bshad gling pa spyi tshogs nas 'chi med 'od snang gi sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog gi rten 'brel bsgrigs shing tshoms chen du gung tshigs kyi bzhugs gral bod sog kun la bshams/ bkra shis lhun po'i mi sna tsha rong dge slong gis mdo rgyud sna tshogs la brten pa'i los gtam tshig don phun sum tshogs pa byas/ spyi sos ja gos dar/ dngul gyi tha phag gser gyis bkang ba/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis ja gos dar shas che ba'i dgu tshan dgu/ gra pa rgan gra dbon chos mdzad sogs drag gzhan dang bstun pa'i sger 'bul bzabs/ 'di nas bzung ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa rnams la sde pa dang lhan du yod pa shas che/ khri 'bul gyis mtshon pa'i brel ba ma byung ba'i srubs rnams la phyi mtshams ngos gter ston rigs 'dzin chen por lho brag mkhan chen gyi snyan brgyud glegs bam/ klong chen rab stims pa gsung rab/ rdor gling / ratna gling / pad —119

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gling (86na)sogs gter kha du ma'i dbang lung zhu ba'i 'go btsugs/ chu mig dgon gsar ba'i lag nas rigs 'dzin ratna gling pa'i gter ma'i rta mgrin gyi phur pa dang rdo rje gnyis sne'u sdong zhabs drung brgyud sde pas nang rten du sprad pa rta mgrin gsang 'dus kyi dbang zhu ba'i rten la dus 'grig /tshes bcu gnyis la kong po stod smad nyang po khul gyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyis zhal dkar bteg /sgar pa gra tshang / chab nag bla ma can dang sger du phrad / tshes bcu drug nas sde pa srin nad kyis glo bur du bsnyun par ser 'bras dge gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dgon khag rags rim la mang ja dngul 'gyed/ser 'bras ja tshul/ bskyas mdos dang gra tshang du sku rim kha yar btsugs/ tshe dpag med dang drag po'i dbang bskur/ byang ngos nas kyis gtsos drung 'tsho ba lhag dar rnams kyis 'phrod bsten la rtsol 'don gyis rim bder song / nyer gsum rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor thog mchod dpon pa sogs bsnyen rdzogs bcu bdun dang dge tshul bcu skor bsgrubs/tor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la sde pa gzhi med du gdangs pa'i lha bya gnyis kyis gtsos e dwags 'ol gsum/ 'bog mdong / gnyal pa/ yar klung shar nub mthil gsum rnams kyi lha sde mi sdes bdog pa'i skyes phul/ tshes gnyis la sde pa rgya ri ba/ gsum la zangs ri dpon sa/ bzhi la dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pas tshogs chas ster cha 'gyed sogs bzabs rgyas kyi sbyin bdag mdzad nas phan bde legs bshad gling pas rdul (86bto'i gyi dkyil 'khor du tshe chog rgyas par btang / gsang sngagasagling pas tshes bcu'i gar 'cham bstar/ khams ldan ma'i gsar 'grul/ a rig gi rta 'bul ba lha/bya/ 'bog /mdong / zangs ri dpon sa can dang sger du phrad/ a rig rnams kyis rta brgya skor bstar/tshes lnga gong dkar dkon gnyer gra tshang gis bdog pa spel te tshe'i rten 'brel dang lha sa 'breng rgyas shag pas gzhis len byas/ de nyin gral los pa'i dbar zhig dang thug pas nged rang gis dkon cog gsum gyi bkra shis dang bstan pa spyi bshad kyi 'phros gtam la brten nas sa stong bgags/tshes drug la rdo rje brag sprul sku/ sna dkar rtse zhabs drung ri bo brag pas thog drangs gong dkar lho brag /—120

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanayar 'brog /chu shur/ snyen thon gyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyis 'bul dpangs gzengs bstod/ sdings po che sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos rgyal srid sna bdun brtsams pa'i 'phros gtam 'jebs chags pa'i kun yid 'phrog par gyur pas khong gi gral 'gor grub mtha' nges med kyi bla ma bdun brgyad cig 'dug pa rnams kyi khengs pa'i ri bo la bsnyil lam snyam/ thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku/ smra bo lcog pa/ gnas gzhi ba/ sdings po che'i sprul sku/ chos 'khor yang rtse/ dga' ldan gsung rab gling /thod ri bshad sgrub gling gi bla gnyer/ zhabs drung ri bo brag pa/ o rgyan mtsho mo/ bde chen chos 'khor ba/ kong po dpon khag /sbyor ra sprul sku/ dkon gnyer dpon/ nyi lde'i sprul sku sogs dang sger phrad byas/ chos rje smra bo (87na)lcog pas nyang gis shel brag nas gdan drangs pa'i slob dpon chen po'i sku li ma/ sde pa'i khri 'don du o rgyan chen por za hor rgyal pos phul ba'i phyag mtshan rdo rje khams gsum zil gnon/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan la byin pa'i mon bum thang dge gnas brag nas mnga' bdag nyang gis gdan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu'i shog ser bcas rten 'gangs che ba 'ga' zhig 'byor/ rgya rig yab sras dang gzims shag lho pa la ba ri lugs kyi sgrol dkar dang zangs ri dpon sa/ bya pa yab sras/ lcang ra mgon tshe ba bcas par phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang phul/ rgya ri ba'i sras gnyis sku lus bsgyur chog sde pa nas khrol cha byung 'dug pas bgres pa'i mtshan ngag dbang phun tshogs dbang phyug dang gcung la dga' rab brtan dbang por gsol/ sbyor ra sprul sku 'jigs med grub pa dang dkon gnyer dpon ngag dbang kun bzang gis gtsos pa'i bsnyen rdzogs bco lnga/ lcang ra chos mdzad ma sogs dge tshul bcu drug bsgrubs/ gnas chen khag nyi shu bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar nyis brgya dang re gcig /'bum brgya gnyis/ phal chen brgya/ dri med bshags rgyud stong / mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar/ swā tstsha rnams chig 'bum re/sher snying bye ba/ sman bla chig khri bzhi stong / lha khang ming can bcu gsum la rgyal mtshan/ ri mgo brgya la dar lcog /gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags ring bye ba/ 'jigs byed drug cu pa/ phyag (87ba)—121—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)drug pa/ las gshin gyi bkang gso/ gur gyi dmar chen gtor bzlog /khro rol bzhi/ ma mdos bcu bzhi/ phyugs lug phyed nyis brgya dang nya 'bum tsho'i srog blu/ rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bkang ba 'bum/zhal dang beg tser khri/ spyi bkang stong rtsa rnams btang /tshes brgyad nas bzung zhag bdun gyi bar gter sgrom gyi chu tshan brgyab/ khal kha g.yas ru'i no mon e jen g.yas ru rnams dus gzings che skabs kyang 'thor zhig ma byung bar 'di lo 'byor ba'i lnga bcu ma nyi shu dang gos dar brgya sogs ster cha spams mtho ba bteg /phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur/ zhabs drung ri bo brag pa dang gzims shag lho par grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang rta mgrin skyer snang lugs kyi byin rlabs thar pa dpon g.yog la tshe rta zung 'brel dang dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / khams rgya ston chos rje bstan skyong / kong po snying phu sku skye mched gnyis/ chab mdo phyag mdzod pa rnams la skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gyi byin rlabs byas/ lho brag gung rgyal yong deb kyi 'go brjod/ rong byams chen spyi tsho gis kyis bskul ba'i sde pa'i brtan bzhugs/ sgo mang slob dpon ga ru pa'i phyi rten 'od dpag med kyi stong thang gi rgyab yig /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyi gra tshang mgon khang du phul ba'i snyan dar zhal yig /chos rje lug bya lung pas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs rnams brtsams/tshes bcu bdun la gzhis rtse/ rgyal rtse/ pa rnam/ ngam ring / rin spungs/ lha rtse rnams kyi mnga' khul nas (88na)gdan sa gong 'og gi sku tshab/ mkhan slob/ drung 'khor sogs kyis zhal dkar gya nom pa bteg /gnas rnying zhabs drung / dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ dkar lcog sprul sku/ chos rje 'ug bya lung pa/ sgrol ma nas/ spos khang mkhan po/ ngam ring bsam grub dga' ldan bla ma/ thub bstan mkhan po/ gzhan yang phyogs 'dus kyi smar khams go bo dbon po/ ka tsal bla ma/ snye mo dgon pa ba rnams dang phrad/ 'dar pa lo stos khri 'don du nā ro mkha' spyod 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i phyag bris ma dang mi tri dang ind+ra mkha' spyod de gsum ga tshar chen yab sras kyi phyag nas ma 'dar pa rin —122

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanachen dpal bzang gi dad rten yin pa byung ba nang rten khrod du yod/ thar pa dpon g.yog la shal dkar dmar snam phrug byin rten gyi rdzong ba bstar te thon/ 'bras spungs blo gsal gling slob dpon par ngor chen dkor cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms kyi sgrub yig dang gsar rtsom seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi mngon rtogs/ 'ug bya lung pa/ sgrol ma phug pa/ brag dkar chu bzang bla ma/rigs 'dzin mthu stobs dbang po/ bla ma snang dkar ba can la gsar rtsom bka' brgyad dang tshe bdag gi zhi drag sbyin sreg gnyis kyi lung bklags/nyer gcig la thon zil gnon pas bod sog tshor gya nom pa'i gzhis len bzabs/ lcang ra chos mdzad mar spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas/ bsnyen rdzogs dgu dang / dge tshul gsum bsgrubs/lhun po rtse mkhan po/ stag lung phyag mdzod/ 'bog gong nas/ se (84ston dbon po/ hor a mdo ba'i dpon khag lnga bcas par tshe dbang grub rgyal ma bskur/ phyi mtshams bcad de gter ston rigasa'adzin chen por rnying ma rgyud 'bum zhu ba'i dbu btsugs/ hor zla bcu par 'di lo nas bzung star chags su mal dro ka tshal lha khang du rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub spo bo ban grong pa bcas dpon slob nyer gsum gyis gshin rje khro chu dang kong po bu chu lha khang du sangs gling gdung 'dzin rnying phu ba gra slob bgragasum gyi khro rol/ rgyab chos 'od sna ba sogs dgon khag lnga chab nag pa can 'brel mtshungs bskor ba'i sher snying btsugs/nyer gsum la nyin gcig mtshams gseng ba'i mgron gnyer drung pa tshang gis gzhis len bstar/ mdo sde bskal bzang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya nga gsum pa/ thar pa chen po/ dpal mar me mdzad kyi lam yig che chung / rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i bla ma lnga bcu pa'i ṭīkka/ dag yig mkhas pa'i ngag sgron/ brda sprod li shi'i gur khang rnams dang deng sang 'chad nyan dang lhan du nyag phra bar snang bas rnying bstan gog po'i gsos su sgrol chen bsam grub rdo rje'i gsung rgyun sngags 'chang nam mkha' rin cen gyis bris pa'i gsang snying gi 'grel pa khog phug sgrol —123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)chen nyid kyis mdzad pa/ sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ spyi don/ chos tshoms/bsdus don sogs dper bskur ba rnams kyang par du legs par 'khod/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga la g.yon ru seng ge'i mi sna 'byor pa'i bskur (89na)ma dpangs bstod/ lha sa byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos rdzong gi skya ser rags rim la gung gi bsnyen bkur rgyas par bshams/ skyid shod sprul skus bkul ba'i a nanta'i don du dmigs pa'i smon lam/ tshe dbang rdo rje'i kha tan du rta mgrin gyi bstod pa/ dkar mo mtsho ma'i ngor gsol 'debs/ bsod nams sgrol mas bskul ba'i smon lam/ ri bo chos gling spyi tshogs kyi ngor ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad rnams bris/ rta tshag rje drung / snang dkar rtse zhabs drung / mon gyi bar chings la 'gro mi rtse gdong phyag mdzod/ bkra shis lhun po'i mi sna sdings chen pa/ tre po hor tshang gi mi gsar slebs/ se ra'i slob dpon gsum/ khal kha no mon e jen/ lha rin po che/ bde chen tha'i ji yab sras/ rgyal mo gnyis/ ratna/ sa skyong can mched/ sku mdun lhun grub rnams dang phrad/ er khe tha'i jis gos dar gyi bdog pa bstar/ bsnyen rdzogs nga brgyad dang / dge tshul phyed nyis brgya bsgrubs/ bde chen chos 'khor sprul sku gza' rgyal gyi ze kha'i bsnyun dam pos grongs par thug pa'i don gyi gtso bo dgon ma lag 'brug sgar bar shor dogs kyi sne'u gdong rtser thugs blo bstad chag pa dgos tshul gyi zhu don dang / zhar byung gson bsngo'i rten du tshes gnyis rin po che'i phyag dril bde chen dpa' bo'i rgyang glu/ tshes lnga rin po che'i phyag ṭwāṃ gnyis sne'u sdong pa'i blo rdor grags pas gtsos bdog pa skyel bar nang so sbra chen pa can 'byor zhing rtse zhabs drung gdan drang chog pa'i khrol cha'i (89ba)sgo gsal kyang mdzad song rung la la cung zad ma bde bar ma 'ongs pa sngun bsus kyi rdzun mdzad dam yang zer/ gra tshang nas grangs bcad kyis gshin rje me'i sbu gri'i sgrub khag gnyis dus mtshungs su btsugs/ shel dkar chos sde'i gra pa zhig gis mdo sdud pa/byams chos sde lnga/ bshes spring / dbu ma rigs tshogos drug /'jug pa/ spyod 'jug rnams kyi rgyugasasprad/ 'bri gung sprul pa'i sku dpon slob phebs par zhal ngo la cha bzhag ma thub rung sgam 'brug rnams —/24

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadadang mtshungs pa'i bkur gzos phul te dzes brgyad kyi snga dro mjal/ sde par phyag 'bul rgyu yin gsung yang skabs su ma bab pas mjal dar rtse sprod kyi ldem mjal mdzad/ bla ma lto pa/ yang ri sgar pa'i bla ma/ ka tshal bla ma zur ba spo bo ban grong ba/ sgar pa'i gra pa sum cu tsam dang bcas chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs kyi bka' 'bum dang mthun pa'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga zhig btang / sprul skus rtse zhwa/dmangs mas sgom zhwa/ spo pos pad zhu/ dge slong dam pas 'bar zhwa/ phyag mdzod pas kha btags kyi leb zha sogs zhwa rigs kyang rnam grangs shin tu mang / phyi dro dkar spro'i dus rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub kyis chos kyi 'bel gtam 'phel bar byung / sang nyin bka' brgyad khrag 'thung gi stod las smad las kyi 'cham rgyas par mdzad/ 'cham 'di bla ma mnga' bdag yab sras nas brgyud par rje zur bas mnal lam bzung ba'i zangs mdog dpal rir byon te zhus dag gnang ba'i khungs btsun par grags shing byin kyang chags (90na)par snang rtsed sna ltar gang bde byas mi chog pa'i cho ga dang 'brel dgos kyin yod 'dug pas las byang gyer ba dang zor las gtor bzlog rim gro tshugs pa 'dra mo zhig byung / 'on kyang bar skabs nas lad pa 'dra yin nam dmangs kyis skor theng re la skyen pa rnamasakyis skor theng gsum sum tsam ma ṇi'i chos skor ltar 'khor/ gtor ma 'gyogs mi rnams kyis kha dkris gtong ba sogs gtsang sbra che mdog kha po la a ra kha skyog des gtor ma'i steng la rkang pa btegs nas yul yul byed pa'i rgya ma bod cig 'dug pa sku rim tshad ldan gyi skabs mdzad kyin yod dogs med la che/ bde chen chos 'khor pa'i phod ka gza' tshan brgyad dang spar kha sme ba sogasagazugs 'gros mang po'i lhan thabs ma des gtsos bda' lan gyi skyes rgyas par phul/ re zhig bcad rgyar bsdad pa'i rgyud 'bum gyi 'phro mus nyan/ rtse lugs kyi tshes bcu chen mo 'dzugs rtsis kyis le'u brgyad ma sman lung chos ldan pa'i de legs po 'dug kyang mtshan brgyad kyi mngon rtogs sogs gter gzhung nas cung zad rgyas su btang ba'i las byang rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol gar brtsams/ nyer brgyad la lag pa g.yas pa'i rtsa 'grams pas rkyen byas lag pa'i nad 'phar te 'phrod bsten dang sbrags —/25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)thos bsam gyi bya ba chag med du bgyis/hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i zla stod du khyab bdag zha lu ba chen po dang dbyar smad nas bsnyun ro 'phar re sku khams je zhan du song bar dpal ldan ma khog tu zhugs te dbus (90ba)su byon na legs tshul zhus5 pa bzhin phebs/ lag pa mi bde bas rkyen gyis rjes gnang 'bul ma thub kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung sha rī ram dang gter sku 'gangs can du ma'i byin rlabs phul/ zhag gsum bzhugs nas gong dkar cho me sder 'phrod bsten la thegs/ tsam bzhugs bar gyi gsol kyi chas mthun rkyen sbyar/ smad rgyud dge skos byang 'dren gnyis kyis bskul ba'i slob dpon ngag dbang nor bu'i gsol 'debs/ shangs bkra shis rtse pas 'bum bzhengs pa'i smon lam sde drug mkhan zur pa dkon cog bstan 'dzin gyis nye du'i don du lam rim bla brgyud bzhengs pa'i thang kha'i rgyab yig rnams bkod/ rjes su 'bam ro 'phar pa drung 'tsho ba lhag bsam gyi sman dkar ngo che/ nad g.yog rkang ma dbu mdzad dang gal che skabs mchod dpon pas kyang yongs/ gra tshang du skong bshags kyi rim gro btsugs/ rigs 'dzin chen pos drag dmar gyi gtor bzlog mdzad pas zhag gsum nas rmi lam du yi ge lhogs rgyu med pa mang po yod pa'i chos shog gi 'khor kha yang rkang pa la dkris 'dug par mi zhig gis 'di bde po mi yong zhes bkrol song ba dang mtshungs pa'i mngon dod kyis bde zhing lhag tu gdon 'grol gyi nub gter ston rin po cher nged kyi rkang pa'i mthil nas yar rag dung 'dra ba'i sbubs gseng las sprul lta bu'i srog chags sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms yin zer ba'i sngags pa zhig gis nar gyi phyung ba mer bsregs te lhag ma rlung gis khyer ba'i spyan ltas legs pa byung snang / de nas bzung lo shas 'bam gyi nad (91na)ma langs/—126

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)dgung lo nga bzhi par lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi chos rgyal lha khang dang tse( rgyan lha khang gi nang rten gsar bzhengs dang / gser thog zhig gso/ bka' 'gyur brgya tshar sgrog pa bcas kyi skor/dus rim le tshan dang lcags khyi'i lo gsar dkyus bzhin btang / nad mjug la brten bskang gso dang bzhugs gral la 'gro ma thub pa'i rtser bkra shis/ ratna/ sa skyong sogs dpon khag rnams dang drung 'khor las tshan thor bur dkar spro'i thog ngos phrad byas/ tshes brgyad nas gter sgrom gyi chu tshan bsten pas phan ngo che zhing 'on kyang lag pa'i skrangs 'bur lhag lus pa bsod nams dbang rgyal byang na yong zhor rtsa sgye mo'i chu tshan brgyab pa pus mor phan pa'i gnas tshul la brten zhu blangs pas ngo so thon pa byung / chos rje na gling pa/ dar mo nas gnyis la sman sprad pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ring nyam thag gi nad pa mang por phan pa bsgrubs/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la gong dkar nas khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po phebs te zhag brgyad kyi bar bzhugs/ sngags rgod log tri'i rig gtad cig phul ba de ma thag rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu'i bsnyun gzhi rnying pa la phan ngo che ba byung tshul phebs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang byang sems bsod nams grags pa zhal sprod kyi zhal thang chos lung tshogs pa'i nang rten mkhan po rtag pa ba'i dus 'khyar ba zhig stsal/ gtsang du shar rgyag thegs khul la zhabs 'bam gyis chos sder bzhugs par drung 'tsho ngag dbang lhag bsam btang bas ma 'gyangs par gdangs skyed che ba byung 'dug /sne'u sdong rtse nas zhabs drung gdung brgyud yab sras phebs par lha gzigs phag mo gru pa'i (91ba)bkur gzos rgyas par phul/ 'on kyang sne'u sdong rtse'i khri bzhag ste bde chen chos 'khor gyi bla —127—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ma mdzad pa'i sgo zhig yod 'dra ba bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis kho bo dpal ldan sa skya'i khrir sdod 'phror nā la rgyu'i mkhan po byas na rta las babs te bong bu zhon pa dang 'dra gsungs pa'i dper snang /zhabs drung gis bka' stsal ba dang du blangs te nged rang dang sde pa'i brtan bzhugs/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ rdzogs chen pa dam pa 'jam gling gis bskul ba'i gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs/ mnga' ris gung thang rab 'byams pa sgra tshad mdo rgyud smra ba bshes gnyen rnam rgyal gyi snyan ngag gi 'phrin lan/skye bar rjes 'dzin gyi brjod bya thebs pa'i thang kha'i rgyab yig gcig chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'i ngo ma bzlog pa rnams bris/ rtsa skye mo'i bye lung mdo'i chu tshan blangs te bsten pas yan lag la lhag par phan pa byung / rdzong gzhis bcu dgu sdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar byed sum brgya/ mtshan brjod rig 'bum/ sman bla chig khri chig stong / tshe chog bcu gsum/ sātstsha chig 'bum/ gshin rje'i sngagasaring bye ba/ gdugs dkar mdos chen gsum/ khro rol gcig /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa/ phyugasalug nyis brgya dang nya 'bum gyi srog blu byas/ chu shur thar pa gling pa rnams kyis phur pa'i 'brub 'cham la mo tsher gseb pa tshor 'gran bzod pa brgyab cing phyi dro tshan grangs dang bcas ring (92na)'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ 'phreng ba'i dkyil thang bzheng dgos yod pa sde pas dang dod kyis khur bzhes te las gra 'dzugs pa'i sgo dod/ de'ang zhi ba'i rigs la sman thang pa dang khro bo dang dkyil thang la mkhyen brtse ba byang chub pas lugs gnyis ka ma nub pa zhig dgos rgyur sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi dus mkhyen brtse phyogs kyi ri mo bas go ma lo ba lta bus ha cang mang rgyu mi 'dug rung gong dkar chos sde nas slob dpon gsang sngags mkhar pas thog drangs mkhas bsgrugs bos/ ma dpe kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam thang kha la gtso bor bzung / 'phreng ba kṛ ya gnyis kyi rgya gzhung / mnga' ris pa tshul 'od dang paṇa chen thar rtse pa'i yig cha rnams mthun mi mthun gyi go bsdus dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ phun tshogs legs—/28

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chada'abyor/ dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa bzhis byas nas mi gcig pa rnams zha lu mkhan rin po cher dogs gcod dang 'di gar yang dris shing gtso bo rgya gzhung dang thang dpe btsan pa byas/ 'then 'byer cung zad byung ba thor bur yig cha la dmar mchan phab nas gzhis rka'i sgo lcog lho mar 'dri ba'i do dam mthon bya sgo nas kyis byas te 'go btsugs pa lcags phag hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du gegs med par 'grub/ khams ri bo che drung khri thog pa phebs rta khrab kyi ster cha dpangs bstod pa mdzad/phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang phul/ bar khams pa rnams (92ba)gsung 'phros mang na mdo med ces 'phya yin yod 'dug pa'i stabs yin nam gsung 'phros ni cher mi gsung / sog po stong phrag tu nye bar byin rlabs byas/ ri bo chos gling bla ma rgyal sras sprul sku dang gra dmangs bcas dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ mtshan brjod/ sman bla'i mdo chog /gsar rtsom mi 'khrugs pa' cho ga'i lung phul/ rgyal mo gnyis/ ratna dpon mo/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma rnams la ja gral btang / sne'u sdong zhabs drung dang zhabs drung ri bo che pa sogs la skyes lan gyi rdzong ba zhus/tshes bcu la ri bo chos gling spyi sos tshogs 'khor bdog pa'i dngos po'i sbyin bdag byas te gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi sgo nas tshe chog btang / chos gling gra dmangs kyang mu 'thud kyis gral du 'khod/ tshes bcu bdun la phan bde legs bshad gling pas tshogs chas/ spyi sger gyi bdog pa dang bcas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs te bcad rgya bsdams/ sde pa chu tshan dang lho kha phyogs kyi gzhis skor mdzad par sgo dod pa'i mchod dpon pa chu tshan la 'gro 'dun 'dug pas gtor ma'i khyad nas nyer gsum la zhing skyong dbang po'i mchod gtor rgyas par btang / do ris kho'i kha ton du gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad bris/ rtse lugs kyi tshes bcu'i phyag len gar 'cham rnams rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug chos rje dkon gnyer dpon kun bzang rtse ba yab sras kyi phyag bzhes khungs btsun pa'i snyan grags kyis snga dus kyi sde (93na)bdag mang po dang phyis su sgar gtsang sogs la'ang 'phel zhing rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dgongs par yang yod —129—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'dug rung yul dus kyi gnang stabs ma bde bar lus/ sde pa bsod nams rab brtan la thugs bzhed med pas gzhis ka rtse'i tshes bcu'i chas rnams zags 'thor du song ba nas rim 'gyangs su gyur pa 'di lo sde pas phod ka /gar gos/ zhal brnyan ging chas sogs dgos cha bzo ba'i gra btsugs/e pa sprul sku bag dro can bcu bzhi bkug pa'i thog mar tshes bcu'i mtshan brgyad skor/ gtum rngams/mtshams gcod rnams kyi zhal brnyan brgyad cu tsam/ rten rdzas kyi thang lha'i zhal brnyan sogs grub pa'i mu 'thud du lha'i lho sgo me long can du gtso bo 'od dpag med longs sku'i cha byad can g.yas g.yon du sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ bar khang gi chos rgyal lha khang du mes dbon rnam gsum/ btsun mo gnyis/ blon po gnyis/ rgyal srid sna bdun tshang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i tshul/ o rgyan lha khang du slob dpon yab yum/ o rgyan dam sri zil gnon/ yang bzlog khro bo/ byang chen mchod rten/tshal dus kyi bde mchog gi sku'i zhig gsos/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i sku dga' ldan lha khang du spos par rnam rtog byed mkhan 'dra yod 'dug pa'i stabs sngar gyi bzhugs gnas su gdan drangs/ra mo che bar khang du bzhugs rtsis kyi klu dbang gi rgyal po dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad rnams kyi rgyur grang gser zho chig brgya bcu gnyis/ gser (93ba〉rgog bod brdungs chig stong bzhi brgya zhe drug/ /rgya brdungs drug stong chig brgya brgyad cu/ li khri dang spang skya bre phyed gsum re/ spang ma bre lnga/ mthing bre drug /sngo skya bre phyed bzhi/ rams bre bdun/ ba bla bre gang / ras kha dgu brgya/ spyin khal drug /gro zhib/ lcags skud/ zangs skud rnams song ba'i do dam dpal 'byor bkra shes dang bstan 'dzin rab brtan gnyis kyis byas te zla ba bdun lhag 'gor ba'i phogs ston yon kun 'bru thog tu dril ba mkha' ru'i sum stong bdun brgya song / dpon mo sa'i khan ju'i dge sgrub thebs su dkar me gser chab bzang spyod khri tshar gsung ba'i dgos cha sprad/ gter ston rin po che la chos zhu 'phros nyan zhing rgyal sras pa dang bcas pa'i mched gnyis la gur lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thun mong ba/ zhal bsnyen kyi dus mgon po'i rjes gnang / rigs 'dzin chen po'i gter byon thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi —130

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadadabang lung yongs rdzogs/ gter ston dgung skag gi rkyen sel la lcags sdong lugs kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa rnams phul/ gter ston sku mched gnyis dang phyogs mthun du mchod dpon pa/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ chos rje kha reg pa/ chos rje padma/ sngags rams pa dga' ba gdong pa can la o rgyan dri med lhun po'i gter ma'i rlung dmar gyi lung phyag len rnams zhib par khrid/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes lnga la sde pa dpon g.yog mas dro brgyud 'ol dgar chu tshan la bteg gos phyi nang / sbugs sil/ rgya rnga/ gser dngul/ ja ras/ grum (94na/tshe/ bur ltang / rta sga bcas kyis gtsos pa'i chos yon gyi bdog pa rgya cher spel zhing rigs 'dzin chen por deb sngon dang rgyal sras pa sgra snyan rtsis sdeb sbyor la sbyangs pa che rab 'dug pas rig gnas kyi glegs bam gsum bzhi zhig kyang byin/ gter ston rin po che'i gsung gis bskul ba'i mgon po che chung las mkhan dang bcas pa'i gtor chog dang / rgyas sras bstan pa'i nyi ma'i ngor so thar sdom pa'i brgyud 'debs brtsams/khong dpon slob rnams rang gnas su byon/ grub thob dar phywa ru ba'i thugs dam rten beg tse lcam sring gi zhal thang brag ram mgon khang du bzhugs pa se ra byes pa'i gra pa zhig gis dkon gnyer la thang kha byung na blu yon bzang po ster zhes pa'i rkyen gyis thang kha khyer nas rdog gi sngags pa kun dga'i nyi ma dang lhan du 'ongs pa 'tshub gyis dkon gnyer chu shur du 'das kun dga'i nyi ma la sne'u a khus blus ma byin nas byung ba dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan brgyud lag tu 'byor/ zha lu sku zhang gis rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i dpang bum byin/ bi ri dge slong dbang phyug grags pas rang la bka' drin gang che'i bla ma rjes dran/ lha rigs lcam chos bzang dbang mo'i zhal 'don/ khal kha sku skye blo bzang 'phrin las kyis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ glang bu ba 'gyur med kyi ngor mtshan brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams bris/ se chen rgyal po mched lugs ma legs pa sogs o rod nang du 'tshub 'gyur mang tsam yod 'dra zer bar phan res gangs can mkhan po (94ba)dkon cog rin cen mi snar mngags te bla ma dpon khag drag rim tshor yig ngag bskur yang seng ge dang bā khan bande can rim gyis ma 'tsham pa'i dus kyi chad —131—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)par phan thogs che ba rang ni ma byung 'dug /mar lam mtsho khar dpon zhig gi rta phrogs par nyung tha'i jis da lam skyon mi yong yang rgyas bsdus med 'di 'dra mang na mi 'gab pa'i mkhan por bslab bya mdzad 'dug rung sbyor ba rtsings pa'i skyon zhig yin nam o rod mthil du brdungs shig kyang phog pa'i mdzes rgyu med tsam byung snang /tshes bcu bdun gyi 'grub sbyor nyin bsnyen rdzogs bzhi dang / dge tshul bzhi bsgrubs/ sde pa 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis smra ba'i dbang phyug blo gsal mkhas pa gnyis la legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos ka lwa pa dang dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa sum rtags rnams rdzogs par khrid de khong du chud nas dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par gyi zhus dag par rdzong bda' byas/ stag rtse tha'i ji rdo rje rnam rgyal dang hor bsod dar rgyas mched gnyis kyis zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i rten brten par zhig gsos mchod bkur mdzad pa tsam ni mnga' bdag khri ral man chad la ye ma byung 'dug pas gtong phod dang brtson pa mgon med zas sbyin gyi rnam par thar pa lta bur snang / de la brten nas chos skyong chen pos slad mar 'byung rgyu'i sde bdag gi mig ltos la phan du re ba'i mdzad pa mtha' dag dkar chag tu 'dri dgos pas de ga'i rgyu mtshan nged la lobs gsungs par brten shog dril chen mo zhig sprel lo byung yang brel bas g.yengs te/(95na) lus pa 'go mjug gnyis mchod khang re'i bar du snyan ngag nas drangs pa'i tshigs bcad dang dngos don rnams kun gyis go bde khyad kyis tshig lhug gi deb ther bkod/ de nas bzung phyi mtshams khog tu thob yig mi ltogs kyi bu lon lta bu'i 'phro 'thud de zla 'phros ngang hor zla bzhi pa'i ring brel ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa lta bur 'bungs par bris/ mgron gnyer don grub rgyal mtshan lnga pa'i lam du gyur pa'i tshe nang mi rnams kyi 'dod pa bzhin snyan dar dang 'dus tshogs kyi zhal 'don gang bder byas chog pa'i smon lam brtsams/zhang ston sku mdun lhun grub kyis ra mo che'i klu rgyal lcang gseb tu gta' bsdem sogs bcos ka mdzad pa'i tshe klu rgyal gyi 'khor du khams sprang 'dra ba gnyis 'dug pa ci yin dris par 'brum pa'i nad —132

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadabadag yin zer ba byung bas da lo 'thor nad zhig yong nyen che tshul mol ba ltar de nas zla ba phyed gsum skor tsam la lha sa nas rim gyis mched pa'i lo phyed gsum tshun la dbus gtsang thams cad khyab pas nges shes 'drongs par snang / bon 'di la bod kyi lha rnams dga' bar ma zad klu la lhag par mnga' brnyes pa zhig yod tshod du 'dug /sde pa'i lam gyi gegs sel sku rim du ser 'bras tshor ja tshul zla phyed kyi bar btsugs/ sde pas sne'u sdong rtse'i dbu mdzad rin chen bzang po can btang byung ba dang bstun dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis do dam byas te gra tshang gis tshes bcu'i gar 'cham gyi sbyong bdar zhib tu mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ khyab bdag (95ba)gnas gsar ba chen po gsum gyi dngul gdung la dkar me dang snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang bris/'dar los rdo rje 'chang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i tshems de nyid kyis 'dar pa chos skyong lhun grub la gnang ba ring bsrel can zhig dad rten du byin/ dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling pa'i gra pa gsum gyis byams chos sde lnga dang gsar rtsom dbu phar gyi rgyugs sprad/hor zla lnga pa'i tshes brgyad la khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po phebs te zla phyed bar bzhugs/'chi blu/ gdon 'grol/ grib sel/ bsu bzlog gi rim gro gnang / mnga' bdag gi gter byon gnam lcags kyi rdo rje byang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs 'gro mgon gnyos zhig chen por gnang ba nas bzung mthing ma ba dang khra tshang ba'i zhal ngo rim brgyud kyi byin can de mi 'gyur bar brten pa'i rten 'brel du stsal/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skur mtshan ltas rtsub pa byung tshul gyi phyag bris 'byor bar lcog sgar ba tshor 'dzugs rgyu'i brtan bzhugs kyi bden brjod phul/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa'i gsung gis bskul bzhin sde pa'i brtan bzhugs bris/ bsam yas su mdo sde 'bul bar chu mig kha ba blo bzang rab brtan btang / bco lnga la sde pa dang sog po'i dpon khag yon mchod rnams byon par tshoms chen du gung gi bzhugs gral dang bstun ngos kyis phrad/ sa skyong dpon g.yog la dmigs brtse ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa phab/—133—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'di nas bzung hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i bar mtshams grol ma grol la ma bltos pa'i thob yig long skabs byung tshad la bris/ khyab bdag sman lung par nā ga rakṣa'i dbang (96na)sogs bsam yas chos skyong chen po'i gsung dang bstun sde pa dang lhan du bskyar nas zhus/ rin po ches phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tshogs pa bla ma gsang 'dus dang bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi mgyogs dbang gnang /nyer gnyis la drung 'khor skya ser rnams kyis tshogs chas ster cha 'gyed gzengs bstod de gra tshang nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog rgyas par gsungs/ de thog sprul sku chos dbyings rgya mtshos rtsom pa'i shog dril dang dngul gyi maṇḍal la gser gyi tshom bu dang bcas te byin/khyab bdag khra tshang pa sde srid phag mo gru pa'i tri shri ra bkur ba'i gdan 'dren 'dug gshis gos dar gyi bdog pa bstan nas phyir phebs/ ra sa'i gtsang khang byang 'di bka' gnyan pa'i stabs gser thog gi zhig gsos mdzad mkhan nyung zhing dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che dgongs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs rtog ye mi gnang bas gsar bzhengs kyi thugs rtse gzhan dang mi 'dra ba bstad yod 'dug rung phyag g.yog rnams kyis tshul ldan ma byas pa'i gog bcos lta bu'i skyon gyis ring por ma lon pa nas shin tu bsdo ba zhig snang ba mchod rten rab 'byams pas mthun rkyen phul ba dang bsam yas chos skyong chen po/ tshangs pa dung thod can gnyis kyis kyang bar chad mi 'byung ba'i dbugs dbyung bar yid brtan du bzung rgya phibs lho byang gi zheng la rgyug mtho so drug dang mdzub gang shar nub la lnga bcu nga gcig /dpangs la nyer gnyis/ ltar rgyab la so bdun/ gañdzi ra gsum rnams kyi rgyur zangasagad phyis grub (96ba)pa mkhar khal drug brgya nga gcig /gser btso ma zho bzhi stong sum brgya re bzhi/ dngul chu zho chig khri nyis stong dgu brgya go gsum/ sne khrid mo re bcas bar mkhar khal bcu gnyis/ star bu khal bcu bzhi/ btsod khal byed dgu /rlung gnon dril gdang gi lcags thag /rlung dril so lnga/ bal po a ma ra sidha dang zangs mgar dbu mdzad rnam sras lhas byin/ dngos grub gsum gyis —134—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadagatsos pa'i so lnga do dam 'dar gzhen/ gra dpon/ gra sa bas gtsos pa'i shing bzo ba sum cu do dam sger logs a dar rigs gsum pa/ lcags kha ba/ gser gsol 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams/ bkra shis rtse nas/ star sdong nas/ spangs che ba/ phogs sogs dgos cha sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos bgyis pa'i phogs gla yon ston mo ston rgyab rnams 'bru thog tu dril bar mkha' ru'i khal chig khri chig stong sum brgya song / zha lu mkhan rin po che skor cig gtsang du byon na sku khams la phan pa'i brtag pa shar ba bzhin nyer bsdogs kyi sngon 'gror phebs/ zhal bzhi pa dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi rjes gnang tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa sogs zhus shing rkyen sel gyi rjes gnang 'dra phul te hor zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis la zha lu phyogs su thegs/tshes bcu gcig nas bzung nyin kha shas kyi bar chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras sbungs kyi gra slob sum brgya skor/ de mtshungs ser theg chen gling pa/ gsang ne'u thog chos rje rnam gnyis kyis thog drangs dpon slob lnga bcu/ dpal ldan smad rgyud gra tshang gra slob yongs rdzogs/ 'phan yul gsas (97na)khang dgon pa ba bla ma gra bcas/ lha ldan ru bzhir rags bsdus sum brgya tsam gyis so sos gos phyi nang / ja/ ras kyis gtsos pa'i zang zing gi tshan grangs ring por brkyangs te dkon cog gsum la gsol ba btab pa'i sgo nas ring 'tsho'i bden pa brjod/ 'bras spungs pa dpon slob kyi zlar 'grul pa gsar slebs yun 'dur dka' bcus gos dar/ ja ko dra'i 'bul ba gya nom pa bltabs/se chen zhabs drung gi sku skye/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod dgon stod pa/ gung thang gzims khang shar bla ma/me rag bla ma/ stag lung phyag mdzod pa'i bu lha skyabs/ 'chad ka spyan snga/ no gon dge tshul/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul/ yer pa slob dpon/ dbu mdzad rin cen bzang po can ban tshang pa kha shas/ khams lho stod nas gsar slebs chos rje ngag dbang gi dbon po rnams dang phrad/ ru thog dbang po'i bsngo rten du sku gsung thugs rten dang stod zog mang bar bstar zhing dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ mnga' bdag 'gro mgon nam mkha' dpal gyi dbu thod dang / rgyal sras padma dbang chen gyi dbu thod gnyis dang spro —135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gra gtsang pa'i nang rten/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi phyag phur shing dza la nag po las grub pa lha lung chos sde ba'i nang rten/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sku chos sne'u sdong rtse nas yar stod du 'khyar ba dga' tshal thub chen gyi nang bzhugs nas don pa/ gtsang ri bo che'i nang rten grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i rdo sku byin rlabs (97bcan rnams sde par 'bul mkhan byung 'dug pa rnams nang rten du bzhugs/bkra shis lhun po nas sprul pa'i sku rin po che dpon slob phebs par chibs bsu ba sum cu tsam dang dan 'bag mdar thab bsu bcas tshes bcu bzhi la po ta la'i yong bzhes khang du stan chags/tshes bco lnga'i nyin dpon slob rnams rtser phebs thog drung 'khor tshang mas mjal dar phul/ tshoms chen du mjal skabs sku gsung thugs rten dang gos dar ja ras kyis thog drangs dgu tshan mang por spel pa'i gnang skyes rgyas par mdzad/ sgam 'brug sprul sku dang dbyibs mtshungs pa'i bzhugs gdan sogs bkur gzos che bar phul/ gung gi bzhugs gral thog 'dar nas dang tsha rong nas gnyis kyis chos las brtsams pa'i 'phros gtam glengs/ sprul sku rin po che sku na phra ba la thugs rig dngas shing bzhugs tshugs pa'i ya mtshan pa zhig snang / dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa zhig gis gsar rtsom phar phyin nas thal phreng lhu bton pa'i rgyugs sprad/ sang nyin bsnyen rdzogs brgya bcu gcig dang /dge tshul nyis brgya bsgrubs/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul mar tshem bu lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i 'pho dmigs nyin gnyis su bcad nas nyams 'khrid du phab/tshes bcu bdun la chos sde skyor mo lung pa gra slob brgya skor gyis bdog pa'i tshan grangs dang bcas yun du gnas pa'i smon lam mdzad/ rab rgyas slob dpon zur pa/ tsha rong dge slong / gsol dpon/ mgron (98na)gnyer/ dge slong blo bzang rnam rgyal/ rdor rgyan pa sogs rgyal mtshan mthon po'i drung 'khor drag pa rnams sger phrad la 'ongs/ tsha rong nas kyis bde mchog gi bris thang legs pa zhig kyang byin/ bco brgyad la rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pas las byang le'u brgyad ma —/36—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanadang 'brel ba'i tshes bcu chen mo'i gar 'cham gra 'grig byin chags par mdzad/nyer gnyis kyi gza' skar legs thogs sprul sku rin po che dpon slob kyi phyags phyir rta tshag rje drung / pha bong kha gdan sa pa/ nyi thang bla ma blo bzang chos grags/ me rag bla ma/ drug brgya dge slong /se chen dbon po/ nang skor gi drung 'khor kha shas dang bcas par mtshan brjod/ tshe mdo/ sgrol ma/sher snying / bzang spyod/ byams smon/ lhung bshags/ gdugs dkar mchog grub/ spyod 'jug gi bsngo le/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i bka' 'bum thor bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun gyi rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum nas nyer mkho po ti gnyis su nye ba'i lung zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig gi bar star chags su phul/ nyin gcig me tog gi char babs zer ba bden na sprul pa'i sku 'khrul pa med pa'i rtags yin nam snyam/ gsas khang dgon pa'i dge slong zhig gis sha ra 'bum pa nas thon pa'i po to ba'i tshems yin zer ba zhig byin/ lha sa'i ma ṇi ba rnams la gsar rtsom rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i las byang (98ba)gi lung dang / dmigs brtse ma tshor rgyal ba btsong kha pa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas/tshes gnyis kyi nyin gong gi gser yig pa dge slong bsam grub chos 'phel dang dang skya bsod nams bkra shis gnyis/ bstan 'dzin da yan rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs kyi shog bu bsreg par mchod rten bla ma brtan pa dge slong / bstan 'dzin dge slong / bsod nams ja lang jang gi /la thu sbyar go chi/yig mkhan gnyis/ khrab pa bzhi/ gzhan ma'i 'grul sdebs chag nar khan cho me rje'i dpon po/ shesarab bla ma/ khor ching jo rig thu'i mi sna sogs gtos che ba 'byor/ bka' shog gnang sbyin rnams sprad/mi sna gnyis dang 'grul sdebs pa so sos gos dar gser dngul gyis gtsos pa'i bdog pa dpangs mtho ba brgya phrag tu longs pa byung / a pa dbang gi bskur ma gos dar dngom che ba dang gser gyi maṇḍal la rin po che beeḍūrla mthe bong tsam pas gtsos pa'i phras brgyan pa snang / thang sag slob dpon blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya nag tu 'das skabs gra tshang dang drug brgya dge slong gis bskul ba'i bka' drin —137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)rjes dran gyis gsol 'debs/ shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor slob dpon don rgyan pas mtshams sbyar ba bzhin sman bla'i mdo chog gi skabs sbyor rgyud 'debs/ blo sbyong dpal ye ma par du brkos pa'i mjug tu nyams 'khrid dang lung gi brgyud 'debs rnams brtsams/ snyigs (99na)ma'i dus 'dir rgyal bsen dam dri gtso bor gyur pa'i sde brgyad kyi gnod pa mchog dman kun la che ba'i gnyen por thang yig sde lnga 'di bsngags par snang bas 'gro phan gyi ched du 'o yug nas dpe rnying pa khungs shin tu dag pa zhig la gzhi byas gzhan glegs bam lnga tsam sgo bstun 'dar pa lo tsā ba mched gnyis/ 'phyong rgyas sde pa dkon mchog rin cen/ spos 'dzin pa tre po ngag dbang nam mkha'/ phu lung lha dbang rdo rje/chos rje na bza' gling pa drug gis zhib tu dpyad/g.yung ston rdo rje dpal zhes gos dkar 'dzin pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba chen po de gong gi sku rim la byon skabs gsang snying gi ṭīkka rang nyid kyis mdzad pa rgya par du brkos nas stong phrag tsam bod du 'phel ba ding sang skya zad sngo rdugs su song bas thos bsam 'dra byed mkhan yongs la re dang bon klu 'bum dkar por grags pa gdengs can gyi tshogs dga' ba bskyed nus pa'i phan yon du dmigs le tshan tsho lo snga ma ma dpe bskur ba'i par rnams wor/ stod rgyud gra slob/ rmi ru ba/ stod lung tsher gseb dgon pa ba so sos legs skyes kyi tshan grangs dang bcas yun du 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ ngam ring mkhan po/ bsam grub dga' ldan bla ma/ stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras sogs dang phrad/ sde pas khur bzhes mdzad de tshes lnga nas rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing gi zhing bkod thog tshad gra tshar (99ba) bzhi bcu rtsa gcig bzhengs pa'i ri mo dbu mdzad stag lung dpal mgon gyis gtsos mkhas bsgrugs nyi shu rtsa drug gis lcags phag hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du gegs med par grub pa so so'i rgyab thad du 'bras spungs 'du khang gi dus brtsams pa'i rtogs brjod dang gtso thang la che brjod dkar chag tshigs bcad lhug gi smon lam bris/tshes bdun gyi nyin bkra shis lhun po ba dpon slob dang brgyad la stag rtse tha'i jis tshogs —138—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chada'akhor ster cha 'gyed bcas spams mtho ba mdzad de gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du tshe chog btang / spyi sgos kyi rim gror rdzong gzhis bco lnga bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar brgya nyi shu/ 'bum brgya/ brgyad stong pa chig stong / mtshan brjod nyis 'bum/ yig drug dung phyur/ sman bla drug stong / gshin rje 'dus pa'i drag sngags bye ba/ tshe chog bzhi/ sātstsha tshig stong btab/ tshes bcu bzhi la gong nas rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs gnang ba len par ratna mched 'byor ba'i gnang sbyin lnga bcu ma nyi shu dang gos dar gtos che ba byung 'dug pa sngar gyi dgongs rdzogs rnams 'di ga nas khur khur te btang bas bsngo rten gyi tshul du 'bul rgyu yin tshul nan che bar mchod yon nang mtshams su de 'dra'i par bkab ma dgos kyang thugs dang bstun te bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/sprul pa'i sku rin po che tshigs snga ma dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i mkhan slob sbrags ma byas khong dpon slob kyi sdebs su ma chud par se chen (100na)zhabs drung gi sku skye dang u khe re tha'i ji'i tho yon gnyis nga ge tshul du bsgrubs/ rgya nag khrims dam pa'i stabs da yan rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs gtong bar btang ba'i skya ser rnams kyis brel ba dngos gzhi ma chod bar sger don bcad mi chog pa'i gshis tshes bco lnga'i wo mar rten bla mas ding phon/ rta rmig ma nyi shu/ gos dar sogs brgya 'bul dang g.yin ma 'grul sdebs dang bcas pas tshan grangs bzabs/ rgyal mo gzhon pa/ phun tsho gis kyi dpon mo/ zhang ston bstan rgyal/ hor lha rgyal dar gyi nu bo gnyis/ sems dpa' chen po'i sprul sku/ ge re lha pa'i sras mo skya btsun/ stod lung khyams pa bla ma/ rgya nag gi mi sna khag /byams chen gnyer pa bar tsho ba/ rigs gra'i skal pa skyel bar sgo mang slob dpon lung rigs rgya mtsho gra pa lnga bcu tsam/ hor dpon btsun chung gi bsngo rten rta brgyad skor/ khrab rmog ster mi rnams 'byor zhing bsngo smon gyi rgyas btab/nyer gnyis la sprul sku rin po che'i zhabs phyir rta tshag sprul sku/ pha bong kha gdan sa pa/ blo gsal gling sgo mang gnyis kyi slob dpon/ se chen zhabs drung gi sku skye/ drug brgya dge slong / rab 'byams pa gtsang phrug sogs nyi shu rtsa lnga dge lugs 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil —139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'khor du dbang phul/nyer drug la dge slong brgyad cu/ dge tshul go lnga/ dge bsnyen (100ba)drug rnams bsgrubs/nyer brgyad nas zhag lnga'i ring yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu la khrus byed par sgar byas pa'i sa spre lo phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tshogs gur dang shog gur rnams gsar du bzos nas sbyor 'jags byas pa da lam gling khar phub pa'i nyin gnyis par gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pas khur khur ba'i gra tshang gis gur gyi skyed bu kha dro'i skya ser tshang mar bzhugs gral bzabs rgyas tshan grangs kyi ster sbyin byung /gsum par tshogs gur de gar stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub spun gyis nyin snga ma dang phyogs mtshungs pa/ bzhi par gzhung gis pho brang gi mi sna 'grul sdebs bcas par dga' ston rol cha rtsed sna'i gar gyi rigs rgyas par byas/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis nas zhag shas kyi bar sprul sku rin po che dang phyogs mtshungs su rta tshag rje drung sogs sngar gyi chos zhu ba tshor thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum gyi chos skyong bkang gso gsol mchod skor/ phyag mdzod pas dgos tshul byung ba ltar gsar rtsom gyi dkar chag /yig bskur/ smon lam rags rim rnams bklags/ chags lugs kyi tshe dpag med dkar po/ skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ sgrol dkar tshe sbyin ma/'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ khyung khra/ las gshin phyi sgrub/ rta mgrin skyer snang lugs dang phyag drug pa gnyis kyis dbang bzhi byin (101na)rlabs/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang rnams phul/ bkra shis lhun po ba dpon slob rnams chos gsan pa dang bcas rgyang tsam bzhugs pa'i dgongs bstad 'dug rung stod smad kun tu 'brum pa mched pa lci ba mi snang yang sku na phra ba'i 'dzem cha gnang bzhed ltar tshes bdun la phebs rdzongs kyi skyes lan bum gdan ma dang gan gos phyi nang / zhal dkar/ dngul spyad/ khro zangs/ snam bu/ ja sogs gzengs bstod/ chab nag /brag dbar/ la mo tsher gseb gsum gyi bla ma/ li thang zur ba'i sngo zhus pa dbon po rta dbyangs/ yang dgon spyan snga/ rgya nag gi jang —140

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadagi dang rjar go che/ dpal 'bor chos sde'i mkhan po'i dbon po/ tshangs pa dung thod can kyi sku khog /gsang sngags byang chub gling gi slob dpon/ a ro jong gar gyi mi sna rnams dang phrad/'bri gung spo po ban grong par 'jam dpal dug sdong gi phyag len zhib tu bcad pas nges shes 'drongs par byung / dpon tshang tsha mo rong dge slong dang drung 'tsho ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gnyis la gso dpyad kyi man ngag 'ga' la dogs bcad/ sger gyi ster sbyin byas shing drung 'tsho ba lhag bsam dang dar mo ba gnyis dpon tshang rin cen grang sbyor gyi phyag len zhur bcug /tshes bcu gcig la sprul pa'i sku dpon slob sogs la gzungs bsdus nas nyer mkho'i lung dang bcu gnyis la rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs kyi dbu'i tshig bkra legs pa zhig tu (101ba)chos mtshams byas/ sang phebs gdong gi gzhis len thog srung mdud myur mdzad mgon po'i bka' bsgro phul/ shel dkar bla ma kong po sangs rgyas dpal 'byor gyis rgyal pa yang dgon pa'i tshems la stod rgyal gyi shrī nas brgyud pa byin/ skyar po bsod nams rab brtan 'das pa'i don du mgron gnyer gyis bskul ba'i dge 'dun gyi zhal 'don/ a dar tha'i ji sde dmangs dang bcas pa/ thor god dpon mo mkha' 'gro/ ma ṇi rab 'byams pa rnams kyis bskul ba'i smon lam/ lha sa zur khang bas mnga' ris drung pa'i phyi rten du sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi li rdzus bzhengs pa dang rta dpon rnam 'joms kyis gnas bcu'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyis sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa bzhengs pa'i dkar chag che brjod/ mon pa a cog dang 'or dus su gu ru dbang gis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs rnams brtsams/ rwa bsgreng gi dbu mdzad byang 'dren dge skos/ ge re lha pa'i zhabs drung stag rtse tha'i ji/ rgya nag gi 'grul pa tsho dang phrad/ mon pa me rag bla ma can rdzong bda' byas/tshes bcu dgu la snyam po sprul pa'i sku dpon slob phebs pa dang mjal/ sprul pa'i sku sku sha lci ba'i 'brum par thugs rtog che ba nas 'phral du phyir phebs/ chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla ma/ dgu gtor tshong dpon tshogs rgyal gling pa dang 'gol smon pa/ lcam mda' bla ma/ gser kha sngags rams pa'i mi —141—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)sna/ hor smad pa rgya mtsho rnams la ja gral btang / yer pa chos rje dang (102na)klu 'bum me rgan chos rje gnyis la rdzong ba gya nom pa bstab ste slar yang yon bdag rnying pa so so'i bla mar brdzangs/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum la mchod rten bla ma/ bstan pa dge slong / jang gi /rjar go che/dar khan chos rje dbon po/ khor ching jo rig thu dbang gi mi sna rnams la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bskur/ rdzong gzhis bcu bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar brgya bzhi bcu/ 'bum brgya phyed gnyis/ phal chen/ dkon brtsegs/ gzungs bsdus rnams lnga bcu re/ dri med bshags rgyud lnga brgya/ sman bla nyi khri/ swā tstsha dang bzang spyod so sor chig 'bum/ ma ṇi dung phyur/ gshin rje'i sngags ring bya ba/ tshe chog gsum/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du zhag lnga'i bar brgya mchod sna lnga 'bul mkhan gra pa bco lnga res zhal 'don du bzang spyod dang byams smon gsungs shing gser chab snyan dar phul/ khro rol gnyis/ phyugs lugs brgya dang nya 'bum tsho'i srog blus/ mchod rten brgyad la zhig gsos dang sku dkar gsol/ shel dkar chos sde'i bla spyi/ rtse chen zhabs drung gi gdan sa pa dka' bcu nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rnams dang phrad/rgya nag gi gser yig pa bstan pa dge slong can dge tshul bco brgyad dang / dge slong don gsum bsgrubs/ gong gi mi sna skor bcas kyis gser gyi maṇḍal gyis gtsos pa'i ster cha 'gyed bcas gra ja'i thog gra tshang nas ring du 'tsho ba'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ pā ras a rig gi bsnyen rdzogs brgyad cu gya dgu/ dge tshul bco brgyad/ (102ba)dge bsnyen brgyad rnams bsgrubs/ bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos kyi 'phrin las dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ e pa dpon yig ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis stong phrag brgya pa/ brgyad stong pa/ bskal bzang rnams kyis gtsos sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / bsam blo a zhang chos rjes mdo smad byams pa 'bum gling gi byams chen la grang gser yang skyor du gsol ba'i smon lam/ me rgan no yon gyi bu nang so tha'i jis bskul ba'i bslab bya/lha khang ser po'i bla ma er te ni chos rjer dmigs brtse ma dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/—/42

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadahan stag lung sku skyes dgon pa btab pa chos skyong la gnyer gtad/ sde pas bskul ma mdzad pa'i gzims chung pa rnams kyi ja mchod/ gsol dpon ge
