ra ba'i nyams len du jo bo lugs kyi dzam dkar gyi sgrub thabs/ pho lha rdzong bas bskul ba'i kho rang gi gsol mchod/ 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor gyi 'dod pa bzhin srung ma bzhi'i gsol mchod/ rtses dang bstan skyong chen mo dang brag gdong klu btsan gyis dgos tshul byung ba ltar gsol mchod/ spos phor ba tre bo ngag dbang nam mkhas rje btsun bcong kha pa'i sku thang bzhengs pa dang / rnam sras gling pa phun tshogs dbang pos dge lugs kyi zhal thang gra tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /gra dga' ldan byams pa gling gi gra rigs e ma chi sangs rgyas 'byung gnas kyis sa lugs gra thang dgon par gnas bcu'i gos sku phul ba'i deb kyi 'go brjod/ bsod nams ja lang jang gi'i kha tan tu gsol 'debs (103na〉skon lam/ mong khol bi che yi chis bskul ba'i smon lam/ rigs 'dzin dkon chog lhun grub kyis kun bzang dgongs 'dus kyi glegs bam dang bcas snyan ngag gi yi ge byung ba'i de lan rnams bris/ bcu drug la rgya nag mi sna 'grul sdebs rnams la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bskur zhing rdzong bda' byas/chab nag ri bo dga' ldan gyi bla ma blo bzang chos 'phel dang yar klungs bkras rab pa gnyis gong du zhu yig 'bul skyel la btang / sngar zhu yig tshor zhabs drung du zhu ba zer gyin yod kyang 'di lo gong nas bka' shog zur pa phebs pa'i de 'dra ma byed gnang ba gyen du bzlog ma nus par drung du gsol ba tsam bris mod cung zad ya nga ba tsam du snang /nyer bzhi la ka brgyad smad pas gzhis len bshams shing ster cha byas/ dwags po bang rim mkhan po/ lcang lo can bla ma/ gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon pa/ bon po gru tshang pa/ sprul sku chos dbyingasargya mtsho rnams dang phrad/ o snod nas skyid shong sprul sku/ cho khur o pa shi'i dpon dpon mo sogs 'grul pa gsar slebs mi grangs lnga brgya skor 'byor/ gos dar gser dngul gyis gtsos pa'i brgya 'bul bteg /a nan ta'i dpon mo'i skra phud blangs/ sku skye dpon dpon mo dmangs bcas la skyer —/43—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenasgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po dang lo ma gyon ma'i rjes gnang bskur a nan ta sogs kyi bsngo rten byung ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos/ skyar po chos mdzad kyis phu (103ba)bo'i don du bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /skyid shod sprul skus ra sa 'phrul snang / ser gos dge gsum/ bkra shis lhun po rnamasasu snyan shal/ chos sde bzhi por dngul gyi chab ril rgyan drug phul ba/ lhag bsam dge ba'i dbang pos rten la na bza' phul ba'i kha byang rnams bris/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa zhig gis gsar rtsom phar phyin dang bo dong mngon dga' chos sde'i gra pa zhig gis brgyad stong pa'i rgyugs sprad/hor zla bcu pa'i 'gor tshangs pa dung thod can gyi lung bstan bzhin rdzong gzhis dgu bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar brgya dang brgyad/ mdo mang brgya dang bcu/ rgya rol sogs dmigs bsal lnga dang / 'bum/ thar pa chen po/ gser 'od rnams so sor chog brgya/ brgyad stong pa chig stong ri / gdugasadakar/ sgrol ma so sor chig 'bum/ bzang spyod brgya/ sman bla sum stong / yig drug dung phyung bcu/ sātstsha chig 'bum chig khri/ gra sa phan tshun du ja tshul bco lnga re/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du brgya mchod sna lnga/ gser chab/ snyan dar/ khro rol bzhi/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nyis brgya/brgya bzhi gcig /mnan pa bzhi/ phyugs lug brgya dang nya 'bum gyi srog blu/ mchod rten drug cur zhig gsos sku dkar/ dar lcog /rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bkang 'bum/ beg tser khri/ spyir stong rtsa btang /shel dkar dpon tshang nam mkha' 'byor ba'i chos rje na bza' gling pa/ ngag dbang lhag bsam/ dar mo nas gsum la dngul chu'i phyag len khrid de btso bkru'ang mi nyung (104na)ba bzos/cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar lo lo bzhin yar stod thos bsam dar rgyas gling pa gra grangs phyed sum brgya skor gyis sman bla'i mdo chog gtong ba'i phogs ston ja thug gi dgos cha pho brang yar stod gri gu gsum nas sprad pa'i lag 'dzin/ ge re lha rin po che yab sras kyi gnang sgos ma khyogs par brten khri lcam dang nang zhig gis phan tshun gnyis gar gting skyes 'jags thebs ma byung ba'i sa tshab gtsang khyad gzhis ka lag bcas them 'dzin so bzhi/ lag 'bab bzhi stong lhag —144

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadapa/ sa lung don grub bkra shis la shangs mdo brjod kyi gzhis ka dud 'dzin nyer gnyis lag 'bab nyis stong bdun brgya byin/ a mdo ba dang a rig sogs phyogs 'dus kyi bsnyen rdzogs brgya dang bcu/ dge tshul nga gnyis/ dge bsnyen lnga rnams bsgrubs/ bā khan bande/ dpon mo tshe ring / khal kha gu yeng ja'i sang / bsam blo dka' bcu chos rnam rgyal rnams kyis bskul ba'i smon lam re bris/ tre bo hor tshang chos rje'i bsngo rten skyel bar ri bo bde chen gyi mkhan po dang khams nas gsar 'byor/ sa skyong dpon g.yog /lcang ra dpon sa/ gzims khang shar dang khams bya mo na'i bla ma/ mtsho sna sku skye sogs dang phrad cing hor tshang chos rjer bsngo ba dang byang bzhu byas/tshes bcu gnyis la yar klungs chu skor bar dang sras po dar rgyas can khag gnyis kyis zhabs tog dang bdog pa bstar/ tshong 'dus chos skyong bya khrid mig gcig pas btsan khang du 'jog rgyu'i nged rang gi 'dra 'bag cig (104ba)dgos tshul gong dkar rdzong sdod sgam bu ba brgyud byung ba bzhin sprul sku bag dro can gyis bzhengs pa'i gzungs bzhugs dang me tog gtor nas skyel bar rgyal thang pa btang / 'jam dpal me'i spu gri dang gshin rje rlung gi sgrub pa btsugs/tshes nyi shu la 'ba' rdzong sdod dar khan dka' bcu dang bra yag pa'i bla chung gnyer pa rnams kyis ja rta drel gyis gtsos pa'i ster cha dpangs bstod/ nyer lnga la mtsho kha nas me rgan khung tha'i ji'i nu bo nor rin cen dpon g.yog 'byor ba'i brgya 'bul bteg /thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang bskur/ bsnyen rdzogs re drug dang / dge tshul bzhi bcu bsgrubs/ dar khan dka' bcus khams phyogs kyi yul bkod rnams bkram pa'i gnas tshul lab chog pa dgos zer ba nged rang khur len par ma song gshis par bkab dgos mdog ma kha yang rtog pa bcug cing rgyu mtshan nyan/ la rgya'i 'dzin lugs gzhan ngo ma bzung ba'i dgon pa'i gra rgan dang zhen yod nyams kyi hur po yin 'dra snyam shar/ o rod du cod pa pā thur gyis bde skyid phung la re ba'i rnam pas seng ge dgra 'dul mtshan brdungs kyis lnga pa'i lam du btang ba'i mgyogs bsngo skyel bar hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis —145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)la me rgan dge slong can 'byor/ bsngo smon dang byang bzhu byas/ dge ba'i mthun rkyen du dkar me dang gra sa chen po gsum du mang ja'i dgos cha sprad/ bsod nams bkra shis/ bsod nams mgon (10ldan)po/rgyal mo che ba/ lcang ra sde pa rnams dang phrad/ slob dpon lcang lo can pa dus kyi chos nyid du gyur par dar rgyas gling spyi tshogs kyis bla ma dag zhing du bzhugs par gsol 'debs smon lam dgos tshul byung ba bris/tshes bco brgyad la khal kha g.yon ru nas 'jam dbyangs sprul sku/ no mon khan/ thu shi ye thu rgyal po/ sirnyi shrī rnams kyis mngags pa'i bka' 'gyur gdan 'dren gyi mi sna brgya skor 'byor/ gos dar gyi rten bcas dang bdog pa bstad/ ru thog dbang po'i sras/ gser kha sngags rams pa'i dbon po can dang phrad/hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la gra tshang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa tshangs pa dung thod can la lung bstan zhu bar 'phrin yig tshogs mchod spyan gzigs dang bcas mngags/ skyid shod sprul skus bskul ba'i seng ge dgra 'dul la dmigs pa'i smon lam/ ge ra chos mdzad blo bzang dge 'dun gyis gra tshang du dmag zor ma dang rgyal por snyan dar 'bul pa'i kha yig /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis gnas bcu'i gser thang dang mdo btsun ngag dbang lhun grub kyi thang kha bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pas bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ sde pa'i thugs dam rgyun khyer gyi gtor bsngo rnams bris/tshes drug la skyid shod sprul sku dang cho khur o pa shis tshogs 'gyed ster cha dpangs bstod pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad nas gra tshang gis rdul tshon (105ba)dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog btang / me rgan ji nong gi tsha bo sbos sbos dpon g.yog brgya skor 'byor zhing ta 'on rab 'byams pa dang bcas pas bdog pa'i skyes byung /tshes brgyad la 'jam dbyangs sprul sku'i bzhed pa dang bstun khal kha'i mi sna rnams kyis bdog —/46

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)pa'i yon sbyar te gra tshang nas rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog btang / bde chen tha'i ji yab sras/ rtse tshogs mkhan spyi gnyer/ sde drug mkhan zur pa/ sku mdun lhun grub/ phun tsho gos dbang phyug /dpon chung tshe dbang / co ba me rgan chos rje/ chab mdo phyag mdzod pa'i bsngo zhus pa/ bla ma chos nyid rang grol/g.yon ru pi chi yi chi dge slong rnams dang phrad/ dpal ri sprul sku 'phrang 'go gter ston gyis mal dro'i 'phrang nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe chu'i gter snod lcags las grub pas gtsos tshan grangs dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ mchims phu gsang phug gi mdor ldebs bris ci 'dra byas pa drag 'dri bar slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar bzhengs na 'thad tshul mol/ phur sgrub dang gshin rje'i dus rim rnams dkyus bzhin btang / zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku mtshur phu lta bur bzhugs na legs tshul gong du zhus pa bzhin lung bzang pos khong dpon slob yar skyel bar mngags kyang rgya mtshams su mkha' 'gros don med kyi sog po 'dra btang bas phyir ldog cing phyi nang kun tu gzer zug mang ba 'dug par 'jam chags kyi bkod pa dgos tshul gyi don gcod la skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan tshes bcu drug la mtsho khar thon/dgung lo nga lnga par ra mo che gtsug lag khang zhig gso'i thog nang rten mchod rdzas rgya phibs dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs dang / bstan 'dzin dwa la'i han rgyal por bskos pa/ thang po che sogs su gser chos kyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa bcas kyi skor/lcags phag gnam (106na)lo gsar du tshes pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i thugs dam bkang ba'i zhi ba'i gtor ma las bdud rtsi sbrang rtsi lta bu mang bar 'dzags pa legs pa'i mtshan mar mngon/ de nyin sog po'i dpon khag rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i dga' ston dang sang nyin ser 'bras kyi —147

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)slob dpon sogs la sum gdan snye 'bol/ pang khebs/ cog tse bcas bod lugs dang 'brel ba'i bzhugs gral bshams/ 'di lo'i le'u tho grong smad nas sangs rgyas rgya mtshos phug pa man ngag lugs kyi phyag len la gzugs 'gros bkod pa'i shin tu rgyas pa bzos/ zab bsdus dkar chag las/ de dag las 'ongs so so'i ngos 'dzin ni/ /ngor lugs yi ge e yig rtags kyis mtshan/ /rdo rje gdan pa las brgyud rdo rje'i rgya/ /mus srad pa ni yi ge mu yi rgya/ /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dbang las brgyud pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i yi ge mchod rten rgya yis mdzes/ /thor bu gzhan dag mchan bur btab pas shes/ /zhes pa'i rtags rnams rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes rtsa ba'i phyag dper bkod pa 'khyar te ding sang rgyun chad pa lugs bzhi ga'i glegs bam la zhib tu ga khugs nas me 'bar kha skong sogs dkar chag tshor btab ste bstan rgyun la phan res gdan sa gong dang gnas gsar dpon rin po cher phul te rgyun 'dzin tshor spel ba'i bsnyel gso zhus/tshes lnga la tshogs mkhan chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan pa'i dbon pos tshogs 'gyed ster cha'i sbyin bdag byas phan bde legs bshad gling pas 'chi med 'od snang gi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i (106ba)tshe chog btang / rnam sras gling pa phun tshogs dbang po'i ngor lta sgom gyi nyams len bya lugs kyi tshigs bcad dang / gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i nged rang dang sde pa thun mong gi ring 'tsho'i smon lam dgongs bzhed bzhin bris/ o rgyan smin grol gling par tshogs dung dgos tshul byung ba ltar dngul gshog ma legs pa cha gcig bsrings/ chos rje na bza' gling pa/ sgo mo rab pa/ ngag dbang 'phrin las gsum la sman rtsis sprad nas mchog dman bar pa'i nad pa ris med gso ba'i mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa byed du btsud/tshes dgu la dga' ldan khri rin po che blo bzang don yod/ rgyal sras bkra shis/ stag rtse tha'i ji bkra shis ljongs chos rje/ zhabs drung grags pa rnams dang mjal/ bsnyen rdzogs brgya nyer gsum/dge tshul brgya bzhi bcu/ dge bsnyen drug bcas bsgrubs/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po bla spyi gra rigs —148—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanadang bcas sum cu skor phebs/tshes bcu gnyis la bdog pa tshan grangs sngon du 'gro ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rje'i bzhed pa dang mthun pa'i tshe chog gi sgo nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs pa gnang / bram ze'i tshangs dbyangs ring mo sogs sngar gyi gdangs rnying byin chen mangs pa'i yun kyang 'gor bar byung /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis gra tshang du snyan dar sum brgya skor gos chen gyi gong bcas phul ba'i kha byang / de dang phyogs mthun tshogs kyi zhal 'don du 'dzugs rgyu'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ sde pa'i tham dmar gyi phud jo shāka (107na)dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ dung stong rgyal mo gsum phul ba'i zhal byang rnams bris/zla gcig gi bar phyi mtshams khog nas khyab bdag zha lu bar mus chen sems dpa' chen pos dkar chag bsgrigs par mdzad pa'i blo sbyong glegs bam/ sa skya bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ bde mchog lnga lha'i dbang sogs zab chos mang du zhus/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i sku brnyan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bzo ma rab gnas kyi dus bu ston nyid kyis kyal ga'i tshul du sku dngos su thim thengs gcig mdzad pa'i grub rtags can rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs par gnang nas rtses dang bsam gtan gling gi nang rten du bzhugs pa rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po brgyud de phyag tu 'byor ba de'ang dad rten du stsal/ lu bu mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang grub mtha' snyogs te zhing khams 'phos pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten seng ge sgra'i thang sku bris legs sogs 'byor don bzhin sa lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i bsngo smon byas/ de bar zha lu'i slob dpon gra bcas kyis tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sgrub mchod btsugs/ chos khur o pa shi dpon dpon mo rnams la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bskur/gdog pa'i ster sbyin dang bcas rang yul du thon/tshes bcu gsum pa dga' ldan pa dang seng ge gnyis kyi dge rtsa byed par se chen chos rje/ me rgan —149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lanadage slong / thar gon dge slong / bi chi ye dge slong can 'byor ba'i gser dngul (107ba)gos dar ko dras sna drangs pa'i bsngo rten rgyas par bstabs pa bzhin dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ na ro pa'i zhal skyogs gzhis rtse'i nang rten gyi gras kun ci rgyal mor byung ba zhig tsha ba sku skyes bskur 'dug /sne'u stong rtse nas lha gzigs mi'i rje bo mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang sku me tog 'thor ba'i dgongs rdzogs kyi thugs dam 'dogs rten skyel mi 'byor/ byang rten du thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i zhal ko 'dug pa sde pa bsam yas kyi dbu thod dang bsgrig bzhed pa thugs dang bstun pas chos skyong chen po'ang dgyes par byung snang ba zhabs drung rin po ches mthil gyi nang rten 'gangs can de dgongs rdzogs su gnang ba chos skyong gis thugs rgyud ma bskul ba'i nges pa'ang mi 'dug /gdung 'bul gya nom pa bstar bar sa ba gru pa bsam grub rgyal po rdzong bda' byas/ chos rje dung dgon pas chu bo rir tshe chog bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas rnams bskyel ba dang phrad/ byang gter gyi thugs rje byams pa'i man ngag 'jam dpal rlung sgrub kyi sgrub pa btsugs/o rod cong gar nang 'khrugs pa'i dben sa sprul skus bā khan bande can bcoms pa'i gnas tshul byung 'phral zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig la chos khur o pa shi 'dam nas phyir log pa'i mi snar dga' ldan khri rin po che sags phebs dgos tshul byung ba ga la 'grig cing tshig gcig tshig min na tshig brgya tshig min pa'i dpe ltar mkhan po gnyis kyis shogs ma thon par mi btang yang dgos nus med 'dra'ang dpon po'i ngo gzung byed du mgron gnyer dar dar rdzong bda' (108na)byas/ skyid shod sprul sku bod du bzhugs rtsis 'dug pa pha ma la dmigs blo sbyong ba'i tshod na ding sang ngal skabs sdug grogs lta bu'i sems gso dang phan thogs gang yong la byon pa 'gab tshul labs rung zhi bde'i lam nas ldog par mi snang /rdzong gzhis bcu dgu bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar nyis brgya dang bcu/ 'bum brgya/ dri med bshags rgyud sum brgya/ sman bla nyi khri bzhi stong / sgrol ma/ tshe gzungs/ bzang spyod/ lhung bshags —150—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanarnams so sor chig 'bum/ tshe chog bzhi/ sātstsha nyis 'bum/ gshin rje 'dus pa'i sngags ring bye ba/gdugs dkar mdos chen gnyis/ ser 'bras su ja tshul nyi shu re/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du brgya mchod sna lnga/ snyan shal/ zhal gser spyan 'byed sngar drung 'khor 'dras phyin skabs khyams skyur du bzhag pa'i ru nga mi nga sna tshogs byung zer bas sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan btang ba'i dngos gtsang bsgrubs/ mdos rdzongs gnyis/ dgra mnan brgyad/ srong btsan du bkang brgya/ rgyal du dmag zor mar khri/ phyag drug pa dang las gshin la stong / spyir brgya rtsa/ dpal lha lcog tu stong rtsa/dngul gyi me long dar snas brgyan pa/ dar lcog sna lnga/ phyugs lug brgya/ nya 'bum gyi srog blus/ sa skyong / lcags zam rje drung / sgo mangs slob dpon can nyung bsdus shig dang phrad/ mkhan rin po cher paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang sogs phul/ zha lu'i gra slob rnams la gsar rtsom tshar chen gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung (108ba)bklags/ kun spangs gnang ba'i dgongs bzhed dang bstun ri sbug dbu mdzad sku zhang bsko ba'i sde pa'i phyag dam dang bsko 'ja' sngar 'byud ltar bsgrigs/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang tshar chen yab sras kyi ring lugs gtsor 'don gyi rgyud sde bzhi'i smin grol rnams mi nyams shing chad 'bums cung zad byung rigs la ngor gong dkar gnyis nas bsabs pa'i bstan pa'i bdag rkyen du 'gyur ba dgos tshul gyi bsko 'ja'i yi ge gser tham chen mos mnan/nyer lnga la rigs kun bdag po zha lu ba chen por gos phyi nang dngul lnga bcu mas gtsos pa'i chos yon gyis bsnyen bkur te dpon slob thams cad gtsang phyogs su phebs/ 'bras spungs spyi khang gi spyi rdzas dang gnyer tshang 'dzin chas kyi deb kyi 'go brjod dang / drung 'tsho ba ngag dbang lhag bsam gyis zhang blon gyi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig lag bris su bkod/ bsod nams dbang rgyal bya lo'i 'jug tu mtsho kha nas 'khor ba'i rgyal sa'i skor la thams cad gros mthun yang / khyi lo bstan 'dzin da yan rgyal po bskos pa'i lo dang gcig par spyir rgyal po sku tshe mthar phyin cing rgyal khams bde bas rnam rtog dgos don mi 'dug rung la la khri thog tu lo bcu gcig tsam las ma bzhugs zhes —151

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dogs pa byed pa dgung lo mthon por slebs nas khrir bton pas dngos po'i gshis lugs de las 'os ci yod/ 'on te 'jig rten grags tshod 'gog mi nus pa'i dbang gis bgol te 'di lo stod smad kun tu zhal dkar gyi brda 'grems sngun chug pa'i nag pa zla ba dus 'khor ba'i lugs (109na)kyi 'go dang de bzhin gshegs pas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du chos rgyal zla ba bzang por rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa gsungs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo shis par brten nam dus kyang legs ldan dpyid kyi dga' ston la babs pa nas hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum gza' nyi ma/ skar ma smin drug 'phrod chen dul ba sbyor chen mdza' bo 'brug gi nyi ma'i nyi shar lug gi dus sbyor thog tham ka dmar po/ chen po hor gyi rgyal po'i nyer spyad du 'os pa'i gan gos dang pags rigs kyi slog pa/ dbu zhwa phru can/ go mtshon sogs dpa' bo'i chas rnams kyis sna drangs gos phyi nang / dngul spyad/ ja ras/bur ltang / grum tses mtshon pa'i bdog pa'i dngos po gya nom pa'i legs skyes dang bcas bstan 'dzin da la'i khan du cho lo'i dril bsgrags te khri thog tu btan/ bkra shis/ sa skyong can dpon khag so sor dga' ston gyi ster sbyin bzabs pa bstar/ rgyal sa snga ma'i lugs kyi khri 'bul khrag sha bgos su ma song ba'i bla chen/ sde dpon/ chos sde che kha/ drung 'bor drag nges 'os bab rnams nas dpon po tshor sastongs su ma lus pa'i 'bul ba yod pa la dmangs mas rgyal por khri 'bul ma chad pa'i chu 'bab kyi gra bsgrigs thog mar ming bkra'i khyad kyis stag rtse tha'i ji lha rgyal rab brtan/ de nas sde chen/ tshal/chos sde chen po phan tshun/ gsang phu chos rje rnam gnyis/ rta tshag sprul sku/ hor tshang chos rje/ sher 'phel sprul sku/ gdan sa gong 'og /sne'u sdong rtse/ rgyal mtshan mthon po/ 'brug sgar pa rnams kyi mi (109ba)sna/ rgya ri zhabs drung / dwags kong gi dpon khag /sne shun sogs nye skor skya ser gyis zhal dkar gyi bdog pa bzabs rgyas su spel/ gung gi bzhugs gral thog sa ba gru pa bsam grub rgyal pos chos kyi gleng mo/ rol cha dang zlos gar sna tshogs bsgyur/ tshes bcu pa khag dang rmi ru ba'i 'chams/ ru bzhi dang sne shun rnying khungs sogs nas bro gzhas kyi gzigs mo rgya cher phul/—152

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadatshes bzhi la gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan/ nā la nā bco brgyad pa/ stag lung khri gdan zur gyi sku tshab/ sna dkar rtse sku mched/ bya zhabs drung / sde pa phon mdo ba/ thon pa/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i bla spyi/ gtsang gi drung 'khor rags bsdus rnams kyis mchod yon sdebs 'dzom thog legs skyes phul/zla ba sngon ma'i mjug tu lag pa g.yon ma'i rtsa 'grams kyang khri 'don la ma gnod pas rten 'brel legs shing tshes lnga nas mchod yon gnyis lha sar byon te zhal dkar rnams rim gyis bzhes/ nged kyi yan lag cung zad bro 'tshal ba nad g.yog dbu mdzad mchod dpon gnyis dang gnyid bsrung ba'i rkang ma dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rten khang dpon tshang / drung 'tsho lhag bsam/ dar mo ba gsum gyis 'phrod bsten byas pas rim gyis bde/ tsho gos su 'gro ma thub kyang zhing skyong dbang po'i mchod gtor dus thog tu btang /tshes bcu gnyis nas bzung zhag bdun gyi bar bka' 'gyur khang du gra tshang gi gra pa phyed longs kyis dri za'i rgyal por rten rdzas kyi zhal brnyan hor gos tse ber rin po che'i rgyan sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs (110na)bzabs gshom bstar te zhag bdun gyi bar mdos bskang btsugs pa'i 'phrin las 'chol ba'i snyan dar zhal byang bris/ dus mtshungs su de 'phros kyis 'du khang gnod sbyin chen po beg tser bskang bshags rgyas par phul/ khag gnyis grol nas mu 'thud du gshin rje 'dus pa'i drag sngags bzlog pa dang bcas pa/ 'gong po ar gtad gsum bye ba re/ dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug mar bkang ba 'bum ther btang / nyer bdun la gter ston rig 'dzin chen po phebs pa'i byad 'grol gdon 'grol sogs rim gro mdzad pa rnams kyang ngo che bar byung /hor zla bzhi pa'i 'gor dben sa sprul pa'i skus gting skyes tshogs gsog pa can btang ba'i yi ge rten bcas kyi sdebs su seng ge dgra 'dul gyis mgo dkar gyi khral nas blangs te bskur rtsis kyi gser zho stong / rten bcas la gser zho stong / seng ge'i sras chung rnams kyi don du mu tig gi thum bu/ ngag ma rgyas par 'dug pa de lan bsrings/ zhang ston sku mdun lhun grub kyis bon mkha' klong gi —153—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)mdos chen rim gror btang zhing lo snga ma tshor yang zhang zhung lugs kyi mo rtsis dang der babs pa'i bcos rim mang du mdzad/tshes bcu nas rtsa sgye mo'i chu tshan blangs te zhag lnga bsten pas gzhi med du song / rten khang drung 'tsho bas gso rig gi man ngag mang du byung zhing bdag rkyen dang ster cha legs pa byas/ lo snga mar bsam yas nas chos skyong chen pos bka' shog yig chung tshigs bcad ma zhig 'dug pa go don ji bzhin ma thebs pa lta bus (110ba〉sno'u sdong bdag mo sde srid 'dzin du 'bod pa'i gleng gzhi byung ba blor ga la babs rung phyag mdzod rgya seng sogs gong ma rnams las cung zad mngon che tsam yong ngam snam pa las rjes kyi rgya che mu med de 'dra'i dogs pa ma shar bas bzang ngan gyi blang dor sogs ha cang yid la mi gsal ba'i rmongs byed kyi mdas zin nyams kyis chu 'gros su song bas bka' blon tsho'i brjod rigs dang bstun/ ngam ru ba gdan 'dren du song ba tshes bcu gsum la lha sar byon/nyer gsum la mtshams grol ba'i sne'u sdong bdag mos gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhun thigs las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po'i skus gtsos dngos po'i tshan grangs bstar/ tshe rta'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi phul/ zhwa gos ster cha tham ka dang bcas/ sa skyong la me rgan tha'i ji/ rin chen la se chen tha'i ji/ sbos sbos la er khe ji nong gi cho lo btags/ shal dkar dmar/ bse sgam/ ja snam phrug gi rdzong pa gya nom pa dang grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur nas mtsho khar thon/ nyer bzhi la byang rtse chos rje/ rta tshag rje drung / mnga' dwags kyi slob dpon gnyis/ dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling dang kong ser srid khag gi bla ma/ lcang ra nas gshone pa/ rtse gdong phyag mdzod pa/ kong stod dpon khag rnams dang phrad/ kong po bu chu'i chos rgyal gyi sku'i nang bzhugs nas thon pa'i zhabs phyags 'khyar ba sgam po bde chen steng pa'i lag nas de mo slob dpon blo bzang bsam 'phel gyis blangs te byung ba lha sa'i rten khrod kyi de dang che chung khyad lha thor ba rgod tshang pa'i zhabs rjes kyi dpe bzhin sku na bsres gzhen dang sprul bsgyur yin na ma gtogs (111na)som nyir mchis/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa dang dpal chen 'od po'i dbu 154

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadathod dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa gong nas gdan drangs te rtses dang bsam gtan gling du bzhugs pa sne'u sdong rtse brgyud rin spungs pa'i nang rten gtsigs can chos mdzad rgyal po don grub kyis lho brag tu khyer ba tsha mo btsun ma zhig gi lag nas byung / rje btsun grags pa'i sku ber dang 'phags pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs ngor shar pa'i nang rten yin pa shar pas ngor gzings shig snga phyir byas nyes ches pa'i chad pa tshabs chen byung ba'i dus su khungs btsun min ri mna' gan gyis bton te sde par phul ba nang rten khrod du bzhugs/stag lung zhabs drung rin po che ma chen zla ba snga ma'i tshes nyi shu la zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs pa'i gnas tshul dang gsal 'debs kyi mgyogs bsngo rten gsang khog nas phyag mdzod pas sde pa brgyud de 'byor zhing 'di res dril bu ja rta khrab sogs kyi bdog pa skyel bar phyag mdzod pa'i bu gzhen pa dang gsol dpon lto gar ba gnyis mngags pa ltar dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ gdung 'bul kyang rgyas par phul/ tre bo hor tshang chos rjer chos mang tsam dgos tshul byung ba 'go ma kho rang la 'brum pa dang de rjes nged rang bro 'tshal bas 'gyangs pa'i ngang 'degs par dus kyis gtugs pas mang ba ma thub rung chos rje'i slar sher 'phel sprul sku kong bkra shis rab brtan dang de mo ba'i bla ma can kha shas la 'jam (111ba)dbyangs dmar ser/ sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ ba ri lugs kyi rnam 'joms/las gshin phyi sgrub/ phyag drug pa'i byin rlabs/ mdo sdud pa'i lung rnams phul/ hor tshang chos rjer ban chas snam phrug gis gtsos pa'i ster sbyin dang bcas ta'i si tu du dben sha'i gdan sar rdzong bda' byas/ spyi sos bskul ba bzhin ri bo chos gling bla rabs kyi gsol 'debs brtsams/ dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling pa'i gra pa zhig gis 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i rgyugs sprad/hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung rim gyis dpal ldan 'bras sbungs kyi gra slob sum brgya skor/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan khri rin po che gdan zur gnyis kyis dbu gnang slob dpon gra —155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bcas sum brgya/ se ra theg chen gling gi slob dpon rnams kyis gtsos pa'i nyis brgya/ lha sa ru bzhi'i grangs sum brgya tsam bcas so sos rung mthun nyer spyad/ gos phyi nang ja ras sogs dngos po gzengs bstod pa'i maṇḍal gyis sna drangs yun du 'tsho ba'i bden pa'i tshig gis shis brjod rgyas par mdzad/dga' ldan pa dpon slob la phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi lung bzhed pa dang sbyar/ bsnyen rdzogs brgya sum cu dang dge tshul brgya nyi shu skor bsgrubs/tshes lnga la rgyal po dpon g.yog rags bsdus la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i rjes gnang / phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul rnams phul/ lcang ra nas/ zhang ston sgar pa'i sras/ dpon sa can la tshe dbang bskur/ (112na〉sos bcu la gra tshang gis tshes bcu chen mo 'chams dang bcas te rgyas par btang / rgyal po dpon g.yog kyang gzigs mor byon/ sog po byang la log mi bzhi brgya lhag la byin rlabs byas/ rgya ston dbon po'i bsngo rten gser dngul gyi sgrol ma'i sku dang gser zho bco lnga 'byor bar smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/tshes bcu gnyis la sde pa rtswa sgye mo'i chu tshan du bteg /sang nyin nas zhag bdun gyi bar gter sgrom gyi chu tshan bsten nyin gcig me tog gi char chen po babs zhes kun mthun par gleng ba rgyu gang las byung ni ma shes/ bsam yas mdo sde 'bul bar mdo pa chos mdzad ngag dbang lhun grub btang /tshes bcu drug nas bzung bcu gcig pa'i bco lnga'i bar dbus gtsang gi sa dge'i dgon khag sum cu tham pa rdzong gnyis 'brel mtshungs su res skor gyis bka' 'gyur tshar sum brgya drug cu/ 'bum nyis brgya/ brgyad stong pa dang gzungs bsdus so sor lnga brgya/ sman bla bzhi stong / mtshan brjod/ gdugasadakar/ sgrol ma/ sher snying so sor chig 'bum/ tshe gzungs bye ba/ bzang spyod tshig khri/ dbyar chos kyi ring gra sa phan tshan du ja tshul dang phogs 'gyed bsgrubs/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyis sde par phyag rdor gyi bsnyen pa byed dgos tshul gsungs pa bzhin nyer bzhi nas bdun mtshams gcig mdzad pa'i tshe gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs nyung ngu dang cung tsho ba yon tan dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i rta mgrin —156

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)gsang sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs bris/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la gra tshang gis (112ba)tshogs spyi sger gyi bdog pa spel te 'chi med 'od snang dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog rgyas par btang / sang nas nyin lnga'i bar rtser tshogs te bsam pa lhun grub ma dang ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ yon du sde pas ja 'gyed btang / tshes lnga la gsang sne'u thog gi chos rje rnam gnyis chen slob/ 'phan yul gsas khang dgon pa ba'i gra slob rnams lhan cig pas dngos po'i tshan grangs bstar zhing yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ gling stod chos rje gsar bskos kyi sger mjal/ zhabs drung bdag mo/ zhabs drung nor bu khra skor yum sras/ stag lung phyag mdzod yar bzang pa/ no yon khu thug thu/ ngor klu sdings pa/ sgrub khang dbon po/ khal kha no mon e jen gyi bu tsha brgyud kyis mi sna rnams la ja gral btang / se chen rgyal po'i mi snar skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang rdzong bda' byas/ ra mo cher zhig gsos thub na gcig tu dkon cog gi zhabs tog yin 'dug pas 'gangs che na'ang / lung bstan dus rtags kyis ma dgos na de ga mi legs rgyu med cing sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis zhig gsos kyi bca' bsgrigs thog gnas gshis de bzhin nas rim lus su song ba sa bya zla ba bdun pa'i nang du glo bur rtsig pa logs gcig 'gyel ba sogs kyis nyi ma dang nam gyi dper song /sde pas chos skyong khag dang klu phebs mkhan zhig kyang bos pa'i gleng cha'i dri ba mdzad pa skyon mi yong tshul byung ba dang bcas khyi lo nas ar po'i 'go btsugs phag lo'i nang du grub pa'i rgya phibs gsar (113na)bzhengs kyi lho byang la rgyug mtho re bzhi/ shar nub la zhe dgu /dpangs la nyer brgyad/ltar rgyab la bzhi cu/ gañdzi ra gsum/ gdung sne/ chu srin rnams kyi rgyur zangs gad phyis grub pa mkhar khal chig brgya re gsum/ gser btso ma zho bdun stong brgya brgyad cu/ dngul chu zho nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya zhe gcig /sna khrid mo re'i bsres la rgya thur gyi srang chig stong brgyad brgya zhe gnyis/ star bu khal nyer drug /bcod khal nyer brgyad/ srog 'dzin dril gdang lcags thag /rlung dril soganyis/ phyogs—157—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gsum gyi mda' yab kyi dpangs la rgyug mtho do lhag /lho dang byang gi dkyus la zhe drug zhub la nga dgu /chu 'bab kyi zheng la drug /lcam gyi sne'i dkyus lho dang byang la zhe gnyis/ nub la bdun cu rnams kyi rgyu cha ra mo che dang thugs rje chen po'i zangs leb rnying pa rnams la bsgrig bcos byas par mkhar khal 'i nyas brgya don bzhi/ shan dang gzer gyi rgyur lcags khal dgu /star bu khal bcu/ btsod khal bzhi rnams song zhing / bal po a ma ra sidha/ zangs mgar rnam sras lhas byin dang dngos grub gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i nyer drug /do dam 'dar pa/ gra dpon/ lhun grub gling pa/ gra sa ba can shing bzo ba sum cu/ do dam a dar/ rigs gsum pa lcags kha ba/ gser gsol brgya so nas/ 'dol chung nas/ star sdong nas/ nang so dgos dgos/ phogs dang dgos cha sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos byas/'di skabs dang thugs rje chen po rgya phibs gsar bzheng dus sbus (112ba)srang gser khang pas sde pa/ 'go lung / bal po/ shing bzo/ rdo bzo ba so sor legs skyes bstar/ phan bde legs bshad gling pas ar ston rgya cher btang / ra mo che'i bar khang du bzhugs rgyu'i sprul sku bag dro can lo snga ma klu dbang gi rgyal po dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad bzhengs pa'i kha longs 'jig rten dbang phyug /sgrol dkar/ lhag par dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ shes rab 'khor lo/ tsunda/ khro gnyer can/ 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po/ dug sel ma/ mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can/ rigs byed ma rnams/ steng khang gsar du 'phar ba'i nang du thub dbang bdud 'dul/ gnas bcu/ dge bsnyen/hwa shang / rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa'i kha longs su 'od dpag med/ seng ge sgra/ phyag rdor zhi ba/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ mi 'khrugs pa/ byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs seng thon/ yum chen mo dang / ldebs brisabar khang du tshe dpag med bdun brgya dang steng khang du sgrol dkar bdun brgya rnams bzhengs/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos bsu bzlog /'chi blu/ grib sel/ drag dmar gyi gtor bzlog /gter gsar gyi tshe sgrub rnams mdzad/nyang gi mkha' 'gro chen mo dang rkyen sel gyi dbang 'ga' zhig zhus/ phar sde pa a bar dang —158

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadalhan du sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe dbang / gra tshang byings dang phyogs mtshungs par dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i thun mong ma yin pa dang lha rje dge 'bum gyi gter ma'i dpal lha'i rjes gnang phul/ padma gling pa'i gter ma'i rta phag khyad can gyi zhu rten byung bar brten o rgyan/ (114na〉skyen grol gling pa'i dgon gnas su gra dar lung dgon la gtogs pa'i bla brang spyil bcas/ mchod thebs kyi snon mar dgon pa'i sa khungs kyi 'bru khal bdun cu skor/ lho brag chag phug chung gi zhing thon 'bru khal brgya lhag /gtam shul nas lo lo bzhin gshor 'degs khal bdun brgya'i 'dzin dang tshogs khro che legs rnams sbyar/ bdog pa'i skyes phul te tshes dgu la rang gnas su thegs/tshes bcu bzhi la no mon e jen gyi nang mtshams kyi kha mchu bsdums par sprul sku dang rgyal pos mtshon pa'i dpon khag tshor yi ge rten sbrags dang bcas no yon khu thug thu btang / thang po che'i mkhan po byed mi khyams stad pa ngag dbang 'phrin las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bye rdzing mkhan po dang ri bo chos gling bla gra la tshe mdo/ gsar rtsom sman bla'i brgyud 'debs dang smon lam tshigs bcad 'ga'i lung phul/ gong dkar rdzong sdod sgem bu nas kyis tshan grangs dang bcas gra tshang gi gra pa brgyad gra zhig gis ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/tshes bco lnga la khyab bdag sman lung pa chen po padma 'od kyi zhing khams su sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor/ chos dbang rin po che'i gter byon gyi ga me gu ru'i drung du mchod pa rgya cher bshams te rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bltas te gsang 'dus bla ma'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas mchod pa phul/ sku gdung rin po cher gos yug la smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i snyan shal/ tshogs su 'dzugs rgyu'i sprul sku myur (114ba)byon gyi smon lam tshigs bcad/dgongs rdzogs kyi mthun rkyen du 'bru cha/ ja gos dar kha btags sogs tshan che tsam/ rten bzhengs gi thebs su dngul srang phyed nyis brgya/ gser srang gang / gang ci'i byed lugs rnams choge rje thub bstan par bslab bya mol bar khang gsar rab brtan btang zhing dad rten du snam sbyar 'byor ba nang —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)rten khrod du bzhag /bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan gyis bka' 'gyur skya pod bzhengs pa'i dkar chag sde tshan so so'i mjug tu smon lam dang bcas pa/ sgo mangs gra tshang spyi'i ngor slob dpon blo gros rgya mtsho/ stod rgyud spyis bskul ba'i slob dpon rim pa lnga/ bsam gtan bzang po'i ngor byes slob dpon 'jam dbyangs lhun grub/ tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi 'dod pa ltar skyabs gnas kun 'dus gsol ba 'debs pa rnams dang / bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos dung skyong dbang mor snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang rnams brtsams/nyer gnyis la grong smad a bar dang gra tshang la drang srong dri med kyi rig gtad/ yang bzlog rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang / phyag rdor gos sngon can dang rnam sras smad lugs ser chen gyi rjes gnang rnams phul/ gsol dpon ge ra bas tshogs chen du mang ja'i thog 'dzugs rgyu yin pas yun du gnas pa'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba brtsams/ gnam gang las skar rgyal gyi thog grong smad a bar la rigs 'dzin chen po'i gter gsar drag po dbu dgu'i rtsa dbang / rigs byed ma nang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul/ 'jam dpal nag po (115na)ba ri lugs kyi rnam 'joms/ sgrol dkar tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang rnams bskur/ 'dar pa lo tsā bas bskul ba'i rgyal rtse zhabs drung byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi brtan bzhugs dang / dbon po lha mo'i ngor dga' ldan shar pa chos rje byams pa bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs bris/'di lo dpyid ka sde pas thugs khur bzhes nas thang po cher nang so dkon cog dar rgyas dang spel nag ri can gnyis kyis do dam byas pa'i bka' 'gyur gser btul ma srang lnga brgya bzhi bcu skor las bzhengs pa'i gser chos hor gos kyi zhal khebs stong skud khra lhas kyi glegs thag rgya rag gi glegs chab/ tsandan gyis gtums pa'i glegs shing gdong la ba so brkos ma sogs rgyu phun sum tshogs pa las grub pa tshar gcig sde pa sger gyi sgrib sbyong du dmigs pa'i gser srang brgya so gnyis dang dngul srang sum brgya don gsum las grub pa'i khra chen gcig bcas bzhengs pa'i gla yon phogs —/60

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanasogs 'brur phab bsdoms par gshor khal brgyad khri lnga stong drug brgya bcu dgu song ba dang / la stod shel dkar du rdzong sdod gnyis dang smon grub pa rin chen bkra shis/ 'bri lung dbang rgyal rnams kyis do dam byas nas skya pod tshar gcig bzhengs pa'i dkar chag che brjod hor zla bdun pa'i tshes lnga la bris/tshes bdun rjes mar smad rgyud slob dpon gra bcas kyis bdog pa'i skyes bteg ste ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ bla ma lha pa'i dpon sa sa dpral g.yu byin zhing gtsug phud blangs nas ming ngag dbang sgrol mar (115ba)btags/ dpal de dpon sa/ hor rgya mtsho spun/ rta tshag rje drung / tsha mig mkhan po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sne mdo ba/ se ra'i slob dpon gsum sogs phrad mi kha yar byung / dga' ldan rab 'byams pa mtsho khar 'gro ba'i rdzong ba bstabs/ thub dbang gi li gsar brdar gad ma byas pa zhig sbyin byung / yer pa gra tshang spyi so nas ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar bris shing tshes bcu gnyis la gra slob rnams kyis tshan grangs maṇḍal dang bcas tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/'dul ba gra tshang gis rigs gra'i skal pa skyel bar slob dpon gra rigs dang slob dpon pa'i pha un 'dur dpon po can gsar du 'byor ba'i sger gyi bdog pa bstar/ 'bras spungs kyi gra rgan bkra shis rgya mtsho da la'i chos rjer grags pa gsar du slebs pa dang phrad/ rong nas chos rje thub bstan pas yi ge mkhas grub rong pa sher seng gi zhal gzigs ltar thugs rten du bzhengs pa'i dus 'khor gyi dkyil thang sprin gseb ma rong sham bha ra gyi rten grags can de dang bcas byung don ltar dngul gdung gi phra rgyan du phub sgor gcig /dpral g.yu gnyis/ spyi khebs gcig /me shel gnyis/ byu ru'i brgya 'phreng /gtsug lag khang gi shing cha'i mthun rkyen la ka thog par hung rgya bskur/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis ri bo chos gling dang bkra shis chos sder 'dzugs rgyu'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung tshigs bcad/pho brang ge ra chos mdzad spun gnyis kyis gra tshang du chos srung spyi bye brag la snyan dar sna lnga phul ba'i zhal byang dgos tshul byung ba bris zhing 'bras spungs su mang ja'i thog ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad (116na)gsar bskul btsugs/—161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)tshes nyi shu la bzang ldan mkhan po rgyal rtse zhabs drung kun dga' bsod nams grags pa gshegs pa'i zhal chems bzhin snyan brgyud glegs bam sogs tshan grangs nye gnas chos grags kyis bsrings don bzhin grub mtha' snyogs par lam gyi gegs sel smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ oṃ gsum ma'i 'bru 'bum sogs thugs dam shin tu smin pa yod 'dug pas mkha' spyod du gshegs par mngon/mkhan po'i gsos skal gyi don du drung chen chos grags kyis grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i tshems shig sde par phul ba lag tu son/ mtsho kha nas chog thu tha'i ji'i mi sna 'byor/ yongs 'dzin sprul sku grib zhags kyis phyag zhabs mi bde ba'i snyun dam pos btab kyang 'gro ba rnams rjes su brtse bas gzhan phan gyi srung ba'i rigs mang po par du bzhengs shing slar bzheng rgyu'i gnas tshul gyi sam ṭa byung ba thugs sems kyis ri 'khor ba rang du yod snang / lug pa lung pa nas so bar byung ba'i thun dong nag po 'dre 'jigs gra snye mdo ba'i grags can de la sde bas blus ma btang ba'i lag tu son/nyer gsum la lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi phyogs bzhi'i gañdzi ra/ ra mo che'i sgo lcog steng gi gsum dang bcas pa'i bdun la gdung sha rī ram gyis gtsos pa'i sku bal gyi ring bsrel/ chos sku'i ring bsrel/ bod khams bde thabs kyi 'khor lo sogs gzungs bzhugs 'bul bar mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gnyis rdzong (116ba)bda' byas/nyer drug la stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras/ lcam nor bu khra sgor/ stag lung phyag mdzod pa/ yun 'dur er khe dpon po can la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur/ zur ri/ sngags lcog /ha ri kha'i bla ma/ rgyal po'i er khe je'i sang can dang phrad/ 'dzum lang rgyal po'i mi sna pa phran rā dza dang lo tsā ba lhun grub slebs pa'i phyag bris yul lugs dang bstun pa'i rten bzang ba 'byor/ bsnyen rdzogs bcu gcig dang dge tshul dgu bsgrubs/ gdan gong nas bka' shog gnang skyes gra tshang du mang 'gyed dang bcas ring por gnas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig par tshong dpon bsod nams mgon po gnang / stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyis mchims phu'i gnas 'dzin sgrub sde rnams la bsnyen bkur ba'i dus sdig —/62

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)pa sbyang ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul bris/tor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis la gdong nas kyis lcam dbyangs can ma'i phyi rten du 'od dpag med dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dang bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang tshan mi g.yo ba sngon po'i mngon rtogs/ bdag mo'i rgyun 'byer du gsol 'debs dang bshags pa'i tshigs bcad/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dang mkhan 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs/ mchod dpon pa'i ngor dam can dang chu rgyud rgyal po'i gtor bsngo/ khro 'char g.yul bzlog pa rnams kyi zhal 'don du skabs su babs par mngon nas rtsa gsum gsol 'debs la ja mchod kyi dus 'don pa bsgyur (117na)chog pa rnams brtsams/ma rgyud lugs kyi rus pa'i rgyan drug cha tshang yod rung pha rgyud nas bshad pa'i shel rgyan ma 'byor pa khungs btsun zha lu dang gong dkar rdo rje gdan na yod 'dug cing / 'brug pa sprul sku bya 'jam dbyangs chos grags kyis yum gyi sku rgyan la bzos pa'i grags can zhig snang ba zhib tu dpyad tshe gzhung rgyan 'dzoms rgyan rnams gser la phul ba las phra ha cang mi phyug pas rgyu song yang don dang mi mthun mod/'on kyang rgyu bzang ngan rang la bltos rgyu ci yod rung dwags brgyud pa rnams phyag rgya chen por gcig tu 'byams klas drags pas rgyud sde'i phyogs la gzigs pa ma chug pa'i nyams kyis rgyu'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs rus rgyan kho nar dpe blangs shing zhwa nag gser mdongs kyis khrom dang 'bul ba sdud pa'i tshab la shel rgyan bzhes kyin yod 'dug pa de 'dra khungs dang mi 'brel bar ma zad 'dir brgya 'bul du ming btags tshad la zha dang rgyan sprod dgos byung na rgya hor gyi 'brel lam stabs nas langs phyid ga la yong na'ang ched du gnyer ba'i dgos don pha rgyud dang 'brel ba'i sa gar mchod gar/ dbang /sbyin sreg gi cha lag tu dgos pas bzo bdun yod pa rim lus su song ba sde pas brtson pa chen pos khur blangs/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i brog zhu sogs la yid brtan du bzung / pha rgyud kyi dgongasadon 'brul med bzhin shog dper bkod/ gzhung rgyan 'dzoms rgyan phal cher gru dkar dmar gyi phra/—163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'ga' zhig tu ga dza mu tig mthe bong nyis 'gyur tsam gyi (117ba)tshad shin tu dkon pa/ beeḍūrla ser po dra ba dra phyed rnams rgya mu tig kho na las grub/ phra rgyab kyi gdan ma ngang 'bu ril la gser btso ma zho nyis stong go gnyis/ rgyu dngom che ba las lcags khyi hor zla gnyis pa nas bzo gra btsugs/ do dam sde pa rag pa rnam sras dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor/ lhug pa gsum dang / rjes su rag pa'i tshab bka' brgyad sbug pas byas te lcags phag hor zla bdun pa'i nang du legs par grub pa bal po bcu gnyis kyis las rgyun lo gcig zla ba gnyis song ba'i phogs yon ston mo sogs 'bru ngor bsgril bar mkha' ru'i khal stong phrag dgu dang brgya zhe bdun song ba sde pas phyag dar nas sgrogs pa tshes gsum nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor thog rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du tshe chog btang ba'i tshogs kyi dga' ston dang 'brel bar shel rgyan rnams mig lam du phab/ rtser slebs thog chas 'jug gi skar 'dzin rten 'brel 'grig par byung zhing de thog stag ru bas legs skyes kyi tshan grangs spel/ sde pas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi bla ma 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel yan thang kha gra tshar nga gcig lcags phag zla ba dang po'i zla stod nas dbu mdzad dpal dgon gyi gtsos mkhas bsgrugs nyi shu rtsa gsum gyis bzhengs pa zla ba 'di nang 'grub tu nye ba'i mdun yig gi che brjod smon lam dang bcas pa bkod/tshes brgyad nas nyin gsum gyi bar drang srong a ga sdu'i rang 'od kyi chu'i (118na)dug rnams bsal te dus kyi yan lag brgyad ldan du bsgyur skabs chu klung chen po'i 'gram du lus kyi 'phrod bsten dang sbrags spyod yul yangs pa'i ljongs rgyu ba skabs su babs na'ang rdzong gi rta lam thag ring zhing nad ro sogs kyis 'gro 'dug mang bar dge mtshan che ba mi snang gshis mer te gtsang po dang gsang yig sman chu nas dre'u sa drangs te nyin gsum gyi bar ro stod la chu sder rgyag pa'i 'phrod bsten ci nus su byas/ zur rig sngags 'chang ba gzhis ka shar a gur gyis tshes bcu'i dus gsol 'debs dang ja mchod gang 'os la bsgyur chog pa'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul bzhin bris/ btsan rgod dar —/64

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)'ongs te rta bcu bdun gyis gtsos pa'i zang zing gi bdog pa bstar/ tshes bcu la ra sgreng mkhan po thog rdugs pa/ rdzing phyi mkhan zur gzims dpon gyi las 'dzin rnying pa byams pa rin cen/ rta tshag sprul pa'i sku/ tshal sde pa grags pa yum sras/ o rod se chen rgyal po'i mi sna sogs dang phrad/ bdag mo lho khar 'byon gdong mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi bka' bsgo phul/ gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad kyis gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag dang log tri'i sgrub pa gnyis sdebs su btsugs/ rta tshag sprul pa'i sku gra skor mdzad bzhed kyi rgyu mtshan byung ba sprul sku gong ma'ang gzigs rgya che rab mchis rung bsdus tshad kyi phyogs su zhal 'dris rngo ma thogs pa'i skyon gyis sngar stong 'khor zhabs drung yon tan rgya mtsho se rar thugs gnyer mdzad skabs gra pa kha rgyags pa zhig gis/ bdag med yin (11sha bsko yod pas khyab pa'i sku/ /de la skyon ni gtong mkhan med pa'i gsung / /btang na gar 'gro 'dir 'gro med pa'i thugs/ kha btags rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes brtsams pa'i dpe bzhin gra skor gyi dam bca'i dus zhal blangs zin po zhig ye byung ma song bas bzo nyes slob dpon gyi don bzhin sku tshe 'di la de dang mi 'dra ba zhig byung na snyam pas chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung lugs la thos bsam gnang bar ra ba stod kyi chos gra 'grim par skor cig phebs pa 'gab ces mol bas/ sprul pa'i sku thugs rig spyi dang mi 'dra ba grung po zhig 'dug gshis chos grar byon song ba thugs skyed che ba'i mtshan nyid kyi ston pa tshad ldan gyi sgo dod skad/ rgya btab ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang du gsar bzhengs kyi sku rnams dang sde pas thugs bcad kyi thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i zhabrungs rabs gra tshar bzhengs pa tsho'i gzungs 'bul sde pa nyid kyis gtso mdzad lag len pa rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa can kha shas kyis byas nas ru nga par phul zhing ra mo che'i steng khang du gnas bcu dang bar khang du sman bla rnams bzhugs su gsol ba'i gnas bcu lha khang du snyan dar kha btags che chung bsdoms pa nyis brgya sum cu skor/ mthing khra drug /sde pas bslab ston mdzad de gnyer pa sbyin pas bkra shis khang gsar du bzos pa'i khro kong bzhi/—165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lanagazhan yang gos 'phan sku gzugs ma che ba brgyad/ 'phan chung zhe drug /mthongs gan gos tshon khra/rgyan (119na)bzhi/ kha thi sngo dmar gyis byas pa'i gnam rgyan lnga/ sman bla lha khang du snyan shal che chung bsdoms pa brgya sum cu skor/ khro kong gong 'dra/ 'phan che ba brgyad dang chung ba zhe gnyis/ bzang gos sna tshogs kyi gnam rgyan bdun/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rjer gos yug lnga dang ling dkar yug /nyin bde ma gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i kha btags nyer brgyad/ dar yug bzhi/ mchod kong drug /ling skyer gyi snam sbyar/ ding phon dang bum gdan ma nyis sbrel gyi bla bre/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan la nyin bde ma gcig the ba'i bcu bzhi/ nye sras sgo srung spyir kha btags dang sman tse bsdoms par nyis brgya skor/ 'du khang du bum gdan gsar ma bzhi dang dkyus ma bzhi sbrel ba gcig gis gtsos gos sna tshogs la sa grub pa'i gnam rgyan bcu gcig /'phan che chung bsdoms pa so gnyis/ kha thi'i phye phur che ba gnyis/ gos sna tshogs kyi phye phur bcu gnyis/ dar ling tshon spel gyi rgyal mtshan cha gnyis/ seng g.yabs la zangs khra sbra yol gyi khebs bcas/ brgya mchod kyi dgos cha la lo rer phye dang mchod 'bru so sor mkhar khal sum brgya drug cu re gsum/ mar khal chig stong dang brgyad brgya/ gtsang spos brgya bam sum brgya drug cu tham pa/ gon ma rnam pa bzhi ma bcu gnyis/ sman bla gtong mi dge 'dun bzhi sde'i rtsis 'khrir mchod rdzas ting lnga brgya/ kong bu nyis brgya/ hor sil/ rnga zlum/ dung dkar/ khrus bum/spos gzhong re/ khro/ zangs ban/ zangs rgyan so sor cha/ ka to ra (119ba)dang lcags skyogs gsum re/ mchod khri bang rim gsum pa/ brgya mchod khang lcam gang mar lcags khra gling bzhi logs bcad can rnams ji srid kyi bar gnas pa'i gra bsgrigs shing la rgya'i dkon gnyer dge skos grags pa rgya mtshos byas/ mchod 'bul 'di nged rang gi blo la yod rung gtso bor sde pa rang gi thugs bzhed yin/dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi dngul gdung lha khang gi steng du 'khrungs rabs bsgrig pa'i zhal bkod mdzad song ba/ de yang sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dus 'bras spungs su lam rim dang mkhan brgyud gra tshar bzhengs pa tshor khri sogs so so'i cha lag tshang ba dgos rgyur skyid shod phyogs 'dir de rigs kyi —/66

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasrol ma dar ba'i stabs mdzad pa ma shar/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis yar klungs bkra shis chos sde'i lam zab lha khang dang gong dkar chos sde'i lam 'bras lha khang / za dam gyi zung 'jug brgyud pa sogs gzigs pa'i gshis 'dir yang bla ma so sor khri rgyab yol/ gos kyi dbu zhwa/ ber zlam/ 'gan sbyar/ cog tse dang bcas pa/ gtso bo'i mdun cog steng du gar gan 'brug ma/ stegs/ spyi blugs/bzed zhal/ rnam rgyal bum pa/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnams dngul las grub pa/ theg chen gan dril rdor bcas/ gi gu shel gyi ting bdun tshar/ khro'i me dam cha/ bla sku gzhan so sor dril bu rdor bcas/rnam bum/ zhal dkar/ rag gi stegs/ spyi blugs/ bzed zhal rnams re/ ting gsar gra mtshudas brgya dang bcu gnyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub la phyag 'phreng tsandan la ma ṇi brkos pa las grub pa/ do (120na)'dzin rgyan bcas/ mchod cog bang rim gsum par dngul gyi maṇḍal gnyis/ bya ma bum gnyis/ tsha gser gyi maṇḍal g.yu rtsi ma/ dkar dam gnyis/ bya ma bum gnyis/ phor pa bdun/sder ma bstobazhi/ gi gu shel gyi ting bcu bzhi/ blug shel gyi bum pa gnyis/ li ting bdun tshar gsum/'do la cog rgyab ma'i me dam gcig /rag gi me dam che chung brgyad/ spos 'dam gyi ri brag gzugs gcig /khro dang rag kong che chung gsum re/ mañdzi gnyis/ sku rnams kyi rgyab tu sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga si'u ma'i gos yol gong par dngul gyi ma ṇi nyi ma'i rgyan yod pa/ bum gdan lnga sbrel zhig gis gtsos bzang gos kyi gnam rgyan che chung lnga/ gan gos kyi gdung khebs dang de la btags pa'i 'phan chung drug cu tham pa/ mar me sdong rkang gsum dang zhal zas gsum re'i rgyun mchod btsugs/tshes bcu drug la a mdo rkyang ri skor gyis rta bcu gnyis kyi phyag rten byung / sde pa thon pa bkra shis rab brtan dang mtsho kha nas gsar du 'byor ba'i kho shi go'u chi mer gan tha'i ji sogs mang ba dang phrad/ tshes bcu bdun nas bdun gcig gi ring 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra/ mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa'i thugs dam rten gyi sgrol ma/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan la gsung byon pa'i gling kha sgrol ma rnams gdan drangs pa'i dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa dang bcas thugs rje —167—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)chen po dang jo mo sgrol ma la gsol 'debs bzlas brjod nan tan du byas na'ang las nyon gyi sgrib pa'i bag chags ha cang 'thug drags pas rmi lam (120ba〉spegs pa tsam yang ma byung bar rang nyid kyis skyon las skyabs yul tshor 'khang ra brdung rgyu ni ci la yod/ chos sde chen po phan tshun du gzhan gyi zur ja med pa'i gseng thams cad la skol ba'i ja tshul zla ba gsum gyi yun btang / gsang sngags rnying ma'i phyogs su gshin rje me'i spu gri dang sngags rgod log tri gnyis kyi mtshan rlung ltar grags shing dbang lung thor bu'i rgyun shin tu 'bol na'ang lag len man ngag yongs rdzogs kyi mtha' chod shig mdzub sprod rgyu yod pa chos rgyal 'bri gung pa tsam ma gtogs phyogs gang du'ang gser bton pa'i sa ror snang bas mchod rten dkar nag gi bca' gzhi mun nag 'dom mjal du ma song ba'i 'khrul med kyi phyag len ltar bzo rtsis kyi rdzas dang yo byad kyi sta gon byas/ e pa sprul sku bag dro can gyis bzos shing tshon rtsi sogs kyang legs pa bsgrubs/ gzungs bzhugs spyir btang gis rgyas mi khebs pa'i gnubs chen brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes chos rgyal 'bri gung par bka' babs pa bzhin nged rang gis phul ba'i lag g.yog mchod dpon pa dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas byas pa'i dngos shin tu gtsang ba yod/ a mdo a drag skor gyis rta lnga bcu nga gsum byin pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/nyer bdun la dga' ldan phun tsho gos gling slob dpon sa ra ha pa blo gros rnam rgyal/ dga' ldan gsang gling bla ma ngag dbang nor bu/ thar gling pa blo bzang chos 'phel/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ stag lung dbu ma phyag mdzod rnams dang phrad/ drung 'tsho gsum dga' dang dar mo sman rams pa gnyis kyi rin (121na)chen rta ri mar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa las shin tu rgyas pa zin tig lugs ltar dang zla shel sbyor bcug pa'i sman dang dgos cha'i rigs shin tu 'dzom pa'i gtod che bar sbyar ba/lhag tu lo sngon ma btso bkru song ba'i dngul chu'i phan yon la brten nad pa'i rigs gang byin ngo so thon pa byung / sde pa 'ol dga'i chu tshan gyi zhon la rgyal me tog thang gi gtor gsos mdzad rtsis 'dug pa bzhin gtsug lag khang dang mgon khang tshor 'bul ba'i snyan shal la 'dri rgyu'i tshigs bcad/ mchod —168

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanadapon ngag dbang shes rab kyis byams chen dang chos skyong kha shas la sgron rgyu'i snyan dar kha yig bkod/nyer dgu la sde pa dpon g.yog rgyal 'ol phyogs su bteg grub rjes gtsang bkra shis lhun po nas phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan 'byor pa sde par zhal dkar 'bul ba sogs mjal na ma mjal yod tshul byung bas bsgugs na yun ring zhing 'ol dga' phyogs la snyeg dgos shar tshe mi khal la gzan pas mi 'chag tu bgrod pa 'gab tshul labs pa ltar rnam sras khang gsar du mjal thub ste phyir 'khor ba'i hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gnyis la nged rang dang phrad/ gos dar gyi ster cha spams bstod/'a shur dang zung chu rnams kyi 'grul pa 'byor ba'i rta brgya lhag gi rnyed pa bstabs/tshes gsum la bkra shis lhun po phyag mdzod kyi 'dod pa bzhin gra tshang gis 'bras gshongs dag snang gi mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs thog maṇḍal gyi tshul du ster cha tshan che ba dang grwa pa tshor kha btags dang dngul srang re'i 'gyed btang / phyag mdzod (121ba)par mi g.yo ba ba ri lugs kyi rjes gnang bdog pa'i tshan grangs dang bcas te rdzong bda' byas/ dbyar tshong 'dus bya khrid mig gcig pas stod hor bzlog pa'i rten 'brel du phyag rdor gyi sku bzheng dgos pa'i lung bstan ltar hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nas bal po sirnyi can gyis bzheng ba'i 'go brtsams pa 'di skabs grub par gzungs bzhugs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas phul te po ta la'i rgya nag lha khang du bzhugs su gsol bar chos skyong gi gsung bzhin snyan dar zhal byang ma sgron zhing me tog gtor/ pā ras 'bul dpon gyis rta bcu bdun/ gra pa spyis bdun cu/ bya bral bstan pa bzang po can gyis rta so bzhi/ bstan pa shes rab kyis rta nyi shu rnams byung /tshes bzhi nas slar yang sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya bdun gcig gi bar bgyis te rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi bsnyen pa'i kha gsos/ 'bri gung gter sgrom gyi rang byung khrus kyi rdzing bu nas chu drangs te nyin bdun gyi bar 'phrod bsten byas/ zung chu blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis rta nyer gcig gi rnyed pa bstar/ 'phreng ba zhe lnga ma'i dkyil thang rgyab yig /lha sa khang gsar pa dge bsnyen khyo shugs —169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)kyis bka' 'gyur dang byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos rnying ma rgyud 'bum bzhengs pa'i dkar chag smon lam/ 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang lho'i steng gi 'dra 'bag la byang gling pas mchod pa rgyun btsugs kyi smon lam/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis gra tshang la 'bul rgyu'i mtshan brgyad kyi bris thang che legs dang dge slong dpal rgyam pa'i gser thang du ma'i rgyab yig rnams bris/nyer bdun la cha gan no mon khan (122na)gyi sku skyes gser srang brgya dang rta brgya/ ja ko dra gtos che ba/ bya bral dkon cog can gyis rta nga dag shes rab can gyis zhe lnga sogs zang zing gi bdog pa'i 'phrin las tshar du dngar/ gsang phu gling smad chos rje/ ngor mkhan po thar rtse ba'i gsol dpon mi rgyu hor yin pa/ bkra shis ljongs cho me rje/ dga' ldan 'og min gling gi bla ma tsha ba rab 'byams pa rnams dang phrad/ ngor mkhan po de gsan rgya che rab yod tshod du 'dug kyang 'phros gleng la brjod pa gtsang ba'i rnam dpyod can mi snang / gnam gang la ru bzhi'i bsnyen gnas ma tshor yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims phab/ dge slong brgya sum cu dang / cha gan no man khan gyi sku skyes gtso medage tshul nyis brgya bdun cu bsgrubs/zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig la no mon khan gyi sku skye can la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur/ chos sde chen po phan tshun du mang ja'i thog nyer spyad kyi dngos po dang ja sogs spong dag gi 'gyed rgyas par phul/ sngags khang dang gnas chung lcog tu nyin gsum gyi bar bskang gso btsugs/ yung shi ye bu klu mgon tha'i jis rta bco lnga byin/ tshes bzhi'i nyin grong smad sde pa a bar la tshe dbang kha shas bskur/ lnga la sde pa dpon g.yog phyir 'khor ba'i khams gsum du phrad/ sang nyin rgyal sras bsod nams bkra shis dang 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon las thog pa rnams la ja gral btang / dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis 'dzugs ja brgyab pa'i tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i ja mchod phun tshogs 'dod dgu ma zhes rjod byed kyi tshig (122ba 'jebs shing brjod bya'i don ngo mtshar can de gra tshang gi tsho gos su btsugs/ don gnyis gling pa'i gra pa zhig gis—170

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)phar phyin gsar rtsom gyi rgyugs sprad/ byang gling bsam grub rgyal por nyin thang gi sgrol dkar zhig byin par brten rgyun 'don la dgos pa'i mngon rtogs nyung ngu / drug brgya dge slong gi kha ton du pha bong kha pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsol 'debs/ lha sa khang gsar bas ma'i ched du rmi ru bar zhing phul ba'i dge ba bsngo tshig /nged rang gi bdag 'jug len rten kyai rdor man ngag lugs dang bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dkyil thang gsar bzhedas kyi rgyab yig /rje btsun rin po che grags pa dang tshar chen gyi sku thang sde pa'i dad rten du bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig tshigs bcad lag bris ma/ bdag mos sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ o rgyan rin po che/ jo bo chen po/ rgyal ba btsong kha ba/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag dang bcas par yan lag gi rjes yod pa'i bris thang bzhengs pa rnams kyi kha byang / ngor mkhan pos e waṃ tshogs chen du 'dzugs rtsis kyi gsung gis bskul ngor ring 'tsho'i smon lam tshigs bcad/ dge slong yon tan bkra shis kyi 'dod sbyar bzhin smon lam dang rgyud smad byang 'dren blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i bdag bstod rnams bris/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po gnyisakyi gsung gis bskul zhing mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis zhabs mthud par brten tshe dpag med/ thugs rje chen po/ bka' brgyad spyi bye brag /mtshan brgyad/ jo mo gnyis/ drag dmar/ rta mgrin/phyag rdor sogs rgya can phal cher gyi 'phrin las sgrub thabs dbang (123na)byin rlabs rig gtad kyi lag len nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i bang mdzod/ re ma ti'i gtor chog dbang rig gtad kyi chog khrigasayongs bo'i ljon pa/ yang gsang ga rma drag po'i las byang dbang gtor bzlog rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i bshan pa rnam rol rnams bkod pa'i yig mkhan dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas byas pa cho ga'i de nyid shes pa'i nyams kyis yi ge dag cing mgyogs pa byung /tshes bcu gsum la mtsho kha nas gsar 'byor mer gan hung tha'i ji'i bu/ dpon mo gnyis g.yog bcas/ bdag mo rnams dang mjal/ tshong 'dus nas bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pas sde pa nyid kyisathog drangs/ gra sa phan tshun/ drung 'khor skya ser/ lha sa pa'i gnas khag sogs mgrin gcig pa'i ngos—171—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gra tshang gis ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs na legs pa'i lung bstan byung bar brten rgyas pa zhig mdzad bzhed 'dug kyang de rigs kyis bca' bkod bsgrigs tshe thams cad phan tshun 'gran pa lta bus bdog pa'i skyes spel ba'i nad langs te don khral 'gel rang du 'gro ba'i mtsher po mchis pas tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin ja sbyor gnyis kyi thog gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga la brten pa'i 'khyer bde mdzad cing / drag rim nas thor bus tshan grangs 'os 'gab dang dmangs ma rnams kyis mjal dar las spros pa'i 'gro sgo med gshis rim gro la 'gyur ba'i tshad cig byung / skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan mtsho kha nas 'khor ba'i gnas tshul zhib par mol/ sde pa'i grang gzhi'i snyun la chu tshan kyis kyang ha cang phan pa ma byung 'dug pas nged (123ba)rang dang dar mo ba mol bsdur ngos gtar kha phul ba zla ba brgyad tsam gyi bar gdangs pa'i 'phrod ngo che nges byung / dbyar stod dpon tshangs mkhas pa mang pos bdud rtsi sman gyi sbyor ba grangs med mdzad pa'i lag rjes khrag phor pa gang gis bsubs par snang /rjes gcod du me btsa' zhig bzhag na slar mi ldang ba yong rigs la thugs la ma ldan pas rta po'i sgal bcos kyi dper song dogs nan tan ma nus/lnga mchod chen mo'i gling me stod smad tshor legs nyes sna tshogs byung 'dra zhing nye skor tshor 'bar po ma byung rung la la legs pa'i snyan brjod kyang che ba pad las yin nam lha mi yi dwags gsum gyis chu phor ba gang la mthong tshul mi 'dra ba'i dpe yin ni ma shes/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis la bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po btsun mo sras blon 'bangs kyis yongs su bskor te rta rmig gi sa'i rdul gyis nam mkha' 'grib pa lta bu dang bcas byon pa snga dro tshoms chen du mjal zhing 'tsham 'dri yul lugs dang bstun pa'i dri bshad rgyas par byung / phyi dro rgyal gling mkhan po/ rdzing phyi mkhan po/ bde chen yangs pa can gyi spyan snga/ thugs sras sprul sku/ sdings po che sprul sku/ rta ra mdo ba khu mtshan sogs bod sog gi phrad mi shin tu mang / mer gan shung tha'i ji'i btsun ma gnyis kyis gos dang ja dngul gyi brgya 'bul/ tre bo hor tshang gi yong mis rta so gnyis dang —172

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)dre'u zhe dgus gtsos pa'i bdog pa rgya cher spel/ bla ma gzhan rnams dang kong po kha thag gi gsung gleng / sdings po che bas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo nas smra ba'i sgo 'phar ci yang phye/ mdo pa chos (124na)rje dge ba'i dbang po mkhas btsun bzang gsum gang nas kyang gral 'gor dgos rgyur khong khu tshan go ldog pa zhig snang ba mchod rten mas sbom gyi dper gda'/tshes gsum la ngor mkhan po dang mdo pa chos rje/ 'dar pa lo tsā bas mtshone kha shas la dbyangs can su la'i pho lha'i rjes gnang / de'i sgrub skor/ mkhan pos bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi lung phul/ bsnyen rdzogs pa zhe dgu dang dge tshul bcu dgu bsgrubs/ tshes brgyad nas gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad kyis 'jam dpal gshin rje dmar po rlung sgrub kyi las sbyor btsugs/ gra tshang gi gra dmangs tsho gsum du bgos te/ lha sa/ ra mo che/ 'bras spungs kyi rten gsar rnams la tshes bcu'i nyin rab tu gnas pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon lha sar chos rje kha rag pa/ ra mo cher dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/'bras spungs dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis byas pa'i zhabs tog yon sogs rgyas pa byung tshod du 'dug /tshes bco lnga la chab mdo rje drung rin po che'i sprul sku/ bon g.yung drung gi mig gcig pu sku mdun lhun grub/ a mdo pa'i rta 'bul ba kha shas/ nag tshangs lha skyabs can phrad mi mang / 'bri gung nasarigs 'dzin dkon chog lhun grub kyis gtan du gnas pa'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs te byung bar de don gyi lan bi warta can bskur/ khams nas dpon mkha' 'gros gangs dkar spun gsum gnas lugs kyi rgyu mtshan dang bcas bsangs mchod kyi bskul ma mdzad pa dpon thugs ris rgyas drags pa'i rgyu mtshan (124ba)bden brdzun ji ltar yang gang smed la slob dpon bcol te yi ger bkod/ ge ra chos mdzad blo bzang dge 'dun bro nad dam pos gtses par rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs dang tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs kyi lung bklags/ srung ba dang gter sbyin gang legs byas/ 'on kyang bka' gdams glegs bam rin po cher gsungs pa bzhin pho —173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)lha bdud babs kyis mtha' tshes mdog kha mo mi snang / bstan 'dzin dpon mos rnga mo drug cu re bzhi dang / nag shod sbus na de'i bla mas rta bcu drug byin/ lar nas shi son gyi don du ngal ba khyad du bsad nas 'ongs pa'i ster sbyin tshan po cher bsngo smon sogs gang yong gi khul byas na'ang dkor nag 'di 'ju ba zhig yong ris su mi 'dug pas bla chen tsho'i phebs lam de rgya bal gyi dpya 'phrang las kyang dka' ba las 'os ci mchis/ da lta ni thams cad khri mthon po'i steng na thugs bag dro bar snang /nyer bdun la 'bras spungs ha sdong khams tshan gyis dkar spro dmar spro'i gzhis len ster cha dang bcas pas bzabs/ sang nyin lha gzigs phag mo gru pa'i bdag mo rtse chen ma nga las nu sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas lhung ba lta bu de dang bkra shis ljongs chos rje/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod sogs bod sog kyi skye bo mang por ja gral btang / stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyi dgongs rdzogs su dbu ma phyag mdzod blo bzang ngag dbang gis bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i dkar chag smon lam bris/ khong pa bla ma'i phyag g.yog tu 'gyur ches pa'i kun (125na)dga' bo dang mtshungs pa'i bsngags brjod rgyas par bris pa yin na'ang 'od srungs chen pos kun dga' bo gnas nas phyung ba'i rten 'brel yin nam/ zhabs drung zur pa'i dgongs phog la brten sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'ang cung zad mthong bar snang / bya khyung mkhan po ye shes rgya mtsho dang o rod g.yon ru da'i chin kho sho'u chi'i dge tshul ma dang bu dpon mo sogs 'grul pa gtos che ba dang phrad/ de nyin ta 'an mnyu shrī chos rje can gyis rgya sog gi dngos po'i bdog pa bag dro chil le ba bstar/rmi ru ba bla gra rnams kyis bzhes spro ster cha dang bcas bla ma brag sgo bas brtsams pa'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ pad chen chos 'khor nas tshan grangs dang bcas te ring por 'tsho nga gos pa'i 'phrin yig mdzad/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum par du ma 'khod pa'i thor bu/ blo sbyong skor/ cha lag bco brgyad par byang dang bcas pa/ nged rang gi brtsams cho me kha yar rnams dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du brkos grub pa skyel mi 'byor/ cha lag bco brgyad 'di sman rgyal gu ṇa sa bdud —174

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanartsi'i snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud bzhi'i dgongs don 'grel par mdzad pa'i med thabs med pa zhig yin na'ang par du brkos dgos pa'i dbus gtsang gi dpon tshang chen po rnams kyis bskul ma mi mdzad mod/ dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis mtshams sbyar ba'i rkyen las byung ba gso dpyad kyi bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa lta bur song / par (125ba〉skyel ba yar 'gro ba dang lhan du rgyal btsong kha ba chen po'i rnam thar rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho so bsgrigs pa/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dam tshig rnam bshad/ bka' dge dgongs pa gcig sgrub gsal pa'i sgron me/ las chen kun rgyal ba'i dri lan/ thams cad mkhyen pa gtsang chung chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i bzang spyod kyi ṭīkka shin tu legs shing dkon pa/ sde pa'i thugs 'dod ltar gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma bsam pa lhun grub dang bcas pa/ chos rgyal byang pas mdzad pa'i rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang gter lnga dang gter ston brgya rtsa'i gsol 'debs/ gsang ba snying por thos bsam byed mkhan byung na 'grel pa mang rab brkos pa des mi 'thus rgyu mi 'dug rung gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i thugs bzhed bzhin phyogs bcu mun sel/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i kye rdor gyi bskyed rim legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer dang dkyil chog gi lhan thabs nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ kun mkhyen go bo dang paṇa chen shāka mchog gi yig cha la a pha'i gsol zhal gtsang ba'i skyo ma snga btsan mang mod/zur gnas shig gis brtags tshe kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho dang paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha gnyis tshig don bzang bar mngon pas mkhan chen ngag chos pas mdzad pa'i sdom gsum rab dbye'i rnam bshad zla 'od nor bu/ brtag gnyis ṭīkka bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ slob bshad rtsod spong / rgyud gsum gyi khog 'bugs/ de'i spyi don rgyud gsum la 'jug pa'i sgo/ 'di ga'i brtsams (126na)chos dkar chag /snyan dar/ yig bskur/ smon lam/ bla ma'i bstod tshogs kyi 'phro 'thud/ bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti'i dkar chag rnams par gyi ma dper bskur/ lho brag dga' ldan don gnyis gling gi gra pa zhig gis gsar rtsom 'jug pa'i ṭīkka/ spyi don/ thal 'phreng gi rgyugs sprad/ rgya'i hwa shang sman shes —175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 'depa zhig rgya bod kyi gnas rten mjal bar dar rtse mdo brgyud yongs pa gegs med du slebs par ngos phrad byas tshe phyag kha tshur bstad de gsum btsal/de nas chos skyong la 'tshal zhes phyir bstad nas gsum 'tshal ba'i dmangs dang mi mthun pa zhig gda'/ sman btab pas mig gi 'grib sel ba'i man ngag zab mo 'dug pa sems can mang por phan na snyam pa'i blos bskul te drung 'tsho ba ngag dbang lhag bsam bslab tu bcug /mi de ca po la dga' tshor cher mi byed kyang yon du dngul srang bcu dang gon pa cha tshang byin par dngul tshur slog 'dug /rgya gar du 'gro ba la phan grogs dgos pa'i lam yig 'dar los rgya gar phal skad du bsgyur lkog pa bas nā ga ra'i yi ge bris te gtad pas dga' tshor chen po byed par snang / drung 'tsho bas sman btab pas mig kha shas bye ba'i phan thogs pa yang byung bar mchis/ lar yon tan gyi rigs su yod yod la ma bslabs na khengs pa'i ri rtser chu bo gyen la ldog par dka'/ phur sgrub kyi rdo rje slob dpon dang gdab las chen mo'i bsgral mchod byed par nged rang 'gro ba'i bab 'brel 'dug rung 'bam gyi ro ma 'di gzhung bzang drags pas bcar sdod byed kyin yod gshis tshogs yun ring po dang (126ba)gar 'chams ma lcogs pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag 'then/ spos phor ba/ mgron gnyen rnams la rin cen rgyan sprod kyi srol yod pa dkyus ma la byas pa ma 'gab pas sgrub mchod la sde pa ma bzhugs pa sogs gang ci nas skabs su ma babs rung ngo tshab tu byon pa'i rten 'brel tsam mdzad/ gong nas gser yig par me rin jang gi a jin da'i/ bo ji jang gi /ma lu rjar go chi sogs mi skya drag pa dgu /cha gan thi yan chi'i bsngo zhus pa can 'grul sdebs kyang ma nyungs pa 'dug /byams gling em chi sangs rgyas 'byung gnas pho brang nas yongs skabs 'grul sdebs pa'i gras la gdang la skor nas mi snar song ba gang du ngos 'dzin ni dpyad dka' bar snang /tshes nyi shu la mi sna rnams kyis gong gi bka' shog dang gnang sbyin sprad cing 'grul sdebs dang bcas par gzhis len bzabs/ sang nyin nas so sos gos dar gser dngul gyi ster cha dang phyi nang —176—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadagi dbang bla khag drag zhan tshang ma'i yi ge rten bcas rnams rtsis blangs/ 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i zor las kyis mtshon lo mjug gi rim gro grub nas/dgung lo nga drug par rin chen rgyan cha ba'i srol gsar du btsugs shing lha sa ru bzhi'i spyi tshogs nas rims bzlog gi ched du ser 'bras sogs dgon khag zhe dgu nas rim gro dang / gdan yig zhib mo rnam dag me long rtsom 'bri gnang ba bcas kyi skor/chu byi 'byung ba gnyis ldan gnam lo tshes pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mchod gtor rgyas par phul/ bskang ba'i nang gi chas dngos su bzor rung ba mtha' dag lo sngon ma'i nang du zin pa 'di'i skabs dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa'i ched du bshams pa byin chags par byung / de nyin gyi bzhugs gral dga' ston la gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos gtsos gnyug mar gnas pa'i sog po'i dpon khag mi (127na)bzang / gong gi gser yig pa dang 'grul sdebs kyis ser mo ba drag rim/ bal po yam bu rgyal po'i mi sna sogs cha lugs dang skad rigs mi gcig pas tshoms chen yongs su gtams/sde pa 'dar pa lo tsā dang glang bu nas 'gyur med gnyis kyis dkon cog gsum gyi shis brjod las brtsams te ngo mtshar ba'i 'phros gleng dang bar bar du rgya gar rgya nag gi rol cha dang gar rigs sna tshogs kyi zlos gar bsgyur/ bod 'dir sger la phyi sger nang sger/ grub/ thob kyi sger gsum las/nang sger ral pa 'dzin gyis gru gu'i yul nas g.yu rdzing bdun drangs par grags shing bod chos rgyal mes dbon gyi dus su g.yu'i rna rgyangs dang bla g.yu sogs rin po che'i rgyan ci rigs sprod srol yod 'dug /—177—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bar skabs su gangs ljongs 'di gsil bur song ba'i dbang gis lung pa so sor dbang che ba res rang gi snang ba la gang shar byed pa'i spyod tshul sna tshogs mchis na'ang gnam jing gir gyi rgyal pos rgya nag gong ma mang pos bkur ba'i khri la zhabs zung bkod pa nas rigs las rgyal po go dan gyis rgya sman dang hor dor rta nag po mngags te bod dang bal mon sogs yul khams thams cad cham la phab/ gong ma se chen gyis chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po cher bod chol kha gsum phul ba nas bzung / kya'u zhwa lnga dang khrims las rnams rgya lugs dang las tshan bcu gsum gyis mtshon pa'i chen po'i sgrigs srol tsi gos/ las zhwa/ rgyan sprod ya rabs che btsun la 'os pa dar zhing / khyad par gnam bskos kyi rgyal po (127ba)dpal phag mo gru pa/ gu'i gung dang tā dben gu lha'i lung las kyi mngon par mtho ba byang pa rigs ldan/ khrom ge sar gyi mag pa rgyal mkhar rtse pa/ sger rigs rin cen spungs pa sogs sde dpon khungs btsun rnams kyi dus gser ga /sog rna sog sgor/ rna rgyangs/ shal dkar dmar/ tsi gos/ tsi ber/ gtsug zhwa ste rin chen rgyan sprod du grags pa'i chas ngo mtshar can de shin tu dar/gsang sngags rnying mar 'jig rten dregs pa'i gsol mchod dus kha g.yu kha gser bshad pa yang gser skyems pa la rna g.yu ma 'byor na de tshab tu dgongs pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ pho rna g.yu can la dgra lha 'khor/ zhes srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/ rje'i mgur lha bcu gsum/ 'bangs kyi srog lhas mtshon pa'i bod kyi lha mthu bo che rnams chas 'di la dga' ba yod tshod du snang / dus phyis sde srid gtsang pas kyang rgyun ma nub pa'i srol 'dzin na'ang lcags sbrul bde gzar nas bzung ming gi lhag ma lta bur gyur/bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos yul lugs mi mkhyen pa'i dbang gis ma dgongs pa ma gtogs gsed bkrol byed mi byung na thugs la mi 'thad pa yong rigs min cing khyad par gu shri bla ma di ya rabs che btsun gyi rnam thar la dga' bas ram 'degs rigs su mchis/ sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dus phur sgrub kyi gdab las chen mo'i gser skyems pa rin cen rgyan sprod pa byung na 'gab 'dra glengs pa gra bsgrig brtsis shig mdzad gsung rung bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma'i dus rtsa ba dmar dmar 'di —178—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chana'agrel pa nag nag 'dis 'chad rgyu e yin (128na)zer ba tsam las chos kyi brda don ma 'phrod pa'i dpe bzhin dbus gtsang gi drung 'khor khrod nas brda chad chags pa'i zhu ba 'bul mi ma byung bar brten mdzad thabs ma rnyed par lus/ ha cang gi rtsol ba mdzad par yang khri 'don grub pa'i lo bzhugs gral gyi thud sgrom sogs bod kyi srol rnying 'ga' zhig btod par phyi nang gi drung 'khor mang pos 'di 'dra sus kyang ma dran zhes gya ma dor brtsi ba'i dgon pa na'ang ma ṇi dang bcas so gsod po med pa'i stabs mdzad bde rgyu yang ma byung ba 'dra zhing ma nas sa glang po ta lar phur pa tshags ma zhig bzo zhor du spos mdong cha gcig dngul tshags khyug tsam rgyag bcug song ba sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis da cha khyod rang gi lham gyi sna la'ang tshags rgyob kyi sgyur sbyang tshan pa ches sna tshig pa lta bu'i de ga nas bzung bzo'i rigs la dang dod chung ba yod/ la la gtsang lugs yin zhes smra ba ni rgyu mtshan ma go ba'i 'os las ci yod/ 'ga' zhig sngar gyi sog lugs de dag bab chags zer ba stod khog sog po dang smad khog bod pa byas pa de 'dra sog po la yod pa ni ma shes/ mi bzhi lnga tsam tshogs par rgyab la/ bod mon/ khams kong / hor 'brog /rgya sog /mnga' ris pa sogs chas sna dgu tshang ba de 'dra ngo mtshar chas dgu yin shas che/ gang ltar sde pas do dam mdzad pa'i sta gon gyi tshe rgyus yod kyi rigs shin tu dkon pas rta nag 'o rlon pa bos te zhib dpyad de sne'u sdong rtse dang la stod byang pa'i lugs la tsi gos yong yang gzhis rgyal gnyis kyi lugs la ral gu sngon pos go gcod pas de dang bstun nas bsgrigs pa'i rin (128brko rgyan cha ba sum cu rtsa lnga tshar du dngar zhing spos 'dzin pa gnyis/ gsol dpon/phyag 'then pa/ mgron gnyer gyi las tshan rnams rin cen rgyan cha bas byas nas tshes gnyis kyi nyin rgyal po skor bcas nyung bsdus/ ser 'bras kyi bla khag gong gi gser yig pa/ gra tshang / drung 'khor skya ser la khri chog pang khebs sogs thob rigs dang de min 'brel mtshungs kyi gdan gzos dang bcas pa'i bzhugs gral thog bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul ba dang shis pa brjod pa'i zhal 'don pa dbu mdzad dkon cog rgya mtshos gtsos gra tshang gi gra pa bcu skor gyis bgyis/ rin chen rgyan cha ba'i khrod nas sde pa sgem bu bas bkra shis rdzas rtags bteg pa'i —179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)tshig dang bstun te lag tu gtad 'dar lo dang sa ba gru pa 'jam dbyangs dbang pos chos kyi 'bel gtam dang gar dang rol cha sna tshogs spel zhing dkar dmar bzhes spro rgyas par bstar/sa khyi bod lugs kyi gra bsgrig gzhan med pa'i 'dren pa bar phu thung rgyab bskyur cig mdzad song rung de gcig pu la ya mtshan rgyu mi 'dug pas bar skabs la btang snyoms su bzhag /'di lo cha lag tshang khyad du bsgrigs/ stod rgyud slob dpon shar pa chos rjes zhal ta ma'i pang khebs la bzos pa'i ras ber gyi mchor chas ngo mtshar ba snang / mtsho kha nas bo lod kyi dpon mo ye shes sgrol ma 'das pa'i bsngo rten rta bcu bdun dang gon pa sogs bskyel bar pho nya mngags/ citshes gsum la lho brag smra bo lcog chos rje/ shangs spo thog bla ma/ 'bog gong mkhar ltag (129na)pas mtshon mang ba dang phrad/ smon lam chen mor 'gro 'dun che'ang mi tsho gos kyis cham pa nges par yong zhing de la 'phrod bsnyen byas na rkang nad la babs dogs kyi g.yeng bas rim 'gyangs su song / 'di lo chos sde khag nas rgyu mtshan gsung ba dang rin cen rgyan cha'i skya rags bsgrig khyad nas thog ma'i rten 'brel du 'gro dgos rgyur 'dug rung lus la gdengs ma khel pas ngo tshab tu sde pa 'byon bcug /tshes drug la byams gling em chis yid kyis sprul te nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i mchod sprin spros nas gra tshang gi gra pa bcu skor dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i yon sbyar zhing ring por 'tsho dgos pa'i gtam yang bldab bskyar bldab snyan gyi bzhes spro tshar du dngar/ pho brang pe cing ser mo ba rnams kyi kha ton du tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba'ang bris/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po yon tan seng ge /rdzing phyi mkhan zur pa blo bzang skyes mchog sogs la ja gral btang / nged rang yang brtsams 'dun yod pa'i khar nye char dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis bskul ba la brten gtor ma brgya rtsa mu thi la'i 'khri shing brtsams/ sde pa lha rgya ri ba'i sras che 'bring chung gsum dus gcig la khri 'don mdzad par skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan dang pho brang sbangs che 'tsho byed gnyis btang ba'i 'di dag dang sde pa so so nas skyes dpangs bstod par ma sangs e pa rnams spyan dbar dog pa dang bcas dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhug par bstan te mi sna gnyis la bdag rkyen che bar mdzad/ sngon —180—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)chad zhal ngo re las khri 'don (129ba)mdzad srol med na'ang da lam gsum la gnang ba rgyun khral mi yong ba'i mnga' zhabs rnying khungs rnams kyis 'di skabs lag 'don che ba dgos kyin yod 'dug pa'i spyan nye yin nam zer/ la la bya ma 'brogs shing sgo nga lon pa'i dpe legs legs mor byed/ 'ga' zhig 'di rigs kyis phugs rnam grangs mang por 'gro zhes mo zur gtong ba'ang mchis mod/ zhabs drung 'di mkhyen dpyod 'jam dpal dbyangs dang mtshungs pas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod par gor ma chag /gra tshang du lha mo'i bskang gso nyin lnga btsugs skabs dar tshon sna lngar 'dod don gyi tshigs bcad/ lha sa gzhis ka shar pa spun rigs brgyud dang bcas pa skye bar rjes 'dzin gyi gsol 'debs dgos zer ba rang la rang dbang med par gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i re ba ga la yod kyang ngo 'dzin tsam du rtsom pa shes pa rgyu mtshan du byas te bris/ gra nas gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po phebs pa lo nang 'dir stan chags/ byi glang gnyis kyi le'u tho phug pa man ngag lugs bzhin 'dar lo skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po dang de'i slob ma tre bo rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha' gnyis kyis bzos/tshes bco lnga la bya khyung chos rjes yon sbyar te gra tshang gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i tshe chog btang / de thog mkhan pos rnga mo dkar po gcig gis sna drangs nyer gcig gis gtsos pa'i brgya 'bul/ mer gan kho
