shu'i chi'i dge tshul ma can gyis gos dar gser dngul ja ras kyi bdog pa mkhan po'i mdzes rgyan du 'gro ba'i phyur bur gtams/ (130na)se chen rgyal po'i bu mo na ma thar gyis zang zing gi dngos po ring du brkyangs/ 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa padma dkar po mdo sngags rig gnas kun la mkhyen spyan mchog tu yangs pa'i yig 'jog gi gsung 'bum kyang gtos che ba'i khrod nas 'jam dpal tshe bdag la las byang / dbang chog /bsnyen yig /brgyud 'debs/ dri lan sogs kha yar snang ba khungs btsun pa gzhir bcas rung pad gnubs kyi lugs srol dang mi mthun par snga mo nas mthong yang nged rang dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i khrod du sdod mi zhig la de 'dra'i dogs sel gyi khag khur mi 'dug snyam rtsol ba ma byas/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa —181—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)nam mkha' dang mnyam pas skye ba'i zlos gar dang rigs kyis bsnyems pa'i mkhas grub cig gi dogs sel mdzad du re na'ang / la la paṇa chen shākya shrī ltar ngur smig gos kyi ha cang klubs drags pa/ la la rgyab thur mdun thur sogs bya bral blo lad can gyi ngang tshul la zhen pa/ la la sgam pa'i mthar thug pa'i brdzu bag gis gsung btsun pa/ la la dgon rnying dang sa mkhar gog po ma zin pa'i 'o brgyal ba/la la rnga brdung dril 'brol gyi grong chog la khor mor 'byams pa/ la la sgra snyan mtshan nyid sgyu ma'i blo brid kyis pha khyim dor ba/ la la thug pas kha tshig pa la yang rdzas ngan gsog cing 'khor lo 'dri ba/la la de 'dra med khul gyi sdug ge dang snying rje'i gsung snyan bsgyur ba/ la la mchis brang gi chas dang phud bzhes kyis dbu 'khor bas mtshon rgyu du ma'i sgo nas da ni dogs sel zhig mi yong ba 'dra (130ba)snyam yig cha de dag gi skyon rnams 'gog byed ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig ces pa brtsams mod/ bab thob med pa 'di rigs lkugs ma'i mas gtam du mi 'gro las che/ tshes bco brgyad la se chen rgyal pos dka' bcu sangs rgyas bkra shis ched du mngags te bdog pa'i chas sbyar bar brten gra tshang gis tshe chog btang / sang nyin nas bzung gra tshang du zhag grangs kyi ring zangs kyi khrab rmog ral gri sogs spyan gzigs mchode gtor bshams te beg tse'i bkang bshags btsugs/dres/ gi nad ro cung zad 'phar ba'i stabs nyer lnga la khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po'i gdan sa pa khri rin po che blo bzang don yod/ byang rtse chos rje/ lha rin po che/ sde pa bde chen pa yab sras/ tsher gseb sku rten rnams ngo bo dang mjal phrad byas/nyer drug la gong gi mi sna tsho 'ongs te mkha' 'gros rgya bod kyi mtshams su gzhung bshig tshul dang shi ra tha la'i mcher gyis mtshon pa'i rgyal po'i lung rnams bsgyur bar gang ci'i rgyu mtshan gyi gsed bkrol glengs par gser gyi khrims ra chen po nas yongs nyams kyis don go ba'i 'phros pa las rdo khab btsugs mi byed 'dug /no yon khu thug thu lam du ma 'tshams pa'i slar de tshab tu 'dul ba zur pa u na 'dur chos rje rdzong bda' byas/ nang so dkon mchog cog dar rgyas lor ba'i thang po che'i bka' 'gyur le tshan mig lam du phab pa dngos gtsang ba'i tshad cig byung / rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che dpon —182

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanaslob kha shas kyis mdzod dbus ma nas byon pa'i 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga rgyas par gnang /zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung (131na)nyin drug gi bar rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin mchog gi sprul sku/ rtsod bral gyi gter ston gter bdag gling pa sku mched/ mchod dpon/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa rnams la tshe dpag med/ mtshan brgyad/ drag dmar/ yang gsang drag po/ manda ra/ 'tsho rgyal/ thugs rje chen po/ bka' brgyad spyi bye brag /rta mgrin/ phyag rdor/ re ma ti'i skor sogs kyi dbang byin rlabs lung yongs rdzogs phul zhing gzhis ka shar a gur bka' brgyad rigs 'dzin zhal lung gi dbang / de dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan/ ngag dbang 'phrin las gsum la yang gsang ga rma drag po'i dbang / dge slong don grub pa can gra pa kha shas la 'chi med tshe'i lha mo'i dbang rnams bskur/tshes bdun la zha lu mkhan po sku zhang rin cen mkhyen brtse mchog grub/ rgyal gling mkhan po snga thog pa/ chab nag pa dang bsam grub dga' ldan pa'i bla ma can dang phrad/ zha lu mkhan por tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i gshed dmar spros med rgyun 'khyer gyi yig cha'i lung phul/ thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor slob dpon gra bcas kyis bdog pa bstar zhing bla ma blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyi dus blo bzo'i cho ga rgya ma bod cig 'dug pa'i sgo nas brtan sdod byas/ chu shur dga' ldan thar gling pa'i gra pa blo bzang phun tshogs kyis 'bum dum pa bcu drug dang rdzong kha 'phel gling pa blo bzang chos 'dzin dang ngag dbang blo gros gnyis kyis gsang 'dus dang 'jigs byed kyi yig cha 'dra'i rgyugs sprad/ la stod sgam spyon sprul sku'i gtsug phud blangs (131ba)shing mtshan o rgyan bstan 'dzin nor bu dang rigs 'dzin stobs ldan dbang po'i sprul skur legs ldan bstan 'dzin dpal 'bar du btags/ e ri sgo gzims shag lho pa nang sodakon cog dar rgyas/ rab stims pa/ btsun ma/ rigs kyi bu gnyis dang bcas pas/ tshes brgyad la yul lugs dang bstun pa'i tshogs 'khor gser zho lnga bcus thog drangs pa'i ster cha/ mar btsod bse mgu'i 'gyed kyi bdog pa gzengs su mtho ba bstod de gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog rgyas par btang / de thog mer gan hung tha'i ji'i —183—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dpon mo skor gyis kyang 'phro 'thud de zi ling nag ja'i dngos po bstar/tshes bcu gcig la dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis dngul lnga bcu ma/ gos yug kha yar sogs ster cha dang tshogs dpangs bstod/ rgya sbug hor sbug /snyan dar brgya lhag gi spyi 'bul/ ja 'gyed tsha ra rgyas pa'i yon sbyar te gra tshang nas gsung chog gong bzhin btang / bar khams nas gzhi rtsa sde pa rnam rgyal bkra shis gzhi rtsa ba'i mjug gi cho ga legs par grub ste 'jig rten phyi ma'i ltad mor rings stabs su song ba'i bsngo rten rta bcu gcig /dre'u nyer dgu /dngul/ khrab glog /mdzo g.yag gi bdog pa 'byor don bzhin bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ nye rigs shig dang de mo ba'i dpon mo bsdebs nas gzhi rtsa ba rang byon yong du re yang 'od zer bla ma shi ba'i gshis kyis brko thub rigs su mi 'dug rung de mo dbon por gong brgyab pa'i sa skal gzengs bstod sde bas byin song / zangs ri dpon (132na)sa'i zhabs drung bsod nams chos bzang chab gzhis grongs pa'i mgyogs bsngo 'byor/ rjes 'jug gi rigs kyang med pa dang bcas phyag rdzas chud mi 'dza' bar yong ba'i 'char ston 'di nas byas/ de ga'i don gcod du sde pas zhang tsha dkon rnam pa rdzong bda' mdzad/tshes bcu gsum nas bzung 'byung ba rin cen kun bsdus la brten pa'i sri gnon/ 'jam dpal dmar po'i rlung sgrub/ li byin ha ra'i las sbyor gyi sgrub khag gsum gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcas la btsugs shing byings kyis gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i drags sngags bzlog pa dang bcas pa btang /tshes bcu bzhi la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dkon chog stod rgyud bla gras 'chi bdag las rgyal ba'i bden brjod dang bcas maṇḍal gyi tshul du bdog pa spel/ skyid shod chos rje'i sku skye gtsang nas 'khor ba dang phrad cing bya khyung mkhan po'i a khu gra tshang chos rje'i skye ba dge tshul du bsgrubs/tshes bcu drug nas zhag shas kyi bar rdo rje'i brag sprul sku sogs chos gsan mkhan rnams kyi thog sha gzug pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi sku skye dang bcas par mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched kyis bsam yas dbu rtse rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprod nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi zlum po bzhi dbang / bstan pa med byung ma/ sirgyu rgya mtsho che ba/ chung ba/ bsam pa lhun༄/ba ma/ tshe —184

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanadapag med 'chi med 'od mchog /tse'u dmar po'i srog dbang / drag po'i dbu dgu ye shes rang gsal gyi sku lnga rdzogs pa'i rtsa dbang / dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang phug dri med (132ba)shel gyi mchod rten nas gdan drangs pa'i ma rgyud khrag rlangs snying po don gsum/ bla ma mnga' bdag gi gter byon rgyal po li byin ha ra'i srog dbang / padma las 'brel rtsal gyis khra mo brag dang rigs 'dzin ratna gling pas gnam skas brag nas spyan drangs pa'i gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po'am gza' gdong dmar nag gi srog dbang rnams phul zhing snying po don gsum drag po dbu dgu'i lung song nas rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi phyed nye bar slebs pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i zhogs nas mgo na ba'i cung zhig ma bde'ang nyams snang che ba ma byas/tshes nyi shu'i nyin lung bklags par rked pa na ba'i ngal ba tsam byung rung 'phro ma bzhag /mchod dpon pa mnan pa rgyag par 'gro ba dang dpon po bkra shis 'dam la thon pa'i brel ba dang bcas dgongs ja phyi zur nas mtshams bzhag /drung 'tsho ba gnyis la bstan par lhag bsam gnyan tshad du dogs shing dar mo nas rims shig yin pa 'dra zhes gleng / rims kyi rigs mtha' dag skam nad kyi dus rtsa chu dbyibs mtshungs pa las so sor dbye ba med pas kha mtshon chod rigs su'ang mi 'dug /lo snga ma gnyis kyi nang 'brum pa 'go la re byung yang ye ma 'gos pas da cha 'go rgyu min 'dra snyam pa'i dogs pa che ba ma shar na'ang drung 'tsho ba gnyis kyis smin byed kyi thang btang / dpon tshang byang ngos nas gdan drangs par yang pho 'bring yan chad blo khog gcig pa'i dpes rims yin tshul las 'di yin gsal bar mi gsung /nyer gnyis kyi nyin rus pa'i gting nas na ba skyug pa sogs na lugs kyi babs (133na)thams cad rjes sor tsha rong drang srong dpal ldan rgyal mtshan gyi yig char bltas pas 'brum par the tshom pa mi gda'/ nyer gsum nas thor pa phyir thon pa'i skam nad zhi ste zos bde ba tsam byung / 'on kyang nad chen gyi gdug pas gtor bsngo dang mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len phran bu las lam dus sogs chag med dang bzlas brjod kyi rigs mtha' dag rang shugs kyis lus/ dpon tshang byang ngos nas dang slob —185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ma lhag dar gnyis kyis rdo sman rtsi sbyor gnyan sman rnams ltag sprod du btang / 'di lo'i 'brum pa dkar po rigs gsum gyi nang nas ran pa tsam yin 'dug rung sde pa sogs tshang mas gsang ba 'gab tshul bzhin yan lag gi nad ro 'phar ro zhes dril bsgrags mod/ bde chen rab brtan phyogs nas mched pa'i spre'u'i rkun ma zhig ni byung bar gda'/ nad 'bar che ba'i nyin kha shas kyi bar gnyid bsrung ba dang bcas grong smad a par kyang bcar sdod byas/ gzhan ma nad g.yog dbu mdzad/ mchod dpon pa/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum yin pa'i steng nad gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i tshad 'khrul gyis mtshan la mchod dpon pa sun tsam byung song / rim gror rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku dpon slob kyis nyin bdun gyi bar thang lha'i bskang gso/ khyab 'jug gi mdos nag mdzad pas spyan ltas dang byin rlabs kyi mtshan rtags bzang ba chos kyi bka' babs pa'i nyams su mchis/ rdzong gi nye skor du rgod bzhur pa'i rnam rtog gsod byed la khro rol zhig bto / gter ston rin po che dpon (133ba)slob kyis pad gling drag dmar gyi gtor bzlog dang gter gsar gshin rje 'joms byed kyi sgrub pa mdzad pa spyan ltas 'tshub lhongs ngos legs pa byung 'dug /de snga rim gro gnang ba tsho yang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba yod/zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gnyis nas bzung gra tshang gis lha mo'i gsang mdos nyin lnga'i bar gtong myur bsngo tshig brtsams/ chos sde chen po phan tshun du ja tshul bco lnga'i ring gdugs dkar sher snying gnyis kyi rim gro'i thog gser 'gyed phul/ de skabs nged rang gi rim gror dmigs te ser 'bras gnyis dang pha bong kha'i bla ma/ las tshan/ khams tshan/ mi tshan sogs kyis rang skya pher ba dang bsdu cha'i mang ja gra ja/ gra tshang gi gra dmangs kyi bsdu cha'i ser 'bras gnyis la mang ja bzhes thug kha shas dang gra tshang du ja dang tsha ba zla sbrel/ de mtshungs drung 'khor skya ser nas bsdu cha byas pa'i mang ja gra ja dang po ta la'i drung 'khor rnams kyis slar 'bras spungs su mang ja gnyis dang se rar gcig gi thog /sbrul lo bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad de btsugs/ lha sa ru bzhi spyi tshogs kyis bsdu cha'i ser 'bras dge gsum gyis gtsos skyid shod skor gyi dgon khag che chung bzhi bcu zhe dgur mang ja/ drung —186

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chana'akhor nas mang ja skol ba ser 'bras gnyis la grong smad sde pa a bar/ stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub/ byang gling bsam grub rgyal po/ 'bras spungs su dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ gsol dpon ge ra ba/ skyar po mgron gnyer/ dar khan dka' bcu/ (134na)mdzes grong pa/ chos rje kha rag pa/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ tsha ba skol mkhan chos rje brag sna ba dang blo gros rnam rgyal/ se rar drung yig tshe dbang / chos mdzad 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ rnam sras gling pa'i cho semadzad/ zur khang dga' ldan du bka' brgyad sbug pa/ gra tshang du gra ja skol mi mang zhing 'gyed gtong ba rta dpon rnams 'joms/ zur khang don grub dbang rgyal/ rin chen rtse pa legs ldan/ drung yig dar rgyas(bkra shis/ byang gling pa/ ka brgyad smad pa/ sbubs srang pa rnam ba/dang sbus srang pas ( de thog tu jo bo la rgya mchod sna lnga/ snyem bu nas kyis chos sde ba/ thod ri ba/ dkon gnyer mgon khang rnamasasu gsol mchod snyan dar/ stag ru ba tshe dbang bkra shis kyis dar rgyas gling sogs yar shar nub kyi dgon sde brgyad la mang ja/ thang po che dang srong btsan du gsol kha chu skor bar nas ri bo chos gling / dar rgyas gling / bkra shis chos sde gsum la mang rdzas mtshon stod smad bar gsum nas lag 'don byed mi mang du byung snang /tshes bcu gcig nas gra tshang spyi dang so so'i bsdu cha dbu mdzad mchod dpon gnyis kyis nyin thub dang bcas nyin lnga khro rol tshe bdag gi sgrub khag smin rgyas su btsugs shing nyin gsum gyi bar na rag skong bshags mdzad/ gter ston rin po ches 'chi blu dang gdon 'grol gyi cho ga gnang / chos rje thub bstan pas thog drangs nges gsang rdo rje gling pa'i gra pa kha shas kyis lha 'dre stong dra'i mdos btang /'brum pa'i mthug rgyan yan lag gi nad la cung zad babs rung ha cang mi lci bas 'gyang med du bde/yan lag gi nad la phan res stod lung rtswa sgye mo'i chu tshan (134ba)blangs te nyin gsum gyi bar bsten yang mi phan pa'i khar 'gro 'dug la phran bu gnod pa lus ma sos pa'i bsor ma'i skyon du da gdod go ste mar gyi byugs pas 'phrod ngo che/ drung 'tsho spyan g.yas pa dang sgar pa grong pa dpon bzang lta bu yod na 'di ni 'di'o zhes thog ma nas lung ston tshod du gda'/ nyer bzhi nas gra tshang gi gra pa —187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)grangs bcad kyis li byin ha ra'i sgrub pa bskyar ma btsugs/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la mtshams grol ba'i 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal por zhu yig rten bcas deb bshar ma dang rgya sog bar gyi gzhung la dgongs pa mtho yangs su bstsal ba'i legs so'i 'bul ba bstar bar ngam ring bsam grub dga' ldan gyi bla ma blo bzang bstan 'phel dang lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang brdzangs shing gong gi gser yig pa 'grul sdebs rnams la gzhis len ster cha so sos khyer ba'i yig lan tsho 'tshems med du bsrings/ byams gling em chis zla ba dang po'i nang du brtan bzhugs phul ba'i 'bul ba yin zhes skya pod kyi bka' 'gyur stong skud khra bo lhas ma'i glegs thag can/ tshe dpag med kyi gos sku/ lnga bcu ma bzhi/ gos dar kha shas dang bcas pa'i bdog pa bstab pa ni nyi ma de ring shar ba la 'od zer nang par 'byung ba'i dper 'dug cing em chi tshangs spyod las nyams pas sdom pa bskyar zer yang lus kyis ma lcogs/ 'brum nad las gegs med du grol bar chos 'khor rgyal du chos skyong rnams la bskang gsodang snyan shal zhag yig ma/ gra tshang du nyin gsum gyi bar chos skyong spyi'i bkang gso'i thog tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs bzabs rgyas/ de dang mtshungs par gnas (135na)chung lcog dang bsam yas/ la mo/ thang po cher sku phebs dang bstun tshogs chas spyan gzigs gya nom pa bstar/ 'bras yul skyed tshal mkhan po/ ser 'bras kyi slob dpon las tshan/ lho brag gnas gzhi chos rje/ sha gzug sku skye/ nang so dkon dar ba can mang po dang phrad/ nang so dkon dar bar rjes gnang kha shas dgos zer yang khong gcig pur ma zad skya ser mang por chos bka' dgos pa rnams lus ma sos pa'i bar dal bar ma bsdad na 'byum nad 'di gdug pa che bas phugs lus mi thang ba 'byung nyen yong zer ba nas zla ba phyed gsum tsam gyi bar ci bder gnas/ mer gan kho sho'u chi'i dpon mo rdzong bda' bgyis/ 'di dus nad drag pa'i legs so'i 'phros 'phros ye med pa byas na 'gab bsam pa shar yang zur khang don grub dbang rgyal gyis thog mar legs skyes shig bstar ba slog ma bde/ de rjes nang gi drung 'khor rnams kyi mjal dar dang sang nas bzung byang gling pa/ gzims shag pa/ 'brang rgyas shag pa/ rin chen rtse ba/ dar khan dka' bcu sogs drung 'khor —188

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanarags rim la nad langs shing de nas chos sde khag dang dbus gtsang phal cher du mgo la mda' phog gi khral lta bu song ba mtsher ba tsam byung / de zhor sde pa la gsung cham gdangs legs kyang 'bul 'dug pa khog yangs pa yin nam thugs snang cher mi mdzad/tshes gsum nas rim pa bzhin legs bya'i tshul du gra tshang spyi so'i tshe'i rten 'byung sgrigs ma dang 'phar ma gcig /gra dmangs kyis bsdus pa gcig ste so sor ster sbyin gzengs bstod de rdul tshon (135na)dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog btang / de rjes mkha' 'gro sde lnga la brten pa'i bsdus pa'ang nyin gsum tsam sbrel/ po ta la dang lha sar dgra lha dpangs bstod la brten lha zhal mthon por bteg /tshes brgyad la lha sa dang ra mo cher brgya mchod sna lnga dang 'dod don bris pa'i snyan dar kha byang can phul/ stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyis bdog pa yon bzabs rgyas su sbyar te gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog mdzad/ sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po dpon blon dang chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs spyi so dang bla ma khams tshan sogs tshang mas legs bya'i dngos po rgya cher spel/tshes dgu la dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas dge 'dun brgya phrag gsum/ se ra theg chen gling nas brgya phrag gnyis kyis lhan du byon pa'i zas sna bu ram gyi za ma tog mang po dang rung mthun kyi gos/dar zab ja ras kyis mtshon pa maṇḍal gyi tshul du bshams te dge 'dun mi byed 'dus pa'i bden brjod kyi byin rlabs char du phab/ se ra spyi so'i legs bya brtan sdod bsdebs su byung ba'i so sor dbye ba yod 'dug rung gzims khang dbon po bod pa'i khams par song ba dang mgron gnyer rnams mgo bo sbos pa'i thams cad chu la chu zhag gi dbyer med ro gcig tu thim/ skyor lung mkhan slob/ yer ba slob dpon/ se ston brgya mkhar ba tshe dbang rdo rje can dang phrad/ se ston pa 'di snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin chen por song ba'i byang pa rigs ldan rim byon gyi bca' tshe btsan par snang yang phyi skor ngam ring sku rim pa'i gral du'ang ma chud pa'i (136na)thang sku'i gral zhig byung tshod du mchis/ se'i sngags 'chang mgon po bzang po'i sku gdung rgya mkhar yas ltag lha khang na bzhugs pa lug lo bde gzar skabs —189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'brog pas bshig pa'i dbu thod khro zhal rang byon yod pa gla ba'i mche ba can/ se ston nyi ma bzang po'i tshems/ rigs 'dzin rgod ldem gyis zang zang lha brag nas spyan drangs pa'i pad gshod drag po rtsal gyi sgrub pa'i skabs pad gtor zhu nas thim pa/ se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum sku sham gdung rus dam rdzas kyi rigs sogs ster cha dang zhu rten byung ba stong par ma lus pa'i tshes brgyad kyi zla ba tsam gyi don smin byung song / 'dar lo la se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi dbu zhwa dang gsol zhal shing gi ka pā la bcas byin pa 'byor zhing lan du gos yug bstar/ glang bu chos rje'i phyag dpe dmar po skor gsum/ me 'bar po ti/ snyan brgyud po ti/ zhal gyi be'u bum/ ha la nag po dang bcas pa glang phu nas 'gyur med kyis byin byung ba gos yug che legs kyi bda' lan dang rigs brgyud la kha'u pa'i bstan 'dzin byung na dpe zags 'khyar med par gtod pa'i khas len byas/tshes bcu la thod ri bshad grub gling pa rnams kyis zang zing gi legs skyes dang bcas chos spyod kyi rim pa dbyangs su gyer/ rme ru ba bla gra rnams kyis smon grong lha khang du mchod yon 'khor bcas spyan drangs pa'i sha'i phung po dang rus pa'i gram khrong chen po spungs pas sngon chad 'di lta bu ma byung zhing slad nas kyang byung bar mi 'gyur ro zhes pa'i skya ser thams cad dgyes pa rab kyi rtser son pa'i dus der nged rang la'ang mgron brda (136ba)byung rung rkang 'theng lag khyog gi rigs 'di myug myug mangs pa mi 'gab pa'i gshis de ga'i skal ba tshes bdun la bskyal ba'i dkar dmar gyi bzhes spros po ta la'i steng 'og thams cad lha zhi klu zhir btang ba dang lhan cig bdog pa spel/ gra phyi nas dpon tshang gnas lugs su grags pa stod lugs kyi 'tsho byed yon tan che zhing lhag par mig 'byed la nang byan chud pa zhig yod zer ba gter ston rin po ches 'bod mi gnang ba'i rgyud dang grub chen mi tra dzo gi lugs kyi mig 'byed phyag len dar mo ba bslab bcug pa'i de lo mi bzhi bcur nye ba'i mig phye ba sogs 'gro phan lhag par 'phel zhing lha rje la phogs dang yon rdzongs rgyas par bstar/byams gling mkhan po nub sgo steng pa smad rgyud slob dpon gsang yig pa gnyis dang phrad/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim la brten pa'i dri mal mang du byung zhing gnyis ka phyogs de la sbyangs ba'i lag —190

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadarjes snang / me rgan co tha'i ji'i ma dpon mo nor bu ster cha dang cas phyir thon/ stod rgyud slob dpon byams bkras pa shar du bsgril ba'i gra tshang gi slob dpon du blo gsal gling zhal snga nas dge 'dun grags pa bskos/ skyed tshal mkhan pos tshogs su 'dzugs rgyu'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba dang dar mkhan dka' bcu'i ngor bdag bstod/ po ta la'i li ma lha khang du bzhugs pa'i bris thang rnams kyi deb kyi 'go brjod bcas brtsams/ bya khyung chos rje la rdzong bda' dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel byas/ thar pa'i mkhan po 'od mchog sku skye bdog pa spel bar 'ongs pa dang phrad/ sde pa (137na tsher phrin las rgya mtsho la yar rgyab kyi bla g.yu khyad can mgron gnyer zhig brgyud de phul ba gtor ma gnas su ma 'khyol ba'i lo rgyus dang bcas zab khog nas g.yu zhig phul/ yar klungs su klu'i sku khog 'dug pa sde pas ched gnyer bos pa'i dri mal mdzad par sa cha yul dbyibs sogs khog par rgyus med pa mang po bshad par brten yid brtan du rung ba'i lung bstan pa dang bstun chos 'khor rgyal gyi lha mo'i bla mtsho dang las gshin gyi bla mtshor gzhan gyi ngan gtad kyis nus pas mtsho sman la 'phog thug byung ba sel byed du klu gtor/ klu gta'/ khrus gsol/ lha bsangs/ dar lcog /gos dar/khrab/ ja/ dngul gyi bum par sman sna dang rin po che blug pa'i mtsho rdzas skyel bar dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho dang dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ 'phyong rgyas kyi bon po thog legs pa bkra shis tshe brtan dang spyan g.yas pa blo bzang tshad ldan rnams rdzong bda' byas shing zhar du byams chen la 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha byang can bskur/yar klungs chu skor bar dang sras po dar rgyas can khag gnyis kyis tshogs 'khor zang zing gi dngos po dang bcas gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi cho ga rdul tshon dang 'brel ba btang / tshogasamagron du chos sde khag gi bla ma dang las tshan rnams kyang bsgrigs/ khong khag la bdag rkyen sde pas mdzad bde mi 'dug pas nged rang nas gdan gzos dang ster sbyin gang legs byas/ rtse tshogs mkhan spyi nas tshan grangs kyi legs skyes pa mngags /tshes bco lnga la 'jam mgon bla ma'i gdan sa ri bo dga' ldan gyi (137ba)mkhan slob gra pa —191—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)brgya skor dang bcas phebs pa'i gos dar ja ras kyi skyes tshar du dngar te smon lam bkra shis kyi zhal 'don rgyas par gsungs/ sde pa tshal pa/ dgas po lcang ra nas/ dga' ldan gsang sngags gling slob dpon rnams kyis de mtshungs kyi zhabs su 'thud/ o rod se chen rgyal po'i bla mar tshal yang dgon chos rje'i 'tsho byed dang bcas pa brdzangs/ bkra shis ljongs spyi sos ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad bskul ba bris/ rmi ru bla ma brag sgo rab 'byams pa'i padma bka' thang gi rtsod yig la ka tshal zur pa rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyis dri lan mdzad pa ston pa dang 'brum pa las grol ba'i legs so brjod pa'i snyan tshig dang bcas bsrings byung ba khong pa shes rab dang yon tan gnyis ka che gshis tshig skyon rnon po de la bltos pa'i lan 'debs lod pa rang ma byung 'dug pas legs so'i 'phrin yig snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs/de yang gser mdog can pa'i dge bshes rgya ma bcod gtun rong pa'i rab 'byams pas thang yig la dgag pa btang ba'i dum bu zhig sngar mthong myong ba lo tshigs snga phyi sogs 'gal 'du brdabs pa dang rtog ge pa'i rigs pa nas drangs pa'i tshig skyon shin tu snang ba dngos lan 'debs bya 'debs byed dang bral bar snang / rgan gyi rjes zlos byis pas byed pa bzhin rmi ru bla mas de nas bsdus pa'i shog dril zhig bris pas rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che sogs lan mdzad mkhan dang slar yang mdzad pa'i sta gon 'ga' zhig 'dug pa thang yig gi lo tshigs rnams ye bsgrig thebs med cing yig skyon shor ba'ang kha yar yong gshis (138na)dngos lan btab kyang bzhengs pas che ru mi 'gro/ rtse le sprul skus rtsod lan du btags pa'i bden kha byin pa de 'dra las nged rnying ma ba tsho chos log yin gsung na dogs bde ba yod/ rtsod pa po rnams kyis kyang rtsod pa song snyam pa'i rlom ni mi 'tshal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad par theg pa che chung so sor bshad pa'ang mi mthun pa mang / mdo mdzangs blun du byang chub sems dpa' da ste zhag bdun nas lus la mar me stong 'dzugs pas lta ba la re|ga ces zla lam gyi bar pho nya bkye ba 'dug pa sprul pa las tha mal ba'i rgyas mi khebs pa'i rgyu mtshan zhag bdun tu lus la mar me 'dzugs par zla lam gyi sa nas lta mkhan rnams mi 'byor ba lta bu'i tshig skyon tsam la khungs —192

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)ci yod/ mo thil gyi bu dgra bcom pa thob nas kun tu rgyus sku lus 'dam bu ltar bcoms te bkrongs par bshad/'brungs rabs so bzhi'i lung rgyun la sa dge bka' brgyud mtha' dag tshad mar 'dzin yang slob dpon gyis bstan bcos mdzad 'phral rten 'brel gyi dbang las stag gi sku lus zos pa sus kyang ma tshor ba ring zhig nas dpe rnying pa'i le'u so bzhi yan ma gtogs de phyin chad char chus zos te ma byung ba'i gtam khungs mar grags pas dpa' bos lung su la gnang / jo bo yab sras kyi rnam thar bka' gdams glegs bam dang lam yig na gsungs pa dngos 'gal la song ba du ma yod/ dus 'khor shambha la nas 'phags yul du phebs pa'i lo rgyus rwa 'gro gnyis phyogs log cing de bzhig gshegs pas dus 'khor gsungs pa'i lo zla ba dang drag po 'khor los (138ba)kla klo btul ba'i lo tshigs sogs la mkhas pa mang po'i yig char yang ma dag pa'i khungs rdol dang log bshad kyang mang / rje mi lar rtsam pa tsam yang ma 'byor bar zwa tshod kyi dka' thub la brten nas gcig pur bzhugs pa'i dus kyi gsung mgur rnams yi ger 'khod 'dug pa'i snag shog sam ṭa yi ge 'dri ba'i rtsol ba sus byas/rje btsun sa chen gyis dus gcig la bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar dang gung thang du zas ngan byung bas thugs la yod pa'i chos rnams bsnyel pa'i lo rgyus/ sgam po zla 'od gzhen nus rlung phyag sor la bkram ste spos thal gtor nus par zhabs kyi dreg gi snyung gzhi la dngul chur sbyar ba'i sman 'byug pa/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa'i sprul par bshad pa la las ka mi yong ba'i mi bskyil na zas skom gyi gron chen po yong bas mi gso zhes zhal gdams su bris/rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin pa la rgya 'dre lba ba dgu brtsegs kyis glags bltas pa'i 31 rgyus sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi rnam thar gyi tshig la 'gal 'du yod pa shin tu mang / slob dpon chen po padma thod 'phreng gi sdig blon sogs las ma dag pa 'ga' zhig ngor bod du zla ba bco brgyad las ma bzhugs par mang yul la thog nas srin po'i kha gnon du 'byon tshul bstan/ mnga' bdag gtso bor gyur ba'i las ldan tsho'i snang ngor zho stod gter sgrom brag —193—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)tu me pho stag gi lor mkhar chen bza' la mkha' 'gro snying tig gnang ba sogs gnas chen gangs brag kun (139na/3 bzhugs nas gdul bya rnams smin grol la bkod de gter kha grangs med sbas/dus yun ring po zhig nas mchog dman kun gyi spyod yul du sku snang bar mdzad pas bdud blon gyis rgyal po mdzad dkar bstad tshe bu tshal gser khang gling du lo paṇa tshor mtho 'tshams pa'i dus khro bo'i skur bstan te tshar bcad pa sogs bskal pa'ang dus mtha'i skad cig mar bsgyur nus pa'i mdzad pa la byis blos tshad gzhal ga la nus/ jo bo shākya mu ni rgyal ba zas gtsang sras po dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad sangs rgyas dngos kyis rab tu gnas par yongs grags dang sa dge bka' gsum gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa'i bka' gdams glegs bam yang lha pa sku skye'i ram btegs nas brag sgo rab 'byams pas bod lha dang chos log tu smra ba'i phyir rnying ma ba tshor snag mo'i sger nyed min 'dug pas rnying lugs kyi thugs sbubs dam po rnams me 'bar 'khrugs pas snag lha/ga gi gron ma mdzad par mda' khra g.yas dang 'phang khra g.yon gyi phyags las la brtson par zhu/ tsa ka li tsho 'tshol bde'i deb bsgrig gi mgo brjod dang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho yan jo bo bka' gdams pa'i rnam par thar pa khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la gtong zhing gyong dang bub kha rang gis len pa'i dma' sa 'dzin pa gnang la/ rje bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal phag mo gru pa dang hor rgyal po'i ti shri ra gyur pas cung zad sgrob che ba dang / rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i dus ga'u le zhig snang ba zhib cha'i nges tig cher mi 'dug pas mi chos dang bstun par sgrigs bcur (139ba)med pa'i gang dran mi 'phya khyi dgod kyi rgyur mi 'gro ba'i nges pa med pa nas/ de'ang mang pos bkur ba rgya nag gong ma'i rgyal khab tu gang bzhugs rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal yin gshis gzos sgo shin tu che ba'i 'os la gzhan gyis 'gran zla ma mchis shing de phyin bkur gzos che ba gdan sa gong 'og gnyis/ de 'og sne'u sdong rtse/ stag lung lha sde/ zhwa dmar nag gnyis rnams/ de 'og dga' ldan khri rin po che/ bkra shis lhun po/ sgam po/'bri gung pa/ 'brug pa/ phan phu drung pa/ 'phags pa lha rnams(kyi sprul sku/ sgam po spyan snga/ khamasari bo che'i chos rje rnams/ de 'og rdo rje brag /'brog bsam sdongs/ sbyor ra che ba/ lcags zam pa/ de —194

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadamo ba rnams kyi sprul sku/ gnas snying zhabs drung / ge re lha pa bslab gtsang rnams/ de 'og zha lu/ tshogs sde bzhi/ gsang phu gling stod smad/ rta tshag /gzims khang gong / ngag dbang / si tu/ nyi lde/ dhī tsha/khal kha'i byams pa/ stong 'khor ba/ 'jam dbyangs/ rgyal khang rtse rnams kyi sprul sku/ dga' ldan rtseshar sogs dbus gtsang gi mkhan po spyan snga thob pa dang de dang dbyibs 'dra ba nā las bco brgyad pa lta bu/ rgyal sras sher 'phel ba sogs dang babs mtshungs kyi sprul sku'i rigs/ 'ug pa lung pas mtshon sngags brgyud che ba/ lha bya sogs sde dpon che kha mnga' ris la dwags/ ru thog /ljangs rgyal pho brang gi rgyal po dang sku rus gcig pa/ cha khar dang ju nang gi dbang / khal kha dang o rod kyi rgyal po rnams la sgroms dbyibs mtshungs par gzos (140na)sgo che 'bring chung gsum ka ma chag skabs sbyar/de 'og bod dang bod wo po/ rgya har rnams kyi chos sde/ gra tshang / spyi so/ bla slob dpon/ tha'i ji/ dpon che chung / sde dpon chung ba/ nang so rnam pa/ drung 'khor/ dkyus ma sogs drag zhan thal bris kyi sgo nasagazos che ba thob pa rgya bal gyi rgyal po dang gu ge bdag po sogs dang / gzhan yang dregs pa'i sde dpon khog tu brlams pas mtshon mchog dman bar ba thams cad la yul dus gnas skabs dang bstun pa'i zhib cha'i reg zig tshig don rabs gsal bkod/ nyer bzhi la rgyal po yab sras tshor che mgon dang sras lha bzang klu dbang la tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ bstan 'dzin da yan rgyal po'i dbu sgor che chung / lha rgya ri ba'i legs skyes pa drung 'khor ngo ma/ mas dro chad ka spyan snga can dang phrad/hor zla lnga pa sngon ma'i tshes gsum nas zhag bdun gyi bar zho stod gter sgrom gyi khrus rdzing nas drangs pa'i chu tshan bsten/ mnga' ris la dwags khri rtse mkhan po dar rgyas rnam rgyal na mthos pa'i nan zhus la brten mkhan por dge slong blo bzang tshe brtan dang lhan du dge lugs kyi dgon pa lnga bcu nga brgyad/ gra grangs sum stong dgu brgya lhag bcas la gnam ja dang ya ju nyag phyed do re/ gra pa bcu rer dngul srang re'i 'gyed dang mang ja skol bar bkra shis rtse nas dang 'phan po lcang rgyab pa sbrel po btang / 'di res sde pas la dwags bde ldan la yi ge bskur tshod yin/ nged kyis ni khong pa zhal dri zhim po mi 'dug pas par bkab ma bsrings/—195—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)tshes drug (140ba)la bdag mo dang mjal/ sde pas ra mo che'i skor tshad dgos tshul byung ba bar skor phyi ma'i khyon dang jo bo'i sku 'bras la gzhal ba'i kha grangs gtan 'bebs 'dar lo dang spos 'dzin pa ngag dbang nam mkha' byed du bcug par 'go brjod dang sgroms bsgrig byas/ tshes brgyad la yar 'brog bsam sdings sprul sku dang 'bog gong khag /bcu la bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan gra tshang gsum/ sngags gra dga' ldan rab rgyas dang bcas pa'i bla ma/ sde srid ri bo brag pa/ thon zil gnon pa rnams kyis legs skyes kyi bdog pa bstar zhing khyad par bkra shis lhun po ba dpon slob kyis gos dar sogs rgya sog gi skyes dngom che/ sngon chad gdan yig sogs par bkab mi snang ba mtho dma' nges med byung tshe bsnyad dogs re 'khang gi rgyud dang shes ldan 'dras khrel gnas su mi byed pa'i nges pa mi 'dug gnyis 'di ga'i khri la cha lngar byas pa'i cha bzhi'i rtsis gdan sa gong 'og gnyis/ de'ang rtse gdong gi zhal ngo chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i bzhugs khri padmo can du khri 'don ma mdzad pa'i rigs la gdan sa gong las cung dma' ba/ cha phyed bzhi pa sne'u sdong rtse/ stag lung lha sde/ zhwa dmar nag /cha gsum pa dga' ldan khri rin po che/ bkra shis lhun po/ 'brug pa/ sgam po/ mtshur phu drung pa/ 'phags pa lha rnams kyi sprul sku/ sgam po'i gdung brgyud spyan sngar btan pa/khams ri bo che'i chos rje/ 'bri gung gdung brgyud yod skabs stag lung pa dang 'dra yang da cha 'di gras/de las cung zad dma' ba sde pa/ cha gnyis pa rdo rje brag /bo dong (141na〉sbyor ra che ba/ 'brog bsam sdings/ gzims khang gong / bar khams rta tshag /de mo ba/ lcags zam pa/ khal kha'i 'jam dbyangs/byams pa/ rgyal khang rtse/ stong 'khor ba rnams kyi sprul sku/ gnas rnying khri pa bslab gtsang yin min la ma bltos pa dang ge re lha pa bslab gtsang rnams/ sum stan snye 'bol che ba zha lu dang tshogs sde bzhi'i mkhan po/ gsang phu'i chos rje rnam gnyis/ lho brag dhī tsha/ dpa' bo/ nyag re bra yag /gi tu bzhi'i sprul sku/ tre bo hor tshang chos rje rnams/ srab lnga brtsegs pa dga' ldan rtse shar dbur stod sems dpa'/ rgyal sras sher 'phel/ gar lugs tre bo/ lho gsung sprul/ thugs sras zla ba/ ras chung phug /bar khamasangag dbang / sbyor ra 'gro mgon/ lha rtse grub dbang rnams kyi sprul sku/ nā la nā bco brgyad pa/ bkra shis —/96

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadartse'i dbon/ stod ri bo che ba dang sger pa ba'i mi ngo'i rigs kyi chos rje/ khams rgya ston pa/ rgyal legs bshad gling / spyan sngar ma bton pa'i sgam po'i gdung brgyud/ ge re lha gdung brgyud/ bam ring mnga' ris khri rtse/ bzang ldan/ sgye chu/ chos 'khor lhun po/ 'dar grang mo che/ lhun rtse/ gangs can chos 'phel/ snar thang / ngor/ gser mdog can/ dpal 'khor bde chen/ thub bstan rnam rgyal/ thub bstan yangs can/ shangs ri bo dge 'phel/ skyed tshal gong / gra byams gling / gra thang / ri bo bde chen/rtses dang lnga mchod pa/ spyan g.yas pa/ gnyal sde drug /thar pa/ 'phags sde bzhi/ rdzing phyi/ sku rab dga' ldan rab brtan/ rwa sgreng / skyor mo lung / gsang sngags (141ba)mkhar rnams kyi mkhan po/bya yul/ mas dro chad ka /bde chen yangs pa can gsum gyi spyan snga/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/bsam yas dkar po/ yang 'ug /rta nag sgrol ma ba/ smra bo lcog pa/ gnas gzhi ba sogs sngags brgyud che ba rnams/ srab sum brtsegs pa gra zhe rdzog gra pa/ e brag sna ba/ la stod se brgya mkhar ba/gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon/ chos rje bkra bzang pa/ rtses dang chen po byang ma ba/ snye mdo ba sogs bka' gter gyi chos brgyud zin nges/ ser 'bras dge gsum/ chos 'khor rgyal/ bkra sa lhun po'i slob dpon pa rnams/ rgyal skabs sum stan snye 'bol dang / bcas bder sa stan gos stan kha gang ma kha gdan lta bur sna dkar rtse/ lha bya/ skyid shod/ stag lung pa sogs gdan sa gong 'og gi btsun mor kha gang ma bzhi brtsegs/ sne'u sdong rtse'i bdag mor sum brtsegs kha gdan/ sa stan steng gos stan yug pa lto 'bog mdong / thon pa/ gzims shag lho pa/ sde dpon che kha'i dpon sa'i rigs dang /nang so rnam pa dkyus ma las drag tsam la gung stan rigs gsum/ nang so rnam pa dkyus ma/ kre nag sogs 'brog rigs kyi dpon/ zhang ston/ dar sdings/ ri zhing / gru tshang pa'i mi ngo'i rigs sogs la mgo stan rigs gsum/ mjug bsgrigs rigs gsum/ stag gdan rigs gsum rnams gang 'os/rgya sngo dmar po gsum gyi grum stan 'jags ldan steng gsang phu'i chen po/ dpal ri sprul sku/ rdzogs chen sprul sku/ gong ra nges gsang gling gi bla ma/ gra dar sdings pa/ bla chen (142na skoms kyi phyag mdzod/ gong gsal 'jags med gsum gyi steng dbus gtsang sa dge bka' brgyud kyi dgon gra gtsang —197—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba'i slob dpon/ bal po'i rgyal khag /rgya gar ra go shing/ 'dzum lang / mnga' ris sogs phyogs mtha'i rgyal khag gi mi sna rnams la dmar grum yan/ nyis tshos/ ljang gu nag po gsum gyi steng btsan btsun/ bya bral gyi bla ma'i rigs/ rkyong gdan gang 'os steng drung 'khor/ lding dpon/ chos sde khag gi gnyer las 'dzin sogs/ srab lnga brtsegs steng rgya nag gong ma'i mi sna rgan gzhen/ gong gi tham kha 'dzin pa'i nang phyogs kyi nang so rnams khri mtho dma' ji ltar 'tsham pa'i steng khal kha'i rgyal po/ de las cung dma' bar bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po/ o rod se chen rgyal po sogs rgyas sar mnga' gsol ba'i rigs/ sa stan gos 'jab nyis brtsegs steng khal kha o rod kyi dpon po/ gos 'jab gcig gis dma' bar dpon chung dang dpon mo'i rigs/ grum tse mi bzang dang mi sna drag par 'ding ba spyir btang dang dmigs bsal/ lo gsar sogs zhugs gral chen mo'i dus khri'i nye skor du grong smad a bar la sa stan gos 'ja' kha bkug kha gang ma kha stan cog tse/ gzims dpon mchod dpon sogs las tshan che kha rnams la grum 'jag mgo stan/ rgyud stod smad ser 'bras kyi slob dpon lta bur sum stan snye 'bol chung ba byed skabs gdan gzos gong ma rnams kyang de ga'i 'gros kyis 'phar 'gro zhing grum 'jag thob par srab sum brtsegs lnga brtsegs gang rung mi babs dang bstun pa/ skyid shod sogs sde (142ba)dpon che kha rnams rgyun du sog po'i tha'i ji tsho dang lhan du 'tsho skabs sog po'i che bas mnyam pa la mi yong yang / rin chen rgyan sprod kyi dmigs bsal la sum stan snye 'bol che ba/'bog gong pa sogs de 'og ma tshor sum stan snye 'bol chung bas mtshon yul dus gnas skabs kyi bsgyur lugs/ bla bre/ pang lcog /'bras shel/ utpal/ ngang chung ma sogs hor dkar/ ga rma gan dkar/ rab dkar gyis mtshon pa'i bye brag rnams dpal phag mo gru pa'i lugs srol khungs mar gzhi byas pa'i zhib mo rnam dag rab gsal me long zhes bya ba bris/bkra shis lhun po pa rnams la bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang zur bka' dang lam rim 'khrid yig gsar rtsom gyi lung bklags/ gtsang gi chos sde chen po'i gos sku sde pa gong mas dbus su 'dren pa mdzad nas po ta la'i shar sgo'i lcog tu sdud pa gnang ba 'di res zhig gsos dgos pa grub —198

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadapa dang thang po cher bzhengs pa'i gser rkyang dang khra chen gyi bka' 'gyur gnyis/ dpag bsam 'khri shing / lam rim brgyud pa/ phreng ba'i dkyil thang sogs la rab gnas rgyas pa zhig dgos tshul sde pas gsungs byung ba po ta la'i pho brang la sngar rab gnas byung ma song bas ma 'gyangs par zhig gsos kyi sgo shar rigs nas 'phyis pa tsam yin 'dug rung dpal chen phur pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor phur cha dang bcas pa la brten nas tshes bcu gsum gza' lhag pa dang las skar sa ga /bcu bzhi res gza' lha'i bla ma dang zla skar lha mtshams kyi 'phrod sbyor shis pa'i thog dngos gzhi grub pa tshes kyi chu tshod khyad nas tho rangs snga (143na)zur nas btsugs shing nyin phyed yol nges la zin pa byas/ brjod bya don gi rab gnas ji ltar yang rjod byed tshig gi rab gnas lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sdom tshig la chu bun ma byugs tsam gyi lugs yin/ rab yon gra pa rer kha btags sman tse gos kha re/ bcu re'i sar gser zho re dang bur ltang / las tshan so sor go babs dang bstun pa'i tshan grangs/ khyon bsdoms kha btags chig brgya nga dgu/ gos kha rig brgya gya brgyad/ sman kha chig brgya gya bdun dar sna tshogs kha bco lnga/ gser zho dang bur ltang so sor bco brgyad/ sngo grum gnyis dang cha grum drug khril yug bzhi/lho ras yug dgu rnams song /tshes bco lnga'i nyin rab ston la tshoms chen du ding btags kyi sngags sku khyad mtshar mang dag bkod legs su bkram/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ sher 'phel sprul pa'i sku/ spyan g.yas mkhan po/ chos rje bco brgyad pa/ gter ston rin po che/ bkra shis bde chen dang chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla ma/dpal ri sprul pa'i sku/ dar rgyas chos sdings rgyal sras pa/ bkra shis lhun po dang dpal 'khor chos sde'i slob dpon kha shas/ sde srid ri bo brag pa/ bde chen tha'i ji/ thon zil gnon pa/ phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan/ stag lung phyag mdzod/ gra tshang yongs rdzogs/ drung 'khor skya ser sogs la gzhis len rgyas par bstar/ gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon pa de khrod du dgos rgyur 'dug rung zan chen rting par song skyon gyis ma byung / rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skus nad las grol (143ba)ba'i legs skyes dang ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung sbrags par bla ma mnga' bdag nyang gis 'phying ngam stag rtse'i bam so dmar —199

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)po nas spyan drangs pa'i byang chub ljon shing las grub pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon rgyud kyi shog ser chu glang gi rwa'i srog shing can gyis gtsos pa'i zang zing gi tshan grangs ster sbyin mdzad/tshes bcu drug la chos sde ri bo bde chen pas thog drangs spyan g.yas/ dpal ri/ 'phyos kyi dgon khag gsum/ drung 'khor/ lding khag dang bcas pas tshogs chas tshan grangs 'gyed kyi yon sbyar te gra tshang gis rdul tshon la brten pa'i 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog rgyas par btang / de rjes ri bo bde chen pa bzhi bcu skor gyi tshigs bcad gdangs ma gsungs/ khong rnams la byams smon/ lhung bshags/bzang spyod/ gtor ma brgya rtsa mu thi la'i 'khri shing rnams kyi lung bklags/ sang nyin yon sbyor dang cho ga sogs dbyibs 'dra ba'i skyid shod bde chen pa yab sras kyis sbyin bdag mdzad/tshes bco brgyad la chos sde chen po phan tshun gyi slob dpon/ las 'dzin/ dbon chos mdzad/ khams tshan/ mi tshan gyi mi sna/ bdag mo rtse chen ma/ chos rje chu mig pa/ nang gi drung 'khor gras nas grong smad sde pa a bar dang bcas la rab ston gyi bzhugs gral btang / tshes bcu dgu la bkra shis lhun po ba skor bcas thon pa'i rdzong bda' rgyas par gyis/ phyag mdzod dang slob dpon rnams kyis bskul ba'i nged rang dang sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i brtan bzhugs/ gzhis ka shar pa a gur gyis log (144na)tri'i bsnyen mtshams kyi dus skyabs sems smon lam bkra shis/ chos blon bran ka dpal yon mtshams sbyor ngan pa'i rkyen gyis mi ma yin du skyes pa 'phan yul thang sag gi gzhi bdag yin pa'i khar phyi skor bya bral gtsod ru lag tu thogs pa'i dam sri zhig gis bla ma snga phyi dang gra pa mang por bar chad byung ba ltas ngan g.yang 'gugs yin khul gyi gsol mchod byed rgyu dang ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ ri go bde chen gyi gra rigs 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas ri bo brag btsan pa'i gsol mchod/ bkra shis bde chen du 'dzugs rtsis kyis 'phyos pa don rgyam pas bskul ba'i kha ton gsol 'debs rgya skad ma/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas gra tshang dang ri bo bde chen du snyan dang phul ba'i kha yig rnams bris/nyer gcig la chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis gtsos bkra shis ljongs pa gra bcas kyis zang —200—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)zing gi ster sbyin mdzad de ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsung / blo bzang nyi ma dge 'dun blo gros can ri bo bde chen dang bkra shis bde chen gyi gra pa bcu bdun bsnyen par rdzogs/ bro 'tshal ba las grol ba'i dga' ston du bye ri stag rtse nas tha'i ji yab sras kyis dkar spro dmar spro'i bzhugs gral dang bdog pa rgyas par byung / shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor slob dpon can la sman bla'i brgyud 'debs kyi lung byas/hor zla lnga pa phyi ma'i tshes gcig la bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal mo bzhi pa dang sras bkra shis/ tre bo dkar lcog sprul sku/ rtse gdong phyag mdzod/ zha lu'i slob dpon sogs (144ba〉skugs skyes bstab par 'byor/ gsang sngags mkhar mkhan slob/ lha sa sde bzhi dang bcas pas dngos po'i tshan grangs tshar du dngar te ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs par so so'i lugs kyi zhal 'don rim gyis mdzad khul la sngags mkhar ba rnams kyis rang rkya ma pher bar lha sa ba tshor babs phul te rjes su 'brangs/ nyang stod nas gnubs kyi sngags 'chang bgrad pa mched/ gnyos kyi sngags 'chang gung ru ba yab sras/ rtse tshogs pa'i gra pa sogs phyogs 'dus mang bar ja gral btang / skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan tshes lnga la bar khams sogs kyi don gcod la mtsho sngon por thon/tshes drug la nged rang gis mkhan po/ pha bong kha'i slob dpon 'jam dbyangs grags pas las slob/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas gsang ston byas te tre bo dkar lcog sprul sku bsnyen par rdzogs/ sang nyin stag lung zhabs drung kun spangs pa phebs par chibs bsu ldang ba mjal dar bzhugasakhris mtshon pa'i bkur bzos gang che zhus shing rta drug cus gtsos pa'i gnang cha dpangs bstod/ sde pa nor bu'i sku rim srung 'bor srad rgyud slob dpon/ rong pa rdzogs chen pa'i bu chen ga me tshe brtan nam blo bde hang sangs can skya ser mang zhig dang phrad/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lus dben lugs sogs lam gyi dka' gnad du ma'i dri ba byas par srad rgyud slob dpon pa rgyal ba btsong pa kha yab sras kyi gsung rab dang mthun pa'i gleng mo rnam dpyod dang ldan pa snang / drug cu par zha lu ba'i rtsa tshig drangs pa'i bshad yam byed (145na)'dug rung rnying ma'i mdos gtor mthong ba la yang dpe —201—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)blangs rngam rngam 'jigs 'jigs gtso bor bton pa'i gu yangs dpa' thal las lugs srol khungs btsun yod nyams kyi gtam mi smra/ blo bde hang sangs ni rdzogs chen gyi nyams rtogs cher med kyang rdo rje sems pa'i sku rkyang pa tsam 'char zer ba de nyams gong 'phel gyi mjug dang rig pa tshad phebs kyi skabs yin rung chos nyid mngon sum gyi thog ma lta bur 'brul ba'i bla btsongs song ba rin ci byung ni ma shes/tshes dgu la stag lung zhabs drung rin po che dpon slob dang rgyud stod slob dpon pa can la grub rgyal lugs kyi lha gcig bum gcig gi tshe dbang zhabs drung dang slob dpon pa/ ge ra gsol dpon/dar mo 'tsho byed bzhin ba ri lugs kyi rnam 'joms la brten pa'i bkru byab srung gsum phul/ de grub bstun gsung bgros gnang khyad nas mi gzhan med pa'i gsol ja sbyor gsum gyi ring zhabs drung chen mo dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa dang khu dbon gnyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa las tshan 'ga'i bi na ya rka'i 'phrul gyis ngos mjal ma byung ba bzhugs khri mtho la kun gyis bsnyad pa'i gzhir gyur tshul sogs rkarma phrin las pa'i thub chen gdan sa dang 'dra ba'i gsung gcod shin tu che ba 'byon pa rgyas pas brag thog nas chu 'byor ba lta bu nyan/ bda' lan gyi 'bul ba gzhiX/len chibs skyel dang bcas dpal ldan thang pa'i chos kyi 'tsho ba'i bsti gnas chen por glang chen dal 'gros kyis gshegs/ rigs kun khyab bdag zha lu (145ba)mkhan chen kun spangs pa gong dkar chos sder phebs par gsol phogs dang bcas zla gcig gi lhag gi bar stan chags mur tshes bcu gcig la phebs pa dang mjal/zla gcig lhag tsam bzhugs par kye rdor nang dbang / lam zab bir srung / mkha' spyod ma/ phyar rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa dang mi zhabrugs pa lha bcu gsum ma rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs bzhin chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag len 'khrul med ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dbang / phyag bzhi pa ngor phyogs nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang khungs btsun/ seng gdong ma dmar mo/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs sogs dbang byin rlabs kha yar/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab mang po'i lung / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi phyag rgya 'ching tshul gyis mtshon phyag len gyi rigs mang —202

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadadu zhus/ 'di skabs sku khog gi bu rgan pa dbang rgyal rdo rje la gnas chung chos skyong chen po phebs nges la bdag mor brten pa'i bsgyur sbyang gi bka' lung rtsub par gra tshang gnyer pa sogs kyis dang blangs ma nus pas skyengs pa zhig yin nam/ rjes su dogs pa za ba gcig tsam ma gtogs 'dre yan zhig zhugs par snang / ge ra gsol dpon gyi nu bo blo bzang dge 'dun 'das pa'i don du gtsug lag khang yas mas la snyan shal phul bar dgos tshul bzhin kha yig /skyor lung mtshan nyid par dam sri'i gnod pa mi yong bden brjod/ le'u bdun ma'i par byang rnams bris/tshes bcu gsum la skyor lung chos sdes gtso me shun dang de mtshungs sne2 khul gyi (146na)drung 'khor mi ser spyi bsdus/ gsas khang dgon pa/ gsang ne'u thog spyi so/ ra ba stod pa sger dang bcas pa so sos gos dar ras snam ja sogs ka ca'i tshan grangs ring por brkyang ste tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ ra ba stod slob dpon pas gsang phu bla ma so so'i sham thabs khral dang ra ba stod sger gyi bla ma'i ster cha mda' gcig gis shwa ba gnyis bsad pas a khu ston par thog dgra btang / gzhis ka rtse'i mnga' khul spyi tshogs kyi legs skyel ba/ kho spe dang rnam rab dwags po gra tshang pa'i bla ma rnams dang phrad/ tshes bco brgyad la thugs sras sprul sku/ sgrol ma phug pa'i thugs sras ga'one pa/ gra tshang gi gra pa thor bu/ 'dar pa lo tsā/ zha lu mkhan rin po che'i phyag mdzod bsod nams rin chen la gter kha 'og ma'i sngags rgod log tri pa'i rig gtad byas/ dbang yon du gri dang khab sogs 'bul srol 'dug par mchod dpon pas khyab bsdus pa la thugs sras kyis ngas spu gri ngar ma zhig phul grub ces ma bcos lhug pa 'dra mo la nang lcags skud ltar grims pa zhig snang / sgrol ma nas kyis gsang rnying / rtsa rgyud kyi rgyugs sprad/thugs sras sprul skus gu ru lha khang du gra tshang gsar du btsugs te rnying bstan gog po la wa kha thigs tshags mdzad bzhed kyi gra pa sum cu skor dang rtogs ldan chos dbyings rang grol gyi skye bas dge tshul ba/glubs/nyer gnyis la gra tshang du khro rol dang tshe bdag zor sgrub kyi rim gro 'phar ma btsugs/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde kun gyi yang rtse chos lung tshogs pa zhes/ (146bsko'u sdong gong —203—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ma'i mched zla'i mkhan por rgya phrug rab 'byams smra ba'i seng ge btang / rtse tshogs kyis bskul ba'i sde pa'i brtan bzhugs/ kye rdor bskyed rim dang dbang chu'i par byang / ra ba stod kyi bla brgyud kha skongs/dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtshos lha sar 'phan phul ba'i kha byang / spos khang mkhan po pa rnam dge slong du grags pa'i gsol 'debs/ thugs sras sprul sku'i gra tshang la theg mchog rab rgyas gling du btags shing de dang mthun pa'i smon lam rnams bris/ ser 'bras gnyis ka nas phogs kyis ma ldangs tshul gyi nan zhus sde par byung ba la brten sgrib sbyong la dmigs pa'i dang dod mdzad ba ched dang bcas 'bras spungs su dgon pa sar/ stag lung brag /za dam sna mo gzhis ka them 'dzin soganyis/ lag 'bab chig stong lnga brgya nyer gnyis/ ser ra ba lang shar/ gung ra gzhis ka them 'dzin bcu bdun/ lag 'bab chig stong sum rgya zhe gnyis/ bsam yas sprul pa'i chos skyong chen pos dkar me'i thebs dgos tshul byung ba bzhin gra rab mi ser them bcu gnyis/ lag 'bab chig stong bzhi brgya bcu bzhi 'byed khra'i don ltar sbyor 'jags zhus/ rang nyid 'chi bar 'jigs pa'i rkyen sel la tshogs gsog dang bstan 'gro'i don du btags pa'i ming snyan po'i rim gro la sman bla stong phrag gsum/ mtshan brjod 'bum ther/ 'bum brgya/ bka' 'gyur tshar drug cu/ gshin rje 'dus pa drag sngags bzlog pa dang bcas pa/ srong btsan du bkang brgya/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ sa dge'i gtsang dgon rags bsdus (147na)brgya dang bcu la mang 'gyed thog tshe gzungs sgrol ma gsungs/nyer bdun la chos rje 'ug bya lung pa/ gra snye mdo ba so ston ngag dbang shākya dpal 'bar/ myug chos 'khor gling gi bla ma can mang ba dang phrad/ snye mdo ba 'di bar skabs su rtogs ldan byed skabs lha sa skor du rdo rje 'chang tsam la brtsi ba 'dug rung rang gi pha chos gog po byas pa nas bzung so skye tha mal pa zhig tu song ba ni gang yin cha ma thengs chos gling slob dpon dang 'phros byas par gra tshang gsar pa bslab sbyangs thon skyed chen pos yod tshul zer bas rtsam tshos shig rgyag pa'i rigs su med par gda'/ o rod g.yon du dga' ldan hung tha'i jis mi sna ched du mngags pa dang rtses dang skya ser gyis tshogs 'khor tshan grangs 'gyed bcas gya nom pa'i sgo nas hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig gnyis la —204

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)rim pa bzhin gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog rgyas par mdzad/ rin spungs dang ngam ring khul skya ser spyi bsdus kyi legs skyes bstar/ tshes drug la mi bskyod rdo rje gzugs gzhan du bsgyur te ngur smrig gos kyis klubs pa'i dpal ldan smad rgyud gra tshang dpon slob kyis dngos po'i tshan grangs dang bden tshig shis brjod gnang / stag lung sangs rgyas dbon gyis rgya bo gdong nas chos gter dang lhan du bzhes par grags pa'i o rgyan chen po'i phyag dril stag lung zhabs drung zur pa'i phyag tham rten la byung /tshes bcu la bdag mo yum sras la rnam 'joms kyi bkru byab srung gsum/ 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang / rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi (147ba)byin rlabs phul/ mkhan chen zha lu pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar gdan sa gong zhabs drung rin po che yab sras kyi brtan bzhugs/ ge ra chos mdzad blo bzang dge 'dun gyi phyi rten thang kha'i rgyab yig /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gnyis kyi nyams len du lam zab phyi ma'i rnal 'byor/ dpon mo tshe dbang rgyal mo'i kha ton du bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ chos rje snye mdo ba'i ngor ring la'i tshigs bcad/ lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bskul ba'i thang kha'i rgyab yig dang gsol 'debs ring 'tsho'i smon lam/spos 'dzin pa ngag dbang nam mkha'i kha ton du gsol 'debs rnams bris/tshes bcu bzhi la rong dga' ldan byams chen pa bla gra rags rim 'byor ba'i maṇḍal gyi tshul du ster byin gzengs bstod de gsol ba btab/ pā ras skor la sngar nas 'then 'khyer byed pa g.yon du dga' ldan hung tha'i jis bstan pa'i la rgyar bsam shing 'di gar gong brgyab nas sbyor 'jags sogs la bdag rkyen gzengs bstod kyi yul du go bas tham kha dmar po sgam bcas/ shal dkar dmar snam phrug gis gtsos legs rten bzang ba dang bcas mi sna phyir thon/ khal kha rgyal khang rtse sprul sku'i mi sna slebs/ srid gsum bdag mo'i rgyun mdos grol ba'i mu 'thud de gra tshang du bkang ba nyin gsum btsugs skabs zhal byang can gyi dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan dar phul/ shel dkar/ ngam ring /rnam gling / pa rnam bzhir bka' 'gyur skya pod tshar re dang 'brang rgyas shag pa nang so dgos dgos —205

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)(148na)kyis bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i dkar chag che brjod brtsams/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa zhig gis gsar rtsom gyi phar phyin/ dpon tshang dkyil spe ba'i slob ma dol pa zhig dang rten khang dpon tshang dang dar mo ba'i slob ma rgya dbang phyug rgya mtsho gnyis kyis rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/bal po dpa' shing / bkra shis/ chos rgyal/ glang bu tra/ gu ṇa tsand+ra/ a ha ṇa/ bye dha na ste bzo bo mkhasapa bdun bkug do dam 'tsho byed sgo mo rab pa ratna sa byas te bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bde bar gshegs pa mched brgyad kyi sku brnyan li brdzus che chung tshar re bzhengs pa'i dpe yar stod sprul sku rdzing kha ba'i lag bzo'i sman sku zhig 'dug pa de la byas pas legs rab byung / de zhor klu dbang gi rgyal po'i sku gcig dang sku par/ sde pa'i bzhed pa ltar thub dbang gi sku gcig dang dus gsum sangs kyi rgyas sku/ 'od dpag med kyi sku gnyis/ o rgyan rin po che'i sku gnyis/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag gcig dang bcas bzheng ba'i las gra btsugs/tshes bcu drug la khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa mkhan chen zha lu pa/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po/ dbon tshang dkyil spe ba/ chos rje na bza' gling pa/ drung 'tsho ngag dbang lhag bsam/ dar mo nas kyis mtshon 'tsho byed kha shas/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa can gra tshang gi gra pa 'ga' zhig /spos 'dzin pa ngag dbang nam mkha' bcas par ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po (148ba)g.yu thog pa'i snying tig gi dbang bzhi mtha' brten du sman gyi drang srong dang chos skyong gi bka' gtad/ tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'joms/ sman gyi lha mo'i rjes gnang / glegs bam yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams phul/ byang ngos kyi sras sman rgyal tshe dbang la 'phros byas na bsam pa shar rung chu 'brug po ta lar zur thams cad mkhyen pa la dpon tshang tsha rong pas zhus skabs sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis byang ngos nas la e gsan gsungs kyang ma byon 'dug pa g.yu thog snying tig 'di chos gsha' ma min pa'i 'byer so zhig yod na snyam gleng brjod ma bde/ zha lu mkhan rin pos ches bstan rgyun la dgongs nas thugs rtsol che ba gnang gin 'dug par tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin mkhan rin po ches dbu gnang / gter ston rin po che/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/—206

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 'dedage slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ sngags rams pa dga' ba gdong pa sogs gra tshang gi gra pa bco lnga skor dang bcas par mkhas grub rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'brul 'khor khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi steng nas 'khor lo'i phyag khrid/ lteb lugs phyag len man ngag zhal shes ma yig bu yig gi lung dang bcas pa rdzogs par phul/ sngar khri rin po che mnga' ris pas dbu gnang dge ba'i bshes gnyen sum cu skor la phul yang gsang sngags gsang ba la dgongs sam phyi mched ni ye ma byung 'dug /da lam mkhan rin po ches spel ba mdzad khul du snang yang lcags kyu dang a lung gi dpe bzhin don gnyer yong mi yong ni cha ma things/ tshes bcu dgu la lha rin po che/ khal kha nas byams pa sprul pa'i sku gshegs (149na)pa'i bsngo zhus pa dga' ldan kha dan pā thur gyi mi sna/ bal po ye rang rgyal po'i sras mo rgan pa'i mag pa su lang tha sidha ku mā la dza dus skyabs 'jug dgos tshul gyi yi ge rten bcas khyer ba'i mi sna ka ma la yan can dang phrad/tshes nyi shu la byams pa'i gos sku dang gser sbyangs las grub pa'i bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs dngos gtsang ba 'bras spungs dang rgyal rtse ba'i gos sku nang mar grags pa dang sde pa'i sdig sbyongs la bzhengs pa'i khra chen gyi bka' 'gyur se ra theg chen gling du phul ba gra pa brgya skor re byon te ser sbreng dang bcas so sor gdan drangs/ de nyin dge slong grub pa dang chos rje kha rag pa gnyis kyis char bsrungs pa phyi dril la sbangs che ba byung na'ang dngos gzhi la skyon ma byung gshis rdul mi ldang ba'i tshul du sri zhu byas zhes sngags ban tsho'i 'bros khungs btsal na yong ngam snyam/ bkra shis ljongs chos rjes dben sa snyan brgyud kyi nang nas cho ga 'khyer bde ba zhig dgos tshul yang yang byung ba de 'dra'i stabs bde ba mi 'dug pas de skor yongs rdzogs chog bsgrigs byas nas phul kyang gangs dkar te se'i zla bo bzhin byung ba 'dra rjes su 'phros 'phros mi mdzad/nyer lnga lamakhan si po ches gnang skyes dang ri ba masang por 'tsho ba'i bden brjod mdzad/ dpon tshang dkyil spe ba'i ngor g.yu thog snying tig gi brgyud 'debs brtsams shing mkhan rin po cher lung phul/ nyer bdun la rdo nga gyo mtshodagon gyi bla ma 'or pa dka' bcu/ gting skyes mnga' khul gyi legs bya brnams dang phrad/—207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gnyis la yar klungs nas tsha (149ba)mig tshogs pa mkhan slob lnga bcu skor byon pa'i tshogs 'khor tshan grangs yon gyi sbyin bdag mdzad de gra tshang gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe tshog btang / tsar stod jo zhwa zhe gcig pa'i gral ring bsgrigs tshe nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'phreng du bstar ba lta bur snang / sger du'ang chos spyod dang ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/tshes lnga la sna dkar rtse nas sa skyong ba gos dkar lcang lo'i phreng ba can/ rdzing phyi mkhan po co ne chos rje/ phyogs mtha'i legs skyel ba mang po dang mjal phrad byas/ mkha' spyod ma'i tshom bu'i dkyil thang gi lha mgron la tshar chen yab sras gsum gyi zhal gzigs ma'i zhing bkod thor bu yod pa gsar bzhengs kyi rgyab yig smon lam/ mchod dpon pas las bzhi lha mo'i bris sku bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig 'phrin 'chol/ rgyal khang rtse'i sprul sku lcam sring ma mkha' 'gro skyabs 'das par smon lam dgos tshul byung ba rnams brtsams/tshes bdun la yar klungs bkra shis rtse'i chos sde nas rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba'i dpon rin po che dang lcam sring mkhyen rab blo ldan dpon slob byon pa dang mjal/ khyab bdag zha lu par chos yon gyi sri zhu gya nom nga/ phul te gtsang stod zha lu'i chos grar chibs kha bskyod/ 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad gter gzhung dang chos rgyal byang pa'i ljags bsgrigs gnyis ka ha cang gsal rgyu mi 'dug gshis zur rtsa ba'i bla ma'i phyag len 'khrul med chog bsgrigs mthong bas don ldan nag 'gros su bkod/tshes bcu gcig la lha rtse mnga' khul skya ser gyis nad las grol (150na)ba'i bdog pa ring por brkyangs/ dpon mo sa'i khan ju'i sog po mtsho khar yod pa 'ongs te mang ja dang bsngo rten gang yod la dpags pa'i spams bstod byed khul la ban chung gis rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba byas par dge rgan rnams ma rangs pa byed na'ang nor gyis bdag po byung na sla nga'i lhan pa bkog par lab rgyu med pa 'dra/ bdag mos gu ru mtshan brgyad la sa rgyu rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod kyis bskor ba'i sku thang gra tshar —208

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ngu)bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /thos bsam dar rgyas gling pas bskul ba'i sde pa'i brtan bzhugs/ gsol dpon ge ra bas 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig rnams bris/ sngar phan bde legs bshad gling pa spyi tshogs kyi rnal 'byor zab mo'i rten du zhal thang gra tshar bris pa ha cang ches pa'i byes la 'dren pa'i 'phral bder bed chung skyon la brten sman lugs kyi nag thang bkrag chen che chung 'tsham pa gra tshar zhig dang de mtshungs 'bras spungs gzims chung mgon khang du yang tshar gcig sde pas legs tshul gsungs pa ltar sprul sku dpal mgon gyis gtsos pa'i lha ris pa tshor mgon po phyag drug pa'i byin rlabs bzo bo dang tshon lag cha rnams la byin rlabs rgyud sde las gsungs pa ltar byas/ rjes gnang gis 'tshub cha dang bar chad sel ba'i khungs la dbu mdzad dpal mgon 'das pa sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i byin rlabs bla chen gyi bstan pa zin nges shig byung / pho brang mnga' khul drag zhan gyi tshogs chas tshan grangs 'gyed kyi sbyin bdag byas te tshes bcu gnyis la gra tshang gis mdzod dbus ma'i tshe mtha' yas pa'i (150ba 〉 sbo ga rgyas par btang / sang nyin rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gdan sa ba rtse tshogs mkhan chen/ sde srid sna dkar rtse pa/ skyid shod chos rje'i sprul sku/ zhal snga nas pha bong kha pa/ dar gling slob dpon/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa/ rtse tshogs/ dar rgyas gling pa'i dge 'dun rnams la sman bla sprul sku dang seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang / sman bla'i mdo chog /rgyal sras thogs med pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma/ kha che paṇa chen gyi skyid sdug lam 'khyer 'khrid brgya'i nang nas phyung ba/ bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga /rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i sman bla'i lhan thabs/ nged rang gi brtsams chos sman bla dang blo sbyong rgyud 'debs/ klu gtor/ dkar cha bzhi/ gtor ma brgya rtsa mu thi la'i 'khri shing / g.ya' bzang lha mo dang sham po'i gsol mchod/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i gtor 'bul rab 'byams rgyal ba ma/ ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kha shas kyi lung phul/ sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa tshogs par yod med dris par mkhan pos dbu yon las gsung mi 'byon pa mi phos ma smras pa rdzong du 'dug cing gra pa rgan pa 'dras gtong —2(19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)srol yod dkar cha bzhi chag med mdzad zer bas de nang gi sgrol mar ngos 'dzin par snang / yar klungs mthil gyi 'dren pa tshor 'khrul pa mi mnga' bas rje btsun gong ma'i gsung la zhus dag dgos par gda'/tshes bco lnga la chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla mar 'gro mkhan rab 'byams pa phun tshogs mngon tho can mi bco brgyad (151na)bsnyen par rdzogs/ tshes bcu bdun la ṛ ṣi shar bas chu zhugs dang ljongs rgyu ba sbrags te phyin/ sang nyin 'dzum lang rgyal po'i mi sna dzā la bhaṇḍa ri can 'byor ba'i rgyal po'i yi ge dang rten bcas rnams sprad/ shag skor bas rigs gra'i skal ba dang lha sa'i gnas chen du mas bzhes spro bteg /dbus gtsang du rgyu 'khrul gyi tshe gur chen bka' blo mi bde bar sde pas gsar bzo mdzad pa gnam sngon gzhon par grags pa'i gur ston tshes bcu dgur mdzad pa'i bzhugs gral la rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku/ bkra shis rtse'i dbon rin po che/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po/ ka tshal zur pa/'brog khri dpon/ gra tshang / drung 'khor/ 'jums lang mi sna dang bcas gtos che ba la dga' ston bstar/ de skabs drung 'khor rgan gzhen la ma bltos pa'i phul skor yod med kyi gral bsgrigs la brten sa ba gru pa bzo bo'i do dam nas ma bos pa'i gral 'phros kyi phyed ya ma byung bar nged kyis bshad yam sna tshogs kha thag gang ring la sde pa 'dar los lan shin tu rgyas par spros/ nyi ma snga rting gi snga dro 'gol skabs rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub la bram ze sngags rgod kyi dogs gcod 'phro lus rnams zhib tu dpyad/ sang nyin gur de gar gra tshang gis zhabs tog la yang kha sang bzhin 'phros gleng byas/ gur gyi ming 'dod khams dpal 'byor du btags shing me tog gtor nas rdzong du log /nyer gnyis la stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras dang bla ma bkra bzang pa sogs mang ba dang phrad/ tha'i ji yab sras la phyag (151ba)drug pa'i byin rlabs bar chad kun sel phul/ nyer bdun la sol thon tha'i shi'i bu mo/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ ru thog dbang po'i sras/ mer gan hung tha'i ji'i mi sna/ ma —210

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadagacig tha'i ji'i bu dpon mo bcas pa dang phrad/ da yan ja'i sang gis rta nyi shu byung /hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la byams gling mkhan po/ 'brog dpal de bas gtsos kong po g.yul rgyal rab brtan gyi skya ser spyi tsho gos kyi legs skyes/ mdo smad nasahrūl pa slebs pa'i zhing stong nang so khu dbon gyis dngul lnga bcu ma drug dang rta bcu gsum gyis gtsos pa'i gos dar ja ras/ zhing skyong paṇḍi ta'i dbon pos gong gsal gyi dngos po cha shas pa'i tshan mi chung ba/ klu 'bum dbon pos rta bcu/klu 'bum tshe brtan gyis rta nyi shu rtsa gsum/ bsam blo gnas brtan can gyis rta bcu/ blo bzang bstan dar gyis rta bcu gnyis kyis mtshon zang zing gi bdog pa rgya cher bstabs/ gong dkar dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling pa'i gra pa zhig gis 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i rgyugs sprad/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i gra pa rags rim la shing lug bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyis gtsos pa'i sngags gsar rnying gi dbang lung mang du phul zhing de rjes gsar 'byor mang por sa khyi phur pa/ 'char ka gnubs lugs/lcags stag thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs song rung rjes su gra gsar mangs pa la brten gra tshang spyi so bka' bgros pa'i dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa gnyis (152na)kyis snyan gsan kha yar zer ba dang de'i mu 'thud dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum gyis nan chen pos mtshams sbyar te/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skur phur pa che mchog dang gter ston rin po cher tshe bdag 'bul dgos kyis kyang rkyen byas tshes bdun nas bzung nyin kha shas kyi bar pho brang chen po'i tshoms chen du rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ bkra shis rtse'i dbon rin po che/ gter ston rigasa'adzin chen po/ chos rje bkra bzang pa/ nges gsang rdo rje gling gi gdan sa pa dung dgon chos rje/ dbon mkhyen rab blo ldan/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ gzhis ka shar a gur can gsum/ drung 'tsho ba ngag dbang lhag bsam/ ngag dbang 'phrin las pha bu/ bla ma kha gcig gi gra pa thor bu dang bcas phyed nyis brgya skor la gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi ras bris kyi —211—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dkyil 'khor la brten te thig tshon gyi cho ga tsam ma gtogs sngon 'gro nas bzung dngos grub len chog gi bar sgrub chen gyi phyag len chad lhag med pa phul/ bum dbang gi dus ma rgyud kyi dbang la sprod pa'i rus pa'i rgyan drug de byed rtsis yin rung shel rgyan gyi thog ma'i rten 'brel la da lam sprad pa 'gab 'dra zla bo rnams kyis zer bas bka' brgyad khro bo'i dbang la 'brel chags rgyu mi 'dug kyang rnying lugs la shel rgyan sprod mkhan dang stod khog rus rgyan la smad khog shel rgyan byed pa sogs gu yangs gshis nged rang (152bskos kyang byed pa shar/ dbon rin po ches chos sde yas mas tshor gsung sgros mdzad na khrel dgod rgyab mi yong la che/ de steng chos rje chu mig pa yang 'byor bar 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang bzhi/ byang gter phur pa che mchog dang lcags khang ma so so'i gter gzhung sor gnas/ 'jam dpal rdzogs chen gyi dbang / rigs 'dzin chen po'i gter gsar tshe grub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i dbang / gru gu yang wang gi gter ma'i 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad/gnubs lugs stag zhen gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bsdus pa gter gzhung sor gnas / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'char ka gnam skas ma'i dbang chos rgyal byang pa'i phyag bzhes dang chos rje dang ma ba'i phyag len cung zad mi 'dra bas so sor tshar re/ 'jam dpal rdzogs chen dang tshe grub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gnyis nyi ma phyi ma yin pas de skabs chos rje gnas gzhi ba dang bsam grub dgon pa ba spun gnyis kyang slebs/gtsang du sku rim slo bur ba zhig tshugs nas bka' brgyad sgrub chen grol mtshams bla ma dga' rab thon pa chos 'phro la 'phreng ba tsam byas tshod du 'dug /dbang sgrub/ 'dzab thun/ dkyil 'khor/dbang rdzas/ mchod gtor phyag len mtha' dag gzhung dang brgyud pa'i bzhed srol ma nyams pa'i lugs kyi gra 'grig cing bgegs skrod sogs la me thun/ chu thun/ dbyangs rol/ ging pa'i tsham ngam dang srog dbang / bsgral dbang / zor dbang tshor bdud chas su zhugs pas mtshon snga 'gyur ba'i chos brgyad po de shin tu 'phel bar (153na)byas/ 'on kyang dregs pa dbang du sdud cing las la bskul ba la lta —212

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)ba'i rtsal/ gnyen po'i stobs/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs shig med na gsar ma ba'i ngo zhus bag ma 'dra ba des sa lam mi phyod par gda'o/ /dbang rnams grub nas chos rje chu mig pa dang bsam grub dgon pa ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan ma tshang bar ma khri skol byang dpe ma rnyed/ gzhan bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi chos skor cha tshang / gshin rje tshe bdag lcags 'dra dang lcags sdig gi skor/ byang gter phur pa lugs gsum/ 'char ka gnam skas ma'i skor/ 'jam dpal rdzogs chen/ tshe grub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i skor sogs thob yig gsor gnas/ bde 'dus nas sngags bzlog chen mo/ mchod pa phud skongs/ 'char ga'i brkos rje zhu ba zhu lan/ gsar rtsom bka' brgyad las byang gi chog sgrigs/ khro rol chog sgrigs/ las byang le brgyad ma/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos sogs kha yar gyi lung rnams phul nas chos tshan nyer lnga nas dbu btsugs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ lung gi rked pa nas rta nag sgrol ma ba'i gdung brgyud gzhon pa'ang 'byor/ snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin tsho dang gra tshang gi gra pa nyi shu skor/ gzhis ka shar pha bu dang ngag dbang 'phrin las bcas pa la mchod rten bcas chog lcags 'dra lugs dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi phyag bzhes dang / lcags sdig lugs 'bri gung chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyi phyag len bzhin dngos su mchod rten brtsig pa dang 'khor lo'i dpe ris ngo sprod/'chi bdag zhal dbye/ mchod rten gyi gzungs (153ba smon bul/ rab gnas sgrub pa'i bar dmar khrid mdzub btsugs thugs nges rnyed du legs par khrid/ zla mtshams tshun 'chad nyan 'phel bar byung / snga 'gyur gyi dgon gzhis mang por mchod rten bcad chog 'di bzhugs na'ang ding sang rdul dang mun pa'i mal du bag la zha ba da lam gad bdar legs po byas nas lha ngo mi ngo 'phrod pa'i lugs su bgyis/bla ma zhig gis sha'i nyes dmigs bshad nas de bshad tshod yin 'di yin zhes pa'i dpe ltar gra tshang gi gra pa rnams kyis kyang 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi bshad tshod dang mi 'dra ba'i lag len nyams myong ma 'di tsho lag tu bstar na dbu khug ma gtogs dbu hril mdzad dgos med do/ /tshes bcu gcig la gon jo dka' bcu blo bzang phun tshogs kyi bsngo rten rta bzhi bcu zhe drug dang —213—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dre'u drug cu re lnga/ pā ras nang so grags pa rgyal mtshan can gyis rta bzhi bcu zhe dgu/ ma la'i mer gan tha'i jis rta bcu gcig rnams byin/ bcu bdun la sgye chu mkhan po/ e wam bla ma/ da la'i hung tha'i ri'i mi sna/ shel dkar dang ngam ring mnga' khul skya ser gyis legs so'i tshan grangs spel/ 'dar grang mo che'i mkhan po ka dpe bar gsung ngag slob bshad kyi bstan pa spel dgos tshul mol zhing 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i gsung ngag 'khrid yig rmi lam nas 'phror lus pa gang yod kyi lung thob 'dug rung de man la nged kyis zin bris byas pa dang lam zab nang ma/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dpyad don dang sems 'dzin sbrags nas gtong tshul gyi lung bklags/ tshes (154na)bcu dgu la bya bral gyi khams pa dar rgyas can gyis rta bco lnga byung / nyer lnga la zhing skyong nang so can rdzong bda' dang snar thang khron pa kha'i bla ma bcas par phyag drug pa'i byin rlabs bar chad kun sel byas/ khron pa kha'i bla ma 'di bstan pa la zhe rus che nyams kyi 'phros pa shugs drag byed par snang zhing lha sar skor ba gsog ring zur gsos ja mar sha rtsam gyi mthun rkyen kyang sbyar/ dbus gtsang gi chos sde bcu gnyis so so nas gra pa rags bsdus brgya phrag gis nyin rer sman bla'i mdo chog chen mo tshar bzhi re'i rtsis kyi zla gcig bar gsungs pa'i khyon chig 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong / 'bras spungs bde yangs gra tshang ba dge 'dun brgyas lha sa dkyil 'khor sdings su nyin lnga'i bar brgya mchod sna lnga phul thog zhal 'don du spyan 'dren khrus gsol dang smon lam rnam gsum/lha ldan/ ra mo che'i rten rnams la zhal gser spyan 'byed/ sa dge'i dgon che chung nyis brgyar mang ja sbyor sbrel dang 'bru mkhar khal byed gnyis brtsis kyi 'gyed/ chos sde chen po phan tshun du zhag bco lnga'i ring mang ja 'gyed bcas kyi thog bzang spyod gang 'gro/ chos 'khor rgyal du dpal ldan re ma tir bkang ba chig 'bum/ zhal dang beg tser chog khri/ chos skyong spyir stong / da lam gyi tshogs gsog phal cher mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams kyi don du bsngo rgyur thub na phan yon che rab yong ba 'dug rung bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dam pos las sgrib srab tu song na nad gdon la phan nam snyam pa'i 'dun pa —214

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)yin yang dkor nag gis rgyun mi 'chad par 'bags (154ba)pa'i sgo gsum gyi spyod pas je 'thug tu 'gro 'dug gshis dgun gyi bem po yin na 'ong bar gda'/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gnyis la dga' ldan khri rin po che'i sku skye ngag dbang phun tshogs sogs dge tshul bzhi/ thag ring du 'gro mi dge slob bzhi bcu skor bsgrubs/ bro 'tshal ba las grol ba'i legs skyes su rwa sgreng mkhan pos rta bco lnga/ spyi sos dgu/ mtsho sna/ lho brag mnga' khul gyi lha sde mi zhes bdog pa gya nom pa bstar/ dga' ldan don gnyis gling gra dmangs kyis ring 'tsho'i smon lam gsungs/ nyi lde sprul pa'i skur sngar rgyun gyi bdag rkyen gang legs byas/ tre bo jo ro dgon sku skyes rta brgyad cu/ zung chu bsam gtan can dang bkras rgyam pa can gyis nyi shu re/ brag nyi gnyer rgan can gyis bco brgyad/ ja gos dar ras kyis mtshon pa spams bstod/tshes gsum la chos rje legs bshad gling pas gtsos pa'i chos 'khor rgyal gra slob sum cu skor/de mtshungs dwags po bang rim chos sde ba sum cu skor gyis rim pa bzhin du yul lugs dang mthun pa'i skyes bstar te smon lam bkra shis mdzad/ 'di nyin nas bzung 'bri gung gter sgrom gyi chu tshan nyin bdun dang mas dro ru thog gi chu tshan yan lag tshor nyin gnyis kyi bar bsten pas snga ma 'phrod bzhin par ma zad phyi ma tshigs kyi nad la 'jam dbyangs hor sgra che ba tsam snang /tshes bcu gnyis la dga' ldan gsung rab gling pas bskul ba'i nged rang dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ rgyal gling mkhan po nub sgo steng par nyams 'char la brten pa'i 'phrin yig tshigs bcad/ bsam blo (155na)dka' bcu sher rin pa'i ngor smon lam rnams bris/ zhol gyi tshe chog pa brje res thug pa'i log mir ja gral gyi thog sgrol dkar gyi cho ga sus mdzad kyi dri ba byas par shod rgyu mi 'dug pa rgya mtsho'i nang gi sbal lcong gral bsgrigs su mngon zhing de tsam yang 'chad rgyu med pa'i bzhi sde ba la chu brgyab nas 'bod dgos ris su mi 'dug /rmi ru lta bu nas btsal yang rnyed par gda' 'o/ /dga' ldan don gnyis gling pa'i gra pa gsum gyis gsar rtsom gyi phar phyin dbu mdzod/—215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lanadaga' ldan gsung rab gling pa'i blo bzang dar rgyas can gnyis kyis dbu ma/ blo bzang mchog legs kyis dbu phar/ blo bzang bstan 'phel gyis byams chos sde lnga dang smra sgo mtshon cha'i rgyugs sprad/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur pa yon tan seng shes rta bco lnga/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod kyis rta bcu bzhi/de mo dbon po bsod nams nor bus lnga bcu ma bcu/ khams dngul srang sum brgya/ ja khor drug ma bdun brgya/ rta lnga/ dre'u mdzo so sor brgya phrag sga gdan bcas pa'i stong 'bul bteg /rgyal legs bshad gling pa/ chos rje bkra bzang pa/ dpon bsod nams bkra shis/ ma gcig tha'i ji'i bu thos pa dga'/ sems dpa' chen po'i dbon po sogs 'phrad mi mang du byung / mtshams kyi brel ba yod gshis dga' ldan gsung rab gling pa'i bla gra rnams 'phral du shog gsungs pa la brten nyin shad mtshan shad kyis yongs pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi zhogs gling khar ka ca dang khal ma tsho bskyur thabs su (155ba)bzhag ste ra mda' ba lta bu'i rgyugs bshar dang bcas 'byor/ dge 'dun rnams zhal dbugs gsos po mi 'dug rung bdog pa'i skyes maṇḍal smon lam bkra shis snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gyer/ de dgongs nas bzung bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ 'bring lung blo bzang dpal 'byor/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum rgyun gyi las byed dang gter ston rin po che dang drung 'tsho lhag bsam gnyis dmigs 'og tu chud pa'i mi 'grul nyung ngur byas te sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya shin tu dam pa'i ngos rlung sbyor la brten pa'i nyams len la brtson par bgyis/bdun gnyis pa'i khongs su log tri'i lung dang rin po che bkra bzang pa nas brgyud pa'i thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi dbang lung bskyar ldab dang la stod dmar po'i bdud rtsi'i dbang / sgrol ma phug tu gter ston yol mo ba chen por dag snang du byung ba'i mkha' 'gro'i brda dbang / de'i yig cha/ yol mo sprul sku'i rnam thar rdo rje sgra ma'i rgyud mangs kyi lung rnams gter ston rin po cher zhus/ dbon rin po che gtso bor gyur pa'i don gnyer gnang mkhan mang por nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'khrid rgyas pa zhig 'bul dgos yod rung 'phral du ma thub par mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs —216

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)grags pa nan ches pas thun mtshams la kha'u pa'i bzhed srol 'khrul med kyi nyams 'khrid smin rgyas su phab/ tshes bcu bzhi nas gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad la gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag dang 'jam dpal gshin rje rlung sgrub (156na)gnyis kyi las sbyor btsugs/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig nas zhag shas kyi bar rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ dbon rin po che/ gter ston rin po che/ rdzogs chen sprul sku 'od gsal klong yangs/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa rnams la dpyid ka 'bul 'phror lus pa'i rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi pod longs/ byang chub gling pa dpal rgyal mtshan gyi bya mang phug nas gdan drangs pa'i kun bzang thugs gter gyi rtsa dbang / phyag rdor gyi dbang dang po ti'i lung yongs rdzogs gter kha gong ma'i gnyen po lha gsum gyi dbang lung / gter kha 'og ma dang rin chen gling pa gnyis kyi 'jam dpal nā ga rakṣa'i dbang lung / 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad yang bskyar dang lung yongs rdzogs/ gter kha 'og ma'i bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi srog dbang lung / mnga' bdag nyang gis gter sgrom nas spyan drangs pa'i bstan ma'i skor/ zung mkhar a jo dpal bo'i gter ma'i rdo rje drag rgyal ma'i sgrub skor cha tshang ba/ de yang sa dge gnyis kyi nā ga rakṣa la gsar ma'i rjes gnang dkyus 'gre'i/bdag la nā ga rakṣa yi/ sku yi rjes gnang sogs sbyar ba'i sad mo che'i nā ga rakṣa dang rnying rlom mang pos gter gzhung sor gnas bskur yang thod pa zhal dbye'i rnam dbye ma dod par nang mchod ka pā la nas kyis bkang ba'i dbang rdzas byed pa tsho dang mi 'dra bar chos rgyal 'bri gung yab sras kyi phyag len 'khrul med dang bstan ma bcu gnyis la gtor spungs bcas nas (156ba)gsar ma'i chos skyong gi rigs 'gre sbyar te gzhan mgo bskor ba'ang snang mod/ phyag len 'di ni o rgyan gyi mkhan po kha sbu can de'i bzhed pa ma nyams pa'i lugs yin/ dbon rin po ches gtso bor gsan dgos bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yan lag la dpal ldan sa skya'i lcags ri phyir mi 'da' zhing bar skabs kyi zhal ngo gnyis tsam gyi ring phyi nas nang la yang mi 'da'/ khri chen kun dga' bsod nams nas slar yang bkag po —217—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)tshang 'dzud byung ba rje btsun gong ma'i zab chos rnams gsan bzhed par tshogs bshad za zi'i gtam gyi gsan pa ni shin tu mang / a gi'i bsnyen chen ma song ba'i stabs gsung ngag slob bshad ni 'phral du 'bul bde ris su mi 'dug par ma zad gser chos dang chos skyong gi skor sogs mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par byed pa nas brtsams pa'i snyan rgyud bzhi'i rten 'brel bsgrigs te byed pa las rkang zin lag zin stabs bde de lugs 'di la srol med pas nam dus phyi mor song ba dang bcas lo rting ma tshor 'chad nyan byed pa brling bar go bas da lam tshar lugs dang rdzong lugs la dar so che ba padma yang gsang khros pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du bla chen chos dpal bzang po'i yig cha la lha dbang bsnan te dbang shin tu rgyas pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i yig cha'i steng nas rdzong chung tshe dbang / rta mgrin bde gshegs spyir dril gyi dbang / gying lnga gza' gdong gi srog gtad/ rta pod yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams phul/ ser byes kyi thog ma'i bla ma kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen seng ge dang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun (157na)rgya mtsho gnyis nas rang phyogs la dar rab byung rung phyi skor lung rgyun yang chad cing byes kyi slob dpon 'ga' res gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang chog badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs te sa phur lha khra la sa los kye rdor 'byin 'jug gi sku ched ra gan gser chus byugs par blo ma song bas bstan
