rgyun la phan du re ba'i pha bong kha pa zhal snga nas 'jam dbyangs grags pa'ang dbang lung gnyis ka nyan par bos/ khong pa thugs rab dngos gtsang bas chos rgyun tshad ldan zhig mdzad dam snyam/ rdo rje brag sprul sku la brag dkar chu bzang gi bla mas gsar ma'i shan re che zhugs pa'i yi ge zhig gi steng nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbang dang slob dpon chen po'i che byang rgyab tu bskyur te tshe dbang dkyus ma zhig la rdzong chung tshe dbang gis ming btags te phul 'dug pa da lam chos bdag po'i phyag tu 'phrod pa'i khul yin rung sa dri kha gsung ba lam dus mdzad pa las sa dri kha ba rang med la che/ da cha padma yang gsang 'di sa dge gnyis kyi khrod du mi tshe ma phyid na rnying ma ba tshos brgya bud du btang nas mi chud thag chod du gda' 'o/ /—218

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)sprul pa'i sku dang gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po gnyis kyi bzhed pa ltar skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gyi byin rlabs tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin dang gter gzhung yig rnying gi skor phul zhing sa dge zhal gsum/ dwags shangs zhi byed sogs chos lugs phal cher la rgyal bsen gyi gnod pa byung tshe 'di nyid la skyabs su 'dzin pa mang yang so so'i bla mas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang tsam las gter gzhung dngos (157ba)spyan gyis gzigs pa nyung zhing 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris thor bu snang ba'ang zha lu ba phyogs kyi gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i mched zla kho nar 'dug pa sngags rgan ral pa can rnams kyi phyag len gyi 'phreng du bcur ba'i phan yon la brten gter gzhung bzhin bkod pa lugs 'di'i srog gi me ro bslang ba lta bur song /gzhan yang gnubs kyi hriḥdamar dang mthu stobs dregs pa'i rgyal po/ gter kha 'og ma'i gu ru dar nag ber chen/ tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi gter ma'i yul 'khor srung gi dmag bzlog /gu ru jo tse'i gter ma'i dbang phyug nag po/ chos dbang dang rnam snang thub rgyal gnyis kyi rgya nag ting rdzogs kyi gsung 'bum/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi srung 'bum/ byang gter dug dbang gi yi ge /las 'brel rtsal dang ratna gling pa'i gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po'i chos skor/ rdo rje gling pa'i za yig nor bu'i bang mdzod dang seng gdong ma'i za yig sogs gter kha sna tshogs kyi za yig gi skor/ phar phyin rgyal ba'i bka' mthu bka' gter gnyis/ zangs gling gi gter ma'i gtad rul/ bya mang pa'i jag 'ching rwa ru ma/ 'khon spyod gi srung ba kha yar/ drag sngags sna tshogs/ chos rgyal byang pa'i gsung kha shas/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nas brgyud pa'i dza bir rlung khrid kyi lag len man ngag dang bcas pa/ chos mtshams kyi rten 'brel du 'phrang 'go gter ston pa'i 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i dbang lung rnams phul/ sprul sku rin po cher 'joms byed kyi phyag len thugs la nges par 'dug pa phyag 'khrid dogs gcod (158na/nus shing gsal byed kyi yi ge zhig kyang rjes byang du btab/ paṇa chen sku mched dang chos rgyal byang pa'i gter gsar gtso bor 'don dgos pa'i gong ra lo tsā ba'i —219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gnas tshul dang bcas rgyu mtshan ni rgyas par phul zhing thugs la rus pa 'jug mi 'jug ni slad nas zos ma zos dmar chung byad kyi dper 'dug /dmag zor ma'i gtor 'bul dgos phebs pa brtsams/sprul sku rin po che dang dbon rin po cher bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas rang gnas su bteg /rdzogs chen sprul skus gter kha gang yang rung ba'i rdzogs chen gyi dbang lung nyams 'khrid cha tshang ba zhig dgos tshul byung ba khas blangs shing khong dpon slob chos bsgugs la yar klungs tshor bzhugs brtsis 'dug pa mthun rkyen kyi 'bru 'dzin sprad/ tshogs gsog tu rdzongs gzhis kha yar nas zhabs tog byas pa'i bka' 'gyur ro cog tshar nyis brgya bcu gsum/ yig drug dung phyur bcu gsum/ pha bong khar zla gcig gi bar rigs gsum mgon po'i gzungs/ dbus gtsang dwags kong gi dgon ris med la mang 'gyed btang /e chos lung dkar mo nas 'od gsal lha rigs 'dzin pa'i mi dbang yab sras phebs te tshogs 'khor tshan grangs 'gyed kyi yon sbyar nas ches bcu gnyis la gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi gsung chog rgyas par mdzad/ 'di nyin tshogs gral du bkra shis sogs o rod kyi dpon khag kyang mang bar snang / sang nyin de mo dbon pos nyin snga ma dang mtshungs pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rwa sgreng mkhan zur bstan pa dar rgyas o rod nas 'khor te de nyin mjal (158ba)thub la res bshad nas byung ba tshe chog gi stabs byin rlabs ma thub rung tshogs gral du bsgrigs pa'i ngos phrad byas/ lcags byi rgyal po sku mched kyis ma ga dha'i don skor la mi sna gtong dgos tshul byung ba dang der ma zad o rod tsho pa bzhi'i gzhung mtha' dag la gang phan gyi bslab bya dang bcas rwa sgreng mkhan zur pa btang bar brten lo yang bcu gnyis tsam thogs shing cod pa pā thur khyo shugs btson ra nas bton te dud grangs lnga bcu skor gyi skal ba dang bcas pa'i bde thabs bag tsam thub par snang / khong tshos tshur ngan mi byed pa'i khag theg byung tshe sde'i cha gsum cha gcig gtod ces seng ges skor yang btang bar tre bo sku skye nam mkha' bsam grub kyis rdzi gsang ma phyed pa'i khas len rtsis byas 'dug rung rwa sgreng mkhan —220

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)pos shol ba spun gcig gis gcig la'ang yid ches mi thub pa'i snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sha 'khon de 'dra'i khag theg ci la nus pas skad cha thos tsam nas rgyas bsdus 'tshams par mngon zhing rjes kyi gnas tshul la dpags na tre po sku skye ltar byas te sbyin bdag la nye ring gis bslus brgyab pa lta bu'i ro sa 'og dang gtam sa steng yong bar ma zad slad nas sog yul phyogs su mi sna gtong thebs dang bral ba zhig 'ong ba las 'os med par gda'/ chos 'khor yang rtse bla gnyer spyi sos bskul ba'i 'di ga dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ dbon po chos dbyings lhun grub kyi ngor nged rang dang gter ston rin po che'i brtan bzhugs brtsams/tshes bcu dgu la 'dam nas gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin (159na)da la'i rgyal po btsun mo sras bcas/ da yan rgyal po'i dbu skor che chung / du ri yal dge tshul ma sogs o rod gnyug mar gnas pa tsho dang cha gan bar dang se chen ji nong gnyis kyi el chi kha yar 'byor ba rnams sdebs mtshungs su mjal zhing gsung gleng dang dri bshad rgyas par byung / rgya gar nas kriṣṭha u da ya zhes pa'i paṇḍi ta zhig 'ongs pa'i gnas chen gyis mchod sbyin gyi ril bur bsgrubs pa dang / byang chub shing gi lo ma byin zhing legs sbyar gyi skad las drangs pa'i bsngags brjod smon lam brtsams pa 'dar pa lo stos bsgyur ba ni/ ming ldan thams cad skyong ba'i dpal mnga' mtha' klas yon tan tshogs kyis brgyan byas sa yi zla ba ste/ /rig dang ye shes rgya mtshos yongs gang dpal dang ldan pa'i dga' ba la 'jug lha mis mchod byed cing / /cha shas yongs rdzogs dpag yas skye 'gro'i sdug bsngal ma lus legs bcom yang dag don la 'god mdzad pa/ /lha ldan gnas su thams cad mkhyen khyed bye ba phrag brgyar bzhugs gsol bdag cag rab tu dang bas 'dud/ /kun mkhyen nyid dang mes po tshangs pa gnyis/ /mtha' yas yon tan srang la gzhal ba na/ /byed po yang bas mtho ris gnas su song / /mgon khyod lci bas sa steng gnas zhes gleng / /zhes tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa zhig snang ngo / /rtsam 'thor 'di la thams cad dga' ba 'dug pas gser sogs kyi ster cha legs pa byas/—221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenadaga' ldan gsung rab gling pa dang dga' ldan don gnyis gling pa gnyis la sman bla'i mdo chog /bzang spyod/(159ba)byams smon/ sgrol ma/ sher snying / tshe gzungs rnams kyi lung phul/ gsung rab gling pa tsho'i tshigs bcad gsar pa de lam du 'dzin long ma byung bas 'di nyin gdangs 'dur gyi zhal 'don mdzad/ tshes nyi shu la sa skyong rgya ri ba yab sras 'khor bcas/ de mo dbon po can la grub rgyal lugs kyi lha gcig bum gcig bsten pa'i tshe dbang / shangs lugs kyi rta mgrin dang phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ rnam 'joms ljang sngon/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ sme brtsegs dud kha rnams kyi rjes gnang phul/ bdog pa'i skyes lan dang bcas khong dpon g.yog rang gnas su byon/ nyer gnyis la rta tshag sprul pa'i sku/ rwa sgreng mkhan zur pa bstan pa dar rgyas/ 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon pa drug /mañdzu shrī sku skye/ khal kha tsho pa bdun gyi mi sna dang bcas pa/ 'dar nas bsod nams lhun grub rdo rje sger gnyis nas 'ongs pa la ja gral btang / 'jam dbyangs sprul sku dang thu shi ye thu rgyal pos gtsos khal kha'i dpon khag tsho dang spyi ba'i yi ge rten bcas sprad cing ngag ma zhib par gleng / nyin gsum gyi bar la dge tshul drug brgya drug cu re gcig dang dge slong sum brgya lnga bsgrubs/ nyer dgu la khal kha'i mi sna tshor thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang dang so so'i yig lan rten sbrags ngag ma dang bcas rdzong bda' byas/ rgyal po'i gcung sirnyi shrī khung tha'i jis sku gsung thugs gsum gyi bstod pa dgos tshul mdzad pa ltar lus ngag yid gsum yod pa rgyu (160na)mtshan du bgyis te brtsams/gnam gang la ru bzhi'i bsnyen gnas ma rnams la sdom pa phab/ thor god mgon po yel deng kho rang gi jo jo dang tsha bo dgrar langs te mnga' thang dang bral ba'i nyam thag cing na tshod kyang smin por song ba bod dag pa'i zhing lta bu'i mos pa dang bcas ched du 'chi bar 'ongs pa rgas nad kyis bgrod dka' bar 'dug pa glo bur du tshe'i dus byas na re ba ma rdzogs dogs 'byor 'phral hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la ngos 'phrad dang 'phros pa zhib tu mol/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse bla —222

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadaganyer spyi tshogs kyis tshogs 'gyed ster cha'i bdog pa gya nom pa bshams te gra tshang gi rdul tshon la brten pa'i tshe chog mdzad/ de rjes khong rang dpon slob kyang chos spyod smon lam bkra shis kyi bden brjod dbyangs su gyer/ sang nyin 'brong rtse gsar ma 'phyong rgyas sgem bu ba bsod nams dar rgyas kyis nyin snga ma ji lta ba'i tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs thog rgyal gling mkhan pos gtsos gong dkar mnga' khul skya ser rnams kyis dngos po'i legs skyes ring du brkyangs/ gsung rab gling gra pa dka' bcu pa bsam gtan chos 'phel gyis gsar rtsom 'jug pa dang mdzod kyi rgyugs sprad/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i rnam thar rje 'jam dpal rgya mtshos mdzad pa sogs rjes su bskur ba'i par phal cher brkos zin pa tsho skyel bar par zhus rab 'byams pa dge 'dun chos 'phel dang blo gros brtan pa can 'byor/nged rang gi don la gnas pa'i rnam thar yin khul gyi thob yig po ti (160ba)bzhi por zhus dag rkang ma sde pa 'dar lo dang de'i rogs byed bya sgo nas/ spos 'dzin pa ngag dbang nam mkha'/ 'dar gzhon ngag dbang 'phrin las bzhis lan grangs mang du byas/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po ches ljags zhus shin tu thengs pa tshar gcig dang gter ston rin po ches zur rgyan bcas zhus dag grub pas 'gyangs med du rab 'byams pa can thon skabs par gyi ma dper bsrings/ sbus srang spyon pas ltad mo dgos tshul ltar g.yar po btang ba shog rtags dang mchan bu 'ga' zhig 'dug pa 'di ga nas zhib pa lta long ma byung rung drung 'khor zhus dag pa rnams kyi brjod ris la gsar du brjod don lhag po thon pa mi 'dug zer/ chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed dang ngo mtshar rgya mtsho sogs kyi snyan grags mi 'dug kyang blo ldan tshos zhib mor dpyad na a pha'i gsol zhal gyi chos 'byung rnams las bod yul du chos dar ba'i rtsa khungs chod tsam yong ngam snyam/ de mo sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan gyi sku skye yin nam zer ba khams kong du 'ga' zhig 'dug pa ji ltar yin gyi brtag pa dgos tshul khams nas dbon pos ched bstad dri bar btang byung skabs rtsa ba gsum la mar me dang chos skyong la dmod bcol phul ba mthun par kong po phyogs kyi de yin pa'i nges shes rnyed par byung —223—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bas de ga'i rgyu mtshan mol ba ltar da lam ngos kyi 'phros pa gleng ba la sprul pa'i sku snga thog 'khrungs yul dang skya rtsa la ye mi dgyes rung shing 'brug 'di nas phyir byon zhen mar lam 'khrungs sa'i yab gzhis (161na)su zhag gsum bzhugs skabs yul dang gzhis la chags nyams chen po mdzad cing sku chas kyang 'ga' zhig bzhag 'dug pa nges 'drongs kyi gtan tshigs su snang / bar khams pa'i ris 'di phyi lkugs brdzu btab pa'i mo bcos pa la nang g.yo 'phrul chen po zhig yong 'dug pas khams phyogs kyi sku skye de tsho pha mas dgos dbang gis bcos tshod du gda'/ snying po kong smad grong du khyung rgyal mtshan gyi sras por 'khrungs par mtshan dkon cog bsod nams dbang phyug tu gsol/ bar chad sel byed kyi rim gros mtshon bslab bya zhib par mol zhing rdzong bda' rgyas par bgyis/ sprul pa'i sku'i brtan bzhugs dgos tshul byung ba'ang brtsams/nyer gnyis la khal kha nas gsar 'byor a kha'i da'i chin zhes grags pa can de'i sras cha gan bar gyis gos dar dngul ja sogs dang khun du len chos khur gyi dpon mo bsod nams rgyal mos gser dngul gyi mdong mo/ ka to ra/ gos dar/ ja ris kyi brgya 'bul/ o rod nas dpon mo ma ga dhas rta lnga bcu/ rnga mo sum cu so drug /dga' ldan rab 'byams pas rta sum cu'i ster sbyin bstar/ sang nyin ge re lha pa bstang zhal/ chos 'khor yang rtse dang brag dbar gra tshang gnyis kyi slob dpon gra bcas/gnas rnying zhabs drung gi sprul sku/ gter ston rin po che/ chos rje dkon gnyer dpon/ gang dkar chos sde'i dpon slob gnyis/ dpal de ras chen gyis mtshon sum brgya lhag la sman bla'i mdo chog chen mo (161ba)brgyud 'debs dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma sher snying gi lung phul/ gra tshang gnyis so so nas maṇḍal smon lam shis brjod kyi zhal 'don mdzad/ o rod khod kyi dpon po bi lig er khe tha'i ji nang khul du sdod ma bde ba mgo dkar du yul 'khyar ba phyogs der chos ma dar ba'i gshis sdod ma 'dod par bros stabs su yongs pa dang phrad/ pha'i bsngo zhus sogs bdog pa rgyas par bstabs/ bkra shis lhun po'i gra pa dbu mdzad bla ma zer bas tha'i ji mgo dkar nas 'bros thub pa'i rogs ram bgyis par —224

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)ming 'dod par 'dug pa dar khan chos rje'i cho lo byin/ gra tshang gi gra pa blo gsal ba mang zhig lha sa rtses dang gnyis su gra skor byed 'dod 'dug pa glang lo'i smon lam gra skor phun tshogs legs 'byor gyis rgyan thob nas bskul ba ltar yul dus rgyud sde so so dang 'brel ba'i tshigs bcad 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs brtsams/mgon po yel deng na bab lci ru song ste 'phrad par byung ba la mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgo nas bka' bsgo dang sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung dam rdzas byin/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad tshar gnyis dang thub dbang gi sku zur pa grub par nye ba'i che gra la tshigs bcad bi warta/ chung ba dang thub dbang la zhal byang bris/ maṇḍal ra ba'i lcags khra la zhig gsos dang jo shākya la thugs rje chen po gnyis kyi spang gcal gsar brjes/ dpal lha lcog gi sgrom skas rnams bzo ba'i 'dun pa nged rang la shar ba zhig ma byung rung sde pas de bzhin byas na 'gab pa'i 'char (162na)ston la shin tu legs pa'i mthun 'gyur byas pa bzhin maṇḍal ra ba'i lcags khra nub ngos dngul tshags dang ru bzhi ra ma lug las byas pa'i mgar ba'i lto dang sol ba rnams dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis bton zhing dge ba bsngo ba'i tshigs bcad bris/ de mtshungs spang bcal sgrom skas tsho grub skabs sbus srang gser khang pas sde par legs 'bul 'go lung bzo bo rnams la lha dar tshan grangs kyi bdog pa bstar/ nged rang gi pha mar drin lan gsab byed kyi dgongs rdzogs rgyun tshugs shig btsugs na snyam pa dang 'char ston byed mkhan byung rung stabs ma 'grig pa'i 'gyangs gzhir song ba 'di lo sde pa'i bskul mar brten/ de ga'i bca' gzhi shar ba byed yul 'o skol gyi ston pa'i rjes su 'jug pa gang la byas kyang bsod nams kyi zhing dang rang re'i ngos nas mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i phyogs su byed pa bab 'brel 'dug kyang 'phyong rgyas zhabs drung de nyid kyi thugs rtse thun mong ma yin pa snga 'gyur la bstad cing khri lcam de nyid kyi bzhes dang la sa lugs ma gtogs mi 'gro ba zhig yod pas lo lo bzhin sa ga zla ba'i nang du zhabs drung bdud 'dul rab brtan gyi dgongs rdzogs la o rgyan smin grol gling du thugs rje chen po 'khor —225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba dbyings sgrol gyi sgrub mchod dang zhabs drung khri lcam gyi dgongs rdzogs su yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sder kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi sgrub mchod zhag bdun gtong ba'i sa 'byed sogs dang rim gro'i ched du tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang sku gsum rigs 'dus (162ba)gnyis kyi sgrub mchod slar shing stag nas rdo rje brag e waṃ lcog sgar bar 'dzugs pa'i sa 'byed kyi sgo dod cing smin grol gling pa dang lcog sgar gnyis kyis cho ga gsar 'dzin dang dbyangs rol gyi bca' bsgrigs/ gter ston rin po che'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi 'phrin las sgrub thabs zhabrugs bsdebs las byang bklags pas don grub brtsams/dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan dag pa'i gnas su rje btsun 'jam dpal snying po'i spyan sngar gshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor/ mgon po yel deng jo shāka gi sku mdun du slebs te blo kha rdzogs mur 'jig rten pha rol tu song ba'i bsngo rten rnams rdzogs byang gi rgyur bsngos/ byang bzhu byas par lha gnas su skye ba'i mtshan ma shar/ hor sog 'di sha khrag la longs spyod pa'i stabs mtho ris su skye dka' ba 'dra zhig 'dug rung skye rtags la lha mi'i yang srid bzung ba mang tsam yong 'dug pa dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pa'i mthu yin nam snyam/ lha sa smon lam gyi dus gra tshang dkyil 'khor sdings su 'tshog sa khul shin tu dog pa yod pa nas sde pas bla brang du gra khang che legs brgyab pa'i zhal spror tshes bcu dgu nas bzung gra tshang nyin gsum gyi bar tshogs pa'i chos srung tshor bskang gso rgyas par btang / gser bsgril btags las grub pa'i ber gyi gtsos gos dmar ser tshon khra las byas pa'i gos ber bcu gsum tsam bshig nas maṇḍal ra ba'i steng la ran (163na)pa'i bla bre btsems/ gos tā hung lto sbyar thog lcags ri dang chal bur mu tig gi rgyan phyug pa'i snam sbyar la smon lam gyi kha yig bris pa jo bo rin po cher phul/ dga' ldan don gnyis gling pa'i gra pa zhig gis gsar rtsom 'jug pa'i rgyugs sprad/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa'i bzhed srol ltar gshed dmar lha lnga'i mngon rtogs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung dang dkyil chog mtho —226

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)ris dbang gi chu rgyun gnyis brtsams shing thog mar gra tshang du 'dzugs rtsis yin na'ang / byung na bde dgyes gang rung zhig tshugs la re zhig then tsam byas/ khams spong ri dgon phyogs su srog blu dar po yod 'dug pas dga' ldan chos 'khor bla ma blo bzang chos dpal gyis bskul ngor dge ba bsngo ba'i tshigs bcad bris/ sde pas ljags bkod mdzad nas gser dngul las grub pa'i cog tse rin po che'i phra mang zhing phun sum tshogs pa zhig chu byi zla ba dang po'i nang du bzo gra btsugs pa 'di dus tshar nas mig lam du 'bebs pa mdzad byung ba cog tse'i rkang la 'brug gis 'khyud pa'i 'phrul lhongs che ba sogs bzo bkod ngo mtshar bar 'dug pas rkyen byas/ 'di 'dra ba'i jo bo rin po cher bzhugs khang /rgya phibs/ rgyab yol bzo thub na tshogs gsog par mchis snyam pa lhan skyes su shar te de ga'i gling gzhi yang bya tha5/nyer bdun la se ra'i phur pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du zhus shing snyan dar phul/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i mjug dang bcu gnyis pa'i stod tshor rkang pa'i dreg cung zad 'phar ba dar mo sman rams (163ba)pas 'byar dang gter ston rin po ches mkha' 'gro grib sel dang nā ga rakṣa'i gdon 'grol gyi cho ga gnang bas gzhi med du song rung 'di nyid nas lag pa g.yon ma'i sor mo'i tshigs na ba'i 'go brtsams nad g.yog dbu mdzad dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gnyis kyis byas/ de lo gsar bzos rnams the ba'i rin chen rgyan cha bzhi bcu zhe lnga gzims chung khams gsum du bsgrigs te ston par mdzad pa shin tu gra 'grig pa'i legs par byung bar snang / phur sgrub dang tshe bdag gi las sbyor sngar 'byud bzhin btang /—227—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dgung lo nga bdun par ra mo che gtsug lag khang gi nang rten dang ldebs bris sogs la tshon gsol bzhengs bkod dang / 'dus sde khag la chos rgyun rim gro btsugs shing zhwa dmar sprul sku sogs phyogs 'grul ltos cher mjal 'phrad mdzad pa sogs kyi skor/lag pa'i nad rim 'phar du gyur pas gnyan kha zhugs dogs chu glang gsar tshes kyi srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i tshogs gral 'gro ma bde rung bzhugs gral la 'gro bar ma nus tsam byung bas tshes gcig gi nyin bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos gtso mdzad o rod kyi dpon khag gsar slebs dang gnyug mar gnas pa/ khal kha da'i bung nyung tha'i ji/ bzod pa yel deng / cha gan bar sogs khal kha o rod bsdoms pa'i dpon che ba brgyad/ de 'og bdun cu don lnga/ so so'i dpon mo/ ja'i sang / mi bzang phon che ba phyogs mtha'i lo gsar 'bul mi bcas par bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston thog 'dar lo dang glang bu nas gnyis kyis dam pa'i chos las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam btang / rol cha ba rnying pa'i steng rgyal rtse nas gsar pa mkhas bsgrugs slebs pa dang bcas pas rol gar gyis mtshon bkra shis pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byas/ lo snga ma'i nang du sde dpon dang nang so rnam pa tshor rin chen rgyan cha rang (164na)gon gra bsgrig dgos pa'i brda 'grems song ba ltar rgya ri ba/ stag rtse ba/ tshal pa gsum gyi gtogs tshang mas gra 'grig pa'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin rtsis 'khri'i rin chen rgyan cha ba bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i thog /sde srid ri bo brag pa/ bde chen zhabs drung / bya zhabs drung / thon nas/ nang so dkon mchog dar rgyas/ 'bog gong khag gnyis/ mdo mkhar nas/ snye mo dgon pa ba/ dpal de ba/sna dkar rtse zhabs drung gi sku tshab gnyis dang bcas kun dril lnga bcu nga bdun gyis mdun bdar/ gra —228—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadatshang gi gra pa rnams kyis tshigs bcad gsung ba/ gral 'phros/ rol cha sogs dus ston gyi dga' ston rgya cher spel/ gnas gsar rje drung mkhyen rab rnam rgyal gyis dzhai kṣiṃ las grub pa'i rdo rje zhig byin/sbyor ra nas dang mdo mkhar nas gnyis sum stan snye 'bol gyi gras tsam yin 'dug rung stobs 'byor gyi dbang las gzos rim 'gros byung zhing gzims shag lho pa pha mes nas dge lugs kyi bstan par dad zhen 'gyur med kyi rnga ma nag po'i tshos mdog dang ding sang sde dpon gyi tshugs ka bzang ba thabs shes zung 'jug nas gzengs bstod 'brel chags su mngon/ lcags sprul phan gyi rang bstan 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa de ga'i mus byung na 'di rigs kyi rnam g.yeng la ya mtshan rgyu ci la yod rung ding sang chos las srid gtso zhing thams cad de la dgyes rtser son pa'i legs so brjod skabs 'dir chen po'i khungs dang 'brel ba'i don spyi yod pa zhig ma byung na seng ge ral pa byas (164ba)nyen snang / de nyin sde dpon khag dang rdzong dpon 'ga' zhig la ja gral btang / lo ma gsar gong tsam du rmi ltas la brten gter ston rin po ches rdzongs gnang bas nang zor yang ba 'dra mo mchis rung tshes gsum nas bzung zhag shas yan lag bro 'tshal bzo chun gyi khyud mo lta bu la drung 'tsho ba lhag bsam dang dar mo ba gnyis kyis bcos ka bgyis pa 'phrod ngo che ba byung /thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan gyi dbu thog tu gser zangs kyi bla bre dang rgyab yol bzheng ba'i bzo thab btsugs pa'i bla bre dkyil ma la rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi thugs rje chen po dang mnga' bdag nyang gi 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu gnyis zhus dag pher bas gang la'ang ngos gzung chog pa/ g.yas su 'gro ba kun sgrol/ g.yon du 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi dkyil 'khor gsum 'phul ba'i shog dper 'god pa'i ngag bkod byas te sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar pa pha bus bris/ de yang 'phyong rgyas su rim gro chos sde res bskor yod pa rnams me shing gis ma sdangs pa'i mi ser la cha snyoms khyad dang bcas rgyal rtser spos pa'i lo 'khor du zla rer gra pa brgya dang drug re 'pho len byas pa'i zla ba dang po'i tshes bzhi nas bzung dpal 'khor chos sde dge lugs gra tshang tsho bsdus kyis sman bla chig khri lnga stong dgu brgya/—229—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)zla ba gnyis par sa lugs gra tshang tsho bsdus kyis sman bla gong 'dra/ zla ba gsum par bu lugs gra tshang tsho bsdus kyis tshe dpag med lha dgu'i tshe chog mjug 'chi blu dang bcas pa/ zla ba bzhi par gnas rnying pas 'bum brgya/ zla ba lnga par mtshan sgrogs pas bzang spyod chig (165na〉〈krum bzhi khri sum stong /zla ba drug par ngor pa khag gnyis su bgos pa'i bsnyen song phyed kyi yiḥkhyon sa ya brgyad drug 'bum dgu khri bzhi stong / ya ma rā dza sa ya gcig brgyad 'bum dgu khri/ ya mānta ka sa ya ga ṇi ga lnga 'bum tshig khri nyis stong song ba'i mjug drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog /phyed kyis seng ge sgra'i cho ga mjug gdon 'grol dang bcas par snying po bye ba gcig sa ya drug chig 'bum bzhi khri drug stong / yum gyi snying po bdun stong dgu brgya/ gzungs ring sum khri bdun stong brgyad brgya lhag bcas/ zla ba bdun par zha lu ri mthil nas bsdus pa'i rnam rgyal stong mchod/ zla ba brgyad par 'bras yul skyed tshal pas brgyad stong pa chig stong lnga brgya dgu bcu/ zla ba dgu par rong byams chen pas gdugs dkar chig 'bum brgyad stong brgyad brgya/ zla ba bcu par dpal 'khor chos sde rang gi dge lugs tsho bsdus kyis brgyad stong pa chig stong lnga brgya dgu bcu/ zla ba bcu gcig par byams chen pa gra grangs drug cu re gsum dang / nges gsang rdo rje gling pa zhe gsum gyis mtshan brjod 'bum ther/ zla ba bcu gnyis par dpal 'khor chos sde'i gzhal phyed khyer gyis sgrol ma sher snying tshe gzungs 'gro gang che yong rtsis kyis btsugs/tshes lnga nas gra tshang du gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags ring rdo rje pha lam gyi bzlog pa dang bcas pa bstar/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog na tshod smin pa nas dus kyi chod nyid du gyur tshe sku phebs 'gyangs gzhir song na nam mkha'i mdzub ris bzhin gzugs med la rgyu mtshan byed thebs mi 'dug gshis slar tsha (165ba)bor khog zhugs mu 'thud dgos pa'i 'phrin yig tshigs bcad ma tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs spams bstod dang bcas khang gsar rab brtan tshes brgyad la sku phebs zhu bar btang ba ji bzhin thog tu phebs pa'i lan byung / klu dbang gi rgyal por gzungs bzhugs dbyar stod nas grub rung bde gshegs brgyad tshar gnyis dang thub dbang gi bzo phud la sangs rgyas kyi 'phel —230

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadagadung kha shas sku gdung sku bal chos sku'i ring bsrel gyi gzungs bzhugs nged rang gis bkod pa dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas lag len dngos gtsang ba lo mjug la grub pa cho 'phrul gyi dus bzang dang bcas tshes bcu bzhi la gter ston rin po ches bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i sgo nas rab gnas dang nyin gnyis kyi bar gra tshang gi gra pa bzhi gras mchod pa gya nom pa'i thog mdo chog btang / 'di lo smom lam chen mo tshogs shin tu che ba khrir nye ba la dge 'dun re'i phyag tu ja nyag gsum re yong rtsis kyi paṇa zhwa nyer gnyis/ rtse zhwa bco lnga/ bla gos sum cu so lnga/ rngul gzan sum cu so bzhi/ mthang gosanyi shu rtsa brgyad/ sham thabs gsum/ ring 'gag nyi shu rtsa gcig stod 'gag gnyis/ ser rked bzhi/gding ba bcu/ gos ber dgu/ 'gan sbyar bzhi/ sbyar ma lnga/ zhwa thul bzhi/ rgya lham mu tig gi rgyan yod med bsdoms pas drug dang sog bod kyi bzhi/ snye 'bol/ stan dmar/ gos stan gsum/ gsar chas cha 'grig gnyis/ gser sga brgyad/ ra ma lug brgyad/ dngul sga drug /sga dmar dngul shar ma bdun/ rta gsar ma (1thun)gnyis dang rgyugs ma nyi shu rtsa dgu /dkar yol/ dngul stegs/ rgyan drug /bzed zhal/ spos phor/ bla bre gnyis/ gos dang 'gang gi yol pa re/ dngos po gzhan gyis tshur blus pa shel rgyan gyi se ral kha gdu bu/ hor dril/ thod rnga/ rta gsar ma sga chas cha 'grig gnyis rnams kyi 11nga dag phul/'phrul snang gtsug lag khang du bla bre mthongs gos sngon sprin ris thog lā lha'i yig drug si'u ma/zur bzhi padma/ mtha' gos sngon bar snang mdzod ris/ sham bu ling dmar ser ljang gu brtsegs pa/rgyab sha gos dmar sprin ris ma thob chin dbang gis byin pa/ 'phan rgya bzo mgo gos sngon 'brug ris mabs byas pa bzhi dang lu his byas pa gnyis bcas pa'i lag sku gzugs 'phan du grags pa gos gser ma sna tshogs/ mtshams su dar thod dang g.yer kha yod pa cha gsum/ jo bo shākya mu ne/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ rang byon lnga ldan/ byams pa chos 'khor/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po/ dung skyong rgyal mo rnams la zhal byang bkod pa'i snyan shal phul/ rdzo shāka gi spyan sngar dngul gyi maṇḍal che tshad cig —231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bzheng ba'i gleng gzhi yod rung de'i sngon du jo bo rin po che'i bzhugs khang rgyab yol dang bcas pa dngul/ rgyab yol la sman bla'i mdo chog chen mo las byung ba'i lha tshogs/ bzhugs khang steng du gser gyi rgya phibs rnams bzhed ba'i las gra tshes bco brgyad nas btsugs/ rgyal khang rtse sprul pa'i sku khal kha nas byon pa lam du sku ma 'tsho ba'i bsngo rten skyel mi 'byor/ gshegs gdong mi dkar po sma ra can cig gis bde ba can (166ba)du sna(ga zer ba byung zhes sprul skus gsungs pa'i gnas tshul ltar na re zhig sku skye 'byon mi 'byon the tshom gyi gzhir 'dug rung myur 'byon gyi tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba brtsams/nyer bzhi la dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa zhig gis gsar rtsoms dbu ma'i rgyugs sprad/'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i gsang mdos kyi bkang ba gsar du bsgrigs nas mchod gter spyan gzigs bshams te gra tshang du 'bum ther btang ba'i thog ma nyer gsum gyi nyin rlung 'tshub che bar ma zad dmar po ri rang la sger du rlung gi gur phub pa lta bu byung ba las tshogs brtag yig gi dbang du byas na re ma tī dgyes pa'i mtshan mar mngon/ rim gro rnams dang rigs 'dzin chen pos gdon 'grol gyi cho ga mdzad pa sman gyi rgyab chos su song ba'i zug rngu las rnam par grol te nyer dgu la khal kha da'i bung khung tha'i jis dngul lnga bcu ma dgu/ mdong mo tha phag gis mtshon spyad pa sna tshogs/ gos dar dngosagatsang / ja ras/ rnga mo lnga bcu nga brgyad dang bcas pa'i brgya 'bul/ bzod pa yel deng gis gser srang drug cu'i maṇḍal/ dngul gyi tha phag /mdong mo/ dung chen/ dkar yol stegs bcas/ ja gos dar/dre'u brgya dang bzhi/ rnga mo lnga bcu skor sogs kyi stong 'bul/ tre bo no mon khan gyi dngul gyi maṇḍal/ gosadar rta sga ma gnyis/ rnga mo nyi shu rtsa gsum/ gzhan yang dpon chung / ser mo ba rnams kyis zang zing gi bdog pa ring du brkyangs/ rgyal mo bsod nams chos 'dzom sras bcas/ stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras bi lig er (167na) khe tha'i ji/ mā mod pā thur tha'i ji/ ma la'i mer gan tha'i ji/ mgon po yel deng gi dge tshul ma can sogs log mi kha yar dang phrad/—232

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadahor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis nas nyin gsum gyi bar mas dro ru thog dang bzhi'i ring gter sgrom gyi chu tshan brgyab/ ra mtshan rdo rje'i rwa gdengs thog mda'i rgya can gyi nang tshan rdo rje gro lod kyi chog bsgrigs gnam lcags 'bar ba dang der ma gtogs pa'i rdo rje rwa gdengs thog mda'i rgya can gyi 'phrin sgrub smin grol gyi chog bsgrigs brtsams/ 'dzum lang rgyal por 'phrin lan gyi rten gser dngul gos dar gyi skyes dang bcas mi sna dzā la bhaṇḍa ri can rdzong bda' byas/tshes gsum nas nged rang gi rim gror dbus gtsang gi rdzong gzhis khag tshor dge lugs gtsor brtan gyi dge 'dun bsdus nas bka' 'gyur tshar brgya dang nyi shu/ 'bum brgya/ sman bla khri/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig dang tshe gzungs sa ya re mtshan brjod dang gdugs dkar sum 'bum re/ phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba sa ya gnyis/ dung dgon pa grangs bcas kyis lha 'dre stong dra'i mdos/ nya sa ya'i srog blu/ srong btsan du dpal ri ba grangs bcad kyis nyin bcu'i ring ma ning gi bskang gso/ thang po cher nyin bcur bzab gsol/ pho brang du bkra shis chos sde ba grangs bcad kyis dmar chen gtor bzlog /rgyal du beg tse'i bskang ba khri/ 'bras spungs sngags khang du stod rgyud pa grangs bcad kyis nag po skor gsum gyi bskang ba gtor bzlog dang bcas pa/ gnas chung lcog tu nyin bdun gyi ring (167ba)bzabs gsol/ gong dkar du chos sde ba grangs bcas kyis zhal gyi gtor skyong / lo dus kyi mang 'gyed dgon adhi dang por gshor khal gsum re/ gnyis par gnyis re/ gsum par khal rer dpus khams dngul dang 'bru sna tshogs/ brtag par shar ba'i sde pa'i rim gror bkra shis khang gsar dang 'phyong rgyas lu ma'i sa skor du klu gta'/ gnyan gyi yo bcos/ nyin bcu'i ring klu gtor btang / sngon gyi gtsug lag khang rnying par sri zhu dkon pa dgung grangs la mchod pa/ sātstsha khri/ 'phan yul khul gyi mchod rten la sku dkar dang cod pan/ zhag gcig gi ring mar me/ sher snying dang gdugs dkar sum khri re/ lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs chig 'bum/ rgyal du rnam sras bskang ba khri/ dpal ri ba grangs bcas kyis khro rol/ bstan srid spyi rim la mang ja gnyis re'i mthun rkyen dang bcas dge —233—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)lugs sngags dgon dang gzhis dgon thams cad nas gtor bzlog /mdo pa rnams kyis mdo sgrub/rdzong mgo tshor dgra lha dpangs bstod/ gra tshang du nyin gsum gyi ring brgya bzhi rnams btang /tshes bcu gcig la chos rje bco brgyad pa khu dbon mched bcas dang phrad cing kye rdor gyi sa chog skor la dri ba kha yar byas/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa dge legs 'byung gnas kyis phar phyin gsar rtsom gyi rgyugs sprad/ sa ba gru pa pha mes nas grub mtha' gtsang zhid bsam grub rgyal po lugs gnyis kyi yong pher che bar brten dol rnam rgyal zhal phu gzhis ka them 'dzin che chung bsdoms pa nyer brgyad/ lag 'bab (168na)chig stong drug brgya zhe bzhi sprad/tshes bcu gnyis la khal kha'i dpon khag dang o rod er khe da'i chin dur khe che/ thos pa dga'/dur bod chog thu bu bcas/ dpon mo bsod nams tshe dbang / mo ja rag gi dpon mo dang nu bo gnyis/spos khang mkhan po/ tshal dbus gling bla ma/ sde pa phon mdo ba bstang zhal/ stag lu rtse pa'i phyag mdzod la tsho byed/ mdo pa nang so/ bar ta blo bzang / kong po bcos mi dang grus smad a bo/ nang sodakon dar ba spun mchis brang / phag ri'i spel dpon brgyad rnams dang khal kha o rod kyi sog dmangs dang bcas par byin rlabs byas/ gling stod chos rje lha rje blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sku skye'i gtsug phud blangs shing mtshan ngag dbang gzhon nur btags/ tshes bcu gsum la rwa sgreng mkhan zur bstan dar bas dngul lnga bcu ma nyer gcig dang gos dar dngos gtsang ba'i steng sbyin tshogs 'gyed dpangs mtho ba'i sgo nas gra tshang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog mdzad/ 'grul sdebs er khe dbon pos gos dar tshan grangs dang sman ce'i 'gyed byas/tshes bcu bzhir g.yon ru'i mi sna spun 'byor smon lam rgya mtshos tshogs 'gyed ster cha bsgrig so pa'i gra tshang nas gsung chos sngon bzhin bstar/ chos rje ngag dbang thub bstan pas gtsos nges gsang rdor gling pa'i gra pa kha shas kyis bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sgo nas tshe'i rten 'brel dang bla mas gsar rnying gi lung 'dren du mas bskal par stod dgos (168ba)tshul —234—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasmed/ de zhor lha 'dre stong dra dang ma mo gling bzhi'i mdos zhag grangs kyi bar btang /tshes bco lnga la g.yon ru dga' ldan khung tha'i ji'i mi sna tshogs gsog rab 'byams pa can gyis dngul lnga bcu ma bcu bzhi dang srang don lnga'i mdong mo gser dang gos dar dngom che ba'i ster sbyin tshogs 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas tshe dpag med lha bcu gsum ma'i tshe chog mdzad/ rwa sgreng mkhan zur gyis gser dngul gos dar pags ras kyis gtsos pa'i khri 'bul/ er khe dbon po'i stong 'bul/ khal kha bzod pa yel deng gi sras lha btsun 'gro mgon du grags pa 'bras spungs su slob gnyer du sdod pa'i mthun rkyen rten dang bcas dngos po rgya cher bstar/ rwa sgreng zur pas khrid yongs pa'i mi gnyis kyi phu zhig btab pas skad mang po 'don pa'i rol mo dang gar gyi rtsed sna bstan/ lding dpon chu mig kha pa can khams nas 'khor ba'i mkha' 'gro blo'i 'char sgo mkha' la 'ja' tshon ltar bkra yang dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs kyi mthus 'di bya 'di byed dang bral ba'i ngang nas da la'i hung tha'i jis gtsos pa'i dpon khag rnams kyi lag tu 'byor bas thog ma'i gtam snyan gyi sgo phye/ chu shur thar gling pas tshogs yon ster sbyin sogs sbyar ba'i gra tshang nas tshe chog gi ram 'degs la khor du dpon slob lhan du tshogs shing sger du'ang zhal 'don gsungs/ gra tshang gi gra pa don gnyer can kha shas la lcags 'dra nas byung ba'i byad 'grol gyi lag len zhib par khrid/tshes bco brgyad la khal kha da'i bung chung tha'i (169na)ji/ cha gan bar/ u kha res tha'i jis gtsos dge bsnyen dge tshul bsdoms pa drug cu re gsum dang dge slong bdun cu bsgrubs shing da'i bung la lha btsun ngag dbang bstan 'dzin du mtshan gsol/ tshes bcu dgu la gra tshang gis sbyin bdag dang cho ga ba sbrags nas rten 'brel bsgrig pa mdzad/ nyer gcig gnyis kyi ring rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog /gter ston rin po che/ gra tshang yongs rdzogs dang bcas par rdo rje gro lod/ kārma gu sa yang gsang drag po/ dngas ma bcud 'dren bzhi'i dbang phul/nyer gsum la zhal snga nas dge 'dun grags pas gtsos stod rgyud mkhas 'dus gra tshang yongs —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)rdzogs kyi bdog pa bzhes spro bstar te tshe'i rten 'brel mdzad/ rta tshag rje drung / spos khang mkhan po/rgya phrug rab 'byams pa/ gu ru chos dbang dang snying ri ba'i gdung brgyud da yan rgyal po'i dbu sgor che chung sogs sog po 'dam du 'gro mi mang ba dang phrad ces spos khang mkhan pos lang lab byang chub rdo rje'i zhun thigs las grub pa'i rdo rje gzhen nu'i sku ster bar mdzad/ nyer lnga nas bzung nyin gsum gyi bar 'brog rgan 'dra'i chu tshan blangs te rkang nad la phan nam snyam pa'i re dogs kyi 'khrul 'khor ci yang bskor mod/ 'di phan med pa'i stod mi bde tsam pa'i dngos grub kyang gsar du byung / rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku dang gter ston rin po cher gza' pod 'bul rtsis yin rung rdo rje brag tu sman sgrub gnang ba'i dus kyis gtugs nas nyer bdun la phebs (169ba)rdzongs zhus/ gong dkar blo bzang bsod nams kyis dga' ldan gsang sngags gling du 'dzugs rgyu'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ 'dar lo 'khor zhag la 'gro zhor du sgo rum dang kha'ur gos yug /pu tra khang dang brag ram gnyis la gos bcad/ thub bstan dge 'phel du rtags brgyad kha btags rnams la zhal byang bkod pa'i snyan shal phul cing khong rang gi thub bstan dge 'phel du 'bul rgyu'i kha byang rnams bris/ nyer dgur cha gan bar gyis gtsos khal kha tsho dang thos pa dga' can la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur zhing bdog pa'i ster sbyin dang bcas rdzong ba byas/ thos pa dgar jo rig thu er khe da'i chin gyi cho lo btags/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa/ ma ga dha/ mo ja rag gi dpon mo sogs kyis gos dar ja ko dra tshan che ba'i bdog pa bteg /hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la spos khang mkhan pos sman bla tshogs su 'dzugs rtsis kyi dri smed mdzad/ ser byes pa blo gros phun tshogs kyis brgyad stong pa'i rgyugs sprad/ 'di nyin nas bzung ra mo che'i kun dga' ra ba'i gtsang khang sbug gi rje btsun btsong kha pa/ nye sras brgyad/ phyag rdor/ dbyug sngon can/ sgo bad steng sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal chen bzhi/ phyi rol gyi phyag rdor dang bcas pa'i 'bur sku la tshon gsol/ 'du khang dngos gzhi'i ldebs lho byang dang sgo 'gram byang gi —236

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadashar gsum mkhas mchog dpa' bos mdzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs gsham la sbyin bdag gi tshul du rgyal po mchod yon (170na)sbug gi sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi phyi'i logs la sman bla bder gshegs brgyad/ nang skor lto'i phyi skya 'bur dod byang ltar jo bo rje la sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ khu rngog /ka ba/ nag tsho rnams kyis bskor ba/ shar ltar rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po la 'jam dbyangs/ rgyal tshab/mkhas grub/ 'dul 'dzin pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ byams chen chos rje rnams kyis bskor ba/ byang gi 'bur dod lho ltar 'brom la sgrol dkar/ sku mched gsum/ dgon pa ba/ sne'u zur pa rnams kyis bskor ba/ shar ltar 'dra 'bag la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ rje pha bong kha pa/ mchod yon gnyis rnams kyis bskor ba/ mchod 'bul khang gi skya chung kha byang lta la mchod lha/ thog mtshams kyi sa stong tshor mkhan slob chos gsum/klu dbang / spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/ phyag rdor/ sgrol dkar/ sa skya'i gong ma lnga rnams dang seng g.yabs la sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ mkhan slob gnyis/ jo bo rje/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/ 'brom ston pa/ rje btsun grags pa/ phag mo gru pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ mnga' bdag nyang shong lo/ bu ston rin po che/bla ma dam pa/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ rje dge 'dun grub rnams/ bse gdong mgon khang gi shar la beng / byang du klu rgyal/ bar khyams byang ldebs la dpal lha/ g.yu sgron ma/ gtsang khang sbug gi phyogs bzhi dang nang skor bar (170ba〉skor gyi lho nub byang gsum bcas la sgrol dkar/ tshe dpag med/ rnam rgyal ma/ sgrol ljang bzhi po so sor stong sku/ bar skor shar gyi phyi skya nang lta la sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ jo bo lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig /bar sgo'i 'gram g.yas g.yon shar ltar dkar chag /skor tshad/ srid pa 'khor lo rnams 'dri ba'i do dam 'dar pa rje drung / kong po gur bzang pa bsod nams dar rgyas/ bris pa'i dbu chen gong dkar chos sde gsang sngags mkhar chos mdzad gzhen nu dang 'bras spungs slob dpon ngag dbang 'phrin las/ dbu 'bring gra nang spus khyim pa ngag dbang sri chod/ zho ra rgyal po/ gsang mkhar tshe 'phel/ dbu chung spus khyim pa nor dbang / byings gras bde chen chos 'khor —237—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba dzam bha la dang dol byams pa rgyal mtshan sogs mi grangs zhe dgu/ 'jim bzo ba e nas dbu chen bag dro/ dbu chung chos 'phel/ byings mi grangs bco lnga'i do dam phod dkar ba bsod nams rnam rgyal dang rgyas sman bkra shis kha pa gnyis kyis byas te sgo khang du rgyal chen bzhir 'khor 'grogs gnas mched lngas bskor ba/ lha sa'i bar khang gi lhor nang sgo kha byang ltar sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ nye sras brgyad/ chos rgyal lha khang gi g.yon sgo shar lta'i nang du thugs rje chen por thub pa drug gis bskor ba/ g.yung drung khug sgo shar lta'i nang du sangs rgyas la gtad rabs bdun gyis bskor ba/ shod g.yung drung khug tu tshe dpag med lha dgu rnams bzheng ba'i dbu btsugs/tshes (171na)bdun la gter ston rin po cher rgya sbug gos dar sogs phebs rdzongs rgyas par bstar te rang gi bsti gnas su gshegs/ seng ldeng nags sgrol la brten pa'i mdos chog mthong bas don grub dang dbu mdzad ngag dbang bzod pas bskul ba'i ngor gter ston rin po che'i brtan bsdos/sa tshigs bcad bris/tshes brgyad kyi dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshe dpal rdo rje'i chos skyong che chung las mkhan dang bcas par gtor chog thugs dam skong ba'i gra tshang gi rdo rje slob dpon du phyin thog sde pas go dkar ldem gnyis/ sag thag gnyis/ me sgrogs bdun/ gos bzang bsgrigs kyi 'phan la tshems ris kyi phyi rten rnams rngam brdzid chags pa bstar/ bar khams phyogs su rang bstan seng ge'i khog pa 'bus zos kyi rnam pa mi bde ba'i rtsa rkyen drung nas phyungs pa'i sngon 'gro'i bya dga' mdong gsol spel bar dar rgyas bkra shis rdzong bda' byas/ jus yags kyi gtang rag la chos skyong spyi dang dmag zor mar 'phar ma dang bcas nyin bzhir bzabs rgyas gra tshang gis btang skabs go mtshon spyan gzigs rgya cher phul/tshes bcu la 'bri gung dang bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod/ dwags po bang rim pa sogs dang phrad/ shing stag gi le'u tho lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bzo bcug pa'i 'go brjod brtsams/ sngon chad gos sku'i rigs bzo ba byung ma song ba da lam nged rang gi 'dod mthun bzhin sde pas khur blangs —238—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)te bum stan ma drug /hor gos kha zheng che chung 'dres pa'i yug (171ba)bco lnga dang yug bcad bzhi/gser gzhi ma legs pa yug brgyad/ kha thi rnying ma yug bcu drug /sgril btags rgya yig dang rgyan gzhi tshon khra sna tshogs yug bco brgyad/ yug bcad bcu gnyis/ gser ma tshos kha sna tshogs yug bcu dgu dang yug bcad bcu bzhi/ bzang gos tshos gcig ma dmar po yug dgu dang yug bcad dgu/ser po yug lnga dang yug bcad lnga/ ljang gu yug nyer bdun dang yug bcad bzhi/ sngon po yug zhe brgyad dang yug bcad brgyad/ li hang yug drug dang yug bcad gcig /ja kha yug gsum dang yug bcad gcig /mchin kha yug bco brgyad dang yug bcad lnga/ g.yu kha yug gcig dang yug bcad gcig /na ros yug gsum dang yug bcad gnyis/ stag shun yug bcad gnyis/ gos phrug sna tshogs si'u yo med 'dres pa yug dgu dang yug bcad gcig /gos dkar bcu gnyis/ lho ras yug bzhi brgya dang bcu gcig /khom bu rnam gnyis bubs bcu/ ling / chor/ dar sogs tshos kha sna tshogs 'dres pa'i yug bco brgyad dang yug bcad brgyad rnams las gtso bo rje btsun byams mgon la jo bo rje/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa/ rje pha bong kha pa/ 'dra 'bag /sprin gseb tu o rgyan rin po che dang rje btsun grags pa/sman bla bder gshegs bdun/ bka' gdams lha bzhi/ gnas chung chos skyong chen po rnams kyis bskor ba dpangs la rgyug 'dom nyi shu rtsa lnga dang zheng 'dom bcu bdun yod pa'i sngon med che legs kyi dbu btsugs pa zla ba (172na)drug pa'i nyer gsum la rdzogs par grub pa'i dkar chag che brjod brtsams shing bzo bo ni/ ri mo'i dbu mdzad rin spungs tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ dbu chung rag kha 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ gos bzo'i dbu mdzad ri nang phun tshogs dang lha sar ga rtse shag o rgyan/ tshangs ldan/ pa rnam brtan pa/ tshe brtan/ dbu chung rgyal rtse padma tshe ring / gzhis rtse dar rgyas bkra shis/ gong dkar phun tshogs/ byings gras sum cu so dgu/ do dam pa dar khan dka' bcu/ lha khang pa rdo rje nor bu/ bkrasarab pa dkon mchog gsum gyis byas te bsgrubs pa la rab gnas rta thog ma byas te bkra shis me tog char chen po phab/—239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)tshes bco lngar dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul nas gter gsar 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen dang log tri'i rig gtad/ thugs thig snying bum g.yas 'khyil/ sgrub khag btsugs skabs dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs dang rjes su mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho/ byang 'dren dkon mchog rgya mtsho gsum gyis bskul nas las byang gnam lcags rdo rje drag 'bebs bskul ba por ma bltos par gra tshang gi mkho byed du srung bzlog thun mong ba nyams su len tshul btsan mkhar bsrung ba'i 'phrul skyogs dang bzlog bsad las sbyor gyi gsal byed glang smyon sna rtser bkod pa'i mtshon 'khor rnams bris/ pho brang blo bzang skyes mchog gi 'don cha yongs su rdzogs pa shog bu lnga (172ba)brgyar nye ba'i rgyugs sprad/ 'phan yul sman tser rigs 'dzin ratna gling pa'i rta phag yab yum yod 'phros thos pa sde pas rtsad gcod btang ba 'khyar ba bzhin yin nam ma byung ba'i tshab gur zhal yab yum gyi sku byin can 'byor/ ri bo bde chen mkhan zur blo bzang mkhas btsun gyis da cha yun ring sdod mdog ma kha 'dug pa mi tshe chos la dril khul yin kyang lag yod rtsa ba bzhi la ma 'bags pa'i gdengs las med tshul gsung ba 'phral ca zhan mdog kha po la myangs na las 'bras mkhyen pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gsung du snang / ring por ma lon par khong pa dang gra thang mkhan pos kun dga' gsang sngags gshegs pa'i bsngo rten byung ba sras bcas rgyal bar mchod sprin spros te bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/nyer gnyis la yer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse bas bdog pa'i skyes spel nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rgyal po sras yum blon por bcas pa/ rdzing phyi dang bzang ldan mkhan po/tshal ba yum sras/ dpal ri sprul sku sogs la ja gral btang thog dur bod chog thu khyo shugs kyis gos dar gser dngul gyis gtsos ster cha dpangs mtho ba bteg /gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas la rdo rje gro lod/ yang gsang ga rma drag po/ gshin rje 'joms byed gsum gyi dmigs skor lag len dang bcas pa khrid nas mtshams bsdams/ rwa sgreng mkhan zur bas dgos tshul du byung ba'i zlar g.yon ru —240

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasku skye/ zhal snga nas pha bong kha pa/ gzims shag lho pa'i rab stims pa/ mdo pa nang so/ gra tshang gi gra pa 'ga' (173na/deg bcas par skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul bzhi'i rjes gnang / mgon po'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel/ tshe rta rnams bskur/ gdugs dkar/ sher snying / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig /spyod 'jug bsngo le/ las kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i gzugs/ blo bzang rgyal ba ma/ rab stims skyob pa ma/ rang rtsom ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad rdo rje'i sku brnyes ma/ bde chen zhing mgon ma/ bder gshegs gtsug tor ma sogs kyi lung bklags/ stag rtse nas lcam ngag dbang grongs pa'i bsngo rten 'byor don ltar byang chub kyi rgyur rgyas btab/nyer lnga la sde pa bsnyun par khams gsum du drung 'tsho lhag dar gnyis kyis gtar kha byas pa'i srung 'khor la phyin/ nyer brgyad la sde pa'i gnyid bsrung bar phyin pa sde par chos skyong 'dra 'khu ba'i mkhren yin nam gra tshang gra pa thar rgyan dol gnas brtan pas khyer ba'i gdon grib ji ltar yang rkang pa g.yas pa'i 'bam 'phar ba'i nad g.yog dbu mdzad/ mchod dpon/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang sman pa drung 'tsho lhag dar gnyis kyis byas/ snang srid kyi dregs pa rang sems su ngo ma shes par phyi rol tu kha gdangs mche ba gcig pa zhig yod par 'khrul nas la mo gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa/ bsam yas dang tshong 'dus su spun bdun nas/ thang po cher gtsang don chen pa so sor spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor bzabs rgyas (173ba)'phrin yig tshigs bcad dang bcas rdzong bda' bgyis shing gnas chung du'ang mchod pa spyan gzigs bskrun/ tshang mas yang nas yang du brtan bzhugs byed rgyu yin zhes nged dag zhing du 'gro bar rings pa'i nyams tsam byed 'dug kyang las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i rigs la de 'dra'i dogs gnas ga la dgos/ da lam kyang 'chi bas 'ji)gas te rim gror dbus khul gyi dgon khag che kha rdog bsgrugs brgya dang bco lngar mang ja bsngo rten 'gyed/ ser 'bras gnyis la dge 'dun lnga re gser zho re/ de phyin dge 'dun drug rer rgya dngul —241—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)srang re rnams bsdoms par gser zho bdun brgya dang bzhi bcu/ dngul srang nyis stong lnga brgya sum cu so brgyad song ba'i zhal 'don du mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig /tshe gzungasarnams gang 'tsham/ chos 'khor rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bskang bshags 'bum/ beg tse/ gur zhal/ pu tra mgon chos tshor khri/ mngon dga' lcog tu sgron dar spyan gzigs gsol mchod/ dol chu mig dkar rgyal gyi tsha ngad cher song ba dang gzhan yang mi bsrun 'gong po'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs snang bar dmigs gra tshang du rdo rje slob dpon brag sna chos rjes byas pa'i ar gtad bya ba mjug tu sreg pa hom gyi las la sbyar/ 'bras spungs sngags khang du stod rgyud pa lnga bcus zhag bdun gyi ring shwa sa na gtso bor brtan pa'i mthar gtor bzlog /thang po cher zhag lnga'i bar bzabs gsol/ srong btsan du dpal ri ba brgyad kyis zhag lngar spyan (174na)gzigs dang bcas bskang bshags/ 'phyong rgyas rdzong du dpal ri sprul sku gra bcas nyi shus bdun gcig gi ring rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi tshe sgrub/ bkra shis bde chen pas sman bla khri/ pho brang rdzong du bkra shis chos sde pa lnga bcus sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub rnams kyi yon thob la gos chen kha drug brgya dang dgu bcu/ dbus gtsang rdzong 'go rags bsdus brgyad nas bka' 'gyur brgya nyi shu dang sātstsha sa ya phyed gnyis btab pa'i yon la brgya dngul srang sum brgya bcu gnyis/ gos kha brgyad brgya re gsum/ mang 'gyed sngon song gi dgon khag brgya bco lnga phud de phyin dbus gtsang gi ris med dgon adhi gnyis pa yan la mang ja bsngo rten sngar rgyun dang 'gyed dbus khul gyi gra btsun bco lngar dngul srang re dang gtsang du nyi shur srang re bcas khyon dril srang nyis stong nyis brgya so bzhi rnams song bar skabs sbyar gyi rim gro/ dbus gtsang gi mi ser gzhung rgyug sger mchod gzhis thams cad la dud che chung gshor khal gcig nas gsum rim 'gros/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la rdzong gzhis kha yar du btsugs pa'i bka' 'gyur tshig brgya nyi shu/sman bla khri/ dpal ri sprul sku gra bcas nyi shus bdun phrag gi bar lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi dag snang tshe sgrub rigs 'dzin srog sgrub/ bkra shis chos sde ba lnga bcus sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub/ sātstsha —242

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)sa ya gcig dang lnga 'bum/ rgyal mthil gyi mgon khang du chos skyong spyir bskang bshags stong / dge tshal du dmag zor mar chig 'bum/ gur (174ba〉lta beg tse pu trar khri/ cho so skyong gzhan tshor stong /mngon dga' lcog tu bzabs gsol/ 'bras spungs sngags khang du rgyud stod pa lnga bcus shwa sa na'i sngags rgyun gyi mthar gtor bzlog /thang po cher zhag lnga'i bar gsol mchod rgyas pa/ srong btsan du zhag lngar ma ning gi bskang bshags/ dbus gtsang gi ris med dgon adhi gnyis pa yan la mang skol 'phar ma'i thog ser 'bras kyi dge 'dun lngar gser zho re/ dga' ldan gyis gtsos pa'i dgon che kha chig brgya bcu gsum gyi dge 'dun drug rer zho re/ de phyin dbus khul gyi dge 'dun bco lngar dngul srang re/ gtsang du nyi shur srang re rnams bsdoms pa gser zho bdun brgya dang bzhi bcu/ rgya dngul srang bzhi stong bdun brgya don gnyis/ gzhung rgyug mi ser khral 'then rkang rer gzhor khal gsum re/ dud chung dang sger mchod gzhis kyi them 'dzin che ba rer khal gnyis re dang chung ba tshor khal re/ sa rim lam phog che ba'i sar so khrug sha pags kyi 'phar cha/ nya bzhi 'bum sum khri brgyad stong go lnga'i srog blu/ mchod rten dang lam 'phrang zhig gsos kyi 'u lag gi chas thebs khyon khal chig 'bum brgyad khri nyis stong sum brgya go bzhi/ rta/ tshwa/ bal/ sha pags/ re snam sogs gong rgyab khal bzhi khri sum stong nyis brgya so gcig rnams song ba'i tshogs gsog rgya cher bsgrubs/tshes bdun la sde pas thugs khur bzhes nas lha sa smon lam gyi tshogs khro che ba gnyis blug par 'thor nas lugs khrod du song ba'i nas khro chus gtums pa dang phyed don pa/ mthil la nor bu sogs ri mo (175na〉 mtshan can 'dug zer ba dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs yin nam snyam/de'i kha byang / dar mo sman rams pas gsang ne'u thog gi sgrol ma rtsod rgyal ma dang zhang blon la 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha yig /mchod dpon pa'i ngor lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal gyi dag snang a ti hriḥgacig ma'i mchan 'grel/ mtsho sna sku skye'i don du gra rigs kyis bskul nas smon lam/ dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtshos bde ba can gyi zhing bkod bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa spun —243—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gyis gra tshang du snyan dar nyis brgya skor phul ba'i kha byang / rab 'byams pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi ngor zhus rkos pa rnams kyi kha rtan du ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ zhi gnas slob dpon bra zhi sku skye ngag dbang bkra shis kyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i smon lam/ de dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan/ brag sna chos rje blo bzang ngag dbang / rgyal ri khrod pa dge slong chos 'phel gsum gyi ngor gsur bsngo rnams bris/tshes dgu la tshangs pa dung thod can la dri ba zhu bar tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs dang bcas gra tshang gnyer pa btang bar 'tshub che tshul bzlog thabs kyi rim gro rnam grangs mang tsam phab pa'i de rnams grub nas ngo so ma byung na slar dri ba dang byung na gtang rag btang chog pa gyis shig pa'i lung bstan mdzad/ rim gror gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po gdan drangs pa tshes bcu gcig la phebs/slob dpon chen pos dus kyi mthar rgyal po dang klu'i gdon sde brgyad gzhan (175ba)las 'tshub che tshul jo mo 'tsho rgyal la gsungs pa'i lo rgyus 'brul pa med pa'i steng ding sang rgyal gsar spang la sha mo lta bur rdol ba'i kun rtog gi ri mo yid la ci yang 'char ba nas gter ston rin po ches dbu mdzad gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis 'byung po de dag mthun rdzas dang bcas rdzongs su btab/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan dang blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dar mo sman rams pa lnga so so'i gos dar sogs bdog pa bcas yun du 'tsho dgos pa'i gsol ba 'debs par blo brid tsam du khas blangs/ nged rang bro 'tshal bar dmigs nas dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ brag sna chos rje/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum gyis ser 'bras gnyis/ sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dge slong blo bzang kun dga'/ dge slong rnam rgyal dpal bzang / byang 'dren dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ gram pa blo bzang ngag dbang / ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ rnam gling chos mdzad/ ngag dbang nam mkha' rnams kyis 'bras spungs/ dar mo sman rams pa dang drung yig 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis 'bras spungs dang gsang phu/ blo —244

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)gros legs bshad dang chos mdzad ngag dbang byams pa gnyis kyis se ra rnams su mang ja/ blo gros rnam rgyal gyi 'bras spungs su thug pa/ blo bzang bzod pas 'bras spungs su mang ja dang gra tshang du mi bcu rer dngul srang re/ 'di gar bcu gcig (176na)bzlog dang gshin rje'i dgra mnan/ gzhis rtser ngor pas 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog /snying ri bas beg tse'i gtor bzlog dang dgra mnan/ 'ug bya lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog dang dgra mnan/ bon po dar sdings pas gtor bzlog dang dgra mnan/ rin spungs su gsang sngags gling pas 'char ga'i gtor bzlog dang dgra mnan/ gong dkar du chos sde bas zhal gyi gtor bzlog /dkon gnyer bas phyag bzhi pa'i mdos/dung dgon pas lha 'dre stong dra'i mdos dang dgra mnan/ 'phyong rgyas su o rgyan smin grol gling pas gter mgon phyag bzhi pa'i mdos dang ki gang gi dgra mnan/ pho brang du bkra shis chos sde bas gur gyi dmar chen gtor bzlog /khra 'brug tu dpal ri bas nag po sum dril gyi gtor bzlog dang dgra mnan/ rtse'i dkon gnyer bas phyag bzhi pa'i mdos/ bsam yas su gra snye mdo bas gter gsar 'joms byed kyi gtor bzlog dang ki gang gi dgra mnan/ rdo rje brag nas 'char ga'i mdos dang 'joms byed/ do bo rdzong du smra bo lcog pas gter mgon phyag bzhi pa'i gtor bzlog dang gshin rje'i dgra mnan/ chos 'khor rgyal mthil nas phyag drug pa/ dga' tshal nas beg tse dang dmag zor ma'i gtor bzlog /lha sar rgyud stod smad so so nas drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog /zhang ston pas mdos dang dgra mnan/ 'bri gung sprul sku rin po ches me'i spu gri'i sgrub pa las sbyor/ rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub dang sngags 'chang ban grong pa gnyis (176ba)kyis ka tshal du khro chu'i gtor bzlog rnams smin rgyas su bsgrubs pas rtags mtshan kyang sna tshogs byung tshod du 'dug /grong smad nas mchod yon la bsnyen bkur ba'i skal ba hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la dkar spro dmar spro bzabs rgyas su bstar zhing 'gan sbyar sogs kyi ster sbyin byas/ stag rtse sde pa tha'i jis bsam yas kyi zhig gsos lcags khyi tshun mdzad pa pe dkar lcog gis mtha' brten pa'i nged rang gi byed sgo rnams zin pa yin —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)pas dkar chag dgos tshul byung ba rgyas par bris/ rab brtan khung tha'i ji'i dpon mos slar yang rta nyer gnyis dang rnga mo bdun sprad/ 'di ga'i rim gror tshes gsum nas chos sde chen po phan tshun du ja tshul bco lnga'i thog gdugs dkar bdun 'bum drug stong chig brgya song ba'i yon gra pa lnga rer rgya dngul srang re khyon srang chig brgya brgyad cu/ mnga' dwags/ shel brag /bo dong / kon ne ma/ bzhad ri bo gru 'dzin rnams su ma ṇi dung phyur lnga'i yon sbyar/ 'dar pa bsod nams lhun grub rdo rje gzhis rtse'i rdzong sdod thog glo bur du ma 'tsho bar bsngo byang gi rten rgyas par 'byor don bzhin bsngo smon byang bzhu yang dag bgyis shing dge thebs kyi mthun rkyen kyang byin/ dpon tshang byang ngos nang so dar rgyas na tshod smin che zhing gcong gis bsnyun nas yun ring song ba grongs pa'i bsngo rten rgyas par 'byor zhing dge 'thud spams mtho ba bstar/ byang rtags kyang dgos tshul byung ba yan lag ma bde gshis 'phral du ma thub rung 'khrul snang la khong byad dbyibs shin tu gsal (177na)mchod thebs su yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sder tshe mkhar ba gzhen pas 'dzin shul dang phan thad bogs 'khyar/ sdum ra khang gsar gyi khang pa rtsi shing rtsa rigs kyi bdag thob mi ser sdad grong rkang gcig dang dud chung gcig gi bogs shas lag 'debs kyi thon bsdoms par mkhar ru'i 'bru khal lnga brgya re drug /dmag rkang gcig gi tshab tu bogs 'os 'tsham 'gel rtsis dang / smin grol gyi gling du zhabs drung bdud 'dul rab brtan de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs su thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi sgrub mchod thebs la rgyang sgo sbug pa can them rkang bzhi'i yong sgo bogs 'khyar dang bcas bsdoms mkha' ru'i khal sum brgya go brgyad rnams sbyor 'jags bgyis/ nyer gsum nas btsugs pa'i gra tshang gis khro rol dang 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i gtor bzlog mdzad/ nyer bdun nas bro 'tshal ba las rnam par grol/ hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig la lha chen tshangs pa dung thod can la tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs 'phrin yig tshigs bcad dang bcas gtang rag 'bul mi btang / jo bo shākya mu ni'i bzhugs khang 'grub tu nye bar bod yul du 'dod dgu —246—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadargya cher spel ba'i ched dzam la dang klu'i nor gter zab gter sna tshogs las byung ba bzhin lag len ltar khrir bzhugs rgyu'i bum gter gyi rim pa bzabs rgyas su bzos/ chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa chos skyong rgya mtshos gsar rtsom phar phyin gyi rgyugs sprad/ zho stod gter sgrom brag gi rang byung khrus chu bdun phrag gi bar bsten/tshes dgu'i nyin byed yol la sngar ma grags lta bu'i (177bakhir bas ne le dang pho rog sogs kyang bsad pa srung ma'i 'khu ldog gam sde brgyad kyi 'tshub lhongs shig tu dogs shing la la zha dmar nag gang du phebs sar mi shes pa re yod gin yod 'dug pas khong dpon slob zhal phyogs yar gzigs pa'i snga ltas yin nam zer/ tshes bcu la gra tshang gis tshes bcu chen mo'i gar 'chams kyi stangs stabs ci yang bsgyur/ tshes bcu gcig la brtag bgyis sde pa'i rim gror dbus gtsang gi dgon a di gnyis pa yan la mang ja'i thog sher snying / tshe gzungs/ yar lha sham por gsol mchod/ sprang po brgyar thug pa rtsam mda' zo re dang so hrug lag pa re/ gos sbyin 'os 'tsham/ khyi yan brgyar zan sbyin/ bstan srid sku rim du dge lugs gzhis dgon dang sngags dgon nas gtor bzlog /mtshan nyid pa'i rigs nas dgu bzlog /zan g.yang du mdo sde mchod pa'i dus chos skyong chen po dpon blon la 'phrin las gsol ba'i tshigs bcad spyan gzigs dang bcas kha rab gong pa brdzangs/ tshes bcu bzhi'i zhogs stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub 'das pa'i bsngo rten 'byor don bzhin byang chub 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngos shing dge thebs rgya cher byin/tshes bcu drug gi nyin mnga' ris gra tshang yongs rdzogs dang rgyang ro gser sdings gra tshang dril ba 'phan yul gsas khang bla ma gra bcas/ rgya mda' khul gyi lha sde mi sde sogs so sos dngos po spams mtho ba maṇḍal du bkod de ring por 'tsho ba'i smon lam mdzad/ mnga' ris gra tshang par yig drug gi bzlas lung dang gdugs dkar mchog grub ma'i bstod pa dang bcas pa'i lung bklags/ bo dong sbyor ra sprul sku/ thugs sras sprul (178na〉sku/ 'chad ka spyan snga gsum dang phrad/ khal kha lha btsun ngag —247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dbang bstan 'dzin/ bzod pa yel deng skor la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang bskur cing rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan/ nged rang gis longs su spyad pa'i gos/ snam phrug gis gtsos dngos po dang bcas rdzong bda' bzabs par bstar/ mnga' bdag smra bo lcog pa lung bstan bzhin du gdung brgyud rdzogs pa'i sku mag dgos tshul byung ba gter kha 'og ma chos dbang gi gdung brgyud brag sna ba'i sras len bcug pa phyogs mthun du byon pa dang phrad cing mtshan mnga' bdag ngag dbang chos rgyal du gsol/ dben sa sprul sku gong ma'i gzims dpon er khe chos rje 'das pa'i dge rtsa gtong mi ched gnyer 'byor ba'i bsngo rten dpangs mtho ba byung ba dge ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar rgyas btab/ dar rgyas chos sdings pa'i gdung brgyud lo chen ngag dbang chos dpal gyis thog drangs pa'i bsnyen rdzogs zhe lnga dang /zhang ston pa'i sras sogs dge tshul nyer gcig bsgrubs/tshes bcu dgu nas srid gsum bdag mo mdos kyi mchod pas mnyes par byas/ gter ston rin po che'i gsung gis bskul ba'i rnon po nang gcod dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bris/ sde drug dang skyor lung pa'i mkhan po/ g.yul rgyal lhun rtse nas 'kho mkhar dbang 'dzin pas gtsos legs skyes pa rnams dang phrad/ g.yon ru'i mi sna tshogs gsog rab 'byams pa yongs skabs mdo pa zi sna sogs lung tsho lnga sbyor 'jags byung (178ba)ba'i legs so rgyas par bstar cing lha 'dre'i gnod pa bsrung ba'i tshigs bcad bsrings te rdzong bda' byas/ chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa gzhen nu blo gros dang blo bzang chos grags gnyis kyis gsar rtsom phar phyin gyi rgyugs sprad/ zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku gong ma'i lung la brten phing sing dbang gis mas chags pa dang 'bum thang bsod dbang la rtsis sprad don ltar gdan drangs par thab bsu dang chibs bsu sogs mdzes lam gang che'i sgo nas lha sar byon/ sngon chad gnang sgo sna tshogs pa byung ba'i thugs gnong lta bus ya nga ba'i sku dang gsung gi bkod pa ji snyed pa ston bzhin pa'i ngang nas mchod yon du dgongs sangs kyi 'bul ba gzengs —248

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadabastod pa dang bcas bla brang du phebs skabs sde pas e waṃ pho brang gi mdor mjal dar dang rgyal pos nang du ldang ba/ mchod yon gnyis las khyad kyis mtho ba'i bzhugs khris mtshon bkur gzos dang gzhis len rgyas par bstar bas thugs kyi khye'u kun rtog gi zhags pa dam pos bcings pa las grol te gar gyi dbang po rang gnas bde ba can du byon pa'i nyams shar/ nged lus cung zad ma bde tsam yod pas slar ngos mjal gyis bcad zhus nas mtshur phur shar rgyag thegs/hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi la yar 'brog sde pa ri bo brag pas bsangs yig chung ngu dang gsol 'debs tshigs bcad dgos tshul phebs pa/ stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyi phyi rten rnam snang rgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig rnams bris/ thang chen bshan pa lag dmar la spyan gzigs tshogs rdzas 'phrin yig tshigs bcad dang bcas mngags/ rgya nag nas zhu dmar sprul pa'i sku bod du phebs(179na)bcug pa sogs sa mtshams bde 'jags byung bar gra tshang gis nyin gsum gyi ring rdo rje'i chos srung tshogs la gtang rag phul/ khal kha lha btsun ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang bzod pa yel deng sogs kyis sog po'i gzhung bstan la phan pa'i bla ma zhig dgos tshul byung ba sde drug mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyas rdzong bda' byas/ byang phyogs kyi yul gru 'di ha cang thag ring bas mkhan po gsar bskos 'gab gras su 'dug rung khong rang yar byon bstun gnas mal 'dra ma rnyed dogs pa'i nyes dmigs dang dgon khag rnams kyang rgya sog gi 'dod yon char du bsnyil la re'i bla ma bskug par ngan song pa spyi rdzas la bgo bsha' rgyag na ni mchod rten yin kyang 'jig par nye/ gzhan du ngam shod byed ma gser dang rgyan 'brum 'byung nyen che/ skyid tshal klu sdings kyi skyed bu kha dro'i skal ba/ de mtshungs gzhis ka shar dang nang pa lo pa gnyis kyis dkar spro'i za ma tog ring du bsgrigs/tshes dgu nas me'i spu gri dang rlung sgrub sogs khag gsum btsugs/ tshes bcu gnyis la bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas par tshe dbang grub rgyal ma phul te 'dam du bteg /dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa dkon cog chos bzang dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i thugs —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9) dam gsol 'debs kyi bdog pa rgyas par byung ba ltar 'gro ba 'dren bzhed yongs su 'grub pa'i bsngo smon bgyis/ zha lu'i slob dpon gnyis la byams pas dam bcas pa/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs gsum po'i lung bklags/ ge re lha rin po che/ chos rje sgrol phug pa/ mang ra mkhan po/ pha bong kha gdan (179ba)sa ba/ mas chags pa can dang phrad/tshes bcu bzhir dpal gsang ne'u thog gi chos rje rnam gnyis/ drung chen/ gzhung las pa sogs dpon slob bzhi bcu skor gyis tshan grangs kyi maṇḍal dang bcas yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i yun 'tsho'i rten 'byung mdzad/ rta tshag rje drung / tsha mig mkhan zur/ se ra theg chen gling gi las sne ba/kong po rgyal skor ba/ gung thang gzims khang shar dang rmi ru bla ma/ o rod nas gsar 'byor gangs can mkhan po dkon cog rin chen rnams dang phrad/ ra mo che'i 'du khang gi zhabrungs rabs so bzhi pa bris pa'i kha byang / dga' ldan thar gling bla rabs gsol 'debs dang gdan sa pa'i brtan bzhugs/e gzims shag lto pa nang so dkon cog dar rgyas kyis gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa nged rang tsho la dpags ba'i bya ba rlabs po che yin tshul dang bcas bskul ba ltar dkar chag che brjod smon lam/ rgyud smad dpon slob kyis gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dgos gsung ba rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po 'di'i dgongs don rtogs par dka' zhing stong rtsa za bar ma phyin pa'i gshis tshad ldan ma byung dogs na'ang bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs don la chu bun ma byugs tsam zhig dang / dpal de nas/ bstan pa dar rgyas gnyis kyi ngor ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad re spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtshos bskul ba'i rje btsun btsong kha pa dang bdag bstod thun mong / bar ta chos mdzad snyi kyis rgyal ba btsong kha pa dang nged rang gi 'dra 'bag /gdong nas kyis mi g.yo ba/ mdo btsun ngag dbang lhun grub kyis bdag cag gi ston pa dang rgyal ba btsong kha pa/(180na〉sum pa ngag dbang chos 'dzin gyis thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs/ 'jam dbyangs kyis brgya thang /tshe bdag /brag sna chos rje blo bzang ngag dbang gis bla ma gsang 'dus kyi brgya thang / spos 'dzin pa —250

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)ngag dbang nam mkhas 'jam dkar gyis bris sku bzhedas pa rnams kyi rgyab yig /ngag dbang bzang po'i ngor bla ma dang rdo rje drag po rtsal dbyer med du gsol 'debs rjes 'dzin smon lam/ gra tshang dkon gnyer gsum gyis rnam rgyal mar snyan dar phul ba'i kha byang / gnang byung chos mdzad kyis bskul ba'i ga rma drag por gsol 'debs dang zangs mdog dpal rir skye ba'i smon lam rnams bris/tshes nyi shur bod khams spyi'i nad yams bzlog thabs su bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos rdzongs khag lnga/ rdzong mgo tshang ma nas dge 'dun bzhi sdes rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs gang rung gi bum pa bsgrubs nas nyin gsum gyi bar khrus gsol/ sngags bon gyis dgra lha dpangs bstod bzabs rgyas/bla ma bkra bzang pas nad bdag stobs 'joms btang ba'i yas rnams gangs te se'i 'og tsam du bskyal/ tshe dpag med/ rdo rje gro lod/ yang gsang ga rma drag po/ gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed bzhi'i sgrub pa nyin lngar btsugs pa'i 'dzugs ston gzhung dang gra tshang gnyis ka nas btang /hor zla bdun pa'i tshes lnga la gong gi mi sna bstan 'dzin bla ma dang bsam blo a zhang er te ni rab 'byams chos rje gnyis kyis gtsos 'grul ldebs shan ta pa'i li'i bla ma mnga' ris rab 'byams pa/ er khe dbang gi bla ma 'brong rtse rab 'byams pa sogs (180ba)tshan che bar 'byor ba'i bka' shog gnang sbyin sprad cing so so'i mjal dar btang ba'i bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston rgyas par bshams/rgyal po'i 'tsham 'dri'i bka' phebs bsgyur byung zhing yul dus dang bstun pa'i 'phros gleng rgyas par byung / tre bo dkar lcog sprul sku dang gu yeng ja'i sang can dang ngos phrad/ sde pa'i zhabs cung zad bsnyung bar dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang bskur/ rgyal po'i bka' shog sprod skabs so so'i don gcod byed mi nus pa'i khrims btsan gshis sang nyin mi sna 'grul sdebs/ 'di nas btang ba'i mi sna bsam grub dga' ldan bla ma dang lcang lo can pa sogs kyis gos dar gser dngul ja ras kyis thog drangs bdog pa dpangs bstod pa bstar/ mchod rten bla ma/ 'or dus su rgyal mtsho gun/ tshe ring tha'i ji/ dar rgyas tha'i ji/ e te ni tha'i ji rnams kyi bsngo rten rgya cher bstabs pa byang chub mchog gi rgyur —251—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)bsngos/ rgya sog gi yul nas yig bskur rten bcas gtos che ba sngar lugs ltar 'dug pa nyin grangs su spel te rtsis len pa'i bkod pa byas/ u khe res tha'i ji'i bu dka' bcu blo bzang bstan 'dzin la er te ni dar khan chos rje'i cho lo 'phags yul gyi li mas gtsos byin rten snam phrug /dpon po la phyir sang tshul gyi hung rgya dang bcas rdzong ba byas/ gangs can mkhan pos o rod nas 'khor ba'i bdog pa bstar/tshes bdun la lha sa zur khang pas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa gra tshang du ja sbyor gnyis kyi thog ster sbyin 'gyed sogs btang zhing de grol mtshams chos 'khor lha sa ba spyi tshogs kyis bu ram bzhes spro ster cha (181na〉groms mtho ba dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ bdag mo yum sras la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma phul/ byams gling mkhan po/ rong khang gsar bla ma/ gling dge slong gi tsha bo bcud 'bum rnams dang phrad cing zhal snga nas dpon dar ba'i sku skye'i gtsug phud blangs nas ming ngag dbang dpal 'byor du btags/tshes brgyad la byams khang rgyab chos skyong dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar gyis tshigs bcad brtsams shing khog par bslabs pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung zur khang pa dang dbyibs 'dra ba/ smad rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dkon cog dpon slob kyis bdog pa maṇḍal tshul du bteg nas tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing smon lam gsar rtsom gyi lung phul/ g.yon ru sku skye/ stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras/'bras spungs kyi slob dpon dge skos dbu mdzad gnyer pa/ dur bod chog thu sogs dang ngos phrad/tshes dgu nas sde pa snyun gdangs pa'i brag dmar lu gu rgyud kyi byin rlabs bskur/ tshes bcu la gra tshang yongs rdzogs la log tri'i gsar rtsom chos tshan bzhi'i lung bklags/ tshes bcu gcig la klu 'bum me rgan chos rje'i sbyin bdag dbang gi bskur ma dang khong rang gi lnga bcu ma bdun gyis gtsos pa'i gser dngul/ shel spyad/ gos yug sum cu skor/ rgya sgam/ me tog sogs rgya zog dngom che ba bstar/ nag tshang tshe skyabs spun gyis sring mo shi ba'i bsngo rten la gser zho brgya skor dang khrab kyis —252

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)thog drangs dngos po tshan che ba byung bar bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab/ shel dkar chos sde'i gra pa ngag dbang dpal skyong dang ngag (181ba)dbang phun tshogs gnyis kyis gsar rtsom phar phyin gyi rgyugs sprad/ sde pa sgem bu nas kyis bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i dkar chag che brjod smon lam/ g.yon ru sku skyes gcung 'das pa rnams kyi don du rje dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs dang 'bur sku kha yar bzhengs pa'i tshigs bcad gsum brtsams/ tshes bcu bdun la rgyal ba slob dpon ban chung gis rigs gra'i skal ba'i dkar spro dmar spro ster sbyin rgya che ba spros/tshes bcu dgur dur bod chog thu skor/ hor lha rgyal dar gyi nu bo sogs la mgon po'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bskur zhing yul dus dang bstun pa'i ster cha dpangs bstod pa byas te rang yul la bteg /rdzong mgo kha shas nas btsugs pa'i bka' 'gyur tshig brgya/ sman bla chig khri btang /nyer drug la tre bo shir la thu chos rje dang sku skye/ mang yul lo tsā ba'i dbon po/ mtsho kha nas gsar 'byor gyi mi sna kha shas rnams dang phrad/ gnam gang nas bzung drang srong chu lha'i bus dal 'gro'i dug thams cad dbyung ste yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chur bsgyur ba'i tshe nyin lnga'i bar chu blangs nad kyi dri ma bkru ba'i cho ga bstar/ slob dpon chen po'i sgrub gnas kun gyi rgyal po yar klungs shel gyi brag phug ces o rgyan he ru ga'i gnas dang mtshungs pa'i gzims phug tu mchod me sdong rkang gcig khor yug chad med du yong ba'i 'thebs su btsan thang skor nas shas bogs 'khyar pa khyon dril mkha' ru'i khal drug cu sbyar/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga la bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal por gong nas gnang sbyin stsal ba len par rten 'brel gyi stabs bsam grub (182na)pho brang du byon pa dang mjal/ 'bras spungs tsho gos chen nas bla gra rags bsdus kyis bdog pa'i skyes maṇḍal gyi tshul du bteg nas yun du 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel mdzad/ gnyal se kun pa gter kha 'og ma chos dbang gi gdung brgyud du brdzub zhig kyang snang / des yar stod kyi mchod rten nang nas sātstsha rnyed pa gter yin min 'dri ba sogs zog rdzun ci —253

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)yang byed 'dug pa ra thang 'di dwags lha sgam po dang gsal ba sgang khams kyi spo bo gsum na min pa med snyam na'ang de ni mang po slebs 'dug pas mchog dman mtha' dag grung po ma byas na mgo la g.yog par tshegs mi snang ngo / /gong gi gser yig pa gnyis/ slob dpon ngag dbang bkra shis/ 'bri gung spu lung bla ma/ zhang ston sku mdun phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ hor rgya mtsho/ a cog gi nu bo sogs dang phrad/ 'di ga'i rim gror brgyad stong pa nyis stong / 'bum rig brgya nyer lnga/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya nga gsum pa bzhi stong lnga brgya rnams bton/ tshes drug la rta tshag sprul sku/ tsha mig mkhan zur pa/ se ra theg chen gling gi dpon slob phyed sum brgya skor dang gong dkar dkon gnyer ba rnams kyis tshan grangs ring por brkyangs te so so'i lugs kyi ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ chos rje ngag dbang thub bstan/ 'dar lo rgan gzhen/ snar thang gi bla ma gnyis/ gnas gsar nas lha sa ka rna shag pa'i mag par bskyal ba'i legs skyes pa sogs dang phrad/tshes bdun la dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pa dang tsher gseb dgon pa ba gnyis kyis rang rang gi lugs kyi cho ga dang bdog pa bteg ste yun (182ba〉cu'i smon lam btab/ tshes brgyad la 'jam mgon bla ma'i gdan sa ri bo dga' ldan nas khri rin po che/ slob chung / gra pa drug cu skor gyis gos dar ja ras kyi dngos po dang bcas nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i bden tshig gi me tog 'thor bar mdzad/spyod bsdus/ lam sgron/ bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa gsum gyi lung phul/ tshes dgu la rgya nag mi sna rnams kyi zhar du bsam grub dga' ldan dang gsang sngags byang chub gling gi bla ma sogs la lha gcig bum gcig la brten pa'i grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel/ las gshin phyi sgrub/ gong steng du gsang sngags byang chub gling gra dmangs la sgrub rgya nas bshad pa'i spyan ras gzigs kha sa rsā ṇi dang skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa/ gur nas gsungs pa'i phyag rdor —254

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chada'abyung 'dul/ so sor 'brang ma/ gser gdugs can gyi 'jam dkar shes rab 'khor lo rnams kyi rjes gnang bskur/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum nang gi mgon po snying zhugs pho ba/ gsar rtsom klu gtor/ dkar cha bzhi/ mkhan chen zha lu pas mdzad pa'i 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma sogs kyi lung dang / dmigs brtse mar brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor phul/ byang chub gling pa sger la gra tshang gi tshogs 'don gyi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad nas snod bcud bde ldan ma/ rdo rje brag sprul skus mdzad pa'i rgyal kun thugs rje ma ma gtogs yongs rdzogs dang 'gro la rjes brtse ma rnams kyi lung phul/ gong (183na)gi mi sna gnyis/ 'grul sdebs kyi bla ma gsum/ gsang sngags gling gi bla ma sogs nyung bsdus la gser chos 'jam nag gi rjes gnang bskur/ tshes bcu la rgya nag gi gser yig pa 'grul sdebs dang bcas phyogs thag ring nas ched gnyer yongs pa sogs dge tshul go dgu/dge slong tshig brgya dang bzhir sdom pa phab/tshes bcu gsum gong gi mi sna gtsang la 'gro gdong ngos kyis phrad/ gong dkar chos sde'i bla ma chos 'chad/ gra rigs sum stoskor 'byor bar snga 'gros su brgyad stong pa'i gsung sgrog btsugs/ se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs ngar brgya mkhar gdung brgyud dang de'i dbu zhwa dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyi lag tu byung ba yang 'byor/tshes bcu dgur nyi lde sprul sku/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul/ gsar 'byor er khe tha'i ji spun dang phrad/rwa sgreng mkhan zur gyi gra pa rnams kyi ngor mkhan po'i brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad/ smon lam chen mor nyin grangs kyi par bkab med na'ang ring mtha' zhag bco lnga tsam yong ba'i dbang du btang nas nyin star gyi chos ra'i yol ba bla bre gdan rnams re re bzhin gsar brjes byed rtsis nged rang gi blor ma shar yang sde pas gtsor 'don mdzad song ba rnam pa gcig tu 'jig rten chos brgyad du song bas ha cang gi dgos pa mi che mod/ 'on kyang bla chen thams cad kyi ngom gcig mar song gshis gra bsgrigs 'di tsho'i thog smon lam du 'gro thub pa zhig dgos rgyu yin kyang sngon bsags rnam par smin pa'i nad —255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gcong gis zin stabs slebs ma thub/ sngar spus srang drung 'tsho bas gdugs byin pa sogs kyi gleng brjod ltar sgo du ma nas lo re nas lo re mdor (183ba)bsdus kyi tshe rgya rgyug rgyug byas pa'ang rje btsun mi las/ pha yod tsa na bu yang med/ bu yod tsa na pha yang med/ ces pa'i dper song mod gang ltar bshad ma thag pa'i yol ba bla bre gdan chas/ nged rang dang sde pa'i rta'i gsar chas rgyug chas/ rin chen rgyan cha'i dus drung 'khor rnams la gtong rgyu'i gsar chas/ rin chen rgyan cha dngos gzhi/ spyi bka' dang sgos bka'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang rig gtad rab gnas sogs kyi yo byad/ lo gsar dus rim chen mo dang gzhan yang mdos bskang tshes bcu khro rol sogs kyi spyan gzigs gar 'chams rnams kyi deb kyi 'go brjod/ sngags thang le tshan gyi rgyab yig sogs bris/nyer gcig la gra tshang gi lha sar zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi sgo nas skong bshags nyin lnga btang /nyer gnyis la sde pa lha rgya ri ba'i dpon sa yum sras/ dol dum bu chos 'khor gyi slob dpon mngon dga' rab 'byams pa/ dpon mo bsod nams tshe dbang sogs dang phrad/ rgya ri lcam gyi gtsug phud blangs shing mtshan blo bzang chos sgron du gsol/ gnyal rdzong sdod zhang mkhar nas la labs pa ltar 'tsho byed dkar po btang byung ba man ngag dang phyag len zur khyad mang tsam yong 'dug pa rnams dar mo ba nyan du bcug pa'i bdag rkyen gang legs dang bcas phyir slog /hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gnyis la gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa rnams kyis tshan grangs dang bcas tshe dpag med kyi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung mdzad thog chab nag bla ma dpon slob kyis snam phrug gis gtsos yul lugs kyi skyes dpangs mtho ba'i maṇḍal brtan sdod kyi ched du bstar/ a mdo/ 'a shur phyogs nas rta 'bul ba (184na)'byor ba'i bzhi brgya lhag bcas/ rwa sgreng mkhan po mnga' ris pas rta sga bcas bzhi bcus thog drangs dngos po gtos che ba bod kyi mkhan po zhig la gtong ba'i phyag ring por rkyong nus pa'i ster sbyin mdzad/ 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon rnams las tshan/shangs spor tog dang kong po rnying phu bla ma rnams dang phrad/ gong dkar chos ster yang dag gi sgrub mchod —256

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)mi 'dug pa 'dzugs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar skabs yig cha'i chog sgrigs kyi bskul ma byung ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i phur pa'i mngon dkyil rnying ma bka' ma'i dgongs don 'khrul med la song gshis lha kha spos kyang btub tsam yong na'ang ha cang gi rigs 'grer song dogs shing / bdag po kun rin pas mdzad pa zhig snang ba dbyar tshad pa che skabs gyo mo spungs pa'i bsil grib tsam yong shas che yang 'khon ston gong ma'i bzhed pa la chu bun gyi tshos chen po rgyab 'dug pas phugs kyi bstan rgyun la phan re'i slob dpon hūṃ kā ra'i mngon dkyil rtsa bar bzung so zur gnubs gsum gyi yig cha dang rgyab brten rnying ma'i rgyud rnams la zhib mor dpyad nas dpal yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i 'phrin las rgyud don snang byed dang dkyil chog hūṃ
