mdzad zhal lung gnyis gsar rtsom 'di res grub pa chos sde pa dpon slob la lung phul/ yig cha 'di la gsang 'dus kye rdor gnyis kyi lhad 'jug rgyu ma byung bas sa dge'i khrod du ra pho dkar po lug khyur ma 'dres dogs mi dgos par snang / rtswa sgye mo'i rang byung khrus kyi rdzing bu nas chu blangs te nyin bdun gyi bar nad ror phan re'i 'bad pa chen pos bsten pa chu tshan la nus pa med pa ga la yin kyang skye ba mang (184ba)por rtsol bas bsgrubs pa'i las ngan gyi 'bras bu 'di ha cang shugs ches pas de la stobs bzhi sogs kyi sgo nas sbyong thabs shig ma byung na thabs gzhan gyis phan par dka' chod du 'dug pas/ bshags stod du/ de yang rgyun du sems ni rnam rmongs la/ /yun ring dus su nad gzhi bsten byed cing / /mdze can rkang pa lag pa chad pa la/ /thang 'ga' sman bsten pa yis ci bgyir mchis/ /zhes pa'i don du mngon/ dge slong blo bzang kun dga' smon lam gra skor gtong ba'i sngon bgrod gra tshang gi zhal 'don yongs rdzogs/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa dka' bcu blo bzang bkra shis kyi gsar rtsom mdzod/ blo bzang lhun grub kyis phar phyin/ dka' bcu blo bzang legs ldan gyis dbu ma'i rgyugs sprad/ de skabs phyogs mtha'i bgegs rigs la dmigs te tshes bcu gcig nas gra tshang gis khro rol/ ser 'bras su zhag bco lnga'i ja tshul thog gdugs dkar sher snying / zhang ston pas mo phywa brtsis nas bzlog bsgyur btang /—257—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gong gi gser yig pa gzhon pa'i ngor dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīkka dang 'dzam nag gi sgrub thabs/mnga' ris gra tshang gi slob dpon blo bzang nor bu'i ngor ma ṇi ril sgrub/ myug chos 'bor gling pa'i ngor yun 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ cha khar the yan chi'i tshab dge 'dun grags pa'i ngor ring 'tsho'i smon lam/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi gsung gis bskul nas maṇḍal 'bul tshig dang 'brel ba'i smon lam/ shes rab rgya mtshos bskul ba'i smon lam/ u chu mu chu che chen ching dbang gi 'dod pa tsam du 'bral med rjes 'dzin (185na)gyi smon lam/ ra mo che'i rten deb kyi 'go brjod/ ri rgya ba dbang rgyal rdo rjes gra tshang du zhal thang gra tshar bzhengs te phul ba'i rgyab yig dang snyan dar brgya don lnga phul ba'i kha byang / bying pa blo bzang chos ldan gyi ngor gnas brtan bcu drug la brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ shes rab bzang pos bskul pa'i bla ma blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsol 'debs/stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyi don du 'ol dga'i nang mi rnams kyis nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa bzhengs pa'i smon lam rnams brtsams/ 'a shur chos bzang / dge slong shes rab can gyis rta nyer bdun/ha sdong mgon ba/ lhun grub bkra shis/ bstan pa/ dge 'dun/ phur rtsa ngag dbang / ra khos bstan pa sogs kyi rta sga ma nyer lnga the ba'i nyis brgya dang brgyad/ rong po rab 'byams pa bstan pa grags pa/zung chu rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang dge 'dun/ mchog grub bcas pas rta nyer lnga/ da yan chos rje'i dbon po/ mdzo dge dka' bcu/ thang kha ri ja'i sang bla ma sogs kyis rta nyer bdun/ er te ni chos rjes rta zhe lnga/ bya bral rgyal mtshan can gyis rta don gcig rnams byin/ za zi'i 'khrul rtog rdzun yig sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor sos kyi nyi ring 'phul ba'i thabs su tshar gnyis 'dri ba'i rgyus yod pa sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar pa/ do dam bya sgo chos mdzad blo bzang dbang phyug /ri mo ba dbu 'bring pho brang phun tshogs/ dbu chung chos mdzad bkra shis/ dmangs nyer bzhi skor gyis byas pa'i dgos cha tsho phyag mdzod dang zhol gnyer tshang nas sprad/nyer lnga la gong gi mi sna 'grul sdebs dang bcas par thon gdong (185ba)gi bzhugs gral ster —258

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (5)cha dang gong gi zhu yig 'bul bar spos khang mkhan po rgya phrug pa dang skyid stod pa gnyis kyang 'degasartsis kyi 'bul ba sogs sprad/ sher 'phel sprul sku/ bya yul mkhan po/ ngam ring mkhan po/ chab nag gsang gling / rong dga' ldan byams pa gling / thang sag bzhi'i slob dpon/ gser tog tho yon/ sde srid lhun po rdzong pa bstang zhal rnams dang mjal phrad byas/ lhun po rdzong pa'i sras la ngag dbang tshangs par gsol/ sa lugs phyogs la 'gangs che ba'i rigs tsho gsung ngag gi grub mtha' stog pa'am rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam la brten nas dag zhing myul ba las sku skye'i srol cher mi 'dug rung 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo klu sgrub rgya mtsho sa lugs spyi dang bye brag kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po yin par klu sgrub chos kyi rgya mtshor grags pa'i sku skye byung ba mkhas grub kyi cha nas gong ma'i zhabs la thag pa ma btags kyang rtag brtan sprul sku sogs mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis dbyen bcos te nad pa sman gzhung ltar na ba ma byung / sngags pa zhig gi bur khong gi sku skye yin zer 'dir byung ba btang snyoms las bzang ngan gsal kha ma byas rung ma byung byung brdzu'i 'bag g.yor gyis bya rgod gshongs kyi khrod du bstan pa 'jig grabs byung 'phros 'dug pa shar 'brug gra rigs kha gso rten la yang shi yang log gi nad de dus phyis rang phyogs dge lugs pa la yang 'gos shing da ni sa skya par yang 'gos dogs 'dug go /mtshur phu nas zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku 'dir phebs pa'i sgo dod par phyi nang tshang ma nas khong dpon slob dbang med kyi mi 'byon ka med la bkur gzos kyi rigs cher (186na)mi dgos gleng ba sngar dpal der thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang mjal 'dzoms skabs ga me pa dbang phyug rdo rjes ldang ba tsam yang ma gnang / zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag gis bzheng ba tsam mdzad 'dug cing khong rang dpon slob nas gnang stabs bde skabs su la'ang spyan mas 'gebs kho na'i rgyun mchis pa/ gang gang ba yi las byas pa/ /'bras bu de lta nyid du smin/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin rnam pa gcig tu ma 'os rgyu mi snang rung dbang chen dbang med kyi dus dre'u rngog tsam pa'i steng du bzhugs su —259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gsol yang de ltar lags so las rtsod pa yong don ci la yod kyang yongs grags kyi bla chen la gzos ma phul na rang gi nang cha ston par ma zad nged 'phyong rgyas stag rtser bcas pa skye sa sa ma khyogs pa'i gdong khrag med pa ma nus pa'i gshis chibs bsu/ 'bri stag dang cha mtshungs pa'i bzhugs khri ldang ba gzhis len sogs dmangs kyi blor mi shong bzhin du gang rgyas bstar/ tshur gnang skyes kyang ding sang dbus gtsang du gru bzhi lam mer bzhugs pa'i bla chen rnams las khong dpon slob bkag por phebs na'ang lha chen po'i ro'i dpe ltar spyan babs mtho bar 'dug cing phar 'bul yang gzengs bstod/gsung 'phros ni chos 'jig rten gnyis ka nas cher mi gnang ba rje gong ma chos kyi dbang phyug gis lhag ma lus par bsnams tshod du mchis/ lar nas sgo yangs na mkhas pa'i tshul dang sbubs thums na grub pa'i tshul 'di bla chen tsho'i sgrib shing la nye bar mkho bas ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyi byin rlabs ngam ngam shugs kyis 'byung bar gda' 'o/ /de zhor bsam yas nas rigs 'dzin dkar po ba'i gdung brgyud kun dga' chos (186ba)dbang rgya mtsho dang phrad cing khong dpon slob zab bu lung gi zhig gsos la 'byon rtsis kyi gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje drangs 'dug pa 'jal nas byin rlabs zhus shing smon lam btab/ dkar chen kun grags pa de bsam yas la mdzad pa che ba yin na'ang ding sang gi rjes 'jug rnams zan gong chen po'i rting pa ma zhim dogs par snang / gong gi gser yig pa phal cher gyis gra tshang du tshe chog rgyas pa'i sbyin bdag byas pa mang gshis da lam yang rgyas bsdus ji lta bu yong snyam pa'i re dogs kyi ngang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i rgyu sbyor ba byams gling em chi las khyad kyis drag pa byung / mi sna rnams dang phyogs mtshungs su spos khang mkhan po/ sher 'phel sprul sku/ se ra'i slob dpon gsum/ chab nag dang gsang gling bla ma sogs la 'od zer can ma'i rjes gnang dang gsar rtsom dmigs brtse ma'i 'grel pa gnyis kyi lung bklags/ sang nyin mkhan po gnyis/ mi sna gzhon pa/ pha bong kha/ chab nag /gsang gling slob dpon gsum/ 'dar lo rgan gzhen/ lkog pa phun dbang rnams la pha dam pa lugs —260—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)kyi 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang dang / de ga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang ril sgrub gsum sgrub khang pas mdzad pa'i lung / spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang dang gsar rtsom ma ṇi ril sgrub/'jam nag sgrub thabs kyi lung bklags/ 'brog rgan 'dra'i chu tshan sde pa'i 'phrod bsten la blangs 'dug pa'i phud nas lag par phan re'i nyin gsum gyi bar lding zangs nang du brgyab/ lha chen tshangs pa'i spyan sngar zhu 'phrin spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas blang dor gyi dri smed la gra tshang gnyer pa mngags/(187na)hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig nas gra tshang gi shin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags ring bzlog pa dang bcas pa bye ba re/ ka tshal bla ma rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub kyi 'phrin lan snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa bsrings/ pa rnam mtshan sgrog mkhan po gra bcas dang myug chos gling gra tshang pa rnams kyis so sos maṇḍal gyi tshul du tshan grangs ring po brkyangs te yun du 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing sman bla sprul sku'i rjes gnang / gsar rtsom mdo chog brgyud 'debs/ gtor ma brgya rtsa mu thi la'i 'khri shing / dkar cha bzhi/ gsur bsngo/ mkhan po'i ngor ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dang maṇḍal smon lam ste drug /byams pas dam bcas pa/ shes rab bskyed pa/ stong 'gyur te gzungs phran bu rnams kyi lung phul/ tshangs pa dung thod can la spyan gzigs tsho gos chas lung bstan gsol ba'i 'phrin yig dang bcas gra tshang gnyer pa btang / rigs gra ba'i mchod gzhis rag ma ba tshos mar phyur la brten pa'i bdog pa bstar/ mnga' ris su bkra shis rtse pa can btang ba phyir 'khor ba'i zlar pu rangs bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan zer ba'i gser mdog can pa zhig dang ye shes dri med gnyis ka rgyun mang ba dang bcas 'byor ba'i gur kum gtso bor gyur pa'i ster sbyin byas/ de zhor gnas rnying sku skye/ g.yon ru sku skye/ 'brug pa phyag mdzod lha khang pa sogs dang phrad/ dpon mkha' 'gro'i snying la bdud zhugs pa'i byed ngan gyi phung zhor la brten sgar chen rgyal thang phyogs su bzhugs thebs dang bral ba'i da la'i hung (187ba)tha'i jis sog po'i mi bzang dpung bcas/ zhal dpon 'gro phan/ dar rgyas bkra shis —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)rnams gdan 'dren la mngags te dbus phyogs su phebs dgos shar ba'i lha sar phebs gdong chibs bsu dang thabs su gang rgyas ngos mchod yon gnyis dang mjal phrad zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku dang phyogs mtshungs par byung bar snang /tshes drug la po twa lar phebs nyin bkur gzos rje zhwa dmar ba dang phyogs 'dra tsam zhus/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang zhwa dmar chos dpal ye shes yan la ga rma pa'i bu chen gyi gras yin kyang rje spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pas dpal phag mo gru pa'i go sa bzung ba nas zhwa dmar nag gnyis la spang rtogs cher mi snang / rje bcu pa chos dbyings rdo rje 'di ba rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs man gyi kur lugs pa yod do cog gi bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i mkhan po brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa bstan pa'i bdag po chen por gdon mi za na'ang dbus ral dang stod hor gyi na bza' jo mo dang sras pho mo sogs 'bor grangs med pa dang chabs cig tu phebs par mi gus pa'i bsam pa can rnams kyang blo 'gyur ba byung 'phros 'dug pa/ 'dag ma rdo bsregs mtshon gyi char pa dag /deng nas bzung ste me tog char par gyur/ /zhes pa'i don nam snying rje gyen la skyes pa yin cha ma 'tshal/ gnang skyes ni chos rje sgar pa'i brtul zhugs kyis shin tu dpangasamatho/ dril yug la phyag 'dar 'dar sil sil mdzad mkhan rnams dang ma 'dra/ gsol ja'i thog (188na〉spyo ngal mi ngal bas mtshon skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar dang mthun pa'i dri ba zhus kyang drung rams pas lan phul gsungs song ba bzhin 'phros gleng mang du byung / lha tho tho ri'i phyag tu dpang skong phyag rgya pa babs na'ang rgyal po sku tshe ring ba sogs kyi rten 'brel las bshad nyan med pas bstan pa'i go mi chod pa ltar rnying ma ba'i sa chos rdo chos kyis chos kyi go mi chod pa'i zur za mang du gleng ba kho rang dpon slob tsho la rmongs dad byed mkhan rnams kyis phyag 'tshal gyi mgo la rdo rje 'dug /rgyal ba ga me pa'i phyag gis nged kyi phyogs su spos phor 'degs pa'i mi chos mkhas shing sku na phra mo nas dbus gtsang gi sde pa'i bla ma mtha' dag dang thugs 'dris pa'i phra lag sbom gsum gyi gnang sgo gzhan dang —262

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)mi 'dra bar mchis/ rje ga rma pa'i sku skye lung zin yongs su grags pa dad pa'i yul yin par ma zad gsang sngags pa rnams snang ba thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du 'khyer ba 'di gnad zab pas skur zhus byed mi kha yar 'dug kyang rang ngos log lta ye ma shor ba byas/ phyags phyir dpa' bo dang rtse lha snang sku skye sogs kyis phrad rten gyi dngos po spel/ dpon slob tshang mar gzhis len/ 'bul ba dang skyes len gyis mtshon gang la gang 'tsham bskrun/ 'bras spungs shag skor ba/ kong po chab nag dga' ldan/ gong ra nges rdor gling pa/ ra ba stod pa rnams kyi bla ma/ khal kha'i mi sna gsar 'byor mang ba la ja gral thog phrad/tshes drug la mtsho sngon mo'i gzhis ma rin cen dbon po/ blo bzang legs ldan (188ba)sogs bsnyen rdzogs gya drug /dge tshul drug rnams bsgrubs/ rgyal grong stag rtse phyogs bzhi bla mas rta nyer lnga/ chu bzang sku skye dang zhang ston sgar pas rta nyi shu re/ zung chu sog po'i rab 'byams pa chos rgya mtsho/rab 'byams pa chos grags can lngas rta zhe bzhi/ pā ras grags pa shes rab can gyis rta drug cu/ a mdo dar khan chos rje/ rgyal srong dka' bcu chos grags can gyis rta nyer bzhi rnams byin/ rwa sgreng mkhan zur pa'i tshong pa rjes res tsho slebs pas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su ming btags pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten la ster cha dang mang 'gyed spams mtho bar snang / de nub nas nyin gsum gyi bar bcad rgya bgyis/ blo gsal gling gi tshogs khro dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis gsar du blug pa'i kha byang /'bri lung pa blo bzang dpal 'byor gyi ngor smon lam/ blo bzang chos 'phel gyis bskul ba'i dga' ldan thos bsam gling slob dpon dge 'dun don grub kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs/ bkra shis chos 'phel gyi ngor bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la bstod pa/ sde pas thugs khur bzhes nas sku dang gsung gi rten gtsug lag khang gser tog sogs dang rin chen rgyan chas mtshon lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i bzo bkod bgyis pa'i rgyu song deb kyi 'go brjod rnams bris/tshes bcu la zhing skyong shi ral thu co ba yer pa chos rje rin chen 'byung gnas/ co ne shi ral thu/ nang —263—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)so sde bdag sogs kyis dngul dang shel las grub pa'i spyad pa/ ja gos dar rtas gtsos pa'i dngos (189na)po ring por brkyangs te bteg par bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ khal kha g.yon ru dar khan hung tha'i ji'i dge rtsar gser dngul gos dar dngos gtsang zhing gtos che ba bstar ba la kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang mtshungs pa'i rgyas 'debs yang dag byas shing mer gan khung tha'i ji'i mi sna bsam yas pa zung du bla ma can dang phrad/tshes bcu phyi mar drung 'khor spyi tshogs nas bdog pa'i tshan grangs tshogs 'gyed dpangs bstod pa'i yon sbyar te gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi cho gar brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bstar/ chu bo ri nas mkhan chen khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po snyun las rnam par grol nas phebs pa dang mjal zhing re zhig rdzong du bzhugs/ rwa sgreng mkhan zur gyi gra pa rnams kyis bskul ngor nged rang dang mkhan po'i brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad brtsams/ mkhan rin po che'i sku'i gegs sel du byad 'grol/chu bzlog /kha 'bar ma dkar mo'i 'chi blu gsum bgyis/tshes bcu gsum la khal kha g.yon ru'i dur gyi chi'i bla ma no mon khan/ shes rab dar khan bla ma/sa sbug rab 'byams pa/ tshe brtan dur khi'i bsngo rten/ ja sang dge tshul rnams kyis rgya sog gi spyad dngom che ba dang / gser kha 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i sku skye/ mdo sngags rab mas gnyis kyi dbon po can gyis gser sil ma phyur bur spungs pa'i phyag rten/ dung dkar sku skye sogs mang ba dang phrad/rwa sgreng mkhan zur gra bcas/ zhing skyong shi ral thu/ sgo mang / chab nag (15bsnya thang gsum gyi slob dpon pas gtsos brgyad cu skor la sher phyin yi ge gcig ma/ 'da' kha ye shes/ rnam 'joms bzang spyod/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal rtogs pa dang bcas pa/ 'od zer can ma'i gzungs/ gza' yum/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ phyogs bcu mun sel/ bkra shis brtsegs pa/ bkra shis don grub pa/ rdo rje mchu/ gnam lcags mchu/ 'phags pa lcags mchu/ lcags mchu nag po/ nor rgyun ma/ de'i gzungs/ lo ma rgyan ma/ tshogs bdag gi snying po/ sgrol mas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ sa paṇa gyis—264

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)mdzad pa'i a ra pa tsa na dang gsar rtsom nas sgrol ljang gi sgrub thabs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgos dpa' sum brtsegs/ sprul sku blo bzang ye shes kyi brtan bzhugs/ dpal lha lcog tu gtong ba'i bskang ba'i cho ga don gnyis lhun grub/ zhang blon gyi gtor 'bul le tshan/ rgyal gsol rgyal kun mkhyen brtse ma/bse khrab pa'i gtor bsngo/ dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīkka tshig don rab gsal/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/rwa sgreng mkhan zur gyi brtan bzhugs/ dzam dkar gyi sgrub thabs rnams kyi lung bklags/ rwa sgreng mkhan zur pa da cha bod du ri khrod lta bu byas chog pa dgos tshul zer ba byes su chas bzhin pa'i mgyogs thon stabs nas khal kha o rod kyi gzhung la phan re'i skyes lan sogs rgyas par bgyis pa'i rdzong bda' byas shing shi ral thu no mon khan gyi cho lo btags/ gra nas gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po pheb tha /tshes bco lngar khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po/ gter (190na〉ston rigs 'dzin chen po mched/kong po rnying phu sku skye rnams la nyang gi drag po rdo rje spyi blugs dang tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi dbang dang thang lha'i rigs gtad phul/ sang nyin mkhan rin po cher sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i lung phyag len dang drag po'i sbyin sreg mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan gyi lung zhus/ snga dro khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos dngos 'byor gyi bdog pa mtshon byed dang gtso bor lha sngags ye shes kyis tshe mtha' yas pa'i cho ga la brten nas nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten 'brel mdzad/ phyi dro klu 'bum chos rje/ tshal dbus gling zur pa/ 'phyos pa rab 'byams pa/ khro phu bla ma rig byed smra ba ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ mgron gnyer dar dar o rod nas 'khor ba'i sdebs su yongs pa se chen rgyal po'i mi sna dge legs dge slong / dga' ldan khung tha'i ri'i mi sna dar go chos rje/ al dar tha'i ji'i mi sna/ khal kha u rang khang er khe'i mi sna sogs dang phrad/ sde par sme brtsegs kyi byab khrus byas/tshes bcu bdun la sde pas lha sar kong phul ba'i zhal byang dang grong smad a bar gyis se ra dang 265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gra tshang du 'dzugs rgyu'i tshigs bcad/ mchod dpon bskul nas ja mchod ljon shing phur ma dang bcas bris/ byang chub gling pa dpal rgyal mtshan gyi kun bzang thugs gter nas sngar ma thob pa yang dag gi dbang dang thugs sgrub kyi ting nge 'dzin dbang (190ba)chos skyong gi bzang gtad/tshes bcu dgu la mkha' 'gro grib sel dang gdon 'grol gyi rkyen sel gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos gnang / tshes nyi shur stag lung zhabs drung ngag gi dbang pos smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin phul/ 'di nyin nas bzung dri za'i rgyal po'i sgrub pa la brten pa'i bcad rgya dam par byas shing grol gdong grong smad a bar la bka' gtad bgyis/nyer lnga la gter ston rin po che lho khar phebs rdzongs bstar/ gling me'i 'phreng ba shin tu gsal zhing dngas pa rlung bser bu tsam gyis 'gul bskyod med pa byung / lo dus kyi rim gror dbus gtsang ris med kyi dgon adhi gnyis pa yan la mang ja bsngo rten deb gsal dang 'gyed a ṅgi dang por gzhor khal gsum re/ gnyis par gnyis re'i rtsis kyi dpus cha khams dngul/ rta/ khom bu/ brtag par shar pa'i sde pa'i rim gror 'phar ma mang ja re/ bod khams spyi'i bde thabs la rdzong mgo rnams nas dgra lha dpangs bstod/ sme brtsegs dang rnam 'joms gang rung gi khrus gsol byas/grong smad nas ho me zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la dngos po'i tshan grangs dang tsho gos yon gzengasabastod de gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi cho ga rgyas par mdzad cing zhal 'don du snod bcud bde ldan ma btsugs/ de nub nas bzung slar yang bcad brgya dam du byas/ tshes brgyad nas sde pa gnyen tshad kyis snyung bar byang ngos nas yab sras/ dar mo ba gsum gyis bltas par thog mar mthun grub kyi nad 'di yin zhes kha dmar 'dogs dka' ba'i ngang nas (191na)bkru sman ma nus pa dang lha 'dre'i 'khu ldog gi rnam pa 'dom pa lta bus shin tu nyen che ba byung bar 'di ga nas byin rten dud rdzas kyis gtsos srung ba nan tan du byas shing gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po ched du gdan drangs pa'i mtshan bcas mtshan med srung 'khor sku rim dang dar mo bas snyan snyan mdzes mdzes kyi sman du ma song —266

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadaba'i bdud rtsi bum pa sogs kyi man ngag la brten pa'i thabs ci shes byas/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos lcags sdong ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ gter ston rin po ches 'ari blu/ gdon 'grol/ byab khrus/ phyag rdor/ gur drag /yang bzlog /rta mgrin/ log tri/ tshe dbang rnams stsal/ 'di ga'i brtag pa dang bsam yas la mo'i lung bstan zhus pa rnams phyogs gcig tu rim gro la yar klungs kyi skyes lha yul lha tshor gsol mchod/ dgon khag lnga bcu nga gsum la mang skol dang ya ju nyag re'i 'gyed/ lha sar sgo 'gyed dud sum cu rer ja sbag re/ lha gdong shan kha dang gdong dkar bud mtshams su cha gsum brgya rtsa re/ dgon khag nyis brgyar mang skol/ dge 'dun nyi shur khams dngul srang re btang thog sher snying / tshe gzungs gang 'gro/ rgyal du dmag zor ma dang beg tser bskang bshags stong / chos skyong spyir brgya/ gzhis rtser 'ug bya lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /rdzong gnyis kha yar 'brel mtshungs kyi chos sde nas brgyad stong pa dgu/ 'bum nga lnga/ gser 'od chig brgya/ rgyal btsan gyi mdos/ bdud kyi kha bsgyur/ phyugs lug lnga brgya brgyad cu'i srog blu/ nyes can (191ba)dong thar/ phur bzlog /dri med bshags rgyud chig brgya/ gza' yum nyis brgya don gcig /lha sa bar khang dang bsam yas su rol mo dung sogs gsol mchod bzabs rgyas/ brgyad stong pa/ bskal bzang / gser 'od gsum chig brgya re/ dkon brtsegs dang phal chen nyis brgya brgyad cu re/ mdo mang tshar bdun/ lha sar sgo 'gyed nasagazhor khal re/ dpal lha lcog tu nyin bdun gyi bar gsol mchod go mtshon spyan gzigs gang rgyas/bar khang / bya rung lcog /dbu bzhi shag /byams khang rgyab/ 'bras spungs/ se ra/ dga' ldan/gnas chung lcog rnams su bskang gso gsol mchod/ rgyud stod smad du mgon chos kyi bskang gso/ gra tshang nas brgya bzhi/ tshe gzungs sa ya/ tshe chog khag bcu gcig / mchod rten sum cur cod pan dang sku dkar/ lha khang rnying pa mchod pa dkon pa bcu la mchod pa sna lnga re/ sprang ston rnams byas pas bde bskyed shin tu che ba'i gzhi med du song / 'di ga'i rim gror dgon khag che ba lo grangs la mang skol thog dge 'dun bcur rgya dngul srang re'i rtsis bsdoms par srang chig stong nyis brgya drug cu/ ser —267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'bras so sor rdza tshul bco lngar gdugs dkar chig 'bum brgyad khri/sher snying dgu khri song ba'i yon du 'gyed gser zho brgyad brgya bzhi bcu/rdzong gnyis tshang ma nas mchod rten la zhig gsos dang sku dkar cod pan mang ba/sprang ston rgya gang che/lha sar sprang po bdun cu skor la thug pa rtsam mkha' ru'i khal lnga bcu/so khrug chung khog brgya dang brgyad cu/snam 'dom nyis stong chig brgya 192na sgoms bstar/tshes dgur 'dam nas bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po sras yum blon 'bangs gnyug mar gnas pa'i sog po brgya phrag du mas bskor ba dang /o rod nas gsar 'byor sol thon tha'i shi 'khor bcas/khun 'du len o pa shi'i sras yer khe da'i chin/rta tshag rje drung /tsha mig mkhan po/rtser slob dpon las sna ba/o rod g.yas ru g.yon ru'i mi sna sogs stong phrag lhag bcas dang mjal phrad byas shing dar dar gyis o rod nas yongs pa'i skyos ma byung /sras rin chen rtse pa lha bsangs rwa thang chen po zhig nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar ba'i sngon 'gro'i tshan grangs spel/er khe da'i chin gyis bu mtshe ma gnyis 'dug pa chos 'chol lam ji ltar byed kyang ster zer ba chos byed du bcug/tshes bcur khal kha dar khan tho yon gyi bu/nom chi hung tha'i ji/ar sa lang tho'i la'i/lha btsun gsum/paṇḍita chos rje/co ba dang dbon 'dur gyi 'tsham waṃ byed mi rnams 'byor ba'i so sos rgya zog la brten pa'i bdog pa gya nom pa bstar/spos khang mkhan zur pa pa rnam dge slong /yangs pa can mkhan po/sdings po che sprul sku/chos rje snye mdo ba/gsang phu mchod khang bla ma/lho bod kyi chings pa bzhi/zhang ston bstan rgyal gyi sras rnams dang phrad cing khal kha dar khan tho yon gyi ched du dmigs pa'i sras yon mchod kyis ster cha spangs mtho ba bteg/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos 'ol dgar sku'i 'phrod bsnyen la byon pa chab tshan sku la shin tu 'jug ngos zla shas kyi bar dpal gror gsol phogs sogs phul te sku mtshams gnang /tshes192ba〉༄ gcig la dpon mo ma ga dha bsod nams tshe dbang /yod khon gyi bu rab 'byams pa yum sras gsum/bstan 'dzin dang tshe dbang /༷ 8brtan gyi dpon mo/khal kha tho shi ye thu rgyal po'i

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)mi sna rnams dang phrad cing phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bskur/ g.yon ru jo rig thu kho sho'u chi'i bu sde skyong dgos nas ban log chog pa dgos tshul ltar sdom pa blangs pa'i khyim par bkod de ming yer te ni hung tha'i jir btags/tshes bcu dgu nas sri gnon dang yang bzlog gi sgrub khag gnyis btsugs/ mchod dpon pa dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gnyis kyi ngor rgya can gyi nang tshan rta zhal yid bzhin rgya can sgrub 'phrin dbang chog bsam don lhun grub kyi chog bsgrigs byas/ sman bla'i mdo chog 'di mnga' bdag gi sku rim la mkhan po bo dhi sa twas chog bsgrigs gnang ba nas bzung gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dar rgyas shin tu che na'ang dpal 'khor chos sde ba dang tsha mig pa sogs spyan 'dren mchod 'phreng gi rigs sna tshogs nas kha bkang ba'i kha thag ring ba gtso bor btan zhing la la dag gis gshin po rjes 'dzin gyis mtshon sngags kyi lhan thabs kyang mang du sbyar/ drung pa grags pa don grub kyis thog drangs bla ma mang pos shog ldebs bzhi lngar tshang ba'i sher snying glo ka gcig la bsdus pa'i dpe mdzad de bdag bslus gzhan bslus kyi gnas la spyor ba dang / mdo sngags kyi lugs srol 'di yin zhes ngos bzung du med pa'i snang tshul mtha' yas shing mdo brgyad brgya pa bya rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud du sngon byon gyi mkhas (193na)pa phal cher bzhed pa bzhin rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos sngags phyogs dang 'brel pa'i yig cha mdzad pa ltar lag tu lon na ma legs pa ma yin kyang rigs gsum spyi'i dbang thob pa nyung gshis gsang sngags 'jol nyog tu spyod pa las mkhan po'i dgongs pa'ang mdo lugs gtso che zhing rig pa'i gnas thams cad la 'brul pa'i dri ma tsam yang spangs pa stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi yig cha mthong ba sogs la brten rang nyid 'dri ba'i 'dun pa yod par ma zad don gnyer can du mas bskul ba la brten nas chog sgrigs yid bzhin dbang rgyas brtsams pa 'dis sman bla'i mdo chog gi srol gnyis pa zhig gsar du phye'am snyam/ jo bo rin po che'i bzhugs khri grub par nye bas dkar chag bris/ 269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi gra pa nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzod rtsa 'grel dang blo bzang mang thos kyis dbu ma rtsa 'grel gnyis kyi rgyugs sprad/ rgyal ba ga rma pa yum sras rnams kyi gsol skal du sgrags rgyal grong / zha ldan gzhis ka them 'dzin nga brgyad/ lag 'bab nyis stong drug brgya bco lnga/ rta dpon rnam 'joms kyi skyor lung gzims khang gong gi sa tshab dang sa snon sbrags par dngos gzhi shar pas 'dzin shul gzhis/them 'dzin bcu gsum/ lag 'bab chig stong brgyad brgya nyi shu/ 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po rgya bod kyi yig ris dang rtsis sogs lag g.yog tu 'gyur ba byung bas sgrub rten du lcang gling pa'i 'dzin shul khang pa le tshan/ them 'dzin phyed brgyad/ lag 'bab chig stong chig brgya so bzhi rnams sprad/hor (193ba)zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la tsha mig spyi sos bskul ba'i ja mchod pad rā ga mdangs 'phrog ma/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i nyal sgom gyi dmigs rten rgyab yig /dge slong phun tsho gos rgya mtsho/ dge slong yon tan dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gsum gyis dkon gnyer las thog byas skabs zhal thang bco lnga'i tsandan gyi tog dang gong gsham zhig gsos mdzo sna a lung dang bcas pa/ sna pā la gnyis kyi nang sha dang kha gcod la dngul srang bco brgyad/ gtor slang gcig /lcags sder gsum/ ting chung gsum/ pad sder gnyis/ 'jon dmar gyi ya mgu ma mgu/ dkar rtsis/dmar rtsi/ nag rtsi gsum bzhu ba'i zangs snod kha gcod dang bcas pa/ kro le ma nyi shur bzos pa'i me slang / zangs kyi sgron skyogs bzhi/ sgron skam gsum/ zangs rkyan gcig /li dang lcags kyi me long legasapa gnyis/ rnga gdan bcu/ zangs kyi phung phor stegs bcas/ gi gu shel gyi phud phor nang sha /lcags kong drug /rnam rgyal 'joms kyi bum stan/ rnam rgyal ma'i stegs bu dang mdun cog gsum/ dung chen cha dang rgya gling cha'i shubs/ spos mdong cha/ spos gzheng cha/ sgo lcags dgu/ rgyun rnams kyi pags pa gsar brjes/ sgom gril tshas ja lung sogs nyer mkho mang du bzos shing rnying pa'i zhig gsos kyis mtshon pa'i 'jog las sna ba g.yin las dpangs mtho ba bgyis dus bla ma gsang 'dus dang bka' —270—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil thang bzhengs tshe dgos tshul ltar rgyab yig smon lam/ rdo dgon pa blo bzang don (194na)ldan zhal thang kha yar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig rnams brtsams/'di ga'i rim gror rdzong gzhis kha shas kyi chos sde 'brel mtshungs su bka' 'gyur nyis brgya/dkon brtsegs/ phal chen gyis gtsos mdo mang brgya/ sman bla chig 'bum/ chos 'khor rgyal tsho gos chen du ja tshul sum cu'i thog smon lam rnam gsum 'gro gang che/ dmag zor ma dang beg tse'i bskang ba khri/gur zhal dang mthil mgon khang gi chos skyong spyir stong / chos 'byung steng gi chos skyong byings la brgya/dbus gtsang gi dgon adhi gnyis pa yan gyi dbus khog la dge 'dun bco lngar rgya dngul srang re/ gtsang du nyi shu rer srang re btang ba'i khyon bsdoms sum stong lnga brgya/ lha sar phyugs lug sum brgya nyer brgyad kyi srog blu sogs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong ched du gang rgyas bsgrubs/tshes bcu gcig la rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul sku rin po ches gtsos e waṃ lcog sgar ba'i gra pa bzhi bcu skor la chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyi zab gter yang zab rdo rje gro lod kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs phul zhing de zhor grong smad a bar la yang bskur/ tshes bcu gnyis la rdo rje brag pa dpon slob kyis dgongs 'dus lugs kyi mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog dang lug gzugs la brten pa'i 'chi blu/ khri srong yon tan gyi rnam sprul chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gter gsar 'chi med sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas 'chi bdag gi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshe'i rten 'brel mdzad pa'i sngon 'gror zang zing gi (194ba)dngos po yang ring du brkyangs/rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi lung bstan du/ padma'i yang sprul rgod kyi ldem phru yis/ /'dzam gling rgyal brgyud bde ba'i rgyal khab rtser/ /bar chod sel ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa gnang / /ces rgyal khab po ta lar rigs 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyis rten 'brel bsgrig dgos pa gsal bar byung zhing / byang gems sprul pa rgyal gyi ming can la/ /rang lo mthun pas brtan bzhugs brgya rtsa dang / /zhes pa'i ngos 'dzin yul byang chub sems dpa' zhig yin 'dug pas de 'dra'i khrod du zhugs ma dgos kyang ri bong cal —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenasgrog gis gleng ba ltar na lo snying gcig pa'i rigs kyis byas pa phan yon che bar bstan pa'i nang tshan rigs 'dzin chen po'ang dgung snying sogs nas shin tu 'grig go /sde par thang stong rgyal po'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang dpal lha'i rjes gnang bskur/ tshes bcu bzhir rtses dang lnga mchod spyi sos bskul nas nged rang dang sde pa'i brtan bzhugs/ sa dge bka' gsum la lo ba'i ja mchod rnams bris/ mchod khang du rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku nyid kyis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad pa'i dpon slob rnams kyis 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po phyag rgya zil gnon gyi drag po zor gyi sgrub pa bdun gcig mdzad/ sku rim byin chags shing zor bkra sogs legs par byung / nyer gcig la gter ston rigs 'dzin chen por phebs rdzongs rgyas par bgyis te rang gnas su thegs/ 'di lo phyogs mtha'i nad rims mched dogs dang rgya bod kyi 'dre ngan gdug pa'i cho 'phrul (195na) sna tshogs kyi 'tshub ltas byung bar nad bdag stobs 'joms dang rgyal rdzongs nyer lngar btang ba'i nad bdag stobs 'joms kyi sngon 'gror lha srin dam 'dogs shig dgos pa bong bu gzigs lpags gyon pa'i tshul gyis dpal o rgyan chen po'i chas su zhugs te che mchog padma thod 'phreng gi lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa'i sgo nas gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon cha spyi bor 'god pa'i stang ka tsam byas/dpe nang du bshad pa mtha' dag lag tu mi khel ba'i sngags pa dbu yon mang na'ang lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gdengs med bzhin du sngar phan sngags pa'i a zob byas pa thams cad tshabs su song ba rlung rta'i rgyu phyogs ni yin shas che/ jo bo shākya mu ni'i bzhugs khang rgyab yol la sman bla brgyud pa'i lha tshogs/rgya phibs stan khri rnams gser dngul las grub pa'i rgyur gser zho nyis stong dgu brgya so gnyis/ dngul srang bdun stong nyis brgya lnga bcu/ dngul chu srang chog stong bzhi brgya don bdun/ zangs bzo ma mkhar khal tshig brgya nyer dgu/ bsha' dkar nyag lnga/ ti tsha khal phyed lnga/ spos dkar khal nyi shu/ dza ti ra tshon pa/ phra rgyan gser pad bco lnga/ g.yu pad chung ba bcu gcig /gser ga gsum/ spyi g.yu gcig /mar pa'i yum bdag med pa'i bla g.yus gtsos gtsug g.yu sna tshogs bcu gsum/ g.yu rdog so brgyad/—272—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)g.yu spyang gcig /nas 'dra chig brgya re bdun/ byu ru sna tshogs chig stong nyis brgya bco lnga/ spos shel gyi rdo rje che chung gsum/ kha che sbur len spus (195ba)legs che nges drug dang sna tshogs tshig brgya bzhi/phor pa bzhi/ hor shel bdun/ tha na mu tig bcu drug /rgya mu tig bya sgong dang mtheb mgo tsam gyisagatsos sna tshogs chig stong lnga brgya go lnga/ mu ltags ma che chung bcu bzhi/ ma na ho dang g.yang ṭi'u bsdomasapha gu sna tshogs nyis brgya nga bdun/ hril mo bdun brgya nga bdun/ a lung bco lnga/ g.yang ṭi'i 'phan mgo gser gyi nyag thag gcig /mu men bcu gsum/ mchong sna tsho gos dgu bcu/ bee ḍūrla ser po gsum/pad rā ga /su ga rnyi/ na la/ ke ke sa bzhu shel/ bsgyur shel sna tshogs chig stong nyis brgya gya dgu/shel ril nyis brgya nyer bdun/ rdo ljang gnyis/ gser ljang brdungs kyi ga'u dra hril gcig /'phan mgo /pha gu/ bab gzugs/ skra rgyan/ me tog /lce le rnams kyi thog rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra rgyan chig brgya nyer gnyis/ mu tig chung bsgrigs kyi dra hril gcig /gser gyi a lung brgyad/ ga'u g.yu phra ma gcig rnams kyis spras pa sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes/ stag lung phyag mdzod pa can bzhis do dam/ bal po mkhas pa sirnyis gtsos lnga bcu/ zangs bzo dbu mdzad rnam sras sogasabacu drug zhang bzo'i do dam sger logs a dar/ dbu mdzad gnas gsar chos skyong dang rtse dga' cho me skyong / sman bla'i dpe sngags 'chang gzhis shar pha bu/ ngag dbang 'phrin las/ bris yig pa 'jam dbyangs dbang po dang ngag dbang phun tshogs/ dgos cha sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos bgyis/de yang (196na/sna sa bsam yas kyis gtsos pa'i gnas chen tsho'i rten gyi khri 'og tu mnan pa'i rigs phan yon che bar gsungs pa ltar chos rje rkan phu bas rdo rje slob dpon byas te grangs bcad kyis gshin rje rlung sgrub kyi sgo nas dgra bgegs kyi mnan pa brgyab cing mchod dpon pa mnan pa'i phyag len la yong ba char can yin par ma zad bum gter gyi rim pa rnams 'jug pa'i lag len dngos gtsang bar byas/nyer drug la khal kha nom chi hung tha'i ji spun/ 'dul ba zur pa dbon 'dur chos rje sogs sum —273—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)cu skor la skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bskur zhing dpon po gnyis la shal snam phrug gi byin rten gyis thog drangs rdzong bda' rgyas par byas/ nom chi hung tha'i ji'i gcung lha dbang gis gtsos dge tshul dang rab byung bsdoms pa bco lngar sdom pa phab/bar khams phyogs su mkha' 'gro dang sgar pa sku nyer 'brel ba sogs skye 'dod brag la shug pa'i dpes rang phyogs zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa rnams kyi bstan pa'i sku chags bdo ba'i mi srid pa srid pa lta bu rnam pa gcig tu nyi ma'i gnyen gyi brgyud dri ma med pa chos rgyal mes dbon gyi gdung la glang dar ma 'u dum btsan byung ba bzhin shes bya mtha' ma bkag pa'i dus kyi chad pa 'byung bar nye bar gtso bor dkon cog gi thugs rje dang dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs rdo rje mi bzad pa'i stengs gnas skabs su da la'i hung tha'i ji'i dpa' mdzangs brtul phod pa rta rmig gi rdul gyis nam mkha' 'geng ba lta bu'i (196brko pung chen po'i dmag dpon gyi khur gzung / dga' ldan dar rgyas/ tshe dbang rab brtan/thar pa/ er khe ji nor/ rtse chen tha'i ji/ bstan 'dzin/ gnyer pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor te bar khams kyi lte bar 'byor ba tsam gyis pha rol ma rungs pa'i mi mthun phyogs kyi ngan dgra mtha' dag nags me rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin mthun pa'i g.yang du khugs nas dregs ldan thams cad gdong pa smad de rang zhabs su 'dus/shar phyogs kyi 'dzin ma'i mthar thug pa 'jam dar yug gcig la btang ste dpung chen mtsho sngon phyogs la log nas dpon g.yog rags bsdus su 'byor ba'i nyer bdun gyi nyin ngos phrad dang ser byes kyi gter phur byin can du grags pa'i byin rlabs bzabs rgyas byas/ stag lung chos rjes glog rgyab par 'brug yong tshul las ma byung bas sgra mi snyan du song gsungs pa'i mched zla'i mo phywa rtsis bsdur la rgyu thugs dam med par 'bras bu brtag pa'i grags skam la brten rgyal po bteg nas phyir ma 'byor bar dge skyon yod med dri bar btang byung ba la sku rim dmigs bsal rnams mdzad rjes tsho ba bdun gyi gzhung bstan la skyon mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan med par yid brtan mdzad de/ khal kha g.yon —274

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)ru'i rgyal po thu she ye thu/ rgyal mo/ sras tha'i ji/ tha bu nad ja'i sang / bla ma ser mo ba'i rigs skya ser gtos che ba'i 'grul pas nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal khur du lci ba 'byor ba'i dpon g.yog nyung bsdus dang mjal te lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i mol mchid rgyas par byung / sde srid sna dkar rtse ba'i (197na sko khas drung gzhung zil gnon dbang rgyal rdo rje thugs blo chos su gzhol ba'i chos sde 'dzugs pas mtshon rnam dkar gyi dge ba rgya che ba chos zab dang bdud zab kyi dpe bzhin sku gcong gis zin pa'i 'phrod bsten la rgan 'drar phebs pa snyun ro rnying pa dang chab bsags 'doms nas sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi rten 'byor don ltar bzhed pa 'grub pa'i bsngo smon ci nus su byas shing dgongs rdzogs thebs kyi 'bul ba gtos mi chung ba bstar/chu byi lo ngos phebs sde pas dri ba mdzad par zur sras med gsungs 'dug pas zhal ma bzhugs pa'i rjes su gdung brgyud spang sha rdol ba lta bu 'ong don mi 'dug gshis zhu ba'i lce chad 'dug na'ang sras yod zer ba phyags phyi rnams kyis dag pa btan rjes rtse stag rang 'jags kyi bka' gros la mthun 'gyur byas par rjes su yi rang dgos rgyu yin na'ang khyung po do bzhes pa sogs kyis 'gro khar skyos ma'i yang nyan byung ba 'dra/ phur sgrubs rim gro rnams kyang dus thog btang / sde pa da la'i khung tha'i ji thog mar byon pa'i dga' ston dang bcas mchod yon gsum ga gdan 'dzom yang de nyin bzhugs gral yun rings pa'i grang ngad kyis bskyed pa lta bu'i srin nad kyi ro ma 'phar ba'i po ta lar 'phrod bsnyen las bzhugs gral la 'byon ma thub/ khal kha dang o rod rgyal po'i mjal phrad shar bar khal kha ni gnam ching gir gyi brgyud las chad pa sogs sngar gyi sog po'i go babs kyi rgyu mtshan gleng / o rod ni bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos dbus (197ba)gtsang khams gsum dbang du bsdus pa'i rgyal sar gang yod srong btsan sgam po'i khri gnon mkhan yin pa'i sgrub byed sna tshogs 'dug pa bstan gzhud gi rgyun la phan tshun lugs legs gal che ba'i gshis gsed bkrol btang ba'i babs 'brel dang mtshungs pa'i mjal lugs stan gyi mtho dma' sogs phan tshun thams cad re khon mi yong —275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba'i rnga'i5'a bsgrigs/dgung lo nga brgyad par rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung dang / lugs zung gi blang dor mu thi la'i 'khri shing mdzad cing 'bras spungs mchod khang chen mor bka' 'gyur sogs rten mchod gsar bsgrigs gnang ba bcas kyi skor/shing stag gnam lo gsar tshes kyi srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa dang nyin dang po khal kha o rod kyi rgyal brgyud blon 'bangs gtso bor gyur pa/ nyin gnyis par sog po rags bsdus dang rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ sde pa lhun po rdzong pa/ lha bya/ skyid shod khag /dbus gtsang gi nang so rnam pa drag gras sogs rin chen rgyan cha rang chas pa nyer bdun/ gzhung gi lnga bcu bcas chos bzang lha'i bdun sa ltar brjid chags pa/ nyin gsum par rgyud stod pa ser 'bras sogs gnyug mar gnas pa'i mkhan slob/ dbon chos mdzad/ las sna ba/ sgar gra tshang bla ma/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa yongs rdzogs la dga' ston rgya cher spel/ 'dar lo dang rnam gling paṇa chen gnyis kyis bkra shis pa'i tshig sngon du 'gro ba'i 'bel gtam rgyas par bstar/tshes bzhi la nom chi tha'i ji spun 'gro gdong du'ang ster cha'i tshan grangs bzabs/ gzer chen pa rnam rgyal tshe ring sogs bsnyen rdzogs nyer bdun dang dge tshul bcu gnyis bsgrubs/ lha mdongs lo tsā ba'i dbon brgyud tha ma grongs pa'i bsngo rten du sgra snyan gtso bor gyur pa'i dpe cha dngos gtsang zhing gtos che (198na)ba 'byor/ sngar rig gnas kyi slob gnyer byed skabs dpe tshan re re tsam la'ang thabs du ma'i sgo nas blu dgos pa'i bal po gser mthong kho na yong / ding sang thos bsam gang yang —276

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)mi nus pa'i so gsod lkog nyal bgyid dus dpe cha 'bad med lhun grub 'di ni 'jig rten gyi byed pos khyod la 'di 'dra e mkhos zer ba 'dra zhig 'dug rung tshe rabs gzhan du da lam lugs la ma song ba'i mi khom pa'i gnas dang bral ba'i rten thob nas thos bsam byar yod pa'i rten 'brel lta bu e yin snyam pa'i rjes su yi rang ba byung /tshes lngar rtses dang lnga mchod pa spyi sos bdog pa rgyas pa bteg nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs shing las chen pa gzhon pas ring du gnas dgos tshul lung rigs nas drangs pa'i legs par bshad/ khong rang rnams kyis bskul ba'i gsar rtsom le tshan gyi lung bklags/ dga' ldan khri rin che la ngos kyis mjal nyid phyag drug pa'i bka' bsgo bar chad kun sel phul/ sde pa'ang snyun las grol ba'i tshes brgyad la lha sar skya rags kyi mgon du 'byon thub pa byung /tshes bcu bzhir shar phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me dwags po gra tshang pa dpon slob bzhi brgya skor gyis gser dang ther ma sogs bdog pa dpangs mtho ba'i maṇḍal bteg nas yun du 'tsho ba'i smon lam mdzad/ gnas brtan bcu drug la brten pa'i bden tshig gi tshe 'phags pa'i gnas brtan 'khor bcas mngon sum du mdun gyi nam mkhar byon yod dam snyam pa'i byin chags pa zhig snang / khal kha rgyal pos lha sar (198ba〉ying dgos tshul byung yang lus kyis ma lcogs pa'i 'di ga'i tshoms chen du kha btags gos phyi nang gser dngul ja rta sogs khri 'bul gyi dngos po dngom che ba/ rjes 'brang gi ser mo ba tha'i ji mi bzang thams cad kyis kyang ji ltar rigs pa'i tshan grangs phyur bur spungs pa dge ba byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngos shing sog bod bsdoms pa'i nyis stong lhag tsam gyis mgor lag pa'i 'degs 'jog bla chen tsho'i mdzad pa'i gtso bo de byas pas mi kun la byin rlabs ji ltar byung yod kyang nyi ma phyi mor song ste dgu tshigs la phaṭa yin nges thengs shig brgyab/ gter ston chos kyi rgyal po nyi zla 'od zer gyis rang gter rnams la 'chad rtsom gso ba sogs gyis shig pa'i 'khrul snang 'dra byung ba rgyun du ma rig pas 'khrul bzhin du nying 'khrul gyi rigs la yid brtan de bas ga la yod/—277—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khena'on kyang rang blo rang la lkog tu ma gyur pa gang yin drang por bshad pa'i dma' sa bzung na dman par brtsi/ ma byung byung dang ma mthong mthong gi o zob byas na skyes bu dam par 'gro bar tshegs mi 'dug gshis nying 'brul la tshad mar bzung ba'i kha pho'i do ger dang bcas rdzogs chen la mos pa'i blo can dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang g.yu thog snying thig pa dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags gnyis kyis bskul bas mtshams sbyar te rang nor rang gis spyod pa'i tshul gyis 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi khrid gzhung shin tu rgyas pa rigs 'dzin zhal lung bris/ sngar byang chub lam rim gyi khrid rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i dgongs par 'gro khul de brtsams pas dge (199na)lugs pa'i gral du chud po rang ma byung / da cha rnying ma ba'i gral du mi chud nges pa nas zab mo slob bshad pa'i gral du dogs 'tshangs byed dgos pa 'dra/ dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi phyi rten yum chen mo'i stong thang gi rgyab yig /zur mangs chos rje dang sku skye blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsum/ rtses dang las chen pa blo bzang chos grags kyi ngor bdag bstod/ khal kha sku skye blo bzang 'phrin las kyis bskul ba'i 'jam dbyangs sprul sku dang thu she ye thu rgyal po gnyis kyi brtan bzhugs/ paṇḍita er ta ni tha'i ji dang bi lig thu ja'i sang gnyis/ gu ye dar khan nang so/ bre pa bla chen chos rgyal rdo rje/ thos bsam dar rgyas gling spyi so rnams kyis bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad re rnams bris/nyer gsum nas bdun gcig gi bar phyi nang gi don bgegs 'byung po'i gnyen por rdo rje gro lod/yang gsang drag po/ gshin rje dregs 'joms/ tshe dpag med dngas ma bcud 'dren bzhi'i sgrub khag btsugs/ jo bo shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar sgo mangs bde yangs dril ba brgyas zhag brgyad kyi bar spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ kun tu bzang po'i smon lam nyi khri nyis stong bzhi brgya/ lhung bshags nyi khri bzhi stong / lha sar phyugs lug sum brgya'i srog blu/ yer par swatstsha chig 'bum tshig khri chig stong lnga brgya/dga' ldan gsang sngags gling du gshin rje 'dus pa'i drag sngags bzlog bcas bye ba gnyis rnams kyi —278—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (5)tshogs gsog bgyis/nyer lnga nas 'ol dga'i chu tshan nyin gsum (199ba)gyi ring yan lag la phan re'i bsten/ nyer bdun la zhang tsha dkon cog rnam rgyal glo bur du 'das pa'i gos sna sogs bsngo rten mang bar rgyas 'debs dang dge 'thud byas/ sngar brag sna chos rjes bskul ba'i tshe bdag gi las byang shin tu bsdus pa de gra tshang la stabs 'gros su btsugs pa gang sa nas yin mdog kha ba ma byung ba shing bya rdo rje brag gi phyag len sgra ji bzhin pa e yong snyam pa'i las byang la bcos rgyag pa'i 'go btsugs tshe ārla pa lo'i gling gi klus lha 'dre gzhan rnams sbran nas bsam yas nyin mo brtsigs pa mtshan mo bshig pa'i dpe ltar dge bshes dge dar bas kho rang phyag len dka' las chen po byed dgos byung dogs pa khongs su bcug pa'i 'phral thugs rtsom las gnangs che ba mi yong yang rong pa sku mdun gyi rang 'dod khar 'tshangs kyi bcos brgyab bo skad drag zhan tshang ma'i sar ri bsgul mtsho skyoms byas par brten sngar gyi de las don spyi dod tsam las bzo bskyar tshang ba ma thub/ de rjes kha skong 'dra rim gyis byas rung blo kha rdzogs pa zhig ma byung ba 'di dus zhib cha'i phyag len rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog nyid la dogs bcad/ las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ zor las gnam lcags thog mda'/ sngon 'gro'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal/ reg zig zhib mo rnam dag bzhi gsar du bsgrigs te gra tshang du tshugs pa bsgugs yun ring na yi dam gyi lha dang mjal ba'i dper song /hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la sde pa thon pas ster cha tshogs 'gyed kyi yon sbyar nas gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog btang / tshes bzhi la da la'i (200na skos tha'i jir 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa bskur ba'i yon du gser srang brgyar nye ba byin/ dpon chung mi bzang sum cu skor la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel/ khal kha rgyal blon rags bsdus la sgrol dkar tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo dang chag lugs tshe dpag med kyi tshe dbang rnams phul/ stag rtse yab sras/ sog dmangs gtos che ba sogs dang phrad/—279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenatshes bdun la mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis gos sna cha tshang gos yug bcu drug dar yug nyi shu rtsa gsum gyis thog drangs pa'i dgu tshan bcu drug gi ster sbyin gra rkyang la bltos pa'i spams mtho ba dang tshogs chas 'gyed le tshan lnga sogs kyi yon sbyar nas 'chi med 'od snang la brten pa'i tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing gra tshang la sbug chol legs pa'i spyi 'bul byas/ tshes bcu la khal kha rgyal po/ rgyal mo/ sras/ blon 'bangs dang bcas pa/ rta tshag rje drung / rgyud stod slob dpon sogs la thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi rjes gnang dang tshe dbang grub rgyal ma rnams phul/ mnga' bdag smra bo lcog pas nyang rin po ches lho brag mkho mthing lha khang nas gdan drangs pa'i a tham ma'i snod khyad 'phags kyi rten dang bcas smra bo lcog mchod khang gi steng du gañdzi ra 'dzugs rgyur mthun rkyen dgos tshul byung ba ltar gser zho bzhi bcu tham pa bsrings/ sun hung tha'i ji'i sras dang er te ni phyag mdzod pa gnyis kyis rgyal khang rtse'i sku skye'i dgongs rdzogs kyi dngos po dpangs (200ba)mtho ba dang o rod dpon rgyud ma las kyi bsngo rten byung ba ltar byang chub mchog gi rgyur rgyas btab/ rnam sras gling nas gzhon pa chos la blo gzhol pa'i 'bor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod bzhin dge tshul gyi dngos por bsgrubs shing ming dkon cog chos grags su btags/ khong pa gzhung lugs dang tha snyad la sbyangs stobs shin tu che ba'i 'phros gtam dang zhus dag sogs la mkho bar byung bas gzhogs su bskyil/tshes bco lnga la khal kha rgyal po sras yum sogs nyi shu rtsa lnga dang rta tshag rje drung / mang ra mkhan po/pha bong kha pa'i gdan sa pa/ g.yon ru sku skye/ khal kha sku skye/ sa spungs blo gsal gling / bde yang sapa/ sngags pa gsum gyi slob dpon pas thog drangs dbang cha gnyis la dze tā ri lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang phul/ de khrod nas 'gro don skyong bzhin pa 'gas dkyil 'khor la me tog 'dor ba sogs kyi don spyi ma dod snang ba gzhan la dbang bskur dus ji ltar mdzad ni ma shes/ 'dul ba zur pa dbon 'dur khal kha nas 'khor ba'i no mon e jen gyi bu tsha brgyud —280

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadakyi don skor ras chung pa'i mdze la lan de bcu gsum gyi dpe ltar don smin cher ma byung 'dug /khal kha rgyal po rang gi 'di ga'i yi ge bsnams nas khebs gang che byed gsung yang sngar phan ni gnas tshul ma 'byor/tshes bco lnga la khal kha rgyal po yum sras bzhi la mgon po bcu gsum ma'i nang gi mgon po tshe bdag gi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du phul zhing (201na)rgyal po dpon g.yog gi sdebs su rta tshag rje drung gis gtsos gong gi bla ma bdun/ gsang gling slob dpon/ 'dul ba zur pa/ bkra shis bde chen slob dpon/ gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas rnams la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang dang gsar rtsom mdo chog /gzhan yang lhung bshags/ sher snying / 'da' kha ye shes/ rnam 'joms/ bzang spyod bcas pa'i lung phul/ sgrags su rje ga me pa zhing 'di'i sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabasakyi bdog pa'i tshan grangs 'byor don ltar zhing khams rgya mtshor 'gro don mtha' klas mdzad pa'i bzhed pa gegs med du 'grub pa'i mchog gsum dam par gsol 'debs dang dgongs rdzogs thebs su zang zing gi dngos po rgya cher phul/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar skyes bu la la dag /tsanda dag ni 'di 'dra ste/ /spos kyi rnam pa yid 'ong zhes/ /tsanda dag gi yon tan brjod/ /de nas mi gzhan la la yis/ /de ltar bsngags pa brjod pa yi/ /tsanda cung zad bsrel tam zhes/ /skyes bu la las de dris na/ /skyes bu de la slar smras pa/ /gang gis 'tsho bar byed pa yi/ /spos kyi bsngags pa brjod pa de/ /spos de nga la med ces smra/ /zhes pa ltar rang thog tu blang dor gang yang mi yong ba'i ba sdu'i smra ba bzhin gzhan dag khrel rgyur snang yang / khal kha rgyal pos gsung gis bskul ba bzhin lugs zung blang dor mu thi la'i 'khri shing dang rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug dkon cog lhun grub kyi 'phrin lan brtsams/bkra shis ljongs cho me (201ba)rje/ skyed tshal mkhan po/ 'chad ka spyan snga/ dkar po thugs sras/ dwags po sgrom mda' ba rnams dang phrad/nyer gnyis nas dam grib la brten pa'i lag pa'i nad ro 'phar tshabs che ba langs pa'i 'phrod —281—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bsten sum dga'/ dar mo ba dang dbu mdzad mchod dpon dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum gyis nad g.yog byas/ gter ston rin po che ched du gdan drangs pa'i gdon 'grol/ nyang lugs kyi phyag rdor/ sme brtsegs kyi byab khrus/ 'chi blu rnams gnang zhing bar chad lam sel rtsa 'grel gyi lung zhus/ rim gror bka' 'gyur lnga/ sgrol ma sher snying gdugs dkar gsum chig 'bum re/ ser 'bras su ja tshul nyi shu'i thog sgrol ma sa ya drug 'bum sum khri drug stong / sher snying drug 'bum brgyad khri/ tshe gzungs bye ba bdun nyis 'bum rnams song ba'i yon gra pa rer dngul zho re 'bab rtsis kyi nyer spyad kyi gos/ rta sga 'khor sogs spong dag /sngags khang du gra pa sum cus nyin bdun dang se rar gra pa solngas nyin bdun bskang gso/ gnas chung lcog tu spyan gzigs tshogs bcas bzabs rgyas/ lha sar sog dmangs nyis stong skor la ya ju smar 'degs khal go lnga/ mar khal chig brgya dgu bcu rnams dang brtag par babs pa'i sde pa'i rim gror bskal bzang / gzungs bsdus/ gser 'od gsum brgya rtsa re/ gra tshang nas dmag zor ma dang rnam sras ser chen gyi bskang ba stong / rgyal thang phyogs su dus gzings byung ba'i sku rim la ser 'bras dge gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dge lugs (202na)dgon che kha sngags gra sum cur mang skol dang bcas pa'i gtor bzlog /bstan srid spyi rim du byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po'i brgya thang / chos rje sgrol ma bas khro rol/ zha lu pas gdugs dkar mdos chen/ngor pas 'jigs byed drug cu rnams btang /hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la nged rang gi rim gror tshe gzungs dung / bkra shis chos sde ba gra pa sum cus sgrol dkar gyi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i gzungs/ lug bya lung pas g.yul bzlog /rdo rje brag nas 'char ka /dpal ri bas khro rol/ ser 'bras su ja tshul bco lnga'i thog gdus sa dkar nyis 'bum bzhi khri/ sher snying bye ba gcig dang sa ya phyed gnyis rnams song bar se hrug sbag bzhi stong drug brgya nga gsum/ dbus gtsang gi dgon adhi gsum pa yan la mang ja/ 'gyed dbus khul gyi adhi dang por dge 'dun bcur srang re/ gnyis par bco lngar srang re/ gsum par nyi shur srang re/ gtsang —282—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)gi a ṅgi dang por cu gsum rer gser zho re/ gnyis par bco brgyad rer zho re/ gsum par nyer bzhir zho re btang ba'i khyon dngul srang sum stong brgyad brgya zhe lnga dang gser zho nyis stong bzhi brgya don gcig rnams song / gnas chen khag bcu bzhir mchod 'bul/ adhi gnyis pa yan la lo dus kyi mang ja bsngo rten deb gsal dang 'gyed a rmi dang por 'bru gshor khal phyed gnyis re/ gnyis par khal re ma'i dpus tshar rta/ lcags cha sogs/ gzhung sger chos gzhis dang bcas pa'i mi ser (202ba)byings la khyad med kyi rkang phyed yan la khal phyed gnyis ma/ sum zur dang dud chung yan la khal re ma/sprang ston btang ba rnams khyon dril ba 'bru khal chig 'bum chig khri bdun stong don bzhi/ tshwa bul khal bzhi stong bzhi brgya so brgyad dngul srang gya drug /spu ja sbag so gcig /ya ju khor drug ma don bzhi/so hrug che ba sha bubs sum stong sum brgya sum cu/ chung sha khog chig khri chig stong bzhi brgya gya gsum/ko pags bzhi stong tshig brgya don bzhi/ lha sar phyugs lug brgya'i srog blu sogs rim gro rgya gang che bsgrubs/ tshes brgyad la gra tshang nas chos skyong che chung gi bskang gso bzabs rgyas dang de 'phros nyin lnga'i bar chos skyong spyi'i bskang gso dang khyab 'jug gi gsang mdos mdzad/tshes bcu bzhir dpal grong chos mdzad ngag dbang dge legs kyis gra tshang gi zhal 'don yongs su rdzogs par shog bu lnga brgyar nye ba'i rgyugs sprad/ drung 'tsho lhag bsam dang dar mo ba gnyis kyis rtsa lto sbrags pa'i khrus btang ba 'phrod ngo shin tu che zhing mchod dpon pas nyin mtshan gnyis ka bcar sdod dang chos rje kha reg pas nyin mo'i bar gnyid bsrung ba'i rogs byas/tshes bcu bdun nas grangs bcad kyis gshin rje me'i spu gri'i sgrub pa bdun gnyis dang tshes bcu dgu nas tshogs su 'gong po ar gtad/ dmag zor ma'i gsang mdos/ chos skyong spyi'i bskang ba nyin gsum gyi bar btsugs/ nyer dgu la sgom sde nang chen gu ru dbang drag gis rta bco lnga/ bā su'i rta nyer bzhi byung / gnam (203na)gang la tshogs gsog tu 'phrul snang / rgya btab bcas par mar khal nyis brgya'i dkar me/ snyan shal kha btags nyer gsum/ dung skyong dbang mor gsol mchod bdun —283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)brgya/ lha sar sga 'gyed la ya ju khor drug ma nyer lnga/ sprang po phyed drug brgyar ston mo la rtsam mkhar ru'i khal zhe bdun/ so rnag brgya bzhi bcu/ ja khal bcu bzhi rnams btang /hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la 'di ga'i rim gror 'bras spungs su ja tshul bcu la gdugs dkar nyis 'bum/ sher snying chig 'bum sum khri bdun stong sum brgya bdun cu/ gzhan yang gra tshang chos sde'i rigs nas yum rgyas pa nyis brgya lnga bcu/ sman bla chig khri nyis stong re bzhi/ tshe gzungs bye ba drug sa ya drug /'bum phrag brgyad/ bdun khri sum stong brgyad brgya dgu bcu/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig chig 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong so gnyis/ badzra gu ru dung gnyis/ mchims phu'i gnas srung rnams dang khra 'brug chos skyong / g.ya' bzang lha mo/ srong btsan/ thang po che/ shel brag /rdzong btsan pa sogs la bskang ba brgya tshar dang sgron dar / yar lha sham por gsol mchod dang dar 'dzugs/ bsam yas/mchims phu/ khra 'brug /yum bu/ shel brag tu dkar mer mar khal chig brgya nyer gcig /snyan dar lnga bcu/ lha sar sgo 'gyed la spu ja sbag brgya bco brgyad rnams kyis phan pa bsgrubs/ snang dkar rtser phyag dpe gsar bzhengs gtos che ba yod 'dug pa phyags phyi rnams kyi brjod rigs sna dkar rtse par babs 'brel yod pa'i grub mtha' (203ba)sa lugs yin/ ding sang dge lugs mdzad na skabs su ma babs pa ci la yod rung rnying ma gnang bas shis rgyu ma byung / dpe 'di tsho lus na sras kyang thugs blo bsgyur dogs 'dug pas tshang ma bzhes dgos tshul nan zhus la brten drangs par gsar bzhengs/rnying pa gzhan gyis phul ba/ g.yar po yun ring bdag tu bzung ba sogs rnam grangs mang ba'i khrod nas rdo rje brag dang gter ston rin po cher nyer mkho'i po ti bco lnga skor re/ bkra shis chos sde ba tshor khong rang rnams kyis g.yar po'i snyan brgyud po ti/ 'di gar tshags byed 'os kha shas/ gra tshang dang drung 'khor nas dpe char shes 'dod yod pa rnams la 'dod sbyar dang gsang sngags chos gling pa rnams kyis dpe lhag byung na dgos tshul ltar ma nyung tsam dang lhag tu khams pa bdud 'dul gyi zog gter de tsho med pa sa gtsang bas phyir slog /sde pa'i sdig sbyong la dmigs te bya sa lha khang gi rnam snang —284

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasku mdun du 'di nas bzung ji srid bar bkra shis rtse chos sde nas dge 'dun bzhi sdes nyin star kun rig tshar gnyis re gtong bar mchod rdzas phogs yon sogs dpyad khra tho gzhir 'khod pa bzhin 'bru char bkug pa mkhar khal lnga brgya go dgu thob pa'i thebs su bya sa'i mchod thebs mtshan sgrog tshogs pas 'dzin bdag byed pa rnams la brje mar gzhor 'debs sprad pa'i sa ris rnying khungs thog yar mda' nye skor nas bags mnan te chag med tshugs/sa ga zla ba'i nang du ji srid bar rdo rje brag gra tshang nas phyed 'khyer gyis (204na)gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rigs 'dzin rjes 'bras mo ljongs nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang chos kyi rgyal po dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis lhang lhang brag nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe dpag med sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi cho ga zhag bdun gyi ring chag med du 'dzugs rgyu'i thebs su sgrags zha ldan gyi sa tshab tu song 'phros kyi mkhar chu nas bsdad grong them 'dzin bcu drug /lag 'bab tshig stong lnga bcu/ bsam dar nas kyis sa sprel bde gzar gyi skabs nye gnas stag lung thang pa'i rnam thar bzung nas sa ris mnga' thang thams cad badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol ba'i sto rten du sne'u sdong chibs ra dang bkra shis mthong dga'i khang pa/ lag 'debs bogs 'khyar shas bcas la drug brgya/ tshogs rgyal gling pa dka' bcu byams pa chos 'phel sngar nas gus zhabs che ba dang tshong dpon tshe 'dzin byed sems 'jug pa sogs nas byang sribs them 'dzin brgyad lag 'bab chig stong bdun brgya don drug rnams sbyor 'jags byas/tshes lngar gter ston rin po ches klu sbug tu phyag rdor dregs 'dul gyi las mtha' klu'i gta' bsdam dang gter gzhug gnang / zha lu mkhan rin po che dpal gror bzhugs pa gzims khang legs rgyu mi 'dug pa nas bzhugs yul spro khyad dang bcas lto mos su phebs pa'i snod ldan gyi tshogs la gsang chen chos kyi bdud rtsis thar pa bla na med pa'i srog 'tsho'i bcud len rgya cher stsal mod/ (204ba)rdo rje'i rna can rnams ni rang dang rigs mthun pa'i khyu chen por 'dus te shin tu mngar ba'i ro la spyod —285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)par mchis/ rgyal rtse zhabs drung byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam gsal 'debs rten rgyal ba brag phug pa'i phyag ting sogs byung bar dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i smon lam byas/'di nyid thugs dam smin ches pas mkha' spyod he ru ga'i grong khyer du gshegs par ma zad 'gro ba'i mig ngor gdung rus la rje btsun rnal 'byor ma sogs rang byon ngo mtshar can mang du byung bar snang /tshes bcu bdun la gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos mkha' 'gro grib sel dang tshes bcu dgur mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog gnang / de yang skye rgu kun la dus kyi chad pa lta bus 'jam dpal dbyangs gong ma rgyal po dang bka'i khrims kyi byed po mdun na 'don phing sing ching dbang rgyal blon thugs kyi 'dzin stangs ma gcig pa'i ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khams chen por g.yul 'khrug rlabs po che byung skabs gong nas bka' shog bka' ngag bsgyur bar mkhar sngon jo rwa'i chi bla ma/ la du rjar go chi/ gu ru bi ye chi sogs rdzong bda' gnang ba bla ma 'phan yul mdar ma 'tsho zhing rjar go chi can gyis bka' shog rten ldan sprad pa blangs shing gang ci'i gnas tshul thams cad zhib par nyan/ spyir ris su ma chad pa'i lus can mtha' dag drin can gyi pha ma sha stag yin na'ang phyogs 'dzin gyi 'ching ba 'di ha cang dam drags pas rang gzhan gyi chos pa kun jo bo bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar zin pa'i re ba ga la yod gshis/ su (205na)byams pha ma'i dpe ltar bog to rgyal po'i dus yi ge rten bzang po mi sna dang bcas mngags pa'i 'dris rgyus thog gnam gyi lha shun tsi rgyal po mang bkur gyi khri la bzhugs pa nas bzung da lta'i bar bdag rkyen bzang po tshad med pa thugs la btags/ nged rang ngos kyis gser gyi pho brang du phyin gser zhal mthong zhing lung las gnang ba sogs nas gong ma'i chab srid brtan cing rgya nag gi rgyal khams thams cad bde bar 'gyur ba'i rnam dkar dang 'brel ba'i tshogs gsog ci nus bgyis/bod gling dgu'i rgyal khams pa'i dpung gis rgya hor gyi yul du rngo thogs pa ni ga la srid sog po o rod kyi dpung gis phyin tshe dgra nus che yang rang dbang 'du dka' ba dang tshad pa dang 'brum pa sogs la 'dzem bag dgos pa'i stabs gong gi zhabs tog tu 'di 'gyur gyi khas len dka' rung —286

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanamachod yon tshang ma bka' bgros pa'i yas phyin rnams khebs gang che'i khyad nas da la'i hung tha'i ji yang mgyogs tsam 'degs pa'i bca' gzhi shar zhing / rgyal thang phyogs su mi srun pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyi rgyab rtsa ljangs sogs su yin things dka' na'ang rang thus dang thun mong gi ched du tshes nyi shur rgyal sras bkra shis la tshe dbang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bskur zhing yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji'i cho lo/ bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas dmag dpon/ dmag las par bka' brgyad nor bu/mas chags pa can rdzong bda' mdzad song /nyer gcig la (205ba)gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos dngos po'i maṇḍal dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung mdzad cing phyags phyir mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ chos rje kha rag pa bcas par mnga' bdag gi gter byon srid pa'i gter khyim dang gsar rtsom thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi 'khrid lung bklags/ ri bo bde chen spyi so'i ngor nged rang dang sde pa'i brtan bzhugs/ gra tshang gyi gra rgyun rnams kyis bskul ba'i 'di ga'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ maṇḍal gsar pa'i kha byang bi warta can/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i dmag zor ma'i bskang ba 'byer bde sogs brtsams/ rgya nag po'i rgyal khams kyi 'thab rtsod zhi zhing legs tshogs spel ba'i ched du ser 'bras su ja tshul bco lnga re dang dga' ldan du brgyad kyi thog bdud bzlog /lha sar gra tshang gis nyin bdun gyi bar khro rol rnams btang /nyer lngar gter ston rigs 'dzin chen por phebs rdzongs dang bcas rang gnas su thegs/ rgyal dbang padma'i drag po'i gnas chen zho stod gter sgrom brag gi rang byung khrus kyi rdzing bu nas chu blangs te zhag bdun gyi ring 'phrod bsten byas/ khal kha rgyal pos bdog pa'i skyes da sgo che ba dang tshogs 'gyed kyi yon sbyar ba'i hor lnga zla ba'i tshes gnyis la gra tshang nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ dpal 'khor chos sde spyi so'i ngor ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad brtsams shing khal kha rgyal sras kyis gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa mdzad/ 'ur du su'i (206na)ji nong thub pa tha'i ji byon skabs drag zhan —287—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dang mtshungs pa'i cho lo sogs tsho chen drug gi gzhung ma zhig pa'i snga dus bzang po'i srol rgyun snang ba dus kyis 'gribs nas mi 'dug pa rgyas par byed 'dod rung rgya bod hor gsum gyi drag zhan mtha' dag snyigs mar spyod pa'i shugs kyis phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du mdor bsdus gtso bor btan pa'i gshis rgyal po'i thugs la ma bstad/ lo tsā bas zer kyang rjes su byas tshe rgyal por thugs rgyus med pa'i skyon yin 'dra tshul ltar na sngar gyi dpe srol zhib mor mol na mdzad shas kha yang brda ma 'phrod pa'i skyon gyis rgyal por dad stobs ldan pa thu shi ye thu rgyal po/ sras bgres par paṇḍi ta er te ni tha'i ji/ rgyal mor pu rtso dha ra dzung shen du tshe lo tsam las/ mi bzang rnams la 'dogs ma thub/ rgyal po'i mtshan thā sun al khan lta bu btags na snyam pa shar yang yab mes kyi mtshan de ga byung na ma byung dgos gsung ba a tir phug pa de sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan thugs bcag thag drags nas pho brang 'di ga'i them mi 'da' yin bsams kyang sog yul du slebs 'dug /de nyin khor mos sogs kyi na bza' sgron pas mi mdog snal mas bsgyur ba'i dper song zhing sag thag ral gris thog drangs bdog pa tshar du dngar ba bstar/ de don dang mthun pa'i 'ja' sa'i yi ge byas/ tshur yang legs so'i tshan grangs bteg /rgyal po mgyogs tsam 'byon rtsis 'dug pa nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung / thub dbang gi sku (206bsgongs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang gnas bcu'i zhal thang gra tshar/ longs spyad pa'i rung mthun gyi gos cha tshang / shal dkar dmar/ snam phrug gtos che ba/ sgam gyi rigs/ shel dkar bu ram gyi ltang tse mang bas gtsos dngos po'i rdzong ba phyur bur spungs/ gnas rnying zhabs drung /dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan slob rags bsdus/ rtse chen chos sde'i slob gra/ rgyal rtse khul gyi drung 'khor thor bu dang bcas bdog pa'i tshan grangs 'phreng bar bsgrigs te yun 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ khal kha'i khrod nas dge bsnyen pha ma lnga phrag gcig bsgrubs/tshes bzhir bkra shis bde chen pa bla gras tshan grangs sngon du 'gro pa'i ring 'tsho'i smon lam mdzad/de dag dang ri bo chos gling pa lhan cig par dmigs brtse ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgom lung phul/—288—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)da la'i hung tha'i ji dpon g.yog sum cu skor/ rta tshag rje drung sogs la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma'i dbang /rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs/ phyag drug pa'i byin rlabs bar chad kun sel bskul/ tsha mig mkhan zur/ ser 'bras kyi las sna ba/ grangs can mkhan po/ la thog zur mkhar bas thog drangs pa'i kong po'i dpon khag kha shas/ 'ba' rdzong sdod mdzes grong pa can rnams dang phrad/ mtsho khri shog rgyal mo 'di rgya bod hor gsum gyi sa 'dus che zhing bstan jus la rgya'i 'go sdud la dpon po rgan pa zhig gal che bar ma zad rgya nag phyogs kyi nye len dang bcas mgyogs thon dgos gshis da la'i hung tha'i ji la shal snam phrug gtso bor bton pa'i rdzong bda' byas shing tha'i ji tshe (207na)dbang rab brtan la er khe da'i chin gyi cho lo dang tham ka /dpon mo'i ming po gnyer par thu shi le thu no yon dang de'i nu bo bstan 'dzin la er te ni pā thur gyi cho lo btags/tshes lngar gong nas gser yig pa la du rjar go chi/ gu ru bi chi ye chi/ sbyor rā chi bla ma'i dbon po/sbo sho kho gnyis bcas sum cu skor la spyan gzigs gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang dang bzhugs gral gyi thog da lam mgyogs 'gro'i gshis mi sna ngo bo tshor yang chas kyi ster cha shal dkar dmar/ gong du zhu yig 'bul bar khang gsar rab brtan dang 'bum thang bsod dbang gnyis btang ba'i kho pa gnyis dang gser yig pa'i g.yog rnams la dngul gyi ster sbyin/ gong du sku rim gyi rigs gang rgyas/ rgyal po'i che ba/ las sgos mtshon tshang ma rgya nag rnying ma'i dus lta bu'i spros pa gang che rten 'brel gyi stabs nas gnang dgos pa'i snyan 'bul phul/ kong po bcos mi sogs skya ser mang dag dang phrad/tshes bdun la ri bo bde chen pa gra slob nyis brgya skor gyis snam phrug gtso bor gyur ba'i bdog pa'i maṇḍal dang bcas yun 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rgyal sras sprul pa'i skus skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su bzung ba yin tshul gyi shes rab 'phel ba'i sku'i skye bar zhal gyis bzhes song zhing nged la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sngon gnas rjes dran dogs pa tsam yang med na yang mda' shor sgo 'drongs yong ba las 'os ma mchis/ da lam bla ma mchod pa'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs —289—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)yin tshul rgyas par (207ba)gsungs/ khal kha rgyal po dpon g.yog rags bsdus dang ma thon bar nyin star phrad/ rgyal rtsa mkhan po dang sa zhal bu gsum slob dpon par dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas sman bla'i phyag len zhib tu khrid/ tshes brgyad kyi shogs khal kha rgyal po dang khung tha'i ji'i sras er khe da'i chin gyis gtsos sum cu skor la yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa phab/ bar skabs su khams ma bde ba'i brtag pa'i rigs mang tsam phungs 'dug pa gnas skabs kyi gegs sel dang phyi ma mtho ris thob pa'i thabs kyi rim pa sum brgya tsam gyi gsal cha byas pas mo ston phag mgo ba yang kha skyengs nas da cha myug myug byed mdog ma kha/tshes bcu gcig gi nyin khal kha o rod kyi rgyal po gnyis hung tha'i ji sogs dpon yog rags rim la ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel gyi sgo nas dam tshig sbrel te byang phyogs kyi skye rgu'i bde skyid dang zhwa ser cod pan can gyi bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs pa'i tshul la snying stobs gcig tu dril ba'i srid sde lu gu rgyud kyis bsdams/ sang nyin dga' ston gyi tshul du sde pas khal kha o rod yongs rdzogs la sha chang gtso bor gyur pa'i ston mo btang / 'jam mgon bla ma'i gdan sa dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du rnam 'dren shākya seng ge la rgyal ba btsong kha pa/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel/ sman bla bde gshegs bdun/ klu dbang gi rgyal po/ sgrol dkar/ las gshin/ rgyas la rnams kyi sku rgyur gos lu hi/ mchin kha/ gos dkar gser ma/ ljang gu/ (208na tshe sngo sangs/ dmar po/ g.yu kha/ zi shun/ ser nag /ya sher/ lwa dmar/ gos phrug si'u ma/ kha thi/ na ros/ mi sha kha/ smad sham/ mchin smug sogs sna tshogs pa yug chig brgya dang drug /'gang dkar /chor/ ling gsum tshos kha sna tshogs pa yug zhe bzhi las grub pa'i do dam dang bzo bo 'bras spungs kyi gos sku dang mtshungs par bzhengs pa'i tshe dkar chag smon lam dang bcas te 'bul bar mngags/rgyud smad dbu mdzad kyis bskul ba'i zhal snga nas byang rtse chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs brtsams/—290

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)tshes bcu gnyis la gra tshang gi ster cha tshogs sogs yon sbyar te yun du 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel mdzad/ tshogs mgron du gangs can mkhan po/ thar gling slob dpon/ rtse tshogs pa/ ri bo chos gling pa/bkra shis sde chen pa/ lam rim pa/ ri bo rnam rgyal ba/ bsam gtan rtse pa rnams kyi las sna ba dang gra rgan kha shas gra tshang gis bos/ de nyin nas chu bo ri'i sman chu 'phrod tshul sgem bu nas dang bla ma khro phu bas zer ba ltar blangs te nyin bdun gyi bar bsten pas khrag dang tsha ba sogs la 'phrod nyams che ba byung zhing tshe chu nas kyang drangs/ 'di lo sman bla'i chog bsgrigs dbus gtsang gi chos sde shin tu mang bas 'dzugs pa'i rtsol ba 'dug pa bzhin phyag len gyi rim pa dang lung phal cher dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang thor bur sngags rams pa blo bzang skyes mchog /gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyis byas/ ra dar bla mas(208bskyo bco brgyad/ bsod nams dbang rgyal gyis rta drel so sor bcu re/ dpal 'khor mkhan zur dbon po'i rta brgyad cu rnams byung / gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan nas khri rin po che/ rtse shar slob chung sogs dpon slob kha shas phebs gos dar gser dngul gyis maṇḍal ring du brkyangs te yun du 'tsho ba'i bden tshig gnang / da la'i nyung tha'i jir bstan gzhung la rgya stod smad tshang mar khebs gang che dgos pa'i 'phros gleng zhib tu mol te mtsho khri shog rgyal mo phyogs su thon/ khong rang gi sger 'dzin go 'jo'i sde yongs rdzogs 'bul yig dang bcas byin/rang lo mthun pas brtan bzhugs phul na phan yon che ba'i lung bstan la brten brag sna chos rje blo bzang ngag dbang / a gling chos mdzad dngos grub rgya mtsho/ blo bzang don yod dang bslab gsum rgya mtsho le tshan gsum pos rung mthun gyi gos sna dang tshan grangs gra tshang du 'gyed sogs rgyas par sbyar nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ khal kha rgyal por lugs zung blang dor gyi lung dang nang rten gyi mjal kha/ rgya hor gyi bstan gzhung khyab cha gang che mdzad dgos pa'i snyan sgron phul zhing rgyal po 'khor bcas sa chen por rta rmig gi rdul gyis nam mkha' 'gengs pa tsam dang bcas rang yul phyogs su bteg /dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa dka' —291—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bcu blo bzang mkhyen brtse/ dka' bcu bshes gnyen/ dka' bcu sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gsum gyis 'jug pa rtsa 'grel gyi rgyugs sprad/tshes nyi shur rgyal gling mkhan (209na)po/ paṇḍita er te ni tha'i ji/ kong po bkra shis rab brtan bla ma/ gsang gling slob dpon rnams dang phrad/ san khung tha'i ji'i sras bkra shis la yul jo'i kha dan pā thur gyi cho lo dang sde 'thor ba gtad dgos pa'i yi ge byin nas rgyal khang rtse'i phyag mdzod dang bcas par snam phrug sogs rdzong bda' bgyis/ khal kha rgyal pos bskul ba'i mchog dman gang la'ang sbyar chog pa mdo dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs/ thugs rje myur 'jug /paṇḍita er te ni tha'i ji'i ngor bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs/ rgyas sras sher 'phel sprul sku'i gsung gis bskul ba'i bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i gsol 'debs/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa spun gyis rdo rje gro lod/ yang gsang ga rma drag po/ dngas ma bcud 'dren/ gter gsar 'joms byed bzhi'i bris thang gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i ljags bkod ltar bzhengs par so sor snyan dar lnga re/ lha tsaka nyer lnga/ bum pa'i mgul chings/ gtor gdugs dang bcas gra tshang gi chog gra so so'i sgrub rten du phul ba'i rgyab yig rnams brtsams/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i dbon rin po che/ gsang sngags gling dang thar gling slob dpon/ rdzogs chen sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang thub bstan/ zhi gnas slob dpon/kong po brag zhi ba/ drug brgya ba blo bzang dkon cog /'tsho byed lhag bsam/ gzhis ka shar a gur sogs phyogs 'dus kyi don gnyer can kha shas dang gra tshang yongs su rdzogs par thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol (209ba)gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang / chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyab rten gyi lung /nyer lnga nas zla ba phyi ma'i nyi shu'i bar bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams 'khrid shin tu smin pa dang rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab cho se nyal sgom gyi 'khrid/ mjug tu rten 'brel gyi khyad nas chag lugs kyi tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang rnams phul/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyi snyan dar kha —292

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)ro/sa kyi kha byang bris/nyer brgyad la da yan rgyal po'i dbu skor chung ba/ rgyal sras bsod nams bkra shis yum sras sogs 'dam du 'degs gdong byin rlabs dang mi ngo tshor mdud pa byas/ rta tshag sprul sku/ sher 'phel sprul sku/ mang ra mkhan po/ g.yon ru sprul sku/ bkra shis rtse dbon rin po che/ zhal snga nas pha bong kha pa/ thar gling / gsang gling / zhi gnas pa gsum gyi slob dpon pa/ drug brgya ba/ dpon mo phun tshogasasgrol ma sogs don gnyer can sum cu skor la skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po dang jo bo lugs kyi dzam la dkar po'i rjes gnang 'dra bcos rgyas bkab ma yin pa'i yig rnying dang mthun pa zhib rgyas sgrub skor rnying pa dang she'u lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i yig cha/ nged rang gi gsar rtsom 'jam dbyangs lus dkyil gyi lung rnams phul zhing sher 'phel sprul skur sger du bka' drin dran pa'i gsol 'debs kyi lung bklags/ rgyal thang gi jus rim la lha sar gra tshang gis khro rol bdun gcig btsugs pa nyer dgur gtor zor 'phangs pa zor bkra (210na)legs/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas slob gra nyis brgya skor byon te zang zing gi bdog pa dang bcas yun du gzhom zhig mi 'byung ba'i bden pa'i tshig gis bkra shis me rtag char du phab/ dpal nā ro pa'i thugs dam rten pham things pa nas brgyud de dpyal lo'i phyag tu byung ba thar pa'i nang rten byang chub ljon shing las grub pa'i kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi sku khyad par can gtsang sde srid kyi chos sde chen po nas dmag dus 'khyar ba thar pa nang so gzi brjid snying pos byin byung bar bda' lan bzabs par byas/tshes gnyis la se ra theg chen gling gi thog lho kha nas rim gror byon pa'i spyan g.yas pa/ ri bo rnam rgyal ba/ bying bsam gtan rtse pa gsum gyis zhabs 'thud de so sos yul lugs dang bstun pa'i tshan grangs bstar nas ring por gnas pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar bsgrigs/ gra tshang gsum por bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs rim phul/ zhing bkod kyi thang kha rnams grub pa'i ras dang bse pags la dbang —293—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dang sgrub pa'i tshe nyer mkho tsaka li gtos che ba'i dbu btsugs/tshes gsum la gangs ri'i khrod kyi rdo rje 'chang ngur smrig gi zlos gar can rgyud stod smad gnyis nas rim pa bzhin zang zing gi skyes dang bcas 'og min zhing gi mgon po ltar mi g.yo ba'i bden brjod rgya cher mdzad/ yar klungs bkra shis rtse nas rnam rgyal sgrub mchod la byon pa rnams dang phrad cing ja gral gyi thog ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ de nyin (210ba)rmog lcog sku skye byung ba zal mo brag sku skye la dbang chos mang po zhus pa'i 'phros byed 'dug pa bla brgyud kyang shod rgyu med pa'i rdzun zog rab rib kho na gleng ba pha smyo bu spyo brgyud pa spyo/ brgyud pa rdo rje la4 chen smyo ba'i dper snang / lha ldan ru bzhis gser dngul gos dar gyi bdog pa gcig tu bsdus te skye bo pho mo rags bsdus tshogs pa'i gsol 'debs ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye/ 'di lo rgya ljangs kyi thugs brel stabs nas rgyal po byang du phebs pa 'phyis pa'i dbyar thog 'byon pa'i sgo dod par zhal ngo blon 'bangs drag rigs la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gyi byin rlabs phul ba'i tshe rgyal pos ga dza mu tig sgo nga tsam pa'i khyad nor bstar/ zhal ngo tshor bkra shis kha btags kyi mdud pa dang dmangs stong du nye bar lag pa mgo bor bzhag par byin rlabs su grags pa'i chen po'i rnam par bskyangs/ khal kha rgyal po'i sras paṇḍita gnas rnying rgyal por dogs pa'i nad drag pos btab nas rjes su lus pa zug rngu las grol te 'gro ba'i sngon 'gro ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad brtsams pa'i lung bklags shing chos skyong la bka' bsgo sogs 'dod don rnams bsgrubs pa'i yab rgyal po'i bshul rjes zin par song / tshes drug la gra tshang dbu mdzad dkon cog rgya mtsho dang ngag dbang dkon cog gnyis kyis gra pa sngon ma rnams dang dbyibs mtshungs/ ngag dbang dkon cog gis gos sna mang ba shog ser khyad can byin byung zhing gra (211na〉spyad du snyan shal brgya lhag gi spyi 'bul byas/ dpon mo bsod nams tshe dbang can mang dag yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims la bkod/ rgya nag tu dpon blon nang 'brug gi mur phing —294

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)sing dbang gis yi ge skyel mi she'u pe'i li rnyeng ku'i can ched bstad kyis mngags/ mi sna'i sne len byas pa 'gab mi 'gab sogs shar tshod kyi brjod rigs sna tshogs byung yang bod lugs la phyogs kyi gser yig par sne len byed pa sngar srol yongs grags yin gshis de don bzhin bgyid par sde pa dang gros thag bcad/ mi sna la ji ltar 'os pa'i bdag rkyen dang yig dag blangs/ yig lan dang ngag mar khyed dpon blon he bag byung ba mnga' 'bangs kyi tshogs sdug bsngal gyi rgyur song bas ma legs pa'i tshul/ man ju'i rgyal po gcig dang gong gi rgyal rabs gnyis te rgyal rabs gsum gyi bar bod kyi mchod yon dang 'brel zab che zhing nged rang gis gong du phyin pa'i bdag rkyen mtha' klas mdzad tshul dbang rang la rgyus yod pas gong du bsam sbyor log pa ni rmi lam tsam du yang mi byed/ byas na dkon mchog thugs khrel bar ma zad khyed rang yang zhe khrel ba las 'os ci mchis/ dbang dang sngon chad 'dris med na'ang da lam gsar du ngo shes thogs pa dang rnam 'dren shākya seng ge'i rjes su zhugs pa rnams 'gro ba mtha' dag la mnyes gshin par byed pa khyad chos yin pas 'khor bcas la bsam pa rnam dag ma ga rta gos log sgrub byed rgyu med/ lar nas bod pas phan tshun gnyis(211ba〉kar shogasanus mi thon/ sog po o rod ni drag shul ches pas tshang mar bsdabs gsigs las spros pa'i legs tshogs med tshul sogs mchog gsum thugs mi khrel ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi yig ngag dang bcas gser yig pa rnams rdzong bda' byas pas dbang de blo gros dkyil che ba'i nyams kyis mgu zhe khrer dang ma mgu yid ches kyi dper song / dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur yon tan seng ge /se ra'i slob dpon gsum/ hor a mdo ba mang dag dang phrad/tshes bcir dpon mo bsod nams tshe dbang gis ber zlam gyis gtsos pa'i gos sna/ gser/ gos yug gtos che ba/ ja ko dra nyi shu sogs bdog pa dngom che bar bteg /gra tshang du gra ja gos chen gyi 'gyed kyi thog mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ maṇḍal zhing khams rgya mtsho lha mi'i 'dod yon g.yas 'khyil gang 'di'i rgyur gser btso ma zho drug brgya zhe gsum/ dngul srang sum stong —295
