rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)brgyad brgya gya gnyis/ dngul chu srang bzhi brgya gya gsum/ zangs khal chig brgya bcu gsum/ zha nye khal gcig /phra rgyan su ga rnyi rdog gcig /rgya nag pad rā ga rdog che chung re bzhi/ dza ta ru pa rdog gnyis/ ind+ra nī la rgya sran chung tsam gnyis/ bzhu shel sna tshogs bdun brgya re gnyis/ bum gzugs gsum/ g.yu ljang brag gzugs dpangs sor phyed gsum gser gar blugs kyi ljon shing rgya bzo ma nyis 'byar gcig /gtsug g.yu drug /g.yu che chung 'dres pa drug brgya zhe gcig /mu tig che chung bsdoms pa brgya so brgyad/ bai ḍūrla rdog gcig /byu ru bzhi brgya (212na)bcu gnyis dang nar mo nyer bdun/ rgyal lag bzhi/ mu men ril mo gnyis dang nas 'dra sogasum/ spos shel nar mo bcu drug khur gsum gcig /ril mo chig brgya go bdun/ nal che tsam nar mo gcig dang rdog chig brgya dang gcig /mchong gnyis/gzi hril bzhi/ ma na ho mgron gzugs gcig zhal rdog bcu dgu/ mgron gzugs gcig /nar mo gcig /ra shel shing sa gzugs gcig /mching bu pu shel rdog gsum/ ni la tsha li rdog gcig /bsgyur shel rdog bzhi brgya bcu dgu/ shel mthongs bcu gnyis rnams las grub pa sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes te 'go lung pa stag lung phyag mdzod blo bzang ngag dbang sogs lnga/ ri mo ba gting skyes tshe dbang lhun po/ bal po dbu mdzad a ma ra sidha/ dha na shing / byings gras zhe drug /zangs bzo dbu mdzad rnam sras lhas byin/ dngos grub/ byings gras bcu bzhi/ shing bzo'i do dam sger logasa.a dar/ dbu mdzad lam rnyed/ gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs/ byings gras kha shas/ rgya bod kyi yi ge pa 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ dgos cha sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos bgyis pa 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du smon lam rnam dag gis mtshams sbyar nas phul/ tshes bco lnga'i zhogs dpon mo phun tshogs sgrol mar bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phab cing gnas bcu'i gos yol che legs gling gsum yod pa zhig byin byung / gangs ri'i khrod kyi rigs par smra ba rnams kyi 'byung khungs (212ba)mtsho ma dros pa lta bu dpal gsang phu sne'u thog gi chos rje rnam gnyis/las chen/ gzhung las/ grangs sum cu skor dang bcas pas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi yan lag —296

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i yun 'tsho'i rten 'byung gi sngon 'gror bdog pa'i yon sbyar/ de mtshungs stag tshang ra ba stod pa gra tshang yongs rdzogs dang nyi thang gra tshang so sos chos spyod smon lam gyi rim pa rgyas par gsungs/ nyi thang slob dpon sog po ngag dbang shes rab de pradzha shin tu che ba zhig yod tshod nas khong rang gis brtsams pa'i tshigs bcad mang tsam snang ba tshig don gnyis ka mtshan nyid dang ldan par go /lha sa byang gling pas ring 'tsho'i ster cha byung /tshes nyi shur bdag mo yum sras la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang phul/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog sangs rgyas phun tshogs da cha nged na tshod kyang mthon por slebs gshis yang yang mjal ba mi 'char bas da lam nang mi yongs rdzogs dang bcas cis kyang 'gro ba 'gab ces gzhung ko phab nas 'byor pa dang phyogs mtshungs su sgrags sngags gra'i bla spyi sogs kha shas dang phrad/ sku khog 'byor bas rkyen byas sku chas len par btang nas spyan 'dren zhus zhing mthun rdzas kyi spyan gzigs rgyas par spel/ tsha bo de la sku phebs zhus pa e 'gab khog par dris pa legs phyogs byung yang chos skyong phebs pa'i dus khog gsar gyi rigs la 'phral 'jug dka' bas rten 'brel 'grig mi 'grig yong rjes sor khog zhugs byed gsung ba'i zhal len mdzad cing legs (213na)nyes blang dor dri lan rgyas par stsal/hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhir mda' dpon gnas gsar bas gra tshang du yon dang bdog pa'i tshan grangs kyi maṇḍal spel te gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/gzhis rtse mnga' khul nas gangs can chos 'phel/ ngor/ thub bstan yangs can/ mtshan sgrog /gser mdog can lnga'i mkhan po/ yang lug /sgrol ma phug pa/ bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod/ ri sbug dbu mdzad/rin cen rtse nas/ tsha rong nas/ gnas gsar tshe dbang / don grub/ dbang rgyal sogs lnga khoskor dang phrad cing gang 'tsham gyi dri med bgyis/ phing sing ching dbang gi mi sngan ma thon gdong rjes ma she'u pe'i zha'u chi twe dang rnyen wa'i ku we gnyis 'byor pas bdag rkyen ster cha dang bcas lhan cig par song /—297—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)tshes lngar tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas yun 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i tshogs 'gyed ster sbyin gyi dngos po gya nom pa drung 'khor skya ser spyi bsdus kyis yon sbyar ba'i sgo nas gra tshang gis phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo 'phar phye/ gzhis rtse rdzong sdod kyis do dam byas pa'i mnga' khul rnams kyis so so'i 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i bdog pa'i tshan grangs khyad par bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod kyis gser dngul gos dar dngom che ba/ tshogs chas/ bkra shis lhun po nas dngul srang res gtsos pa'i sum tshan/ spyi bsdus kyis kha btags dang dril yug re'i yon sbyar te mdzod dbus ma las byon pa'i tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor (213ba)gyi sgo nas rten 'byung bsgrigs/de nyin gdan yig ltar go babs kyi bzos sgo la brten gsang sngags gling pa rlom pa skyes nas rdzong sdod la sbud shar brgyab pa'i grags pa'ang byung / zhag gsum gyi bcad rgya grol nas sbas ti dgra bcom pa'i dgon gnas skyor lung chos sde'i mkhan slob rags bsdus/ mar khu sbus skyu'i btsun ma dang bcasapas zang zing gi skyes sngon du 'gro ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing mchod 'phreng gi gdangs sogs shin tu snyan pa'i sgra skad bzhag /'on kyang de phyogs rgyal 'gong mangs pa'i stabs yin nam de nub ser drag sogs nam mkha' cung zad 'tshub/ mang ra mkhan po thang skyar bskos pa'i phyag dkar/ 'phags sde mkhan po/ dpal ri sprul sku/ chos 'khor yang rtse'i slob dpon/ snye thang bkra shis snang gi drung chen dang gnyer pa/ chos rdzong dang myug chos gling gnyer pa/ rag shul dbon po/ mkhar ldan nor bu bsam grub/sa khud pa/ sbus srang a bo spyon pa/ shing bzo gra sa ba rnams dang phrad/ phing sing ching dbang gi mi sna gsum pa she'u me'i phan yul long dang tong ming ga'u can 'byor ba'i dbang gi yi ge rten sbrags sprod tshul rgya lugs kyi bsgrigs ma dam/ ja gral thog gang ci'i gnas tshul dang sger du ngag ma zhib tu nyan cing sngar yong mi dang 'dra ba'i dmag dpon gyi las 'dzin yin 'dug pas de rtsis kyi bdag rkyen gang 'i sgogs byas/tshes bcu gnyis la 'phyong rgyas stag rtse mnga' khul skya ser rnams kyis yul lugs dang bstun —298—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanapa'i yon rgyas par sbyar te gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i brtan bzhugs su grags (214na)pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ dbus 'gyur sman ljongs kyi gsang chen slob bshad kyi sngags gra bkra shis chos sde ba gra pa brgya skor dang ngor mkhan po/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po sogs la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum dang klu pa'i gcig ste bcu bzhir grags pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang phul shing mngon rtogs kyang ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyi des go mi chod pa min kyang tshar lugs kyi yi ge tshig zur ma nyams pa byas te phul/ 'bras yul skyed tshal dang thar pa mkhan po/shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor/ 'u yug brag dkar/ rta nag rdor gdan gsum gyi slob dpon/ gzims shag lho pa'i chos mdzad/ rin spungs rdzong sdod sbangs che ba/ shangs bde yangs pa/ brag dkar ba/ bkra shis gling don chen/ bsam gling dkyil khang pa/ sgo mo rab pa skya ser/ dga' bde ba/ byams chen dang mtshan sgrog gnyer pa sogs dang phrad/ bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan gyis khur blangs te gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i rgyal khams su 'gyur ro cog gi 'phags yul kha spu can gyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos pu sta gaḥnyis brgya lhag bcas bzhengs pa'i smon lam che brjod dang bzang po'i bskal pa 'di'i rnam 'dren stong gi snang brnyan bzhugs pa'i gas la'i deb kyi 'go brjod/ stag ru ba blo bzang dngos grub kyi don du cha dbang bkra shis kyis sman bla bde gshegs brgyad so sor brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam/ tsha mig gra rigs (214ba)kyi ngor mkhan skyo nga ba'i gsol 'debs/ se chen dbon pos tshe ring bsam grub kyi don du rnam snang gi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /bsam blo a zhang rab 'byams pa blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyi ngor bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi gsol 'debs smon lam rnams brtsams/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa dka' bcu blo bzang legs ldan gyis gsar rtsom mdzod dang dka' bcu legs ldan rgya mtsho dang blo bzang lhun grub gnyis kyis 'jug 'grel gyi rgyugs sprad/ zla shas kyi bar lho mos su phyi 'khrid rdo rje brag rdzong dang nang gsang gi 'khrid sogs snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gtso bor bton pa'i chos 'khor khyab bdag zha lu —299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)pa chen pos bskor ba'i tshe gnas gsar dbon rin po che dang 'dar pa chos mdzad gnyis la phogs dang chos rje bco brgyad par zur gsos yang dag byas/ dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la chos rgyal byang pa ngag gi dbang po dang sprul pa'i gter ston yol mo ba chen pos mdzad pa'i yig cha kha yar 'dug pa shin tu khungs btsun na'ang cha lag tshang mi tshang ci rigs nas de dag gi dgongs don 'khrugs bsdebs su byas pa'i 'phrin las brgya phrag nyid ngos 'dzin pa'i snang gsal/ mdos chog rgya 'bag mig gi rnam 'phrul/ de'i lag len dran pa'i gsal 'debs/ sreg gtad rjes gnang mu thi la'i 'phreng ba bzhi po tshes gcig nas bcu gsum gyi bar la grub par bkod/ tshes bcu bzhir mtshan sgrog mkhan po dang dar mo sman rams par smyung gnas kyi dus khrims phab ste rkyang khug gtong (215na)du bcug /lha sa byang gling pas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung la mchis brang gi lus rgyan gyi rin po che kha shas sogs kyi ster sbyin dang gra tshang du yon sbyar/tshes bco lnga'i snga dro phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan/ khal kha sku skye/ khun du lu a pa shi'i tho yon ngag dbang don grub sogs la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ sman bla sprul sku dang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang gi rnam rgyal ma gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang bskur nas phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan la sger gyi ster cha dang mthun pa'i slog sogs rdzong bda' gang legs byas/ sprul pa'i sku da lo dbus phyogs su phebs na e yong gi dri bar mtshan nyid kyi thugs gnyer skabs phyogs phebs 'di gnod po yong bas re zhig gsan sbyong gang smar 'gab tshul mol/ er te ni chos rje/ dpon mo bsod nams tshe dbang yum sras bcas par grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / ma ṇi dang a ra pa tsa na'i bzlas lung dang shal snam phrug gis thog drangs pa'i rdzong bda' rgyas par bgyis/ o rod g.yas ru da'i chin nang so sogs gsar 'grul brgya skor gyis rgya nag dang stod hor la brten pa'i dngos po tshan che ba bstar/ phing sing ching dbang gi mi sna la yig lan rten sbrag ngag ma ster cha'i rdzong ba byas/ dbang gis 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag dang mdud pa kha shas dgos tshul byung ba bsrings/ spor thog bla ma/ lha lung nas gnyis dang phrad cing —300—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)zhang ston sku mdun phun tshogs rnam rgyal la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma bskur/tshes bcu bdun la thar pa mkhan po/ rdzogs chen sprul sku/ dpal ri (215ba/sprul sku gsum la bla ma bde chen dbang phyug gi byin rlabs dbang bzhi phul/ mtshan sgrog /skyed tshal/ thar pa gsum gyi mkhan po/ shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor dang zhi gnas pa'i slob dpon sogs nyi shu skor la sman bla sprul sku dang bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi rjes gnang phul/ skyed tshal mkhan po sman bla'i skor la don gnyer che bar ma zad dam pa'i chos kho nar zhol ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por snang /mtshan sgrog mkhan pos 'di ga dang skyed tshal mkhan pos sde pa'i brtan bzhugs bskul ma mdzad pa/rigs kun bdag po zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyi thugs dam du 'phags pa brgyad stong pa bzheng ba gnang ba dang yar 'brog bsam sdings sprul skus rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i smon lam/ ngag dbang nam mkha'/ klu 'bum cho so rje rin chen/ ngag dbang mkhas btsun gsum gyis 'di ga dang chos rje bco brgyad pas nged rang dang zha lu mkhan rin po che'i brtan bzhugs/mdo btsun gyis 'jigs byed dang phyag drug pa'i thang kha/ blo gros rgya mtshos bka' gdams glegs bam gyi 'khrungs rabs/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ mnyan yod kyi cho 'phrul/ mdzad bcu/ gnas bcu/ lam rim brgyud pa/ sgrol ma rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /lha gzur khang pa khyo shugs kyi kha ton du drag dmar dang tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos rtsoms shig pa'i gnang ba thob pa la brten nas rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga 'khrul med yid (216na〉sos sum ldan/ dza stir gyi zhal shes rnams bris/ bkra shis rtse chos sde bas tshe chog grub mtshams e waṃ pho brang du nyin bcu'i bar gur zhal gyi bskang ba/ dbus gtsang gi rdzong gzhis kha shas su bka' 'gyur nyis brgya/ thang yig lo grangs/ mtshan brjod 'bum ther/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sa ya/ āoṃ ring bye ba gnyis/ sher snying lnga 'bum/ tshe gzungs sa ya gnyis/ ser 'bras so sor ja tshul nyi shu'i thog dmigs brtse ma gang 'gro/ rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bskang ba 'bum/ zhal dang beg —301—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)tse'i bskang ba lnga stong re/ phyag drug pa/ las gshin/ gur/ rnam sras rnams la stong re/ chos skyong byings la brgya re/ srong btsan du ma ning dang thang po cher gsol mchod brgya rtsa/ lha sar phyugs lug brgya'i srog blu sogs tshogs gsog rgya cher bskrun/tshes brgyad la sol thon tha'i ji pha bu la thon rdzongs byas/ tshes nyi shu nas btsugs pa'i rgyal thang ljangs phyogs kyi jus rim du dbus gtsang gi sngags rnying ma'i sde kha shas nas khro rol gsum/ zil gnon khro chu 'char ka sogs kyi sgo nas dgra mnan dgu/ 'char ga'i glang chen sna bsgyur dang zor las gnam lcags thog mda'/ tshe bdag /nag po gsum dril/ khro chu'i gtor bzlog /ser 'bras dge gsum du ja tshul gyi thog sher snying gi mdo sgrub rnams bstar/ 'bras spungs bde yangs pa'i rigasagra'i skal ba skyel bar slob dpon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa/ bsam yas rab byung bla ma/ do nang (216ba)pad gling pa rnams dang phrad/ nyer gsum la rin spungs/ shangs/ pa rnam ste rdzong khag gsum gyi 'go mir spangs che ba/ stong ra ba/ me do bas gtsos skya ser rnams gcig tu bsdoms nas tshogs 'gyed ster cha dang bcas gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīkka tshig don rab gsal gzims shag lho pas par du brkos pa skyel ba dang lhan du se mdo dka' ldan rnam rgyal du 'dzugs rgyur ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul bzhin bsrings/nyer bzhir gter ston rin po che'i gcung gter gsar gyi chos bdag tu 'dug pa ltar snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs kho na nyams su blangs na legs rgyur mkhas rlom la las dbyen bcos pa'i sgra snyan gyis mtshon gzhung lugs mang po'i thos bsam dang 'dul ba'i bca' khrims kyang tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin lta bur song bas srung ma 'khrugs pa sogs rten 'brel 'phyugs nas glo bur du gshegs pa'i bsngo rten 'byor zhing dngul lnga bcu mas gtsos pa'i dge 'thud kyi bdog pa rgyas par sbyar/ 'phags yul nub phyogs rā ṇa de ba'i yul gru nas 'ongs pa'i se rtswa si ya sma gi ri dang go rna na —302

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)gnyis kyis chu bo gaṅgā'i chu ka lā sha lag pa'i grangs ldan byung ba'i bda' lan du gser zho lnga sogs ster cha byas/ nyer dgur dbon 'dur tshang gi 'grul pa gsar 'byor kha yar dang phrad/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa dka' bcu blo bzang brtson 'grus kyis gsar rtsom 'jug pa'i (217na)rgyugs sprad/ tshes gnyis la yar klungs bkras rab pa spun gyis yon sbyar nas gra tshang gis gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ tshes drug la gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi'i 'byung khungs gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa mkhas grub dge ba'i dbang pos thog drangs/ slob dpon/ chos 'am da/ dge 'dun brgya lhag gis tshe dpag med kyi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i yun 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i sngon 'gror bdog pa maṇḍal gyi tshul du bteg /slob dpon rnam ri grong pas lung sbyor gyi bshad pa sogs gcig tu bsdoms te mtshungs med chos kyi zhal snga nas bskal brgyar bzhugs pa'i bka' bzhes zhu lags zhes pa'i kong po kha thag cig mdzad/ chos rje dge ba'i dbang pos gtsos kha shas la tshig lugs tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang phul/ nā la ṇḍa chos rje bco brgyad pa/ brag dbar slob dpon/ po ti bla ma dang tsha rong bla ma/ 'bri gung spo bo ban grong pa/ rag shul dge slong / be lig er khe tha'i ji/ thod ri bshad sgrub gling gi slob dpon/se ra theg chen gling nas bya bral dang ha gdong gi dge rgan rigs gra'i skal ba skyel mi sogs/ mang dag dang phrad/ chos rje bco brgyad par rgyud sde'i skor la dogs gcod byas pa rnams la lan zhib par byung zhing ma nas chos rje 'di pa dkyil 'khor re gnyis kyis gsol grod sbos pa dang skyes tshad mthong tshad sman du gyur pa'i dbang bskur mkhan po tsho dang mi 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tu snang / bi lig er khe tha'i jir skyer sgang lugs (217ba)kyi rta mgrin gyi byin rlabs bskur/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos tsha kho dbon por gdams pa'i lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum 'di rje bla ma'i bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa nas 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel gyi drung du gsung bshad lan mang du nos pas rang lo nyer gnyis pa'i dus zhal dpon sbyin dpal gyi ngor mchan 'grel zhig —303—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)brtsams kyang drung rams pa dom nyag gis zhib 'jug mdzad pa las phal cher ji mi snyam pa'i dpe ma 'phel/ dus phyis khams phyogs nas don gnyer can 'dras bskul ba dang nye char dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas mtshams sbyar bar brten dgongs 'grel lung rigs gter mdzod bkod pa phyag rgya ba'i chos kyi ma bslad pa'i dge lugs pa gtsang sing nge ba tsho'i thugs la 'thad rgyu'i re ba ni yod mod dug sman du 'gyur ba dang sman dug tu 'gro bar nges pa ni mi snang /tshes bdun la dbyangs i/ re gza' lha'i bla ma/ rgyu skar lha mtshams/ 'phrod kun dga'/ sbyor ba sha 'khon/ rten 'brel skye ba/ stag gi nyi ma rnams yod pa'i 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i nyin pho brang chen po'i tshoms chen du gsar bskrun gyi bka' 'gyur ro cog tshar bzhi sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang por rdo rje slob dpon dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos byas pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa yongs rdzogs kyis lha brag gter byon phur pa lcags khang ma'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas ra btu gnas te bkra shis dga' ston gyi char chen po phab/ gser zho re (21zha〉〈/ gas tshan grangs kyi yon dang bsnyen bkur gya nom pa bstabs/tshes brgyad la zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku'i mchod gzhis la/ stod lung ram pa mda' sgro'i gzhis ka them 'dzin nyer drug lag 'bab chig stong sum brgya gya bdun/ rdzogs chen sprul sku ngag dbang kun bzang 'jigs med la pho brang thar pa gling stod kyi spyil po/ mdo pa sku skye'i 'dzin shul them 'dzin brgyad/lag 'bab sum brgya go drug /khyim chung pa dbang ldan gyi sgrub rten du gzhis rtse khul gro khud gzhig ka /them 'dzin bcu gnyis/ lag 'bab brgyad dang gsum rnams sprad/ tshes dgu la khal kha u rang khang thang pa o pa shi/ ser byes 'phrin las lhun grub kyi sku skye'i bsngo rten skyel mi jo rig thu khung tha'i ji rnams dang phrad cing dngos po gya nom pa bstar par byang chub thob pa'i rgyas 'debs yang dag bgyis/ phyi dro 'dul ba zur par sa lugs phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang dang rdzong bda' byas/ drang srong ā ga sdus chu'i dug dbyung ba'i yan lag brgyad ldan tshe chu bo ri'i sman chu zhag lnga'i bar bsten/ gra sa chen —304

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)po ser 'bras gnyis kyi rten deb le tshan gyi 'go brjod/ rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang mgon po don grub gnyis kyi ngor gsol 'debs smon lam/ lha sa khang gsar ba dge bsnyen gyi don du bder gshegs brgyad kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos dgos tshul bzhin dang rme ru bla ma rin cen rgya mtshos gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang (218ba)bcas pa'i glegs bam brgya dang sum cu skor par du btab cing gser gyi sman mdo brgyad brgya pa dang spyi sos bde gshegs brgyad kyi lha tshogs sman 'dam las grub pa bzhengs pa'i so so'i smon lam/ snga sor dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi chog bsgrigs dang phyag len rnams gra tshang du tshes bco brgyad mig dmar dbyu gu'i 'grub sbyor thog btsugs pa'i tshe snyan dar sna lngar kha byang btab ste phul/ 'khor 'o1 sdom pa lha hi pa dang dril bu lus dkyil gnyis la thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos gnang ba'i yig cha zla med pa bzhugs na'ang / dril bu lha lngar rang bstan la yig cha khungs thub cig mi snang bas rtsom pa'i 'dun pa yod pa'i steng du dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung dang dkyil chog dpa' bo grong 'jug rnams brtsams shing mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po'i spyan lam du 'bebs par dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa btang ba'i the tshom gyi dri ma bsal/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor rdo rje'i khri la g.yo ba med pa'i ngos chos 'khor rgya cher skor ba'i rten 'brel du brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad stan dkar na bza' cha tshang / bzang ja bar khag dang bcas 'bul bar dar mo sman rams pa mngags/nyer bzhi la cha dkar no mon khan gyi jo rig thu nang so can gyis rta so gcig byung / nyer lngar yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sde'i mkhan po rje dbon nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gis rgyal po/ ka tshal bla ma khri zur (219na)gnyis/ ra ba stod bla rme khri zur gnyis gsang phu rnam rgyal gser khang dang khu pe gra tshang gi slob dpon/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ khal kha g.yas ru'i thar pa o pa shi/ a mdo —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dang sog po gtos che ba/ tshur phu'i phyag mdzod/ kong po bcos mi a bo/ sde pa rag pa ma bu/ khrom sab khu tshan/ dgu gtor gyi tshong dpon brag gdong pa dang rnam rgyal sgang pa sogs skya ser rnams la ja gral btang / phyim red khal khar log mi dge slong dang dge tshul bdun re bsgrubs/ ka tshal zur pa rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub la gshin rje log tri sogs kyi mol mchid rgyas par bgyis shing gos sna cha tshang gi ster cha bstar/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod dkon cog rgyal mtshan 'byor ba'i rta bco brgyad byin/ nyer drug la bkra shis rtse'i dbon rin po cher kha'u brag rdzong pa'i ring lugs gtso bor bton pa'i ris med kyi rgyud sde rgya mtsho chen por gsan bsam mdzad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mol te dngos po'i tshan grangs dang bcas rdzong bda' byas/nyer brgyad la rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs kyi sprul sku'i don skor la phyag mdzod dgon stod pa can gyis sde par chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i sku ber ding phon srab btags ma byung ba nang rten khrod du yod/ slob dpon chen po padma'i rnam sprul 'phags yul grub chen dza ha bhi ra gyi dngos slob badzra nā thas chos rgyal 'bri gung par gnang ba'i rlung sbyor gyi skor cha lag tshang ba dang ma ni ka badzra gyis thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen (219ba)brtse'i dbang phyug la gnang ba gnyis ka thob na'ang phyi ma'i phyag len bzhin hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig nas zhag bdun gyi ring mchod dpon pas grogs byas te bhu rlung gi nyams len chog dril du bgyis/ la la nyin zhag re la ja phor pa re tsam 'thung ba'i rtsing spyod yod 'dug rung chu thigs pa gcig dang zas nas 'bru gcig kyang ma btang ba'i nyams len la brten rlung gis nus pas ltogs skoms kyi snang ba ni cung zad tsam yang ma byung / chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs dang rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs la mngon mkhyen dang snyun las grol ba sogs kyi rtags ya mtshan pa byung ba bzhin ni ga la yong / 'on kyang rgyu med kyi 'bras bu ltar zhag re la dri chu dkar tshad phyed do re byung ba nad rang 'khrus su mngon / mchims phur dpal ri sprul sku gra bcas bco lngas 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa dang g.ya' ma lung du rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che gra bcas bco lngas tshe dpag med bdud rtsi —306—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chana'akhyil ba sgrub zhag bdun re btsugs/ lha sar sgo 'gyed la ya ju khor drug ma nga bzhi/ sprang ston ja 'dur sge do rnams btang / 'bri lung gzhen tshang legs ldan gyi zhi drag sgrub rten du 'od zer gyang pa'i 'dzin shul chum pa sho gong nas them 'dzin bdun/ lag 'bab chig stong sum brgya gya drug bying bsam gtan rtse par sa snon du rtses dang lag 'debs thog nas lag 'bab sum brgya skor thon rtsis kyi zhing bco lnga sprad/ mchod dpon pas zhing bkod gra tshar so lnga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig bris/ 'dar pa lotsā ba pha bu/ phu lung (220na༄ge slong / bkras rab phun tsho gos dbang po/rdo dgon blo bzang don ldan lngasaphug pa man ngag lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i le'u tho lo lnga'i bar bzos/tshes bco lngar 'dar grang chen mkhan po ka spe ba blo gsal bstan pa rab rgyas/ ngor thar rtse'i bla ma/ don gnyis gling dang dpal 'khor chos sde'i rkyang 'dur bde ba can gyi slob dpon zur pa/ bra yag bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi sku skye/ rgyal sras bsod nams bkra shis dpon mo bcas pa/ lcam nor bu khra sgor/ zhang ston ri khrod pa/ phing sing ching dbang gi mi sna/ snar thang mkhan po ma yum lo chen gyi dbon po/ mchod rten bla ma'i gra pa dge slong / bkras gzhongs rab stims pa dbon po rin cen/se chen khan gyi shog nas me rgan chos rje/ ja'i sang rjar go cha'i bu tshe ring / rgyal po'i shog nas er khe pag shi /gnam bde legs pa'i dpon po chos mdzad/ bya bral shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs mang dag la ja gral dang los gleng byas/ shangs rgod tshang ri khrod pa sum cu skor la yi ge drug pa'i sgom bzlas phab/tshes bcu bdun la thos bsam dar rgyas gling gra slob sum brgya skor gyis zang zing gi bdog pa'i maṇḍal dang bcas ring por gnas pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad kyi rigs mang du gsungs/ 'jam dpal zil gnon gyi chog bsgrigs gsar pa'i steng nas sgrub zhag gsum gyi bcu dgu la gdab las rgyas pa sogs zor las tshang bar mdzad/ a rig sangs rgyas dang dbon po don (220ba〉sgod kyis rta don brgyad byin/ ri bo bde chen gyi mkhan zur hre bo chos rje ngag dbang dpal bzang khams nas byon pa'i dbon skya ser g.yog sum brgya skor 'byor ba'i rta brgya bcu bdun/ dre'u re gsum gyis gtsos —307—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenapa'i ster cha spams mtho ba byung bar dge ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsngos/ zhing skyong nang sa'i dbon chung gis gser dngul ja gos dar mang ba bstar zhing de zhor spang gzhongs ha ri kha'i bla ma/tha'i ji nor bu/ rwa sgreng gi las sne ba/ ri bo chos gling gi gnyer gsar rnying / a mdo ba nyis brgya skor rnams dang phrad/nyer gcig la mkhar rgya rnam sgom can gyis rta bco brgyad/ a rig bya phral blo bzang can dang rong po blo bzang can gyis rta nyer gsum re/ nags shod sbus mda' bla mas rta nyi shu rnams kyi ster cha byung / zhag bdun gyi ring dbus stod gter sgrom gyi chu tshan bsten/ ding sang sngags 'chang phal cher thun dang phur pa zhor sgrub las mi mdzad pa mang yang rje 'bri gung pas dmag bteg nas lag cha bzo dgos byung na mda' thungs 'gro bar dgongs te pad gnubs brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin thog ma nas sgrub pa mdzad pa ltar dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas rdo rje slob dpon byas te grangs bcad kyis nyer bdun nas thun phur sgrub zhag bcur nus ldan du bstar/ gnam gang gi dgongs nas dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos rdo rje slob dpon byas te grangs bcad kyis gshin rje (221na)me'i spu gri'i srung ba'i dbu btsugs/ zla ba rting ma'i nyer dgu la mnan zor gyis mtha' bsdus pa'i pu ri dkar nag gi las sbyor pad gnubs brgyud pa'i man ngag rje gnam lcags me 'bar gyi phyag len ltar gra tshang gyi gra pa grangs bcad kyis lag tu blangs pas kha ma rdugs pa'am stabs 'grig pa ji ltar yang rgyal thang du zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin yul jo'i thu pā thur gyis gtsos pa'i bod sog gi dmag gis rgyab bya/ mo bkag /rab brtan/ rtsibazhag /khang gsar/ a spong 'go /rtsa nye ba sogs rgyal thang yang thang gi skya ser tshang ma bcoms par snang /hor zla bcu pa'i tshes lngar dbus gtsang gi rdzong gzhis kha yar nas sman bla bdun khri drug stong sum brgya nyi shu/ mtshan brjod sum 'bum/ gshin rje 'dus pa'i drag sngags bye ba gnyis/ dbus gtsang gi ris med dgon adhi gnyis pa yan la lo dus kyi mang ja bsngo rten deb gsal dang 'gyed khams —308—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)dngul srang nyis stong drug brgya re drug rnams song / tshes brgyad la lha sa'i bsnyen gnas ma tshor yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa phab/ dga' ldan shar pa chos rje/ nyang rong gra tshang dang lnga mchod pa gnyis kyi bla mas thog drangs sne mo ba kha shas skyon mtsho mo/ ras chung phug sprul sku/ ri khrod dga' ldan zur pa spyan g.yas pa/ dwags ze mo dgon bla ma/ lha ri bla ma/ sems dpa' chen po'i dbon po/ se chen rab stims pa/ kong po sman sgom bla ma/ mdo pa sku skye/ 'dzam gling chos 'khor ba'i dbon (221ba kho/ bkra shis rab brtan pa'i rten 'byung bsgrig mi gnyis/ phag mo chos sde'i las sna ba/ lha rtse chos sde dang ngo rdzong chos sde gnyis kyi sman bla'i phyag len 'khrid mi/ nags shod sbud mda' bla ma'i rta ster mi/ gzhisamagron rtag 'du se skor ba/ nyan po phyug po/ stag lung sba yan/ dkon cog blo gros/ gling stod sku skye/ ri bo che ba'i padma sku skye/ bang rim chos sde'i gnyer pa/ chos 'khor yang rtse'i grwa pa brgya lhag /bsod nams bkra shis kyi ma dang dpon mo 'khor bcas/ sgo mangs pa'i 'bul sdud dka' bcu chos blo bzang / se chen khan gyi shog nas er te ni dbon po/ er khe dbon/ me rgan chos rje/ nags chu bla ma blo grosargyal mtshan/ rtse chen tha'i ji'i mi sna u lang pā thur er te ni da'i chen gyi mi sna chos mos/ rtse chen zhabasadrung gi grwa pa da'i chen nang so/ thar pa'i sras tshe ring rgya mtsho/ a mdo bya bral dka' bcu dge 'dun rin chen/ kha rag rkan phu ba chos rje bstan 'dzin sogs lnga brgya skor dang phrad/ ras chung phug sprul skus skar 'brug la ma bltos pa'i ras chung lugs yin pa'i shes byed rdo rje 'chang tai lo na ro pa nas brgyud pa'i bka' babs lo rgyus yig 'phreng gsum gyi tshod la 'og 'og min min zhes tshig lhad bcug pa'i rta ring mdzad pas ja 'debs gnyis kyi yun 'gor/ padma rgyal po'i sku skye la stag lung phyag mdzod pa can do gal che ba 'dug pa was gzhu rgyud zos pas mchog snar 'phog pa'i tshod tsam yin kyang rnga mo'i 'gram rus (222na)mur ba 'dra/tshes bcu gcig la rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi gra pa chos bzang pos byams chos sde lnga/ rtse gdong drung yig pa dge slong chos 'phel grags pas padma bka' thang / tsha rong dpon tshang gi slob ma lha —309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)mo tshe ring gis gso dpyad rgyud bzhi rnams kyi rgyugs sprad/ khal kha sku skye'i ngor nged rang / shes rab bzang po'i ngor bkra shis lhun po'i sprul sku rin po che/ grags pa shes rab kyi ngor rgyal sras sher 'phel sprul sku gsum gyi brtan bzhugs/ gzhis ka shar pas mtshan brgyad dang byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi thang kha'i rgyab yig /sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis bu mo'i don du zhi khro'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis nged rang gi 'dra 'bage bzhengs pa'i smon lam/ rang gi kha ton du dmigs te nyang lugs drag po bder gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs thog mda'i tsha dbal rnams brtsams/tshes bcu bdun la rong po blo bzang don grub can gyis rta sum cu dang a bsam pā thur gyis rta don drug byin/ rtse gdong nas zhabs drung khri rin po che bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po nā la ṇḍa ra phebs rtsis kyis chibs kha bskyod pa shar rgyag stod lung phu brgyud lha sar byon par chibs bsu/ tshes nyi shur po ta lar phebs skabs nged rang nas bsu ba dang phyag lan gyi rnam pa/ mjal dar bzhugs gdan sogs chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i (222ba)dbon por gong brgyab kyi bkur gzos gang che phul/ zhal ngo khu dbon tshang ma gsung sgros la thugs sbubs 'thum pa zhig snang bas dri mal nyang nyung 'dra zhus par de lan gyi phebs sgo dang gsung ngag tshogs slob gser chos chos skyong gi skor la rgyu mtshan phul bar srid gsum rnam rgyal slob dpon par zhu lan phul zhig pa'i skabs dbye song bar bde bar gshegs pas kyang rjes su gnang ba'i bka' la dgongs pa bstad pa 'dra/ ma nas 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi rigs su 'khrungs pa'i gsung ngag dang dbang rjes gnang re mang gnang rgyu yod tshod du 'dug rung khri chen gong ma kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub de rgyud sde rgya mtshor mkhyen rnga/ che bar ma zad gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags la slob bshad sogs yab chos mtha' dag gsan nas bstan pa'i sgron me spar bar bzhed kyang khams pa ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rjer grags pa'i mkhas zlo ske g.yag zhar ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa zhig gis 'phrin las kyi sgo bkag —310

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)pa'i skyon gyis zhal ngo phyi ma rnams gdugs dkar sngags kyi dpe bzhin gser chos kyis gtsos pa gzims khang gi them pa'i nang du 'da' yin med pa 'dra/ tshe bdag gi dbang gis mtshon chos bka' kha shas dgos tshul phebs kha nam dus dang dbang chog rjibs pas 'phral 'bul ma thub par ma zad dze tā ri'i lha dgu dang grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang sogs la dbang gral du yang nged 'gro ma lcogs pas chag lugs tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang phul/(223na)gzhis len zur gsos tshur gnang gi skyes lan gang rgyas bstar bas dngar mo dang skyur mo'i dpe bzhin thugs dgyes pa bskyed pa'i 'phros shig snang / ma 'gyangs par rong ston chen po'i gdan sar thegs/ khams bya mo nang bla ma dpal ldan grags pa/ bon po rgyal ba ye shes kyi tsha bo/ dwags po gra tshang gi gnyer pa/ gling dge slong blo bzang phun tshogs/ 'on dgon gong bla ma nyang rong rab 'byams pa blo bzang bkra shis/ da la'i hung tha'i ji'i mi sna man du skyabs/ er te ni pā thur tha'i ji'i mi sna sgrol mud gan/ che chen khan gyi mag pa pā thur tha'i ji'i mi sna su jug thu bla ma dang bā khan khu thug thu/ shas bsod gling stod pa/ mang ra mkhan po/ bzod pa yel deng gi lha btsun/ zhad ston bstan rgyal yab sras/ dga' ldan tsha kho rab stims pa/ ra la no mon khan gyi nu bo/ a mdo stag lung dge slong lhun grub shes rab/ mkhas pa rgya mtsho'i tsha bo 'jam dbyangs/ thar pa'i mi sna bsam gtan dge slong / khal kha g.yas ru bzod pa yel deng dang nom ji hung tha'i ji'i mi sna ja'i sang dge slong / gra tshang chos rje'i sku skye sogs sum brgya skor la ja gral btang / rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po dga' ldan du gshegs pa'i dus chen lha mchod chen mo'i nyin dngul sku mthong ba don ldan gyi drung du mchod pa bzabs rgyas dang maṇḍal brgya rtsa phul zhing gsol 'debs smon lam nan tan du btab/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la 'phyong (223ba)rgyas ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis gra tshang du dung gos dang snyan shal 'bul rtsis kyi kha byang / khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po'i bkas bskul bar brten nas zha lur bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bstod pa padma rā ga'i 'phreng ba/ mkhan brgyud —311—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gsol 'debs kha skong / zha lu'i ma he'i skad gtong ba'i lam yig /lha ldan gyi bsnyen gnas ma tsho'i ngor bla ma dang spyan ras gzigs dbyer med du gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa rnams bris/gdan sa gong nas 'di lo phebs bzhed kyi khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po brgyud bka' shog byung bar nam zla 'phyis pa nas lo rting ma tsam 'gab 'dra bsam rung sde pas 'di lo rang phebs pa 'gab tshul nan chags mdzad pa bsam yas nas chos skyong dpon blon gyis lo sngon ma tshor phebs gsungs pa rim 'gyangs su song 'dug pa da lam sde pa'i thugs rgyud bsgul ba 'dra/ khong dpon slob la kyas kya rags/ kya dar/ rgya gling sogs snga thog gi las tshan thams cad bsgrigs te phebs dgos tshul zhus rung dbu gdugs sgor mkhan rkang thang pa dang rgya gling pa yang cha ma 'grig pas gtong ma thub pa sogs thugs gra 'grig rgyu ma mchis/ gdan sa gong 'og gnyis la dngos gzhi 'gangs che chung mi 'dug na'ang rtse gdong gi zhal ngo phyi ma gnyis 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri pad ma can du khri 'don ma mdzad pa nas nang gses kyi khyad par cung zad 'dug pa chibs bsu sogs shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas chos 'khor dpal gyi lha (224na)sar phebs/ tshes lnga'i nyin zhabs drung khri chen ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rigs chos kyi sras khri thog pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ rdo rje btsun mo lha gzigs rigs kyi sras mo bkra shis lags dang bcas pa dpon slob rnams dang mjal ba'i bzhugs stan bsu phyag sogs bkur gzos gdan sa 'og las che tsam phul/ gser zho brgya phrag shal dkar dmar gyis gtsos pa'i gnang skyes rgyas par stsal/ zhabs drung chen mo gsung stod skad dam pa ljags dib kyang cung zad snang bas yab rje sngags 'chang sems dpa' chen po dang mi 'dra ba'i thugs gu dog pa tsam 'dug rung rgyud sde spyi dang bye brag ngor rdzong tshar gsum sogs zab chos kyi skor la dri ba zhus pa rnams la rjes su gnang ba'i bka' mdzad mi dgos pa'i zhabs drung nyid nas gsung sgros shin tu smar ba byung / gzhis len rgyas par zhus pa'i 'dzugs chen lnga'i nang gi thud sgrom sku skyos khrod du mgron gnyer gyis then pa phyogs der srol med pa'am bdag —312

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba'i dus kyi snang tshul gyi ri mo yal ba gang rung gi tshod du mchis/ tshar lugs snyan brgyud po ti nas mdo khams pa rdo rje bkra shis zin bris kyis mtshon lung ma gsan pa kha yar dang bram ze'i mngags gtad sogs 'ga' zhig dgos phebs pa chos kyi bdag por 'bul ba spro ba che yang nam dus dang lus gcong gis 'phral du 'bul ma thub pa'i slar (224ba)'bul rtsis dang da lam sku tshe'i rten 'brel du chag lugs tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang phul/ gdan sa gong 'og gnyis ka dang thog mar mjal nyin pu tra ming sring gis 'khrul snang che ba re yong 'dug pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi rigs la srung ma 'di nges par 'khor ba zhig yod par snang / sang nyin zhabs drung yab sras khyab bdag zha lu pa dang bcas dpon slob gsum lhan cig par ja sbyor lnga'i ring phal cher chos phyogs dang 'brel ba'i gsung sgros shin tu zhib cing zhabs drung gong ma'i gsan rgya dang dbyibs mtshungs pa snang bar legs so dang slad mar yang gdung brgyud rim pa chig brgyud du byon pa tshar lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i rjes 'brang mkhas grub rnams kyi zab chos dang bstan pa spyi bye brag la gsan bsam 'chad nyan sogs ding sang sku na gzhon dus 'dir gnang dgos tshul dang de mtshungs zhabs drung khri thog par yang snyan sgron phul/ lo chen rin cen bzang pos rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i yon tan gyi rten mgon po shing drung ma dang thugs rten gnam lcags kyi rdo rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung la gdan drangs pa'i rjes su sne'u sdong rtser bzhugs pa'i khungs btsun/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa dang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i dbu thod/ zur pa shi shāka 'od kyis brag rdo rje'i tshe brtan nas tshe chu dang lhan du spyan drangs pa'i slob dpon chen po'i phyag gi pad phur khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gzhan yang bsnyen phur chu bo gyen bzlog /mkhar chen (225na)bza'i phyag rdor/ sa paṇa gyi zhun thigs las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku sham la sku brnyan bris pa sogs nang rten kha shas kyi mjal kha phul/tshes bcu la dril bu brgya dang sum cu so gsum gra tshang du sbyor 'jags byas/ tshes bcu gnyis la —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gdan sa gong nas sbyin bdag gnang ste tshogs chas 'gyed gser zho brgyas gtsos pa'i gnang skyes dang bcas gra tshang nas mgon po tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas cho ga rgyas par ci mdzad/ zhabs drung khri chen gyis gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sku brnyan lag tu gtod pa gnang ba dang sbrags ring por gnas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhib tu stsal ba skyes chen dam pa'i bden tshig 'grub pa gzhir bcas pas rten 'brel lhun gyis grub/tshes bcu bzhir sa skya zhabs drung yab sras la gser dngul shel spyad ja ras gos dar rta sga chas sogs phyir 'bul gya nom pa dang phebs gdong na bza' cha skor zhal dkar dngul gyi stegs bzed zhal gyis gtsos gzims chung 'bul ba'i tshul du bteg /nā la ṇḍa chos rje bco brgyad pa dbon bcas/bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po sras ltor dang bcas pa sum brgya skor/ ri bo chos gling bar mchod gzhisagasar chod kyi legs skyel ba rgyal sras sher 'phel ba'i dbon po can dang phrad cing khal kha nas gsar slebs u rang khang bing thu da'i ching spun 'khor bcas kyi gser dngul ja gos dar gyis thog drangs dngos po wo che ba bstar te dge ba sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngos/ chos sde (225ba〉gi po dpal ldan 'bras spungs spyi sos mchod yon la bsnyen bkur ba'i skal bar tshes bco lnga'i nyin gnyug mar gnas pa'i tsho gis dang khyab bdag zha lu ba chen po phebs/ 'dar lo dang rnam sras gling nas gnyis kyisarigs gnas lngar spyi bshad kyi los gtam byas thog dkar spro dmar spro'i gzhis len bzabs rjes slob dpon rnams dang blo gsal gling pa'i 'bul dpon pas bdog pa'i skyes bteg par ja gral btang /tshes bcu dgur bstan srid spyi rim du dge lugs sngags dgon tsho nas gtor bzlog nyin chog ma dang mdo gra nas mdo sgrub mdzad dgos pa'i brda 'grems thog ja sbyor sbrel zhus/ chab mdo nas 'phags pa lha'i sprul sku rin po ches chos rje ngag dbang 'phrin las bzang po'i sku skye'i skor la dogs dpyod byung bar brtag pa'i tshul gyis mo : la nga phod pa bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i bur dogs gnas tsam yang ma byung / glang grong nas tshe ring bsam grub gyi bu chos grags dang bkra ri nas sngags rnying ma ba ye —314

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)shes lhun grub kyi bu bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gnyis ka gsal mnyam lta bur gcig 'dra min las 'os med pas kha mtshon ma chod gshis bla ma sngon ma'i nyer spyad kyi sku gsung thugs rten phyag 'phreng dkar yol bcas par ngos 'dzin byung na dang ma byung na bu chu lha khang du zan ril su thon la ngos 'dzin cing mtshan ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub tu gsol/nyer gcig la khyab bdag zha lu pa chen por klu sgrub lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal lha so bdun ma/'jigs byed rwa lugs yig rnying dang tshar chen yab sras kyi (226na)yig cha'i steng nas sngar dbang tshar gcig thob rung yang bskyar gyi tshul du nyer gnyis la sta gon dang gsum la dngos gzhi zhus shing /'di lo phrug po che bas rtag brtan rten drag khrod nas lus pa khyer yongs pa'i rwa lo'i phyag dril khungs btsun de rten 'brel gyi khyad nas dbang rdzas la blangs/nyer bzhir rnam sras snyan grags sgrub pa'i dung 'bud kyi rjes gnang zhus/ rnam sras skor la stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi yig cha zhig 'dug pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags dang khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i chog sgrigs rnams dang bstun tshe dbu ha cang tshos mdog ma kha yang rna ba 'dreg snga ba 'di bka' brgyud pa'i spyi srol yin pas log rtog tu mi sems/ gong nas khang gsar rab brtan dang 'bum thang bsod dbang gnyis rgyal po'i bka' shog rten sbrags/ mkhar mtshor 'grem rgyur bka' shog smyug mdong gnyis khyer byung ba blangs/ so so'i phyag rten tshan grangs dang lhag tu bsod nams dbang pos gnang sbyin gyi gser sga byin/ khong gnyis mtsho kha nas thon pa'i skad cha snga pa la dus la ma 'byor ba khang gsar rab brtan lha sa pa'i brtul zhugs kyi tshong zog mangs pas lan 'phros snang yang sde pas khyab bdag bla ma'i dbon por gong brgyab kyis brjod med du bzhag song bas legs thog tu 'khyol/nyer drug la lha ri bla ma dang mnga' ris gra tshang gnyer pa/ tshe dbang rgyal mo'i log mi bcas dang phrad/ sa skya zhabs drung yab sras nas bka' stsal gnang (226ba)ba bzhin byang chub bar du 'bral ba —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)med pa'i smon lam dang ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ dpal ri sprul skus bskul ba'i smon lam rnams brtsams/ chu glang zla ba lnga pa nas zla ba 'di'i nyer dgu'i bar lha sa khyams ra chen mor gra tshang res skor gyis 'di ga'i rim gror dkon cog brtsegs pa nyis brgya dang bcu/ 'bum chig stong dang gsum/brgyad stong pa lnga stong bdun brgya don gsum/ ting 'dzin rgyal po chig brgya/ gzungs bsdus chig brgya/gser 'od sum brgya so gnyis/ bskal bzang bzhi brgya zhe gnyis/ sman bla brgyad khri drug stong drug brgya dang bcu/ mtshan brjod chig 'bum bdun khri chig stong drug brgya/ tshe gzungs lnga 'bum lnga khri bdun stong drug cu/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i cho ga dang rnam rgyal stong mchod so sor dge 'dun brgyas zla gcig bar btang ba nged rang nas ched bstad byed pa ma shar yang sde pas do dam mdzad/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen por chos yon gyi skyes bzang bar dbul nas hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la gtsang phyogs su chibs kha bskyod/ mas dro chad ka spyan snga/ lho brag gdang dgon gsar/ khams ldan ma sa dkar/nub dgon/ kong po nags phu bzhi'i bla ma/ sde pa phon mdo ba/ kong po 'brug chos sdings pa'i gnyer pa/ rmi phu dgon gyi ring 'tsho re rten 'byung bsgrig mi/ u khe re'i bu dbon chung gi mi sna bos bos che/ dur ge che'i mi sna shes rab dge slong / bang rim snye thang gi (227na)em chi/ lung nag dar khan nang so sogs dang phrad cing sog yul nas 'ongs pa rnams kyis ster cha mang bar byas/ o rod dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i mi sna u'i ching dar khan nang so mngags te tshogs/ 'khor ster sbyin 'gyed sogs bzabs par bstar nas gra tshang gis dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung bsgrigs pa'i zhan byung du bstan 'dzin chung tha'i ji'i mi sna se chen chos rje/ u khe re'i tha'i ji'i shog nas rab 'byams chos rje/ mkhas pa rgya mtsho'i nu bo 'jam dbyangs rnams kyis kyang dngos po'i tshan grangs spams mtho ba byin/ dga' ldan chung tha'i jis gtsos pa'i yi ge rten sbrags ches mang ba dang bstan 'dzin khung tha'i ji'i rten du stod hor gyis gos chen dngom che ba mer bsregs na phal cher gser du 'gyur zer ba'i khyad mtshar yang byung / skyar bo ba blo bzang legs ldan mtsho sngon po phyogs su mi snar 'gro ba'i gegs sel la —316

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang lo grangs dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bskul/ mnga' ris gra tshang gra pa 'ga'i 'dod pa ltar 'khor gsum gyi tshe mchod yar rbad bcas/ mnga' bdag bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gshegs pa'i bsngo rten nyang ring po che'i gter snod zangs sgrom du grags pas gtsos pa'i khyad mtshar 'byor don bzhin sa lam gyi gegs sel ba'i bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab cing spang ston ngag dbang chos rgyal sogs kyi ngor bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i smon lam/ dpal ldan yaṃ gha bza' la gter (227ba)gzhung gi zin sor mdos kyi gsal kha yod na'ang chog bsgrigs khyer bde zhig mi 'dug pa dang byas na legs sam snyam pa'i 'khrul snang yang byung bar brten 'phrin las yid bzhin gter mdzod rnams bris/tshes brgyad nas bzung bdun gcig gi bar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bcad rgya'i sgo nas tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa'i kha gso byas/ tshes bco brgyad la mnga' ris khri rtse mkhan zur pa/rgyas shod ban mkhar bla ma/ stong gzhongs pa pha bu/ brtul mi ming sring / o rod nas rtse chen rgyal po'i rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan/ kha dan no yon gyis gtsos dpon chung bdun/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bkra shis/ sbyor rā chi dge slong / er te ni chos rje/ brag pa sha ba kha pa dkon cog bkra shis sogasasum brgya skor dang phrad cing sha ba kha pas dngul gyis thog drangs bdog pa'i skyes bstar/ brag dbar gra tshang nas gra pa brgya rtsa dang kho sho'u tha'i jir ja gral btang /nyer gsum la bde yangs dang sdings kha slob dpon du bsko rgyu'i tshag khur rab 'byams pa dang dka' bcu dpal 'byor can dge slong brgyad dang dge tshul gnyis bsgrubs/ thob yig po ti phyi ma gnyis/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi mchan 'grel dang 'grel ṭīka /las chen kun rgyal ba'i bka' dge dgongs pa gcig sgrub kyi dri lan mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i kye rdor dbang gi lhan thabs/ gser 'od rnga sgra rnams kyi par 'byor/bod khams (228na)kyi nad rims bzlog thabs su rdzong khag kha shas nas mgon po g.yul bzlog /khro rol/—317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bstan ma'i mdos khag gsum re/ nges gsang rdor gling pas ma mo gling bzhi'i mdos rnams btang /'bras spungs mchod khang chen mor bka' 'gyur khang gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i dbus su rten gtso yum chen mo sman sku mi tshad ma/ de'i g.yas g.yon rten star bdun gyi dang por thugs rten drug cu re gsum/de 'phros drug la 'phags bod kyi li rigs dang rgya nag gsar rnying / bka' gdams ma sogs rag sku sna tshogs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam chos srung gi snang brnyan 'dres pa brgya don dgu/ de'i g.yas g.yon du snga sor gyi thang po cher bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur de dang / mtshal par ma tshar nyis khri bcas/ mchod rdzas mdun cog bzhi tshar steng du gser dngul gyi maṇḍal che chung drug /gi gu shel/ da khab/ rag gsum gyi maṇḍal lnga/ dung dkar gsum/ g.yang shi'i dam phor gsum/ khri rdo dang nya phyisakyi phor sder nyer dgu/ gi gu shel gyi bya ma bum dam gzugs sogs spyad pa so gcig dang dkar yol gyi dgu bcu go drug /blug shel gyi so bdun/ li rag 'khar gsum gyi ting drug cu re drug /me dam brgyad/spos 'dzin spos phor bcas pa dgu/ ye pha 'u'i par bu snod bcas gsum/ brtse ru'i rwa gsum/ khro rag gi kong drug /bzang gos khra bsgrigs kyi gnam rgyan sbyib khebs/ gdung khebs gser ma dmar ser (228ba〉sngo gsum khra spel la kha btags kyi lce la bzhi bsgrigs btags pa rnams dang / 'khrungs rabasalha khang du lho nas byang gzigs rten star drug gi dang po'i rten gtso thub dbang li dmar/ gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang chos li/ gsum pa byams pa li brdzus/ bzhi pa thub dbang li dkar/ lnga pa 'jam dbyangs bka' gdams ma/ drug pa sgrol ma li brdzus rnams kyi g.yas g.yon du li rigs sna tshogs dang rgya nag bka' gdams ma sogs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems kyi snang brnyan brgya dang nyer bzhi/ mdun cog bang rim gnyis kyi steng dngul gyi maṇḍal gnyis dang rag gi gcig /dkar yol dang blug shel gyi phor sder dam gzugs sogs so brgyad rnams bsgrigs shing mchod khang chen mo'i steng shod kyi lha khang bcu so sor zhal zas dang mchod me sdong rkang gsum re'i mchod sprin gyi rgyun ji srid kyi bar du btsugs par lo rer rtsam mkhar khal cig brgya brgyad cu dang mar khal lnga brgya bdun cu re/ de mtshungs sngags —318

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadakhang gi mchod khang steng shod gnyis la zhal zas gsum re dang mchod me sdong rkang gnyis re'i rgyun la lo rer rtsam mkhar khal so drug dang mar khal zhe lnga re 'gro bar snang /dgung lo nga dgu par sde par sku rten dngos chas sa ris dang bcas pa stsal ba dang / po tā la dang chos 'khor rgyal gyi zhig gsos/ sde srid blo bzang sbyin pa sde srid kyi khri la 'khod pa bcas kyi skor/dus rim le tshan dang shing yos gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i srid gsum bdag mo'i mchod pa dang rin chen rgyan sprod sogs zhugs gral snga rting thams cad sngar 'khrud bzhin byas/ rkang 'gos cung zad zhel bas mchod khang rtse'i skas mi bde ba'i gshis gtor skyong rten 'dogs nyi (229na)'od du bgyis pa kha ba babs pa dang thug pas stabs 'grig par byung / 61 gsar la kha ba cung zad babs kyang mi shis pa re yong 'dug pa 'di res shin tu che bas tshang ma rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du mang du 'phel/tshes gsum la mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ 'brong rtse nas/ rnam sras gling nas/ rab brtan shar pa/ bla ma dung dkar sku skye/ phyag mdzod dbu ma ba'i bu/ se chen khan gyi dpon mo rnams dang phrad/ sde par kha ba'i dogs sel la tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma brgya rtsa dang dpal ldan lha mo dung skyong ma/ khal kha u rang khang bing thu da'i chin skor la 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang bskur/ drung 'tsho ba ngag dbang lhag bsam 'di skor la do gal shin tu che bsad lam gtong rtsis yin kyang khams ma bde ba'i gshis bang chen zhig la mor btang ste snyan shal gser skyems dmod nas dang bcas sku khog sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi tsha bor sku phebs zhu bcug pa g.yar dam gyi zhal bzhes ma 'gyur bar phebs pa'i gnas tshul ma 'gyangs par 'byor/—319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khe)tshes dgu da la'i rgyal por lo gsar la gangs babs pa'i dogs sel du tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang rnams phul/ sne'u sdong bdag mo 'byon bzhugs mdzad pa skya ser tshang ma'i blor mi shong ba'i brjod gleng gi sgro skur mang ba dang de la brten pa'i dge skyon kyang ci rigs snang ba rang bstan la rgyar slebs chung ba 'dug pa blos ma bzod (229ba)cing sde pa glang lo'i mjug tu snyan drag la yun ring tsam byung ba nas zur bzhugs byas chog pa dgos tshul nan gyis byung ba gsol skal sogs gang 'dod phra brtsegs ga la byed kyang bdag mo yum sras gzi brjid dang ldan bzhin par phyir byon na yid srubs snying zhugs kyi sgro btags mkhan po rnams kyis bstan sel gyi rdzun ris 'jig par mi nus par ma zad yum sras de tsam bzhes pa'i babs 'brel kyang mi 'dug pa bcas sgo du ma nas drag shul gyi cho gas phyir skrod dgos shar ba sde pa'ang tsha shur ba yod gshis re zhig shun du bskyil dgos byung ba bstan par bsam pa'i mi byed ka med las yid slong slong por gyur cing phyi yul du mi mdzes tsam las nang du bag phebs rtsis kyi ngag dbang smon lam dang blo bzang chos ldan rgyun gyi nye 'khor ba yin pa btang ste dgos cha'i rigs thogs med dang 'dam chu ma 'phros dogs gtsang chu nas len pa sogs kyi bkod pa byas/ de yang bdag mo dbyung ba'i dgos dbang tsam yin na'ang thog mar rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i ngo chen dang de rjes chos sde chen po ser 'bras gnyis/ rgyud stod smad/ grong smad sogs nye skor ba 'ga' zhig gis rgyu mtshan/'bri gung pa ni sngar nas ya rabs pa'i grags pa dang mthun par 'di gar ster cha rta khrab kyi bdog pa bteg ste sprul sku rin po che'i chab shog khyer nas phyag mdzod dkon cog rgyal mtshan ma 'gyangs pa 'byor/ rgyal po/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa/ skyid shod khag gsum/ gter ston rin po che/ dga' (230na〉rdon gsang sngags gling pa/ ri bo chos gling pa/ thar pa gling pa sogs lha sde mi sde mang pos gsol chas dang bdog pa nyin grangs kha yar gyi bar rim bzhin spel rtsis 'dod pa dang mthun par sbyar bcug /stod cung zad bsnyung bar 'phrod bsten la dar mo ba dang gzhan yang nyer len dbu mdzad/—320

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)mchod dbon/ gra tshang gnyer pa sogs btang /tshes bcu gnyis la khal kha bing thu tha'i ji 'khor bcas rdzong bda' bgyis shing er khe chos rje gsar slebs dang drung 'khor lnga bcu skor dang phrad/ smon lam chen mor dge 'dun stong phrag dgur nye bar mang ja'i thog kha btags re/ gra pa rer dngul zho re'i rtsis yol ba bla bre/ gos sna mang ba/ dkar spyad/ dngul spyad/ rta sga 'khor sogs gra pa rer rgun 'brum mkhar bre re dang bcas pa'i 'gyed gsum btang / gong dkar du chos sde pa lnga bdus zhag bco lnga'i bar tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sgrub mchod/ 'phyong rgyas su bkra shis chos sde ba zhal grangs dang yun gong 'dras rnam rgyal stong mchod/ thang po cher gsol mchod brgya rtsa'i thog spyan gzigs sgron dar dang bcas sku phebs zhus/tshes bcu bzhi nas gra tshang du gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i drag sngags bzlog pa dang bcas pa bye ba re btsugs/ 'bum thang bsod nams dbang po rgyal thang phyogs su byed sgo'i rgyu mtshan smed pa dang sog po thabs mkhas da la'i khung tha'i jis gtsos par blo 'khol mi dgos pa'i gnas tshul skyel bar btang / phing sing ching dbang (230ba)gis dar rtse mdo brgyud 'di gar gser srang nyi shu dang rgyal por srang bcu'i skyes dang bcas yi ge byung bar de lan rin po che'i rten ldan 'gyangs med skyel bar brdzangs/ spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho bsam yas su chos skyong dpon blon la tshogs mchod spyan gzigs dang bcas btang ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin chos rgyal chen po khog zhugs kyi las mkhan tshes gsum gyi nyin byang sham bha lar 'gro zhes zer bas de ring yod pa med tshul/ dri ba dang 'phrin yig gi lan rim gro dgos tshul mdzad cing sang las mkhan e yong bltas par 'gal ba med gsungs pa ltar sku phebs zhus pas gnod sbyin chen po ma phebs par chos skyong chen po zhugs nas ka ba rnams la 'bag bsdams te gar mkhan gyi thad du ḍā ma ru dkrol zhing lag tu rde'u chung thogs pa'i gar mkhan khyed nub zangs thang dmar po'i phyogs su song la sde brgyad 'gugs pa'i las kyis/ de bzhin du bdud mo la byang 'brong po'i phyogs dang spre'ur lho nags rong gi phyogs gsung ba ci yin dris par las —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)mkhan gyis bslabs byung zhes rab rib mdzad nas gsal bar ma bstan/ zla ba phyi ma'i tshes gsum la bskyar ma btang bar gnod sbyin chen po phebs te rgya gtam bod du mi shong ba lab par yongs sam zhes 'tshub kyi rnam 'gyur dang bcas ma gro'i bslab bya 'phrin lan du rgyas par mdzad/ tshes bcu drug la se chen khan gyi shog nas sbyo rā chis gtsos gsar slebs/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ dpal 'bar bla ma (231na)sogs dang phrad cing gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po phebs pa dang mjal/tshes bcu bdun la sngags pa se chen pa'i sku skye dang er khe chos rjes dngul lnga bcu ma nyer gcig gis thog drangs pa'i bdog pa gya nom pa bstar/ tshes nyi shur tre bo hor tshang chos rjes ster cha tshogs mas 'gyed dang bcas pa'i yon sbyar te gra tshang gis tshe dpag med kyi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung mdzad/ dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa 'phrin gsol tshigs bcad dang bcas la mor sku phebs la btang ba khog pa sngon ma rnams kyi dus kyang gsung rgyu dang rnam 'gyur sogs zla re tsam gyi bar ji bzhin mi yong ba'i rgyun ltar sku phebs pa tsam las yig lan gyis mtshon pa'i gsal cha che ba mi 'dug rung tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs phul bas rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig /thar pa mkhan po 'od mchog pa'i ngor bla ma bde chen dbang phyug gi brgyud 'debs bris/nyer gsum la dga' ldan khri rin po che smon lam gyi thugs brel chod pa'i phebs gdong ngos mjal zhus/ nyer bzhir rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan 'khor bcas la seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang bskur/ nyer drug la u jo'i thu pā thur tha'i jis gtsos pa'i bod sog gi dmag g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam snyan skyel mi 'byor ba dar 'phyar rgyas par byas shing nyer gsum gyi bar gra tshang gis chos skyong spyi bye brag la gtang rag bzabs par btang / de dag ci bder bzhag na slar yang dus mi bde ba'i rtsa rkyen du 'gro zhing lus (231ba)srog la tsa ra sogs kyi sdig rgyun yang gang ci nas skabs su ma phye bas zhod 'jags ched du drag rigs nyi shu skor dbus gtsang du 'khrid cing bying khrod nas na rgan pa skya rtsar bsdam ra dang gzhan ma rnams khams stod smad kyi sde dgon dpon rigs rdzong gzhis —322

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadatshor zos bder 'jog pa'i yig ngag dang bcas pho nya phyir slog /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo bla ma dam pa du ma'i drung du dbang dang byin rlabs sogs zab chos mang pho lhan cig tu nos gshis sde pa'i sems bsregs pa'i sel 'don du dmigs te gnam gang nas bdun gcig gi bar gra tshang du na rag skong bshags/ rdzong gzhis dang 'brel ba'i dgon sde gzhan dag nas dri med bshags rgyud bdun stong nyis brgya/ bskal bzang bco brgyad/ dwags po gra tshang pas ma ṇi dung phyur/ yang rdzong du rdo rje brag dang shel brag tu rdzogs chen pa gra slob bdun res tshogs brgya rnams byas/ rtse gdong zhabs drung rin po che nā lan da nas yar chibs kha bskyod gdong mgron gnyer gnang byung bar sde pa dang thugs nang dag na sku ngo dang de min 'di gar nyer len tsam gnang dgos gras las snyan gyi dbang po 'jim pas bgags pa lta bu'i 'phros ye med par gtan tshigs kyi rgyab snon yang bskyar dgos phebs pa phul yod cing ma gzhi thugs shin tu chung ba'i skya 'byar sngo 'byar la skabs 'gar thugs ji mi snyam pa'i ras chung pa'i lta ba zhig gnang gi yod tshod du 'dug /hor zla dang po nyis brtsegs kyi phyi ma'i (232na〉pos gcig la lo dus kyi mang 'gyed/ ser 'bras gnyis mi the ba'i dbus khul gyi dgon adhi dang po'i gra pa brgyad rer dngul srang re/ gtsang khul/yar 'brog /lho brag /nyang kong bcas pa'i adhi dang po'i gras gra pa bcu gnyis rer srang re bsdoms srang bzhi stong nyis brgya nga gnyis/ adhi gnyis pa'i gras gra pa bcu gnyis la srang re'i rtsis dang gtsang khul/ yar 'brog /lho brag /nyang kong bcas pa'i gra btsun bco brgyad rer srang re'i rtsis kyi ja ya ju khor drug ma chig brgya nga dgu bsngo rten dang bcas pa rdzong gzhis khag shas nas bka' 'gyur nyis brgya bcu bdun/ sgrol ma dgu khri drug stong sum brgya/ sher snying nyi khri chig stong / tshe gzungs tshig 'bum nyi khri brgyad brgya/ mtshan brjod dang gdugs dkar chig 'bum chog stong lnga brgya re/ gzhis rtser ngor ba sum cus zhag nyi shu'i bar tshe dpag med lha dgu'i 'chi blu dang zhag bcur seng ge sgra'i gdon 'grol/yer par sātstsha 'bum/ rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bskang ba khri/ gur zhal beg tser stong / chos skyong gzhan —323—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khe)rnams la brgya/ ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul bco lnga re'i thog gdugs dkar/ yon la gra pa lngar dngul srang re khyon srang brgyad brgya nyi shu/ ltas ngan bzlog byed du rgyal rtse 'ug bya lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /gong dkar du chos rje dung dgon pa dang / lha khang du smra bo lcog pas khro rol/ bod 'bangasabade thabs su gsang sngags gling pa don brgyad kyis zhag bco lngar bsam pa lhun grub ma (232ba)sogs spyi sgos kyi ched du rim gro tshogs gsog rgyas par bskrun/tshes lnga la ser 'bras kyis gtsos lha sde mi sde rnams kyi thog sa skya dang sne'u sdong rtse/ bkra shis lhun po/ mnga' ris gra tshang gi gnyer pa sogs kyi khag theg pa dang bcas sde par dag pa blangs te phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i bkra shis khang gsar du bzhugs/ tshes brgyad la gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad kyis dgra lha dpangs bstod btang / dpal grong rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis lha sa smon lam chen mor gra skor bgyis pa'i tshe gra tshang du spyi 'bul dngul srang nyer gsum las grub pa'i kong gi kha byang brtsams/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos bdun gcig gi bar padma gling pa'i gur drag gi gtor bzlog mdzad pas rtags legs par byung / tshes bcu bzhir se chen rgyal po/dga' ldan hung tha'i ji/ bstan 'dzin khung tha'i ji sogs kyi mi sna rnams la yi ge rten sbrags bstan don la rgyar khur bsam dgos pa'i bslab bya bdog pa dang bcas rdzong bda' byas shing dga' ldan hung tha'i jis dgos tshul bzhin bla ma rgyud smad rab 'byams pa blo bzang byams pa dang 'tsho byed mas dro rin cen gling blo bzang dkon cog gnyis btang bar bla ma'i ngor dmigs brtse mar brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgom lung phab/ ka tshal zur pa dkon cog lhun grub/ dga' ldan rab stims pa can kha shas dang phrad/tshes bcu bdun la rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan gyis gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i yon sbyar te (233na)gra tshang gis tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs thog gser srang gya brgyad/ dngul srang stong phrag lhag bcas/ gos dar ja pags rigs sogs dngos po spams mtho ba'i ster cha dang tshogs —324

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)su'ang 'gyed gya nom pa btang / tshes nyi shur gsar slebs dbu mdzad chos rje/ ar dag se chen ja'i sang / dar khan dbon po/ u chin dge tshul/ dar khan nang so/rdo rje tha'i ji'i mi snas gtso sebargya skor dang phrad cing gser dngul ja gos dar gyis thog drangs pa'i dpangs bstod pa byung / hor tshang chos rje grongs pa'i bsngo rten rnams byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngos shing dgongs rdzogs mthun rkyen du sha mar 'bru cha sogs thebs rgyas par sprad/ lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam gyi bar mchod dpon gtso bor gyur pa'i lag g.yog khur bsam che zhing / khri thog tu 'khod nas kyang lha sa ra mo ches gtsos pa'i gtsug lag khang gi zhabs tog /dpag bsam 'khri shing dang 'phreng ba'i dkyil thang gis mtshon sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs bkod rin cen rgyan cha/ rta chas/ gdan mas sogs sngon chad sems kyi sog le shing la ma song ba mtha' dag blo dang mthun par bsgrubs/ rab gsal gyi rtogs brjod las/ yul la mngon par phyogs pa'i blo/ /dga' ba'i ro la chags gyur pa/ /gshong gshong mang por ri yi chu/ /rnam par lhung bzhin su yis bzlog /lus ni ngal ba'i bslab pa la/ /'dul bar byed pa kho bo mkhas/ /yid ni sdom pa'i bslab pa la/ /thub pa rnams kyang mkhas pa min/ /zhes(233ba)pa ltar/ phra rgyas kyi dbang du gyur pa tsam las sems skyon gzhan mi snang bas/ rang ngos nas sel med kyi bdag rkyen byed bsam pa dngul dkar gyi me long bzhin rim gyis gsal ba kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa ltar yin mod/ la la dag grong smad a bar dbu mdzad mchod dpon dge bshes sbyin pas gtsos gra tshang phal cher ban rtsar song ba'i lab dbang du btang zhes gleng ba kha phan tshig phan tsam ni thogs pa gzhir bcas gang labs rang byed pa'i spre'u zhig min pa rtogs brjod 'di ga'i mgo mjug la gzigs kyang mkhyen par mchis/nyer gnyis la sde pa po ta lar ngos phrad la 'byor rta bsu drung 'khor rnams mjal dar phyag dbang sogs zur pa'i rtsis kyi bdag rkyen gang che dang bcas phrad/ gung tshigs kyi dus zhib tu mol/phyi dro sde par sku rten skor la/ sangs rgyas kyi yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel phung po che ba gsum stegs bzhugs khang dang bcas pa/ lhas gru bzhi pas bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba gnyis ba shar btsong kha pa blo bzang —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)grags pa'i sku brnyan phyag nas ma rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa'i thugs dam rten/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa brgyad pa'i gras rgyab yol dang bcas pas gtsos klu 'jim li ma rgya nag ma/ rdo mnyen/ rag sku bcas pa'i bla ma/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan thos/ chos skyong sogs kyi sku brnyan na bza' dang bcas pa lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ rtsa gsum gyi lha tshogs kyi tshon thang / gser thang zhe mtshungs dang sna tshogs gong gsham/ zhal khebs/ (234na)tog bcas chig brgya zhe drug snod sgam bcas/ gsung rten bka' 'gyur rin po che skya chos rgyal rtse them spangs ma'i zhal bshus bris shog legs pa yongs rdzogs glegs shing / glegs thag /gdong dar dang bcas pa/ par ma brgyad stong pa/ bskal bzang mdzangs blun/ gra tog gser gsum/ klu 'bum dkar po/ gzungs bsdus/ bka' gdams glegs bam/ rgyud bzhi/ cha lag bco brgyad/ nged rang gis gsar rtsom gras sogs glegs shing / glegs thag dang bcasapa'i pusta gaḥdon gcig /thugs rten gser zangs las grub pa'i bder gshegs mchod rten brgyad bzo legs pa/ mchod rdzas skor la/ ma na ho/ g.yang ṭi/ gi gu shel/ dngas shel/ ljang ser/ rag sogs kyi spyad pa sna tshogs zhe gcig khyu sna tshogs kyi ting so brgyad/ mchod kong chig brgya go drug /sbug sil bzhi/ dril bu gsum/ dung rgya gling so so cha/ gos 'phan sna tshogs zhe bzhi/ thod ṭwāṃ gcig /hor dus kyi ting shags cha gnyis/ dngul gyi nang mchod kā pa la cha/ rag lcags kyi spos phor bzhi/zangs dmar gyi gtor cha brgya char/ ya mgu ma mgu dang bcas pa/ spos mdong dang spos gsho me rtsi ma re/ dngos spyad skor la/ dga' ldan sgar zhwa dang sba zhwa phru yod med legs nyes bsdoms pa bgrag ga /na phyis kyi tse ber legs pa gcig /lding slog /rtsag pa/ chu pa bcas so bzhi/ ska rags bkrol ma gnyis snag smyug thel shubs dang bcas pa/ g.yang ṭi (234ba)gser bkongs ma'i pha'u bzhi/ dor ma drug /bod sog gi lham cha so gcig /smad g.yogs bzhi/ stod 'gag sum cu/ sham thabs drug /ska rags nyi shu/ gzan phrug chen phrug chung 'jag can brgyad/ ther gzan spu hrug 'dres pa bco brgyad/gos kyi 'gan sbyar drug /gon phying gnyis/ sbu la ga /dbyi/ wa mo/ snam bu bcas pa'i sbyar ma dang zha —326

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)thul bcu drug /gzan phrug chen bcu dgu/ gos gdan kha gang ma dang gos 'jag nyer bdun/ gdan dkyus ma bcu gnyis ras ther gyi rkyong gdan sna tshogs drug cu tham pa/ 'bol gcig /snye 'bol gsum/ sa gdan sna tshogs nyer gsum/ kha gdan gnyis/ stag gzig gi gdan dang grum 'jag bcu re/ khri grum/ lo grum/ dkyus grum/ grum yug sogs brgyad cu gya drug /stan dmar brgyad/ ban khebs sba ri brgyad/ 'bog 'jo gsum/ dgas sle brgyad/ 'og 'jug gnyis/ gos dang snam bu'i stod gos nyi shu tham pa/ sna thig dang sngon po'i gos gsum/ lham nyer gcig /bzang gos kyi bla bre lnga/gos/ dar/ ras/ la ta sogs kyi yol ba nyer drug /rten khebs sna tshogs bcu/ mu tig /spos shel/gzi/ mchong / g.yang ṭi drug gi brgya 'phreng / shal dkar dmar/ kong rna pad 'dab/ dpral g.yu/g.yu rdog rnams re/ spos shel rdog che chung gsum/ gser zho bzhi brgya/ grang gser zho re bzhi/ rgya dang khams kyi dngul srang chig stong / kha btags nyin bde ma dang rtags brgyad kha btags lnga/ mthing khra che chung nyer bdun/ kha btags che chung (235na stig stong / pi cing kha btags bcu gnyis/ sman tse gsar rnying 'dres pa yug brgya/ dar ling tshos sna tshogs yug brgya dang gcig /ding phon gser tshon ma che ba gcig dang ska rags ma gcig /bum gdan ma gnyis/ gos kha thi rnying ma/ mthon thi/ cod ldan/log thang / 'phan 'khor sogs tshos kha sna tshogs yug phyed nyis brgya/ hu ja nag po 'dres pa khor drug ma so brgyad/ ya ju khor drug ma brgya dang gsum/ sha shan dang 'u zi brgya dang so bdun/ zi ling sbu ja/sun tsha/ tā tsha 'dres pa ko dra chig brgya/ snam bu dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang / sngo/ rgya rnams thig dang rkyang pa legs nyes 'dres pa 'dom tshig khri sum stong phyed drug brgya/ phying dkar dos bcu/ sbom tshar khom do/ shog bu bcu deb chig stong / bal khyem bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu tham pa/ gde snal lcags lnga brgya dang sum cu so bdun/ zam so/ spu kha/ spen bubs/ dril/cog ras/ lho ras rnams bsdoms par yug nyis stong bdun brgya re bzhi/ 'bras ltang chig brgya/ rgun ltang bcu drug /zhal dkar sgobs shubs cha 'grig /dngul stegs 'dzed zhal dang bcas pa/ gan dkar bcu/ dkar sang / sngo khra/ yu ring /—327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)yu thung bcas pa shubs bcas chig brgya sum cu/gos kyi sder gdan legs pa gsum dang dkyus ma chig brgya/dngul gyi lte ri shubs bcas gsum/sdir bu che chung gsum/sder ma cha/skyogs gcig/thur ma gcig/mdong mo che ba gcig rnams dngul dang /sgog mā 235bsko sum/gos ding btagasakyi pang khebs/rag sder gcig/bsgos phor gser gshog ma gcig/ja phor drug/rten khebs lnga/gsol khebs dang gsol gdan lnga re/ gri chung gcig /gangs phrug shubs gcig /ra shel dang g.yang ṭi'i phor pa shubs bcas re/zo lag brgyad/sder ma legs nyes bsdoms pa chig stong chig brgya so drug/li 'gag/rag 'gag bsdoms pa chig brgya dang gcig/sgam dang skong tse gnyis re snod dang bcas pa/khro zangs bsdoms par bzhi bcu zhe gcig/lcags zangs kyi kha gcod nyer gnyis/zangasaban cha gnyis/lcags skyed gsum dang lcags thab gcig/ka ṭo ra che chung nyer lnga/gzheng sgor sgor bzhi/khol me mchu bcas gnyis/ja tshags dang lcags skam bzhi re/me khyim gcig/lcags slang lnga/lcags zangs kyi skyogs bcu gsum/mar thur gnyis/lcags gzar dang gri rdob re/lcags zangs kyi zhu kong bcu/'gar bum gnyis/rag zangs kyi lta ri re dang sba stir lnga/lcags kyi me 'then gnyis/sta re gnyis/mdong mo brgyad/ko lteb gcig /chu zom bzhi/sbag phor khebs yod med sna tshogs chig brgya/bse sto ra legs pa nyi shu/gser sga/dngul sga/ra ma lug/gsar chas gnyis kyis gtsos cha 'grig sum cu so lnga/'theb la srab rmed gong gsum tsher gsum dang /yab gdan gnyis/mtshal/mthing /spang ma/ba bla/sdong ros/li khri sogs sna 'dzom rkyal khug bco lnga/rtsa rtsi zangs ban gang /tsandan 236na ti kar dmar rdum bzhi/a ka ru nyer brgyad/gu gul dkar nag mkhar khal chig brgya/stod ja khal don lnga/zangs khal chig brgya brgyad cu/bye skar khal nyer bzhi/bur khal drug brgya dang bcu gsum/rams dpus legs nyes khal lnga bcu/rgya chos khal nyis brgya/khrog sman khal nga gcig/dmar tshos khal chig stong brgyad brgya re bdun/ zhun khal brgyad brgya/tshwa gshor khal chig stong /bul khal chig brgya/rgya byi'i khrag rmog/dong pa daXr thag/gri khe gsum 'dzab bcas/sgrod ma/

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)mtshal phub/ mdung / lcags gzhibs dang bcas pa cha 'grig /gri sog po dang dmar bcas brgyad/bu la ha ri'i sag thag /mda' gzhu cha 'grig /gur che ba yol sgor dang bcas pa cha 'grig gnyis dang / g.yabs yol skor dang bcas pa gcig /dkyus gur dkar nag drug /g.yabs bcu gcig /phying gur gnyis rnams la 'jug tshas thag cha ka gdung dang bcas pa cha 'grig /me slang gcig /sam ṭa bcu gsum/ sgam che chung nyi shu/ sgrong tse brgyad/ ko 'bog nyer gcig /khrog tshas la gos dar gyi 'bog /sles ras snam sogs mang du song / rme phu ngang pa/ tshogs rgyal 'ol bas gtsos rta so gcig /dre'u sum cu/ gong gsal rin gong khyon gcig tu bsdoms par dngul srang nyi khri dgu brgya bdun cu/'bru thog tu phab par gzhor khal sum 'bum lnga khri drug stong bzhi brgya go brgyad rnams/zangs ri lhun grub rab brtan rdzong gi bka' rgya dang rtsis 'khror yod pa'i dngos spyad/ 'bru cha (236bsom snum/ sha mar/ gnag lug so gos dang sras po tshe dbang gi zog zangs rir drangs pa rnams bsdoms par mkhar khal brgyad khri sum stong bdun brgya drug cu/ mi ser bsdad grong che chung nyis brgya sum cu/ lag 'bab chig khri chig stong nyis brgya bco lnga/ khyung po do/ shar re/ skyi khu brag /gram mda'/ the po ra/ snye mo lung /na mar/ sram sna sogs kyi them 'dzin bsdad grong nyis brgya bcu dgu/ sngar yod kyi chas dang lag 'bab bsgril bar mkhar khal dgu stong brgyad brgya/ grib zhang lha tshi sa spus grong bcas mi ser bsdad grong lnga bcu nga gcig /sngar chas 'bru thog tu phab pa sum stong bzhi brgya nga gcig lag 'bab sum stong bdun brgya nga lnga/ lha sa dpal 'byor rab brtan/ dar rtse mdo/ so gar/ skyid mos tshal bcas pa dang blo mdar gtogs pa'i mi ser/ them 'dzin nyer brgyad/ lag 'bab khal chig stong drug brgya gya gnyis/ gong gsal sku gsung thugs rten dngos mas sa ris kyi yongs sgo bsdoms par khal bzhi 'bum bdun khri brgyad stong sum brgya bcu bzhi rnams sprad/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung sha rī ram mthe'u chung gi mgo tsam/rigs 'dzin ratna gling pa'i gter sku padma mthong grol/ byang gter gyi slob dpon chen po'i phyag phur dza la nag po las grub pa'i 'bar ba mchog /dpyal pa'i rdo rje thog bzlog ma sogs kyi byin rten yang —329—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'dod pa dang sbyar/ de dgongs rdzong du bzhugs/ bzhed pa ltar rgyun 'don tshigs bcad gcig brtsams/nyer gsum la (237na)dmag zor mar 'phrin bcol gyi bka' bsgo dang bcas bkra shis khang gsar du gteg /sa ris nang chas dang bcas rtsis sprod la gra tshang gnyer pa dang dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa/ spun drug rdzong pa dang don grub dbang rgyal sogs drung 'khor skya ser sum cu skor rogs byed du brdzangs pa'i zangs rir thon/ rong byams chen gyi gra pa rab 'byams pa mdo rgyud rgya mtshos 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i rgyugs sprad cing tshar brgya bcu bdun nged rang gi rim gror 'don zer ba ltar yon sbyar/ sde pa lhun po rdzong pas phyag bris rten du gnubs khu lung pa'i phyag mtshan byin can bskur ba mdzad/ 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis gra tshang gi zhal 'don shog bu lnga brgya skor gyi rgyugs sprad/ sngon bsags kyi steng du da lta bar gcig 'phel gnyis 'phel las grib stug po 'di la phan du re ba'i lha sa khyams rar bde yangs pa drug cus zhag bco lnga'i bar dkar sdor bshad tshod dang mthun pa'i sman bla'i mdo chog sum stong drug brgya/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol dgu brgya/ lhung bshags nyi khri bdun stong dang mu 'thud nas zhag bco lngar tog gzungs/ khye'u sa zhus pa'i mdo/ rdo rje mchu/ gnam lcags mchu/ snang brgyad/ gza' yum rnams so sor brgya/ gdugs dkar sum khri bdun stong tshig brgya/ thang skya bas brgyad stong pa nyis stong dang bcu/ sgrol ma tshig khri bzhi stong lnga brgya/ sher snying brgyad stong bdun brgya/ tshe gzungs nyi khri drug stong / ser (237ba 'bras so sor zla re'i bar ja tshul thog 'bras spungs pas gdugs dkar chig 'bum nyis brgya/ se rar sher snying sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum song ba'i yon du nas mkhar khal gnyis re'i rtsis kyi gser 'gyed/ dga' ldan gyis gtsos dbus khul nas dgon pa brgya dang bcu gnyis la mang ja sbyor sbrel bsngo rten dang 'gyed gra pa rer khal re ma'i rtsis kyi dga' ldan chos 'khor rgyal du gser/ de phyin thag nyer ya sa ring bar sngo chas/ dngos spyad mang ba btang / gra tshang la rgya nag ma shas che ba'i sku brnyan lnga bcu nga drug skor spyi rdzas su sbyar/ gter ston rin po che gra bcas kyis bdun gcig gi ring gshin rje dregs 'joms kyi —330

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)mnan pa dang gtor bzlog mdzad par rtags legs par byung / 'di ga'i rim gror gra tshang nas lha mo'i gsang mdos sum khri drug brgya dang mu 'thud du nyin gsum beg tse'i bskang ba nyis khri lnga brgya/nyin gcig rgyal btsan gyi gsol kha mdzad/ lo 'di'i dbyar stod phal cher phyogs mtha'i dri smed kyi bslab bya'i yig lan dang kha mchu che phra'i gzu zas gnon chad las kyis mtshon pa'i tsa ra'i rigs sogs mi lus stong zad kyi 'du 'god kho na lhur blangs mod 'brug pa padma dkar po'i gsung mgur du/ skabs 'gar mi nag skye bo'i khrod/ /sdig can gyi srog la tsa ra btang / /zhes shin tu dgyes pa'i zhal pho ltar na rnga brdungs dar 'phyar kyang byas chog pa'i tshod du yod do/ /rin lding pa'i rtse mo'i thebs kyi bar tsho gra khang chu rta sgar pa'i chas bcol bskungs pa brdol bas sde pa (238na)bsod nams rab brtan gyis nyes chad la bzhes pa don smin gyi babs 'brel mi 'dug rung khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po'i bka' nan dang sgrub mchod bstan rgyun la gong brgyab khang pa dang dngos gzhi lho dgon pa'i sdod gnas su sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dus chos 'dug pa bsgyur bkod ma thub pa'i tshab gzer chen pa'i 'dzin shul phun tshogs gling gra khang sbyar ba cung kha ma longs tshul mkhan rin po ches gser gyi rten dang bcas rdor legs pa yang bskyar byung don ltar rang gzhung gra khang sprad/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la jo shāka gis gtsos pa'i ra sa/ ra mo che/ po ta la gsum gyi sku brnyan rags rim la srang do zho drug gis zhal gser/ dbu mthing / spyan 'byed zhib rgyas su bstar/gnas chung lcog tu gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos mkha' 'gro grib sel smin rgyas su mdzad/tshangs pa dung thod can khog tu zhugs kyang lo rer lan cig tsam las mi phebs tshul stag rtse tha'i ji sogs la gsungs pa thos par brten sngar lugs ltar skye rgu'i legs nyes ston par 'byon dgos pa'i 'phrin gsol tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs dang bcas chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse btang /tshes lngar rme ru bas khyams rar la sum 'bum/ sog dmangs drag zhan med par mi rer tā tshang nyag —331—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenare/ mar nyag lnga re/ snam dkar 'dom lnga re btang bar ja mkhar rgya'i khal go drug lhag bcu gsum/mar khal bzhi brgya gya gsum nyag lnga/ snam dkar rgyug 'dom dgu stong drug brgya re lnga (238ba)lha sa'i sgo 'gyed la ya ju nyag re'i rtsis khor drug ma bcu bdun/ sprang po drug brgya skor la ja thug thog rtsam khal lnga bcu nga bdun/ so hrug khog chig brgya don gcig /rgya ja'i sigs skogs bzhi brgya gya brgyad/ yer pa man nas tshar sna yan gyi rdo lha lnga brgya dang zhe dgu/ ma ṇi bzhi stong sum brgya re dgur spyan 'byed dang mchod rten sum brgya nyi shu'i zhig gsos byed pa'i do dam sgo mo rab pa ratna sī sha can gyis byas te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ sde pa zangs rir 'byon gdong shing stag nag chen stabs nas ma thub pa ma gtogs sgo mchor gyi zhig gsos da lo rang gnang dgos yod tshul 'phros gleng mdzad pa ltar sger logs a dar bsgyur bkod byed dgos kyi bslab ston nyan par sde pa'i sar btang ba bzhin tshes bcur las 'go btsugs te hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la grub cing sgo mangs bya gdang sogs gsar du bskrun pas sra mdzes byung khul yin/ 'go mi dang bkod pa sger logs blo bzang dar rgyas/ las rgyab kyi skyid grong kun dga' dpal bzang / spel bzhi dbang rgyal/ shing bzo dbu mdzad gra phyi dgos dgos/ rdo bzo dbu mdzad spangs gog mgon po sogs dgos byed 'don pas mtshon rogs ram byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos byas/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po gra bcas kyi bdun phrag gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la mi bsrun pa'i 'byung po'i rig la bsreg pa'i sbyor ba dang bcu gsum la gtor bzlog rgyas par mdzad/ tshes bco brgyad la la mo nas tshangs pa dung thod can gyis (239na)rim gro'i bskul ma'i gsung 'phrin byung ba khog zhugs sngon ma rnams kyi dus dang khyad par med pa'i yid ches kyi gnas su 'dug cing de lan tshigs bcad du phul/ lus med kyis 'tshub ltas che bar rdo rje slob dpon dge slong blo gros rgyal bas byas te gra tshang gis rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi sgo nas 'gong po spyi dang bye brag chu mig dkar mo'i dam sri ar la gtad pa'i drag sngags bye ba'i mjug tu hom gyi las sbyor dang bcas bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs bsgrubs/ rin —332

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)chen sgang pa dbang rgyal rdo rjes rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dgos tshul byung ba khog zhugs myur du yong la re'i gang rgyas byas pa rjes gnang drug 'tshams rlung sogs rkyen ye med par gtor ma cog tse'i steng nas lhung ba gas chag ni byung ma song / de skabs dpyad ma shes rung phya phyo de dam sri stobs can gyi cho 'phrul du go /la mo nas ging chen tshangs pa'i lung bstan sogs la brten dbus gtsang gi rdzong gzhis rnams nas tshe gzungs chig dung bye ba gcig sa ya gnyis sum 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong bdun brgya/ gdugs dkar chig 'bum nyi khri tshig stong / mtshan brjod sum stong / sher snying chig 'bum nyi khri sum stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshig 'bum sum stong chig brgya lnga bcu/ ri khrod ma'i gzungs drug stong sum brgya/ lha sar brag dbar gra tshang dang gsal khang pa dril bas bka' 'gyur chig brgya/ 'bum chig brgya dang gsum/ ting 'dzin rgyal po chig brgya dang lnga/ bskal bzang chig brgya dang lnga bcu/ nyi khri tshig brgya/(239ba)brgyad stong pa tshig brgya so lnga/ 'bras spungs su rgyud stod dbu mdzad kyis gtsos bzhi bcus bdun gsum gyi bar ya ma rā dzā sa ya bzhi nyis 'bum btang ba'i mthug drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog /mchod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phyag drug pa dang las gshin gyi bskang gso/ dbus gtsang gi yul gru dang rdzong gzhis nas dgra lha dpangs bstod sogs spyi sgos kyi rim gro mi chung tsam gyis bgyis/ zho stod gter sgrom chu tshan zhag bdun gyi ring bsten/ gnas chags kyi yon bdag a bsam 'brug phyogs su kha bstad par bu gte mna' sog dam zhing sa ris la rang dbang ma byung bas blo log /'brug pas a chog la chings ma grol gong gsang dmag byed rtsis kho pas shes nas bya btang bar brten khag gnyis dril te lag snga mgyogs kyis zla ba dang po sngun ma'i nyer lnga drug tsam la steng gdung rdzong mer bsregs pa'i chag grum re che bzos pa byed pa pha dang brjod pa bu'i dper 'dug rung 'brug pas de lan gyi dmag byed pa mi bden rgyu ci la yod na'ang de lan tsam gyis zhe sdang zhi byed byas ngos phyir then yong la re dang 'phral du sgab gseng btang ba'i khyi'i ya bo rgyug pas bcar na lho bod kyi 'gro ba mang po nyam thag gi rgyur song dogs 'jam gang chags byas par lho 'brug 'gro —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gzor rgyas bsdus mi 'dug gshis sa mtshams gyi nye len du dpal de nas dang bde mchog mgon po rta rkang gi so 'dzin 'os 'tsham btang
