zhing rgyal rtse sogs nas 'tshams tshigs rnam pa lta bar mda' dpon phun tshogs kyang brdzangs/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bdun la 'jam dbyangs gong ma (240na)chen mo'i lung gis mi sna rgan pa stag lung sku skye/ gzhon pa dbur stod blo bzang dge slong / kho yag bcu/ 'grul sdebs chog thu chos rje/ sam gyang dbang gi rab 'byams pa/ dbu mdzad dge slong / cha khar chos rje/ em chi bstan 'dzin sogs ngo bo bcu dgu/ g.yog phyed sum brgya skor/ spos khang mkhan po lam du grongs pa'i skyid stod pa/ da la'i rgyal po'i mi sna dang bcas par bzhugs gral rgyas par btang ba'i thog gong gi bka' shog gnang sbyin blangs shing yul dus dang bstun pa'i 'phros gleng zhib par byung / brgyad gtor chen mo'i dus rim bzabs rgyas su btang zhing mu 'thud du rgyal thang phyogs su brlang por spyod pa'i mi srun pa rnams tshar bcad de g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtang rag yang bskyar chos srung spyi bye brag la snyan shal 'bul rgyu'i kha byang / rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal gyi gnas bdag 'dzin pa lag mangs kyi 'phrin lan/ sman bla don grub pas mdzad pa'i sku gzugs kyi cha tshad rab dbye yid bzhin nor bu dang sprul sku 'phrang kha bas mdzad pa'i mchod rten gyi thig rtsa gnyis/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon cog chos grags kyis mtshams sbyar bar brten par byang / thor god dbu mdzad chos rjes bskul ba'i smon lam rnams brtsams/dpon mkha' 'gros rgya bod kyis mtshams mi bde ba byas par brten gnas nas phyungs shig par gong nas lung byung ba ltar tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bya dgar tshes brgyad kyi nyin gong gi bka' shog rten du gser srang chig brgya so lnga las grub pa'i maṇḍal dang (240ba)srang tshig brgya yod pa'i lhag /dngul gyi mdong mo/ rta mig ma sogs srang bzhi brgya dang bcu/ gan gos yug nyis brgya/ nyin bde ma dang rtags brgyad kha btags sogs khyen lnga brgya rnams kyi gnang sbyin byung ba blangs/ sher 'phel sprul sku/skyed tshal gong mkhan po/ mnga' ris gra tshang slob dpon/ la stod ri bo che'i rje drung / chos rje chu mig pa/—334

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadabla ma snye mdo ba/ kong po rdzogs chen pa'i sku skye/ snying ri gdan sa ba/ bzhad dar sdings pa'i gdung brgyud/ tre bo hor tshang dpon g.yog bcas bdun cu skor/ sga chag a bo/ sna dkar rtse'i mi sna/ mi nyag rgya 'go ba sogs lnga brgya skor dang phrad ching a chi mgon po'i mi sna rdzong bda' bgyis/mnga' ris dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling gi gra pa bstan 'dzin bzang pos gso rig rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/ sde pa bsod nams rab brtan mnyel babs la brten rjes su phan tshul sku mdun gzug po nas gzhen nu skal bzang gis 'char ston ltar sngar rgyal sras bde ba bzang pos khyab 'jug gi lam gcod mdzad par char chu sogs kyis rab gnas la gnod pa byung 'dug gshis da lam gdan sa bas yang bskyar rgyas par byas/ lho 'brug gis jus tshod mi 'dzin pa'i je lod du gtang bar sdig can gyi 'tshub lhongs zhi byed la gong dkar du rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul sku rin po che gra bcas nyer lngas 'char ga'i glang chen sna bsgyur gyi rgyab chos su chos 'khor yang rtse ba lnga bcus sher snying / 'phyong rgyas su dpal ri sprul sku gra bcas nyer gsum gyis khro rol gyi rgyab chos lam rim pa lnga bcus(241na)sher snying / 'bras spungs sngags khang du rgyud stod pa lnga bcus bdun gcig gi ring nag po skor gsum btang ba'i ya ma rā dza sum khri dang shā sa na bzhi 'bum song ba'i rjes gtor bzlog rnams bstar/ lo sngon ma gdan sa nas zhabs drung chen mo kher rkyang phebs pa'i sa bcad las med par btsun mo lcam bkra shis lags zhabs phyir 'byon pa dang yab sras lho kha phyogs su phebs ring lha sar bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba mtha' dag bdag mos mdzad pa'i rjes ngan gyi lab brjod kun rtog 'og 'gyu'i 'phros gleng sna tshogs la brten sde pa zangs rir 'byon gdong 'di skor la kho rang gis dag sangs mdzad na smos ma dgos de min sa skya'i drung 'khor ci rigs kyis ngan khag btsugs gshis phan tshun snum rtse sprod kyi sa ris 'byor spud dgos 'dug tshul don gnyer cher byung ba 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung la rnyog bral du 'gro ba'i zhabs 'degs dang sde par ma nyes pa'i kha g.yogs sel byed du lha rtse rdzong sdod phug pa gdan sar rdzong bda' byas pa sgo rum du ri tshig gi don bzhin rdo rje btsun mos dag sangs mdzad pa'i —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)btsun mo dang sde pa so sor sa skya'i phyags phyi rnams kyis shal dkar dmar gser gos dar sogs dkar 'don yig gsal ltar bsgrubs/ lcang lo can pa kun dga' rab brtan gyis gleng brjod byas 'dra zer ba mi dga' ba zhig gisang na khag bkal tshod nas ra mo cher dag pa bskyal song / tshes dgur gong gi mi sna rgan gzhon gnyis/ 'grul sdebs chog thu chos rje sogs kyis gtsos pa rnams kyis (241ba 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi gser chos glegs bam rgya bzo khyad mtshar gser dngul gos dar ja ras mu tig /bya tha dkar gyi sgo nga / khyung sgong gi bum pa/ rta rnga mo sogs bdog pa dngom che ba dang skyid stod pas gos yug bcu drug gis gtsos pa'i ster cha rnams byung / bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po'i mi sna ching khi yas dngul srang sum cu'i mdong mo sman tse sogs dngos po byin/tshes bcu bzhir dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis thang sham ma gtogs pa'i 'gan sbyar sogs gos sna cha tshang dngos po'i tshan grangs dang gra tshang du yon sbyar te 'bras ljongs dag snang bsun bzlog ma'i sgo nas rten 'byung bsgrigs/ de thog rong pa em chis ster cha dang 'gyed btang /tshes bco lngar thor god ā yu de'i dpon po'i bskur ma dang bcas pa'i dbu mdzad chos rjes gser srang phyed bzhi brgya/ dngul srang bdun brgya/ ja gos dar pags ras sogs bdog pa dpangs bstod pa/tsho gos 'khor 'gyed dang bcas pa'i yon sbyar te gra tshang nas tshe mtha' yas pa'i cho gar brten nas rten 'byung mdzad/ gtsang rong gi rgya chu tshan 'di yan lag na ba la phan pa zhig yod pas bum pa kha shas blangs pa'i zhag brgyad kyi ring bsten/ lha sar thang skya bas brgyad stong pa nyis stong dang bcu/ gdugs dkar lnga stong bdun brgya/ sgrol ma chog 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong / sher snying brgyad stong bdun brgya/ tshe gzungs nyi khri drug stong chig brgya rnams btang / gra tshang spyi sger nas ster sbyin tshogs 'khor spams bstod de nyer gcig la 'chi med 'od snang gi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel (242na)ba'i cho ga mdzad/nyer gnyis la sa ma gyang dbang gi rab 'byams pa bsam gtan gyis gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i yon rgyas par sbyar te gra tshang gis tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ nyer bdun la skyid stod —336

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (za)pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis kyang gong 'dra'i rten 'byung bstar/ nyer dgur rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan/chos rje smra bo lcog pa/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs kyi sku skye/ gung thang rab 'byams pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/mon 'dzum lang rgyal po'i mi sna rnams dang phrad/ 'brong rtse ba bsod nams dar rgyas kyis gra tshang du yon tshogs chas bdog pa maṇḍal gyi tshul du gya nom pa bteg ste hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la bcom ldan 'das 'chi med 'od snang gi cho ga'i sgo nas rten 'brel bsgrigs shing de steng dka' bcu dar khan chos rjes kyang ring 'tsho'i ched du tshan grangs dang 'gyed bstar/ 'phags yul gyi sman pa rma na ho zhes pa gso rig gi yan lag du ma dang khyad par mig bcos la shin tu mkhas pa zhig g.yor po phyogs su byung tshul thos pa sgem bu nas kyis do dam byas te 'byor byung ba dar mo sman rams pa bslab tu bcug pa mang po'i mig phye ba'i 'gro phan 'phel bar gyur/ sman pa de sdod ring gi mthun rkyen dang yul du ldog skabs ster sbyin lam yig sogs bdag rkyen gang legs bgyis/ lha sa smon lam chen mor ser 'bras gnyis kyi dge 'dun yongs rdzogs dang gzhan ma phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun ris su ma chad pa 'du ba'i se ra ba dpon slob kyi gral 'bras spungs pa'i las sne ba ci rigs kyi byed pas (242ba)rim gyis shor ba dang ra mo che'i smon lam gyi tshe se ra bas de lan de mjal la brten pa'i dge skyon sna tshogs shig snang ba 'di lo smon lam gyi dus 'bras spungs dge skos kyis chos skyong bya rung pa brdungs pas rkyen byas dge 'dun gyi dbyen du 'gyur ba'i gzhi mngon du dod pa gra tshang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa dang sger logs blo bzang dar rgyas gnyis kyis gra sa phan tshun gnyis da'i so so'i thugs 'dod gyang ma gyang sogs rgyu mtshan mtha' dag sha bcad khrag gtigs su zhib bcad/ mnyan yod kyi mchod pa'i dus bzang por rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa'i mdzad chen dpe zla dang bral ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog dam par chos zab dang bdud zab kyi dpe'i nyes pa chen po khegs pa'i slad du bca' yig dang gzu sbrags ma lta bu zhig bzos nas 'dus tshogs rnams kyi snyan gyi dbang por bsgrags/ byes pa slob dpon 'jam dbyangs lhun grub pas 'bras spungs dge skos la lag lan slog mi'i sog ban la —337—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)lnga dar gzings bstod byas tshul 'bras spungs bla gra'i brjod rigs se rar sbrel po gnyis kyis glengs 'dug kyang byes par nang nad che ba zhig yod pa yin nam gang ltar dogs sel dang bla mar dri skor sogs ma byung ba rting sor bla ma ngos kyi 'byor bas sog po des dge skos bsad nas 'gro rtsis la bstan bshig mi byed pa'i rngan pa byin pa phyogs log de bzhin la dag sangs byed zer ba'i yus pa 'dug rung gzu song gi bshags su mchis/ lar nas byes pa rnams gad kha sa pa'i do gal gyi zur cha tsam zhig chos zhus kyi bla mar dgos rgyur snang / (243na)byang sribs rtses dang rang gi mi ser la mi dgosaka med 'dug pa de tshab ri bo chos gling par mthil mdzes rgyan gling khungs bkras rab pas sa brjes dgos tshul ltar 'dzin shul ljangs khri khang gzhis ka /them 'dzin bcu gcig /lag 'bab chig stong chig brgya lnga bcu/ me shing thebs su thub rgyal gling / mas dro gling nas gnag phyugs sum brgya ldangs pa'i rtsa kha/ grub rgyal gling gi gzims khang gong la ming dgos tshul ltar bsam grub bde chen du btags shing / me shing thebs su grub rgyal gling klu sdings lcang ra dang rgyal bzang gling / rgyal dar gong pa ngag dbang shes rab kyi gtor bzos sogs cho ga phyag len gyi rigs la do dam che ba byung ba'i lag g.yog sgrub rten dang mi ngo gzhan rnams kyang 'tsho byed yin 'dug gshis brgyud bcas la yar klungs khe gsun gnyis ka /them 'dzin nyer bzhi/ lag 'bab sum stong sum brgya lnga bcu/ sgrags 'brog rtswakha'i steng nas phyugs ma sum brgya ldangs pa'i rtswa kha/ 'bras spungs lha dbang gling gi spyil sa/ chos 'khor gling rta ra dang sgrol ma lha khang gi go ra/ lkog pa pa'i sa cha tshur blangs pa'i sa tshab 'phar kha dang sbrags par bsam dar bas 'dzin shul gyi gra phyi khang rnying them 'dzin nyi shu/ lag 'bab chig stong nyis brgya sum cu/ zhabs drung nor bu khra sgor gtsang phyogs su thugs blo ma phebs shing mi dang bya'i dpe bzhin 'phyong rgyas rang du bzhugs bzhed stag lo sde par rgyu mtshan gnang ba'i zhal bzhes grub 'dug pa ltar bzhugs yul dpal ri bar tshe ring pho brang (243bgi yar/ rta nag gi gsol skal sa tshab dang bcasapar 'phral dgos phyags phyir them 'dzin drug /bzhes yong 'bru khal dgu brgya bcu bzhi/ tshwa khal bcu/—338—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasnum khal phyed drug /rgya ja nag po srang khal bcu bzhi/ zi ling sbu ja khal bcu gsum ya ju dang sha shan byed khyer khal bcu gsum/ mar khal chig brgya dang phyed so bzhi/ lug khog gya bzhi/ tshag bubs nyi shu/ gser zho bcu/ bal 'degs khal chig brgya sum cu/ bar 'jam 'dom sum brgya go lnga skor rnams skyid shod dang 'phyong rgyas nas 'dzin nang ltar lo lo bzhin phul ba'i lo gcig gi khyon bsdoms 'bru thog tu phab pa mkhar khal sum stong chig brgya zhe drug /rtswa shing ldangs tshod dang bcas pas rjes 'jug tsho ngal gso'i mkhar bar song / gter gsar lung bstan gab rgya can du/ khyad par dbu ru gtsang ma'i sar 'di nyid 'chad cing sgrub pa'i sde: tshom bu gcig tu 'dus pa dag brtson pas bsgrubs na 'grub gyur cing : ma 'ongs bstan pa cher 'phel te: bod kyi bde skyid gong du spel zhes gter gsar nyams len gyi sngags sde zhig 'dzugs bzhed 'dug pa ltar gter ston rin po cher bzang yul grong gsar dang sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyi dus lho brag nas gshor 'degs dar lung gi dgon pa sogs yod na'ang gra grangs gtong sgo gang sa nas kha thug pa ma byung gnang ba'i sa snon zhu rten mnga' bdag nyang gis mkho mthing lha khang nas gdan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gser sku mthong ba don ldan smra bo lcog pa'i nang rten/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i phyag bris (244na)dgongs 'dus po ti brgyad kyi nang nas bsam yas 'og khang du bzhugs pa'i o rgyan rin po che'i gser sku chen mo'i nang du yod pa'i 'phros po ti bzhis thog drangs gos dar rta sogs kyi dngos po dang bcas dgos tshul gsung bar/ bzang yul phu mda' skor dang gshor 'degs tshur blangs/ sa tshab 'phar kha dang bcas par chos 'khor gling pa'i 'dzin shul thar pa gling pa gtogs pa phyir song ba yang slog pa'i bla brang 'du khang gra shag sgo phyi sa skor rten gsum mchod chas nang chas/ them 'dzin chog brgya dang bdun/ lag 'bab lnga stong drug brgya re gnyis/ ri bo rnam rgyal bar chos 'khor gling khungasanas bogs 'khyar 'dug pa'i sa tshab tu gra nang nas phyag mdzod khungs kyi bogs 'khyar 'bru khal gya gcig /sde pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs la thar gling khungs nas sa ris 'dzin bdag byed pa'i tshab gra —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lanaphyi 'ju bde skyid khang gsar rkang gcig la lag 'bab nyis brgya re gsum/ chos 'khor rgyal bar sa bya lo sbyor 'jags byas pa'i mchod gzhis gra phyi thar gling khungs ra ma steng pa dud brgyad khungs slog byed dgos byung ba'i tshab tu gra nang bsam dar pa'i 'dzin shul gser khung mas bzang 'dems them brgyad lag 'bab drug brgya so bdun/ 'bri lung gzhen tshang la snga sor 'od zer gyang pa'i 'dzin shul nas sprad pa kha 'thor skyon gyi sa brjes dgos tshul byung ba ltar tshab tu chum nas them 'dzin bcu/ lag 'bab sngar dang mtshungs pa/ lcang lo can pa 'dre gnod kyi dogs pa ches pa'i sa brjes dgos tshul sde par (244ba)zhus pa'i zhal len byung 'dug pa bzhin sa ris rnying pa rnams tshur blangs pa'i tshab stod lung gram mde'i gzhis ka them 'dzin so drug /lag 'bab nyis stong drug brgya bcu drug /gra tshang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa bsam pa rnam dag gis khur bsam che ba byung bar brten tsha bo thang sras brgyud bcas la lcang gling pas 'dzin shul them 'dzin brgyad/ lag 'bab rig stong chig brgya drug cu/ spus srang drung 'tsho ba blo bzang nor bu spun chos dpal gyis lha sa'i gnyer kha byed dus nas bzung kha phyogs ma log pa'i gzhung du gus zhabs che ba dang ding sang dkon gnyer spyon pa dad zhen dang mchod khang gi zhabs tog la khur bsam che bar brten rnam 'joms kyi 'dzin shul snang rtse khungs lcags ru ba can bcas them 'dzin bcu gsum lag 'bab bdun brgya so lnga rnams byin 'jags byas/tshes bzhi la zhabs drung nor bu khra sgor/ bco brgyad chos rje/ mas dro ho ka bla ma/ gyang ro lha khang slob dpon pa rnams dang phrad thog chos rje dung dgon pa dpon slob kyis ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kha yar gsungs/ gdan sa gong nas zhabs drung rin po che phebs skabs bstan rgyun la dgongs nas snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gsung ngag slob bshad gsan na legs tshul zhus pa dgongs par shin tu babs pa'i zhabs phyir bkra shis chos sde nas gnas gsar dbon rin po che sogs don gnyer can kha shas la zha lu mkhan chen kun spangs pa khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis gdan sa bar dge sdings bkra shis bsam grub tu hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun (245na)la 'bul ba —340

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadaganang rtsis kyi zhabs drung rin po cher legs so'i tshigs bcad snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa gos yug gi rten/ mkhan chen zha lu pa chen por snyan tshig gi 'phrin gsol bskal brgyar 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i rten 'byung du tshems lhas kyi rdo rje'i re khā sa mtshone pa'i bzhugs stan/ bzang gos gsol ja sogs kyi tshan grangs dang bcas pa/ zab chos 'di nyid mnyan drags pa'i 'tshub ltongs 'ga' re sngon dus kyang byung 'phros 'dug pa da lam yang dpon slob tshang mar thugs dogs shig gnang ba'i mi mthun phyogs la phan re'i sgo rum du bse mgon yid bzhin nor bur gos yug mu men mdog grum stod kha'u brag rdzong du gnyan mgon zhal bzhi par bzang gos dmar po yug /pu tra khang dang rin chen sgang bla brang gi mgon khang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bsti gnas 'dar stod rmu gzhongs rdo rje'i pho brang gi beg tse gsum la nor bu cha bdun gyi ri mo yod pa'i kha btags rnams la so sor 'phrin bcol gyi zhal byang dang bcas pa phul zhing chos bdag po'i lag tu sprod par 'chub 'ong don mi 'dug rung bdag po kun rin pas rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje bkrong rtsis kyi 'dar du dmag drangs rmu gzhongs mgon khang gi sku bshig pa sogs mtshams med kyi las glang dar la skyengs pa ster ba'i mdzad pas rje btsun gong ma'i rdo rje chos skyong gi tshogs 'khrugs pa'i lhags cung zad lus nyams dang bdag po rang gi sger srung 'dra dga' mi dga'i skyon gyis snang gsum rdzogs mtshams mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang sku khams(245ba)sreb pa'i re zhig chos 'phro gzhol bar shar na'ang dpon slob mtha' dag gis slar 'chad nyan rgya chen gnang ba'i dgongs pa gtad pa skyes chen dam pa'i mdzad pa lhun kyis 'grub pa ni gor ma chag /rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par rgyun gyi dus gtor star chags/ sgrub mchod/ slo bur ba'i las sbyor sogs gtong deb cha lam tsam las ha cang mi zhib cing gnyer las 'dzin so so'i shog ril mi res glu re dang rta res bang re brgyugs pa'i dpe de bzhin mtho dma' sna tshogs kyi rgyu kho nar mthong bas dge skyon mtha' dag zhib mor dpyad de mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis khur blangs pa'i deb kyi 'go brjod/ se chen dbon po blo bzang chos 'phel gyis rang byung 'phags par phye phur phul —341—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba'i kha byang / lha sa byang gling pas gnas bcu/ mtshan brgyad/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i 'khrungs rabs kyis gtsos pa'i sman sku mang du bzhengs pa'i che brjod smon lam/ bal po si la thus yo byad rnams lag 'don byas pa'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi gser sku snga sor nas bzhengs yod snang ba'i steng nye lam sman bla'i yig cha gsar bris dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'grem rgyu'i lha tshogs yongs rdzogs kyi gser sku bzhengs 'dug par gzung bzhugs dang rab gnas bsdus pa/dag pa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i smon lam rnams bris shing bal po'i rigs 'di dngos spyad la 'jungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa mang yang 'di nyid dge stobs che bar mngon/ rten bzhengs la legs so'i gos dar 'bru 'dzin sogs dpangs bstod (246na)rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po/ gong gi gser yig pa 'grul sdebs dang bcas brgya skor la thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs/ sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma ba ri lugs/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gsum gyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs dang nang rten rags rim gyi mjal kha btang zhing rgyal mo sger la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya tshar dang / sras chung ma/ dbu mdzad chos rje/ dka' bcu sangs rgyas bkra shis gsum la nyer lnga re byas/mtshan sgrog mkhan pos yon sbyar nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i gra tshang nas yun gnas kyi smon lam mdzad/ rang nyid nad kyis mnar ba'i tshe lha mi 'byung po'i gnod pa 'dra yod du dogs pa'i bcas ka sna tshogs byed bzhin du sde brgyad kyi gnod pa mi yong pa'i springs yig ster ba gtsang sde srid kyis sog yul du lam yig gtong ba dang stag lung zhabs drung gis 'dre shig par bka' shog gi dpe kho nar 'dug kyang bla chen gyi rigs 'di gdong lpags 'thug drags pa'i gshis rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan gyis dgos tshul ltar springs yig byas shing rgyal mo 'khor bcas/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po/ thor god/ dbu mdzad chos rje/ tre bo hor tshang gi dpon rnams la rten gsum shal pa snam phrug sogs so sor gang la gang 'tsham gyi rdzong ba bzabs shing bar chad sel byed kyi bka' bsgo dang rjes gnang bskur/ rgyal mos tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin pa'i khas len dgos zer ba nged rang —342

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasngon chad 'khor bar 'khyams pa (246ba thas kyang yun ring ba zhig yong mi yong mi shes pa'i gar 'gro'i bstad so cha ma 'tshal na'ang de ga rang byed do zhes khas blangs pa khri stan mthon po dang ber 'di byin rlabs che drags pas dad ldan rnams kyi mgo bo mgal me ltar 'khor 'gro ba gnad shin tu che bar gda'/tshes dgu nas chos sde chen po phan tshun du ja tshul bcu bdun re'i thog sher snying sa ya brgyad 'bum drug khri chig stong lnga brgya song ba'i yon gra pa bco lnga rer gser zho re'i rtsis khyon zho nyis brgya gya drug btang / mdo sde mchod pa sngar rgyun bzhin 'bul bar sbyar ra dngos grub btang ba'i sngon gyi g.yar dam rjes dran gyi bskul ma'i 'phrin yig tshigs bcad du bsrings/ tshes bcu gnyis la mtshan sgrog mkhan po ngag dbang 'phrin las/ er khe chos rje/ thor god pā thur gyi mi sne er khe dge slong / sngags pa rtsechen zhabs drung gi sku skye rnams la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas bshad pa'i kha sar pā ṇi lha bcu gsum ma'i rjes gnang dang yer khe chos rjer ban mas snam phrug sogs rdzong bda' gya nom pa byas/ ser no mon khan spyi sger tshang mar byas pa lag ris che gshis gra rigs sde dang bcas par 'dzin rgyu'i dar khan gyi yi ge /tshes bcu bzhin gong gi mi sna/ stag lung sku skye rjes 'brang bsdu chas tshogis 'gyed ster cha sogs kyi sbyin bdag byas te gra tshang nas yun gnas kyi tshe chog mdzad/ mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i sku gdung rin po che bzhugs gnas thig phyi'i gtsug lag khang gi shing cha rul skyon gyis dib tu nye bar dgos cha bzo bo 'u lag sogs gra bsgrigs/ do dam pa bla ma tshe bdag dbang (247na)rgyal dang 'phyong rgyas sbun gsum pa gnyis kyis byas/tshes bco lngar btsugs pa hor zla drug pa'i nyer drug la grub pa'i sra brtan legs pa bzos chos rje gdung 'dzin pas bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i po ti gnyis kyi zhu rten byung ba dang smra bo lcog dar na bod kyi bde skyid la phan gshis rgya ri dmar dgon ma lag dang bcas pa bong bu sku skyer grags pa'i zog po des bzung ba gang ci nas skabs su ma phye bas smra bo lcog tu sbyar zhing kho pa bsam stengs su sdod bcug /dge ye dgon pa'ang sa thag 'brel mtshungs stabs nas chag byang chub gling par —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)sprad/ chu bo ri'i sman chab de khrag gzhir phan pa byung bas bdun gcig gi bar bsten/tshes bcu dgu la bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po yum sras 'khor bcas/ khod dpon rgyal po'i ming can/ gzims shag byang ma/ sde pa bying pa/ rong pa rdzogs chen pa'i sku skye/ gnyal ri 'dag bla ma/ chos rje gung ru ba/ sha gzugs sku skye/ 'brug phyag mdzod dpag bsam mchog ster/ sgrol ma la kha ba'i rten 'byung bsgrig mi/ 'phyos lam rim pa'i las sna ba sogs dang mjal phrad byas shing rgyal po sras bcas la tshe rta dang khong dbon por tshe dbang bskur/ chos rje gnas gzhi ba sras bcas/ glang lung bla ma/ nub dgon bla ma/ rtse tsho gos mkhan po rnams la ja gral btang zhing gnas gzhi ba'i sras la mtshan padma chos dbang bstan pa rgya mtshor gsol/po ta la'i rdzong le lag rnams gcong can mangs pa'i tshugs ka mi rgyag ka med dang des (247ba)kyang phan gnod ci rigs su 'gro yin 'dug pa gra shag zil gnon lcog la 'byar ka rgyab pas lho nub kyi rtsig pa nas grul mi thub pa'i 'go brtsams te nam langs nyi ma'i dpe ltar ar po rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel lhun gyis grub par lcog rnying pa gra pa mangs pa'i khul dog skyon nas shar du bskyed pa'i rgya ma chung tsam byed rtsis rig gtsang la sa gnyan yod dogs kyi lho kha nas khog pa bos te klu phab pa'i gnas gzhan du spo thabs dang sngags pa ngag dbang gis spom gta' sogs rtsis nas bshad pa'i bcos ka rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i bkod pa dang do dam gyi gtso bo sger logs a dar dang las rgyab 'o rlon pa sogs bcu gnyis/ shing bzo dbu mdzad lha sa lam rnyed dang gra phyi dgos dgos/ dbu chung byings gras bzhi bcu skor/ rdo bzo dbu mdzad rgya mon dar rgyas/ dbu chung byings gras bzhi bcu zhe lnga /shing dang bzo bor phogs sprod pa'i do dam byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos byas nyer drug la rmang bting /hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig la sgo sge khung dang zhal ba zhib cha ma gtogs ha lam grub cing bkod pa byed mi rnam grangs mang drags na rjes su mi legs pa'i rgyu yong gshis a dar rang shes su bcug pa ka brgyad steng du ka bcu yod pa sogs sngar ma grags med pa'i legs rab byung 'phros snang /—344

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadas skya/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs/ stag rtse ba/ thon pa/ grong smad/ star sdong pa/ skyar po ba/ lha sa byang gling pa/ ri bo bde chen/ bkra shis bde chen/ dar rgyas gling / ri bo chos gling / rtse tshogs/ rtses (248na)dang lnga mchod/ mnga' ris gra tshang sogs dang gra tshang rang dang gra pa rgan gzhon byed pa bzang ngan dang bstun pa'i ja chang thug pa bag tshas mtshon nyin gnangs chag dang gzhes chag sna tshogs kyi 'u lag rnams tshim zhing 'go lung bzo bo sogs la'ang tshan grangs kyis gtsos pa'i ar ston rgyas par byung /pa rnam du 'phar ba dang khyi gzig 'ongs pa bstan srid la rgyar 'tshub ngo tsam shar ba zlog byed du zha lu ba grangs bcad kyis gdugs dkar mdos chen/ nya mgo gru'i lcags chad pa'i nyes sel la dpal ri bas khro rol smin rgyas su btang / tsha mig mkhan po/ bla ma snye mdo ba/ rgyal skor bsod nams dbang po/ rdzo rdzong nas/ snying ri gdan sab/ sog dmangs sum brgya skor rnams dang phrad/ chos 'khor rgyal gyi mgon khang shod dang lhun grub dga' tshal gyi zhig gsos/ stod phyogs nas drangs pa'i dngul gdung khang bkod kyi do dam la pad rdor 'gro rgyu yin na'ang mgon khang nang gi gtor gzhi spo bas mtsho ni zhib cha gra tshang gi gra pa dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtsho dang blo bzang bzod pa gnyis la tshogs su mang ja kha shas/ byams chen/ mgon khang tshor 'bul rgyu'i snyan shal kha byang bris te lha khang gsar rgyag gis yul dang mgon khang rnams kyi babs yul sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs la dri ba byed khyad nas zangs ri brgyud brdzangs pa hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gnyis nas las 'go btsugs pa'i mgon khang shod rnam sras kyi sku'i rgyab kyi rtsig pa sbo lug nyen che ba'ang sku so gos la chag grums med pa'i bzo bcos/ lhun (248ba)grub dga' tshal gyi dbus ma gzims khang dkar po gcong dang bab zhol che ba/ de khyu ko ṭi dang bsil ba tshal la yang skyon yod pa rnams kyi rtsig pa zhal ba shing cha brje dgos/ rtsig skyon yod pa'i rigs la phyi nang du zhabs 'bum sogs sra rma khregs brtan brling yong rtsis/ gzhan yang ri mthil gyi gog brjes dgos pa grub nas gdung rten gyi bzhugs khang dang 'du khang ka ba bcu drug gi sa tsam zla —345

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba gsum gyi khongs su phyed lhag legs par grub/ rgyal sras bsod nams bkra shis kyi dpon mo khams ma bde ba'i shegs sel du phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bskur/ brag sna gdung brgyud/ kong po rdzogs chen pa'i dbon po'i sku skye/ 'dzum lang gi mi sna rnams dang phrad/ chos rje bkra bzang ba la stod nas ched du 'byon par bskul ba 'byor te zhag shas kyi bar gter ston rin po cher byang gter gyi zab chos mang du mdzad/ 'di lo then pa lhag par che bas gra tshang nas klu sbug lha sa/ gsang yib gsum gyi mtsho dang chu mig la rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gyi sbyor ba ci rigs dang sprul sku gter ston chen po dang chos rje bkra bzang pa gnyis nas kyang mdzad pas phab char nges shes 'drongs pa zhag shas babs/ ri bo bkra bzang gi rtser o rgyan za hor ma/ rked par rdo rje ga smo nu/ rtsa bar rdo rje rnam 'joms te thugs kyi lha gsum bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang so sor bod 'bangs bde thabs su mtshan mo khor yug sdong rkang re sngar yod chag pa'i rgyun btsugs/ gnas 'dzin thebs la 'bru gzhor khal nyis brgya re/rtse'i gtsug lag khang (249na skong khams dang mthun pa'i dar lcog dmar ljang re zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la 'dzugs pa rnams star chags dang lha khang rtser gañdzi rar nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi ba'i man ngag ltar gzungs bzhugs rigs 'dzin nyid kyis phyag len bstar nas btsugs par rab gnas mdzad dgos kyi bslab bya zang zing gi skyes dang bcas rang gnas su rdzong bda' byas/ gsang chen bstan pa'i 'byung gnas rgyud stod smad dang gangs khrod rigs pa smra ba kun gyi ma dros mtsho chen dpal ne'u thog gi mkhan slob rnams kyis rim pa bzhin dngos bshams yid sprul gyi maṇḍal dang bcas ring por gnas pa'i bden tshig mdzad/ sa skyong bde chen pa yab sras dpon sa hor mo gsar 'byor dang bcas pa/ thon legs ldan dbang po/ dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i mi sna dge slong dge legs da par 'byor/ g.yon ru a khas kyi mi sna dge slong ngag dbang ye shes/ se chen khan gyi shog nas tshul khrimasadage slong / bkra shis ljongs su sdod mi yid bzhin tha'i ji/ dung dkar sku skye/ li thang sku skye/ lho brag bsam dgon pa sogs la ja gral btang / pho lha gangs la nyi shar gyis sbyin bdag byas te gra tshang —346

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)gis 'bras ljongs dag snang ma'i sgo nas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ khra 'brug chos skyong gis mthun rdzas dgos tshul byung lan snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa dang gra rigs rnams kyi ngor tsha mig mkhan po las thog pa'i gsol 'debs bris/ 'phags yul me la wa ri'i ya ma ri gi ri la sa snying zho bcu gsum/ gla 'khor bcu/(249ba)ja dar gyis gtsos pa dang pa tra na'i gar mkhan rdo lir sa zla zho gsum/ gla 'khor bcu/ thon mas bzabs te blo'i re ba bkang / la stod snye nam phyogs su rang bstan rgya chung zhing legs gshin pa'ang bla ma sogs gang sa nas rnam pa bkra ba zhig med 'dra ba dgon gnas spo ba/ gra rgyun yon sa/ sho khang gi mkhar las kyis gtsos pa'i don gcod la sho ba mtsho sna gdong pa dang mnyam du 'brong rtse lhun grub gling pa dang a bar dpal yags gnyis rdzong bda' byas pa'i hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nas las 'go btsugs/ gshin rje 'joms byed kyi sku chos 'khor stod smad du bzhugs na mtha'i 'khrug rtsod sogs bzlog pa la phan yon che bar gsungs pa bzhin lha sa byang gling pa'i rten bzheng gi zhar byung du dbu mdzad bag dro can mi gsum gyis bzhengs pa dang rigs 'dzin chen po'i dag snang mar rgyal chen yul 'khor bsrung gi sku la brten nas mtha'i rgol ba rnams zil gyis gnon par bshad pa bzhin zla ba gsum pa'i nang du gser zangs kyi sku bzhugs khang dang bcas zin pa rnams kyi gzungs bzhugs rab gnas sgrub pa kun rigs 'dzin chen po nyid kyis phyag dar te gshin rje'i sku lha sa bsam yas dang dmar po ri'i pho brang rtser yul 'khor bsrung bzhugs su gsol/ snye mdo chos rje so shākya ngag dbang dpal 'bar gyis rog snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyags sa 'bum nas thon pa dang gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon gyis dge steng gi zhing la khung slob skor la thu btsun 'jigs med dpa' bo'i shangs mtshal las (250na)grub pa'i nyid kyi sku thang zhu rten du byung /tshes bco brgyad la ri bo che nas zhabs drung ngag gi dbang phyug /stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras/ ge re lha pa yum sras/ dga' ldan thos bsam gling bla gnyer/ lho sgang thog lcags zam pa/ rmog lcog sku skye/—347—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenadabus gling bla ma/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod/ rgyal dar 'tsho byed sogs mang bar ja gral btang / ri bo che'i zhabs drung de sngar rab byung gi zlos gar bar skabs su chu pa dang rtsag pa'i rnam par song ba slar yang skya rengs shar ba ltar ngur smrig gi na bzas klubs kyin 'dug pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis las lhag tsam gnang bzhed yod pa 'dra/ gaḥthog gdags dkar bla ma'i sku skye'i gtsug phud blangs shing ming o rgyan chos kyi rgya mtshor btags/ tha'i ji mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku skye dge tshul du bsgrubs/ spyir yang dus kyi dbang gis 'byung po'i rigs 'di 'tshi cing bye brag gangs ljongs 'dir gong po dang dam sri'i 'phrul gyis mi bde bar bshad pa bzhin mchog dman mang por 'khrul snang yang ci rigs byung 'dug pa dang dngos su'ang rlung gis sprin gtor zhing grang ngad sogs sad nyen gyi rtags cher ston par bod 'bangs bde thabs su dmigs nas rdo rje slob dpon dge slong blo gros rgyal bas byas te grangs bcad kyis sgrub zhag bdun phrag gnyis kyi ring lha brag gter byon gyi dgongs pa ltar hom mnan gyi phyag len 'khrul med smin rgyas su bstar bas dam sri'i tsha ngad zhi nyams kyi 'phral du sprin 'khrigs nas char rde'u shal ba babs/nyer lngar wa ra ṇa si'i bram ze ha ri (250ba)dwa sa dang dza ya dwa sa sa gaṅgā'i chu sogs byung bar gser zho drug dang 'bras gro zhib kyis mtshon pa'i zur chas byin/ thod ri dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling gi gra pa chos 'phel rgya mtshos gso rig rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/ gdan sa gong 'og bkra shis lhun po/bde chen pa'i mi sna rnams lho nang du 'byor nas rgyang tsam song ba'i da cha bod nas mi sna med na skor yang thal mo ya gcig gi dper 'dug pa ltar rdzong bda' dgos tshul bzhin tshag rtse sbrel por gsar skyes kyi ham 'dzud bzhag ste sa bya'i chings la cha bzhag ngos gangs te se dang spa gro stag tshang gi mchod 'bul skor sogs dod snyom dgos pa'i rdo kha bskur nas bsdongs/ gong dkar dkar brag pa'i sa brjes dang sa snon bsdoms par them 'dzin bzhi/ lag 'bab sum brgya don brgyad/ chang khyim par sa snon du gra nang dpal rab mda' nas them 'dzin lnga/ lag 'bab bzhi brgya nyi shu/ dge slong 'jam —348—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)dbyangs grags pa'i bogs steng nas khal sum cu bcag cing rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyi spyil po go ra dang bcas pa rtsa 'jags/ khams nam bzang ring gzhor 'debs/ 'bum thang bsod nams dbang pos gong du gser yig dang khams phyogs su snga phyir btang ba sogs la do khur byung ba'i bdag rkyen/ sngar 'dzin la g.yogs ris med pa'i sa snon du 'phyos zhol mo bas 'dzin shul bcas them 'dzin bcu/ lag 'bab bdun brgya don gsum/ zhal dpon 'gro phan gyis gtsang gi sa char sabarjes dgos tshul ltar 'phyong phu zhol khang / chen (251na〉du/ glang gzhongs/ mgo sne bcas par them 'dzin brgyad/ lag 'bab brgyad brgya/ 'phyos bkra shis sde chen par 'du khang zhig gsos thebs su dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis khang zhing zhu rten dngul lnga bcu ma byung bar shing tham phog par mig 'gran byung dogs kyi don smin ma bde ba'i 'phral phugs slebs tshe khyad kyi sman bla nyin gnyis gsum re gsar 'dzugs gtong rgyur 'phyos mda' sdangs pas 'dzin shul dang gzhung rgyug them 'dzin bzhi bcas lag 'bab drug brgyar nye ba/ dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags la yar stod ra mo lding nas dud stongs kun sbug pa'i zhing khol gyi skor bogs thon khal bcu gnyis/ tha lus rtswarigs dang bcas pa 'khri med/ lu ma 'go pa sngags pa ngag dbang snga sor rim gro rtsis sogs kyi lag g.yog tu 'gyur ba byung ba dang slar g.yul rgyal dang bcas pa sgrub rten du zhol phyag 'tshal shag khang pa lag 'bab don gnyis/ yig mkhan a lhun la snga sor song khrod nas za ma zos pa'i sa rjes ngo dkar du gra thang nas them 'dzin phyed gnyis lag 'bab tshig brgya go dgu/ sger logs blo bzang dar rgyas mkhar las snga phyi thams cad la khur bsam che ba byung bar 'phan yul grub rgyal nas them 'dzin bzhi/ nub khang gsar tshoms ka ba bcu gnyis kyi steng gshod bar 'khyams de thob kyi mdo ra dang bcas/ lag 'bab nyis brgya bcu bzhi/ lcog sbug par lcang lo can gyi sa tshab tu rgyal rtse bsam grub dge 'phel gyi khang pa them 'dzin bdun/ lag (251ba〉snab ba sum brgya/ me rdo bar skyed tshal gyisatshab dang zhi drag sgrub rten 'phar kha sbrags par rta nag shod khud gzhis ka them 'dzin zhe brgyad/ lag —349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)'bab chig stong bdun brgya gya drug /bkra shis rtse chos sde bar bogs 'khyar gyi tshab dang snon mar che mkhar gzhon khungs phu lung 'ong ba byang nas zhing shas thon them 'dzin gcig gi yong 'bab/ gong gi mi sna gzhon pa phag mo blo bzang dge slong gis zhu rten spams mtho ba byung bar drag 'don mi gra rkang gcig gtsang chag thog sger sha'ur lto skal phye gsal byas pa phud pa'i sa ris byings dang kha slong gzhung rgyug phye ba bcas them 'dzin dgu/ lag 'bab drug brgya nga gcig /kong po rdzogs chen par thar pa gling stod kyi 'thus tshod yin rung gling smad dgos tshul nan ches par brten zla 'dril/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyi sa snon du rab rtses dang / 'bring mas dro gung mkhar/ tha ma snye 'phrang gang rung dgos tshul ltar rtses dang ma lag dang bcas pa drung 'khor them che 'bring chung gsum mo bran bsdoms pa bdun brgya skor/ lag 'bab tshig khri chig stong brgya dgu bcu rnams dang sku gsung thugs rten sogs nang chas lhag lus che ba/ bkar rgya'i 'bru khal chig stong / logs/ lha lung bcas par them 'dzin lnga bcu/ lag 'bab chig stong bdun brgya zhe lnga/ tshogs rgyal gling par kha 'thor skyon gyis byang sribs tshab tu yar stod go mal nas them 'dzin drug /lag 'bab brgyad brgya gya bzhi/ bkras rab par ljangs khri khang gi tshab la dol gser steng bsam grub gling gi khang pa them 'dzin bcu gnyis/lag 'bab (252na)dgu brgya re gnyis/ rgyal rtse tshe dbang la sa brjes sa snon sbrags par sne stod gnyis ka them 'dzin bco brgyad/ lag 'bab dgu brgya re gsum/ dol sbar mdo ba'i gsang mda' klu chu shar ma khungs kyi bogs shas tshab la chag cha/ pho brang bde chen khang gsar bar bogs chag /dar rgyas bkra shis la lha sa nas khang mig kha shas/ dar khan dbon bor snye mo nas khal nyer lnga'i shas thon/ nā landa bco brgyad pas sna mo jo gdan dgon la sa brjes dgos tshul byung ba bla mar bskos pa'i deb nang gi yong sgo rnams kyis phan re'i lugs dang rkang 'gro lag 'don thog tu phan pa ma byung ba 'dug gshis da lta'i chos rje 'di pa gsang sngags kyi dbang rig gtad rjes gnang 'khrid lung sogs bstan rgyun la phan nges nas 'brel mtshungs mthong smon nas them 'dzin lnga/ lag 'bab lnga —350

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)brgya nga bzhi/ pad tshal btsun pas bar khams su mkha' 'gro'i ngo 'dzin ches pa'i byed 'dzol che bar bka' skyon babs lci ba byung 'dug na'ang sngar byas la bsam pad tshal rnying khungs rang slog byas par gzhis ka them 'dzin bcu drug /lag 'bab chig stong sum brgya gya dgu/ nas 'bras par sa snon du gra nang bcur pa them 'dzin bco lnga/ lag 'bab sum brgya/ 'o rlon pa'i rnam rgyal sgang gi tshab tu rong spang chen gzhis ka them 'dzin bcu bdun/ lag 'bab chig stong bdun brgya nyer gcig /rgyal ba ga rma pa'i jo mo sras bcas kyi gsol skal sgrags rgyal grong dang zha ldan gyi sa tshab tu lcang lo can gzhis ka dang 'jun kha longs gzhung (252ba)rgyug mi ser bcas them 'dzin zhe drug /lag 'bab nyis stong lnga brgya drug cu/ 'jun rtse zhol sa 'dres ches pa'i bdag po ma gcig phyin su la'ang 'dzin bde mi 'dug pas zla 'dril khyad nas 'jun zhol bar sa tshab dang sa snon sbrags par shel grong gzhis ka shar gyi khang pa/ them 'dzin sum cu/ lag 'bab nyis stong bzhi brgya re gsum gyi kha 'grig lhag dang bcas pa yod rung sa snon du zhal phu mda' long mo grong pa them 'dzin dgu/ lag 'bab bzhi brgya don brgyad/ba ra bas gser 'dul sogs lag g.yog sgrub rten du snying mkhar gzhis ka them 'dzin brgyad/ lag 'bab brgyad brgya/ 'bras spungs rtses dang spyi khang 'dzin thebs la skyor lung bogs 'khyar nas khal drug cu/ skyar bo ba rdo rje dbang phyug la drung pa rgyal tshab pa'i sku skye yum bcas kyi snga sor mchod gzhis su mi gra chod pa'i lag 'don brgya bcu gcig /mal dro tshe brtan la 'phan yul ban grong pa'i bgos phud ban grong gzhis ka them 'dzin brgyad/ lag 'bab bzhi brgya brgyad cu/ pho brang ge ra bas gsol dpon gyi las tshan khrol cha snga phyir dgos tshul byung ba ltar de tshab rtses dang rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dge legs bskos pa'i sger g.yog 'khrid khyad nas yar stod go mal gzhis ka them 'dzin lnga/ lag 'bab bdun brgya/ grong smad a bar gyis 'brel mtshungs khyad nas spa ri dang gong dkar dpal grong gi gzhis g.yog gi tshab dgos tshul byung ba der ma bltos pa'i sbyor 'jags byas par bzang yul bkra shis steng dang grong gsar gzhis ka them 'dzin nyer gnyis/(253na)lag 'bab chig stong nyes —35/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)brgya bdun cu/ gong dkar skyi nag gzhis ka them 'dzin sum cu/ lag 'bab sum stong dgu bcu/ 'jun gyi gzhis ka them 'dzin sum cu so lnga/ lag 'bab nyis stong nyis brgya sum cu/ spa ri gnyis ka 'dam ra phran bu/ them 'dzin bzhi/ lag 'bab bzhi brgya/ gsang phu dus ma chad par snon bkras gzhongs kyi sbyar yig shun zhabs drung dang yar rgyab zhabs drung sogs bka' shog dmar nag gi rigs sde pa 'phrang 'go bas gzhi ba gra tshang la bar rdzing gzhis ka skor sbyar ba'i gtan tshigs/ brag kha bas mnga' ris blo bzang dpal 'byor la zhing rtsa byin pa nyi thang par chod pa'i 'bra bzung byed zer ba dang gzhung nas be ser nyi thang la gsar chod gnang ba phud de phyin snon yongs rdzogs star sdong par gnang ba'i sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi gtan tshigs la rgyab snon gyi yig ris dang bcas phan tshun gnyi ga yus shing ri pa'i rbab dang klungs pa'i khu'i dper 'dug pa mgron gnyer gu ru byas pa che bar gong brgyab gsang phu ba khag gi sa tshab rnam rgyal sgang nas sprad/ mi ser rnams dang 'then khyer che ba so so'i 'dod pa snye ma rked gcog lugs kyi shing stag gi khra ma'i chod yig tshul kha mchu bcad cing bar skabs su 'dzin bdag bral ba'i rta nags pa'i gzhis ka them 'dzin zhe bzhi/ lag 'bab chig stong nyis brgya nga lnga/ 'dar bsam grub pa sa ris dang 'don rkang ma 'grig pa 'don phyed nga gsum dang bogs khal nyis brgya bcag /rnam sras gling pas tha lus chus khyer mangs pa'i rnam rgyal (253ba)khungs nas chag cha dgos tshul byung ba gzhan ma ma bde ba'i sngar brgyad grar 'gro ba'i bogs khal brgya bdun cu ra ba stod pa dang gsung gling pa'i dus rim 'phar la song ba sngar srol la cha bzhag de 'phros rnams bcag /gdan sa gong gi bla brang bzhir gyes pa'i nang nas rin chen sgang bla brang 'di dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs gsang chen slob bshad kyi bdag po rim par byon pa'i bstan pa'i 'byung gnas lta bu yin kyang bdag rkyen khri thog pa na rim gyi bzhugs gnas bzhi thog dang bla brang gzhan gsum gyi rgyun chad pa'i zhal ngo rnams dus mchod bla brang gi gdung brgyud du song ba'i skyon bzhin yin nam gang ltar zhabs tog ha cang gis khyogs pa zhig mi 'dug gshis —352

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)tshogs gsog dang bstan rgyun la bsam nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sku mchod kyi dus dran la kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi mngon dkyil 'khor lo sdom pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad par lhan thabs rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i nor bu'i 'phrong ba skyar ba'i phyag len ltar gyi rdul tshon dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i chog gra gra slob sum cus zla ba drug pa'i nyer lnga la sta gon dang bcas pa'i nyin brgyad/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mchod la nyid kyis mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sku tshom bu/ gsung bdud rtsi/ thugs sis ra gsum la brten pa'i chog gra/ gra slob gong bzhin zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga nas nyin bdun/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dus nas chos skyong gi gtso bor gnang zhing (254na)nged rang yang lhag par mos pa yod pas kha'u skyed lhas su dus gtor zhig 'dzugs pa'i sta gon byas skabs so skye'i 'khrul snang la tig bstad ga la yod rung las mgon lcam dral gyis bskul ma'i rnam pa 'byung bas rkyen byas/ chos skyong gnyis kur 'dzugs pa'i 'dun pa shar/ ma 'ongs pa na 'di 'dra'i rigs kyis zhal gzigs dang mngon mkhyen sogs kyi sgro btags a tsi bar mi 'gro ba'i nges pa med na'ang de 'dra yong re'i ltogs la min kyang rang ngos byang chub bsgrubs pa'i 'phrin las zhu ba'i ched gra slob nyi shus zhal la gtor chog pho nya myur mgyogs bskang gso lhan thabs dang bcas pa zla ba bcu pa'i nyer lnga nas 'tshugs pa'i nyin lnga/sgo rum du ding sang gdan sa rang du mdzad pa'i phyag len ltar gur mgon gyi gtor chog bskang ba/ pu tra khang du gra slob bcus zhag gong mtshungs 'khor rkyang mi shis par bshad pas bdag bskyed kyi kye rdor du ma zad mgon po che chung gi gtor chog sngon du 'gro ba'i las mgon gyi bskang bstod rnams gtong ba'i mchod thebs su shab brag dkar gzhis ka them 'dzin dgu/ gdong sna'i shas zhing dang bcas par lag 'bab dgu brgya bcu bzhi/ sgrub blangs sa skya'i mchod gzhis rnying khungs dpe 'gre las gzhung khral chag /gzhi rtse lha rtse/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling / chos rgyal pho brang / mkhar rtse rnams nas gto me deb star chags su bkod pa'i brag ram du bla ma snying ri ba gra bcas bco lnga/ rmu gshongs bla brang du 'dar —353—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)grang mo che (254ba)ba rdo rje slob dpon the ba'i gra pa nyi shu bcas pas zla ba bcu pa'i tshes lngar tshugs te nyin lnga'i ring beg tse'i bskang ba/ brag ram mgon khang gi gtor gzhi sbo chas snga sor sa bcad tsam las mi 'dug pas da cha zla ba bcu gcig pa'i gza' tshes gang legs la gra pa bcu gcig gis bskang ba nyin gcig ma/ snyan shal dar lcog sogs nyams gsos rgyas pa/ sa skya bsam brling dang bo dong e gnyis su gdan sa gong ban gtsang pa rdo rje slob dpon the ba'i gra pa bco lnga res zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu nas nyin lnga'i bar dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i bskang ba/ 'phan yul dpal ldan rtser nā landa bco brgyad nas rdo rje slob dpon the ba'i gra pa brgyad kyis zla ba bcu pa'i nang du gur zhal pu tho'i bskang gso/ rtses dang bsam gtan gling du bkra shis rtse chos sde nas rdo rje slob dpon the ba'i gra pa bco lngas zla ba bcu pa'i nang du gur zhal pu tra beg tse dang bcas pa'i bskang bstod btsugs/ shangs bkra shis rtse bar g.yog bsdad grong gis dmag 'khris kyi 'don ma longs zer bar cha bzhag ma thub kyang bdag rkyen du gram nas them 'dzin bzhi/ lag 'bab chig brgya bdun cu/ dar chung par snga sor byin pa dang bgos phung gnyis brje dgos tshul byung ba ltar dud drug dang 'phar kha chos khang 'brog pa dud gsum gyi lag 'bab phyed bdun brgya/ skya rgyal la lung khang nang mig bcu gsum yod pa shas zhing thon sum cu so dgu 'khri med/ gra tshang la dar po gling khang pa sa skor/ chos 'khor gling chos ra snye thang gdal (255na)gshongs kyi yong 'bab rnams gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pas mchod dpon pa brgyud nan chags byung ba bzhin sbyor 'jags byas/nyer brgyad nas ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul bco lnga'i thog gdugs dkar bdun 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong / lha sar yer pa gra tshang gis sman bla bdun stong lnga brgya/ gsas khang pas 'bum chig brgya nyer lnga/ gdugs dkar sum stong / sgrol ma sher snying chog khri lnga stong re/ tshe gzungs sum khri rnams kyi tshogs gsog la stod ding ri ston chen khro bo lha mo ju thig la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas bcu gsum khor rtsis btab/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin tshangs pa dung thod can la lung bstan zhu —354

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chagabar chang khyim pa blo bzang mkhyen brtse btang ba'i 'phrin yig tshigs bcad tsho gos 'khor spyan gzigs snyan shal dang bcas dngos bshams yid sprul bskrun/ de'ang drag zhan rags rim gyis gang ci nas khri 'don byed dgos tshul bzhin 'os tho bsdus par grong smad a bar/ dbu mdzad/ mchod dpon pa/gra tshang gnyer pa bzhi po phal cher gyis deb bshar ma dang 'ga' zhig gis stag rtse tha'i ji bges pa/sde pa thon pa/ ra ma rtse ba/ stag lung dbu ma phyag mdzod/ dar khan dka' bcu/ rje drung rta tshag pa/ bsod nams dbang rgyal/ skyar po nas/ gdong nas/ rtse chen nas/ bka' brgyad nor bu/ stag ru ba tshe dbang bkra shis/ sgem bu ba/ mda' dpon tshe dbang / byang gling bsam grub rgyal po/ nang so dgos dgos/star sdong blo bzang tshe brtan rnams dang (255ba)dpon tshang byang ngos nas kyis sde pa zur pa bldabs na e 'bag dang grong smad a bar gyis sde pa bldab pa gnang tshe chos sde khag dang drung 'khor chos spyi zhus kyi gra bsgrigs na e legs kyi gleng gzhi sna tshogs byung ba brtag pa phul bar grong smad a bar rtse thon zhing gra tshang gnyer pa 'bring stod 'tshub che tsam/ gzhan ma rnams 'bring smad las mthar lhung ba'i lod pa rang ni ma byung / gang ltar brtag par ma zad lung bstan dang bcas/ tshes bcu'i phyi dro lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor thog mda' dpon tshe dbang dang stag ru pa tshe brtan bkra shis gnyis grong smad a bar la khur len byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan lab par btang ba'i lan du gang ci nas mi lcogs zer bar da lo'i gnas tshul dang bcas khyod 'jig rten par song bas gu dog byung ba 'dra/ phyag mdzod rgya seng gnyis nas bzung rim par btsun pa'i tha snyad med/ bla brang du bdag mo len pa sogs sngar ma grags ni da cha sus kyang byas mi yong khyod khyim pa la rab byung sgrub dgos pa'i don ma go ni ci la lab kyi rgyu mtshan byas par phebs sgo de 'dra byung dogs min shes sgo dog pa sogs rgyas tsam gleng bar bdag mo'i skor ma gtogs sde pa snga rting su dang yang dge skyon che ba med cing / lhag par khyod dang then khyer mi yong ba'i gsed bkrol btang bar lus gcong pa sogs nan lab zer 'dug pa de nyin lab mtshams ma bcad par bzhag /zla ba rting ma'i tshes bdun la stag lung phyag mdzod pa dang mchod —355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dpon pa gnyis brgyud pa'i sde pa a bar la lan (256na〉de gnyis bldabs par nan zhus ha cang ches par khrol cha byed dgos shar/ lho nas bar chings pa rnams phag rir 'byor bar rdo kha labs 'dug rung lho 'brug gis a cog kho rang tshor dbang ba dang sgang thog 'bras gshongs kyang spyi par 'jog dgos pa'i rgyal po nga lung la skyid sdug legs nyes sngon gyi bskos tshad las 'os ma 'das gshis sa bya'i chings lha pa kha rgyal du song ba des kyang ma 'thus phyin lab pa'i spros pa dang bral na'ang bde gzar gyi rigs 'di 'gro ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal la sbyor ba'i rgyu kho nar bsam nas slar rdo kha 'bring dang tha ma bskur ba'i rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi re ba skyung ba'i lugs byas/ rim gror mchod rten drug cur sku dkar dang zhig ral byung ba kha shas gsos/ rgyal du dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ gur zhal/pu tra/ beg tse rnams kyi bskang ba chig stong lnga brgya re/ phyag drug pa/ las gshin so sor nyis stong /'phyong rgyas su ri bo bde chen pas 'bum brgya/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du mchod pa sna lnga so sor brgya rtsa dang zhal gser snyan shal/ mchims phu/ shel brag /yang rdzong gsum du tsho gos brgya/bod 'bangs bde thabs dang khyad par 'brum pa sogs nad rims bzlog thabs la bkra bzang chos rje/ zur chu mig pa/ nub dgon pa/ brag dkar chu bzang pa bzhis nad bdag stobs 'joms btang pa'i yas rnams gangs te ser bskyal/ sgrol ma ba/ brag lha ba/ dung dgon pa/ rdo rje brag pa/ dpal ri ba lngas bstan ma'i (256ba7dos/ yul gru so so nas bka' 'gyur/ yum rgyas pa/ brgyad stong pa/ gzungs bsdus/ kha mchu nag po/ mchu sde lnga / la mchod rten la zhig gsos dang sku dkar cod pan/ klu gtor/ chab gtor/ srog blud lam 'phrang zhig gsos/ dag lugs bstan srid kyi rim gror btson dong ma gsum glod bkrol/ yer pa gra tshang gis sātstsha 'bum sogs gang rgyas bgyis/ ye shesargya mtsho'i ngor spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs gsol 'debs/ blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bskul pa'i smon lam/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis rgya nag tu kha btags la thags su 'thag rgyu'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul rnams brtsams/ gra snye mdo ba 'di rog gi brgyud pa dang / de nas sngags 'chang —356

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)shākya dpal bas sku mag mdzad de so zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal por grags pa'i so'i gdung 'khrul med yin na'ang zhal ngo phyi ma 'ga' zhig nas thos bsam bsnyen sgrub sogs rim gyis ca zhan du song zhing chos rje ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi sras ngo bo ngag dbang shākya dpal 'bar dge skyon gyis sdings po che'i gra pa byas 'dug na'ang rjes su spyon pa mi khyur zhugs te pha mes kyi chos la blo khug par kun bzang pa'i chang skyon dang / sdings po cher sdod mi'i brtol gnyis la chos gos 'og nas dug mda'i dpe bzhin klad pa sdugs mi 'dra byung ba yin nam gang ltar phyogs gcig tu dril ba'i mi ngo bo zos mi bde zhing snye mdo'i dgon sa ris rnams chos 'jig rten gang gi'ang lag rjes med pa'i chang rin kho nar mdzad snang ba byung chos pa (257na)dang ba ra ba btang ba'i chu dang 'o ma so sor phye ngos da cha snye mdo bas spyi sgos kyi rim gror sngags pa tshad ldan yod pa'i bkod 'dom byas/ dol chu mig dkar mor smon lam log pa'i dam sri mthu rtsal shin tu che ba zhig gis bstan 'gro spyi bye brag la gnod pa'i grags pa me bya nas je cher song ba'i don thog tu'ang khel ba mang rung nga la ma rag lta bu'i byed mi dkon zhing dol chu mig dkar mor sa bya'i mjug khang pa gsar brtsigs dang ka ca sogs spos pa'i rgyal po chags rten yong la re byas na'ang gnod pa je 'phel byung zhing nye char skya ser du mar nad yams dang gra pa re gnyis shi chad byung bas rkyen byas gra tshang gi gra pa rnams mgrin gcig pa lta bu'i las sbyor byed zer bar brten 'di gar rdo rje gro lod kyi rdo rje slob dpon sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho dang yang gsang ga me drag po'i rdo rje slob dpon gnang byung sngags 'chang blo bzang mkhyen brtses byas pa'i grangs bcad kyis sgrub khag gnyis/ rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog /chas rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ lug bya lung pa/ 'bri gung sprul sku rin po che/ ka tshal zur pa mnga' ris dkon cog lhun grub/ dpal ri sprul sku rnams kyis bla ma drag po/ gshin rje/ phur pa/ log tri sogs kyi sgo nas sgrub zhag bdun sngon du 'gro ba'i sreg pa me'i las sbyor gyis dam sri 'byung po 'khor bcas bsregs par rtags mtshan gyi rigs ngo mtshar ba shin tu mang zhing / ro bsregs pa'i dri ma lta —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bu kun gyis tsher ba'i yid ches (257ba)kyi gnas su gyur pa dngos su 'gro ba mang por mi 'jigs pa srog gi sbyin pa dang rgyud nas 'byung po de dag las ngan je rgyas su song ste gnas ngan len gyi duḥkha mi bzad pa myong ba las thar pa'i bde ba la bkod/ 'di skabs 'byung po de dag mgon skyabs dang bral ba'i gzu dpang bris shig gra tshang rdo rje brag dar sdings pa rnams nas sngags sdebs kyang mdzad/rgyab chos la ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul bcu gcig re'i thog gdugs dkar bzhi khri bzhi stong /sher snying thig 'bum chig khri brgyad stong song ba'i yon gra pa rer 'bru khal gnyis re/ nye skor dgon gra gtsang ba re bdun la mang ja sbyor sbrel bsngo rten gra pa re la 'bru khal re 'bab rtsis kyi gser btang ba'i gdugs dkar 'gro gang che/ yer par rgyud stod pas zhag gsum gyi bar mgon chos kyi bskang ba drug brgya go gsum/ shā sa na sa ya gcig rig 'bum nyi khri chig stong brgyad brgya/ drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog /chos 'khor rgyal du dmag zor ma/ gur zhal/ beg tse/ dga' tshal du chos skyong spyi'i bskang ba rnams khri/ phyag drug pa/ las gshin/ rnam sras gsum la stong / rdzong mgo bcu gcig tu dgra lha dpangs bstod/ yul lha gzhis bdag la gsol mchod rnams bsgrubs/ bar skabs su sngar mnan pa'i phung sri 'dra langs pa'i 'byung po mi bsrun pa 'ga' zhig la dmigs nas rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po ches 'jam dpal rlung sgrub/ gter ston rin po ches 'joms byed/ gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad kyi rdo rje slob dpon chos rje zil gnon rdo rjes byas te (258na)'gong po ar la gto pa'i sgrub pa btsugs par mtshan ltas legs pa mang du byung zhing rdo rje brag pas mnan pa gnang skabs klu bdud sdom kha brgyad pa'i rnam par dngos su bstan nas blangs tshod du 'dug / hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gnyis la chos rje bco brgyad pa/ bzang ldan mkhan zur pa rgyal rtse chos rje/ ras chung phug phyag mdzod/ khams rgya ston chos rje/ tre bo dpon chung / ā yu ma dur bod blo bzang sgrol ma/ sde pa phon mdo ba/ sde pa thon pa/ ko nga po gyar pa/ bar bzung tshe ring dar rgyas/ er khe gu ru tshe ring / mañdza shrī'i sku skye'i gnyer pa/ khod kyi dbon mo/ phan phyi dpon/ yer pa bla gnyer/ ldan —358—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)chos 'khor ba brgyad cu skor/ rgyal sras bso de nams bkra shis/ gter ston gyi yum sogs dang phrad cing la mo sku rten pa'i skra phud blangs/ ming dbang 'dus rgyal po btags/ dge bsnyen lnga/ dge tshul don gcig /dge slong brgya nyer gcig rnams la sdom pa phab/ tshes bzhir gong gi gser yig gzhon pas ster sbyin tshogs yon sogs sbyar te gra tshang nas sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/g.yon ru'i mi sna dge legs dpal 'byor gyis kyang ches lngar gong mtshungs bstar/ 'brog stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor gling gi sngags rams pa kun dga' rgya mtshos thang yig shel brag ma'i rgyugs sprad/ 'os tho gzhan ma rnams las gra tshang gnyer pa brtag pa ngo dkar ba dang grong smad a bar gyis kyang da cha thugs bsam gnang (258ba)rung gsar du thon rgyu dka' bas gra tshang gnyer pa rang la thugs thag bcad pa 'gab tshul zer ba khong pa bsam pa che zhing gra tshang rang du'ang med thebs med pa zhig yin kyang tshes brgyad kyi 'grub sbyor thog sde pa a bar dang bde chen khang gsar ba gnyis 'bras spungs bkra shis khang gsar du khur len byed dgos tshul lab par btang ba nged la lhag bsam rnam dag tsam las spros pa'i shes yong cher med pas shes 'dod ni gtan nas med/ 'gangs ches pas brtag pa zhib pa zhig gnang ba'i babs byung na bka' mi bcag zer ba de nyin stabs 'gros su song ba'i thag ma chod gshis slar mo rtsis zhib tu bgyis par dngos gzhi legs pa la lo gsum tsam nas nged rang ngam de min sde pa rang la gegs chags shin tu che ba de thog khur bzhag tshe 'tshub sangs pa byung bar brten lo gsum gyi ring khur len byed par thag bcad/ de nyin gong gi gser yig pa 'grul sdebs rnams dang 'di ga nas zhu yig 'bul bar mngags pa'i tsha mig mkhan po dang sde pa gnas gsar ba bcas la tshoms chen du yul lugs dang bstun pa'i rdzong ba bzabs shing de'i sang skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang / mkhan po can la sger du tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur/'brug pa sprul sku rin po che/ thos bsam dar rgyas gling bla gnyer/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa/ rdzogs—359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenachen sku skye/ dga' ldan phun gling (259na 〉 slob dpon lung rigs/ zhang ston phu mda'/ yab sku skye/khod dka' bcu'i dge rtsa byed mi/ bya khyung mkhan po'i mi sna/ sngags pa snying phu ba/ er khe chos skyabs kyi bu/ lha rgyal dar gyi bu/ ma dzñā shrī'i sku skye/ sde pa tshal pa bstang zhal/ yam bu rgyal po'i mi sna/ khams rgyal ston chos rje/ stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras/ bla ma snye mdo ba/ sras rin wo rtseb/ dge slong dar khan nang so/ de mo dbon po'i tsha bo/ me long dgon bla ma'i sku skye/ mtsho kha nas bi yig er khe tha'i ji dang /o rod rdo rje tha'i ji'i mi sna/ 'bras spungs blo gsal gling pa'i rigs gra'i skal ba skyal mi/ me rgan chos rje sogs dang mjal phrad byas/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po la mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can mir sprul pa'i dag thod rnyed par mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa bzhin tsa rir lan gsum byon pa'i gsum pa'i dus rnyed pa'i rang byon ma kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i dngos slob 'bri gung mkhan chen dri med rnam rgyal la byung ba rim gyis bla ma nam mkha' mdzod par yod 'dug pa khyab bdag zha lu pa chen por gtum mo zhag bdun ma zhus dus lo rgyus dang bcas dgongs par bab na khong gi 'bul ba 'dra gsung ba ltar 'di lo byin byung / tshes bcu nas rab 'byams pa kun dga'/ 'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang nam mkha' phun tsho gos lhun grub/ blo gros legs pa/ ngag dbang mkhes btsun rnams tshe bdag dang /blo bzang dbang rgyal gshin rje 'joms byed/ blo bzang 'phags pa ga me gu dra rnams kyi dmigs skor khrid de bsnyen mtshams bsdam bcug /tshes bcu (259ba)drug la dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa spun gyis 'gan sbyar gyis gtsos pa'i gos sna cha 'grig sogs ster sbyin/ mang 'gyed dang bcas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su gragasapa'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ tshes bco brgyad la skyar po ba 'byor ba'i rgya sog gi gnas tshul gleng ba rnamasanyan/ gong nas gser yig pa a zhang gi dbon po rgyal mtshan don grub dang rab 'byams pa sbyin pa bsam gtan 'byor ba'i tshes bcu dgur ngos phrad thog bka' shog gnang sbyin sprad cing bka' ngag bsgyur/ tshes nyi shu nas zhag lnga'i ring yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chur zhugs pa'i 'phrod bsten byas/—360

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 'damanga' ris gung thang phyogs nas gter ston zla ba zer ba zhig gis byang gter gyi gter zhabs rdzogs chen thugs kyi me long bton pa dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling bla mas bskur byung ba the tshom gyi gzhi las kha mtshon ma chod/ ras chung phug pa'i slob ma ga rma blo bzang gi gra par song ba'i ko long skyon can yod 'dra re zhig gang 'dod byed ma bcug pa 'gab tshul gleng mi byung ba nas glang bu mkhar rdzong sdod la de ga'i 'phros song rjes kho rang gi yi ge dang mang yul 'phags pa'i lha khang nas gdan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying tig dang bcas snye mo ban stag pa brgyud byung ba dus dbang gis mi rnams g.yo sgyu che bas tshig gi sbyor sde tsam la yid brtan mi 'dug gshis gter sku 'gangs can rnams kyi drung du brtag pa phul ba legs phyogs tsam babs pas khong rang la 'phrod lan dang glang bu mkhar du mi ched gnyer btang ba'i 'gro don 'phrin las (260na'i 'babs su skyong 'jug pa'i bslab ston byas/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la 'brug pa sprul sku rin po ches thog mar tshogs 'khor yin gsung ba don du dkar spro gnang cha bzabs rgyas thog mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i lugs kyi yun du gnas pa'i zhal 'don gnang / phyi dro phebs rdzongs dang phyag drug pa'i bka' bsgo dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ tshes gsum la chos rje rkan phu ba bsam yas su 'phrin gsol tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs dang bcas lung bstan zhu bar btang ba mkhar las stabs kyis gnod sbyin chen po 'khor gdug pa can khrid nas byang sham bha lar byon zhes khog zhugs ma byung zhing chos rgyal chen po phebs pa'i dri lan rnams rgyas par gsungs/ tshes dgur ri bo che'i zhabs drung ngag gi dbang po dang / gong gi gser yig pa tshor 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ gur nas bshad pa'i phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang / me rgan chos rjes gtsos bsnyen rdzogs bco brgyad/ dge tshul nyer gsum rnams bsgrubs/ gra tshang spyi so'i zhal thang gra tshang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pas khur blangs nas bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam bris/ mtsho sna bshad sgrub chos 'khor bas lcags sprul bde gzar gyi mjug tu dga' ldan pho brang gi gnyer pa'i yin zer ba'i thel rdzus byas pa sa khad 'gyangs —361—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)skyon gyis tshabs su song ba 'di lo lho brag bsam 'grub dgon pa ba dang sa ris kyi skor la zlos rtsod byung ba'i rkyen gyis rdzun phugs rdib pas dgon pa (260ba)'jig par nye bar shar rung 'chad nyan gyi gra sa yin 'dug pas gser chad dang gnyal gyi gshor 'debs blangs pa tsam las nyes dmigs dngos gzhi rnam par grol/tshes bcu gcig la gong du 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig rten sbrags ngag ma ster sbyin dang bcas gzhis len thog gser yig pa gnyis 'di ga nas btang ba'i rab 'byams pa blo bzang don grub dang lam gdong pa ngag dbang grags pa rnams rje me bda' dang bka' bsgo byas/ rdzing phyi zur pa mkhan rab 'byams pa seng ge /lha rin po che/ sde pa phon mdo ba/ gyang ro gser stengs bla ma byams gling mkhan po/ra ba stod slob dpon zur pa zing pa stag mgo'i bla ma gung thang rab 'byams pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal 'phags sde mkhan po ding ri glang 'bor bla ma rkan phu chos rje bstan 'dzin/ bar ta dpon/ jo bo skyabs/ mon pa gdung nag po/ bsod snyoms pa grub pa'i rdo rje/ gdan sa gong gi mgron gnyer/ slob dpon ngag dbang bkra shis/ brag dbar bla gra sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub/ bo dong sman phyi bla ma/ dbus gling bla ma rnams da dza phrad/ tshes bcu gsum la dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i btsun chung chos phun tshogs kyis chos spyod rab gsal dang sman bla'i rgyugs sprad/ gra tshang gi thang kha rnams la tshes bcu bzhir rab gnas mdor bsdus thog me tog brgya rtsa gtor zhing rab ston du dkar spro bshams/ tshes bco brgyad la thugs sras sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje dgon lag gi bla ma (261na sgoms dang bcas pas rgya gar sten tog sogs ras cha gtso bor gyur pa'i bdog pa'i dngos po gya nom pa mang 'gyed thog gra tshang gis 'bras ljongs dag snang ma'i sgo nas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ sprul skus mi tshos bskal pa mang por bzhugasazer mkhan yong gi 'dug na'ang nged kyis zhe thag pa nas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor lo gsum bzhi las mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs dgos gsung ba zla re tsam 'phul thub kyang chog pa pad las ha thal du ma —362

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 66)song ba'i drang po'i gtam du mchis/nyer gnyis la 'dam nas bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po dpon g.yog rags bsdus khri 'don la byon pa dang mjal/ a mdo a drag can gyis rta bcu dgu byin/ dge rgyun du dmigs pa'i lha rtse chosasder chos thog zla ba brgyad byung res bzhin tshes bco lngar rdzong nas mchod chas tsha ra ja thug sogs btang ba'i sman bla nyin gcig ma dang nyer lngar chos sde'i gnyer tshang nas mchod pa sna lnga bdun tshar ja thug gsum rer sman bla/ dbyar gnas kyi ring zhal 'don g.yin ma bzhag pa'i tshab tu sman bla gtong ba/ lcags rtse gri gu'i lha khang gi 'dzin spras dang yul pa'i gson dge gshin las kyi mchod gnas su ri bo bde chen pa'i gra pa brgyad grar phogs ja thug rkyen theg mthun rkyen dang bcas sbyar/ sde pa khri bskos kyi zla dus tshes grangs sogs gzhis ka shar a gur dang lu ma 'go slob dpon ngag dbang gnyis kyis zhib tu brtsis pa'i gnam bskos rgyal khab pho brang po ta la'i tshoms chen mor tshes nyer bzhi dbyangs e/ mchan gyi dar (261ba)rgud lang tsho/ gsal byed ṭa dang 'byung ba rlung ma nub pa/res gza' nyi ma/ las skar rgyal/ 'phrod dpal bes sbyor ba grub pa/ byed pa rig can/ nyi ma chu lug/rten 'brel tshor ba/ spar kha ging / sme ba drug dkar rnams yod pa'i gza' tshes skar sbyor mtha' dag legs pa'i nam langs tatpal bu mo'i thog sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pa lugs gnyis khrims kyi byed por dbang bskur ba'i rten 'brel du rin po che'i nor gzhong gro sogs 'bras bus gtams pa'i steng tham ka deb lde mig gis thog drangs te rtsis sprad rjes mtshan bkra'i khyad nas sde pa bde chen pa'i rgyal bu bsod nams rab brtan gyis sna drangs gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos gtsos sog po'i dpon khag mi bzang / rta tshag rje drung / chos gra chen po ser 'bras gnyis kyi slob dpon/gnyer las 'dzin/ sne mo ba/ sku skye/ dbon chos mdzad/ rme ru bla spyi/ ge re lha rin po che/ rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub/ chos 'khor lha sa'i ru dpon bzhi/ slob dpon gsum/ gnas khag /nye skor rnying khungs drung 'khor/ skyor lung mkhan slob/ ra ba stod bla gnyer/ 'phags sde mkhan po/ 'brug —363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)phyag mdzod/ zhang ston phu mda'/ zhwa dmar nag gi phyag mdzod/ mtshur phu/ gnas nang / yangs pa can/chu lam sdings gsum sogs stod lung phu mda'i chos sde khag dang drung 'khor/ gling stod smad sogs sne'u khul gyi mkhan slob chos rje drung 'khor rnams kyis drag zhan go babs mtshungs pa'i zhal dkar bteg /sde pa 'dar lo/ rnam gling paṇa (262na thin/ gung thang rab 'byams pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal gsum gyis gral 'phros rkang ma dang mig nas slad mar byed rtsis kyi 'phros gtam 'os 'tsham gyis zur brgyan/ phyi dro lha sa ba'i rgyal srid sna bdun gyis thog drangs nyi ma kha yar gyi bar lha sa'i tshes bcu/ rmi ru ba/ tshal yang dgon dbus gling / gung thang chos khri ba/ snye thang bkra shis sgang pa rnams kyis 'cham dang nye skor stod smad kyi bro gzhas shon sogs rtsed sna shin tu mang / ru 'dren gyi nam mkha' kha dog dmar por 'gyur zhing rlung dmar nag tu zhabrug pa'i 'tshub che/ sde pa'i tham phud 'phags ma ga lo ke shwa ra/ rje btsun rigs byed ma/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma gsum la snyan shal dang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis gra tshang du rdo rje gsang lam ma'i snyan dar gong ba/ gos dmar rgyan bzhi'i yol ba cha/ ri bo chos gling du snyan dar gong bcas phul ba rnams kyi kha byang bris/ skyid gzhongs ra ba smad nas bstan srung btsan rgod chen pos rang lo nyer lnga/ so bdun/ brgya bco lnga 'gro ba gsum gyi na tshod dang mthun pa'i 'dra 'bag bzhengs par sprul sku gsum gyis rab gnas mdzad na legs tshul byung ba byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos dad blangs kyis sbyin bdag byas pa grub nas dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas gzungs legs par phul te bla ma lha khang du bzhugs pa la nyer bzhir gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho/ gnam gang la rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po ches lha brag gter byon gyi rdo rje (262bskrag po rtsal/ zla ba rting ma'i tshes brgyad la dpal ri sprul skus dgongs pa yang zab rnams kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad/ 'di dag gi skabs khri 'bul la yongs pa'i sger du phrad pa dang don gcod par 'ongs pa sogs mi 'dzoms che gshis 'di nyin rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ rdzing phyi mkhan zur/ rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub/—364—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)dbus gling zur pa/ dga' ldan gsang sngags gling dang thar gling slob dpon/ rnam gling 'byor rgyas/brgyad gra rab 'byams pa kun tu bzang po/ rgyal legs bshad gling chos rje/ bco brgyad chos rje/ kong chab nag /bkra shis rab brtan/ stod lung chu bzang / 'brog pad gling / snye mo rgyal byed tshal/ thang sag /lho bsam grub dgon/ khyung tshang / thob rgyal sman ri ba/ chos 'khor yang rtse rnams kyi bla ma/tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog /me rgan tha'i ji'i mi sna/ dge slong dar khan nang so/ mi ching dbon po/ pā thur dbon po sogs mang dag la ja gral btang zhing lto brag thugs sras zla ba'i gra pa yon tan phun tshogs kyis shing rta chen po rtsa 'brel gyi rgyugs sprad/ nyer dgu la grong smad nas khri 'don du rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che dang gter ston rig 'dzin chen po sku mched/ gra tshang drung 'khor skya ser yongs rdzogs la dkar spro dmar spro dang bdog pa rgyas par bstar/gnam gang la gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan gyi khri rin po che'i sku tshab dang gra tshang gzhi byes kyi bla ma/ las sne ba/ sde pa stag rtse ba dang tshal pa/(263na)de khul gzhung rgyug drung 'khor/ 'bri stag phyag mdzod/ mnga' khul gyi chos sde khag /sde pa phon mdo ba ma zur/ dbu ma phyag mdzod/ gung mkhar gzhis sdod rdo rje dbang chen sogs mas dro khul gyi lha sde mi sde rwa sgreng mkhar rtse rdzong sdod dar byung nas/chos rje bco brgyad pa sogs 'phan yul gzhung rgyug gi lha sde mi sde/ 'ol dga' rdzong sdod rnam sras gling pa/ chos sde/ drung 'khor/ chu shur rdzong sdod ri gsum pa mnga' khul lha sde mi sde/ rgyal dang rnam rgyal rdzong sdod 'byor rgyas pa gzhung rgyug sogs dgas stod smad kyi chos sde drung 'khor/ snye thon gyi char gtogos pa'i lha sde mi sde/ khams rgya ston de mo ba lho rong rdzong gsum gyi ngo tshab/ star rdzong dang lhun grub mi 'gyur rab brtan gyi rdzong sdod kha ru ba dang cha dkar ba gnyis rnams kyis yul lugs dang bstun pa'i dngos po'i tshan grangs rgya cher spel bar gnyis len bshams/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyi lung bstan dang ding ri khro bo lha mo'i mo ngag ltar rdzong gzhis kha yar dang/ 'brel mtshungs chos sde khag nas bka' 'gyur chig brgya sum cu/ 'bum lnga brgya bcu gcig /rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum so sor bdun/—365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)brgyad stong pa chig stong /bskal bzang gsum/gdugs dkar bdun khri brgyad stong sum brgya drug cu/sher snying chig 'bum nyi khri lnga stong chig brgya bdun cu/phyag 'tshal nyer gcig chig 'bum bdun khri sum stong dgu brgya/tshe gzungs bdun 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhi brgya/lha rtser thub bstan dge 'phel ba bzhi bcus rnam rgyal stong mchod/gzhi rtser ngor pas263bsko'i dang gra grangs gong mtshungs kyis tshe dpag med 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i tshe chog 'chi blu dang bcas pa/pa rnam du zha lu ba gong mtshungs kyis tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sgrub mchod 'chi bslu dang bcas pa 'phyong rgyas su zhag gong 'dra dpal ri ba yongs rdzogs kyis 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i tshe chog/pho brang du bkra shis chos sde ba bzhi brgyas zhag gong mtshungs sgrol dkar gyi tshe chog/chos 'khor rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bskang ba khri/chos 'byung steng gi chos skyong spyir brgya/gur zhal pu tra beg tse phyag drug pa las gshin rnams la stong /gas tshor brgya/rwa sgreng du ja tshul gis thog jo 'brom gyi bstod pa nyi khri lnga stong sum brgya re/dga' ldan gsang sngags gling du gshin rje 'dus pa'i sngags ring bye ba bzlog pa dang bcas pa/yar 'brog nas nya 'bum phrag gi srog blu/rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul la dmigs te chos 'khor rgyal nas phyogs bzhin drug stob/de mtshungs dga' tshal nas phyag drug pa'i gtor bzlog/lho'i thus rim du dmag zor ma'i gtor bzlog/gong dkar du gla ba dang sgra sdigs byung bas yul rims la de khul mi ser spyi bsdus kyis dgra lha dpangs bstod/yul lha gsol mchod/thar gling pa nyi shus phyag drug pa/las gshin/dmag zor ma gsum gyi bskang ba brgya re'i mjug drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog rnams rgyas par bstar/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la rgyal legs bshad gling /bang rim chos sde/chab nag pa/bkra shis rab brtan bzhis bdog pa'i dngos po gya nom pa brkyang ste ring du sdod pa'i 264na ) rten 'brel bsgrigs/tshes gnyis kyi nyin rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa spyi sos khri 'don du rdo rje brag sprul sku dang gter ston sku mched drung 'khor skya ser bcas par dkar spro dmar spro'i gzhis len dang spyi sger gyis dngos po bzabs rgyas bte/6/sgam po/bsam sding /nyi lde/lcags zam/sding

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)po tshe rnams kyi sprul sku/ sde pa rgya ri ba/ skyid shod chos rje/ thod ri bshad sgrub gling dang / gsung rab gling gi slob dpon/ lcang ra chos mdzad ma dpal de ba'i dpon sa/ ā yu dzi'i mi sna bstan pa bzang po/ gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon/ yang ri sgar pa/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod/ snum nas/ sgrom mda' ba/ bang rim pa/ la thog zur mkhar ba so gos dang mjal phrad byas/ sgam po sprul sku sde pa dang gzims chud du mjal phrad mdzad khul khri 'don gyi nyin ma phebs zhus par bsnyad pas phyags len char can ma rab rib mdzad nas byon ma song /tshes gsum la gong dkar rdzong sdod 'brong rtse ba/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po/ zhabs drung lhun po rdzong pa sogs gong dkar/ yar 'brog /lho brag phyi nang / rgya mda' rdzong sdod bde gling pa sogs nyang po skor gyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyi zhal dkar 'degs pa'i dngos po gya nom pa dbul zhing bzhugs gral gyi thog gung thang rab 'byams pa'i dri lan sding po che'i sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos cho me mngon pa mdzod kyi le'u gsum pa gtso bor btan pa'i los gtam mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnam par grol ba'i legs bshad tshar (264ba)du dngar bas khri dang sum stan snye 'bol ba thams cad spyan sgor mor btang / 'ol dga' rin chen gling / dga' ldan don gnyis gling / sgar pa/ de mo dgon/ mchod khang rtse/ lha rtse chos sde/ brag lha/ sde pa lhun po rdzong pa/ glang lung dum bu chos 'khor ba/ gdang dgon/ rdza mon rtse/ sang sing / bkra shis chos gling / e lha khang dgon/lho brag dge bcu rnams kyi bla ma/ sras rin chen rtse nas/ 'phyong rgyas rdzong sdod lcang lo can pa/ g.yul rgyal rab brtan rdzong sdod myug nas/ rtse lha sgang rdzong sdod bon grong bstan pa/ 'bri gung gzhis sdod sgrog ra ba/ sdum ra nas/ mkhar ldan nas/ pu shud nas/ rdzong ri ba/ brag pa sha ba kha/ gra sdum po nas/rin spungs rdzong sdod na ga blo bzang / ka bzhi smad chos mdzad/ lco brag gnas gzhi chos rje/ kong po zin po ba/ nga phod pa/ chu skor a bo/ lto brag gdang pa/ ge ra nas/ stag smad pa/ glang bu nas/ sa ba gru pa/ btsan spro ba rnams dang phrad cing sbyor ra chung ba 'gro ba'i mgon po'i sprul sku'i gtsug phud —367—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)blangs te mtshan ngag dbang dbyangs can dga' ba'i lhar gsol/ chun su'i gyi bdog pa'i skyes gser yig pa rgyal thang du slebs pa'i ja dngul sogs dngos po gtos che ba 'dren pa'i sa rim dgos tshul ched du mngags pa'i pho nya 'byor/ rin chen bstan 'phel gyis gra tshang dge bskos byas pa'i 'jog la dngul srang bcu gsum las grub pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i kha byang / 'bri gung sprul sku rin po che'i chab shog lan snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa bris/ tshes drug la 'phyong rgyas (265na)rdzong sdod lcang lo can pa rdo rje/ pho brang rdzong sdod bstan 'dzin/g.yul rgyal lhun rtse dang mtsho sna lhun grub yang rtse'i rdzong sdod kyi ngo tshab/ sde pa bya ba'i sku tshab/ sbyor ra sprul sku sogs rdzong khag so so'i lha sde mi sde drung 'khor dang bcas pas dngos po'i skyes spams mtho bar bteg par bzhugs gral dga' ston bzabs par btang /tshes bdun gyi nyin chos sde chen po phan tshun gnyis nas slob dpon/ las tshan/ gra pa rags bsdus chabs cig par spyi sger gyis zang zing gi bdog pa gya nom pa maṇḍal du bstar te mchog gsum dpang por bzhugs pa'i bden tshig gsungs nas bkra shis kyi me tog char du phab/ gnas rnying zhabs drung / rgyal sras sher 'phel ba/ ras chung phug /dpal ri ba gsum gyi sprul sku/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ lho brag smra bo lcog pa dang rnying phu ba'i chos rje/ mdo sngags gling / dar rgyas gling /gra mig rtse/ li thang / ri khrod dga' ldan lnga'i bla ma/ phug nas/ 'bri lung nas/ ri bo bde chen gnyer pa/ 'byor rgyas pa/ ri sgo shag lho byang / bsam grub sgang pa/ rin spungs skyid khang pa/ zhal che bon grong pa/ rgya rgan pa/ sne'u sdong rtse'i mi sna/ rtse chen hung tha'i ji'i dbu mdzad dge slong / kong po brtul mi /o rong / spyang )grong pa/ lho sgo ba/ rdo dgon nas/ lhun grub wo brtan pa/ khyams stod pa rnams dang phrad/ rdo rje brag sprul skus rin po che rang gnas su 'byon pa'i rdzong ba zhus/tshes brgyad la sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis gter ston sku mched/ gra tshang drung 'khor skya ser bcas (265ba)par dga' ston thog zhal dkar 'degs pa'i legs skyes kyi tshan grangs spel ba'i ngo —368—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanatshab tu brag gdong rgyal phur mngags/ tshes bcur pa rnam rdzong sdod sa gru pa/ rin spungs rdzong sdod na ga blo bzang / g.yul rgyal rab brtan rdzong sdod myug pa/ rtse lha sgang rdzong sdod bon grong pa/ rgyal rtse 'u yug gling dkar gnyis kyi rdzong sdod dang kong po skyem gyi gzhis sdod rnams kyi do dam byas/ gnas rnying zhabs drung / spos khang dang dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan pos thog drangs rdzong khag yul gru so so'i skya ser 'dzom pa'i zhal dkar 'degs pa'i tshan grangs las sgo dang bstun pa'i dpangs mtho ba bzhugs phral gyi dga' ston du spel/ spyan g.yas/ ngam ring / spos khang / bzang ldan/ thub bstan rnam rgyal/gangs can/ ngor/ grang mo che/ sgye chu rnams kyi mkhan po/ byang rtse chos rje/ lug pa lung pa/ gnas gzhi ba/ zu lung pa/ lcags zam rje drung / shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor/ g.yag sde dgon/ zhi gnas/ bkra shis rab brtan/ rgyang ro gser sdings/ nub dgon/ lha khang / gur pa/ dus 'khor shar chen/ rtse chen bde ba can/ brag dkar chu bzang / bsam grub dga' ldan/ zha lu khang rnying rnams kyi bla ma/ gdan sagong 'og bkra shis lhun po gsum gyi phyag mdzod/ ru thog dbang po/ 'dar pa bsod nams lhun grub rdo rje/ sgang chen nas/ bkra shis mthong smon rab brtan/ bsam grub bde chen dar rgyas/ shun gzhi ga ba/ ram pa ba/ 'a sras pa/ yul lha ba/ dga' bde ba/ tshogs rgyal gling pa/ bkra shis rtse pa/ grong stod khang gsar ba/(2thun so rong nas/ bzhad chos pa/ mda' thang pa/rdo rdzong pa/ bkras mthong pa/ dar mo ba/ nas khang pa/ gser sdings pa/ sras skud pa/ skyid stod pa/ pā ras dang am mdo ba brgya skor re rnams dang phrad/mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lung sngon nas thob zin kyang rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po nas brgyud pa zhig 'od mchog sprul skur gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos gsan pa dang mgon po g.yul bzlog yongs rdzogs khyab 'jug gi bcos skor zur pa ratna gling pa'i drag dmar gyi dbang 'bring po/tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang / gter gas ra tshe dbang gsum rkyen sel gyi ched du zhus/ 'bras spungs ha sdong spyi sos tshes bcu gsum la ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung dang 'brel ba'i ster cha'i bdog pa —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)drung 'khor skya ser bcas par dkar spro dmar spro'i gzhis len/ gra tshang du ja 'gyed btang / sgar pa khams su bzhugs pa nas bzung skar lugs kyi sku skye rnams kyang de phyogs su byung bar dgos pa'i dbang gis bzos par mi dmangs tsho gleng zhing the tshom gyi gzhir byed 'dug pa dang rje chos dbyings rdo rjes da la'i hung tha'i ji la nged kyi bu 'di rgyal tshab pa yin min ma shes gsungs par brten gang yin dpyad dka' rung sgar pa gzhis byes mtha' dag mgrin gcig tu ngos 'dzin byas chog pa dgos tshul zer ba dme pa'i sku zhabs nas ngos 'dzin mdzad pa sogs yid ches yod na 'dod pa dang bstun chog ces labs pa ltar las sne ba rnams kyis lha sar dag pas brtan pa'i don (266ba)bzhin tshes bcu bzhi gza' tshes legs thog rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs kyi sku skye rkarma pa'i rigs sras nor bu bzang po dge tshul du bsgrubs shing mtshan blo bzang mchog dbyangs snyan grags ga me yongs 'du'i sder gsol/ chos rje sgar pa bla sgab che ba'i gnang cha spams bstod/ bla chen du rlom pa'i phyag sbar dam pa'i tshogs dang mi 'dra ba mdzad cing de lan gyi 'bul ba gzhis len bzabs/ sprul pa'i sku thugs sgam zhing gsung sgros kyis mtshon pa la'ang sgo ha cang mi dog pa'i mkhyen pa yangs pa zhig yong ba 'dra/brgyad gra rab 'byams pas za dam du gzhi gsum gyi phyag len yod tshul sogs 'dul ba'i 'phros gtam zhib tu mol ba dar lugs kyi 'dul bstan sngags phyogs dang mthun par 'grel thub pa gling ras padma rdo rje'i rnam thar la thog dgra gtong ba yod par snang /tshes bco lnga la gzhis rtse rdzong sdod 'dar pa bsod nams lhun grub rdo rje dang / rnam gling rdzong stod khyams stod pa gnyis kyis do dam byas/ gdan sa 'og dang bkra shis lhun po gnyis kyi phyag mdzod pa sogs mnga' 'og so so'i lha sde mi sde rnams kyis dpal 'byor dang bstun pa'i legs skyes kyi bdog pa bstar bar dga' ston spel/ zur chu mig pa/ sngags pa rdo dmar pa/ me long dgon bla ma/ nyin po phyug po ba/ gdong kha bkra shis rtse pa/ lha ri rtse pa/ ka drug ma/ mngon thong pa/ ka spe ba/ skyid sbug pa/ khab pa/ dgu gtor 'khor ba'i ja gsar skyel bar gra tshang gnyer pa ngag dbang smon lam/—370

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (ca)tshong dpon dgos dgos bcas (267na)pa'i lag do rags bsdus/ sngo ma lung pa sogs nyis brgya skor la ja gral btang / a rig bsam gtan can gyis rta zhe bzhi byin/ lcags zam sprul sku bar ma rab byung du bsgrubs shing mtshan blo gsal nyi zla 'od 'bar dbang phyug grub pa'i shing rtar gsol/sngar grub chen rin po che'i sku brnyan drung du brtag pa phul ba dang mthun pa'i tha mal gyi spyod tshul las 'das pa'i nges shes 'drong nges par mchis/ 'dar pa bsod nams lhun grub rdo rjes tshar chen yab sras kyi phyag nas ma gser chos zhal thang khrod kyi dmar po skor gsum byung ba nang rten du bzhugs/rgyal byed tshal pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal dang padma chos 'phel gnyis kyis mdzod dang dbu ma gsar rtsom gyi rgyugs sprad/tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin shel dkar rdzong sdod shul gzhis ka ba/ ngam ring rdzong sdod gong dkar lhun grub rab brtan pa/ lha rtse dang mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar po'i rdzong sdod gnyis kyi ngo tshab rnams kyis do dam byas/ gdan
