sa gong gi phyag mdzod/ ru thog dbang po dang glo po sde pa'i tshab ma sogs rdzong gzhis so so'i 'bangs skya ser rnams kyis legs skyes kyi tshan grangs bzhugs gral gyi thag ring por brkyang / dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur/ sems dpa' chen po/ ngor klu sdings pa/ rta nag sgrol ma ba/ gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon rnams dang phrad/ chos rje sgrol ma ba bsres par sras min sras su btags pa'i gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi dge skyon yod 'dug pa dbyung ste sku mched rnams phyogs (267ba)mthun du lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong yong ba'i gzhis rtse nas bsdam ra byed bcug /zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku phebs par chibs bsu ldang ba bzhugs khris mtshon pa'i bkur gzos sngar 'khyud ltar dang tshur gnang phar 'bul sogs gzhis len zhus/ chos 'brel dgos tshul phebs par thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i bzlas lung phul/ lho brag dpa' bo sprul sku bsnyen rdzogs bzhis 'dod 'dug pa dge tshul man chad zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul skus mkhan po dang rab 'byams pa kun tu bzang pos slob dpon mdzad nas bsgrubs zin pa bldab dgos med gsung ba rab 'byams —371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)pa rgyal ba ga rma pa dang jo mo phyogs mthun du mdzad pa sogs so so thar pa gzhir bzhag na phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad nas mdor bsdus pa zhig snang yang sa dge lta bu'i rtog ge ba rnam rtog can dang mi 'dra ba'i dpal dwags po'i bka' brgyud 'dir gang shar phyag rgya chen po'i yo lang gis ci mdzad chos su 'gro ba'i gu yangs pa 'dug gshis skya da'i tshang 'dra ba byung rung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phul zhing mtshan dgos phebs pa ngag dbang gtsug lag don grub tu gsol/ sprul pa'i sku gsung sgros 'byon pa rgyas shing thugs rgyud dul nyams che ba'i ltar snang spro bar mchis/ lto bod kyi chings tha ma'ang lho 'brug gi ma byas pa'i chings pa rnams kyis btsan gdong dbu mdzad kyi rjes zlos lta bu'i gzu chung btang ba sde pa thugs tshig cing shes ldan phal cher zhu chings phan tshun gnyis ga'i 'dod par bgo bsha' brgyab pa dgos rgyur (268na〉sto pa'i gang lab la cha bzhag na chings kyi tha snyad ga la yod sogs gleng ba nas mi mdzad ka med lta bu'i tsha bal gyis gtsos las sgo bsdams pa dang shel dkar nas mtsho sna'i bar gyi so srung gi dmag bteg pa'i bde gzar gyi 'go tshugs pa sems can spyi mthun gyi las su mngon/ bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod pas ster cha dngom che ba gra tshang du mang 'gyed gya nom pa dang bcas tshes bco brgyad la 'bras ljongs dag snang mar brten pa'i 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ gdan sa gong du gsung ngag slob bshad yongs rdzogs 'dar stod chos 'khor yang rtse'i mkhan por gsan na legs tshul gyi snyan sgron phul ba dgongs par 'dzems pa'i nye char phyag mdzod par bka' shog bka' ngag gnang 'dug pa'i zhu lan rgyas par phul/tshes nyi shur sde pa thon pas gra tshang drung 'khor skya ser bcas par gzhis len bzabs rgyas thog tshan grangs spel zhing 'di yan sger gzhung gi dga' ston tshang ma la rgyal po byon par 'bul ba dang khal kha o rod chun su'i gyi gser yig pa'i mi sna rnams kyang chad med du yod/ rgyal po dpon g.yog byang la 'byon gdong gi ja gral dang de thog sman khab dpal sdings bla ma phan phyi dka' bcu/ lha lung pa/ dga' ldan pa/ 'gram pa/ sman khab smad pa/ mtsho dbar ba/ nyan po ba/ mthong smon pa/ dga' —372

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)gdong pa/ dgu gtor ja gsar ba gdan sa gong 'og /rgyal mas mthon po/ ngor klu sdings/ thar pa rtse dang lnga'i tshong dpon/ stag 'du skyid khang pa/ bzhad khang shar pa/ dngul (264) ba/ rgyang 'go ba sogs dang phrad/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse ba blo bzang chos 'phel gyis phar phyin mtha' gcod rgyugs sprad/ zhag dgu'i bar gter sgrom gyi chu tshan bsten/ rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul sku rin po ches nged rang gi lus la bcar ba'i bsnyen phur lta bu zhig dgos tshul phebs pa chos rgyal byang pa'i gter ma yin min som nyir 'dug rung rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i bsnyen phur yun ring mdzad de sngags 'chang kun bzang dbang por gnang / de nas zur rtsa ba'i bla mas sku la yun ring bcangs nas nged la stsal ba lo grangs nyi shu skor bsnyen phur byas pa de phul ba gzims chung du phur sgrub mdzad pa dang dus 'grig pas dgyes rtser son nas gtso phur du bkod par mdzad pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten 'brel 'grig gam snyam/ mnyan yod bya gshongs mkhan po mang thos grags pa rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar gsol 'debs/ mkhas btsun rgya mtsho'i ngor bla bstod/ padma bka' thang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bas dpal ri'i par 'phrin las kyi stabs yig 'bru mi gsal ba kha yar 'dug pa nas gsar brke'i 'dun pa yod thog grong smad a bar gyis kyang mtshams sbyar bar bsten par byang sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bslab ston mdzad de lho rong rdzong du bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis bzhengs pa'i dkar chag smon lam/ byang gling bsam grub rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i sku brnyan la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig /dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar gyi gsol mchod rnams bris/nyer brgyad (269na〉pa sogs dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling bla spyis rta zhe brgyad/ a mdo dar khan chos rje/ gser khang dbon chung / dpon btsan rgod dar/ dbang rgyal/ spang rgyal/ ser sbar/dbang drag /rta mgrin skyabs sogs kyis gtsos rta nyis brgya nyer bdun byung /hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig la sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos bsu bzlog sogs rkyen sel gyi rim gro kha shas gnang / khri 'don zhal dkar du lha sa zur khang pas gter ston sku mched/ gnas gzhi —373—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)chos rje/ lha rin po che/ ru thog dbang po/ a mdo sum brgya skor sogs phyi mgron 'ga' zhig dang gra tshang drung 'khor skya ser gyi tshogs la dga' ston gyi bzhugs gral legs skyes kyi bdog pa bstar/gral 'phros pa rnam gling paṇa chen gyi dri lan sbus srang dkon gnyer spyon pas lho nas 'bras dang byang nas tshwa'i dpe bzhin lha sa'i dkar chag shas che ba'i lan btab/ de rdzogs nas rnam gling dkon chog chos grags kyis mjug sdud kyang bgyis/ rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la phyag drug pa'i bka' bsgo byas/thang chen mkhan po dung dkar ba/ khal kha sku skye/ dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling / dga' ldan gsang sngagasagling / bsam grub dga' ldan/ dga' ldan rab brtan/ mngon dga' chos sde/ 'brug la ba rnams kyi bla ma/ spo rong nam mkha' dgon/ a mdo ba'i rta 'bul ba bla ma gsum/ dpon khag drug /byings sum brgya skor la ja gral thog thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung phab/tshes drug la dum bu chos 'khor bas bdog pa'i skyes spel te tshe dpag med kyi cho ga'i sgo (269ba)nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung mdzad/ rab stims sa rje mdo rgyud kyi lung stor dang bcas pa'i legs par bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par gsungs/ skyed tshal mkhan zur rtses dang chen mo byang ma bas rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i drung du gsung ngag slob bshad rdzogs par gsan yang rnam g.yeng gi bsnyen chen sogs ye ma byung 'dug pa bstan rgyun la phan du re bas bar skabs su mdo'i 'chad nyan stabs chos rje bco brgyad pa'i drung du chag med gso dgos rnams gsos te lho mos su mthun rkyen sbyar nas gzhi bsnyen mdzad du bcug /bar khams nas 'phags pa lha'i phyag mdzod ge re dka' bcu/chos lung dang thar pa mkhan po/ zhi gnas slob dpon/ 'on dgon gong bla ma/ rwa sgreng me rgan chos rje/ dar khan em chi/ kong po yem chi/ rab brtan khung tha'i ji'i gzhi ma dang smad ta dkon cog gnyis kyi tsha bo rnams dang phrad/ gnyal gung snang chos rje mdzes pa nam mkha' bsod nams grags pa'i sku skye'i gtsug phud blangs shing ming ngag dbang nam mkha' bstan 'dzin du btags/ gung snang gdung brgyud kyis 'dzin srol yod gshis sku skye dwags gra tshang du slob gnyer du btang ba 'gab tshul mol/ dpal —374

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ 6)zha lu gser bkang gi ma he mchod pa'i dus ston thog snang srid lha srin sde brgyad thams cad 'bod pa'i skad gtong ba bya btang rtog med he ru ga'i chas can 'byor ba dang phrad cing bka' bsgo byas/ pho brang rtse nas kyang mi rkang lan gsum bus te skad gtong byed kyin 'dug pa tsham ngam che/ dga' ldan gsang gling pas tshes bcu'i 'chams rgyas pa dang (270na)bdog pa'i maṇḍal dang 'bras gshongs dag snang la brten pa'i tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem 'phru'i dag snang du byung ba'i slob dpon rsā po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor brda don lam zab tu grags par rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las 'bring po dang / tshe phur gnyis kyi bsnyen pa'i dmigs sgor phyag len dang bcas pa zhib par phul/ rgyal tshab sprul sku gong ma'i gdan sar khri 'don mnga' gsol la sde pa 'dar lo dang bkra shis rtse snang nas gzhan pa mngags pa'i gos phyi nang dngul spyad ja ras sogs kyi legs skyes spams mtho ba bstar/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs dpon g.yog byon par rta bsu dang bcas dga' ldan khang gsar du gnas mal mdzad cing dpon g.yog yongs rdzogos dang phrad thog ster sbyin gya nom pa 'dug /'di nas bzung thon gdong bar mtshams dam pa bdun gcig gi bar ma gtogs nyin gnangs chag bzhes chag gis po ta lar byon pa'i nyin khyongs kyi lhod pa byung / chos dang rim gro'i yon sogs bdog pa'i tshan grangs bstabs te rigs 'dzin chen po rang gnas su thegs/ stag lung zhabs drung rin po che khu dbon phebs pa'i zur pas rta nga lnga dang khri pas nyer lngas gtsos pa'i gnang cha mdzad/tshes bcu gsum la stag tshang ra ba stod pa dpon slob kyi dngos po'i tshan grangs dang bcas yun 'tsho'i smon lam gyi bden brjod gsungs/ stag lung zhabs drung zur pas brtan bzhugs shig 'bul gsung ba rje thang pa'i phyag len du grags pa phyogs bzhi ga nas zhal 'don (270ba)mdzad rgyu 'dug pa de ga yin nam snyam zhabs skor gnang rtsis kyi gra bsgrigs rung phyags phyir zhabs drung rtse pa'ang ma chud pa'i sku rkyang gis gnang cha dang thugs rtsom tshigs bcad ma lag gtod mdzad/ rjes su brtags tshe sde pa dang nged rang ma gtogs gzhan med na sku don gsung sgros gnang ba'i g.yo thabs kyi dgongs bzhed —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)la bka' brgyud kyi thugs gnad zab mo de ma go ba'i grong smad a bar/ mchod dbon/ 'dar nasarnam gral la yod skyon gyis de nyin gyi brel ba de 'bras med sbun ba 'phyar ba zhig byung / khu dbon sogs la gur nas bshad pa'i phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang dang gnang skyes kyi lan rgyas par phul/ lha rtse/ ngam ring / stag rtse/ shel dkar/ gting skyes dang lnga'i lha sde mi sde rnams kyi sa snying gtsor gyur gyi ster sbyin dang tshogs tshwad rgya cher bteg pa'i tshes bcu bzhir gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi cho gar brten pa'i tshe chog mdzad/ khyab bdag sman lung pa chen po'i sprul sku 'phyong rgyas dung dgon dang bon lung tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi sku skye snye mo a ta gling par byung ba'i dogs gnas la brten chos rje ngag dbang thub bstan dang thugs sras sprul sku gnyis kyis brtag pa dgos tshul ltar o rgyan chen po'i gter sku rnams kyi drung du mar me phul ba nges pa rnyed nas kha dmar gdags/tshes bco brgyad la stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras/ dpon e mi gan/ kre pa khro bo dkar po bu/ pā ras rta 'bul ba brgya skor/ lha sa lcang gseb khang pas dkar spro spoms 'bul/ zhang ston (271na)sgar pa khams nas 'khor ba'i rta so brgyad dang hor bar ta dpon gyis zhe lnga byin/ nag sbug dgon bla ma/ nag tshang tshe skyabs kyi bu/ er te ni da'i chin dang od khon gnyis kyi mi sna/ skyor lung mkhan po/don gnyis gling slob dpon zur pa rnams dang phrad cing khal kha yer te ni da'i chin can gyis rta nyer bdun/ kong po dar khan yem chis gser dngul ja gos dar gyis sna drangs pa'i brgya 'bul dngom che ba bteg /tshes nyi shur thar pa gling pas phur pa smad las kyi 'chams bstan pa'i tshe phag pa'i zhal brnyan gyon mi des 'don yin khul gyi dran par shar tshad las tha snyad yod pa mi byed 'dug pa rjes sor sne mo ba rnams kyis bsdam ra sdom gcod dgos rigs su mchis/ zhan byung du tshan grangs brkyang ste tshe'i rten 'brel mdzad/ tshogs gsog tu rdzong gzhis 'brel mtshungs kyi chos sde nas bka' 'gyur brgya nyi shu/ sher snying bzhi 'bum drug stong / 'bum brgya/ gdugs dkar nyis stong chig brgya/ sgrol ma lnga khri —376

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chanachig stong lnga brgya/ tshe gzungs drug khri/ pho brang du bkra shis sde pa sum cus zhag bco lnga'i bar sgrol dkar gyi tshe chog /'phyong rgyas su dpal ri ba bzhi bcus zhag gong mtshungs gshin rje nag po sum dril gyi sngags gang 'gro'i mjug gtor bzlog /gzhis rtser dar pa bzhi bcus zhag bcur drug cu pa/lha rtser grang chen pa sum cus sgrub zhag gong 'dra'i dmar chen gtor bzlog /gong dkar du chos sde ba sum cus zhag gong mtshungs zhal gyi gtor bzlog /dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pas (271na/sna sar gshin rje 'dus pa'i sngags ring bzlog bcas bye ba gnyis/ lha sar srog blu sum brgya/ dbus gtsang ris med dgon adhi gnyis pa yan la mang ja sbyor sbrel bsngo rten rnam gzhag 'gyed adhi dang por dge 'dun rer 'bru mkhar khal gnyis re/ gnyis par khal re ma/ ser 'bras dge gsum la dngul srang rig stong chig brgya bdun cu/ bkra shis lhun por gser zho sum brgya lhag bcas/ de phyin la ja dang rta sogs dpus cha/ mang ja 'gyed bsdoms par ya ju khor drug ma chig stong chig brgya bcu dgu/ rta nyis brgya bcu bdun/ dre'u bcu gnyis rnams btang zhing / chos skyong rnams kyi lung bstan dang 'di ga'i brtag pa bstun pa'i sde pa'i sku rim la rdzong 'go che ba bdun nas dgra lha dpangs bstod/rgyal du dmag zor ma dang beg tse'i bskang ba stong / chos stong gzhan tshor brgya/ thod ri bshad sgrub gling pas mtshan brjod chig 'bum sum stong lnga brgya/ tshe gzungs drug khri/ sgrol ma nyi khri/ sher snying chig khri/ ri mgo mtho ba brgyar dar lcog /lha sabs ma yas khra 'brug gsum du dar chen/ dpal lha lcog dang gnas chung lcog tu bskang ba brgya rtsa rnams dang rgyal khams spyi rim la yul che ba nas 'bum gra lnga dkon brtsegs thar pa chen po sprin chen klu 'bum rnams bcu re/ 'bring gis nyi khri gra lnga klu 'bum gsum lnga re/ chung bas brgyad stong pa gya lnga klu 'bum gsum lnga re/ so so'i yul lha mchod pa/rgyags rngan gtong ba dang jus rim du lha sa bsam yas khra 'brug gsum du nyin lnga'i bar mchod pa sna lnga brgya rtsa re (272na sgoms bgyis/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi sprul sku lha sa byang gling pa/ la mo/ sngags pa ri rgya bas mtshon kha shas la byung 'dra zer ba'i 'phros gleng thos na'ang —377—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenazhib tu dpyad par yid ches kyi gnas su ma gyur bzhin du lag 'thogs kyi blo 'tshub kyang dgos don med pas skad nyan tsam las mun nag mda' 'phen gyi rtsol ba ma byas rung drung 'tsho ba ngag dbang lhag bsam gyi skad char gsang phu dar ma sgang gi bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor gyi bur yod 'dra zer bas bden rdzun brtag par drung 'tsho lhag bsam dang gzhis ka shar lags a gur gnyis la rje nyid kyi dbang zhwa bskur te btang ba kha ma phye ba nas 'di nga'i zhwa yin gril chas yang 'di 'dra yod ces mngon shes lta bu bshad 'dug pa nas slob dpon chen po'i zhabs rjes ma'i zhal thang / padma mthong grol/ padma gu sa gur drag /rta phag sogs gter byon gyi sku byin can mang po bshams pa'i spyan sngar mar me phul bar dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyogs la dud pas mi gsal ba byung bar rnam 'joms dang byad 'grol gyi chus khrus gsol ba tsam gyis shin tu dngas par gyur pa gzhan don du gshegs rkyen slob ma dam tshig mi gtsang ba'i grib tu dogs shing slar phyag dpe ngo ma ltar snang legs rgyu med pa 'dra dang kha thi'i shubs byas pa'i dpe yid du 'ong ba bcas bskur bas ma 'dres par ngos 'dzin gsal bar byung /gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i mnal lam du shing 'bras smin pa sogs dang nged rang gi nying 'byul du yang yang (272ba)gsang drag po'i gter kha 'don rgyu yod khul gyis 'don par dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gtong rtsis byed pa sogs sgo du ma nas nges shes 'drongs pa byung bar brten hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga rgyal phur 'grub sbyor gyi thog 'phel gdung srung mdud dam rdzas bzang ja dang bcas mtshan ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams su gsol bar drung 'tsho ba dang lags a gur gnyis btang / dam sel gyis srung ma'i 'khu ldog la brten pa'i sprul sku'i bar chad zhi phyir yar klungs bkra shis rtser mgon po che chung las mkhan dang bcas par bskang bshags thog kye rdo rje/mgon po yab yum/ zhal/ pu tra/ beg tse rnams la 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar la kha byang btab ste dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan chu tshan la 'gro zhor du bskur/ gung thang gi chos skyong rnams dang khyad par zing pa stag mgo/ snang gsal sgang sogs sku skye na rim gyi dam can srung ma rnams la mchod gtor bskang —378—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)gso gzhis ka shar pa dang / blo khar yum sras la gtong dgos pa'i bslab bya byas/ 'od mchog sprul sku 'od gsal rang grol klong yangs kyis dgos tshul ltar bla ma bde chen dbang phyug gi zhal shes 'chi med srog 'dzin dang yang gsang dme drag po'i bsnyen sgrub 'jigs pa med pa'i zhal lung / bya nag rigs kyi thig le rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags kyis 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /drung yig rgya mtshos lha mo lcags phur mar snyan dar 'bul rgyu'i kha byang / lha sa ba blo bzang dpal 'byor (273na)gyis bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ gnas bcu/ lam rim brgyud pa/ 'khrungs rabs 'gro la rjes brtse ma lnga dang / dge slong blo gros rgyal bas 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig rnams bris/ 'od mchog pa'i dgon gnas lhas sgang sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis lho ka thog par bkag rten du gnang gshis sprul skur rong zangs la mkhar sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos gnang na'ang re zhig bya bral rnying pa rnams kyis go bgags/ de rnams zags nas gra tshang zhig btsugs par thebs dgos tshul nan che bar brten 'og lcang ra gzhis ka them 'dzin brgyad/ lag 'bab chig stong chig brgya rnams snang sog gong gsum gyi bsre bslad med pa'i bka' gter gyi bstan pa spyi dang bye brag sprul sku rgya zhang khrom/ gter kha gong 'og /byang gter/ratna gling pa/ mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched/ chos rgyal 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ byang bdag dbang po'i sde sogs kyis spyan drangs pa'i gter rnying dang / rigs 'dzin thugs tig /rgya can gyi yang gsang ga rma drag po sogs kyi ring lugs spel ched sbyor 'jags byas shing gra tshang gi ming o rgyan chos gter gling du btags/ sdum po nas rtsis rig smra ba'i khyu mchog don grub dbang rgyal grongs pa'i smon lam rten 'byor bar dge thebs kyi mthun rkyen rgyas par bsgrubs/ bsngo smon dang byang bu bzhu bar thugs dam smin po yod 'dug pa dang mthun pa'i mtshan ma legs pa byung / gter ston rin po che khong gi gsal 'debs la byon skabs nā ro mkha' spyod (273ba)dang rig byed ma'i thang sku gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam rten yar rgyab spyi ru ba brgyud pa'i byin rlabs can de phyag bris rten du byung /—379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)bsnyen sgrub kyi long ma byung ba'i bar chad kyi dbang gis kong po rdzogs chen sprul sku grongs pa'i smon lam rten du g.yu gong drag nas gter ston o rgyan gling pas spyan drangs pa'i li dmar gyi gu ru drag po'i sku sogs wor don ltar sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam yang dag byas/ phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gsung ngag rin po che sogs lta ba mang por ngo sprad pa bya lam rjes med kyi sems rnam rtog mtshan 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dam pos bcings par re dogs kyis lung bstan zhu 'dod gnas skabs su ji mi snyam pa lta bur lkog tu mi gtong bas mtshon pa'i phyi nang ma shes pas hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la srog bdag gi rgyal po tshangs pa chen por tshigs bcad kyi 'phrin gsol tshogs chas spyan gzigs dang bcas dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa rdzong bda' byas/ gtsang stod zha lu'i chos gra nas mkhan chen kun spangs rdo rje 'chang phebs pa dang mjal/ zhag bzhi'i bar stan chags ngos lho mos su sku mtshams gnang ba'i gsol chas 'khyud bzhin phul/ khal kha rab brtan khung tha'i ji lam du ma 'tsho ba'i dpon mo ḍā ki ma sras er khe tha'i ji blon 'bangs bcas pas gser dngul ja gos dar sogs kyi stong 'bul byung ba dge ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngos/ rgyal legs bshad gling gi bla ma grong gsar bas ma lcogs par bde yangs zur pa 'phyos pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rdzong bda' bgyis/ bzang ldan mkhan (274na)zur dpal rtse drung / rin sdings bla ma/ na bza' gling pa/ rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub/ zhang ston sgar ba rnams dang phrad cing byang chub gling sku skye'i yang srid kyi gtsug phud blangs nas ming ngag dbang rin chen du btags/ khams zur mangs chos rjes rta nyer bdun/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa'i zhang po ma gcig can gyis rta bco lnga dang rnga mo brgyad rnams byung / khal kha dpon mo ḍā ki mas gtsos dge tshul pha ma nyer gnyis dang / dge bsnyen pha ma bcu gnyis la sdom pa phab/ zha lu ma he mchod pa'i las gshin yab yum la snyan dar dkar dmar mthing gsum re 'bul rgyu'i kha byang brtsams/tshes bzhi nas bzung bdun gcig gi bar sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya shin tu dam pa'i ngos —380

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)pad gnubs brgyud pa'i zab chos gshin rje dmar nag gi srung bzlog bsad mnan nyams len gnad bsnun du byas/ ma he mchod pa'i snyan dar dmod nas gser phud len mi yongs dogs te thog ma nas mtshams khog tu bcug pas mtshams ral skyon ma dgos par bang chen 'phral du slog /tshes bcu bzhir sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis rgyal por gzhis len dang sde par spoms 'bul gyi skal bar dkar spro dmar spro'i bzhugs gral bstar zhing gos sna kha yar byin/ khra 'brug chos skyong gis bskul ma mdzad pa ltar tshangs pa gtso bor gyur pa dang mchod dpon pa'i ngor pho lha dpal 'byor rgyal po'i gsol mchod/ 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi ngor bla ma (274ba)'dod mos kyi gsol 'debs dang byes gra tshang 'phel rgyas kyi tshigs bcad smon lam/ gsang sngags mkhar ngag dbang bsod nams kyi 'dod mos ltar rgyal ba btsong kha pa dang nged rang tha mi dad pa dang ba so chos rgyal ba'i 'brungs rabs sa bon gang 'khod rgyu mtshan du byas pa/ blo bzang dbang rgyal gyi ngor bla ma chos dbang rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs rnams bris/tshes nyi shu nas lag pa g.yon pa'i dreg nad 'phar ba dar mo bas tshigs bshal btang bas 'jug pa byung rung slar rkang pa'i dreg kyang rim bzhin langs pa zhag bzhi bcu skor bro 'tshal ba'i 'phrod bsten drung 'tsho lhag bsam dang dar mo ba gnyis/ grong smad a bar/ dbu mdzad/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dpal grong rab 'byums pa rnams kyis nad g.yog rkang ma dang phur sgrub ma tshugs bar mchod dpon pas kyang rogs byas/ gzhis ka shar pas gdon 'grol dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas kha 'bar ma'i 'chi blu kha yar btang / ga rma pa dbang phyug rdo rjes sgrol ma lung bstan ma gdan drangs pa snye thang sogs nye skor gyi sa bcud la gnod 'dug gshis mkha' 'gro'i lag nas da la'i hung tha'i jis ched du skyel mi mngags pa yul khams la phan ched ze'u lha khang gsar du bzos nas 'or mchod khang du bzhugs su gsol rung sgar pa'i sku chas sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi dus lha sar drangs pa'i yig dril hrul po'i khrod na lung bstan sgrol ma'i 'dra dpe yin zer —381—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba'i shog bur sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma bris pa zhig thon (275na〉khyug pas mtshan ldan dbu thod bzhin thug med du 'gyur ram snyam/ lha sar blo gsal gling / bde yangs/ ra ba stod pa gsum gyi 'bum brgya gsum/ chos sde chen po phan tshun gnyis su dge 'dun lnga bcu rer ya ju khor drug ma re'i rtsis khyon khor drug ma go gnyis/ dga' ldan phun gling nas par zhus par mkhan rnams 'byor ba dang lhan du gsar rtsom smon lam/ yig bskur/ snyan dar zhal yig /bslab bya rnams kyi 'phros/ sman bla/ 'gro don che stabs par sngon ma zad nyams dang / gzungs sngags par thung sor bzhag ma dag pa min kyang rgyal rtse'i gzungs 'bum glegs bam ma skad gnyis smra ba thugs rje dpal zhabs kyis zhus dag gnang gshis de dang bstun pa'i slar yang par gsar/ dpal yang dag mar me dgu pa'i mngon dkyil/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i dpal kye rdo rje'i phyi bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ nang rdzogs rim rnam bshad skal bzang snying gi padma bzhad pa/ bskal par yig 'bru rnams gsar ngad can du bzhugs thebs la klong chen pas mdzad pa'i gsar snying 'grel pa phyogs bcu mun sel/ se dkar rigs kyi thig le 'dar pa lo chen gyis gsar bsgyur dbyangs can brda sprod kyi rtsa ba dang rgya 'grel slob dpon chen po a nu bhu tis mdzad pa'i rab tu bya ba gsal ldan/ 'di ga nas brtsams pa'i brda sprod kyi smon lam/ sman bla don grub pas mdzad pa'i sku gzugs cha tshad dang sprul sku nga la gzigs kyis mdzad pa'i mchod rten gyi thig rtsa dang bcas pa'i gsar bskrun rnams 'byor/ lho phyogs kyi jus rim la dge lugs gra tshang rnams la mang ja 'phar ma sbyor sbrel thog sngags dgon dang gzhis dgon rnams kyis gtor bzlog /mdo gra rnams dang sa lugs adhi dang po rnams la ja thug bzhi re'i thog sher snying / gra tshang gis tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog /ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul bco lnga sngon du 'gro ba'i 'di nyin 'phar ja bzhi dang dbus gtsang gi dgon khag thams cad nas mdo sgrub dang bcas tshogs zangs kha sbub/ zha lu ma he mchod pa'i skabs gzhan gyi mang ja sogs ma 'dres pa'i gtong sgo sgrig chug sngar rgyun thog ja 'phar ma gsum dang dge 'dun rer 'bru mkhar khal gnyis re —382

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)'bab rtsis kyi gser 'gyed/ bzhes sgra dang bcas lho 'brug steng du kha bsgyur/ gzhan ma gra slob nyer gsum res grabs zhag gsum sgrub zhag bdun ma'i sgo nas gtor mdos mnan sreg pa ngam ring du nub dgon pa dang lha sar dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pa gnyis kyis tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog dang ki dang gi dgra mnan/ shel dkar du brag dkar chu bzang pa/ ri bo bkra bzang du chos rje bkra bzang pa/ pa rnam du brag lha ba/ rgyal rtser yar 'brog gsang sngags chos gling dang bgrad pa/ rnam gling du sgrol ma ba so so nas tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog dang dgra mnan/ lha rtser 'dar grang chen pas zhal gyi gtor bzlog /thub bstan dge 'phel ba dang bsam grub dgon gsar ba gnyis kyis dmar chen gtor bzlog /chu mig pas 'char ga'i gtor (27na〉shi/ dka' bcu kun dga' rgya mtshos gra tshang du ja 'gyed gra pa phal cher gyis gra ja dang tsha ba ci rigs/ gra pa spyis bsdus pa'i ser 'bras gsang phur mang ja bzhes thug kha shas/ gzer lnga 'khrug pa yun ring gtong ba'i gra ja/ gra tshang rang gis tshogos su dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi cho ga bdun gcig gi bar mdzad cing mchod dpon pas 'dzugs ston nyin thub bzabs rgyas dang bcas a ti khyoḥgacig ma btsugs/ zhang tsha dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis ring 'tshor dmigs te ja 'gyed dang chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtses gra ja 'ga' zhig skol/ zhang ston phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis pho brang gi yas mas tshor gta' gter dang rten 'dzugs kyi bcos ka bgyis/ pha bong kha'i gra pa brgyad kyis zhag bco lnga'i ring klu gtor/ po ta la'i rtser se ra nas brgyad gras gtsug tor sde lnga sgrogs/ 'bras spungs nas brgyad gras chab gtor 'bum/ dga' ldan gsang sngags gling du gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i drag sngags bye ba bzlog bcas/ bsam yas su rab byung pas dri med bshags rgyud stong / rdzong gzhis khag bcu bzhin bka' 'gyur chig brgya nyi shu/ bskal bzang chig brgya/ 'bum brgya/ brgyad stong pa stong / thang yig nyis stong / gser 'od nyis stong nyis brgya/dkon brtsegs/ ting 'dzin rgyal po/ thar pa chen po gsum chig brgya re/ gzungs 'dus nyis brgya/sman bla chig khri chig stong / le'u bdun ma chig khri/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol sum khri/ smon lam rnam —383

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)gsum lnga khri rnams btang ba'i yon thob rgya dngul srang nyis brgya gya bzhi/ gos kha chog (276ba〉stong drug brgya so gcig /zi ling sbu ja sbag go gcig rnams song / gra tshang nas brgya bzhi/ gter ston rin po ches rgyal mtshan dang ma mdos/ se 'bras su ja tshul 'gyed bcas steng lhung bshags 'bum/sgrol ma sum 'bum/ g.yag lug sogs kyi srog blu brgya rtsa/ dbus gtsang gi ris med dgon adhi gnyis pa yan la mang ja bsngo rten 'gyed dbus khul nas gnyal byar sogs la gra btsun bco lngar khams dngul srang re/ dwags kong / e rong / lho brag /gtsang khul bcas par nyi shur srang re btang ba bsdoms par sum stong bzhi brgya nga gsum/ dbus gtsang gi rdzong gzhis thams cad nas ngan long dbul phongs gang 'dzom la sbyin gtong rgya che ba/ 'u lag la mar khal lnga brgya chas thebs su btang ba'i lam 'phrang bzo bcos/ ri rtse bcu gsum la bsangs dang dar lcog /lha sa ru bzhir sgo 'gyed dud rer tā tshang mkhar nyag re dang dud brgyad rer khams dngul srang re song ba dril bar ja sbag gya bdun dang dngul srang chog brgya brgyad cu/ nye skor 'u lag spyir ja sbag bcu bdun dang rtsam gzhor khal chog brgya bcu drug /phyi sha nyas brgya so bzhi/ lha ldan/ ra mo che/ po ta la'i mchod khang tshor gser chab la srang gang dang zho gsum/ dkar me 'bul thengs gsum la mar khal brgyad brgya rnams song /rim gro gang la'ang mi bslu ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ba gzhir bcas kyang tshe rabs sngon ma mang por gzhan gyi yan lag bcad pas mtshon las tshan po che bsags tshod nas sman bla bzang spyod sogs sdig bshags kyi rigs rnams 'phrod ngo che bar snang / zhabs drung khri lcam de nyid kyi sku mchod kye rdor sgrub (277na)pa 'dzum bag dang bcas lho nub phyogs kyi nam mkha' la yer rer bzhud pa byung bas lha'i srid pa 'dzin 'dra zhes kha dmar gdags/ de dang mthun pa sreg sbyangs dus a dang dung rang byon gdung lcags gcod sogs mtshan ltas legs par byung snang bas lha gnas khyad par can zhig tu 'phos pa yin nam snyam/ khong pa sku tshe'i stod la gso dpyad kyi 'chad nyan dang 'gro don gnyis ka 'phel ba'i phan yon du mchis/ gser btul ma srang gsum zho do'i gser chab 'phrul snang / ra mo —384

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadache/ dmar po ri gsum gyi sku brnyan phal che bar sgron/ rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal gyi khog rnying la jo bo rgyal mtshan pa yin zer ba babs pa'i rta stag gdan dkar yol gsol mchod dgos tshul byung ba ltar dang dga' gdong sngags rams pas gser zangs las grub pa'i 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i smon lam brtsams lha sa dkyil 'khor sdings su 'bras spungs bde yangs pa gra pa brgyas zhag lnga'i ring jo shāka la mchod 'bul bzabs rgyas thog bzang spyod byams smon lhung bshags la sogs sdig bshags kyi zhal 'don mdzad/ ru bzhi'i sgo 'gyed la tā tshang nyag do re'i rtsis ja sbag chig brgya brgyad cu/ 'di gar bro 'tshal ba'i rim gror dar rgyas chos sdings nas gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po gdan drangs/gdon 'grol/ byab gtor/ 'chi blu/ mkha' 'gro dang sde brgyad kyi grib sel rnams rim par gnang zhing rgya 'dre 'gong por dmigs pa'i drag dmar gyi sgrub par gtor bzlog dang bcas smin rgyas su mdzad/(277ba)bde chen tha'i ji bsod nams lha'i dbang phyug sku gshegs pa'i bsngo byang 'byor don ltar dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos shing dgongs rdzogs thebs kyi bdog pa bstar/phur sgrub dang 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i zor sgrub gnyis sngar 'byud ngos nged rang nad mjug stabs 'gro ma thub rung gra tshang nas me 'brug gnam lo tshes pa'i srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa dang mchod yon gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i lo gsar gyi dga' ston nyin gsum snga 'byud thog chun su'i gyi mi sna hā'i cha'u lung dang lang lang su khal kha o rod kyi gser yig pas mtshon phyogs 'dus mang por gzhis len bzabs/ nged rang gi ga 'gas su sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs/ gter ston rin po che sogs nang skor kha shas la bzhugs gral dang rgyal po sras blon nyung bsdus la ja gral btang /sde pa cung zad bsnyung ba'i rtsa ma bde ba sgos kyi dgra lhar song gshis thang chen bshan pa lag dmar la gsol mchod bzabs rgyas 'bum thang bsod dbang 'bul bar btang ba'i sdebs su tshan grangs spyan gzigs dang bcas ka 'phreng las brtsams pa'i 'phrin shog /drung 'tsho dar mo bas lha sa/ ra mo che/po ta la gsum du brgya mchod snyan shal/ gra tshang du gra ja bcu mkha' 'gro lngar snyan dar sna lnga phul —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)ba'i kha byang / drung 'tsho ngag dbang lhag bsam gyis mkhar rgyar 'phan phul ba'i kha yig sngags ram pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang dge slong yon tan dpal bzang gnyis kyis tshe bdag /dge slong dpal rgyam pa/ blo bzang dpal 'byor/ gnyos gung ru ba (278na〉lo rje dbang rgyal lhun grub gsum gyis zhi khro bka' brgyad/ sngags rams pa blo bzang skyes mchoge gis thugs sgrub drag po rtsal/ blo bzang thabs mkhas kyis ga rma gu dra rnams kyi gzhi bsnyen gtong bcug skabs dgos tshul ltar bla ma yi dam rang sems dbyer med du gsol ba btab chog pa/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis ri bo chos gling du gos rtags brgyad ri mo can gyi gnam rgyan/ 'brug ris ma'i rgyal mtshan bzhi phul ba'i kha byang / 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis smon lam chen mor gra skor byas pa'i tshe gra tshang du dngul srang nyer gsum las grub pa'i kong phul ba dang / rda pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis gra tshang gi dge skos kyi 'jog la dngul srang bcu gsum gyi pad sder phul ba'i kha byang / dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas nu bo bkra shis thog chod kyi don du sman bla rin 'byung mi 'khrugs pa gsum gyi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam/ dri med bshags rgyud snga sor par brkos grub pa rgyud kha shas dang bstun tshe dag ma dag ci rigs snang ba zhus dag dang zhabs drung byang pa'i phyag dpe phyag dreg ma gzhan rnams dang tshig zur cung mi mthun pa 'dug pa bstan rgyun la dmigs nas brkos rgyu'i par byang le tshan/ blo bzang thabs mkhas kyi nyams len du ga rma gu ru'i bsnyen yig /rdzing phyi mkhan chen co ne cho me rje byang phyogs hor gyi rgyal khams su gzhung spel bar 'byon pa'i sta gon dus gsung gis bskul ba'i bla ma dang rigs gsum mgon po dbyer med du gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs (278ba)bcad gong dkar chos sde'i 'chad nyan pa dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas rdo pa chos rje dge ba'i dbang po'i zhal 'don du bdag bstod dang / bla chen shākya rdo rje'i gsol 'debs rnams bris/ sde pa bsnyan pa'i sku rim du brag dbar ba brgyas brgyad stong pa chig stong lnga brgya bcu bdun/ gdugs dkar drug stong /sgrol ma sher snying tshig khri lnga stong / tshe gzungs sum khri/ tshes dgur rig 'dzin chen po thar pa gling gi —386

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (cha)zhig gsos kyi thugs brel stabs sri zhu bgyis te chibs kha bskyod/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs 'di lo sman 'dam gyi sku bsnyan gra tshar/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog /dngul gdung sogs rten bzhengs mang bar mdzad pa'i khyad nas zang rir tshes bcu gnyis la thon pa'i sngon 'gror gser dngul gos dar ja ras sogs kyi ster cha bzabs par byas/ rigs 'dzin padma gling pas sman mdo nas gdan drangs pa'i rta phag /thugs sras zla ba bsam yas su rab gnas la byon skabs chur shor nas zla gnyis tsam song yang ma gnod par nya dol gyi khrod nas bton pa rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi phyag tu byung ba'i ngo mtshar can/ slob dpon chen pos bza' bdud dam la btags pa'i phyag rdor nyang gi gter ma/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i sku brnyan bkra shis rdo kha ma/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku me thub ma sogs sku gsung thugs rten/ sbub sil gyis mtshon pa'i 'phral gyi nyer dpyad gang dgosadang / lo lo bzhin gser zho phyed nyis brgya/ rgya dngul srang phyed nyis brgya rnams yong ba'i 'dzin/gzungs bzhugs la 'bul (279na)rgyu'i byin rten rnam grangs mang ba/ 'byon gdong dmag zor ma'i zhal thang dang bcas bka' bsgo rgyas par byas/smon lam chen mo sngar rgyun ltar tshugs par dge 'dun drug stong nyis brgya lnga bcu skor la gra pa bcur ya ju bar khag re dang mtha' gral la lnga rer 'go khag re'i rtsis khyon khor drug ma chig brgya nyer lnga/ gra pa rer dngul zho do re'i rtsis kyi gos sna/ dkar yol/ bzed zhal/ chab ril rta sga mas sogasakyi spong dag /gra pa bcu rer khams dngul zho re'i rtsis 'gyed gsum gyis bsnyen bkur/ zhing mo che ba 'phrin las sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyi lag g.yog tu 'gyur pa byung 'dug pas dgos tshul ltar lha sa gad po shag pa'i mag pa dang rnam rab blo rtsa khungs kyi mi ser dud 'dzin bcu/ lag 'bab drug brgya gya dgu sprad/ gra tshang du dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i bskang bshags zhag bcu'i bar btang bas nad mjug la 'phrod pa byung / bzang ldan chos sde pa bka' lnga pa ngag dbang nor bus byams chos sde lnga dang dwags lha sgam po'i gra pa chos dbyings rab brtan gyis bka' thang shel brag ma'i rgyugs sprad/—387—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)dge rgyas ngag dbang rdo rje can gyi rta nyer drug byung / tshes nyi shu'i nyin tshoms chen mor mchod yon gnyis dang lhan cig par chun su'i gyi mi sna gtso bo hā'i cha'u lung dang lang lang su gnyis 'bring she'u pe'i bdun/ de 'og g.yog dang bcas bdun cu skor/ khal kha khun du len dur ge chi/ da'i chin kho sho'u chi/ e bu gen/ se chen rgyal po/ da la'i hung tha'i ji/ dga' ldan dar rgyas/ thor god tshe ring rnamasakyi mi sna sogs skya ser (279ba)sum brgya skor la gzhis len bzabs rgyas kyi thog chun su'i gyis 'di gar yi ge sgam bcas/ rten gser dbus zho khri tsho las grub pa'i gser gyi khog ma/ sgrogs/mdong mo bzhi/ dngul srang khri tsho/ ljangs ja rgya khal khri tsho rnams dang dpon mos gas bzhi nas/ wang ca skyon/ sba yan/ le'u shan sogs kyi bskur ma/ sde pa dang rgyal po so sor gser mdong cha rer dbus zho lnga stong don brgyad re/ dngul srang stong phrag lnga re/ ljangs ja rgya khal lnga stong re/ khal kha o rod kyi rgyal po dang dpon so so'i rten chas sogs srid pa'i 'byor pa phyur bur spungs pa snyigs dus kyi rab tu byung ba tsho'i rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed pa'i rtser son/ rnam gling paṇa chen dang sa ba gru pa lha dbang rdo rje gnyis kyis 'phros gtam bgyis/ bzhugs gral dngos gzhi grol nas rgya sog gi mi sna so sor ngosakyi dri mal byas/ phyi dro rdzing phyi mkhan po/ pha bong kha pa/ ser stod zur pa/ bde 'byor gra tshang /myug chos gling / 'phel rgyas gling / gsang do bo mgo rnams kyi bla ma/ mdo pa chos rje/ spo bo ban grong pa/ dpal de ra tha/chen/ stag lung khri pa'i phyag mdzod/ par zhus/pa bzhi/ yig mkhan bzhi/ par pa sobargyad/ zur khang shar pa'i lcam/ rnam sras gling pa bkra shis rab brtan rnams dang phrad cing mdze lha khang gi sku skyer chos dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor btags/nyer bzhi la dga' ldan khri rin po che byams pa bkra shis smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs zhor ngos kyi mjal ba lugs gnyis dang 'brel pa'i gsung gleng 'phel zhing babs chags par snang /'bras spungs pa'i (280na〉slob dpon las sne ba sogs la ja gral btang / lha sa byang gling pas mchod yon la bsnyen bkur gyi skal ba'i dkar spro dmar spro'i gzhis len ster cha sogs spams mtho ba bteg /—388

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gnyis pa/ (chadasbus srang gser khang pas dkar spro'i spom 'bul bstar/ chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa blo bzang tshe ring gis gsar rtsom phar phyin gyi rgyugs sprad/nyer brgyad la par pa tshor rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs/ gur nas bshad pa'i 'byung 'dul/ chun su'i gyi mi sna nyung bsdus la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na gtso rkyang / thugs rje chen po gtso 'bor gsum pa/ rdzing phyi mkhan po co ne chos rje/ rab brtan hung tha'i ji'i dge tshul no gon dha ra/ kong po dar khan em chi/ se chen rgyal po sogs kyi mi sna khag rnams la skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang rnams bskur/ se chen rgyal po'i mi sna no yon dbon po/ phun gling par zhus pa gsum sogs dge slong bcu gsum/ thar rgyas chos mdzad sogs dge tshul nyer bzhi rnams bsgrubs/ dol chos rdzong par yar rgyab byang pa sogs mang pos phul pa'i rang byon ring bsrel sku brnyan sogs mang tsam yod pa rnams dol gsung gling par byung 'dug pa nas spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi zhun thigs las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi snang brnyan gyi mthar/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇa/ byang sems zla rgyal/ jo mo tsha rtsi ma/ rgyal sras thogs med/ rgyal thang pa/ mkhan chen don yod rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grags rgyal ba rnams kyi yung bru lta bu'i ring (280ba)bsrel gyis bskor zhing / mi la'i ras gos/ kha che paṇa chen/ sa paṇa/ khro lo/ bu ston rnams kyi dbu lo bzhugs pa'i gas la/ 'phags chen bsod nams dar gyi tshems ring bsrel can bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung sha rī ram/ bram ze mchog sred/ sha bo sgang pa/ rje btsun grags pa/ kun mkhyen dol bo ba/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyal sras thogs med/ dgra bcom pa gzhen nu byang chub/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po rnams kyi ring bsrel/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'phags chen bsod nams dar/'phags dbon gsum gyi tshems/ dge slong ma dpal mo'i dbu klad ring bsrel gyi gong bu can/ pha dam pa'i gdung / rkarma pa shi'i thugs ring bsrel can dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyis mtshan pa rnams —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khenabazhugs pa'i gser zangs kyi rnam rgyal mchod rten/ paṇa chen nags rin dang 'phags dbon gyi zhun thigs bzhugs pa'i gab tse/ gnyags dbon gyi sku cog gang ma che gra me thub ma/ dus 'khor rgya nag ma tsandan dkar po las grub pa dngos gtsang ba/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong kā ma rū pa'i rdo las grub pa/ tsandan rgarnyi ṣa las grub pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi sku/ mkhan po bodhi satwa'i zhabs rjesal 'od zer 'phros pa'i lhas bskor ba'i bris thang / 'phags dbon gyi nang mchod ka pā la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i snang brnyan rang byon yod pa/ hor jus kyi rten khebs/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos (281na)rgyal rnams kyis rim par dbang gdan du bstar ba'i byin rten/ mnyam med jo bo wo po'i chos dung sogs pho brang 'dir bzhugs 'os rnams rtsis blangs shing 'phros rnams phyir slog /hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la dpon mo bsod nams chos 'dzom/—390

〈gangs can khyad nor 〉 dpe tshogs chen mo'i bsdu sgrig dang las zhugs mi sna'i mtshan tho/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gtso bo/ blo bzang lhun grub/ dbang grags/ tshe ring /bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gzhen pa/ blo bzang stobs bcu/ phur bu chos 'phel/las zhugs mi sna/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ rgyal mtshan byams pa/ grags pa kun ldan/ tshe brtan rdo rje/blo bzang 'phags mchog /snyan grags/ blo bzang 'jigs med/ tshe ring ma/byams pa brtson 'grus/ rdo rje mtsho/ spen pa/ lhag pa sgrol ma/ tshe ring chos sgron/lha skyid/ bsod nams dbyangs can/deb 'di'i zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ phur bu chos 'phel/glog 'phrul yig 'jug pa/ lhag pa sgrol ma/ bsod nams dbyangs can/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ byams pa brtson 'grus/
